items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on the data infrastructure that powers our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the systems that make world-class data possible. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:

 

 - Building large-scale data pipelines for collecting, processing, filtering, and transforming datasets used to train state-of-the-art models.

 - Training models used in our data processing pipelines, such as classifiers, quality filters, and labeling models.

 - Designing data curation strategies such as deduplication, quality scoring, labeling, and augmentation that measurably improve model performance.

 - Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers explore and train on massive datasets quickly and reliably.

 


REQUIREMENTS

We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:

 

 - Experience building data-intensive systems, ideally in support of machine learning training pipelines.

 - Strong engineering skills in distributed data processing at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, or custom pipelines over large datasets).

 - The capacity to autonomously evaluate how data quality, composition, and curation affect model outcomes, and to build the tooling to measure it.

 

Bonus: Experience building or operating web crawlers.

 


LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

 

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Scientific Assistant – Real-Time Generative Models / Computer Vision 
 chevron_left 
 Übersicht 
 Scientific Assistant – Real-Time Generative Models / Computer Vision
 100%, Zurich, fixed-term 
 print 
 Drucken 
 The Biomedical Image Computing Group develops algorithmic solutions to enable automatic interpretation and forming of biomedical images, aiming to increase efficiency and accuracy in clinical practice and research.
 Project background
 The enhancement of endoscopic videos is a critical yet complex task. These videos are integral to various clinical interventions, where the clarity of imaging data is essential for procedural success. Due to challenging imaging conditions, the quality of endoscopic videos can be significantly compromised by a range of artifacts. This project seeks to develop the next generation of enhancement algorithms tailored for endoscopic videos, with a focus on applications in real-time interventions. Development efforts will prioritize both enhancement quality and computational efficiency, particularly with respect to latency. 
 The successful candidate will join the BMIC team at ETH Zurich and also be part of the Computer Vision Lab (CVL). The project is conducted in collaboration with an industrial implementation partner, who will provide support with hardware and software integration. 
 The position is open immediately and initially limited to 8 months. 
 Job description
 This position involves the implementation, optimization, and deployment of deep-learning image-enhancement models for real-time operation. Rather than focusing primarily on model training, the successful candidate will work on translating existing and new architectures into efficient real-time processing pipelines connected directly to an industrial camera system. Typical tasks will include profiling and optimizing models for low-latency inference, implementing and adapting neural-network architectures with real-time constraints in mind, integrating camera acquisition and preprocessing pipelines, and contributing to project deliverables and scientific manuscript preparation. 
 Profile
 MSc degree in computer science, machine learning, medical image computing, or a related field. 
 Familiarity with neural-network-based image processing pipelines. 
 Excellent programming skills and experience with Python. 
 Experience implementing and validating neural-network architectures using PyTorch. 
 Demonstrable experience with model deployment/acceleration (PyTorch, ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA/C++, etc.), profiling tools, and camera/sensor integration is a plus.

items.desc: Summary You will become part of the Incident Creator and AI Research team within the Technology Division in Bratislava. The team focuses on detecting malicious activity, combining correlation rules with machine learning models to evaluate potential security incidents from terabytes of behavioral data. Beyond detection, the team builds incident-handling tooling for security operators and develops automation, including potential AI SOC. Job Description As an Experienced AI Researcher, you apply machine learning methods to real-world cybersecurity problems — preparing behavioral data, building and evaluating models, and guiding them toward production. Beyond that, you maintain and improve deployed models across their full lifecycle, from monitoring to continuous optimization. About The Role Prepare and process behavioral data for training models that detect malicious activity. Build and evaluate prototypes, iterating on architectures and features until production-quality, on dedicated in-house GPU servers — enough compute to compete with the biggest players in the industry. Deploy models into production and integrate them with existing detection and incident-handling pipelines. Monitor, maintain, and optimize deployed models across their full lifecycle — from drift detection to retraining and performance tuning. When opportunities arise, explore novel architectures beyond applying existing models. Essential Requirements Practical understanding of modern AI/ML methods — knowing which models fit which problems, when to use simpler approaches versus novel architectures, and how to optimize them for production. Proficiency in Python and its AI/ML ecosystem. Experience with AI/ML lifecycle tooling and infrastructure for production model serving and lifecycle management. items.desc: Research Scientist – Optimisation Science About Us: At SLB our purpose is to create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. As innovators, that’s been our mission for 100 years. We are facing the world’s greatest balancing act - how to simultaneously reduce emissions while meeting the world’s growing energy demands. We’re working on that answer. Every day is a step closer. Our collective future depends on decarbonizing the fossil fuel industry while innovating across the entire energy landscape. It’s what drives us, ensuring progress for the people and the planet - on the journey to net zero and beyond. With a global footprint in more than 100 countries and employees representing almost twice as many nationalities, we work each day on decarbonizing industry, innovating in oil and gas, delivering digital at scale, and developing and scaling new energy systems that accelerate the energy transition. We’re looking for innovators to join our diverse community. If you share our passion for discovery we’d like you to apply. Location: Cambridge, UK SLB Cambridge Research (SCR) is part of SLB’s global network of research and engineering centres. SCR is a dynamic, multidisciplinary environment with state-of-the-art laboratory and computing facilities. We work on applied research projects in the physical sciences to meet the current and future challenges of the industry. At SCR, we strike a balance between academia and industry with projects from early-stage research all the way to solution development for real business challenges. SCR is a distinctive marquee-like structure dominating the High Cross site on the western outskirts of Cambridge, England. The centre provides extensive laboratory and office facilities and is home to more than 100 scientists, technicians and domain experts. Job Summary: We are seeking a creative and self-motivated Research Scientist with expertise in optimisation, particularly multi-objective optimisation, and decision science. The scientist will develop optimisation methods for complex engineering and operational systems involving multiple, often competing objectives, constraints, uncertainties, and decisions across different temporal and spatial scales. The successful candidate will work as part of a multidisciplinary research team, combining optimisation with experiments, physical and mathematical models, data-driven methods, and domain knowledge. The research will support the understanding, design, operation, and control of complex systems and the development of new technologies. Responsibilities: Develop and apply optimisation methods for complex engineering, process, and operational systems. Formulate and solve decision problems involving multiple objectives, constraints, uncertainties, and trade-offs. Develop and integrate optimisation approaches with physics-based, reduced-order, surrogate, and data-driven models. Develop computationally efficient methods for optimisation under uncertainty, including robustness and sensitivity analysis. Contribute to optimisation of system design, operating strategies, measurement selection, resource allocation, and control. Work collaboratively with experimental scientists, mathematical modellers, data scientists, and domain experts to translate scientific and engineering challenges into suitable optimisation problems. Communicate findings through technical reports, publications, conference presentations, patent applications, and engagement with internal and external collaborators. Qualifications: PhD in operational research, applied mathematics, optimisation, engineering, computer science, or a related discipline. Strong expertise in mathematical optimisation, including multi-objective optimisation and decision-making under uncertainty. Experience applying optimisation methods to complex engineering or scientific problems, including integration with simulation, surrogate, and data-driven models. Strong scientific programming skills and experience developing optimisation workflows. Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams. Experience in dynamic systems, process optimisation, optimal experimental design, resource allocation, decision support, or optimisation-based control would be advantageous. SLB is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

items.desc: Location: Teagasc, Animal & Grassland Research Centre, Grange, Dunsany, Co. Meath C15 PW93, Ireland Research Salary: Research Officer with a Salary Scale of €42,921 to €81,218 Closing Date: 10/11/2026 12:00 PM Funded Full Time Job Summary Duration: Temporary externally funded non Grant-in-Aid contract post, the indicative duration of which is 24 months , subject to contract. A panel may be formed from which future similar vacancies may be filled; such a panel will remain active for a maximum period of 12 months. Basic Function: We wish to recruit a dynamic and suitably qualified research scientist to support the Grass-BÓ project with particular focus on modelling GHG emissions from grass silage biomethane production and assessing sustainability criteria for forage feedstocks. The Research Officer will have expertise in bioenergy, more specifically AD, and ideally will have undertaken a PhD on a similar topic. Furthermore, they should preferably have experience in environmental modelling and sustainability analysis. There will be opportunities to acquire new skills, continued professional development and for travel to conferences within the duration of the role. Background: Ireland has ambitious targets to reduce agricultural emissions by 25% and to expand anaerobic digestion (AD) to meet 10% of current national gas demand by 2030. This includes the development of both farm-level and grid-scale AD plants. However, several knowledge gaps exist relating to the optimal supply of farm sourced forage and slurry/manure to provide secure and sustainable AD feedstocks in line with Renewable Energy Directive (RED) sustainability criteria. Grass-BÓ will address knowledge gaps in relation to the seasonal, regional and farm-specific dynamics feedstocks for the AD sector including livestock slurry and grass-silage. The project will also explore whether adding legumes and diverse plant mixes to grasslands can boost the amount and quality of material available for renewable gas production. This project will provide a more detailed understanding of how much farm-based feedstock is truly available across different regions in the country throughout the year; along with how digestate (a by-product of AD) can be reused on farms in an environmentally friendly way. By filling these knowledge gaps, this project will create decision-making tools to help farmers and policymakers plan for the rollout of AD more effectively. Ultimately, it will support the growth of renewable energy in Ireland, reduce agricultural emissions, and strengthen Ireland’s leadership in sustainable energy research. Job Objectives Day-to-day management of the Grass-BÓ project. This successful candidate will be a key member of the project team and will support the partners in adhering to the work-programme, its constituent tasks, deliverables, and milestones. To analyse how grass sward composition and fertiliser management practices influence the emissions factor of grass silage biomethane. items.desc: Job description Vill du arbeta med datorseende och AI där millisekunder kan göra skillnad? Nu söker vi en junior Computer Vision Engineer till ett teknikbolag i Lund som utvecklar intelligenta sensorsystem för att upptäcka och förstå vad som händer i omgivningen. Tekniken kombinerar eventbaserade kameror med AI för att identifiera objekt och analysera deras rörelse med mycket låg fördröjning. Tillämpningarna finns inom bland annat autonom mobilitet, robotik och industriell automation – med målet att göra fordon och maskiner säkrare och mer responsiva. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav för tjänsten. Om rollen Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan mjukvara, sensorer och maskininlärning. Här får du möjlighet att omsätta teori i praktiken, arbeta med verkliga sensordata och följa hur algoritmer presterar i fysiska miljöer. Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat innebära att: Utveckla och utvärdera algoritmer för objektdetektering, klassificering och rörelseanalys. Bearbeta, visualisera och analysera data från kameror och sensorer. Bidra till träning och utvärdering av modeller för datorseende. Testa algoritmer och analysera precision, robusthet och svarstider. Samarbeta med kollegor inom mjukvara och hårdvara för att integrera och verifiera lösningar. #LI-IK1 #SIE Basic qualifications Vem är du? Du är i början av din karriär och har en relevant högskole- eller civilingenjörsutbildning inom exempelvis datateknik, elektroteknik, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande. Du kan vara nyexaminerad eller ha något års erfarenhet. Vi tror att du har: Kunskaper i Python och/eller C++. Grundläggande förståelse för bildbehandling, datorseende och maskininlärning. Arbetat med relevanta projekt under utbildningen, genom examensarbete eller på egen hand. Förmåga att kommunicera tekniska resonemang på engelska. Erfarenhet av OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow, kamerakalibrering, 3D-geometri eller eventbaserade kameror är meriterande. Du behöver inte kunna allt från start – vi värdesätter din tekniska nyfikenhet, problemlösningsförmåga och vilja att utvecklas. Därför är rollen spännande Du får arbeta nära teknik där algoritmer möter den fysiska världen. Rollen passar dig som vill förstå hela kedjan från sensordata till detektering och respons, och som motiveras av att utveckla lösningar med tydlig praktisk betydelse. items.desc: The Faculty of Science and the Finnish Institute for Molecular Medicine Finland (FIMM), HiLIFE at the University of Helsinki invite applications for a joint (50%:50%) position as RESEARCH FELLOW (UNIVERSITY RESEARCHER) IN AI FOR POPULATION HEALTH AND GENOMICS for a fixed-term appointment of maximum 4 years with starting date as soon as possible. Position Description The position relates to the Sustainable Wellbeing Across Lifespan (SWAN) ( https://www.swan-helsinkiuni.net/ ) research action that conducts cutting-edge research to promote health span by identifying individual risks and susceptibilities, aiming to clarify mechanisms of degeneration across the lifespan and exploring new approaches to detecting, monitoring and treating remodeled metabolism associated with ageing. The candidate is expected to develop an independent research program within this scope, focusing on methodological innovation and the application of modern AI approaches to large-scale biomedical data. Research topics may include foundation models for longitudinal electronic health records and genomics, multimodal learning integrating health records with molecular data, causal representation learning, in-context learning and amortized inference for healthcare decision-making, and AI-assisted scientific discovery workflows. The work will be done together with the Ganna Lab ( https://www.dsgelab.org/) at FIMM and the Probabilistic Machine Learning Lab ( https://www.helsinki.fi/en/researchgroups/probabilistic-machine-learning ; groups of Acerbi and Klami) at the Department of Computer Science, aligning with concurrent projects developing foundation models for healthcare. The groups are active members of the ELLIS Institute Finland ( https://www.ellisinstitute.fi/ ), providing opportunities for collaboration with leading researchers in artificial intelligence across Finland and Europe. The position offers access to globally unique research resources, including nationwide longitudinal health records from Finland covering more than five billion healthcare events, FinnGen with genomic data from over 500,000 participants, and extensive multi-omics datasets including proteomics and single-cell transcriptomics. Researchers also benefit from access to world-class computing infrastructure through CSC and LUMI, one of Europe's most powerful supercomputers. Responsibilities The appointed researcher is expected to pursue independent research on methodological innovation in developing and applying AI methods, in collaboration with existing research groups at the university, and will have the opportunity to be part of ELLIS Institute Finland activities. They will also participate in university-wide activities advancing the use of AI in scientific research, together with other researchers working in the intersection of AI and other scientific disciplines. The daily working activities of the appointed researcher will be split between the Faculty of Science and FIMM. Opportunities for contribution to teaching (up to 5-10% of annual working time) will be provided. Qualifications We require a doctoral degree and postdoctoral research experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, or computational statistics, with demonstrated interest in applications to population health and/or human genetics. Excellent communication skills in English are necessary. The candidate needs to have: A doctoral degree in a suitable field Research activity after PhD (typically 2-4 years of postdoctoral research), ideally with evidence of independent research contributions, ability to lead a research group, experience in research funding acquisition, and public engagement. Scientific competence in developing and/or applying artificial intelligence methods with proven publication record in scientific venues in the field. We expect publication record in top-tier venues in AI and machine learning (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or similar) and/or publications with clear AI contributions in leading biomedical journals (e.g. Nature Genetics, Nature Medicine, Nature Machine Intelligence or similar ). Personal research interest that relates to the scope and topic of the position and connects to existing research groups at the University of Helsinki. What We Offer University of Helsinki is an equal opportunity employer and offers an attractive and diverse workplace with a variety of development opportunities and benefits. items.desc: The opportunity For our research center in Krakow, Poland, we are seeking a Researcher with solid expertise in polymer materials – particularly epoxy resins, thermoplastics, and related composite systems – and their processing, mechanical behavior, and life-cycle performance. You will join a dynamic, motivated, and interdisciplinary team with broad experience across materials science, mechanics, and energy technologies. As part of our team, you will focus on the practical application and processing of modern polymer materials, ensuring their reliable and efficient use in existing and future products by developing manufacturing ‑ ready solutions that deliver consistent mechanical performance and meet durability and life ‑ cycle requirements. Your work will directly support the development of products and systems used in energy distribution and transmission, ensuring that polymer materials are selected, processed, and applied in ways that maximize mechanical integrity, safety, and long ‑ term reliability. How You'll Make An Impact Propose, contribute to, and lead research and development projects focused on polymer materials processing, mechanical behavior, and their application in energy technologies. Investigate how manufacturing processes and parameters (e.g., molding, curing, extrusion, forming, joining) influence material structure, quality, and mechanical performance. Develop and optimize manufacturing methods for polymer components to improve product consistency, robustness, and efficiency. Evaluate durability, mechanical degradation mechanisms, fracture behavior, creep, fatigue, and long‑term aging of polymer materials used in demanding environments. Assess environmental impacts and life‑cycle performance of polymer materials, contributing to sustainability‑oriented material and design decisions. Collaborate globally with researchers and engineers at Hitachi Energy to solve material‑ and mechanics‑related challenges and optimize product performance. Stay up to date on polymer technologies, mechanical testing methods, and sustainable solutions, identifying opportunities for industrial application. Engage with universities, research institutes, startups, and technology partners to advance knowledge in polymer mechanics and applications. Communicate research outcomes through technical reports, scientific papers, conferences, and patent applications. Your Background Master’s or higher degree in Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Polymer Engineering, or related fields. Robust understanding of polymer mechanics, including stress–strain behavior, viscoelasticity, fracture mechanics, fatigue, and failure mechanisms of epoxy resins and thermoplastics. Minimum 2 years of experience with polymer processing technologies (e.g., molding, curing, extrusion, composite processing, additive manufacturing), with a clear understanding of how processing influences mechanical properties. Experience with mechanical characterization techniques, such as tensile testing, compression, impact, DMA, fracture toughness testing, creep, and fatigue testing. Experience with thermal and chemical characterization techniques (DSC, TGA, rheology) supporting the interpretation of mechanical behavior. Knowledge of material aging, environmental degradation, reliability, or life‑cycle assessment is highly valued. Experience with CAD/CAE, mechanical simulation, or modeling of polymer behavior is an advantage. Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary and multicultural teams while continually learning new topics. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. In addition, the following skills would be beneficial for the role: Knowledge of power network business, green energy, respective requirements, and industry standards. Understanding of energy system products, power network components, and relevant industry standards. Familiarity with sustainability concepts, circular materials, polymer recycling, or environmental compliance. items.desc: Ship maintenance is broken. We're fixing it. Ceto is a fleet intelligence company. Our platform, Watchkeeper, takes the high-frequency sensor data ships already generate and predicts machinery failures before they happen — on one vessel we flagged a developing fuel-system issue three days before a critical failure, on a ship earning $48,000 a day. No new hardware, no rip-and-replace: if an owner is already capturing data, we can have a full fleet live in days. We're deployed across fleets owned by major global shipowners, and we sell directly to the ship owners and operators who feel every day of unplanned off-hire on their P&L. We're a small, senior team - our CEO spent eight years at sea as a marine engineer before founding the company; we’re backed by investors including Dynamo Ventures who led our $4.8m seed round, and we're compounding fast which is exactly why we need you. What we're doing We're reshaping maritime. It's an industry that's incredibly important and serves as the backbone of global trade, moving $14 trillion of cargo each year. Despite its significance, the industry remains one of the final frontiers of digitalisation. Ceto provides the operational intelligence layer that technical teams rely on for mission-critical decision making. By capturing and analysing high-frequency data from commercial ships, Ceto monitors the condition of the machinery onboard. Through anomaly detection and degradation forecasting we predict mechanical failures ahead of time and guide decision making for our customers. Our analytics are served as insights through our SaaS platform, preventing costly breakdowns, loss of hire events and reducing operational risk. The role You'll turn high-frequency sensor data from ships' machinery into analytics our customers act on: condition monitoring, performance baselines, degradation trends, anomaly detection. Some of this is machine learning; much of it is statistics, signal processing and a real understanding of the physical systems producing the data. You'll work closely with the engineering team to take problems end to end, from raw, messy sensor data through to a deployed, monitored output feeding our dashboard. Your responsibilities will include: Building time-series analytics on machinery sensor data: performance baselines, derived signals, trend and degradation detection Owning the data from the point it arrives: ingesting raw sensor feeds, cleaning, validating and resampling them, and building the checks that catch gaps, outliers, sensor faults and vendor tag differences before they reach any model or customer Exploring new ideas in predictive maintenance and condition monitoring, and turning them into reliable, production-ready features Applying ML, supervised or unsupervised, where the problem calls for it, including cases where failure examples are rare and labels are imperfect Building and maintaining analytics pipelines end to end (cleaning, feature engineering, model training and inference, output storage) using version control, testing, CI/CD and experiment tracking Working closely with the rest of the technical team to prioritise what's worth investigating and what isn't Using AI tools such as Claude Code to work faster and more effectively Two firm requirements: You have experience in an early-stage startup and are comfortable working at speed, context switching and turning ambiguous problems into delivered solutions You’re AI-native, using the modern tools to increase your productivity and you have a good feel for when to trust agents and when to do the work by hand You'll be perfect for this role if: You have strong Python skills and know its data/scientific libraries (pandas/numpy/scipy, scikit-learn, statsmodels) Experience with supervised and unsupervised ML (e.g. gradient boosting, clustering, hidden Markov models), and clear reasoning about when you'd use each You have a strong grasp of time-series analysis (trends, seasonality, filtering, changepoints, anomaly detection) and the judgement to pick the simplest method that works You've shipped analytics or models into production, not just notebooks, with exposure to CI/CD and DevOps practices You have a physics, engineering or other quantitative degree, and a genuine interest in the physical systems behind the data, not just the data itself You can explain why a method fits a physical problem, and you're sceptical by nature. Models can be wrong, intuition can be disproven, and correlations in data often have mundane explanations. Jako ad hoc konzultant pomůžete internímu ML vývojáři s onboardingem na Chronos-2 – od testovacího a backtesting rámce přes přípravu provozních dat až po běh v prostředí zákazníka, plně remote. 🚀 Projekt predikce průtoků v distribuční síti provozovatele kritické infrastruktury experimentální fáze (PoC) s cílem pilotního nasazení on-premise testovací a backtesting rámec pro Chronos-2, srovnání se základní linií a LightGBM příprava dat z provozních měření a běhu modelu v prostředí zákazníka ad hoc konzultace a podpora interního ML vývojáře – doplňujete ho, nenahrazujete kontrakt přes CoolPeople, full remote 🎯 Skills min. 3 roky v ML a zkušenost s adopcí ML modelů v komerčních projektech Chronos-2 – silný důraz predikce časových řad na reálných provozních datech správná validace: walk-forward backtesting, prevence úniku informací z budoucnosti Python ML stack: pandas, scikit-learn, LightGBM, PyTorch přetrénované modely pro časové řady (Chronos, TimesFM apod.) čeština, angličtina B2 💡 Nice to have pravděpodobnostní a vícekroková předpověď, doprovodné veličiny, práce s mnoha řadami najednou senzorická a telemetrická data (nepravidelný krok, mezery, chybná měření), metriky pro hodnoty blízké nule SQL, Git, MLflow, reprodukovatelnost experimentů StatsForecast, NeuralForecast, Darts nebo GluonTS dotrénování na GPU i optimalizace pro CPU Airflow nebo Dagster, Prometheus, Grafana, databáze pro časové řady utility / energetika / vodárenství, SCADA, historian, NIS2 prezentace výsledků netechnickému publiku

items.desc: Job Description Overview As a Research Engineer, you are expected to contribute to cutting-edge projects that advance both applied and theoretical aspects of AI. This role is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building practical systems from research ideas, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are committed to supporting impactful research through technical excellence. Our team operates in two main directions: Applying AI to the design and optimization of semiconductors Conducting fundamental research that supports both our applications and the broader sci-entific community Current areas of interest include large language models (LLMs), optimization methods for deep learning, reinforcement learning (RL), and generative models. Key Responsibilities Implement and test research ideas in machine learning and artificial intelligence Build prototypes and support experiments for team and company projects Collaborate with researchers to translate theoretical models into practical systems Maintain and improve research infrastructure, tools, and workflows Assist in preparing technical documentation and reports Stay up to date with the latest advancements in AI and related fields Main Requirements and Qualifications Qualifications & Expectations Required: Experience implementing machine learning algorithms and techniques Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or similar Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work both independently and collaboratively Good communication skills, with the ability to document and explain technical work clearly Preferred: Experience with optimization, reinforcement learning, and/or large language models (LLMs) Familiarity with deep learning frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX) Experience building and maintaining research infrastructure or tools Exposure to chip design or applied AI research Ongoing Development Employees are encouraged to continue developing their technical skills, seek out new learning opportunities, and actively contribute to the team’s goals. Regular feedback, mentorship, and support will be provided to help you achieve your professional objectives and grow as a research engineer. Competitive Package Available Closing Date - 26-Oct-2026

items.desc: STANDORT Munich GESELLSCHAFT ARRK Engineering GmbH VERTRAGSART Vollzeit Arbeitsform Hybride WAS SIE ERWARTET Sie nutzen Sensor-, Fahrzeug- und Flottendaten, um ML-/KI-Lösungen für automatisiertes Fahren zu entwickeln, validieren und zu optimieren. In einer fachverantwortlichen Rolle konzipieren, entwickeln und verbessern Sie datengetriebene Software entlang des ML-Lebenszyklus – von Datenaufbereitung über Training, Evaluation und Deployment bis zum Betrieb auf Edge, Cloud und On-Premise. Sie bringen Expertenwissen in ML, Deep Learning, Computer Vision und Generative AI ein, bewerten neue Technologien und übertragen diese in robuste, skalierbare Lösungen. Durch Ihre Expertise, Eigenverantwortung und Mentoring stärken Sie KI-Kompetenzen im Team und tragen zum Erfolg strategischer Entwicklungsprojekte bei. IHRE AUFGABEN Konzeption und Entwicklung anspruchsvoller Lösungen in den Bereichen Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Edge AI und Generative AI Technische Verantwortung entlang des gesamten ML Lifecycles – von der Analyse und Konzeption über Training und Evaluation bis hin zu Deployment und Betrieb Überführung von Research-, Prototyping- und PoC-Ansätzen in robuste, skalierbare und produktions- bzw. serienfähige Lösungen Entwicklung, Optimierung und Deployment von AI-Lösungen für Cloud-, On-Premise- und Edge-Plattformen Analyse komplexer technischer Problemstellungen sowie Auswahl und Bewertung geeigneter Modelle, Architekturen, Technologien und Lösungsansätze Eigenständiges Identifizieren neuer technologischer Potenziale sowie Initiieren und aktives Vorantreiben neuer AI-, Research- und Innovationsthemen Beobachtung und Bewertung aktueller Entwicklungen aus Forschung und Industrie sowie Übertragung relevanter Ansätze auf konkrete Anwendungsfälle Aktive Mitgestaltung unserer technologischen Ausrichtung und Entwicklung neuer Use Cases gemeinsam mit unseren Teams und Kunden Fachliche Begleitung und Mentoring innerhalb des Teams sowie aktive Weitergabe von Wissen und Best Practices. Hybrides Arbeiten im Home Office oder unserem Büro am Standort Unterschleißheim möglich IHR PROFIL Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Künstlichen Intelligenz, Data Science, Robotik, Mathematik, Physik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung, Promotion erwünscht Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Machine Learning und Deep Learning, idealerweise in produktiven Projekten Fundierte Kenntnisse in Computer Vision, z. items.desc: Structure d'accueil The Curie Institute Research Center France’s leading cancer research and treatment centre, Institut Curie unites a renowned research centre and a specialist hospital, fostering close collaboration between scientists, clinicians and healthcare professionals. It offers an environment of excellence where expertise comes together around shared values: care, humanity, openness, collaboration, efficiency, innovation, solidarity and commitment. Missions Activités principales Laboratory The RACER (Rare Cancers Exploration and Research) team, led by Dr. Sarah Watson within the Chemical Biology of Cancers Unit (INSERM U1339, CNRS UMR366) , conducts translational research focused on rare cancers, particularly cancers of unknown primary (CUP) and soft tissue sarcomas . The team integrates genomic and transcriptomic approaches, including single-cell analyses, with innovative preclinical models and direct access to patient cohorts and biological samples from Institut Curie . This position aims to support and expand the team's preclinical modeling activities, including cell lines, 3D cultures, organoids, and PDX . These models are central to therapeutic target validation and drug screening projects in sarcoma research. The successful candidate will work under the direct supervision of Dr. Watson and interact closely with researchers and technological platforms at Institut Curie. Missions Development and Characterization of Models Establish and characterize sarcoma-derived cell lines, organoids, and PDX models from patient samples Develop and optimize 3D culture systems and co-cultures with stromal or immune cells Contribute to the maintenance, monitoring, and annotation of models and associated biobanks Perform functional assays, including viability, dose-response, and drug screening studies Molecular and Cellular Characterization Extract nucleic acids and proteins and perform quality assessment Prepare sequencing samples and/or libraries and liaise with sequencing platforms Conduct standard molecular and cellular biology techniques, including RT-qPCR, Western blotting, flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, and immunohistochemistry Perform genetic engineering using transfection, lentiviral transduction, and CRISPR/Cas9 Contribute to quality control and preliminary data analysis Laboratory Organization and Scientific Contributions Ensure experimental traceability, data management, and regulatory compliance Participate in laboratory operations, including inventory management, purchasing, and equipment maintenance Train and support students and new team members in cell culture and preclinical modeling techniques Present research findings and contribute to publications, grant reports, and regulatory documentation Constraints and risks Work in a Biosafety Level 2 (BSL-2) laboratory handling human samples Occasional schedule flexibility required to accommodate cell culture experiments, in vivo studies, and receipt of clinical specimens. Profil du candidat Savoirs et compétences attendus Training And Experience Required Education and qualifications: Professional Bachelor's degree or University Bachelor of Technology (BUT) in Biology, Biotechnology, or Biological Sciences for an Assistant Research Engineer position; Master's degree (MSc) or Engineering degree in Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, Oncology, or Biotechnology for a Research Engineer position. Professional experience: 2 to 5 years of experience with a focus on the development of cellular and/or animal models in oncology. Certifications in laboratory animal science (designer or operator level) and authorization to work with Class 2 genetically modified organisms (GMOs) is an asset. Required expertise: Hands-on experience with established and primary cell culture, 3D culture systems and organoids, molecular biology techniques and NGS library preparation, cellular imaging, and flow cytometry. A solid understanding of tumor biology is expected. Experience with sarcomas or other mesenchymal tumors would be advantageous but is not required. Skills Required Language skills: Fluent French and scientific English Computing skills: Proficiency with standard office software, electronic laboratory notebooks (ELNs), and data analysis/quantification tools such as GraphPad Prism, FlowJo, and ImageJ/Fiji. Basic knowledge of R or Python for the exploration and analysis of sequencing data would be an asset. Personal skills: Strong experimental rigor and attention to traceability, ability to work independently and manage experiments autonomously, strong organizational skills with the capacity to handle multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines, enthusiasm for multidisciplinary teamwork involving clinicians, biologists, and bioinformaticians. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics. Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy. Familiarity with MLOps best practices, including model monitoring, logging, and CI/CD pipelines for AI assets. Strong communication and teamwork skills, with an ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams including solution architects and data scientists. items.desc: About CNTXT AI CNTXT AI is a UAE-based Data & AI company delivering end-to-end AI solutions and large-scale data services globally. Our work spans AI training data, robotics, embodied AI, computer vision, human data collection, data annotation, and enterprise AI applications. As we expand our global operations, we are seeking an experienced Hardware & Robotics Engineer to join our London team and help develop advanced hardware and robotic systems supporting next-generation AI and robotics applications. About the Role CNTXT AI is looking for a hands-on Hardware & Robotics Engineer with strong expertise in robotics systems, electronics, embedded systems, sensors, and hardware integration. You will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, testing, and deploying hardware and robotics solutions, including robotic platforms, wearable data collection devices, motion capture systems, and sensor-based technologies. The ideal candidate has experience working with physical robotic systems, integrating hardware and software, building prototypes, and bringing engineering solutions from concept to real-world deployment. This role combines robotics engineering, hardware development, systems integration, and practical experimentation , working closely with our AI, Robotics, Engineering, Product, and Global Operations teams. Key Responsibilities 1. Robotics Engineering & Systems Integration Design, develop, integrate, and test robotic systems and hardware platforms. Work with robotic arms, mobile robots, humanoid systems, and other robotic platforms. Integrate actuators, motors, controllers, sensors, and communication systems. Support robotic system calibration, commissioning, and performance validation. Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and software integration issues. Collaborate with robotics software engineers on robot control, perception, and motion systems. Support robotics research and proof-of-concept development. 2. Hardware Design & Development Design and prototype electronic and electromechanical hardware systems. Develop and validate circuits, PCBs, embedded devices, and sensor modules. Select and integrate microcontrollers, processors, cameras, sensors, and communication components. Build reliable hardware solutions for robotics and AI data collection. Optimize systems for performance, durability, power consumption, and cost. Support the transition from prototypes to production-ready hardware. 3. Sensors, Motion Capture & Data Collection Systems Develop and integrate sensor-based systems for capturing human and robotic movement. Work with cameras, IMUs, depth sensors, motion capture equipment, and wearable devices. Support egocentric video capture, robotic demonstrations, and human movement data collection. Implement sensor calibration, synchronization, and data acquisition processes. Ensure hardware produces accurate, consistent, and high-quality data. Troubleshoot sensor performance, recording reliability, connectivity, and synchronization issues. 4. Embedded Systems & Robotics Software Integration Develop, configure, and troubleshoot embedded hardware and firmware. Integrate hardware with robotics software frameworks and control systems. Work with communication protocols such as CAN, I2C, SPI, UART, USB, Ethernet, and Bluetooth. Support robotics platforms using ROS/ROS 2 and Linux-based environments. Collaborate with software engineers on hardware interfaces, device drivers, and system-level debugging. Support real-time data acquisition, processing, and device control. 5. Robotics Testing & Validation Develop testing procedures for robotic and hardware systems. Conduct functional, reliability, performance, and durability testing. Validate hardware under laboratory and real-world operating conditions. Diagnose hardware failures and implement engineering improvements. Establish testing standards, technical documentation, and quality acceptance criteria. Ensure systems meet operational, safety, and performance requirements. 6. Prototyping, Manufacturing & Supplier Management Build and iterate hardware and robotics prototypes. Work with external suppliers, manufacturers, and robotics technology partners. Evaluate components, robotic platforms, and hardware vendors. Support design for manufacturing, assembly, and testing. Review technical specifications, production quality, and cost. Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing efficiency and hardware scalability. 7. Deployment & Technical Operations Support deployment of robotic systems and data collection hardware across global projects. Develop setup, calibration, troubleshooting, and maintenance procedures. Work with operations teams to resolve technical issues in the field. Monitor device performance, reliability, and utilization. Support technical training and knowledge transfer. Scientific Assistant – Biomedical Data Science & Spinal Cord Injury Research 
 chevron_left 
 Übersicht 
 Scientific Assistant – Biomedical Data Science & Spinal Cord Injury Research
 80%-100%, Zurich, fixed-term 
 print 
 Drucken 
 The Biomedical Data Science Lab investigates data-driven solutions for healthcare applications with a focus on neurological conditions and systemic infections such as sepsis. At the core of our research is the collaboration across disciplines spanning expertise in medicine, biology, computer, and data science. We seek a motivated scientific assistant to join this growing team and contribute to interdisciplinary research partnerships. 
 Project background
 The Biomedical Data Science Lab at ETH Zurich invites applications for a Scientific Assistant to support our data-intensive projects in biomedical imaging and clinical research. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work at the forefront of biomedical data science, contributing to key projects including data curation, image segmentation, and tool development for clinical research applications. The scientific assistant will support the Biomedical Data Science Team for a range of application projects, with a particular focus on our work in pediatric sepsis, lower back pain, and pediatric neurooncology.
 Job description
 We are looking for a Scientific Assistant with a strong background in statistics, machine learning, and biomedical data science to support our research using the European Multicenter Study about Spinal Cord Injury (EMSCI) and related SCI databases.
 The position combines hands-on data analysis and scientific project support with the coordination of scientific activities within our research network. The successful candidate will work closely with researchers, clinicians, and international collaborators to analyse large-scale longitudinal SCI datasets and contribute to scientific publications and meetings.
 Your key responsibilities will include:
 Conduct statistical and machine-learning analyses using EMSCI and related SCI datasets.
 Develop and validate predictive models of neurological recovery and functional outcomes after SCI.
 Perform data preprocessing, quality control, harmonisation, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis.
 Apply appropriate statistical methods, including regression, longitudinal data analysis, survival analysis, and machine-learning approaches.
 Develop reproducible analytical workflows in R and/or Python.
 Contribute to scientific publications, reports, presentations, and grant applications.
 Collaborate with clinicians, neuroscientists, statisticians, and data scientists across participating SCI centres.
 Support the organisation and coordination of scientific meetings, workshops, consortium meetings, and other research activities, including scheduling, preparation of agendas and materials, communication with participants, and follow-up.
 Assist with the coordination of ongoing collaborative projects and follow-up of scientific activities and deliverables.
 Profile
 MSc or equivalent degree in statistics, biostatistics, data science, biomedical engineering, computer science, epidemiology, neuroscience, or a related discipline.
 Strong background in statistics and/or machine learning.
 Experience working with longitudinal and/or clinical datasets.
 Strong programming skills in R and/or Python.
 Experience with statistical modelling, data visualisation, and reproducible research.
 Familiarity with machine-learning methods such as random forests, gradient boosting, neural networks, or related approaches.
 Previous experience working with EMSCI data or other large SCI databases is highly desirable.
 Knowledge of SCI-specific clinical and neurological outcome measures (e.g., ISNCSCI/ASIA, SCIM) is an advantage.
 Experience working with multicentre clinical datasets is an advantage.
 Fluent in English and proficient in German, both written and spoken.
 Excellent organisational and communication skills.
 Ability to work independently and reliably while collaborating effectively in a multidisciplinary and international research environment.
 Interest in SCI research and the application of data science to clinical research.

 Workplace

 An 80–100% position within the Biomedical Data Science Lab at ETH Zurich.

 A highly interdisciplinary environment at the interface of clinical neuroscience, statistics, machine learning, and biomedical data science.
 Close interaction with leading SCI researchers and clinical centres in Switzerland and internationally.
 The opportunity to contribute to high-quality scientific publications and international collaborative projects.

Where you create outstanding solutions making a real impact for our customers. In a company that invests in the solutions of tomorrow and has the strength to drive technology development. About us Heraeus Covantics Denmark produce optical fiber in Brøndby in the Greater Copenhagen Area and is a fully owned subsidiary of Heraeus Group – a German based globally leading technology company with 17.200 employees in 40 countries. In Brøndby we are currently 90 employees and growing rapidly. As a small and agile site, we offer you a dynamic and versatile work environment, where your contributions will be visible and impactful. items.desc: Service de statistique (STAT) Le STAT constitue le pôle cantonal en matière de science des données et d'intelligence artificielle. Ses principales missions consistent notamment à fournir aux autorités cantonales et communales ainsi qu'à la collectivité des informations statistiques pertinentes, significatives, fiables et cohérentes. Il collecte, produit, traite, analyse et stocke des données à but statistique sur la base de principes scientifiques choisis en toute indépendance, dans le respect de la charte de la statistique publique suisse. Vos missions En tant qu'expert·e IA, vous collaborez étroitement avec la déléguée cantonale à l'IA et êtes en charge de projets liés à l’intelligence artificielle et à la science des données. Dans ce cadre, vous réalisez des analyses avancées dans divers domaines (santé publique, finance, marché du travail, etc.). Vous développez et mettez en œuvre des solutions innovantes en matière de machine learning, deep learning et d'IA générative pour valoriser les données statistiques et soutenir la prise de décision. De plus, vous assurez la préparation et l’exploitation de grandes bases de données, tout en participant à la création et à la diffusion de formations relatives à l’IA au sein de l’administration cantonale et de ses partenaires. Dans l'exercice de vos missions, vous collaborez activement avec les services de l’État, les communes et le système statistique suisse. Enfin, vous documentez vos travaux, proposez des pistes d’amélioration et contribuez à la valorisation et à la diffusion des données statistiques du canton. Votre profil Titulaire d’un master universitaire ou d’un diplôme jugé équivalent en intelligence artificielle, science des données, mathématiques, physique ou informatique, vous justifiez d’une expérience professionnelle de 3 ans minimum dans les domaines de l’IA et de la science des données. Un doctorat dans l'un de ces domaines constitue un atout. Vous disposez de solides compétences en planification et gestion de projets complexes et multidisciplinaires. Sur le plan technique, vous maîtrisez parfaitement les langages (Python, R) et outils (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) liés au machine learning, à l’analyse de données (Pandas, NumPy, RStudio, Tableau+) et aux bases de données (PostgreSQL, SQL Server). À cela s'ajoute, une maîtrise de la mise en place de RAGs et l'implémentation d'agents IA. Vous attestez également de bonnes connaissances du fonctionnement des institutions politiques et administratives ainsi que des missions de la statistique publique. Par ailleurs, vous possédez de bonnes connaissances en anglais et allemand. Enfin, votre profil se distingue par un esprit d’initiative, une grande rigueur organisationnelle, une réelle aisance relationnelle et un respect absolu de la confidentialité. Nous vous offrons pour ce poste D’intégrer une équipe dynamique, accueillante et bienveillante. Un poste à responsabilités, varié et motivant, dans un cadre prônant l'innovation. Une organisation de travail flexible dans un environnement moderne et ouvert aux nouvelles idées. Gérard Geiser, chef de service, tél. 032 889 48 12 M. Olivier Berthoud, chef de service adjoint, tél. 032 889 46 28 Les postulations féminines sont vivement encouragées pour les fonctions supérieures. Nous défendons l’égalité des chances et l’inclusion, les candidatures de personnes de tous horizons et vivant avec un handicap sont les bienvenues.

items.desc: Introduction At Burberry, we believe creativity opens spaces. Our purpose is to unlock the power of imagination to push boundaries and open new possibilities for our people, our customers and our communities. This is the core belief that has guided Burberry since it was founded in 1856 and is central to how we operate as a company today. We aim to provide an environment for creative minds from different backgrounds to thrive, bringing a wide range of skills and experiences to everything we do. As a purposeful, values-driven brand, we are committed to being a force for good in the world as well, creating the next generation of sustainable luxury for customers, driving industry change and championing our communities. Job Purpose The Customer Data Science team at Burberry is looking for an early-career Data Scientist to help create more relevant and personalised experiences across every customer touchpoint. This role is well suited to someone with master's-level knowledge or approximately one year of relevant experience who is ready to apply statistical modelling, machine learning and emerging AI techniques to meaningful business challenges. Working with data scientists, engineers and cross-functional stakeholders, you will build scalable solutions that deepen our understanding of customer behaviour, preferences, purchase intent and response to marketing activity. Your work will contribute to areas including propensity and causal modelling, product recommendations, discovery algorithms and client relationship intelligence. Responsibilities Develop robust statistical models, machine learning solutions and data-driven tools that support customer and business objectives. Explore and prepare new data sources, assess data quality and create relevant features for modelling and analysis. Apply techniques including propensity modelling, causal inference and experimentation to understand customer behaviour and measure the impact of customer outreach. Contribute to product recommendation, discovery and client relationship solutions that create more relevant customer experiences. Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to build scalable, reliable and production-ready solutions. Monitor and evaluate models in production, using technical and business measures to identify opportunities for improvement. Optimise existing models and analytics solutions through a structured test-and-learn approach. Translate business questions into clear analytical frameworks, methodologies and practical solutions. Generate reliable insights and recommendations that inform strategic and operational decisions. Present analytical methods, findings and limitations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Identify opportunities to improve models, processes and ways of working across the team. Explore relevant developments in data science and AI, applying new technologies where they can deliver meaningful value. Personal Profile A master's degree or PhD in a quantitative discipline, such as Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Physics or Engineering, or equivalent technical knowledge. Master's-level project, placement or internship experience, or approximately one year of relevant experience in data science or a closely related role. Experience applying statistical analysis, machine learning or data science techniques to practical problems in an academic or commercial setting. A sound understanding of mathematics, statistics, experimental design and model evaluation. Practical experience developing, testing and interpreting statistical or machine learning models. Exposure to one or more specialist areas, such as time series, recommendation systems, customer journey modelling, causal inference, deep learning or large language models. A solid programming foundation, with practical experience using Python and SQL. Familiarity with relevant libraries and technologies such as Pandas or PySpark would be advantageous. An understanding of collaborative development practices, including version control tools such as Git. Exposure to Python packaging tools such as Poetry would be welcomed but is not essential. A logical and considered approach to problem-solving, with the curiosity to explore new analytical methods. The ability to translate business requirements into structured analytical questions and practical approaches. A collaborative working style and the ability to contribute effectively across technical and business teams. Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analysis to different audiences. A commitment to learning and keeping informed about developments in data science, machine learning and AI. Burberry is an Equal Opportunities Employer and as such, treats all applications equally and recruits purely on the basis of skills and experience.

items.title: Data Engineer / Signal Processing Specialist
items.card: What You'll Do Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer. Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.
items.desc: Who We Are Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap. We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz and Munich, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team. What You'll Do Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer. Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour. Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment. Ship modules, not scripts: Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers. Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements. What You Bring Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures. Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain. Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing. Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it. Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike. Why Limatica Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead. Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers. Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options. Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card and free beverages What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us. Ready to find the signal in the noise? Let's build the future of battery diagnostics together. ⚡

Passion for photography and videography.

items.desc:
OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

 

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

 

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.


ROLE IMPACT

You will own applied RL programs from the first ambiguous customer problem through a deployed improvement loop. You will understand the workflow and business stakes, decide what can be measured and learned, build the environment and evaluation, run post-training experiments, deploy the result, and determine what should generalize into Prime's shared stack. The majority of your work will be organized around external programs. You will work directly with customer researchers, engineers, and leaders, and you will be accountable for both the research result and its practical impact.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

Role scope

We have active programs across technology, science, engineering, regulated industries, and the public sector.

Representative early problems

 - Turn a partially documented workflow and business goal into an environment, baseline, and evaluation that the customer team agrees measures the right outcome.

 - Improve a domain agent through RL or another post-training method while separating model limitations from task, harness, inference, and integration failures.

 - Carry a successful experiment into deployment, measure its effect on the customer outcome, and convert the recurring parts into reusable environments, recipes, data loops, or platform capabilities.

What you will own

 - Technical and business discovery that produces a clear research plan, success measure, environment, and baseline.

 - RL, distillation, and other post-training experiments tied to deployment outcomes.

 - Agent systems that handle tool use, memory, recovery, long horizons, and human oversight.

 - Deployment and adoption decisions, plus reusable artifacts carried back to Prime's research, engineering, and product teams.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Relevant experience: customer-embedded technical work, research engineering, technical founding experience, applied ML consulting with real build ownership, or end-to-end post-training programs.

 - You should be comfortable with senior external teams and able to connect experimental evidence to business decisions without lowering the research bar.

 - Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.

 - Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.

 - Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.

 - Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Evidence of exceptional work

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your …

Your experiments will track skill acquisition, transfer, forgetting, and loss of plasticity over long sequences of tasks.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. Role scope

Control update cadence, policy lag, task drift, and exploration, and evaluate each checkpoint on earlier skills, unseen tasks, and general capabilities. Build task-generation and training pipelines with reproducible data and harness versions, so regressions can be traced to a specific change and rolled back. You will work directly with the external collaborators whose deployments drive the research.

Representative early problems

 - Select high-value production traces and interventions, convert them into training signal, and establish regression gates before a change reaches deployment.

 - Determine which adaptation belongs in model weights, harness state, memory, tools, or data, then measure the tradeoffs across a sequence of tasks.

 - Build evaluations that distinguish retained learning and transfer from memorization, context accumulation, or measurement drift.

What you will own

 - Methods for selective consolidation, replay, adaptation, memory, and online or offline RL.

 - Evaluations for retention, transfer, regression, and rollback as tasks and distributions change.

 - Promotion gates and human oversight for agents that continue to change in production.

 - Field experiments, benchmarks, and open research that make continual improvement measurable and transferable.


REQUIREMENTS

items.desc: The AIT Austrian Institute of Technology is Austria’s largest Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) . We aim to transform scientific excellence into innovation with impact. Together with our partners, we develop technologies and solutions for a sustainable, resilient, and digitalised future, strengthening Europe’s competitiveness and technological sovereignty. Our international teams combine cutting-edge research with strong implementation expertise to create measurable value for industry and society. Our Center for Digital Safety and Security is looking for new Ingenious Partners for our location in Vienna (Giefinggasse, 1210). In the Reliable Wireless Communication and Sensing research team , we develop energy efficient solutions for reliable wireless 5G/6G communication and sensing. We are enthusiastically researching integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) methods in mobile indoor and outdoor scenarios using 5G/6G physical layer technologies. Scientists (f/m/d) for Advanced Algorithms in 5G/6G Wireless Networks CENTER FOR DIGITAL SAFETY & SECURITY You will investigate cooperative positioning and advanced localisation algorithms for wireless communication networks in complex outdoor scenarios, using AIT’s Radio-Frequency lab and an optical tracking system to obtain accurate ground-truth position measurements. You will validate the algorithms through numerical simulations and empirical measurements , while contributing to the development and deployment of a distributed wireless network using state-of-the-art hardware and software-defined radio (SDR) technology. You will publish your research results at conferences and in international journals. You will gain expertise in a research field with a wide range of applications , spanning construction, logistics, aviation, railways, agriculture, robotics, and defence. You will work alongside an international team of scientists and expand your professional network through European-wide research projects . Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: Completed technical studies (Master’s degree or PhD) related to Telecommunications, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering Experience in at least one of the following profiles: 1. Distributed localisation in wireless networks 2. Positioning and sensing in 5G/6G networks Please describe in the cover letter how your CV and expertise match with at least one of the technological areas above (explicitly referring to 1.– 2.) Applications that do not address this point may not be considered further. Excellent knowledge in the field of statistical signal processing and numerical simulation software development (Python or MATLAB) Sound knowledge of radio propagation modeling and data analysis, machine learning, algorithm design and validation Experience in performing lab measurements and collecting datasets for validation of developed algorithms Good understanding of algorithms in the field of wireless communications (beamforming, channel estimation, signaling, …) Interest in reading and writing scientific publications and motivation for solving application-oriented challenges from industry High level of commitment and ability to work in a team Good language skills in English (spoken & written). German language skills are an advantage. What to expect: The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 56.784, -. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. In case of interest, we offer the opportunity to pursue a PhD at TU Wien alongside your full-time employment as a Scientist. Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, pension fund, additional days off for various life events, family benefits (including two weeks of paid paternity leave “Papa-Weeks” and leisure subsidies), voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events and many more, as well as flexitime models (incl. up to 50% home office), travel support for conferences and networking, and individual training and career development opportunities. At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants. Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity. Would you like to get to know our team & how it feels like working at AIT? Join us live! When: Thursday, 22.10.2026 | 5 pm (CET) Topic: PhDs and other career opportunities at AIT: Research the 6G networks of tomorrow Please subscribe here ! …
