Our initial focus is strategic portfolio management (SPM): choosing the right initiatives, coordinating execution and adapting as priorities and conditions change. We aim to help organizations execute two to ten times faster, with shared memory, clear responsibilities and people accountable for consequential decisions. We are starting with ourselves. We are building our own company around this same model, using AI agents in the work of creating and operating the business. An MVP is being built with our first design partner, grounding development in concrete operational needs. Our ambition: build a unicorn within five years, serving Western Europe and ASEAN. Your role as cofounder Join as a peer in founding leadership to co-design the product and the company. Own technical strategy, architecture and engineering within agreed priorities and budgets. Shape product direction, key hires and fundraising together. Ownership and commitment 20–30% co-founder equity before pre-seed, subject to future dilution. Proposed vesting over four years in annual tranches, conditional on continued contribution and agreed milestones. Full terms shared with shortlisted candidates and agreed before joining. No cash compensation before funding. We are bootstrapped. Weekly commitment, outside activities and transition to full-time agreed upfront. €90,000 gross annual salary during the funded pre-seed phase, once financing is secured. €700,000 pre-seed target by December 2026. Seed readiness targeted for late 2027. Compensation reviewed after successful seed financing, based on results and resources. Dates are objectives. Must have • Daily Hermes Agent practice: skills, MCP integrations, orchestration, tools and persistent memory. • Agentic memory expertise: episodic, semantic and procedural memory, context engineering, retrieval, knowledge graphs, freshness, provenance and permissions. • AI-native development: OpenCode, Aider, Goose, Claude Code, Codex or comparable agents, from specification to delivery. Demonstrate depth in your chosen tools, delegation and verification. • Strong software engineering: Python, async execution, APIs, databases, containers, CI/CD and testing. • Strong, verifiable open-source contributions or maintenance experience. • Fluent English, both spoken and written. Should have Enterprise delivery on AWS, Microsoft Azure or GCP; scaling projects and leading engineers or maintainers; agentic reliability through evals, tracing, recovery, sandboxing and human approval boundaries. Nice to have Startup or founding experience, an exit, conference speaking, technical publications or community leadership. Where you live We are based in France. You must physically reside in Belgium, France, Germany, Indonesia, Malaysia, Netherlands, Singapore, Thailand, United Kingdom or Vietnam. Start with evidence Apply through our English questionnaire with your strengths, learning priorities and actual contributions. Honest gaps are welcome. Trust and constructive disagreement matter. Apply online: click the Apply button to open our questionnaire in English. Applications reviewed each weekend; every applicant receives a decision the following week. Shortlisted candidates meet the founder for 30 minutes on Google Meet from early November 2026, before any agreed mutual assessment. Bring something you built; I will bring what I have built. Founder fit matters on both sides. ──────────────────────────────────── FRANÇAIS CTO et cofondateur IA agentique | Startup confidentielle basée en France | À distance | Démarrage immédiat possible Construisez l’entreprise que vous vouliez créer Nous construisons une entreprise qui aide ses clients à devenir des organisations hybrides, où les équipes humaines et les agents IA travaillent ensemble pour transformer la stratégie en actions concrètes. Notre point de départ est la gestion stratégique des portefeuilles de projets (SPM) : choisir les bonnes initiatives, coordonner leur exécution et s’adapter lorsque les priorités ou les conditions évoluent. Notre objectif est d’aider les organisations à exécuter leur stratégie deux à dix fois plus vite, grâce à une mémoire partagée, des responsabilités claires et des décisions importantes qui restent sous responsabilité humaine. Nous commençons par nous-mêmes. Notre propre entreprise est le premier terrain sur lequel nous développons et améliorons cette façon de travailler, en faisant participer des agents IA à sa construction et à son fonctionnement. Un MVP est en cours de développement avec un premier design partner, autour de besoins opérationnels concrets. items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer based in Germany. Join a mission-driven engineering team developing practical AI systems that address real-world challenges in healthcare, agriculture, education, and international development. As an AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build, evaluate, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered applications used by nonprofit organizations and their communities. You will work on solutions ranging from clinical copilots and AI coaching tools to agricultural advisory chatbots and evaluation infrastructure. Collaborating with behavioral scientists, researchers, and embedded engineers, you will translate applied AI research into reliable, scalable products and reusable technical resources. You will also help partner organizations strengthen their own AI capabilities through mentorship, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing. This fully remote role offers substantial technical ownership and the opportunity to apply advanced AI engineering to initiatives that can improve outcomes for millions of people. Accountabilities In this role, you will build and improve production-ready AI systems while helping nonprofit partners adopt effective, measurable, and responsible AI practices. Your work will combine hands-on engineering, applied research, experimentation, and collaboration with teams working directly in the field. Design, build, evaluate, deploy, and improve machine learning systems and AI-powered applications for real-world use cases. Contribute to open-source AI evaluation infrastructure and tools that help nonprofit organizations assess and improve their AI products. Work closely with behavioral scientists, researchers, and field teams to identify recurring challenges and translate findings into reusable tools, frameworks, playbooks, and technical publications. Develop rigorous evaluation methods for AI systems, including appropriate datasets, evaluation criteria, and measurable performance improvements. Build and iterate on production-grade LLM applications and agentic systems, improving their reliability, usefulness, and performance for intended users. Release meaningful technical innovations from partner projects as open-source contributions whenever appropriate. Deliver solutions through rapid development and deployment cycles, using experimentation and measurable feedback to guide improvements. Document technical decisions, maintain engineering standards, and ensure AI components remain reliable and maintainable. Monitor developments in applied AI research, assess relevant advances, and test promising approaches in practical settings. Advise and support nonprofit organizations developing generative AI products, helping them adopt effective engineering practices, tools, and workflows. Mentor partner organization staff and help strengthen their internal technical capabilities and responsible AI practices. Contribute to workshops, seminars, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that communicate lessons and best practices from ongoing projects. Conduct site visits to understand operational challenges, observe how AI tools are used, and recommend technical improvements based on direct user needs. Take initiative in identifying problems, defining solutions, and driving projects through implementation and deployment. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning fundamentals with substantial hands-on experience delivering end-user AI products. You should be comfortable moving between research, experimentation, production engineering, and collaboration with nontechnical stakeholders, while maintaining a strong focus on practical impact. Strong foundations in mathematics, deep learning, large language models (LLMs), and modern AI systems. At least 4 years of hands-on machine learning engineering experience, including building, evaluating, and systematically improving at least one end-user-facing product powered by deep learning. Experience limited to integrating model APIs, building internal dashboards, or contributing solely to ML infrastructure does not meet this requirement. At least 1–2 years of experience building LLM-powered applications, including at least one production-grade agent beyond a proof of concept. Practical experience evaluating AI systems, with a strong understanding of dataset design, evaluation methodology, and performance measurement. Proficiency in Python and a willingness to remain deeply involved in hands-on implementation. Fluency in prompting and context engineering for agentic systems, including the ability to determine whether a problem requires improved prompting, a different model, better tools, or changes to the overall pipeline. Experience using AI coding agents to produce high-quality work, with the judgment and accountability to validate outputs and take responsibility for what you ship. Ability to read …

Implementar y optimizar algoritmos de procesado digital de señal (DSP) para transmisión y recepción de comunicaciones. Desarrollar funcionalidades relacionadas con modulaciones, codificación de canal, sincronización, ecualización y técnicas de espectro ensanchado. Modelar, simular y validar soluciones de comunicaciones mediante Matlab y Simulink. Participar en el diseño e implementación de soluciones sobre FPGA utilizando VHDL. Colaborar en la integración y validación de sistemas de comunicaciones avanzados basados en arquitecturas SDR, RFSoC y MPSoC. Requisitos: Titulación en Ingeniería de Telecomunicación o similar. Experiencia de mínimo 8 años en el diseño y desarrollo de formas de onda y/o datalinks (capas 1 y 2). Sólidos conocimientos de procesado digital de señal: modulaciones, codificación, sincronización, ecualización y técnicas de espectro ensanchado. Experiencia avanzada en Matlab y Simulink. Conocimientos y experiencia en desarrollo FPGA mediante VHDL. Valorable experiencia con arquitecturas RFSoC y/o MPSoC. Conocimientos de programación en C/C++ para sistemas embebidos. Valorable experiencia en comunicaciones militares, SATCOM y estándares ESSOR. Se ofrece : la posibilidad de trabajar en proyectos de defensa y aeroespacial. en una empresa líder a nivel tecnológico. con 2 días de teletrabajo a la semana. ubicación del puesto en Barcelona.

items.desc: Who We Are We’ve been helping clients plan and invest for their futures for over 50 years. From more than 25 locations around the world, we provide investment services and retirement expertise to everyone from central banks to private individuals. We’re known for acting with integrity and thinking for the long-term. And across our organisation, we foster a welcoming, caring and inclusive culture where people feel respected, trusted and able to be themselves. The Team You Will Join Fidelity Platforms is the engine that powers Fidelity's global business, bringing together technology, digital, cybersecurity, data and platform capabilities to deliver innovative, scalable and secure solutions for our customers and associates worldwide. Operating across multiple global locations, our teams work together to build and support the platforms, products and services that enable Fidelity's investment, retirement and workplace businesses. By combining engineering excellence, modern technology practices, AI-enabled innovation and a customer-first mindset, Fidelity Platforms plays a critical role in driving Fidelity's digital transformation, enhancing client experiences and supporting long-term business growth. As a graduate, you'll join a collaborative global community with opportunities to contribute across software engineering, data, cloud, cybersecurity and technology transformation initiatives while developing the skills needed to shape the future of financial technology. What You’ll Be Doing Working as part of agile technology teams, you'll contribute to the design, development, testing and deployment of innovative solutions across software engineering, data, cloud, cybersecurity and various technology domains. You'll apply modern engineering practices to solve real business challenges, leverage AI-powered tools to enhance productivity and contribute to the delivery of secure, scalable and customer-focused technology solutions. As your experience grows, you'll collaborate with stakeholders, influence technical decisions and help shape the future of technology at Fidelity. The Difference You’ll Make As your skills, confidence, and functional expertise grow, you’ll become increasingly involved in key decisions that help our customers achieve their investment and financial planning goals. Through hands-on experience, you’ll build deep knowledge of the industry, products, and customer needs, enabling you to make a meaningful impact. You’ll also provide invaluable support to your team, contributing insights and expertise while continuing to develop your professional capabilities. How You’ll Be Supported Our Graduate Programme is designed to provide a strong foundation for a successful career in technology through a combination of structured learning, hands-on experience and continuous support. From day one, you'll participate in a comprehensive induction and technology bootcamp that helps you build core capabilities across software engineering, data, cloud, cybersecurity and modern delivery practices, while also developing the professional skills needed to thrive in a collaborative environment. A key focus of the programme is building AI Fluency, equipping graduates with the ability to responsibly leverage AI-powered tools to enhance productivity, accelerate software development, improve analysis and solve real business challenges. As you progress, you'll apply these skills in agile delivery teams, working on live projects that create tangible business value while gaining exposure to a variety of technology disciplines. Beyond technical development, you'll benefit from ongoing training, leadership interactions, networking opportunities and workshops focused on communication, adaptability and personal effectiveness. Support is embedded throughout the experience, with dedicated managers, mentors and buddies helping you navigate your career journey, while a vibrant early careers community provides opportunities to build lasting professional networks. By the end of the programme, you'll have developed both the technical expertise and AI-enabled ways of working needed to succeed in an increasingly technology-driven world, with access to continued learning and career opportunities across Fidelity. What We Look For We are looking for graduates to help accelerate FIL’s enterprise data journey, combining data, technology and AI to solve real enterprise problems. The focus is on strengthening our data foundations while finding smarter, more automated ways of working – using AI to accelerate the data journey, not just preparing data for AI. We’re Looking For People Who Are curious about data, AI and emerging technologies Bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills Have an aptitude for technology and data, with coding or engineering skills an advantage Are comfortable challenging existing ways of working, experimenting and learning Can connect data and technology to meaningful business outcomes Enjoy collaborating across …

items.desc: Des expertises, une passion partagée, une envie commune : Grandir avec le Bois ! ISB est un acteur reconnu, spécialiste des solutions bois en France. Nous sélectionnons les meilleurs bois, fabriquons des produits fiables et durables pour fournir des solutions bas carbone, adaptées aux besoins des acteurs de la construction, de l’aménagement, de l’industrie. Chez ISB, nous anticipons demain : les équipent ne cessent, depuis plus de 60 ans, de faire avancer l’entreprise pour porter haut et fort le bois en France et s’adapter continuellement aux nouveaux besoins. Notre spécialité ? Apporter des solutions d’avenir, dans un monde qui doit se réinventer. Les expertises ISB sont là pour accompagner cette dynamique avec des solutions bois performantes et durables. Ces solutions sont aussi respectueuses : des femmes et des hommes, du bois et des forêts (avec des approvisionnements contrôlés et certifiés), de notre planète (grâce à des produits à faible impact et des transports optimisés). Mais la grande force d’ISB réside dans son esprit d’équipe : au sein de l’entreprise en unissant les compétences et les personnalités de 350 collaborateurs. Description du poste et Missions : Vous recherchez une mission dans le domaine de l’IT ? Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour être à la pointe de la technologie ? Vous aimeriez intégrer une entreprise tournée vers une démarche RSE engagée ? Alors notre proposition peut vous intéresser ! Le Groupe ISB recrute un Freelance IT/ IA/ Low code (H/F) pour son site de Bruz (35). Vous intégrerez une équipe dynamique, empreint d’un fort esprit d’équipe ! Votre principale mission sera de concevoir et déployer des solutions digitales innovantes, combinant low-code, intelligence artificielle et valorisation des données, afin d'accompagner la transformation numérique d'ISB et d'améliorer durablement la performance des équipes. A ce titre, vos misions pourront être les suivantes : Analyser les besoins des différents métiers (RH, commerce, production, fonctions support) et proposer des solutions adaptées. Identifier les opportunités d'amélioration des processus existants grâce aux outils digitaux. Concevoir et développer des applications métiers avec Power Apps et les technologies low-code. Structurer, fiabiliser et exploiter les données de l'entreprise via Dataverse, SQL et autres solutions de gestion de données. Mettre en œuvre des automatisations de processus avec Power Automate pour gagner en efficacité opérationnelle. Participer à l'identification et à la qualification de cas d'usage concrets autour de l'intelligence artificielle. Déployer et tester des assistants IA, agents intelligents et solutions Copilot en collaboration avec les utilisateurs. Contribuer à l'interconnexion des outils développés avec l'ERP de l'entreprise et garantir la cohérence des flux de données. Rédiger la documentation fonctionnelle et technique des solutions mises en place. Profil : Vous sortez d'une formation de niveau supérieur en informatique, data, systèmes d'information ou école d'ingénieur et avez idéalement une première expérience réussie Vous disposez de bases en développement et en gestion de données (SQL, Python ou équivalent) et manifestez un intérêt pour les outils low-code, l'automatisation et les solutions d'intelligence artificielle. Sensible aux enjeux de la donnée et des systèmes d'information, vous faites preuve d'un esprit analytique, d'autonomie et de rigueur. Curieux(se) et force de proposition, vous appréciez travailler en collaboration avec les équipes métiers et contribuer à des projets concrets à fort impact. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? ISB est un acteur engagé et qui travaille un matériau naturellement attractif : le bois ! Un parcours d’intégration personnalisé : visites de site, rencontres avec les équipes, les services support… Notre processus de recrutement : Préqualification téléphonique : Premier échange avec notre équipe RH (Emmanuelle ou Raphaël) pour vous présenter l’entreprise, le poste et mieux cerner votre profil et vos attentes. Entretien avec le manager : Rencontre avec votre futur manager pour parler plus en détail des missions et valider l’adéquation technique et humaine. Rencontre des équipes & visite du site : Dernière étape sur site pour découvrir les locaux, échanger avec l’équipe et vous projeter dans votre futur environnement. Cette annonce vous a plu ? Vous souhaitez grandir avec le bois ? ISB Recrute N’hésitez plus, envoyez-nous votre candidature !

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un(e) Ingénieur performance et algorithme GNSS (h/f) au sein du département "Navigation au sein de la division "Engineering / Upstream Ground Systems" de Space Systems". 
 Vous rejoindrez une équipe composée d'ingénieurs en Navigation passionnés, hautement qualifiés, couvrant un large spectre d'expertise dans les systèmes GNSS complexes tels que EGNOS V3 , le SBAS (Satellite Based Augmentation System) européen augmentant le GPS et GALILEO. 
 Vous contribuerez aux vérifications des performances de navigation du système EGNOS V3. En particulier, vous interviendrez sur des analyses de performance de type end-to-end ou plus localement sur les différents éléments composant le système, tels que les RIMS ( Ranging Integrity Monitoring Station) ou encore le CPF (Central Processing Facility). Le CPF inclut le PCF (Prediction Chain Facility) en charge des calculs des corrections d’orbite et d’horloge des satellites et des corrections ionosphériques, l' ICF (Integrity Chain Facility) en charge de l’intégrité de ces corrections, et de leurs algorithmes respectifs. 
 Depuis 2018, Airbus Defence and Space est le maître d'œuvre de l'Agence spatiale européenne (ESA) et de la Commission européenne (CE) pour le projet EGNOS. Rejoignez-nous pour relever les défis GNSS d'aujourd'hui et de demain, en assurant l'interface avec les principaux acteurs institutionnels du GNSS et les utilisateurs finaux évoluant dans un environnement transnational ! 
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! 
 Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : 
 Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d’actions souscrites. 
 Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et sportives et d’autres services. 
 Bien-être / santé : couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage. 
 Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale). 
 Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. 
 Vos challenges: 
 Appréhender les besoins des clients, 
 Se familiariser avec les algorithmes du CPF (ICF et /ou PCF), 
 Appréhender les contraintes de l'architecture d'EGNOS V3, 
 Contribuer à la définition, préparation et au lancement des campagnes de simulations pour évaluer les performances, en utilisant les moyens mis en place, 
 Contribuer aux rapports de tests et datapacks pour les revues EGNOS V3. 
Vous serez impliqué(e) sur tous les jalons d'EGNOS jusqu'à sa qualification finale lors de grandes campagnes d'essais utilisant des simulateurs et une plateforme haut de gamme dédiée.
 Votre profil : 
 Compétences avérées en GNSS, traitement du signal, mathématiques appliquées ou systèmes spatiaux, 
 Connaissance des systèmes GNSS (analyses de données et traitement au niveau des récepteurs), 
 Connaissance des performances des SBAS et des algorithmes (disponibilité, continuité, précision, intégrité), 
 Connaissance des systèmes et signaux de navigation par satellite (GPS, EGNOS, GALILEO), 
 Expérience en langage de programmation (python, scripts, ...), 
 Connaissance des outils de simulation : Matlab/Simulink, 
 Forte implication/motivation pour les sujets GNSS et Navigation, 
 Bonne communication, proactivité, autonomie et dynamisme, 
 Langue : niveau avancé d’anglais. 
 Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Vous ne matchez pas à 100%? Pas d'inquiétude! Airbus vous accompagnera dans votre plan de développement.

items.card: THE ROLE As an Evaluation Engineer on the Applied AI team, you will shape how enterprise customers measure and trust AI solutions. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to deliver evaluation systems that define when an AI model is ready for real business impact. The team's mission is to ensure every project—no matter how ambitious—moves from idea to production with clarity and accountability.
items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




THE ROLE

As an Evaluation Engineer on the Applied AI team, you will shape how enterprise customers measure and trust AI solutions. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to deliver evaluation systems that define when an AI model is ready for real business impact. The team's mission is to ensure every project—no matter how ambitious—moves from idea to production with clarity and accountability. Your work will sit at the intersection of research, engineering, and solutions, directly influencing how models are improved and deployed across varied domains.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Design and implement comprehensive frameworks to evaluate large language model (LLM) performance across customer use cases

 - Build and maintain scalable evaluation infrastructure and pipelines for rapid, reproducible assessment

 - Develop new evaluation methods for sector-specific or emerging model capabilities

 - Collaborate with customers to create custom evaluation suites that fit their unique needs and criteria

 - Partner with research teams to turn evaluation insights into actionable model improvements

 - Work with product teams to refine evaluation tooling based on user feedback

 - Define and communicate clear success metrics for "production-ready" AI models


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience evaluating ML, LLM, or agentic systems

 - Proven background in implementing AI or machine learning products, especially with APIs or back-end systems

 - Strong Python coding skills

 - Deep understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms, especially as they pertain to LLMs

 - Experience communicating technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Familiarity with evaluation frameworks like LM Eval Harness or OpenAI Evals, or contributions to related open-source projects

 - Experience working with ML libraries (e.g., PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers)

 - Collaborative, direct communicator who values outcomes and low-ego teamwork




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.




PRIVACY POLICY

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

 

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

 

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.


ROLE IMPACT

You will build and post-train agents for scientific research: searching literature, writing and running code, using domain tools, and choosing the next experiment. The work spans autonomous research and computational science, with environments and evaluations built around research partners' tools, data, and experimental feedback.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

Prime's autonomous-research study https://www.primeintellect.ai/blog/measuring-autonomous-research used multi-day nanoGPT optimization tasks to examine how agents measure noise, revisit earlier experiments, and verify improvements. You will build similar experimental loops for scientific tools and datasets.

 - Build long-horizon environments where agents search literature, query scientific databases, run code and domain tools, and choose experiments within a fixed compute or experimental budget.

 - Turn research partners' workflows, datasets, and outcome criteria into trainable tasks, evaluations, and reward signals.

 - Design verifiers for correctness, novelty, and reproducibility. Test whether agents use the underlying evidence, with checks for label leakage, lookup shortcuts, and unsupported conclusions.

 - Connect programmatic checks, simulations, domain models, and expert feedback to training. Account for noisy or delayed results, calibrate confidence estimates, and define where an experiment needs human review.

 - Develop RL and multi-agent methods for proposing, testing, and critiquing hypotheses. Compare them with strong single-agent baselines at equal compute and evaluate on held-out problems.

 - Keep code, data, logs, and experiment configurations reproducible. Re-run promising results, measure noise, and use ablations to separate model improvements from changes to the data, harness, or inference setup. Release reusable environments, evaluations, and research code.


REQUIREMENTS

 - We are looking first for depth in RL, agents, or post-training systems and the ability to acquire the relevant scientific context.

 - Prior work in autonomous research, ML for science, scientific computing, or reproducible computational research is useful but not required.

 - Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.

 - Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.

 - Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.

 - Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Evidence of exceptional work

 - Professional Development budget

OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

 

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

 

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.


ROLE IMPACT

Computer-use agents must understand changing interfaces, maintain intent over long workflows, recover from mistakes, manage permissions and side effects, and know when an outcome is actually complete. You will build post-training and evaluation systems for multimodal agents operating browsers, desktops, and cross-application workflows. The work is grounded in an active external program. The research challenge is turning real workflows and traces into environments, rewards, and experiments that produce reliable improvement.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

Representative early problems

 - Build long-horizon computer-use environments from real workflows while preventing shortcuts, leakage, and unsafe side effects.

 - Train agents to recover from interface changes, partial failures, and ambiguous intermediate states instead of restarting or silently drifting.

 - Develop evaluations that distinguish genuine completion from plausible-looking behavior, including correctness, efficiency, permissions, and appropriate escalation.

What you will own

 - Multimodal environments built from partner workflows, demonstrations, tools, interface state, and outcome criteria.

 - Browser, desktop, and cross-application agents with reliable sandbox and boundary enforcement.

 - Training and evaluation from demonstrations, interventions, production failures, synthetic tasks, and verifiable outcomes.

 - Experiments on recovery and generalization across applications, layouts, permissions, and deployment contexts.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Relevant experience: multimodal agents, computer use, browser or desktop automation, RL, imitation learning, HCI, embodied agents, or long-horizon agent evaluation.

 - Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.

 - Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.

 - Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.

 - Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Evidence of exceptional work

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Cash Compensation Range of $150-300k + equity incentives

 - Flexible Work (San Francisco, New York, London, or remote)

 - Visa Sponsorship & relocation support

 - Professional Development budget

 - Team Off-sites & conference attendance

mimic robotics is a frontier physical AI company building the full stack of general-purpose dexterous manipulation. Founded in 2024 by ETH Zurich researchers, mimic pioneered Video-Action Models for robotics while also developing in-house dexterous hand hardware. Our growing team brings together world-class researchers working across our offices in Zurich and San Francisco.
 As a Forward Deployed Robotics Engineer , you will bring mimic's AI capabilities to new robotic platforms and customer environments. You will work directly with robotics customers to integrate our models, optimize their software and robotics stack, and drive the technical changes required for successful deployment. 
 Working across AI, robotics, and software, you will own technical integrations from initial planning through deployment. You will also help build scalable tooling and workflows that make our AI capabilities easier to deploy, monitor, and improve across different robotic platforms 
 Responsibilities 
 Integrate and deploy mimic's AI models on different robotic platforms and hardware stacks
 Adapt our software, training, and deployment stack to new robots, sensors, and environments
 Work directly with customer engineering teams to integrate and optimize their robotics stack
 Diagnose AI, software, and robotics integration issues and drive them to resolution
 Build scalable tooling and workflows for deploying, monitoring, and improving our models
 Define technical requirements and implement features that improve model productization
 Own deployment planning and execution, coordinating across customers and internal teams
 Translate deployment learnings into improvements for our AI, robotics, and product stack
 Track deployment performance and communicate progress and technical risks to stakeholders
 Requirements 
 Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Robotics, AI, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field
 Strong robotics background and a very good understanding of physical AI and robotics systems
 Excellent software engineering skills, with the ability to design, implement, and test robust solutions
 Strong Python skills and experience with modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch
 Experience deploying AI/ML systems on real robotic hardware
 Good understanding of AI training methods, data pipelines, and model evaluation
 Ability to build repeatable and scalable solutions rather than one-off integrations
 Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work across AI, software, and robotics
 Strong ownership and ability to independently plan and execute technical deployments
 Excellent communication skills and confidence working directly with technical customers
 Fluent English
 Willingness to travel for customer deployments and technical workshops
 Driving Licence (B)
 Nice to have 
 Familiarity with modern robot learning approaches (imitation learning, reinforcement learning, diffusion policies, foundation models)
 Experience with robotic manipulation, ROS/ROS2, robot control systems, or simulation environments
 Experience integrating AI models with robotic hardware platforms
 Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containerization, and deployment tooling (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)
 Compensation & Benefits 
 We offer a total compensation package including a competitive yearly base salary and a strong stock option package to make you part of our shared success.

At mimic, you are accepted for who you are.  Join our Team
 About this opportunity: 
 Dreaming about a traineeship that kickstarts your career? Unwrap your future with us! At Ericsson Estonia supply site, we’re giving you more than just a traineeship— we’re offering you a chance to dive into the business side of cutting-edge technology, work on projects that matter, and grow into the professional you want to be.
As a Manufacturing AI Trainee, you will support AI-driven initiatives in Ericsson’s Tallinn manufacturing environment, developing and testing computer-vision, automation and smart-factory solutions. You’ll work with Production alongside industrial engineering and automation specialists to analyze processes, identify improvement opportunities and turn pilot ideas into practical solutions. This traineeship offers hands-on learning in manufacturing processes and smart-factory technologies, including the opportunity to develop a small-scale Manufacturing AI pilot.
 This is a standard office hours Traineeship – Mon-Fri, 40 hour per week (8hr per day). 
 What you will do: 
 • Support implementation of AI-driven solutions in manufacturing operations
• Help develop, test and improve computer-vision and automation applications
• Participate in smart-factory pilots, from defining objectives to developing a small-scale pilot solution
• Analyze manufacturing processes and identify potential AI use cases and improvement opportunities
• Collaborate with Production, engineering, industrial engineering and automation teams
• Document pilot objectives, tests, results and lessons learned, and share findings as agreed
• Communicate risks, blockers and decisions needed to the manager, and keep work-related documentation up to date
• Follow occupational safety, information security, confidentiality, quality and ESD requirements; use company data and systems only for assigned work and within granted access
 Who we are looking for: 
 • Students studying AI, information technology, automation, robotics, industrial engineering or a related field, with an interest in AI, automation or manufacturing
• Analytical, practical problem-solver with good collaboration skills; programming, computer vision/machine learning, robotics, automation or technical-project experience is a plus, not required. Estonian or Russian is also an advantage
• Curious, passionate individuals eager to bring fresh ideas, adapt to change and learn quickly
• Candidates who are willing to take initiative, challenge themselves, and make a positive impact
• Good proficiency in English, both verbal and written
 Why you will love it here: 
• Supportive, collaborative team – You’ll be surrounded by friendly colleagues who are always ready to help and share their knowledge.
• Real development opportunities – From day one, you’ll learn new skills, get hands on experience, and grow in areas that matter for your career.
• A culture that values curiosity – Ask questions, try new things, and explore ideas — we encourage it.
• Opportunities to connect and feel part of the team – Team events, knowledge-sharing sessions, and chances to network across the organization.
 How to apply: 
• Apply early — applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
• Upload your CV (English version) and complete screening questions
• Candidates who pass the screening will be invited to a short virtual interview with a recruiter 
• Shortlisted applicants will be contacted for further assessment

Innovation is at the heart of everything we do, and it is fueled by our commitment to the inclusion of unique perspectives and different experiences. Because power is nothing without our people! 
 WHY JOIN US 
We are offering a rewarding role with scope for career progression along with: 
 • International, engaging, and supportive working environment.
• Global onboarding process.
• Bespoke training and development programs accessible to all.
• Competitive welfare and benefits package.
• International mobility opportunities.
 DRIVE YOUR FUTURE 
The Cyber Tyre Algorithms Engineer will contribute to the development of innovative algorithms that transform the Smart Tyre vision into real-world automotive solutions. The mission is to enable new vehicle functionalities that enhance safety, driving performance, and the overall driving experience.
The role combines algorithm development, experimental validation, and hands-on engineering. You will have the opportunity to explore new ideas, develop working prototypes, and validate innovative solutions directly on vehicles, supporting the entire development process from concept generation to real-world implementation.
 YOUR CORE ACTIVITIES 
• Develop and validate innovative estimation and control algorithms for Smart Tyre and vehicle applications. 
• Design, implement, and test prototypes using embedded systems and rapid prototyping platforms. 
• Perform experimental activities, including vehicle testing, data acquisition, and track validation. 
• Analyze vehicle data and simulation results to improve algorithm performance and robustness. 
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to bring new functionalities from concept to real-world implementation. 
• Explore innovative technologies and approaches to continuously enhance Smart Tyre solutions.
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
• Master’s degree in Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Physics, or equivalent disciplines. 
• 2-3 years of experience in Vehicle Dynamics, Vehicle Control Systems, State Estimation, ADAS, or related automotive fields. 
• Strong knowledge of vehicle dynamics and experience in estimation and control-oriented algorithm development. 
• Good programming skills in MATLAB, Simulink, Python, C/C++, or similar environments. 
• Experience in experimental data analysis, algorithm validation, vehicle testing, and simulation environments. 
• Good proficiency in English.
 WHAT PUTS YOU IN POLE POSITION 
• Experience with embedded systems, rapid prototyping platforms, and hands-on engineering projects. 
• Familiarity with machine learning techniques, cloud-based data analysis environments, or tyre-related applications. 
• Strong creativity, engineering curiosity, and passion for experimentation. 
• Pragmatic problem-solving attitude with the ability to transform ideas into validated solutions. 
• Strong ownership and ability to effectively collaborate within multidisciplinary teams.
 COMPENSATION PACKAGE 
• The employment contract will be regulated by “Gomma Plastica” National Collective Bargaining Agreement.
• The gross annual base salary (RAL) offered will be no less than €32.000.
• The Company is committed to offering a competitive compensation package and, following the selection process, may propose a final gross annual base salary above the stated level, commensurate with the candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications.
• The position’s compensation package also includes a variable component and a competitive welfare and benefits offer. Further details will be provided at a later stage and will be subject to the applicable Company policies.
 APPLY NOW, DRIVE YOUR FUTURE! 
 #WePirelli 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and this search is open to all individuals, in compliance with the principles of equal opportunity and non-discrimination, pursuant to applicable laws and regulations.

Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

 Own delivery of defined data pipeline workstreams that transform raw data into valuable insights, ensuring scalability and reliability in cloud environments. 
 Develop, tune, and refactor data models with a focus on query performance, workload efficiency, and maintainability. 
 Partner with cross-functional teams to turn business requirements into technical solutions and delivery plans. 
 Implement data quality checks, apply governance standards, and drive clear remediation paths for quality issues. 
 Operate automated data ingestion, observability, and monitoring systems to track operational KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and improve pipeline health. 
 Build, maintain, and improve ETL processes and machine learning workflows, providing clean AI ready data for applications and downstream products. 
 Apply and share data engineering practices through design patterns, CI/CD integrations, containerized deployments, code reviews, and technical documentation.

 Hands-on experience building and improving ETL/ELT pipelines (IICS or equivalent), data transformation models (dbt preferred), and Python data processing components. 
 Experience operating cloud data services (AWS preferred) and orchestration frameworks (Airflow preferred) for production workflows. 
 Practical DevOps and DataOps experience, including CI/CD (GitHub Actions preferred), version control (Git), and infrastructure as code principles (Terraform preferred). 
 Ability to choose and apply engineering patterns and technical standards for defined workstreams. 
 Soft Skills: 
 Owns delivery of defined data engineering workstreams with sound judgment, accountability, and attention to operational quality. 
 Partners confidently with cross-functional stakeholders to shape practical technical solutions. 
 Shares knowledge with peers and helps improve team practices through reviews and documentation. 
 Comfortable using approved AI-enabled tools to improve engineering productivity, documentation, code quality, and operational effectiveness, while following Sanofi's Responsible AI and data governance standards. 
 Patient-focused and quality-driven, with a collaborative mindset, high standards, and a constructive approach to feedback, problem-solving, and continuous improvement. 
 Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.

items.desc: Voorstelling dienst: Intelligence Georganiseerde criminaliteit is slim, snel en meedogenloos. Wie daartegen wil optreden, moet minstens even scherp staan. Bij de Federale Gerechtelijke Politie West-Vlaanderen is intelligence één van onze krachtigste wapens. Binnen de cluster Intelligence bouwen we elke dag aan een helder en betrouwbaar beeld van de criminaliteit: wie speelt welke rol, waar lopen geldstromen, welke patronen tekenen zich af? Dat doen we door enorme hoeveelheden data te verzamelen, te verrijken en te analyseren — met behulp van innovatieve technologieën en zelfontwikkelde tools. Onze intelligence-specialisten zijn pioniers. Ze vertalen ruwe data naar inzichten die onderzoekers helpen om sneller, gerichter en veiliger te werken. Zo dragen ze rechtstreeks bij aan de bestrijding van zware en georganiseerde criminaliteit. Functieomschrijving Criminele netwerken laten vandaag overal digitale sporen na: banktransacties, telefoniegegevens, logistieke data, open bronnen, handelsstromen… Die informatie is goud waard — als je ze tenminste kan structureren, koppelen en analyseren. Als Machine Learning Engineer/data scientist versterk jij de capaciteit van FGP West-Vlaanderen om dat te doen. Je werkt samen met analisten en onderzoekers. Je ontwikkelt en implementeert tools die grote hoeveelheden data automatisch verwerken en doorzoekbaar maken. Je helpt complexe datasets structureren zodat onderzoekers er meteen mee aan de slag kunnen. Je bouwt mee aan oplossingen die geldstromen reconstrueren, netwerken blootleggen en patronen of anomalieën detecteren. Je vertaalt analytische modellen naar robuuste en gebruiksvriendelijke toepassingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat ontwikkelde oplossingen schaalbaar, onderhoudbaar en betrouwbaar blijven. Dankzij jouw werk worden hypotheses niet alleen vermoed, maar onderbouwd met objectieve data-inzichten. Je werkt mee aan dossiers en projecten met maatschappelijke impact — jouw code maakt écht een verschil. Kortom: jij maakt van data operationele intelligence. Gewenst profiel Je houdt ervan om complexe problemen te ontleden en op te lossen. Je denkt analytisch, maar verliest de praktijk nooit uit het oog. Je werkt graag samen en communiceert vlot met zowel technische profielen als eindgebruikers. Je hebt een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen en denkt data-driven. Je kan helder communiceren en overlegt vlot met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines. Je hecht veel belang aan datakwaliteit, nauwkeurigheid en betrouwbaarheid. Je ziet automatisering en schaalbaarheid niet als extra’s, maar als basisprincipes. Je deelt je kennis graag en draagt actief bij aan een positieve teamsfeer. Specifieke vaardigheden Minstens 4 jaar relevante ervaring in data science of machine learning engineering. Grondige kennis van Python voor data-analyse en automatisering. Ervaring met ML Ops en infrastructuur (zoals Git, MLflow; ervaring met Kubernetes of Kubeflow is een plus). Kennis van datamodellering en het optimaliseren van complexe queries is een meerwaarde. Ervaring met relationele en niet-relationele databanken (SQL & NoSQL), zoals PostgreSQL, MySQL, Neo4j, Elastic DB… Talenkennis: je beheerst het Nederlands en kan vlot werken in het Engels. Opmerkingen Je komt terecht in een innovatieve werkomgeving waar leren, experimenteren en verbeteren centraal staan. Toelatingsvoorwaarden Minstens 4 jaar relevante ervaring Je beschikt over een masterdiploma ICT of een gelijkgestelde opleiding (Twijfel? Neem gerust contact op). items.desc: Vi søger en data scientist med stor erfaring i at udføre sundhedsøkonomiske analyser ved Dansk Center for Sundhedsøkonomi, Institut for Sundhedstjenesteforskning , Det Sundhedsvidenskabelige Fakultet , Syddansk Universitet , med tiltrædelse den 1. januar 2027. Der er tale om en 2-årig ansættelse. Stillingen udgør 75% (27,75 timer per uge). Dansk Center for Sundhedsøkonomi (DaCHE) er nordens største center for sundhedsøkonomisk forskning og undervisning. DaCHE bygger på mere end 25 års erfaring med at designe og gennemføre sundhedsøkonomiske forskningsprojekter og analyser med stærk faglig forankring og høj samfundsrelevans. Centeret har en stærk international profil, og samarbejder tæt med både kliniske forskningsmiljøer og sundhedspolitiske myndigheder. Vi er ca. 40 forskere, data scientists og data managers, der arbejder for at skabe innovativ forskning og stærk evidens, som kan understøtte styring og prioritering i sundhedsvæsenet. Vores forskning spænder bredt og omfatter blandt andet analyser af sundhedsrelateret adfærd, præferencer og incitamenter, evaluering af nye sundhedspolitiske initiativer samt sundhedsøkonomiske vurderinger af nye interventioner. Vi er meget empirisk drevne og anvender en bred vifte af metoder, herunder registerbaserede analyser, spørgeskemaundersøgelser, økonomiske evalueringer og præferencemålinger. Vi arbejder ofte med store og komplekse datasæt, der kombinerer register- og spørgeskemadata, og vi lægger stor vægt på metodisk kvalitet og samfundsmæssig relevans. Ansvarsområder Behandle store datamængder og foretage opdateringer Designe spørgeskemaer Ansvarlig for at linke data og udføre økonometriske analyser Foretage økonometriske analyse med henblik på at afdække kausale forhold Udarbejdelse af statistiske analyser Samarbejde med forskere, klinikere og myndigheder om forskningsprojekter med sundhedspolitisk relevans Kvalifikationer Har en relevant kandidatgrad inden for økonomi, sundhedsøkonomi, data science, statistik, matematik, folkesundhedsvidenskab eller et beslægtet fagområde. En ph.d.-grad vil være en fordel, men er ikke et krav Har erfaring med forskningsresultater og kan understøtte forskere i forbindelse med publicering af forskningsresultater i anerkendte fagfællebedømte tidsskrifter Der vil blive lagt vægt på kendskab til og erfaring med økonometriske analyser af registerdata Der vil endvidere blive lagt vægt på erfaring med design af spørgeskemaer Kontakt Ønsker du yderligere information om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte professor Dorte Gyrd-Hansen, dgh@sdu.dk . Ansøgningsproces Ansøgningsfristen er den 8. november 2026 kl. 23:59. Ansættelse pr. 1. januar 2027 eller snarest muligt derefter. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår Dit tjenestested er Dansk Center for Sundhedsøkonomi, Institut for Sundhedstjenesteforskning, Syddansk Universitet i Odense, Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M. Ansættelse finder sted i henhold til overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og AC. items.desc: Kalray est une entreprise technologique spécialisée dans les semi-conducteurs et le calcul haute performance au service de l’intelligence artificielle. Forte de plus de quinze ans d’expertise en architectures de calcul parallèle, en conception de processeurs et en systèmes de calcul haute performance, Kalray est une entreprise technologique française et un acteur européen de premier plan dans des domaines devenus essentiels aux infrastructures d’intelligence artificielle. Avec plus de 120 collaborateurs en France et en Roumanie, Kalray développe et licencie des technologies matérielles et logicielles stratégiques pour les nouvelles générations de semi-conducteurs dédiées aux infrastructures d’IA et, plus largement, aux applications nécessitant le traitement de volumes massifs de données. Ces technologies permettent de traiter, de faire circuler et d’orchestrer efficacement les données entre les différentes ressources de calcul, afin d’optimiser les performances, la consommation énergétique et la sécurité. Kalray accompagne ses clients à travers la concession de licences sur ses technologies matérielles et logicielles (IP), complétée par des projets de développement sur mesure. De la définition d’architectures complexes jusqu’à leur intégration dans de nouvelles générations de semi-conducteurs, Kalray associe ses technologies propriétaires à une solide expertise des systèmes, de la conception des puces en silicium et du développement de systèmes complets. Rejoindre Kalray, c’est intégrer une entreprise technologique européenne pionnière, qui conçoit des solutions innovantes à la croisée des semi-conducteurs, de l’intelligence artificielle et du calcul haute performance. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d’ingénieurs et d’experts technologiques reconnus, sur des projets de pointe qui contribuent à façonner l’avenir des infrastructures d’IA. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant, collaboratif et inclusif, où les professionnels expérimentés comme les nouveaux talents peuvent développer leurs compétences, évoluer et contribuer concrètement à des projets ambitieux. Le tout dans un cadre de vie privilégié, au cœur des paysages inspirants des Alpes ou de la Côte d’Azur. Envie de contribuer avec nous à façonner l’avenir des infrastructures d’intelligence artificielle ? Rejoignez l’aventure Kalray ! Kalray est cotée sur Euronext Growth Paris (ALKAL). Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre site internet et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn. Rejoignez l’équipe IA de Kalray, à la pointe de l’innovation, pour développer des solutions d’IA autonomes dédiées à la conception de puces de bout en bout, depuis la définition des exigences initiales et l’exploration architecturale jusqu’à la génération du RTL, à la vérification et à l’implémentation physique. Notre ambition est de repenser la manière dont les puces sont conçues en développant des systèmes agentiques capables de planifier des activités d’ingénierie complexes, de coordonner les outils de conception et d’itérer sur les résultats en s’appuyant sur des mécanismes de validation fiables. Cette approche doit ouvrir une nouvelle ère pour les architectures de puces, en permettant d’explorer des possibilités de conception difficiles à envisager avec les méthodes conventionnelles. Vous contribuerez directement à cette ambition en développant des solutions combinant des grands modèles de langage (LLM) de dernière génération, des agents d’IA et des outils de conception de semi-conducteurs. Dans un premier temps, vos travaux associeront une collaboration étroite avec les ingénieurs de Kalray, un accompagnement opérationnel à l’adoption de l’IA et le développement de prototypes fonctionnels. À mesure que vous vous familiariserez avec nos pratiques d’ingénierie et nos contraintes de conception, vous évoluerez vers le développement de processus autonomes de plus en plus ambitieux, avec pour objectif de transformer les premières expérimentations en solutions robustes capables de prendre en charge des projets complets de conception de puces. Vos principales responsabilités : Appliquer l’IA à des problématiques concrètes de nos activités techniques, développer des processus de travail efficaces et partager les approches qui ont fait leurs preuves. Concevoir des prototypes d’agents capables de planifier des tâches, d’utiliser des outils d’ingénierie, d’évaluer les résultats et d’itérer pour atteindre un objectif de conception défini. Explorer des processus couvrant l’exploration architecturale, la génération du RTL, la vérification et l’implémentation, en collaboration avec les experts en conception de puces. Connecter les modèles et les agents aux outils de conception via des API, des interfaces en ligne de commande et des scripts. Évaluer le degré d’autonomie, la fiabilité, la qualité de conception et l’efficacité des solutions développées par rapport aux processus d’ingénierie existants. items.desc: Ben jij geduldig, klantgericht en heb je affiniteit met techniek? Vind je het belangrijk om mensen op een rustige en duidelijke manier te helpen? Dan maken wij graag kennis met jou. Voor onze Low Vision hulpmiddelen zijn wij op zoek naar een enthousiaste buitendienstmedewerker. In deze functie ben jij het gezicht van Van Lent Systems bij onze klanten thuis. Je reist door heel Nederland om hulpmiddelen af te leveren, te installeren, uit te leggen en waar nodig te repareren. Onze hulpmiddelen helpen mensen met een visuele beperking om zelfstandiger te leven. Denk aan het kunnen lezen van een krant of boek, het bekijken van foto’s, het uitoefenen van hobby’s of het werken met een computer. Jij zorgt ervoor dat de klant het hulpmiddel goed begrijpt en met vertrouwen kan gebruiken. Je hoeft nog niet alles van onze producten te weten. Wij zorgen voor een uitgebreide producttraining én een technische training, zodat je precies weet hoe onze hulpmiddelen werken en hoe je kleine reparaties zelfstandig kunt uitvoeren. Wat ga je doen? Als buitendienstmedewerker ben je veel onderweg en kom je bij klanten in heel Nederland. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Het afleveren en installeren van Low Vision hulpmiddelen Het geven van duidelijke uitleg en instructie aan klanten Het uitvoeren van kleine reparaties aan beeldschermloepen en andere hulpmiddelen Het ophalen van hulpmiddelen bij klanten Wie ben jij? Jij bent iemand die graag zelfstandig werkt, maar ook goed communiceert met klanten en collega’s. Je vindt het belangrijk om mensen op een rustige, duidelijke en geduldige manier te helpen. Veel van onze klanten hebben extra uitleg of begeleiding nodig bij het gebruik van hun hulpmiddel. Daarom neem jij de tijd, luister je goed en zorg je ervoor dat de klant zich begrepen en op zijn gemak voelt. Daarnaast vragen wij: Minimaal MBO 4 werk- en denkniveau Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift Goede communicatieve vaardigheden Een klantgerichte, vriendelijke en geduldige houding Affiniteit met techniek of technisch inzicht Een representatieve uitstraling Flexibiliteit; geen 9-tot-17-mentaliteit Rijbewijs B Wat bieden wij jou? Je krijgt een afwisselende functie waarin geen dag hetzelfde is. Je bent veel onderweg, ontmoet verschillende mensen en werkt met producten die een waardevolle bijdrage leveren aan het dagelijks leven van slechtziende klanten. Bij Van Lent Systems kom je terecht in een betrokken organisatie die zich inzet voor mensen die ondersteuning verdienen in hun dagelijks leven. Wij leveren niet alleen hulpmiddelen, maar vinden goede service, begeleiding en persoonlijke aandacht minstens zo belangrijk. Salaris: Vanaf €2.600,00 per maand Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Pensioen Reiskostenvergoeding Werklocatie: Onderweg

items.desc: OptoScale’s underwater cameras record fish in real time, around the clock. Our machine learning models turn the images into measurements of weight, lice, health and behaviour, and show how the fish respond when the feed comes in. Now we want to close the loop. Feeding thousands of fish is a control problem with almost everything that makes control hard. You only see part of what’s going on. The feedback is noisy and delayed. Currents, temperature and weather keep shifting the conditions. And at the other end of the loop are living fish, whose appetite, stress and behaviour change from one day to the next. We already have the sensors, the data and the models, and the first parts of the decision layer are in place. The next step is to make it autonomous, and we’re looking for someone to help us get there. You’ll join our AI & Optics team in Trondheim, a group with backgrounds in physics, mathematics, cybernetics and marine technology. What you’ll do Shape and develop the control strategy for autonomous feeding: how sensor data turns into feeding decisions Estimate the state of the fish and their environment from noisy, delayed data, and forecast how both develop over time Work with our machine learning team to turn model outputs into reliable inputs for feeding decisions Write Python that runs in production, not just in notebooks Follow your work from first idea to deployment, and keep improving it once it’s running Who you are You have an MSc or PhD with a strong foundation in control theory, cybernetics or autonomous systems. You write strong Python, and you’re fluent in English, written and spoken. You take ownership and finish what you start, also when it gets hard. You know when to pull others in and when to get on with it yourself. And you’d rather see something work in the sea than look good in a simulation. What gives you an edge At least three years in research or development (a PhD counts) Statistical modelling, data science or forecasting Reinforcement or imitation learning It’s also a plus if you’ve built something that already runs in a real product, worked with transformers, generative models, computer vision or deep learning, or know aquaculture. About us We operate across Norway, Sweden and Chile. We build our own hardware and software, from the optics and electronics in the cameras to the algorithms and the portal our customers log into. So you’re not working around a black box. If your controller needs better data, you can sit down with the people who build the sensors. We’re small enough that what you build gets used, and specialised enough that someone will push back on your thinking. Recruitment process We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. To reduce bias, applications are first reviewed anonymously. Selected candidates will be invited to take an aptitude test and a personality test (Matrigma and MAP from Assessio), and we may carry out background checks as part of the process.

items.desc: Shape the future of industrial operations with Falkor At Falkor, we’re building technology that helps industrial companies understand, optimise and operate complex assets more intelligently. We combine deep industrial domain expertise with advanced simulation, software and AI to solve some of the toughest challenges in energy and industrial operations. We’re now looking for a Graduate Process Engineer to join our Energy Simulation team in Fornebu or Horten. This is an opportunity to begin your career at the intersection of process engineering, industrial operations and technology, learning from experienced engineers while developing specialist expertise in dynamic process simulation. The role You’ll work with our dynamic process and flow simulators, K-Spice and LedaFlow, helping customers model, understand and optimise complex industrial processes. Our technology is used across the energy industry for engineering studies, design verification, virtual commissioning, operator training, real-time production monitoring and flow assurance. It also supports Falkor’s Digital Twin solutions and applications including CO₂ capture, transportation and storage. You’ll receive support as you learn to build and run simulation models, understand customer processes and contribute to simulator deliveries. What you’ll do Build, configure and run dynamic process simulation models. Support the integration of dynamic models with control systems. Help prepare simulators for engineering testing, virtual commissioning and operator training. Work with experienced colleagues to understand customer processes and technical challenges. Apply your engineering knowledge to practical industrial problems. Test and document simulation models and technical solutions. Collaborate with process engineers, software specialists and other technical disciplines. Contribute ideas that improve our tools, products and ways of working. Build your technical knowledge and gradually take on greater responsibility. What we’re looking for A recently completed or soon-to-be-completed BSc or MSc in Process Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Automation or another relevant technical discipline. A structured and analytical approach to solving technical problems. Curiosity and a genuine appetite to learn. An interest in process simulation, industrial software or energy operations. A collaborative and solution-oriented approach. The ability to communicate and work effectively across technical disciplines. Fluency in English and Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Flexibility to travel to customer sites when required. Interest or academic experience in Python programming, digitalisation, industrial AI, energy-transition technologies or CO₂ capture, transportation and storage would be an advantage. We know that graduates will not arrive with experience in every area. We’re looking for strong engineering foundations, learning agility and the potential to develop into a specialist within our team. Why Falkor? Industrial companies generate enormous amounts of data, but turning that data into better decisions remains a complex challenge. At Falkor, you’ll work on technology designed for the realities of industrial operations. You’ll learn how sophisticated simulation and software can help customers understand complex systems, test decisions before putting them into practice, train operators safely and operate assets more effectively. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, software specialists and industry experts, giving you the opportunity to build deep technical expertise and develop your career in industrial technology. Application process Send us your CV and tell us why you’re interested in beginning your career with Falkor. We’re interested in your potential, so you should still apply if you don’t meet every requirement. Please upload your diploma, academic transcript and/or other relevant documentation under Additional files. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Different perspectives make better technology The problems we’re solving are complex, and we believe solving them requires different perspectives, experiences and ways of thinking. We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where people are valued, respected and able to contribute at their best. We welcome applications from people with different backgrounds and experiences. Recruitment agencies Falkor occasionally partners with recruitment agencies for specific roles. We work with a limited number of preferred suppliers under agreed terms and processes. We therefore cannot accept responsibility for unsolicited candidate submissions or associated fees unless terms have been agreed with our Procurement team in advance.

Anställningen Välkommen med din an! Övrigt Ref HDa 2.3.1-2026/632 Vill du arbeta med en av de mest aktuella frågorna inom högre utbildning och samtidigt bidra till att utveckla framtidens undervisning och lärande? Vi söker en högskolepedagogisk utvecklare som har erfarenhet inom generativ AI i högre utbildning och vill utforska dess möjligheter tillsammans med oss. På Högskolan Dalarna vill vi ligga i framkant och med högskolepedagogisk utgångspunkt vill vi utveckla hur generativ AI och andra digitala verktyg kan bidra till studenternas lärande. Här får du inte bara arbeta med utveckling, utan också avsatt tid för att själv utveckla din kompetens inom området. Du kommer att möta och samarbeta med många olika kompetenser inom högskolan, från lärare och forskare till högskolepedagogiska utvecklare och IKT-pedagoger. Tillsammans prövar vi nya idéer, delar erfarenheter och omsätter ny kunskap i praktiken. Det här är en roll för dig som vill kombinera pedagogik, utveckling och samarbete och samtidigt vara med där mycket händer just nu. Din arbetsdag som högskolepedagogisk utvecklare I tjänsten som högskolepedagogisk utvecklare kommer du att undervisa i behörighetsgivande högskolepedagogisk utbildning, både på svenska och engelska, samt utveckla, planera och genomföra workshops inom högskolepedagogik och digitala verktyg, där utvecklingen av kompetens inom generativ AI får allt större betydelse. Du kommer att driva och delta i högskolepedagogiskt utvecklingsarbete och olika projekt samt ge pedagogisk konsultation till lärare i frågor som rör högskolepedagogiska förhållningssätt, upplägg och digitala verktyg. I rollen ingår även att utveckla och pröva nya högskolepedagogiska metoder samt bidra till utvecklingen av såväl digitala som fysiska lärmiljöer. Du kommer att jobba nära andra högskolepedagogiska utvecklare och IKT-pedagoger. Är du personen vi söker? Våra krav för denna tjänst är att du har : akademisk examen på avancerad nivå i pedagogik, utbildningsvetenskap eller motsvarande som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig dokumenterad erfarenhet av högskolepedagogiskt arbete eller undervisning i högre utbildning dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda workshops och högskolepedagogiska utvecklingsarbeten behörighetsgivande högskolepedagogisk utbildning (motsvarande SUHF:s rekommendationer) dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta med generativ AI inom högre utbildning dokumenterad erfarenhet av digitala verktyg för att stödja lärande och undervisning inom högre utbildning mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både skriftligt och muntligt Meriterande är: erfarenhet av att utveckla och genomföra distansutbildningar erfarenhet av att handleda kollegor i högskolepedagogiska frågor genomförd forskarutbildning Vid tillsättningen lägger vi stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och vi vill att du som person är strukturerad, initiativtagande, kvalitetsmedveten och har samarbetsförmåga. Anställningen Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning, tjänstgöringsgrad 100%, med tillträde snarast möjligt. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas. Högskolan Dalarna är ett lärosäte som verkar på två orter. Placeringsort för denna anställning är Falun och visst arbete förekommer även i Borlänge. Vi erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete på max 40% av din arbetstid. Välkommen med din an! Du er via vår webbplats senast 2026-11-08 . Din an ska innehålla CV samt betygshandlingar. Övrigt Vi värdesätter de kvaliteter som mångfald tillför verksamheten och vi använder oss av kompetensbaserad metodik genom hela rekryteringsprocessen. Högskolan kommer i denna rekrytering att göra en kvalitativ helhetsbedömning för att bedöma vilken sökande som har de bästa förutsättningarna för att fullgöra uppgifterna i anställningen. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att jobba vid Högskolan Dalarna så besök vår hemsida www.du.se/sv/om-oss/jobba-hos-oss/ Vi undanber oss all kontakt med försäljare av annonser. Vi har gjort våra strategiska val för denna rekrytering. På Högskolan Dalarna är du med och skapar framtiden. Vårt uppdrag är att utbilda och forska kring aktuella frågor. I nära samarbete med näringsliv och omgivande samhället skapar vi spännande möjligheter och erfarenheter för både studenter och medarbetare. Vi är en akademisk miljö som bygger på öppenhet, mod och ansvar och för oss är våra medarbetares kompetens och kreativitet viktig. Högskolan Dalarna är en högskola med två campus som lockar studenter och forskare från hela världen. Hos oss studerar ca 17 800 studenter och vi är ca 700 anställda. Hos Coor arbetar fler än 12 000 personer, både i våra leveranser mot kund och på våra egna kontor i Norden. Som M365-specialist ansvarar du för teknisk förvaltning och vidareutveckling av Microsoft 365 i en stor enterprise-miljö med omkring 18 000 konton. Copilot, AI och automation tar allt större plats och vi söker dig som både kan M365 på djupet och blir nyfiken när plattformen plötsligt kan göra något den inte kunde igår. Vi erbjuder dig Hos Coor arbetar vi med teknik mitt i arbetsdagen för tusentals användare. I den här rollen har du ett specialistansvar för en stor Microsoftmiljö med möjligheten att utveckla hur vi använder den, inte minst när Copilot och AI öppnar nya möjligheter. Du får: Arbeta praktiskt med Copilot och AI, från användarnära agenter i Copilot Studio till att utforska hur mer avancerade AI-lösningar kan användas tillsammans med andra delar av IT. En komplex enterprise-miljö där M365 möter identity, säkerhet, cloud, workplace och automation. Utrymme att testa och lära. Här finns resurser att prova en bra idé, utvärdera den och bygga vidare på det som fungerar. Det här gör du hos oss Du arbetar hands-on med administration, förvaltning och vidareutveckling av vår Microsoft 365-plattform. items.desc: Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens arbetssätt inom processledning, ledningssystem och ansvarsfull AI-användning?
