items.desc: Kan du energibranschen, bygger förtroende och vet hur du tar en affär hela vägen till avslut? Hos Solpulsen får du sälja helheten – från solceller och batterilagring till vår Energy Hub och AI-baserade energistyrning. Nu söker Solpulsen Energy Norden AB en erfaren, affärsdriven säljare som vill ta en viktig roll i vår fortsatta utveckling. OM SOLPULSEN Vi arbetar med energilösningar för villor, företag och bostadsrättsföreningar. Solceller, batterier, laddning och smart styrning är delar av vårt erbjudande. Med vår Energy Hub och AI-styrning är ambitionen att hjälpa kunderna att använda, lagra och styra sin energi smartare. Här får du kombinera etablerade energiprodukter med ett erbjudande under utveckling – och vara med och påverka hur det når marknaden. DIN ROLL Du driver hela säljprocessen: från första kontakt och behovsanalys till offert, förhandling och avslut. Du förstår kundens förutsättningar och presenterar en lösning med tydlig kundnytta och realistiska kalkyler. I arbetet ingår att: • Aktivt hitta nya kunder och affärsmöjligheter. • Boka och genomföra kundmöten. • Sälja solceller, batterilagring, Energy Hub och AI-baserad energistyrning. Ta fram och följa upp offerter tillsammans med vårt tekniska team. • Bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och utveckla samarbeten. • Hålla ordning på affärer, uppföljningar och nästa steg i vårt CRM. • Säkerställa en tydlig överlämning till installation och leverans. VI SÖKER DIG SOM Har erfarenhet av försäljning inom solenergi, batterier, laddning eller närliggande energiteknik. Du kan visa vad du har åstadkommit och är van att själv skapa aktivitet och driva affärer framåt. Du behöver kunna förklara tekniska lösningar på ett enkelt och trovärdigt sätt. Du lyssnar, ställer rätt frågor och hjälper kunden att fatta ett välgrundat beslut. Vi värdesätter särskilt att du: • Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av försäljning och avslut. • Förstår energibranschen och kundernas vanligaste frågor. • Är självgående, strukturerad och håller vad du lovar. • Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift. Trivs med tydliga mål och eget ansvar. Erfarenhet av företagskunder, bostadsrättsföreningar, energistyrning eller partnerförsäljning är meriterande. Ett relevant kontaktnät är också ett plus. DET HÄR FÅR DU HOS OSS • Ett brett energierbjudande med solceller, batterier och intelligent styrning. Nära samarbete med teknik och installation. • Korta beslutsvägar och direktkontakt med ledningen. • Möjlighet att påverka försäljningen, arbetssättet och kundernas erbjudande. • Utrymme att växa med verksamheten och på sikt ta större kommersiellt ansvar. Vi söker dig som vill göra affärer som håller – där kunden förstår vad den köper och vi levererar det vi har lovat. ANSÖKAN Skicka ditt CV och en kort beskrivning av din erfarenhet inom energibranschen. Berätta vilka lösningar du har sålt, vilka kundgrupper du har arbetat med och vilka försäljningsresultat du är mest stolt över. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vill du vara med och utveckla försäljningen av nästa generations energilösningar? Välkommen till Solpulsen.

Vill du vara med och forma framtidens digitala universitet – och samtidigt fortsätta arbeta praktiskt med teknik? Luleå tekniska universitet befinner sig i en omfattande digital förflyttning. Vi moderniserar vårt IT-landskap, utvecklar vår integrationsförmåga och skapar nya lösningar med hjälp av molnplattformar, data och AI. Det här är en roll för dig som redan arbetar som lösningsarkitekt – eller som har en gedigen bakgrund inom systemutveckling och teknisk design och är redo att ta nästa steg. Rollen Som lösningsarkitekt har du en central roll i utformningen av universitetets framtida IT-stöd. Du arbetar nära verksamheten, utvecklingsteam, förvaltningsansvariga, IT-drift, informationssäkerhet och externa leverantörer. items.desc: Institutionen för programvaruteknik omfattar ca. 50 personer från 20 olika länder. Vår tradition inom programvaruteknik sträcker sig tillbaka till 1990 då vi startade Sveriges första utbildning inom området. Institutionens forsknings- och utbildningsmiljö, SERL Sweden ‒ Software Engineering Research and Education Lab Sweden, har sedan dess expanderat och är nu positionerad som världsledande när det gäller forskning inom mjukvaruutveckling. Institutionen ansvarar för utbildningar i programvaruteknik från kandidatnivå upp till forskarutbildning. Arbetsbeskrivning I anställningen ingår forskning, kursutveckling, undervisning och handledning inom programvaruteknik, med särskild inriktning mot verifiering och validering (V&V) av AI-intensiva system. Anställningen fördelas på 60 % forskning och 40 % undervisning under sex år. Inom det första året förväntas den sökande delta i rekryteringen av en doktorand inom kärnområdet och ta på sig huvudansvaret för handledningen, med stöd av ett team av erfarna handledare. Den sökande förväntas uppfylla kraven för befordran till universitetslektor inom högst fem och ett halvt år, vilket leder till en tillsvidareanställning. Den sökande kommer att leda uppbyggnaden av ett nytt forskningsområde och en ny forskargrupp inom SERL (Software engineering Education and Reserach Lab)och ta sig an en av de mest angelägna utmaningarna inom modern programvaruteknik – att säkerställa tillförlitlighet, pålitlighet, säkerhet och regelefterlevnad i system som innehåller generativ AI (GenAI) och andra lärande komponenter. AI-intensiva system uppvisar icke-deterministiskt, adaptivt och föränderligt beteende, vilket utmanar etablerad praxis för utveckling och kvalitetssäkring. Anställningen inriktas på att utveckla nya metoder, verktyg och principer för verifiering och validering som säkerställer kvalitet och regelefterlevnad i sådana system utan att begränsa deras generativa potential. Tillämpningsområden omfattar, men är inte begränsade till, autonoma fordon, försvarssystem, telekommunikation och andra programvaruintensiva produkter och tjänster. Den sökande förväntas utveckla sin egen forskningsinriktning, leda industrirelevanta projekt i samproduktion och bidra till SERL: s fortsatta utveckling som en forsknings- och utbildningsmiljö i världsklass. Samverkan med industrin och extern forskningsfinansiering är centrala delar av anställningen. Den sökande kommer att arbeta nära SAAB, Ericsson och FMV för att hantera verkliga V&V-utmaningar i AI-intensiva system, och ytterligare industripartnerskap förväntas tillkomma i takt med att forskargruppen växer. Den sökande ska vara beredd att genomgå en säkerhetsprövning som en del av anställningsförfarandet. I undervisningsuppdraget ingår föreläsningar, handledning av projektarbeten och kursutveckling på grundnivå, avancerad nivå och forskarnivå. Undervisningen på grundnivå är huvudsakligen på svenska, medan undervisningen på avancerad och forskarnivå huvudsakligen är på engelska. Vi förväntar oss att en icke-svensktalande anställd inom tre år förvärvar tillräckliga kunskaper i svenska för att kunna undervisa och kommunicera med högskolans olika enheter/funktioner på svenska. Behörighetskrav Behörig att anställas som biträdande lektor är den som har avlagt doktorsexamen eller har motsvarande vetenskaplig kompetens. Främst bör den komma i fråga som har avlagt doktorsexamen eller har nått motsvarande kompetens högst sju år innan tiden för ansökan av anställningen som biträdande lektor har gått ut. items.desc: Job number NAT02308 Faculties Faculty of Natural Sciences Departments Department of Physics Salary or Salary range £50,733 - £62,001 per annum Location/campus South Kensington Campus - On site only Contract type work pattern Full time - Fixed term Posting End Date 16 Nov 2026 About the role We are looking for a candidate with experience in optimal quantum control for the collaborative QuantERA project FALCON. The successful candidate is expected to design optimised driving schemes that allow the experimental partner in Innsbruck (UIBK & AQT) to implement entangling gates with trapped ions that achieve high fidelities under practical conditions, i.e. at finite temperature and without accurate calibration. The candidate should have strong interest in collaborative work, and they should collaborate both with the experimental partner in Innsbruck and with the theory partner in Sofia. What you would be doing Your main role would be the design of optimised driving patterns for the realisation of noise-resilient quantum gates of trapped ions. Together with the other consortium partners you would identify the main sources of imperfections in the consortium’s experiments that result in reduction of gate fidelities, and you would develop optimal control solutions to achieve resilience to the identified imperfections. You would use both analytical and numerical tools for your work, and you would interact on a regular basis with all the project partners. What we are looking for We are looking for a candidate who holds a PhD with theoretical/numerical work in the fields of quantum information/quantum technologies. Additional experience as Postdoc is desired but not necessary. You should have a strong interest in collaborative work, and the ability to communicate with experimental partners. Ideally, you would have a strong background in optimal control and it’s application to quantum-optical systems. items.title: Research Coordinator in Accelerator Science
items.card: The role will be based at the Cockcroft Institute on Daresbury Science and Innovation Campus and make substantial contributions to the research portfolio of the pan-European QUASAR Group. It will focus on the development and experimental exploitation of particle accelerators and light sources and we are looking for an outstanding accelerator expert to strengthen our team and complement our existing expertise.
items.desc: Hours of work: Full-time - 35 hours per week Tenure: Permanent A permanent position as Research Coordinator in the Accelerator Science cluster at Liverpool University is available. The role will be based at the Cockcroft Institute on Daresbury Science and Innovation Campus and make substantial contributions to the research portfolio of the pan-European QUASAR Group. It will focus on the development and experimental exploitation of particle accelerators and light sources and we are looking for an outstanding accelerator expert to strengthen our team and complement our existing expertise. Applicants are expected to have an internationally recognized researcher profile and make major contributions to the cluster’s world-class research programme in accelerator science. The cluster’s work currently stretches over the following principal research areas: Scientific frontier facilities and underpinning technologies, including beam physics studies for particle colliders and light sources; Novel acceleration techniques, including beam and laser-driven acceleration, as well as micro accelerators; Applications of accelerators in addressing global challenges with a focus on medical applications and the commercialization of accelerator technologies. The scientific frontier facilities on which we aim to focus for the next decade include the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) at CERN; the Future Circular Collider (FCC); and the low energy antimatter facility AD/ELENA. We will continue to push the development of novel acceleration techniques. We are a key partner in the EuPRAXIA facility and involved in many international collaborations such as PACRI and EPITA where we combine cutting-edge R&D with leadership in cross-sector knowledge transfer. Our research focuses in particular on more sustainable accelerators, the development of high-resolution diagnostics and knowledge transfer with identified industry partners. We also carry out research into high impact applications of accelerators to address global challenges in health, security, energy, manufacturing and the environment. The accelerator science cluster has led a number of European research and training networks in these areas, and works closely with industry partners in the UK and around the world. Candidates are expected to develop the cluster’s cutting-edge research portfolio, work with our international partners, maximise the impact from our projects, co-supervise PhD and undergraduate students and contribute to research grant applications and the dissemination of our research results. We are looking for an outstanding accelerator scientist to make important contributions to the cluster’s research and training programme. Your research will involve leadership in one are several of the following areas: accelerator design and optimization, sustainable accelerator technologies including AI, novel acceleration techniques, sensor and beam instrumentation development, and accelerator applications. There are opportunities to contribute to teaching and supervision, and to make important contributions to major European projects such as High Luminosity LHC (HL-LHC), EuPRAXIA, EPITA and TwinRISE. This role is based at the Cockcroft Institute on the campus of Daresbury Laboratory. The research will be carried out at partner institutions around the world and some national and international travel will be required. Candidates should have a PhD in a relevant discipline and an excellent track record in accelerator design and optimization, demonstrated through publications in high impact journals. Experience in the training and supervision of students will be an asset. The working language is English. Our commitment to Equality, Diversity and Inclusion We are committed to enhancing a workforce as diverse as our community and particularly encourage applicants who are of minoritised genders and ethnic backgrounds, living with a disability, and/or are members of the LGBTQIA+ community.

items.desc: Role : Electrochemical Water Treatment Technology Specialist (KTP Associate) (Heriot-Watt University and Sidon Water Ltd; KTP Project Number 10197548) Salary : £36,500 per annum Contract Type : Full-time (35 hours per week), Fixed term for 26 months Detailed Description The successful candidate will secure a 26-month collaborative Knowledge Transfer Project (KTP) position between Heriot-Watt University and Sidon Water Ltd. The Associate will receive specialist training in electrochemistry, water-chemistry analysis, materials and surface characterisation, and predictive modelling from experts at Heriot-Watt University before leading the development of a practical, evidence-based framework for predicting the performance of Sidon Water's Integro electrochemical water-conditioning technology. The role represents an opportunity to shape how a growing UK water-technology company evaluates, validates and deploys a sustainable, non-chemical approach to scale control and fouling mitigation. You will be at the heart of an interdisciplinary programme linking fundamental scientific investigation with real-world applications in desalination, reverse osmosis, industrial water treatment, leisure, hospitality and commercial hot-water systems. This project and its Associate fulfil a critical role at Sidon Water. The Associate will transfer and embed new scientific, analytical and modelling capability within the business, helping Sidon move from demonstration-led sales to a scalable, evidence-based technical-sales and consultancy model. The project will build an improved understanding of ion behaviour, mineral nucleation and scale formation; establish in-house water-testing and analytical procedures; define the technology's operational performance envelope; and develop Sidon's first validated predictive performance model. This full-time position is funded by Sidon Water Ltd and Innovate UK. The successful appointee will be based primarily at Sidon Water's premises at 18 North Street, Glenrothes, Fife, KY7 5NA, with approximately nine months of laboratory-based activity at Heriot-Watt University's Riccarton campus in Edinburgh across the project. If the project is successful, there may be an opportunity to secure a permanent role at Sidon Water to support the continued development and commercialisation of the capability. The role may particularly appeal to people currently engaged in work such as: Water chemistry, water analysis, industrial water treatment, desalination or reverse-osmosis research and development. Electrochemistry, materials science, chemical engineering, environmental engineering, physics or surface-characterisation research. Applied scientific or engineering roles that combine laboratory investigation, data analysis, modelling and translation into practical commercial tools. As a KTP Associate, you will receive training as part of a national Associate cohort, training on Sidon Water systems and processes, protected development time, and a dedicated personal and professional development budget. Keyword search: electrochemistry, water chemistry, scale control, predictive modelling, desalination, reverse osmosis, materials characterisation, industrial water treatment Key Duties and Responsibilities The successful appointee will be expected to undertake the following: Plan and manage project activity in line with the approved workplan, including project scheduling, budgets, milestones, reporting, risk management and engagement with the Local Management Committee. Design and carry out a structured programme of laboratory and applied research covering electrochemical behaviour, mineral nucleation, scale formation, water chemistry and operating conditions. Use and interpret electrochemical methods such as cyclic voltammetry, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and related techniques to investigate ion behaviour, charge-transfer processes and early-stage mineral nucleation. Develop and validate methods for monitoring nucleation and scale-suppression behaviour, working with Heriot-Watt specialists to ensure scientific rigour and commercial relevance. Specify, coordinate and interpret materials and surface-characterisation studies, potentially including SEM, EDS, XPS and XRD, to understand mineral composition, growth and adhesion. Establish Sidon Water's internal water-chemistry testing capability, including methods for hardness, alkalinity, pH, conductivity, dissolved solids and scaling indices such as LSI and RSI. Evaluate how water composition, temperature, flow, pressure and other operating conditions influence performance, and define an operational performance envelope for the Integro technology. Integrate electrochemical, water-chemistry, materials and operational datasets into a validated predictive model capable of forecasting performance under different site conditions. The role This company is building a proactive AI assistant that maintains a living model of a person's entire work history — emails, messages, meetings, documents. It acts on their behalf, drafting replies and preparing for meetings, all before being asked. The core challenge is building long-term memory that stays current, retrieving messy context across diverse sources, and reasoning about information live on screen. This is a genuinely unsolved problem in AI. You will own the research direction for these core problems, working end-to-end from hypothesis to production. Develop and deploy reasoning models that operate across diverse, messy data sources. Build models capable of real-time reasoning over live screen and application context. Take research from initial hypothesis and experimentation through to robust, production-ready systems, owning the entire lifecycle. What You Bring A PhD or personally owned a hard, end-to-end technical project at a company. 5+ years solving research-level problems in NLP, LLMs, or adjacent ML, in academia or industry. You implement and build upon current research papers, not just apply existing libraries. You've run both halves of the work: forming and testing hypotheses, and building robust, scalable systems. Strong Python, comfortable with cloud infrastructure, and both SQL and NoSQL databases. Work in person in Elephant and Castle five days a week. items.desc: Our Mission Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all. About The Role Own the red-teaming and adversarial evaluation pipeline for Reflection’s models, continuously probing for failure modes across security, misuse, and alignment gaps. Work hand-in-hand with the Alignment team to translate safety findings into concrete guardrails, ensuring models behave reliably under stress and adhere to deployment policies. Validate that every release meets the lab’s risk thresholds before it ships, serving as a critical gatekeeper for our open weight releases. Develop scalable, automated safety benchmarks that evolve alongside our model capabilities, moving beyond static datasets to dynamic adversarial testing. Research and implement state-of-the-art jailbreaking techniques and defenses to stay ahead of potential vulnerabilities in the wild. About You Graduate degree (MS or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience in AI Safety. Deep technical understanding of LLM safety, including adversarial attacks, red-teaming methodologies, and interpretability. Strong software engineering capabilities with experience building automated evaluation pipelines or large-scale ML systems. Experience with Reinforcement Learning (RLHF/RLAIF) and how it impacts model safety and alignment is a strong plus. Thrive in a fast-paced, high-agency startup environment with bias toward action. Willing to make high-stakes decisions regarding model release and safety thresholds. Passionate about advancing the frontier of intelligence. What We Offer We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models. We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported. Top-tier compensation: Salary and equity structured to recognize and retain our talent globally. Stock options: Everyone who joins and contributes to Reflection's success gets to share in the upside through stock options. Health & wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life, with an annual wellness allowance. Meals: Lunch and dinner are provided in the office daily. Life & family: 22 weeks paid parental leave for all new birthing and non-birthing parents, including adoptive and surrogate journeys. Vacation days: Unlimited paid time off in the U.S. and 30 days in the U.K. Sponsorship support: We sponsor visas to help exceptional talent join our team and support long-term immigration pathways where applicable. Team building: We have regular off-sites, happy hours, and team celebrations. Export Control Notice: This position may require access to technology or source code subject to the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Any offer of employment for this role may be conditioned on the Company's ability to provide the candidate with access to such technology or source code in compliance with applicable U.S. export control laws, which may require the Company to seek government authorization. items.desc: Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one. Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles. As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands. About The Role We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team in developing high-quality, validated markers that extract insights from dense temporal stacks of satellite imagery across agriculture, land management, and climate. The markers you build form the core of our Area Monitoring System (AMS) delivered to Common Agricultural Policy paying agencies across Europe, owned end-to-end from method to production code. You will collaborate closely with scientists and engineers to deploy models at scale, while expanding beyond compliance into land-cover change detection using embeddings and AI-first workflows. Ideal candidates are adaptable, curious about AI agents, and eager to iterate directly based on customer feedback. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to work with multi-sensor Earth observation data to solve complex environmental and agricultural challenges. This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Graz, Ljubljana or Haarlem office 3 days per week. Impact You’ll Own Develop algorithms and machine learning models that extract insights from satellite imagery time series, and maintain and improve the markers we already run. Take a research topic from exploration through to production. Own marker results for production AMS deliveries across several EU countries — run them, review them, and confirm quality before they reach the client. Explore and build embeddings-based insight extraction in new areas beyond CAP. Use AI agents in your daily work, and help the team get better at it. Co-own the markers codebase together with the rest of the team. Collaborate with the team to iteratively build solutions on our platform and existing data building blocks, and inspire and enable our partners to extract insights using them. Document and organize your work to be transparent and repeatable. Write internal research reports, public blog posts, and reports for clients. What You Bring 4+ years of relevant work experience. Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, data science, or another STEM field. Understanding of machine learning principles, including model validation and performance evaluation techniques. Proficiency in Python programming, with the ability to write maintainable, well-documented code. Experience working with AI agents and modern machine learning tools. Experience with version control and Git, and comfort working in a shared codebase. Working knowledge of the geospatial domain. Ability to deliver projects on schedule and manage technical deliverables. Problem-solving skills in technical or analytical domains. Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company. What Makes You Stand Out Experience working with embeddings or other learned representations of imagery. Remote sensing expertise, particularly with satellite time series. Experience processing radar data (for example Sentinel-1). Familiarity with the agricultural domain, or with the EU Common Agricultural Policy and area-based payment schemes. Experience with cloud environments and distributed computing. Application Deadline 11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to. Benefits While Working At Planet These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy. Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off Employee Wellness Program Home Office Reimbursement Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning Equity Volunteering Paid Time Off …

You will work on challenging problems involving large language models, retrieval, agent behavior, experimentation, evaluation, and optimization to help create digital agents that can understand customer needs, access relevant knowledge, and successfully complete complex tasks. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, software engineers, product managers, and other data scientists to take ideas from experimentation through production. You will have significant ownership of data science solutions while helping establish strong practices for measuring and continuously improving the quality of our AI-powered experiences. What You Will Be Doing Machine Learning & Agent Intelligence Develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning and generative AI solutions that power Intermedia's Digital Agent Platform. Apply large language models (LLMs), natural language processing, retrieval, and other advanced AI techniques to improve agent understanding and performance. Develop approaches that improve agent reasoning, tool selection, knowledge retrieval, context management, personalization, and task completion. Experiment with model, prompt, retrieval, and agent configuration strategies to identify approaches that deliver the best customer and business outcomes. Evaluate commercial and open-source models and recommend appropriate approaches based on quality, latency, scalability, and cost. Generative AI & RAG Design, develop, and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions that ground digital agents in relevant enterprise and customer information. Develop and evaluate embeddings, retrieval strategies, ranking approaches, semantic search, and other knowledge-retrieval techniques. Build and refine end-to-end pipelines that combine LLMs with retrieval systems, enterprise knowledge sources, and agent workflows. Develop approaches to improve the relevance, accuracy, and consistency of AI-generated responses. Identify and mitigate issues such as hallucinations, poor retrieval, inappropriate responses, and other failure modes in generative AI applications. Evaluation & Experimentation Develop rigorous evaluation frameworks for measuring digital agent quality, including accuracy, relevance, task completion, reliability, safety, and customer experience. Design offline and online experiments to compare models, prompts, retrieval strategies, agent configurations, and other AI approaches. Apply statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, segmentation, and other quantitative methods to evaluate AI performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Define appropriate metrics and benchmarks that connect model and agent performance to customer and business outcomes. Analyze production behavior and feedback to identify patterns, failure modes, and opportunities to continuously improve digital agents. Ensure data and model quality through comprehensive testing, validation, and performance evaluation. Data & Solution Development Gather, preprocess, analyze, and model large volumes of structured and unstructured data from multiple sources. Use Python, SQL, Spark, and other relevant technologies to build scalable analytical and machine learning solutions. Develop features, datasets, and analytical approaches that support model development, experimentation, and evaluation. Partner with data and engineering teams to build and maintain reliable pipelines for model training, evaluation, and production use. Contribute to scalable ML/AI pipelines that support experimentation, deployment, monitoring, …

Grâce à des savoir-faire et des moyens industriels exceptionnels, il conçoit, réalise, intègre, maintient en service et modernise des sous-marins, des navires de surface et des drones ainsi que leurs systèmes, leurs armes et leurs équipements, jusqu'à la déconstruction. UN ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL POSITIF Implantés sur 9 sites en France et dans 17 pays, nous valorisons un environnement de travail agréable, favorisant la diversité des profils, l'esprit d'équipe et le bien-être. Cela se concrétise par une mixité sociale, des accords pour la qualité de vie au travail, un engagement dans le développement professionnel via la formation continue et l'implication des collaborateurs et collaboratrices dans la mise en œuvre collective de notre stratégie de responsabilité sociétale de l'entreprise (RSE). NOS CHIFFRES CLEFS 17 170 collaborateurs et collaboratrices 4,6 milliards d'euros de chiffre d'affaires Description Du Poste Filiale 100% de Naval Group, Sirehna est une entité experte en hydrodynamique navale, controle dynamique des plateformes et perception de l'environnement marin et langage embarqué pour la tenue au temps réel des systèmes qu'elle met à bord de navire militaire comme civil allant de la barge de travaux Offshore jusqu'au porte-avions. Sirehna déploie également des outils d'aides à la décision pour la maitrise énergétique des navires de surface et sous-marins ainsi que pour la maitrise des risques en opération par mer formée. En tant qu'ingénieur Perception de l'environnement maritime, vos missions principales seront les suivantes: Vous serez amené à maintenir et faire évoluer des suites logiciels de traitement d'images et de données Vous serez amené à interagir avec les algorithmiciens pour l'analyse, le portage de solution ou et l'intégration de logiciels Vous serez amené à développer des outils de tests et de validation Vous serez amené à réaliser des architectures de système de perception basée notamment sur les technologies optroniques (caméra jour/nuit, IR, LWIR, etc...) pour la détection/classifcation d'objets Vous serez amené également à tester, valider, installer, calibrer des systèmes de perception multicapteurs en condition laboratoire et en conditions opérationnelles. Vous serez amené également à développer des preuves de concept et les mettre en oeuvre afin d'assurer une levé de risque dans la montée en maturité de fonctions de perception spécialisées à base de machine learning ou de méthode plus classique pour réaliser des taches de detection/classification/pistage et fusion de données multicapteurs. Vous participerez à la construction des feuilles de route du domaine perception avec le responsable d'axe technologique. Vous serez donc en interface avec l'ensemble des métiers de Sirehna (Ingénierie système, hydrodynamique, Contrôle/Commande, perception, navigation, guidage, essais, simulation) et la direction technique innovation de Naval Group. Les applications principales étant sur bâtiment de surface, sous-marins, véhicule marin autonome Profil Diplômé(e) d'un bac+5 (Ecole d'Ingénieur généraliste), avec au minimum 3-5 ans d'expérience professionnelle, - Vous maitrisez les développements en C++, gestion des SDK, traitement vidéos, cuda - Vous maitrisez les environnements Linux, virtuels et conteneurisés (production image conteneur et déploiement) - Vous avez des notions en conception et ingénierie système, et êtes capable de rédiger des spécifications - Vous maitrisez la validation logicielle et système, la rédaction et déroulement de plan de tests, en particulier du point de vue performances. - Solides connaissances en configuration et analyse des réseaux - Vous avez exercé un poste d'ingénieur développement de logiciel de traitement d'images pendant au moins 3 ans Les plus pour ce poste: - Autonomie dans les déplacements pour l'intégration en platforme et les mises en service sur navire - Analyse des faits techniques, recherche de pannes et rédaction de rapport d'essais - Maitrise des outils gitlab, wireshark, gstreamer ou ffmpeg - Géométrie 3D, changement de repère et calibration caméras - être familier avec les capteurs de type radar ; caméra (voie visible et infrarouge) ; plateformes Pan Tilt - Python 3.10+ - une connaissance et une appétence pour le milieu marin, - une expérience dans le développement de véhicules autonomes, Vous êtes curieux, ouvert d'esprit et aimez les travaux d'innnovation et de prototypage et vous êtes à l'aise avec le travail en équipe. Des déplacements en France métropolitaine sont à prévoir Le contexte international du poste nécessite un niveau d'anglais courant tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. La Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS è alla ricerca di persone con spirito d'iniziativa e capacità innovative, approccio alla multidisciplinarietà e al lavoro di gruppo , con voglia di intraprendere un percorso insieme nell’eccellenza professionale sanitaria in un contesto sfidante ed internazionale. La Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS si impegna ad attrarre ed assumere persone con diversi background e abilità, perseguendo la parità di genere in fase di selezione attraverso l’individuazione di una rosa di candidati/candidate tendenzialmente paritetica uomo-donna, valorizzando la meritocrazia, considerando esperienze, capacità e competenze criteri guida nella scelta dei/delle migliori candidati/candidate. CHI STIAMO CERCANDO Ruolo Junior Data Scientist Ambito Di Inserimento Unità Operativa DWH E INNOVAZIONI DIGITALI IN SANITA' Attivita’ Del Ruolo La risorsa sarà coinvolta nello sviluppo, nell’analisi e nella validazione di soluzioni di Artificial Intelligence e Machine Learning a supporto della ricerca, dell’analisi dei dati, della predizione e dei sistemi di supporto decisionale (decision support system) in ambito sanitario e biomedicale. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes d'information et le développement de solutions innovantes. Nos consultants interviennent sur des projets à forte valeur ajoutée, au croisement des technologies numériques et des enjeux opérationnels. L'innovation, le partage des connaissances et le développement des compétences sont au cœur de notre démarche. Description Du Poste Vous êtes ingénieur(e), passionné(e) par l'industrie et curieux(se) des applications concrètes de l'intelligence artificielle ? Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur Vision Industrielle & IA (H/F) pour participer à un projet innovant de contrôle qualité automatisé dans un environnement industriel exigeant. Vous contribuerez au développement de solutions de vision par ordinateur permettant d'identifier et de caractériser des défauts sur des produits industriels. Votre mission couvrira deux dimensions complémentaires : 🔹 Analyse industrielle et préparation des données (40 %) Collaborer avec les experts industriels pour comprendre les procédés de fabrication et les défauts à détecter. Identifier les caractéristiques visuelles pertinentes pour les contrôles qualité. Participer à la collecte, à la qualification et à l'annotation des images. Définir des méthodes d'annotation fiables et assurer la qualité des données. Traduire les besoins opérationnels en problématiques exploitables par des solutions d'IA. 🔹 Vision par ordinateur et intelligence artificielle (60 %) Participer à la conception de solutions de détection et de classification de défauts. Contribuer au développement et à l'entraînement des modèles de vision par ordinateur. Évaluer les performances des modèles et identifier les axes d'optimisation. Participer à l'intégration des solutions dans les applications industrielles. Suivre leur efficacité en conditions réelles de production. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des outils et méthodes de contrôle. Environnement technique Python C# Vision par ordinateur (Computer Vision) Traitement d'images et traitement du signal Vision industrielle et optique Intelligence artificielle / Machine Learning OpenCV (apprécié) MLOps (notions appréciées) Qualifications 🎓 Formation Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieurs ou d'une formation Bac+5 à dominante industrielle ou technique. 💼 Expérience Vous justifiez d'une première expérience professionnelle en développement Python ou C#, hors stage et alternance. Une expérience dans l'industrie, notamment en production, qualité, maintenance ou procédés industriels, constitue un véritable atout. 🔥 Compétences clés Connaissances en vision industrielle, optique, traitement du signal ou traitement d'images. Capacité à comprendre des problématiques industrielles et à les traduire en solutions techniques. Intérêt marqué pour l'intelligence artificielle et l'analyse de données. Connaissance d'OpenCV ou d'outils de vision industrielle appréciée. Notions de Machine Learning et de MLOps appréciées. Anglais requis. 🤝 Qualités personnelles Curiosité technique et envie d'apprendre. Rigueur et esprit d'analyse. Autonomie et force de proposition. Goût du terrain et des échanges avec les équipes industrielles. Capacité à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs techniques et métiers. Informations supplémentaires Pourquoi rejoindre Citech ? 🤔 Chez CITECH, nous accordons une importance particulière à la qualité des missions proposées et à l'accompagnement de nos consultants. Vous bénéficiez d'une relation de proximité avec nos équipes et d'un suivi individualisé tout au long de votre parcours. Rejoignez une ESN à taille humaine et participez à des projets technologiques qui contribuent concrètement à l'évolution des systèmes de santé. items.desc: Nous accompagnons un acteur du secteur technologique dans le renforcement de ses équipes spécialisées en Data Science et Intelligence Artificielle. Dans un environnement technique exigeant et stimulant, vous participerez à la conception, au développement et à l'industrialisation de solutions d'intelligence artificielle répondant à des problématiques concrètes. Notre client recherche plusieurs profils AI Engineer / Data Scientist , avec une attention particulière portée aux compétences en Machine Learning, NLP, Large Language Models (LLM) et IA générative. Les candidatures de différents niveaux d'expérience sont étudiées, avec une priorité actuelle donnée aux profils Data Science. Vos missions Selon votre niveau d'expérience et vos responsabilités, vous serez amené(e) à : Concevoir, développer et optimiser des modèles de Machine Learning et Deep Learning. Développer des solutions reposant sur les technologies NLP, LLM et IA générative. Participer à la conception d'architectures IA performantes, robustes et évolutives. Expérimenter, évaluer et améliorer des modèles et systèmes d'intelligence artificielle. Contribuer à l'industrialisation et au déploiement des solutions IA en production. Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie logicielle et les différentes parties prenantes. Assurer une veille technologique et proposer des approches adaptées aux besoins des projets. Pour les profils Lead et Manager : Définir les orientations techniques et participer aux décisions d'architecture. Assurer le leadership technique et accompagner les équipes dans leurs choix technologiques. Piloter les projets de leur conception jusqu'à leur livraison. Participer aux échanges avec les clients et à la compréhension de leurs enjeux. Coordonner les équipes et assurer, selon les responsabilités, le management de projets ou de collaborateurs. Profil recherché Formation et parcours Diplôme d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu, idéalement de premier plan. Une expérience professionnelle au sein d'une entreprise technologique de référence peut également constituer un parcours particulièrement apprécié. Les profils présentant une expérience technique solide et des réalisations significatives seront également considérés. Compétences techniques Bonne maîtrise des fondamentaux de la Data Science, du Machine Learning et des méthodes statistiques. Expérience en développement et exploitation de modèles d'intelligence artificielle. Connaissances ou expérience en IA générative, NLP et LLM particulièrement appréciées . Pour les profils spécialisés en IA générative, une expérience concrète de conception et de développement de solutions, au-delà de la simple utilisation d'outils de génération de code, constitue un véritable atout. Une expérience couvrant l'ensemble du cycle de vie des modèles, jusqu'à leur déploiement en production, sera fortement valorisée. Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements techniques variés et à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies. Curiosité, rigueur, autonomie et capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes. Expérience attendue Confirmé / Data Scientist : différents niveaux d'expérience sont considérés selon les compétences techniques et les réalisations. Senior : minimum 2 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de niveau senior. Lead : environ 4 ans d'expérience professionnelle, dont au moins 1 an en tant que Lead ou dans une fonction équivalente. Manager : expérience significative en pilotage de projets, coordination technique et/ou management d'équipe. Pour les profils Lead et Manager, des compétences en leadership technique, gestion de projet et relation client sont particulièrement recherchées. Pourquoi rejoindre cette opportunité ? Participer à des projets concrets et ambitieux autour de la Data Science et de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Intervenir sur des problématiques techniques variées, de la conception à la mise en production. Développer votre expertise sur des technologies en constante évolution. Évoluer au sein d'équipes techniques expérimentées. Bénéficier de perspectives d'évolution vers des fonctions d'expertise, de leadership ou de management.

items.card: The role encompasses applications in continuous casting of steel. This position bridges laboratory research and plant operations, emphasizing sustainable solutions, process efficiencies, and delivering high-quality results for industrial clients worldwide. Responsibilities: 1. Project Management : Define research programs aligned with new product and service objectives. Organize and execute laboratory-scale R&D
items.desc: Role The Research Engineer will contribute to driving R&D initiatives within a dynamic industrial setting, focusing on the development of new products, services, and basic knowledge of steel casting fluxes (mold powder for continuous casting of steel) and raw materials. The role encompasses applications in continuous casting of steel. This position bridges laboratory research and plant operations, emphasizing sustainable solutions, process efficiencies, and delivering high-quality results for industrial clients worldwide. Responsibilities: 1. Project Management : Define research programs aligned with new product and service objectives. Organize and execute laboratory-scale R&D projects. Performs tasks/projects and takes the responsibility for assuring quality, cost effectiveness & timeliness for those projects Develop materials and processes while supporting related projects. Maintain regular reporting on project progress and outcomes. Supervise customer sample preparation and optimize products based on feedback. Monitor technical advancements in the market, including patents and scientific publications. Consolidate fundamental knowledge on steel casting fluxes and associated raw materials. 2. Laboratory Research and Data Management : Plan research activities, including experiments, characterization, and analytics Manage, process, analyze, and document data from lab activities. Maximize data collection value from R&D, production, and quality assurance. Develop project reviews, technical reports, and presentations with clarity and precision. Document knowledge and findings in technical memos and share them with stakeholders. Utilize project management tools (e.g., Vantage) for deliverables and resource planning. Organize stage-gate meetings and prioritize multiple projects. 3. External Collaboration and Scientific Contributions : Prepare papers, proposals, and presentations for conferences, congresses, and seminars. Build external collaborations and networks to share and extend expertise. Address intellectual property topics, support evaluations, and assist in patent filings. Requirements: PhD or master’s degree in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Mineralogy, or a related engineering discipline, preferably with a focus on casting fluxes (mold powders), glass chemistry, and/or interactions between slag and liquid steel. Minimum of 5 years of experience in R&D, project management, or product development, ideally within or for a steel plant environment. Comprehensive knowledge of continuous steel casting processes, mineralogy, and ceramic raw materials for casting fluxes, including their melting and solidification mechanisms under high-temperature conditions. Strong expertise in thermodynamics and reaction kinetics, with proficiency in thermodynamic calculation tools (e.g., FactSage®). Hands-on experience with advanced analytical techniques, such as high-temperature viscometry, hot-stage microscopy, TG/DTA, XRD, and Rietveld refinement. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with demonstrated experience in data analysis and interpretation. Strong technical writing and presentation skills, including the ability to clearly summarize research outcomes and present results during stage-gate or project review meetings. Motivated, adaptable, and innovative, with a proactive approach to challenges and a strong drive for continuous improvement. Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively in an international environment and partner across R&D and plant operations. Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken. As a global organisation operating across multiple countries, compensation for this role may vary depending on location, local market benchmarks, and experience. In line with our commitment to pay transparency, a salary range relevant to your location will be shared with you during the early stages of the recruitment process, before any interview is scheduled.

items.desc: À propos de l’entreprise Kalray est une entreprise technologique spécialisée dans les semi-conducteurs et le calcul haute performance au service de l’intelligence artificielle. Forte de plus de quinze ans d’expertise en architectures de calcul parallèle, en conception de processeurs et en systèmes de calcul haute performance, Kalray est une entreprise technologique française et un acteur européen de premier plan dans des domaines devenus essentiels aux infrastructures d’intelligence artificielle. Avec plus de 120 collaborateurs en France et en Roumanie, Kalray développe et licencie des technologies matérielles et logicielles stratégiques pour les nouvelles générations de semi-conducteurs dédiées aux infrastructures d’IA et, plus largement, aux applications nécessitant le traitement de volumes massifs de données. Ces technologies permettent de traiter, de faire circuler et d’orchestrer efficacement les données entre les différentes ressources de calcul, afin d’optimiser les performances, la consommation énergétique et la sécurité. Kalray accompagne ses clients à travers la concession de licences sur ses technologies matérielles et logicielles (IP), complétée par des projets de développement sur mesure. De la définition d’architectures complexes jusqu’à leur intégration dans de nouvelles générations de semi-conducteurs, Kalray associe ses technologies propriétaires à une solide expertise des systèmes, de la conception des puces en silicium et du développement de systèmes complets. Rejoindre Kalray, c’est intégrer une entreprise technologique européenne pionnière, qui conçoit des solutions innovantes à la croisée des semi-conducteurs, de l’intelligence artificielle et du calcul haute performance. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d’ingénieurs et d’experts technologiques reconnus, sur des projets de pointe qui contribuent à façonner l’avenir des infrastructures d’IA. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant, collaboratif et inclusif, où les professionnels expérimentés comme les nouveaux talents peuvent développer leurs compétences, évoluer et contribuer concrètement à des projets ambitieux. Le tout dans un cadre de vie privilégié, au cœur des paysages inspirants des Alpes ou de la Côte d’Azur. Envie de contribuer avec nous à façonner l’avenir des infrastructures d’intelligence artificielle ? Rejoignez l’aventure Kalray ! Kalray est cotée sur Euronext Growth Paris (ALKAL). Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre site internet et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn. Voir la fiche de l'entreprise Description Des Activités Significatives De L'emploi Rejoignez l’équipe IA de Kalray, à la pointe de l’innovation, pour développer des solutions d’IA autonomes dédiées à la conception de puces de bout en bout, depuis la définition des exigences initiales et l’exploration architecturale jusqu’à la génération du RTL, à la vérification et à l’implémentation physique. Notre ambition est de repenser la manière dont les puces sont conçues en développant des systèmes agentiques capables de planifier des activités d’ingénierie complexes, de coordonner les outils de conception et d’itérer sur les résultats en s’appuyant sur des mécanismes de validation fiables. Cette approche doit ouvrir une nouvelle ère pour les architectures de puces, en permettant d’explorer des possibilités de conception difficiles à envisager avec les méthodes conventionnelles. Vous contribuerez directement à cette ambition en développant des solutions combinant des grands modèles de langage (LLM) de dernière génération, des agents d’IA et des outils de conception de semi-conducteurs. Dans un premier temps, vos travaux associeront une collaboration étroite avec les ingénieurs de Kalray, un accompagnement opérationnel à l’adoption de l’IA et le développement de prototypes fonctionnels. À mesure que vous vous familiariserez avec nos pratiques d’ingénierie et nos contraintes de conception, vous évoluerez vers le développement de processus autonomes de plus en plus ambitieux, avec pour objectif de transformer les premières expérimentations en solutions robustes capables de prendre en charge des projets complets de conception de puces. Vos Principales Responsabilités Appliquer l’IA à des problématiques concrètes de nos activités techniques, développer des processus de travail efficaces et partager les approches qui ont fait leurs preuves. Concevoir des prototypes d’agents capables de planifier des tâches, d’utiliser des outils d’ingénierie, d’évaluer les résultats et d’itérer pour atteindre un objectif de conception défini. Explorer des processus couvrant l’exploration architecturale, la génération du RTL, la vérification et l’implémentation, en collaboration avec les experts en conception de puces. Connecter les modèles et les agents aux outils de conception via des API, des interfaces en ligne de commande et des scripts. Évaluer le degré d’autonomie, la fiabilité, la qualité de conception et l’efficacité des solutions développées par rapport aux processus …

items.desc: ¡Hola! Somos OGA Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo. Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico. Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico. Sobre la posición. Buscamos un/a Data Scientist con experiencia en la investigación, análisis y modelado de datos para identificar patrones y tendencias clave, impulsando la toma de decisiones estratégicas en la organización, para unirse a nuestro equipo. ¿Qué harás? Análisis de datos y desarrollo de aplicaciones de optimización de procesos complejos con técnicas tanto de Inteligencia Artificial como de Investigación Operativa, utilizando entre otros, lenguajes de programación como Python, Java, JavaScript o C++. Analizar, depurar, transformar, visualizar, etc. los datos disponibles para proyectos de IA, utilizando las herramientas y tecnologías necesarias en cada caso concreto. Realizar el EDA (Exploratory Data Analysis) de los datos para proporcionar un buen conjunto de datos a los modelos de IA. Utilización de diferentes modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning, los cuales serán entrenados, validados y testados en función de los objetivos de cada proyecto. Tuning de modelos ML/DL. Investigación e implementación de algoritmos y herramientas de ML/DL. Implementación del pipeline completo de un modelo de ML/DL (Datasource, Limpieza datos, Ingeniería de Variables, Entrenamientos, Validación, Puesta en producción y Monitorización/Operación). Analizarás bases de datos utilizando técnicas de análisis estadístico avanzado. Desarrollarás soluciones y modelos avanzados de Inteligencia Artificial. Elaborarás documentación técnica relacionada con los proyectos. Timing de primeras semanas en OGA Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación. ¿Qué requerimos? Titulación en Máster en Matemáticas / Estadística / Ingeniería / Ciencias de la Computación o área relacionada (valorable Doctorado). Experiencia de 3 a 5 años en el sector de Inteligencia Artificial, incluyendo al menos 2 años como consultor liderando proyectos complejos y horizontales con exposición al negocio, con experiencia en tratamiento de datos (captura, almacenamiento, normalización, limpieza, visualización, ETLs y modelos de datos) e implementación de soluciones de IA utilizando Machine Learning y Deep Learning, aplicando algoritmos supervisados, no supervisados y auto-explicativos, como RandomForest, CatBoost, XGBoost, CNN y RNN. Conocimiento y dominio experto en Python (valorable experiencia en otras plataformas y lenguajes), conocimientos recomendables en bases de datos como Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL y MS SQL/SQL Azure, así como experiencia en el entorno de desarrollo de Microsoft Azure. Nivel Alto de inglés. ¿Qué valoramos? Airflow, Hadoop, Spark, MongoDB. Interés por el desarrollo de una carrera técnica y vocación por la especiación tecnológica. Pasión por la tecnología y por la creación de valor para el cliente. Capacidad de relación con equipos de negocio y funcionales, visión holística del problema de negocio a resolver. Orientación a resultados, proactividad, trabajo en equipo. Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional e internacional de manera esporádica. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla. Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras. Colaboración permanente con el Grupo CÁTEDRA, el Consejo Asesor Tecnológico de OGA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos. Acceso a diversas herramientas de IA Generativa, que nos ayudan a acelerar …

items.desc: APPLICATION BY EMAIL according to the application rules hereunder (not via LinkedIn). Please attach all the documents asked. CONTEXT We are seeking a full-time research scientist or engineer with a master’s degree in physics, photonics, optical engineering or a related engineering discipline to join the ‘PESLAPOD’ project. The position combines laser and optical system modelling, experimental measurements, and the integration and testing of technologies for laser power transfer and optical communication with drones. The Royal Military Academy is a recognised university conducting academic and applied research funded by Belgian Defence and external organisations. We value diversity and equal opportunities. Whether you are a man, a woman or X, or come from any background, we firmly believe that diversity enriches our community, and we encourage all qualified candidates to apply. PROJECT PESLAPOD (Persistent Eye in the Sky from Laser Powered Drones) is a three-year research project managed by the European Defence Agency. It investigates long-range laser power transfer to extend the endurance of small electric drones, with the longer-term ambition of enabling continuous airborne operation. The project also addresses secure, reliable communication with drones and resilient navigation in environments with jamming or unavailable satellite navigation signals (GNSS). Alongside other international partners, Belgium has committed to contributing to this research project through research activities at the Royal Military Academy. You will work within the Royal Military Academy’s Department of Communication, Information, Systems, and Sensors (CISS), specifically in the Laser & Optronics research unit (https://optro.rma.ac.be), in close collaboration with scientists and engineers from other consortium partners. MAIN TASKS Model and evaluate laser beam propagation and optical link performance for drone power transfer and communication, taking atmospheric conditions and operational constraints into account. Develop and conduct laboratory measurements to characterise relevant laser and optical components, including beam properties, optical power and receiver performance. Contribute to the integration and experimental validation of laser power transfer and optical communication systems. Prepare for and participate in field trials, analyse measurement data, and compare experimental results with model predictions. Assess laser safety requirements and develop appropriate operating procedures and protective measures for the applications under study. Review current approaches (state of the art) to high-power laser safety and contribute to the assessment of safety requirements, operating procedures and protective measures for laboratory and field activities. Contribute to the concept study for long-distance optical power transfer to high-altitude pseudo-satellites. Prepare technical reports and scientific publications, and present results at consortium meetings, conferences and stakeholder meetings. SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Applicants should hold a master’s degree in physics, photonics, optical engineering, electrical engineering or a related discipline, with relevant knowledge of lasers and optical systems. Applications are welcome from recent graduates to candidates with research and/or industrial experience. “MUST HAVE” skills A sound understanding of lasers, optics and beam propagation. Practical experience with optical experiments or instrumentation, gained through academic projects, a thesis, an internship or employment. Ability to analyse experimental data and interpret results using physical principles. Ability to prepare clear technical and scientific documents. Good spoken and written English is essential. “NICE-TO-HAVE” skills Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage: Optical alignment, beam profiling and laser power measurements. Free-space optical communications or optical power transfer. Atmospheric propagation modelling or measurements. Photodetectors, optical receivers and data acquisition. Python, MATLAB or LabVIEW for modelling, instrument control or data analysis. Training or experience in the use of high-energy lasers. Laser safety, particularly for high-power laser systems, would be an asset Personal skills You work carefully and systematically, with attention to experimental quality and safety. You take initiative and progressively develop independence, with guidance from experienced researchers. You collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary and international team. You communicate methods and results clearly. You respect confidentiality requirements when handling consortium information and intellectual property. Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is an added value. SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS The position may involve access to classified information. The successful candidate must therefore be willing to undergo the background checks required for security clearance conducted by …

items.card: About The Role You'll build out the data science layer of Adaptyv's foundry — the work that turns tens of thousands of raw, messy experimental readouts into clean, trustworthy, structured data that our customers, our models, and our own scientists can rely on. items.desc: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About The Role You'll build out the data science layer of Adaptyv's foundry — the work that turns tens of thousands of raw, messy experimental readouts into clean, trustworthy, structured data that our customers, our models, and our own scientists can rely on. Binding (BLI/SPR), developability, biophysical, and functional assays all produce data at scale; your job is to make that data correct, comparable, and useful. This sits at the intersection of three things: data quality (is this number real, or an artifact?), bioinformatics (linking experimental results back to sequence, structure, and protein design), and dataset building (turning foundry output into the kind of high-quality, benchmarkable data that frontier AI labs actually want). You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the lab scientists who run the assays, the software team who own the pipelines, and the customers who train models on what we produce. This is a hands-on build role, not a management one. What You'll Do Own the scientific logic of data quality across the foundry: define what "good data" looks like for each assay type — expected signal ranges, control thresholds, failure modes, edge cases — and turn it into automated checks. Build anomaly detection and QC models that catch bad data the eye would miss: assay drift, instrument variability, plate effects, false passes and false fails — and distinguish real signal from noise statistically. Work with the software and ML teams to specify, review, and improve the automated data pipelines that process instrument outputs, feeding back precise requirements for what to flag, auto-reject, or route to human review. Connect experimental results back to the protein side — sequence, structure, and design — so wet-lab data and computational models reinforce each other. Turn foundry output into structured, documented, benchmark-grade datasets that are a genuine asset for our customers and for training and evaluating protein-design models. Apply real statistical rigor to multi-condition data at scale — thousands of samples across hundreds of simultaneous experiments — and make the results interpretable and comparable across runs. What We're Looking For Strong data science / bioinformatics background — you're fluent in Python (pandas, numpy, the scientific stack) and comfortable owning messy, real-world experimental data end to end. Genuine biology grounding — you understand proteins, assays, and sequence/structure/function well enough to know what the data means, not just how to process it. You don't need to be a bench scientist, but you can't be biology-blind. Statistical maturity — process control, anomaly detection, handling variability and batch effects; you can tell drift from noise and defend the call. Prolific builder with the receipts to prove it. You've shipped a lot — pipelines, tools, models, datasets — and can point to concrete things you built end to end and put into real use, not prototypes that died in a notebook. You move fast, systematize what works, and have no patience for babysitting a fixed dashboard. AI-native builder. It's 2026 — you build with coding agents like Claude Code as a default, and you have sharp judgment about what they produce. Interdisciplinary by instinct. You're energized working across the lab bench, software, and ML, and you treat automation and data infrastructure as part of your job. Bonus: experience with protein/sequence-structure data (bioinformatics tooling, structural data), ML on experimental data, or building datasets for model training and benchmarking. Details Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site) Type: Full time Start date: ASAP Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

Per la presente posizione, è previsto un livello di inquadramento B1 nel CCNL Metalmeccanico. La fascia di retribuzione annua lorda prevista è compresa tra 30.814,29 € e 40.800€. Le tue caratteristiche Esperienza in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, elaborazione di immagini e video e nello sviluppo di soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale applicate all’ambito industriale e manifatturiero Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica, Intelligenza Artificiale, Data Science, Ingegneria dell’Automazione, Ingegneria Robotica, Ingegneria Elettronica, Ingegneria Meccatronica o in altre discipline STEM correlate
