items.desc: Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise en cybersécurité et en analyse de données au service de la lutte contre la fraude ? Rejoignez-nous ! Nous recherchons un(e) Expert(e) sécurité et cybersécurité du SI F/H – Expert(e) cyber IA data science en CDI, sur notre site de Sophia-Antipolis ou de Rennes. Qui sommes-nous ? La CNAF (Caisse Nationale des Allocations Familiales), tête de réseau des 101 CAF, représente la branche Famille de la Sécurité sociale et a pour mission de piloter la politique familiale et l’aide aux populations en situation de précarité ainsi que la politique d’action sociale. Votre futur service : Au sein de la la Direction des Systèmes d’Informations (DSI) de la Cnaf, la Direction du Contrôle Interne et de la Sécurité Numérique (DCISN) mobilise, au sein d’une même Direction, l’ensemble des acteurs œuvrant pour la sécurité numérique afin de faire face à l’augmentation incessante du niveau de menace, en apportant de l’agilité dans la mise en place des postures de sécurisation des SI, de détection des tentatives de compromission, de contrôle de l’application des politiques et processus. Rattaché(e) au département Cyber défense de la DCISN, vous intégrerez plus précisément le pôle SOC (8 collaborateurs) qui participe au dispositif de détection des activités malveillantes ayant trait à la fraude sur le système d’information de la DSI de la CNAF. Concrètement votre futur quotidien ? Votre mission consistera à transformer de grands volumes de données en systèmes intelligents de prévention et de détection de la fraude, directement exploitables par les équipes métiers ! Pour ce faire, vous vous appuierez sur votre expertise cyber et sur l’utilisation de l’intelligence artificielle, en combinant Data Science avancée, Machine Learning, analyse comportementale et expertise fraude. Vous prendrez en charge les missions suivantes : Analyser les traces cyber et investiguer les comportements frauduleux Analyser les journaux de sécurité, les événements applicatifs et les traces d’utilisation des services web et des API pour identifier des activités suspectes ; Reconstituer les enchaînements d’événements et caractériser les modes opératoires associés aux compromissions de comptes, aux usurpations d’identité, aux usages automatisés abusifs et aux détournements de services numériques à des fins frauduleuses ; Conduire les investigations techniques en croisant les sources disponibles, distinguer les comportements légitimes des anomalies et des indices de fraude. Concevoir et faire évoluer la collecte et la corrélation des données Enrichir la détection par la CTI et les informations de compromission Exploiter les outils et sources de CTI afin d’identifier les menaces, les indicateurs de compromission et les modes opératoires susceptibles d’alimenter des scénarios de fraude sur les services numériques. Développer des capacités de détection combinant expertise cyber, analyse de données et IA Construire des variables pertinentes à partir des traces cyber et des parcours d’utilisation des services. Développer des approches supervisées et non supervisées : classification, détection d’anomalies, regroupement de comportements et calcul de scores de risque. Identifier les signaux faibles, les comportements coordonnés et les relations entre différentes entités. Industrialiser les dispositifs et améliorer leurs performances Intégrer les règles, traitements et modèles dans les outils de détection et d’investigation. Automatiser les opérations répétitives de collecte, d’enrichissement et de préqualification. Définir les méthodes de validation et d’évaluation à partir des données historiques et des cas confirmés. Proposer des améliorations sur les outils et processus utilisés lors de la détection et qualification des cas de fraude. Apporter une expertise opérationnelle et garantir la maîtrise des usages Collaborer avec les équipes cybersécurité, lutte contre la fraude, métiers, données et développement pour comprendre les usages légitimes, qualifier les risques et définir les priorités de détection. Produire des restitutions claires et exploitables : synthèses d’investigation, descriptions de scénarios, documentation des règles et des modèles, recommandations d’amélioration des dispositifs de surveillance et de sécurisation. Garantir l’explicabilité des résultats et documenter les sources. Des déplacements sur les autres sites de la CNAF sont possibles. Etes-vous notre prochain(e) collaborateur(trice) ? Par ailleurs, vous vous reconnaissez dans les compétences suivantes : Cybersécurité Maîtrise d’un SIEM, notamment Splunk et du langage SPL Sécurité des applications web et des API : savoir interpréter les méthodes HTTP, les codes de réponse, les en-têtes, les cookies et les identifiants de session Capacité de comprendre et d’exploiter des données CTI, IOC, données issues de fuites de données Analyse de données Python pour l’analyse de données SQL avancé : écrire des requêtes comprenant des jointures, des agrégations, des …

items.title: Applied AI Engineer
items.card: The Role Reporting to the AI & Innovation Lead, the Applied AI Engineer builds and improves AI-enabled products and workflows. The role focuses on agents, model and tool selection, prompt and context engineering, retrieval, MCP, evaluation, token economics and the practical skills needed to make AI useful in legal and business work. The role will work closely with the Product Manager, Automation & AI Engineer,
items.desc: The Department Our Technology team continues to go from strength to strength, playing a vital role in firm-wide innovation and strategy. Far from being a support function, Technology is integral to the firm's growth agenda, backed by strong leadership engagement and sustained investment. The Team The AI and Engineering team develops practical AI, automation and integration capability for legal practice and business operations. It works closely with Product, Data, Architecture, Security and operational teams to turn valuable ideas into secure, maintainable services, while retaining space for controlled experimentation and rapid learning. The Role Reporting to the AI & Innovation Lead, the Applied AI Engineer builds and improves AI-enabled products and workflows. The role focuses on agents, model and tool selection, prompt and context engineering, retrieval, MCP, evaluation, token economics and the practical skills needed to make AI useful in legal and business work. The role will work closely with the Product Manager, Automation & AI Engineer, lawyers, business teams, Data, Architecture, Security and vendors. It will move use cases from rapid experiment and proof of concept into tested services, with clear evidence of quality, safety, adoption and value. Duties And Responsibilities Applied AI delivery Work against the prioritised AI and innovation roadmap, with the Product Manager accountable for product priorities and outcomes and the AI & Innovation Lead accountable for innovation direction and team capability. Build AI-enabled applications, agents and workflow components using Python, TypeScript, Azure and approved model services. Develop prompts, system instructions, tool definitions, retrieval approaches and context strategies suited to real legal and operational tasks. Design and evaluate retrieval pipelines, including document preparation, chunking, metadata, permissions-aware access, source attribution and retrieval quality. Build MCP integrations and other APIs that allow agents to use approved data and tools through controlled interfaces. Use AI-assisted software development to accelerate prototyping, while reviewing, testing and hardening generated code before release. Evaluation, quality and token economics Create representative evaluation sets from real use cases and define acceptance thresholds before wider release. Evaluate end-to-end outcomes and intermediate agent behaviour, including tool selection, task adherence, groundedness, safety and failure modes. Measure token consumption, latency and cost; compare models and architectures and recommend the simplest approach that meets the need. Use telemetry and user feedback to improve prompts, retrieval, skills, agents and model configuration after release. Track task-success rate, output quality, human correction or override, latency, unit cost, adoption and time or capacity created. Experimentation and productionisation Work with Product to turn opportunities into clear hypotheses, technical spikes, PoCs and controlled pilots. Document experiment design, limitations, decisions and results so learning can be reused across the roadmap. Retain engineering ownership as successful prototypes move into secure, monitored and supportable production services, working with the Automation & AI Engineer on architecture, integration and production standards. Contribute reusable components, evaluation harnesses, prompt patterns and engineering guidance. Responsible delivery Protect confidential and personal data through appropriate access, retention and environment controls. Design human review, fallback and escalation into AI workflows where quality or consequence requires it. Explain model limitations and uncertainty clearly, avoiding the presentation of experimental capability as production-ready. Monitor production AI services for quality, cost, latency, tool failures and unexpected behaviour; investigate incidents and maintain appropriate runbooks, rollback arrangements and operational guidance. Essential Skills and Experience Strong software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, code review, documentation and secure development. Experience working with APIs, integrations, cloud services and event-driven or workflow-based solutions. Ability to move from an unclear problem to a working prototype, then improve it using evidence and user feedback. Confidence working with Product, Data, Architecture, Security and business specialists in a multidisciplinary environment. Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. A pragmatic approach to experimentation, with good judgement about what is safe to test and what is ready to operate. Use of approved identity, secrets-management and service-connection patterns, avoiding embedded credentials and unmanaged service accounts. Commitment to accessible and usable user-facing applications and workflow interfaces. …

items.desc: We’re looking for data scientists who turn ambiguous business questions into models and analyses that actually get used. You’ll frame the problem, wrangle the data, build and validate models, and — just as importantly — explain what the numbers mean to people who don’t speak Python. Your day-to-day will revolve around the classic Python data stack: pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. You’ll also work on modern enterprise data platforms — running notebooks and lakehouse workloads in Microsoft Fabric, building pipelines and operational applications in Palantir Foundry, and deploying analytics on Azure, AWS, or GCP. The science matters, but so does making it work inside a real organization’s data ecosystem. What We Offer AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else. AI Center of Excellence — Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily. Your tools, your choice — Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you. Real project variety — From generative AI for legal document compliance through agentic systems in manufacturing environments to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored. Conference and speaking support — Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better — we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses. Your tasks Translate business problems into analytical solutions: define hypotheses, choose metrics, and select the right modeling approach for the question at hand Explore, clean, and prepare data using Python (pandas, NumPy), working with structured and semi-structured sources of varying quality Build, validate, and tune machine learning models for classification, regression, forecasting, segmentation, and recommendation using scikit-learn, XGBoost, and statsmodels Design and analyze experiments: A/B tests, statistical hypothesis testing, and causal analysis that hold up to scrutiny Work hands-on with enterprise data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric (lakehouses, notebooks, semantic models) and Palantir Foundry (pipelines, ontology, operational workflows) Communicate findings through clear visualizations, dashboards, and narratives tailored to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike Collaborate with data engineers on data availability and quality, and with ML/AI engineers to move models from notebook to production Monitor deployed models for drift and degradation, and own the retraining and improvement cycle Requirements At least 4 years in data science or applied analytics, with models and analyses that made it past the prototype stage Strong Python skills across the standard data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) Solid statistical foundations: hypothesis testing, regression, experimental design, and knowing when a result is real versus noise Knowledge of at least one cloud/data platform and its data science components — Azure (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Machine Learning), AWS (SageMaker), GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML), Snowflake (Snowpark ML, Cortex), Databricks (MLflow, Mosaic AI), or Palantir (Foundry Code Workspaces, Foundry ML, AIP) items.desc: We’re looking for data scientists who turn ambiguous business questions into models and analyses that actually get used. You’ll frame the problem, wrangle the data, build and validate models, and — just as importantly — explain what the numbers mean to people who don’t speak Python. Your day-to-day will revolve around the classic Python data stack: pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. You’ll also work on modern enterprise data platforms — running notebooks and lakehouse workloads in Microsoft Fabric, building pipelines and operational applications in Palantir Foundry, and deploying analytics on Azure, AWS, or GCP. The science matters, but so does making it work inside a real organization’s data ecosystem. What We Offer AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else. AI Center of Excellence — Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily. Your tools, your choice — Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you. Real project variety — From generative AI for legal document compliance through agentic systems in manufacturing environments to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored. Conference and speaking support — Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better — we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses. Your tasks Translate business problems into analytical solutions: define hypotheses, choose metrics, and select the right modeling approach for the question at hand Explore, clean, and prepare data using Python (pandas, NumPy), working with structured and semi-structured sources of varying quality Build, validate, and tune machine learning models for classification, regression, forecasting, segmentation, and recommendation using scikit-learn, XGBoost, and statsmodels Design and analyze experiments: A/B tests, statistical hypothesis testing, and causal analysis that hold up to scrutiny Work hands-on with enterprise data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric (lakehouses, notebooks, semantic models) and Palantir Foundry (pipelines, ontology, operational workflows) Communicate findings through clear visualizations, dashboards, and narratives tailored to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike Collaborate with data engineers on data availability and quality, and with ML/AI engineers to move models from notebook to production Monitor deployed models for drift and degradation, and own the retraining and improvement cycle Requirements At least 4 years in data science or applied analytics, with models and analyses that made it past the prototype stage Strong Python skills across the standard data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) Solid statistical foundations: hypothesis testing, regression, experimental design, and knowing when a result is real versus noise Knowledge of at least one cloud/data platform and its data science components — Azure (Microsoft items.desc: The Role The Rosalind Franklin Institute (the Franklin) is a technology institute established by the UK Government as a unique centre committed to advancing tools that are needed to transform healthcare in the future. The Institute brings together researchers in life and physical sciences, and engineering, to develop a spectrum of tools which we will use to image, interpret and intervene in biological systems. These insights will speed up the discovery of new medicines, help find new diagnostics and contribute to a deeper understanding of human health and disease. Our Science Strategy seeks to focus the Franklin’s research and unite our researchers around our Technology Innovation Challenges and Life Science Challenges. For more information on the Franklin’s Challenges click here . The Grange group is developing tools that can image the 3-dimensional organisation of macromolecular complexes within brain tissues. This utilises fast vitrification of surgical biopsies and in-situ structural biology methods (cryo-focused ion beam milling, cryo lift out, electron tomography). We are seeking a motivated postdoctoral research associate who will be able to develop methods to investigate content-rich data taken from human tissue resections and reconstruct the molecular make-up of supramolecular complexes utilising quantitative approaches. The project will focus on cytoskeletal and mitochondrial changes during aging and disease. As part of this post, you will drive a project aimed at the computational reconstruction of macromolecular structures from in-situ data, pushing integration of workflows to enable the molecular sociology of cytoskeletal and mitochondrial processes to be examined in the context of aging and neurodegeneration. As part of the team, you will work with partners at Imperial, University College London and the University of Oxford to coordinate the procurement of specimens, work towards the acquisition of high-quality cryo-electron tomography data and develop structure determination pipelines capable of delivering a comprehensive overview of macromolecular organisation and diversity. Key Responsibilities As a Research Associate at the Franklin, you will bring scientific knowledge and skills to deliver a specific research project and/or you will bring independent, creative science, or specific skills to a team delivering a project or program. Through this work, you will build scientific independence, develop new science and leadership skills, and establish a growing reputation externally. You will also: Develop and streamline computational approaches to in-situ structure determination methods from tissue sources that enable an assessment of macromolecular diversity. Demonstrate leadership as part of a team working with clinicians to prepare tissues for cryo-electron tomography. Plan and conduct experiments, analyse and interpret results and supervised delivery of outputs (e.g. research reports, patent applications) in a scientific/technology area of interest. Work within a project team, contributing to wider projects around key Franklin's Challenges. Lead major contributions to research outputs including papers, patents and both internal and external presentations. Support and develop others including day-to-day supervision of students or visitors in areas related to your own research. Have supervised, staged progression to first stages of scientific independence with opportunities to further develop science and skills/experience. Enhance your research through collaboration with other researchers and make active contributions to exchange of ideas through your own network. Be able to understand, interpret, create and communicate appropriately within a research context. Develop search and discovery skills and techniques. Be supervised by a Scientist/Senior Scientist in delivery of research outputs, either in the context of a project or Franklin's Challenge or as an early career development fellow. Before submitting your application please ensure you read the Job Information Pack for full details of this role. This can be found in the careers section on the Franklin's website. This job description sets out the skills and experience we believe are needed to be able to do this job but, research also tells us women are much more likely than men to take this list of requirements as absolute and self-select out of the process. If you think you can deliver this role then we want to hear from you, regardless of the boxes you did not tick. Whilst the role requires candidates to hold a PhD/DPhil (or equivalent), we may consider candidates who have submitted their PhD/DPhil thesis, in which case the initial appointment will be made at £38,500 per annum (to be increased on completion of the PhD/DPhil qualification). Die Eggersmann Gruppe ist ein international tätiger Verbund von Unternehmen mit über 50 Jahren Erfahrung in Umwelttechnologien und mehr als 1.300 Mitarbeitenden weltweit. Als führender Anbieter von Recyclinganlagen und -maschinen treiben wir zukunftsorientierte Lösungen für eine funktionierende Kreislaufwirtschaft voran. Um die Potenziale der Digitalisierung und Automatisierung in der Recyclingbranche voll auszuschöpfen, haben wir in Aachen unseren digitalen Innovations-Hub als Corporate Start-up gegründet. Mit der ESA app, unserer modularen IIoT-Software, optimieren wir den Betrieb von Recyclinganlagen und -maschinen durch Datenanalyse und Machine Learning. Deine Mission: Du machst Machine Learning produktionsreif: Du entwickelst skalierbare Daten- und Modell-Pipelines auf AWS und bringst Machine-Learning-Modelle zuverlässig in den Einsatz. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Anomalieerkennung in Zeitreihendaten von Recyclinganlagen. So trägst du dazu bei, Abweichungen frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen und den Anlagenbetrieb datenbasiert zu verbessern – von der technischen Infrastruktur bis zum laufenden Modellbetrieb. Deine Aufgaben: Du verantwortest die Konzeption, Entwicklung, den Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer Daten- und Modell-Pipelines auf AWS, beispielsweise mit EC2, Lambda, S3 und CloudWatch. items.desc: About the role The Product Intelligence Platform is a generative AI-driven system that transforms how Tesco handles product data at scale. The platform leverages multi-agent generative AI systems to automate product categorisation, enrichment and matching across a vast number of products every week, processing over 1 million events weekly on an event-driven Kafka architecture. This role sits closest to our generative AI work: prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, embeddings, scoring and evaluation. You will work alongside our Java/Spring Boot platform engineers but will spend most of your time in Python, on the services and pipelines that sit nearest to the models. A lot of this work starts as ambiguous, research-shaped problems — “is this even feasible?” — before becoming production services. You'll run feasibility studies and proofs of concept, then carry the strongest ideas through to production, working closely with product managers, data stewards and engineering peers along the way. You will be responsible for Leading generative AI feasibility studies and proofs of concept for new product intelligence capabilities (for example, image-based accuracy scoring or dynamic attribute handling), and turning promising results into production designs. Designing and building generative AI solutions that integrate large language models (Azure OpenAI GPT-4) through our GenAI Service facade, including prompt design, evaluation and iteration. Building and maintaining embedding-based similarity and scoring pipelines using PostgreSQL with pgvector. Contributing to LLM observability and evaluation practices (e.g. with Langfuse), including regression testing and drift detection as prompts and models change. Supporting Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) tooling that helps data stewards review and validate generative AI output efficiently — 100% HITL review before publication is a core control on this platform. Contributing to responsible Gen AI governance activities, including audit support and structured release criteria for prompt and model changes. Building event-driven services in Python for high-volume data processing on Kafka. Collaborating with product managers, data stewards and other engineers to translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical designs. Sharing generative AI knowledge with the wider team and contributing to upskilling. Optionally representing the team's generative AI work externally, such as at conferences or in the tech community. You will need Mandatory skills Solid, recent experience building production backend services in Python with a modern framework (FastAPI, Django, Flask or similar). Practical, hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering in a production or near-production setting, not only experimentation. Experience with embeddings and vector similarity (pgvector or an equivalent vector database). Good understanding of event-driven architectures and Apache Kafka. Comfort working on ambiguous, research-shaped problems — running feasibility studies or PoCs — and then carrying them through to a shipped solution. Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure. Understanding of software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, testing and code review. Strong stakeholder communication skills: able to navigate ambiguity and translate it into clear requirements and implementation plans. Nice-to-have skills Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling (Langfuse or similar). Experience working with multi-agent systems. Familiarity with Java/Spring Boot, since the wider platform is polyglot Java/Python. Experience with Kubernetes (Azure Kubernetes Service) for container orchestration. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Knowledge of the retail or e-commerce domain. Understanding of data quality and governance principles. Experience mentoring or upskilling others in applied generative AI, or involvement in hiring. Whats in it for you? Salary UoP 20 000 - 25 000 PLN gross/month Hybrid working We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about different flexible working options. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a career, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support. This role requires you to be based in or near Kraków, as you will spend 60% (3 days) of your week collaborating with colleagues at our office locations or local sites and the rest remotely. Benefits Tesco is a diverse and exciting employer, dedicated to being #aplacetogeton, providing career-defining opportunities to all of our colleagues. If you choose to join our business, we will provide you with (for all): Up to 20% yearly salary bonus – based on both individual and business performance Permanent contract from the go – as a sign of our trust in your …

items.desc: Vacatureomschrijving Een klant helpen een passende outfit te kiezen. Informatie uit documenten begrijpen. Een toepassing gecontroleerd acties laten uitvoeren in onze systemen. Als AI Engineer bij Omoda Brands bouw je de AI-functionaliteit die dit mogelijk maakt. Je zorgt dat die in productie betrouwbaar doet wat ze moet doen. Wat een AI Engineer bij ons is Jouw expertise zit in de AI ín de toepassing. Je kiest en combineert bestaande modellen en bouwt de retrieval, context, tool use en controles eromheen. Je begrijpt hoe die keuzes doorwerken in kwaliteit, snelheid, betrouwbaarheid en kosten. Je ontwikkelt vooral met bestaande taal- en beeldmodellen. Waar gerichte fine-tuning waarde toevoegt, werk je samen met het datateam. Je werkt aan klantgerichte toepassingen, zoals onze AI Stylist en aan AI die interne processen ondersteunt of taken uitvoert. Wat je doet Je bouwt AI-functionaliteit die informatie begrijpt, antwoorden of content genereert en gecontroleerd acties uitvoert. Je combineert modellen, bedrijfsdata, retrieval en tools tot werkende toepassingen. Je ontwikkelt, deployt en beheert de services en API’s achter die toepassingen. Je zet evaluaties op en behandelt prompts en configuraties als geversioneerde, geteste onderdelen. Je bouwt logging, monitoring, foutafhandeling en terugvalopties vanaf het begin in. Je zorgt voor duidelijke grenzen aan wat een toepassing zelfstandig mag doen en wanneer menselijke beoordeling nodig is. Je bewaakt en verbetert kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid, snelheid en kosten in productie. Je bouwt mee aan gedeelde AI-voorzieningen die het team kan hergebruiken. Functie-eisen Je bent een medior of senior software-engineer en hebt AI- of LLM-toepassingen in productie gebracht. Je kunt betrouwbare backendservices en API’s bouwen, deployen en beheren. Je hebt praktische ervaring met bijvoorbeeld retrieval, tool use, agents of multimodale modellen. Je begrijpt embeddings, contextmanagement en de afwegingen rond fine-tuning. Je weet hoe je systemen test waarvan de uitkomst niet iedere keer identiek is. Je werkt met Python of een vergelijkbare backendtaal en hebt ervaring met een cloudplatform. Je gebruikt coding agents en beoordeelt hun output kritisch. Je kunt technische keuzes helder uitleggen. Voor deze functie is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal vereist. Je hoeft niet ieder model of framework te kennen. Sterke software-engineering, productie-ervaring en het vermogen om nieuwe technologie te doorgronden vinden we belangrijker. Aanvullende informatie Je team Je werkt in het AI-team, samen met AI Product Builders en AI Specialists, en werkt intensief samen met IT en data. AI Product Builders bouwen interne software met behulp van coding agents. AI Specialists passen AI toe binnen hun vakgebied en helpen de inhoudelijke kwaliteit beoordelen. Jij brengt de engineeringexpertise voor de AI-functionaliteit en de technische werking daarvan in productie. Security, privacy en verantwoord datagebruik zijn gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheden. Over Omoda Brands Omoda Brands is het huis achter Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com. Vier merken, ruim 2.000 collega’s en meer dan 3 miljoen klanten per jaar. Onze ambitie is de meest persoonlijke boutique op schaal. Een winkelervaring waarin we klanten helpen kiezen op basis van hun smaak, wensen en situatie. Daar werken we al aan. Onze AI Stylist stelt outfits samen in een gesprek, we maken productbeelden met AI en onze webchat handelt een deel van de klantvragen af. Ook intern bouwen collega’s toepassingen voor campagnes, content en planning. Wat je bij ons vindt Flexibel werken vanuit Zierikzee, Amsterdam of Zwolle. We komen gemiddeld 1 à 2 dagen per week samen op één van deze locaties. 32–38 uur per week, afhankelijk van jouw voorkeur. Een passend salaris op basis van jouw kennis, ervaring en de waarde die je meebrengt. Concrete AI-toepassingen waarop je kunt voortbouwen. Technisch eigenaarschap, van ontwerp tot werking in productie. Ruimte voor technische keuzes en verdieping. De schaal van vier merken en direct contact met de collega’s die jouw werk gebruiken. Een rol die we op medior- of seniorniveau kunnen invullen. Interesse? Laat ons zien of vertel wat je hebt gebouwd en vooral hoe je daartoe kwam. Welk probleem loste je op, wat was jouw eigen bijdrage en welke technische keuzes maakte je? Hoe controleerde je of de AI goed werkte, en wat leerde je nadat de toepassing live ging? Hoe je dit deelt is aan jou: een korte beschrijving, link, screenshots of demo. Een beknopt voorbeeld is voldoende voor je sollicitatie; in het gesprek gaan we er samen dieper op in. Vertrouwelijke code of bedrijfsinformatie hoef je niet te delen.

items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we need a Data Scientist to join our Anti Fraud Team. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to tackle fraud, one of the most impactful and fast-evolving challenges in insurance. You will do this from a global perspective. In fact, the team is responsible for detecting fraudulent claims across all Prima markets: the UK, Spain and Italy. You’ll collaborate with engineers, claims handlers and business leaders to improve the detection of fraud, directly influencing real-world fraud decisions with impact on the company’s bottom line measured in millions. This is a highly practical area of work where strong business judgment is just as important as technical expertise. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details What You’ll Do Design and improve fraud detection systems that prioritize high-risk claims, optimizing the trade-off between detection accuracy and operational efficiency Collaborate across teams and functions, working closely with fraud analysts, engineers, and product managers Develop deep expertise in fraud dynamics, identifying emerging fraud patterns, understanding how they evolve across the insurance lifecycle, and translating these insights into effective detection and prevention strategies, for example identifying suspicious networks of related claims, synthetic entities, or anomalous behavioral patterns What We’re Looking For Extensive experience (3+ years) in data science or applied machine learning, leading end-to-end initiatives in complex technical domains and delivering measurable business impact Strong analytical and quantitative mindset able to translate data into insights, assess model performance, and guide decision-making with evidence and clarity Structured problem solver skilled at framing ambiguous challenges, defining success metrics, and communicating results to both technical and non-technical audiences Strong Python programming skills, especially in the data domain, and fluent use of Git Knowledge of Spark, SQL or any other data-oriented programming language and proficiency with standard data wrangling and modeling libraries (Pandas, Sklearn, Keras, XGBoost, LightGBM, etc.) Nice-to-Have Experience in analytical fraud detection in the Insurance, Finance or Law Enforcement domain In-depth knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) and analytics (NetworkX, GNN) or explainability applied to anomaly detection Knowledge of BI tools (Tableau or similar) €45,000 - €65,000 a year Why you’ll love it here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 💵 Competitive compensation: We offer a performance-based bonus of up to 5% of the fixed salary for this position. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy hybrid working, with a mix of home and office days. Plus, for up to 30 days per year, work from anywhere. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

items.desc: Data Science Graduate Contract type: Permanent Location: Hatfield (Hybrid working – 3 days in the office) Working hours per week: 40 hours Level: Entry level – Graduate Starting Salary: £32,000 Application Closing Date: Sunday 1st November 2026 Scheme commences: September 2027 About Us Our mission is to deliver joy in every shop, through unbeatable choice, unrivalled service, and reassuringly good value. We’re Ocado Retail , a market-leading joint venture between Ocado Group and M&S, and the world’s largest dedicated online supermarket, ocado.com . Not only is Ocado.com the only place to shop a full range of M&S food online, it’s also the home to the widest online supermarket range in the UK and champion of small, independent brands. We’re also the brains behind Zoom by Ocado , our same-day grocery delivery service. About The Team And The Role Data is core to our decision making, and we have one of the richest datasets in the industry. The Data Science team develops models which turn our data into actionable insights. It is our mission to leverage data to give the best value and experience to our customers and suppliers whilst increasing profitability and growth for Ocado Retail. The Data Science team is responsible for understanding the complexities in the data, generating appropriate models to answer business questions, and delivering the outputs of these models to stakeholders in diverse areas of the business. It is our responsibility to work across functions to productionise these models so they are available to the right people, any time they need them. This could be in the form of a data table with the outputs of the model, or developing an interface to allow users to interact with the data in a way that allows them to leverage models for their specific needs. We also develop multi-agent AI systems to solve for complicated workflows. This means that we have to truly understand the business users, their needs and the goals they are trying to achieve in order to create AI systems that can deliver value for those users. To do this we have to understand the art of the possible with AI, and have to keep up with an ever changing AI technology space. Our remit is to apply statistics, machine learning and artificial intelligence to our data at scale. To do this we use Python, SQL, and the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). We are cross-functional by design, working with stakeholders across the business with varying degrees of technical expertise, meaning communicating complex ideas is core to the success of the Data Science team. What You’ll Do This scheme is about learning how we apply data science in Ocado Retail. The majority of your time will be spent in the Data Science team, owning projects from start to finish with responsibility for managing stakeholders and delivery of data science solutions with support from the wider team. This will allow you to continue to develop your Python and SQL skills to answer business questions. There will be opportunities to rotate into other areas of the business and explore analytics, insight and data engineering with Ocado Retail. You will be given support and guidance from the Data Science team in scoping out data science projects, developing novel solutions and delivering these to key stakeholders. A typical project involves researching a business question within the context of scientific literature, identifying relevant data sources, developing models that provide an answer to the question, and delivering this to our internal stakeholders. Throughout this process there is clear communication of progress of the project to the wider team, alongside our stakeholders. You will be taught our coding standards, and will be producing production-ready code by the end of the programme. At the end of the programme you will have a rounded knowledge base of how data is used in the organisation, and how to apply statistical approaches to improve our service for customers and suppliers. Placements in other teams will be aimed at broadening your awareness of what goes into data driven decision making. They may involve: Working in an analyst team within insight for 6 months in either Marketing, Category, Operations, Forecasting, Customer Research, Web Merchandising, or Trading (Range, Pricing, and Promotions). Delivery of key analytic projects for the designated team and the wider business. Build relationships with analyst colleagues and understand different data needs throughout the business. Working with Data Engineering for an expanded understanding of how data is processed, prepared and used in the wider business. In addition to your core scheme, you will have the opportunity for cross-functional rotations to gain broader business exposure outside of your primary discipline. Skilled in logical …

items.desc: Entra nel nostro mondo. Trasforma insieme a noi. AI ENGINEER EXPERT Quale sarà la tua sfida? Sarai tu a entrare nel nostro team? Requisiti fondamentali Almeno 6 anni di esperienza nel ruolo; Laurea specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science, Informatica o discipline affini (STEM). Esperienza pregressa di almeno 5 anni nello sviluppo di software in almeno un linguaggio, come per esempio: Python, Scala, e/o simili. Esperienza nel disegno di soluzioni software e nell’implementazione di strutture dati, algoritmi. Esperienza nell’utilizzo degli strumenti di Code Repository e CI/CD. Conoscenza di framework di versionamento di dati e/o modelli (esempio: MLFlow, DVC, WanDB…). Conoscenza dei concetti, algoritmi e metodologie di Machine Learning e Gen AI. Esperienza con linguaggi SQL per il design, query e gestione dei database; esperienza nell’utilizzo di linguaggi SQL per le attività di ETL; Esperienza in attività di coordinamento e crescita di un team o più team di progetto, pre-sales e delivery; Indispensabile la conoscenza fluente di italiano e inglese professionali. items.title: Research Associate In Translational Radiobiology
items.card: You will support a Prostate Cancer UK funded project investigating extracellular matrix remodelling in prostate cancer radioresistance and the development of non-invasive urinary biomarkers to monitor treatment response. You will be responsible for: Conduct individual and collaborative research projects. Develop research objectives and proposals for own or joint research, with the assistance of a mentor if required.
items.desc: We are seeking a motivated and collaborative individual to join our team as a Research Associate in Translational Radiobiology. This is an outstanding opportunity to work within the Translational Radiobiology group under the supervision of Professor Ananya Choudhury at Manchester Cancer Research Centre. You will support a Prostate Cancer UK funded project investigating extracellular matrix remodelling in prostate cancer radioresistance and the development of non-invasive urinary biomarkers to monitor treatment response. You will be responsible for: Conduct individual and collaborative research projects. Develop research objectives and proposals for own or joint research, with the assistance of a mentor if required. Use creativity to analyse and interpret research data and draw conclusions on the outcomes. Prepare proposals and applications to external bodies, e.g. for funding and contractual purposes. Plan and manage own research activity in collaboration with others. We welcome candidates who bring diverse perspectives, experiences, and approaches to their work. About You We encourage applications from individuals with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. You should demonstrate: Essential Criteria Have, or be about to obtain, a relevant PhD (or equivalent) Specialist knowledge in the discipline oncology, radiobiology or radiotherapy Experience in research methods and techniques in molecular biology assays, specifically RNA/DNA extraction and real time PCR assay, Western blots, Immunofluorescence Experience of working on clinical research projects involving collection and processing of human liquid and tissue samples Experience in cell culture and excellent aseptic techniques Desirable Criteria Experience of undergraduate or masters project supervision Experience working in research related to prostate cancer Experience working on clinical research projects Specialist knowledge in the field of radiotherapy Experience in RNAseq, Genomics and/or proteomics (such as Mass Spectrometry) We value transferable skills and real-world experience as much as formal qualifications. Our benefits include: Generous employer contribution pension 29 days annual leave plus bank holidays, along with Christmas closure Ride to work and EV car scheme available For more information, please see University of Manchester Benefits. You can also find information on our Flexible and Hybrid working here. We are an open place of enquiry and challenge. We embrace and celebrate difference, diversity and debate, and we pride ourselves on being a place of education, learning and community where we are able, within the law, to question and test received wisdom, express new ideas and explore controversial or unpopular topics and opinions. Find out more from our Freedom of Speech Policy. items.desc: Job title: Machine Learning Engineer Locations: Manchester or Haywards Heath (hybrid working) Role Overview Markerstudy Group are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to help take leading-edge and novel insurance risk modelling and pricing techniques and participate in creating fully automated machine learning pipelines. Markerstudy is a leading provider of private insurance in the UK, insuring around 5% of the private cars on the UK roads, 20% of commercial vehicles and over 30% of motorcycles in total premium levels of circa £1 billion. Most of Markerstudy’s business is written as the insurance pricing provider behind household names such as Tesco, Sainsbury’s, O2, Halifax, AA, Saga and Lloyds Bank to list a few. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will use your skills to: Tune machine learning methods to best leverage our state-of-the-art processing capabilities Deploy and maintain machine learning methods in a DevOps / MLOps based machine learning environment Create robust high-quality code using test-driven development (TDD) techniques and adhering to the SOLID coding standards Your work will enable sustained improvements to products, prices and processes giving Markerstudy a critical advantage in the increasingly competitive insurance market by minimizing the development to deployment and monitoring stages of the ML lifecycle through automation. You will also be responsible for refining, tuning, deploying and maintaining machine learning methods in our machine learning pipeline by using robust test-driven development (TDD) approaches to maximise performance and robustness, and improve company performance and our customer-centric offerings across Motor, Home and Commercial Lines businesses. The successful candidate will also enjoy opportunities for leading, coaching, and mentoring more junior ML Engineers. Key Responsibilities: Report and communicate with Senior Stakeholders, such as the Head of Data Science and Machine Learning and Director of Technical Underwriting Propose, proof-of-concept, develop, and deliver novel machine learning processes that automate current manual processes, and leverage DevOps and MLOps software. Work in a collaborative environment with data science to help deploy machine learning methods that are state-of-the-art, robust, and future extensible. Tune machine learning methods for optimal performance. Deploy and maintain machine learning methods in our machine learning pipeline using robust test-driven development (TDD) coding approaches, using the SOLID software development principles. Actively contribute to creating a culture of coding and data excellence Implement efficient solutions across a range of markets, including Private Motor, Commercial Vehicle, Bike, Taxi, and Home Lead and mentor junior machine learning engineers and share best practices Key Skills and Experience: Previous experience in tuning and deploying machine learning methods Experience with some of the following predictive modelling techniques; Logistic Regression, GBMs, Elastic Net GLMs, GAMs, Decision Trees, Random Forests, Neural Nets and Clustering Experience in DevOps and Azure ML, or other MLOps and ML Lifecycle technology stacks, such as AWS, Databricks, Google Cloud, etc. Experience with deploying services in Docker and Kubernetes Experience in creating production grade coding and SOLID programming principles, including test-driven development (TDD) approaches Experience in programming languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, R, SAS, SQL) Experience in source-control software, e.g., GitHub Proficient at communicating results in a concise manner both verbally and written Experience in data and model monitoring is a plus Behaviours: A high level of professional/academic excellence, educated to at least a master’s level in a STEM-based or DS / ML / AI / or mathematical discipline Collaborative and team player Logical thinker with a professional and positive attitude Passion to innovate and improve processes

items.desc: We’re looking for data scientists who turn ambiguous business questions into models and analyses that actually get used. You’ll frame the problem, wrangle the data, build and validate models, and — just as importantly — explain what the numbers mean to people who don’t speak Python. Your day-to-day will revolve around the classic Python data stack: pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. You’ll also work on modern enterprise data platforms — running notebooks and lakehouse workloads in Microsoft Fabric, building pipelines and operational applications in Palantir Foundry, and deploying analytics on Azure, AWS, or GCP. The science matters, but so does making it work inside a real organization’s data ecosystem. What We Offer AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else. AI Center of Excellence — Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily. Your tools, your choice — Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you. Real project variety — From generative AI for legal document compliance through agentic systems in manufacturing environments to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored. Conference and speaking support — Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better — we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses. Your tasks Translate business problems into analytical solutions: define hypotheses, choose metrics, and select the right modeling approach for the question at hand Explore, clean, and prepare data using Python (pandas, NumPy), working with structured and semi-structured sources of varying quality Build, validate, and tune machine learning models for classification, regression, forecasting, segmentation, and recommendation using scikit-learn, XGBoost, and statsmodels Design and analyze experiments: A/B tests, statistical hypothesis testing, and causal analysis that hold up to scrutiny Work hands-on with enterprise data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric (lakehouses, notebooks, semantic models) and Palantir Foundry (pipelines, ontology, operational workflows) Communicate findings through clear visualizations, dashboards, and narratives tailored to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike Collaborate with data engineers on data availability and quality, and with ML/AI engineers to move models from notebook to production Monitor deployed models for drift and degradation, and own the retraining and improvement cycle Requirements At least 4 years in data science or applied analytics, with models and analyses that made it past the prototype stage Strong Python skills across the standard data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) Solid statistical foundations: hypothesis testing, regression, experimental design, and knowing when a result is real versus noise Knowledge of at least one cloud/data platform and its data science components — Azure (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Machine Learning), AWS (SageMaker), GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML), Snowflake (Snowpark ML, Cortex), Databricks (MLflow, Mosaic AI), or Palantir (Foundry Code Workspaces, Foundry ML, AIP) Ability to communicate analytical results clearly to business stakeholders and influence decisions with data Familiarity with working autonomously while collaborating effectively with data engineers, architects, and product teams Fluent English, both written and spoken Fluent Polish required Residing in Poland required Nice to have Production experience with Microsoft Fabric or Palantir Foundry certification (Foundry Data Engineer / Data Scientist tracks) Experience with time series forecasting, NLP, recommender systems, or exposure to LLM-based workflows Familiarity with MLOps practices: MLflow, experiment tracking, model versioning, and CI/CD for ML Experience with Power BI or other BI tools, and distributed processing with Spark/PySpark Job no. Sluit je aan bij het AI for Corporate team van KPN Jouw rol als AI Engineer Ben jij een AI-engineer die net zo makkelijk met business-stakeholders schakelt als met technische teams? Iemand die energie krijgt van co-creëren met de business, processen doorgronden, kansen spotten én oplossingen bedenken en bouwen? Dan zoeken we jou! Als Medior AI Engineer in ons AI for Corporate team: Ontwerp en bouw je Generatieve AI- en NLP-oplossingen die interne processen in HR & Finance slimmer, sneller en AI-Native maken. Werk je aan concrete use-cases zoals AI-agents voor HR/Finance, geautomatiseerd factuurscannen, goedkeuringsworkflows en voorspellende modellen. Neem je zelfstandig eigenaarschap over features — van idee tot productie — met focus op schaalbare, betrouwbare en maintainable AI-services. Ben je een brugbouwer tussen tech en non-tech, durf je te challengen, stel je kritische vragen en bouw je sterke domein-connectie en begrip op. Combineer je AI-expertise met productie-mindset en software engineering-kwaliteit. Team & werkmodel We werken hybride met flexibele thuiswerk-opties. We ontmoeten elkaar op maandagen in Rotterdam en op donderdagen in Amsterdam. Daarnaast organiseren we regelmatig AI-knowledge-sharing en community events. Dit is je team Corporate Insights & Analytics (CIA) is de data- en AI-motor binnen KPN. Met zo’n 40 professionals — van developers en data scientists tot consultants, data engineers, scrum masters en product owners — werken we verspreid over vijf Scrum-teams aan interne digitale innovatie. Je wordt onderdeel van het AI for Corporate team binnen Group Business Services, een hechte en ondernemende groep van zes AI-specialisten die AI-oplossingen bouwt voor HR & Finance. Binnen dezelfde afdeling werk je ook nauw samen met het Anaplan-, Oracle Reporting-, Managed Dashboarding- en Data-team én met KPN’s snelgroeiende AI-community van 50+ AI-engineers en data scientists. Wat breng jij ons? Je bent een Medior AI Engineer die technologie én business-impact laat samenkomen. Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en krijgt energie van het oplossen van echte corporate uitdagingen binnen HR & Finance. Dankzij je consultant-uitstraling en engineering-achtergrond bouw je vertrouwen op bij stakeholders en vertaal je ideeën naar AI-oplossingen die schaalbaar, betrouwbaar en productie-ready zijn — precies waar Corporate Insights & Analytics (CIA) voor staat. Dit breng je mee: Een afgeronde master in AI of Computer Science 2–5 jaar ervaring met AI/ML-oplossingen in productie-omgevingen (bij voorkeur binnen enterprise-domeinen zoals CIA) Consultant mindset of uitstraling: je werkt graag samen met de business om oplossingen te bedenken én te bouwen Sterke software engineering-basis met ervaring in production-grade Python Ervaring met Docker en container-based development Cloud-ervaring, bij voorkeur met Azure Bekend met API-integraties en CI/CD-deployment flows NLP-ervaring of pipelines is een plus Gewend om te schakelen tussen tech- en non-tech-teams, stakeholders te challengen en domein-begrip op te bouwen Jouw kracht in samenwerking: Je denkt vanuit mogelijkheden én concrete oplossingen, niet alleen modellen Je communiceert helder met developers, data scientists en zakelijke stakeholders binnen CIA Je bent analytisch scherp, pragmatisch in je aanpak en technisch sterk in uitvoering Je bouwt connectie met het domein om oplossingen te maken die echt landen Waarom jij bij CIA past: Je bent niet alleen iemand die bouwt — je bent iemand die begrijpt, verbindt, adviseert én realiseert. Binnen Corporate Insights & Analytics (CIA) krijg je de ruimte om jouw expertise om te zetten in AI-services die interne processen verbeteren en meetbare waarde leveren aan de organisatie. Klaar voor impact binnen CIA? Sluit je aan bij ons team en help KPN’s interne dienstverlening AI-Native en toekomstbestendig te maken. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal is vereist voor deze functie/ Proficiency in Dutch (spoken and written) is required for this role. Wat krijg je van ons? Natuurlijk hebben we als werkgever jou ook veel te bieden. Dit krijg je van ons: Een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal maximaal € 5.216- €7.843 afhankelijk van je werkervaring, op basis van 40 uur Vaste 13e maand, een deel krijg je maandelijks uitbetaald en een deel in januari van het volgende jaar. Óf je zet het in voor een FLEX & BOOST doel naar keuze! items.desc: Description du poste Métier METIERS - Data Intitulé du poste Data Scientist H/F Contrat CDI Rémunération (brut/an en €) (hors package social) 35 000-45 000 Votre mission Vos principales missions concernent le périmètre DSF&C (détection, filtrage et profilage LCB-FT), la détection/prévention de la fraude externe et l’accompagnement SSI sur les données. Elles seront les suivantes : Pilotage autonome de la conception, du développement et du réapprentissage de modèles prédictifs Conception, implémentation et documentation complète des modèles (spécifications, jeux de données, pipeline d’entraînement, métriques) Accompagner la mise en place et le suivi opérationnel des modèles en production (monitoring, alerting, reporting) Recalibrage et réentraînement réguliers des modèles en fonction de la dérive des données et des performances Application rigoureuse des méthodologies MRM et IA pour la création, le réapprentissage et le suivi des modèles Participation active à la gouvernance des modèles au sein de la Direction (revues, validations, conformité) Promotion et renforcement de la culture « modèle » auprès des collaborateurs de la Direction et, si nécessaire, plus largement au sein de la DRC Proposition et co-construction de solutions analytiques opérationnelles adaptées aux besoins des métiers Veille technologique et scientifique en data science pour identifier et tester des approches innovantes Veille sur l’architecture SI et les outils Data Science d’Arkea, et collaboration avec les équipes techniques pour leur évolution Assurer, selon les besoins, la fonction de backup Data Scientist pour le département S2D. Vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences Data (ML, statistiques, data engineering…) au service d’un métier central de la banque ? Ce poste est fait pour vous ! Et si c'était vous ? Vous disposez d’une formation Bac+5 en mathématiques & statistiques, en machine learning et I A. Le data Engineering et la programmation (Python, SQL, R…) sont maîtrisés. Vous avez idéalement 2 à 3 ans d'expérience sur un poste similaire. Une connaissance de la banque / finance est la bienvenue. Les compétences techniques attendues : Méthodes d’analyses de données Maîtrise des outils technologiques d’accès aux données, mathématiques et statistiques, machine learning Vous vous reconnaissez également dans ces qualités : rigueur et esprit d’analyse (respect de la méthodologie, performance du modèle, analyse de la gêne client) curiosité pour les métiers de la banque (montée en compétences sur les métiers de la banque sous-jacents à la méthodologie) esprit critique et autonomie (pragmatique pour accompagner la recherche de solutions) capacité d’adaptation (évolution du métier et des technologies). Qui sommes-nous ? Le service Science des Données (S2D) rassemble des Data Scientists au sein de la Direction Sécurité Financière & Cyber (DSF&C) et prend en charge la gestion des modèles prédictifs dédiés aux métiers LCB-FT et LCFE. L’activité de SSI pourra également être explorée en fonction des besoins, notamment sur l’apport méthodologique. Au-delà du périmètre SécuFi&Cyber, le poste s’inscrit dans la Direction des Risques et de la Conformité (DRC) et implique des interactions régulières avec les autres data scientists de la DRC ainsi que des échanges opérationnels avec les MOA Données. Plus précisément, cette équipe a vocation à : concevoir, développer, et suivre les modèles prédictifs, en s’assurant de la bonne mise à jour de la documentation des modèles (spécifications, jeux de données, pipeline d’entraînement, métriques) ; accompagner la mise en place et le suivi opérationnel des modèles en production (monitoring, alerting, reporting) auprès des équipes ASI (Arkea Solution Informatique); s’intégrer dans les méthodologies MRM et IA pour la création, le réapprentissage et le suivi des modèles ; assurer une veille technologique et scientifique en data science pour identifier et tester des approches innovantes. Lieu Le Relecq-Kerhuon Critères candidat Niveau d'études min. requis BAC+5 OU PLUS

items.desc: We’re looking for data scientists who turn ambiguous business questions into models and analyses that actually get used. You’ll frame the problem, wrangle the data, build and validate models, and — just as importantly — explain what the numbers mean to people who don’t speak Python. Your day-to-day will revolve around the classic Python data stack: pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. You’ll also work on modern enterprise data platforms — running notebooks and lakehouse workloads in Microsoft Fabric, building pipelines and operational applications in Palantir Foundry, and deploying analytics on Azure, AWS, or GCP. The science matters, but so does making it work inside a real organization’s data ecosystem. What We Offer AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else. AI Center of Excellence — Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily. Your tools, your choice — Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you. Real project variety — From generative AI for legal document compliance through agentic systems in manufacturing environments to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored. Conference and speaking support — Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better — we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses. Your tasks Translate business problems into analytical solutions: define hypotheses, choose metrics, and select the right modeling approach for the question at hand Explore, clean, and prepare data using Python (pandas, NumPy), working with structured and semi-structured sources of varying quality Build, validate, and tune machine learning models for classification, regression, forecasting, segmentation, and recommendation using scikit-learn, XGBoost, and statsmodels Design and analyze experiments: A/B tests, statistical hypothesis testing, and causal analysis that hold up to scrutiny Work hands-on with enterprise data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric (lakehouses, notebooks, semantic models) and Palantir Foundry (pipelines, ontology, operational workflows) Communicate findings through clear visualizations, dashboards, and narratives tailored to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike Collaborate with data engineers on data availability and quality, and with ML/AI engineers to move models from notebook to production Monitor deployed models for drift and degradation, and own the retraining and improvement cycle Requirements At least 4 years in data science or applied analytics, with models and analyses that made it past the prototype stage Strong Python skills across the standard data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) Solid statistical foundations: hypothesis testing, regression, experimental design, and knowing when a result is real versus noise Knowledge of at least one cloud/data platform and its data science components — Azure (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Machine Learning), AWS (SageMaker), GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML), Snowflake (Snowpark ML, Cortex), Databricks (MLflow, Mosaic AI), or Palantir (Foundry Code Workspaces, Foundry ML, AIP) Ability to communicate analytical results clearly to business stakeholders and influence decisions with data Familiarity with working autonomously while collaborating effectively with data engineers, architects, and product teams Fluent English, both written and spoken Fluent Polish required Residing in Poland required Nice to have Production experience with Microsoft Fabric or Palantir Foundry certification (Foundry Data Engineer / Data Scientist tracks) Experience with time series forecasting, NLP, recommender systems, or exposure to LLM-based workflows Familiarity with MLOps practices: items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Scientist (Time Series Forecasting) based in Estonia. Join a data-driven team developing advanced forecasting solutions that power a live energy trading platform. In this role, you will build and optimize time series models to predict weather conditions, energy market prices, and electricity grid supply and demand. Your work will directly support data-informed trading decisions by transforming analytical models into reliable, production-ready code. You will collaborate in a fully remote, distributed environment where quantitative expertise, technical excellence, and practical problem-solving are highly valued. Leveraging Python, SQL, and modern AI-powered coding tools, you will help bridge the gap between sophisticated forecasting techniques and real-world business applications. This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on data scientist who enjoys solving complex prediction challenges and delivering measurable impact in the evolving energy sector. Accountabilities Time Series Forecasting: Design, develop, and refine forecasting models for weather conditions, energy market prices, and electricity grid supply and demand. Production Model Development: Translate forecasting algorithms and analytical models into robust, scalable, production-ready code that integrates with and powers a live energy trading platform. Data Analysis & Model Optimization: Analyze relevant datasets, identify patterns and trends, and improve forecasting accuracy to support reliable, data-driven trading decisions. AI-Assisted Development: Incorporate agentic coding tools into daily development workflows to accelerate implementation, improve productivity, and support efficient software development. Technical Integration: Work with data pipelines, analytical systems, and production environments to ensure forecasting solutions are reliable, maintainable, and suitable for operational use. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical findings, explain forecasting approaches, and collaborate effectively with distributed teams to align model development with business and platform requirements. Requirements Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or higher in Mathematics, Econometrics, Physics, Engineering, or another closely related quantitative discipline. Professional Experience: At least three years of relevant professional experience in data science, quantitative analysis, forecasting, or a related field. Time Series Forecasting Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing and applying time series forecasting models, with the ability to translate quantitative methods into practical solutions. Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, model development, and production implementation. Experience with Go is considered an advantage. Agentic Coding Tools: Regular, hands-on use of agentic coding tools as part of your daily development workflow, with the ability to integrate AI-assisted techniques effectively into software development. CE QUE NOUS VOUS OFFRONS Une expérience au sein d’un groupe bancaire puissant (nous sommes la 9ème banque mondiale) à la pointe de l’innovation technologique, avec une ambition stratégique 2025-2028 centrée sur la Data et sur l’IA. Une participation directe à des projets stratégiques et innovants avec un fort impact business. Un environnement stimulant, jeune avec des experts IA passionnés.

Kundenselektion für Marketing- und Befragungsaktionen) nutzbar zu machen. Die Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung der auf SAS und Python basierenden, modernen Data Mining Architektur, der vorhandenen Modellierungsstandards und der Reportings zur Unterstützung unseres Innen- und Außendienstes gehören ebenfalls zu deinen Aufgaben. Du erstellst Analysen bezüglich Cross-/Upselling, Stornoprognosen, Kundensegmentierung, Schadenprognose, Zahlungsausfällen und Geomarketing. Dabei werden Daten und Analyseergebnisse von dir visualisiert. Du steuerst hausinterne Projekte von der Analyse-Phase bis zur Umsetzung und Wartung der Analyse-/ und Prognose-Verfahren. Die Unterstützung und Begleitung von Compliance-Themen runden deine Aufgaben ab. items.desc: Management Solutions es una firma internacional de consultoría centrada en el asesoramiento de negocio, finanzas, riesgos, organización, tecnología y procesos, tanto en sus componentes funcionales como en la implantación de sus tecnologías relacionadas. Contamos actualmente con un equipo multidisciplinar (funcional, matemático, técnico y de integración de sistemas) de más de 4.000 profesionales, que desarrolla su actividad a través de 53 oficinas (22 en Europa, 24 en América, 3 en Asia, 2 en África y 2 en Oceanía), desde donde atendemos de manera recurrente a clientes que operan en más de 50 países. Funciones Incorporación e integración en equipos de trabajo realizando funciones de: Tratamiento estadístico de datos (data mining y knowledge discovery). Modelización predictiva mediante técnicas de machine learning y data science. Modelización de eventos temporales (series temporales, modelos ARIMA). Desarrollo de modelos de simulación (Monte Carlo). Revisión y validación de modelos regulatorios en el ámbito financiero. Apoyo quant al negocio : desarrollo de algoritmos, estadística y probabilidad. Proyectos de I+D. Requisitos Recién titulados o estudiantes de último curso de Grado en Matemáticas, Físicas, Estadística, Econometría, Ingeniería u otros estudios con fuerte componente cuantitativo. Sólida trayectoria académica. Dinamismo, madurez, responsabilidad y capacidad de trabajo. Nivel de inglés avanzado. Valorable la realización de estudios específicos de postgrado, en especial Data Science, Finanzas Cuantitativas o similar Manejo avanzado de herramientas informáticas. Valorable conocimiento de técnicas de modelización (logit, GLM, series temporales, árboles de decisión, clustering, etc.), lenguajes de programación estadística (SAS, R, Python, Matlab, etc.) y herramientas y plataformas de big data (Hadoop, MongoDB, Cassandra, Pig, Hive, etc.) Alta capacidad de aprendizaje. Facilidad de integración en equipos multidisciplinares. Ofrecemos Ofrecemos la incorporación a una Firma que ofrece todo lo necesario para el máximo desarrollo profesional Trabajar en los proyectos de consultoría más relevantes del sector; para las mayores compañías, líderes en sus respectivos mercados; junto al top management empresarial, ante sus retos nacionales e internacionales; junto a un extraordinario equipo de profesionales, cuyos valores y cultura corporativa son una referencia en el sector. items.desc: About Please refer to our Notion Job Board for the full job description and priority in your application process! CarbonFarm is creating a sustainable, profitable future for smallholder farmers. We believe in a future where the 1 billion land stewards in this world can live profitably while taking care of the planet. That’s why we are aligning the two: profitability and climate impact. Why CarbonFarm? Impact-focussed company helping to fight climate change Beautiful office spaces in (the very cool) Station F Agile team of brilliant problem solvers International team with international ambitions (22 people, 14 nationalities) Deep-tech startup using modern, cloud-based technologies How To Apply A good CV is a short one (two pages good, one page better) No need to write a cover letter, but you can highlight something from your CV or experience You can send us a couple of examples that best showcase things you’ve done (e.g. links to code, or projects from your studies) Job Description We are searching for a data scientist/engineer who can own technical scientific delivery and communication for customer missions end-to-end , and who can grow into a role combining operations, engineering, and product. CarbonFarm’s work combines remote sensing data, agricultural data and machine learning. We work closely with worldwide customers to turn complex carbon projects into reliable and valuable outcomes, while feeding what we learn back into product and engineering. As a Forward Deployed Engineer you will apply our models to each client project, adapting each time to the reality on the ground. This role sits at the intersection of data science, engineering, and customer delivery operations . You will work closely with operations, engineering, product, and R&D to deploy and adapt CarbonFarm’s technical capabilities. That includes everything from running data pipelines and validating model outputs to shaping requirements and helping identify what should become part of the core product. On the client-facing front, you will be working closely with our Customer Success Managers. They will manage client expectations. You will help translate client needs into technical delivery requirements and intervene in client communication when things get too technical. This is not a consulting role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working directly with data, code, and technical systems, and who can bridge the communication gap between a technical product and the real world in which our clients operate. Preferred Experience What you’ll do Adapt pre-built models and data processing to the idiosyncrasies of each client project Collaborate with the Customer Success Manager to deliver technical results to commercial partners Run and maintain customer mission workflows from data intake to final output Work with Python, SQL, cloud systems and machine-learning pipelines Validate model outputs and investigate issues in data or execution Support reporting and communicating the environmental outcomes for multiple customers in parallel Translate customer needs into actionable technical requirements Identify recurring delivery patterns that should be improved or productised Contribute to product improvements over time as delivery work reveals missing capabilities Leverage AI tooling to drive rapid iteration, with a strong bias for technical accuracy What We’re Looking For 2 years experience in data science or in a similar technical role Masters degree or equivalent in engineering, computer science or similar Excellent communication skills, notably with regards to communicating scientific concepts to non-technical stakeholders Comfortable interpreting technical results in a commercial context Autonomous coding in Python with 2+ years professional experience Ability to understand technical systems end to end, even when not every component is owned directly Comfortable navigating and querying SQL databases 1+ years experience creating or adapting data visualisations in Python or a data visualisation platform (e.g. Superset) Experience working with cloud platforms Experience working with data pipelines Experience applying and adjusting machine-learning models, preferably in a professional context English fluency Paris-based, with the ability to work in person with the team Nice to have Experience with machine-learning pipeline operations, deployment, or monitoring Familiarity with workflow orchestrating tooling such as Airflow or Dagster Remote sensing or earth observation familiarity, notably SAR imagery Familiarity with GIS tools or geospatial software concepts Additional Information Contract Type: Full-Time Location: Paris Experience: > 2 years Occasional remote authorized
