From our Brussels headquarters, we work with private companies, public authorities and other organisations across Belgium and Europe , from long-term transition scenarios through to near-term strategy and change management, combining tailor-made consulting with our own models and off-the-shelf software. Our mission: empower our clients to turn climate ambition into action, towards a sustainable, net-zero society by 2050. (www.climact.com) We're looking for a curious, mission and data-driven Junior Product Developer ready to dive into the heart of the energy and climate transition from day one. What you'll own You'll join our Product development (Prodev) team, who are responsible for building and running state-of-the-art digital tools behind Climact's work : • Sirius , for climate risk analysis • Pathways Explorer , for transition pathways • myClimact , for carbon footprints, action plans and CSRD reporting These tools are used every day by our consultants and by our clients. Working at Climact means real exposure from day 1 and a fast learning curve across the whole portfolio. Concretely, you will: Be the first point of contact for our consultants and analysts when they run into a problem with one of our tools. This is the fastest way to learn the portfolio. Develop and maintain features across our products, with review and feedback on your work. Work with our cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines, and manage our test and production environments. Progressively become a second holder of critical operational knowledge: infrastructure as code, releases, authentication, monitoring. Document and automate what keeps coming back, so that it stops coming back. Contribute to the migration of legacy tools onto our myClimact platform. We work with AI assistants as part of our standard development practice, supported by shared skill libraries, coding conventions and documented deployment procedures. You will use them daily, and help spread these practices to the consulting teams. What you bring A genuine interest in climate and energy issues, and the ability to explain what draws you to them. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 0-3 years of working experience Very good knowledge of Python and data-related libraries (pandas, numpy, …). Comfort reading and understanding existing code, not only writing new code. Familiarity with version control (Git) and agile project management tools (Jira, Odoo). An established practice of AI-assisted development: the ability to frame a problem before producing, and to verify the proposed solution. Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD and cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Terraform). Front-end experience (JavaScript, TypeScript) is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Resourcefulness, and a habit of keeping an eye on how the technology is evolving. Comfort working autonomously on a defined scope, and flagging blockers early rather than late. A service mindset: a significant part of the first months is helping colleagues get unblocked. Curiosity, openness to learning, and adaptability across a broad portfolio of tools. Professional English, and either French or Dutch. What We Offer Full-time or part-time position with a competitive salary package Meaningful work with measurable impact: our clients' decarbonization plans translate into real energy savings, fossil phase-out, and avoided emissions Flexible working arrangements: hybrid, home working, flexible hours Mobility solutions aligned with our sustainability mission A dynamic, collaborative expert team driven by a shared purpose Brussels headquarters with an active and growing client base across Belgium and Europe Flexibility Full time or part time, hybrid or in the office, your choice Impact The opportunity to drive the energy transition in Belgium and beyond Passion The opportunity to join a tight-knit, mission-driven team Fun Great team events and moments to celebrate

items.desc: Agency RAPP Job Function Data and Analytics Job Subfunction Data Science and Analytics Job Description WHO WE ARE We are RAPP – world leaders in activating growth with precision and empathy at scale. As a global, next-generation precision marketing agency we leverage data, creativity, technology, and empathy to foster client growth. We champion individuality in the marketing solutions we create, and in our workplace. We fight for solutions that adapt to the individual’s needs, beliefs, behaviours, and aspirations. We foster an inclusive workplace that values diversity and emphasises personal well-being. DATA ANALYTICS The Data Analytics team at RAPP is a driving force behind the agency's success. Sitting within a wider Marketing Sciences team, we drive value for our clients by delivering work that helps them to market and run their businesses more effectively and efficiently, empowering them to make data-driven decisions that directly impact performance and drive measureable results. THE ROLE As An Analyst, You Will Work On a Specific Client Or Workstream. Initially Under The Supervision Of a More Senior Member Of The Team, You Will Quickly Start To Take Ownership Of Your Own Deliverables. Some Of The Projects And Tasks You May Work On Include Setting up a simple test and learn plan for a client’s marketing and CRM activities Using RAPP’s AI tools to provide clients with insights on what creative elements of a campaign are working, and why Creating a customer profile for a specific audience subset and reporting back to a client Providing post campaign analysis reporting for clients that tell them what elements of a campaign worked and how they should optimise the activity moving forward Supporting the experience strategy team in the creation of a data-driven customer journey Building a KPI tree or measurement framework that tells a client the key metrics they should track and try to move About You You have a working knowledge of SqL and/or Python, and can independently write code to pull data from a cloud environment (AWS/Azure/GCP) You will have experience working agency, consulting or client side with customer- or customer related datasets - think marketing analytics, sales analysis, product analysis, consumer profiling etc). If you don’t have this experience, you have a demonstrable interest in growing your experience in this area and can show how what you’ve done before will help you do this More important than your technical skills and your past experience is your attitude, and what makes you tick. You are curious, ask a lot of questions and are most interested in the “why” of data – what it means, and what clients should do with it. That curiosity extends to a desire to understanding a dataset and not just taking it at face value – you are accurate, detail-oriented and if a piece of data looks wrong, you’ll want to know why that might be. You will want to work independently even if that doesn’t happen on Day 1, and you will have an interest and desire in presenting your findings to the rest of your team and to clients, even if you don’t have much experience of doing that yet. You’ll get a kick working across multiple teams (at a client level and an analytics level), learning from others and sharing things you’ve learned with you About You – Nice To Haves You will likely work across some of the following areas in your RAPP career and experience of any of the below is a plus; if you have experience of none of these things but think you fit the main criteria, we’d still love to hear you. Web and social analytics Dashboarding/visualization Working with cloud environments in an engineering capacity Statistics Marketing orchestration/ad tech tools/stacks (Salesforce/Braze/Adobe/DSPs etc) Basic customer segmentation and modeling Test and learn programmes Campaign analysis Customer journey/experience planning To the extent permissible by local law, Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager. Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice. Link to Recruitment Privacy Notice: https://www.omc.com/privacy-notice/

items.desc: We're hiring someone who loves figuring out how things work, how they could work better, and then actually building the solution. Someone who already spends their spare time playing with LLMs, building little tools and automating annoying tasks. Someone whose first reaction to repetitive work is “couldn't we just automate this?”. Someone with no ego about being wrong, because being wrong fast is how you get right. If that's you, keep reading About the role You'll join our Applied AI team in Lisbon to find problems across the business and build the solutions: automations, AI workflows and lightweight internal tools. Around 75% of your time will be spent building. You'll sit down with teams across the company, understand how they actually work and spot where time is being lost. Then you'll scope something sensible and build it. Today we work a lot with Claude, n8n and AI-assisted coding, but we're deliberately not tied to a stack. Sometimes the answer is an n8n workflow. Sometimes it's a small vibe-coded tool (built quickly, with AI writing most of the code). Sometimes another platform makes more sense. And sometimes the best solution doesn't need AI at all. What you'll actually do Understand how the business really works You'll meet teams across Auto Europe and learn how they actually work, not how the process document says they work. You'll map their processes and find the repetitive work, the bottlenecks and the opportunities. Turn messy problems into something buildable Most problems won't arrive as a clean specification. You'll take loosely defined problems, break them into manageable pieces and scope a sensible solution with the team. Build. A lot. This is where most of your time goes. Automations, AI workflows, lightweight internal tools. You'll use LLMs and AI coding tools to prototype fast and iterate faster. You'll pick the tool that fits the problem, not the other way around. Test it against the real world Real users do unexpected things. You'll test what you build against real scenarios and edge cases, so it holds up on a busy Monday, not just in a demo. Measure what actually changed Shipping isn't the finish line. You'll check whether what you built actually made things better. Time saved. Errors avoided. Work people no longer have to do. If it didn't help, you'll say so and fix it. Grow with a small team We're a small team with a lot of freedom. We find problems across the company, decide what's worth solving, scope the approach together and build. We're learning as we go and shaping our own way of working, not following a rigid playbook. You'll get plenty of support and coaching. And you'll have room to experiment, suggest ideas and increasingly own problems from discovery to delivery. Must have LLMs: used regularly, as part of how you already work Hands-on building: automations, workflows or tools you have made yourself Nice to have (you don't need to tick every box) n8n: a big part of how we automate today Claude: the AI we use most across the team AI coding tools: for prototyping and iterating quickly APIs, webhooks and JSON: the basics of connecting systems together Zendesk SQL or scripting What you bring Curiosity: you are good at figuring things out Structure: you can break a messy problem into manageable pieces Process first: you understand the problem before picking the tool Comfortable with people: you talk to stakeholders and ask lots of questions Initiative: you get moving without waiting for a detailed specification A love of learning: you enjoy trying new tools and experimenting Good judgment: you know when to keep investigating and when to ask for help Strong English, written and spoken

Wil jij niet alleen meedenken over AI, maar ook zelf bouwen aan de oplossingen die collega's dagelijks gebruiken? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Als onze Junior AI Specialist ben je samen met onze AI Specialist Kevin de motor achter technologische vernieuwing binnen de Globen Groep. Je onderzoekt, experimenteert en bouwt: van slimme workflows tot applicaties. Je test nieuwe functionaliteiten binnen bestaande applicaties grondig door, zodat alles wat je oplevert ook echt werkt in de praktijk. Je vertaalt behoeften uit de organisatie naar concrete, werkende oplossingen die werk makkelijker én leuker maken, zonder de persoonlijke touch te verliezen. Wij zijn een creatieve en vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke merken die vooroplopen in hun sector. Technologie en innovatie zitten in ons DNA. We zoeken iemand zoals jij om dat verder te brengen voor onze merken. Dit zijn wij Als Junior AI Specialist werk je niet alleen voor Globen, maar ook voor onze andere bedrijven binnen de Globen Group: KENNISS, CCB en Versado. Globen is een uitzendorganisatie in de groen- en infrabranche, terwijl Versado zich richt op logistiek en productie in Limburg. CCB biedt opleidingen voor de groen-, infra- en bossector voor bedrijven en particulieren. KENNISS is hét leerplatform voor de buitenruimte. Deze bedrijven werken dagelijks samen, verbonden door hun focus op de buitenruimte. Dit ga je doen Zelf (mee)bouwen aan praktische applicaties en tools die processen binnen de Globen Groep slimmer en sneller maken. Introduceren en implementeren van innovatieve AI-tools. Opzetten van (automatische) workflows en integraties, die creativiteit en efficiëntie versterken. Vertalen van behoeften van collega's (bijv. Marketing, recruiters en administratie) naar werkende applicaties en -oplossingen. Testen, bijschaven en doorontwikkelen van gebouwde tools op basis van feedback uit de organisatie. Signaleren van technologische trends en adviseren over kansen voor nieuwe applicaties. Over de werkgever Wat wij bieden Een creatieve functie voor 32 uur per week. Opleidingsmogelijkheden en ruimte voor persoonlijke groei. Een inspirerende werkplek op ons moderne hoofdkantoor in Apeldoorn. Ruimte om te groeien, te leren en te experimenteren. Een werkomgeving waar AI niet nieuw is, maar dagelijkse praktijk. #Jobster

items.desc: A Robert Walters está a recrutar um/a Transformation, Data & AI Analyst para integrar uma empresa de referência. Esta função terá como principal objetivo apoiar a execução de iniciativas de transformação organizacional e digital, com especial enfoque na gestão e governação de dados e na transformação de sistemas de informação. O profissional terá também um papel importante na articulação entre as áreas de negócio e IT, contribuindo para o alinhamento de requisitos, a qualidade da informação e a implementação de soluções que respondam aos objetivos estratégicos da organização. Principais responsabilidades Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a implementação de iniciativas de transformação organizacional e digital; Assegurar a ligação entre as áreas de negócio e IT, promovendo o alinhamento entre requisitos funcionais e soluções técnicas; Participar em projetos de transformação de sistemas de informação, desde a análise e definição de requisitos até à implementação; Apoiar a definição, documentação e monitorização de requisitos funcionais e de dados; Contribuir para o cumprimento de requisitos regulamentares relacionados com a gestão de dados, nomeadamente BCBS 239; Acompanhar o progresso das iniciativas, monitorizando o estado dos projetos, riscos e dependências; Perfil pretendido Mestrado em Matemática, Data Science, Engenharia, Economia, Gestão ou áreas similares; Conhecimentos de gestão de projetos e gestão de dados; Familiaridade com práticas de governação de dados e requisitos regulamentares, nomeadamente BCBS 239, será valorizada; Conhecimentos de Inteligência Artificial e Analytics;

items.desc: Etsimme juuri nyt uutta kollegaa Digialle vahvistamaan asiakastiimejämme älykkään automaation, tekoälyratkaisujen ja järjestelmäintegraatioiden parissa. Business Analystina varmistat, että asiakkaan liiketoiminnallinen ongelma, tavoite ja tavoiteltavat hyödyt ymmärretään ennen teknisen toteutuksen aloittamista. Tehtävässä toimitaan hybridiroolissa ja siinä yhdistyvät liiketoiminta-analyysi, vaatimusmäärittely, palvelumuotoilu, projektityö ja modernien AI-työkalujen hyödyntäminen. Pääset kartoittamaan asiakkaiden liiketoimintaprosesseja, tunnistamaan kehitysmahdollisuuksia sekä muotoilemaan tarpeista toteutuskelpoisia ratkaisuja yhdessä arkkitehtien ja kehitystiimien kanssa. Työlläsi vaikutat siihen, että automaatiota, kielimalleja, integraatioita ja ohjelmistoteknologioita hyödynnetään tarkoituksenmukaisesti ja asiakkaalle syntyy konkreettista liiketoimintahyötyä. Työsi arjessa Arjessasi fasilitoit asiakastyöpajoja ja haastattelet liiketoiminnan asiantuntijoita. Kuvaat prosesseja sekä määrittelet käyttäjätarinoita, hyväksymiskriteerejä ja vaatimuksia kehitystiimin työn tueksi. Tunnistat myös poikkeustilanteita, reunaehtoja, tietovirtoja ja prosessien kriittisiä riippuvuuksia. Toimit tärkeänä linkkinä asiakkaan ja teknisen toteutustiimin välillä. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä muun muassa arkkitehtien, ohjelmistokehittäjien, projektijohdon ja asiakkaan eri sidosryhmien kanssa. Tuet asiakkaita ratkaisujen käyttöönotossa ja muutoksen läpiviennissä sekä autat pitämään projektien tavoitteet, laajuuden ja liiketoimintahyödyt hallinnassa. Hyödynnät generatiivista tekoälyä esimerkiksi analyysissä, määrittelytyössä ja tiedon jäsentämisessä. Työskentelemme hybridimallilla: voit työskennellä kotitoimiston lisäksi Helsingin, Tampereen tai Jyväskylän toimistoillamme. Asiakastyön tarpeiden mukaan tehtävään kuuluu ajoittaista työskentelyä pääkaupunkiseudulla. Millaiseen tiimiin liityt? Liityt Digian Business Automation Solutions -yksikköön, jossa rakennamme liiketoimintakriittisiä ratkaisuja automaation, kielimallien, integraatioiden ja modernien ohjelmistoteknologioiden avulla. Yhteinen tavoitteemme on ratkaista asiakkaiden todellisia liiketoiminnan haasteita teknologian mahdollisuuksia tarkoituksenmukaisesti hyödyntäen. Kulttuurissamme oppiminen, tiedon jakaminen, rohkeus ja ammattiylpeys näkyvät arjen tekoina. Jokainen digialainen on Senior Trainee: opimme jatkuvasti uutta ja jaamme osaamistamme muille. Uskallamme kysyä, haastaa rakentavasti ja kokeilla uusia toimintatapoja – samalla seisomme työmme ja ratkaisujemme laadun takana. Mitä odotamme sinulta? Kokemusta liiketoiminta-analyysistä, vaatimusmäärittelystä tai palvelumuotoilusta ohjelmisto-, automaatio- tai integraatiohankkeissa. Osaamista asiakastyöpajojen fasilitoinnista ja vaativasta sidosryhmäyhteistyöstä. Kykyä laatia käyttäjätarinoita, prosessikuvauksia, vaatimuksia ja hyväksymiskriteerejä. Ymmärrystä liiketoimintaprosesseista sekä järjestelmien välisistä tietovirroista, integraatioista ja sääntöpohjaisesta logiikasta. Kokemusta projektien tai kehityshankkeiden koordinoinnista. Selkeää viestintä- ja yhteistyökykyä sekä sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Oma-aloitteista työotetta ja kokemusta tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä käytännön liiketoimintaongelmien ratkaisemisessa. Eduksi katsomme Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen automaatio- tai AI-ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja käyttöönotosta sekä ChatGPT:n, Clauden, GitHub Copilotin tai vastaavien työkalujen tavoitteellisesta hyödyntämisestä. Arvostamme myös kykyä tunnistaa piileviä riskejä, haastaa oletuksia rakentavasti ja hahmottaa nopeasti asiakkaan ongelman ydin. Mitä tarjoamme sinulle? Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden rakentaa uuden sukupolven AI-avusteisia liiketoimintaratkaisuja ympäristössä, jossa tekoälyn käytännön hyödyntämiseen suhtaudutaan myönteisesti. Saat vastuuta, näkyvän roolin asiakastyössä sekä tueksesi monipuolisen asiantuntijaverkoston. Pääset kehittämään osaamistasi liiketoiminnan, teknologian ja asiakasyhteistyön rajapinnassa sekä vaikuttamaan oman työsi sisältöön. Työsuhde-etuihimme kuuluvat muun muassa vapaa-ajan mökit, kattava sairauskuluvakuutus ja hammashuolto. Tutustu tarkemmin Digiaan, kulttuuriimme ja työsuhde-etuihimme. Palkka tässä tehtävässä on osaamisestasi ja kokemuksestasi riippuen tyypillisesti noin 4 600–5 400 e / kk . Kiinnostuitko? Jos tehtävä herätti kiinnostuksesi, kuulisimme sinusta mielellämme. Sinun ei tarvitse täyttää jokaista kohtaa täydellisesti – kannustamme hakemaan rohkeasti. Hakuaika ja lisätiedot Hakuaika tehtävässä on 25.10.2026 asti. Lisätietoa tehtävästä tarjoaa rekrytoiva esihenkilö Kaisa Laatikainen: kaisa.laatikainen@digia.com.

items.desc: Zakres Odpowiedzialności mapowanie procesów biznesowych oraz identyfikacja dokumentacji tworzonej przez poszczególne komórki organizacyjne, przeprowadzanie wywiadów z pracownikami w celu diagnozy potrzeb i potencjału wdrożeń AI, wsparcie w budowaniu programu Ambasadorów AI i rozwoju społeczności AI w Zrzeszeniu SGB, prototypowanie rozwiązań z wykorzystaniem najnowszych narzędzi AI (generatywna AI, automatyzacja, narzędzia no-code/low-code), wsparcie w zakresie nadzoru nad projektami AI oraz tworzeniu dokumentacji projektowej, udział w tworzeniu agentów/prototypów aplikacji w środowisku Google Cloud Platform (GCP), monitorowanie trendów, nowych narzędzi i najlepszych praktyk w obszarze AI - inspirowanie zespołu i organizacji. Oczekiwania status studenta/studentki uczelni wyższej (preferowane kierunki: informatyka i analityka danych, analityka danych ekonomicznych, informatyka i ekonometria, Przemysł 4.0, zarządzanie lub pokrewne), postawa "AI-native" – biegłe i świadome korzystanie z narzędzi AI w codziennej nauce i pracy (np. Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, ElevenLabs, narzędzia do automatyzacji), umiejętność prowadzenia rozmów, zadawania trafnych pytań i wyciągania wniosków z wywiadów, zdolność analitycznego myślenia, mapowania procesów i syntezy informacji, samodzielność, proaktywność i gotowość do szybkiego uczenia się nowych technologii, umiejętność przygotowywania przejrzystych dokumentów, raportów i prezentacji, gotowość do odbywania stażu w biurze w Poznaniu (ul. Szarych Szeregów 23A), mile widziane: doświadczenie z platformami chmurowymi (GCP, Azure), znajomość Pythona lub narzędzi low-code/no-code. Klauzula informacyjna Administratora danych osobowych Na podstawie Rozporządzenia Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych, dalej: Rozporządzenie) SGB-Bank S.A. przedstawia następujące informacje: Administrator danych SGB-Bank S.A. z siedzibą w Poznaniu, ul. Szarych Szeregów 23a, 60-462 Poznań (zwany dalej „Bankiem”) Dane kontaktowe Z Administratorem można się skontaktować osobiście poprzez adres poczty elektronicznej: [email protected], telefonicznie: 800 888 888 lub 61/ 647 28 46 (z telefonów komórkowych i z zagranicy) pisemnie: ul. Szarych Szeregów 23a, 60-462 Poznań Inspektor Ochrony Danych W SGB-Banku S.A. został wyznaczony Inspektor Ochrony Danych, z którym można się skontaktować pisemnie na adres Administratora lub na adres e-mail: [email protected]. Dane kontaktowe Inspektora Ochrony Danych opublikowane są na stronie www.sgb.pl. Z Inspektorem Ochrony Danych można się kontaktować we wszystkich sprawach dotyczących przetwarzania danych osobowych oraz korzystania z praw przysługujących na mocy Rozporządzenia Kategorie danych Bank przetwarza w szczególności następujące kategorie Pani/Pana danych osobowych: dane identyfikacyjne (np. imię, nazwisko, data urodzenia) dane kontaktowe (np. numer telefonu, adres e-mail) Bank może przetwarzać dane osobowe wykraczające poza katalog danych wskazanych w Kodeksie pracy. Źródło danych Pani/ Pana dane Bank pozyskuje bezpośrednio od Pani/Pana. Cele przetwarzania oraz podstawa prawna przetwarzania Pani/Pana dane osobowe będą przetwarzane przez Bank w celu: realizacji procesu rekrutacji i przyszłych rekrutacji oraz w zakresie przetwarzania danych osobowych wykraczających poza katalog danych wskazanych w Kodeksie pracy, podstawą prawną przetwarzania danych osobowych w tym zakresie jest Pani/Pana zgoda, tj. art. 6 ust. 1 lit. a Rozporządzenia oraz realizacji przez Bank obowiązków prawnych ciążących na Banku, tj. art. 6 ust. 1 lit. c Rozporządzenia w zw. z przepisami Kodeksu pracy Okres Przez Który Dane Będą Przechowywane Bank będzie przechowywał Pani/Pana dane osobowe przez okres niezbędny do realizacji procesu rekrutacji/przez okres niezbędny do realizacji procesu przyszłych rekrutacji, nie dłużej jednak niż przez okres 12 miesięcy. Po zakończeniu rekrutacji Pana dane zostaną usunięte. Prawa osoby, której dane dotyczą Przysługuje Pani/Panu prawo dostępu do Pani/Pana danych osobowych, prawo żądania ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przeniesienia na warunkach wynikających z Rozporządzenia. W zakresie, w jakim podstawą przetwarzania Pani/Pana danych osobowych jest zgoda, ma Pani/Pan prawo wycofania zgody. Wycofanie zgody nie ma wpływu na zgodność przetwarzania, którego dokonano na podstawie zgody przed jej wycofaniem. Przysługuje Pani/Panu również prawo do wniesienia skargi do Prezesa Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych w sytuacji, gdy istnieje podejrzenie, że przetwarzanie Pani/Pana danych osobowych narusza przepisy o ochronie danych osobowych. Informacje o zautomatyzowanym podejmowaniu decyzji Bank nie będzie podejmował decyzji opartych wyłącznie na zautomatyzowanym przetwarzaniu danych osobowych. items.desc: About The Job As a CCP Quantitative Models Analyst Trainee, you will evaluate the risk models used by Central Clearing Counterparties (CCPs) to ensure market stability. You will identify risk factors for Spot/ Futures/ Forwards / Options / Swaps, among many others, compute margin levels using VaR models, and build internal tools to assess market safeguards. This role offers high visibility through direct interaction with CCPs, market forums, and diverse internal stakeholders Your Main Activities Are Monitor and control risk-facing margin algorithms put in place by CCPs, considering its hypotheses, suitability, calibration and performance Understand risk drivers for margin models and their interactions with portfolios and market parameters Implement risk models built by CCPs by means of available information, quantifying errors and their impact Timely delivery of a quantitative assessment on the robustness of the margin models to help Credit Analysts form a holistic opinion regarding the market infrastructure entity and its suitability for BNPP exposure levels Present quantitative assessment at the relevant credit committees that contribute to decisions on the market infrastructure entity Ability to work independently and diligently Continuously monitor the portfolio of counterparties under own responsibility, jointly with Credit Analysts, and detect any quantitative issues that may require a specific review Drive the necessary changes to work towards a more robust risk management platform in the market Ensure that the counterparty data management is conducted well, namely on-boarding, collection of documents, and commensurate limits update Profile And Skills To Success Master’s Degree in Quantitative Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics or Physics Fluency in English Strong and proven analytical skills. Rigorous and reliable. Ability to organize and prioritize high volume workloads. Strong presentation and communication skills (verbal and written). Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Python Programming Skills About The Team Global Markets, the capital markets division of BNP Paribas' Corporate & Institutional Banking, is a powerhouse delivering top-tier solutions across asset classes. Our Portugal Platform (Porto and Lisbon) stands as a major European HUB and a unique player in the country, boasting a wide range of Front Office roles and services – Trading, Sales, Research, Structuring, Quants & Engineering, Business Dev and Support, Marketing & Client Support, Risk Management, Data Analytics and Machine Learning. With rapid growth and ambitions to make a global impact, we offer numerous short and long-term opportunities Get a glimpse into our world- Check out our Global Markets Portugal webpage Why joining BNP Paribas? BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities; Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses; Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate. Our presence in Portugal In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centres providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees; Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard. To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden rakentaa uuden sukupolven AI-avusteisia liiketoimintaratkaisuja ympäristössä, jossa tekoälyn käytännön hyödyntämiseen suhtaudutaan myönteisesti. Työsuhde-etuihimme kuuluvat muun muassa vapaa-ajan mökit, kattava sairauskuluvakuutus ja hammashuolto. Tutustu tarkemmin Digiaan, kulttuuriimme ja työsuhde-etuihimme. items.desc: AI Software Engineer Als AI Software Engineer bij Nmbrs Reporting (voorheen Visionplanner) geef je de toekomst van het Nmbrs Reporting cloud platform vorm voor een grote, enthousiaste groep accountants, administratiekantoren en ondernemers die complexe taken uitvoeren. Met jouw expertise in .NET-development en AI-integratie zorg je voor ijzersterke code en een fantastische gebruikerservaring. Samen met een levendig team van 130 toegewijde collega's bij Nmbrs Reporting (onderdeel van Visma) werk je aan het ontwikkelen van revolutionaire cloudsoftware. Daarbij kijk je verder dan wat er vandaag moet gebeuren en zoek je naar mogelijkheden om het voortouw te nemen in het gebruik van AI binnen ons development-proces en ons team mee te nemen in de razendsnelle AI-revolutie. Time to grow. Time to thrive. Wij zijn Nmbrs. We maken slimme business software die onnodige complexiteit wegneemt voor mkb-ondernemers en de professionals die hen ondersteunen. Nmbrs brengt vier gevestigde productorganisaties samen—Payroll, Accounting, Invoicing en Reporting—met teams in Nederland, Zweden en Portugal. We zijn één merk met een gezamenlijke ambitie, terwijl we blijven werken vanuit de expertise en kracht van onze eigen organisaties. We bundelen onze krachten waar dat logisch is en houden teams, expertise en besluitvorming dicht bij elkaar. Voor deze functie ga je werken bij Nmbrs Reporting (voorheen Visionplanner) in Veenendaal. Je werkt nauw samen met je directe collega’s op deze locatie en bent tegelijkertijd onderdeel van de bredere Nmbrs-organisatie. Jouw impact Je past jouw diepgaande kennis van AI-tools en technieken pragmatisch toe als skill om efficiënter code te schrijven, complexe problemen te analyseren en de kwaliteit van je werk te verhogen. Creëren van de ultieme User Experience voor duizenden gebruikers en oplossingen ontwikkelen voor onze business uitdagingen. Waarborgen van kwaliteit door unit testen, statische code analyse, integratietests, code reviews, coding standards en design patterns. Zorgen dat je op de hoogte blijft van de nieuwste tools, technieken en methodes. Bijdragen aan het technische ontwerp wanneer nodig. Jouw profiel Je bent een absolute expert in het gebruik van AI binnen de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van softwareontwikkeling en je vindt het leuk om dit te delen met collega’s. Minstens 3 jaar ontwikkelervaring met C#, .Net Core, SQL, REST, moderne JavaScript (≥ ES6) en frameworks zoals Angular of React. Ervaring met Scrum/Agile, source control, continuous integration, test-driven development en peer reviews. Je hebt een scherp oog voor kwaliteit en past best practices pragmatisch toe. Duplicaatcode? Daar krijg je acuut jeuk van! Je werkt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband gestructureerd. Je communiceert helder en hebt een goed gevoel voor humor. Beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal. Het is een pré als je kennis hebt van MongoDB, NodeJS. Dit bieden wij Een uitdagende rol voor 32-40 uur per week, met een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.200 en €5.200,- o.b.v. fulltime, 8% vakantietoeslag en 27 vakantiedagen. Wil je er meer? Dan kun je er 5 bijkopen (op basis van 40 uur) plus 1 dag diversiteitsverlof. Collega's die openstaan voor jouw ideeën en waar je mee kunt sparren om de beste oplossingen te vinden. Persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling met een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan. Een informele, open en inspirerende werkomgeving met korte lijnen. Dagelijks een verzorgde lunch op kantoor en altijd vers fruit. Gezellige borrels om successen te vieren met ons team, plus een ontspanningsruimte met onder andere games om even te ontspannen met je collega's. Hybride werken, waarbij je zowel thuis als op kantoor kan werken. Toegang tot het uitgebreide netwerk en expertisecentra van Visma. Klaar om de toekomst van ons cloud platform te bouwen? Solliciteer nu en groei met ons mee! Heb je vragen, neem gerust contact met mij op. We kiezen ervoor om deze werving zelf te doen. We verzoeken bureaus dan ook vriendelijk om geen contact met ons op te nemen

Budete stát mezi IT, daty a byznysem – řešit konkrétní potřeby výroby, skladu, obchodu i vedení a převádět je do funkčních technologických řešení. Zároveň chceme posouvat automatizaci a praktické využití AI. Ne hledat AI jen proto, že je zrovna všude, ale tam, kde může reálně ušetřit práci nebo zlepšit proces. 🟥 Na čem budete pracovat? 📌 Data & SQL SQL dotazy a práce s databázemi správa dat, jejich kvality a řešení datových chyb nastavování datových toků a propojení různých zdrojů tvorba a sjednocování datových standardů a číselníků 📌 Power BI & reporting tvorba reportů, dashboardů a datových modelů napojování ERP, databází a dalších datových zdrojů správa prostředí Power BI Service 📌 ERP & interní systémy správa a další rozvoj ERP a dalších firemních systémů návrh úprav a nových funkcionalit podle potřeb uživatelů komunikace s externími dodavateli a koordinace změn 📌 Automatizace & AI hledání procesů, které lze zjednodušit nebo automatizovat práce s API a skriptováním testování a zavádění smysluplných AI nástrojů do praxe Součástí role je také základní dohled nad firemní IT infrastrukturou ve spolupráci s externími partnery a občasná podpora uživatelů. 📌 Kancelář máme v Olomouci. Dle dohody můžete pracovat nějaké dny z domova. 🟥 Co potřebujete umět? Hledáme někoho, kdo už má pevné technické základy. Od začátku se Vám budou hodit především: ✔ velmi dobrá znalost SQL a databází ✔ zkušenosti s datovými toky, integracemi a kvalitou dat ✔ tvorba reportů, dashboardů a datových modelů ✔ schopnost připojovat a kombinovat různé datové zdroje ✔ základy skriptování a orientace v PowerShellu, API nebo Windows Serveru ✔ analytické uvažování a schopnost přeložit požadavek byznysu do technického řešení ✔ pokročilá angličtina ERP systém ani Power BI nemusíte znát do posledního detailu – specifika našeho prostředí Vás rádi doučíme. Výhodou je zkušenost s ERP ESO9 , výrobním prostředím, automatizací nebo praktickým využíváním AI nástrojů. 🟥 Co za to? Mzda 55 000–75 000 Kč hrubého podle Vašich zkušeností Pružná pracovní doba a možnost home office dle dohody Dovolená 25 dní Prostor ovlivňovat, jak firma pracuje s daty, automatizací a AI Možnost přicházet s vlastními řešeními a také je uvádět do praxe Přátelské prostředí s jasně nastavenými procesy Otevřená komunikace majitelů o výsledcích, plánech a dalším směřování firmy Pracovní poměr uzavíráme nejprve na 1 rok, následně je možné přejít na dobu neurčitou. 🟥 Jak probíhá výběr nových kolegů? Po zaslání životopisu Vás pozveme na osobní setkání, kde probereme Vaše zkušenosti i to, na čem byste u nás pracovali. V případě potřeby následuje druhé kolo pro doladění vzájemných očekávání. Pokud hledáte místo, kde SQL dotaz nekončí v reportu, ale může změnit reálný proces ve firmě , ozvěte se nám. Těšíme se na Vás!

Je werkt dicht op de business en vertaalt concrete gebruikersbehoeften naar software die prettig en goed werkt. Wat een AI Product Builder bij ons is Bij jou zit AI in de manier van bouwen. Je specificeert wat de toepassing moet doen, laat coding agents bouwen en testen en beoordeelt het resultaat. De software die je maakt hoeft zelf geen AI te bevatten. Het kan ook een portal, formulier of workflow zijn die collega’s overzicht geeft en handwerk bespaart. Je begrijpt het werk waarvoor je bouwt. Je maakt bedrijfsregels en uitzonderingen expliciet en kunt beoordelen of de toepassing in de praktijk klopt. Je hoeft geen traditionele software-engineer te zijn, maar hebt voldoende technisch inzicht om verantwoord te bouwen en te herkennen wanneer je hulp nodig hebt. Wat je doet Je bouwt interne toepassingen met coding agents, zoals een productportal of medewerkersportal. Je werkt een concrete gebruikersvraag uit tot duidelijke schermen, bedrijfsregels en acceptatiecriteria. Je laat agents code en tests maken, onderzoekt fouten en beoordeelt de werking. Je test met de collega’s die de toepassing gaan gebruiken en verwerkt hun feedback. Je ontwikkelt bestaande prototypes verder tot toepassingen die een afdeling kan blijven gebruiken. Je werkt binnen afgesproken ontwikkelstandaarden en laat je werk passend reviewen. Je zorgt voor begrijpelijke uitleg en duidelijke afspraken over beheer. Je werkt in korte cycli en laat regelmatig een werkende versie zien. Bij complexe integraties of productiekritische onderdelen werk je samen met engineers. Je blijft betrokken bij de gebruikerservaring en de functionele werking van de toepassing. Functie-eisen Je hebt met AI-agents iets gebouwd dat anderen gebruiken. Coding agents zoals Claude Code, Codex of Cursor zijn onderdeel van je manier van werken. Je kunt gebruikersbehoeften vertalen naar concrete specificaties en testbare afspraken. Je begrijpt de bedrijfsregels, gegevensstromen en toegangsrechten van wat je bouwt. Je kunt gegenereerde code voldoende lezen en onderzoeken om fouten te herkennen en gerichte hulp te vragen. Je hebt oog voor gebruiksgemak en luistert goed naar feedback. Je kunt uitleggen hoe jouw toepassing werkt, zonder dat de gebruiker technische kennis nodig heeft. Voor deze functie is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal vereist. Je achtergrond kan liggen in productmanagement, businessanalyse, operations of softwareontwikkeling. Aantoonbaar eigen werk, oordeelsvermogen en gevoel voor de gebruiker wegen zwaarder dan jaren ervaring als developer. Aanvullende informatie Je team Je werkt in het AI-team en trekt dagelijks op met collega’s uit de business. AI Specialists brengen vakkennis en helpen beoordelen of een toepassing inhoudelijk klopt. AI Engineers bouwen de AI-functionaliteit wanneer die onderdeel is van jouw product. Met IT en engineers werk je samen aan technische standaarden, integraties en beheer. Jouw bijdrage is de werkende interne toepassing: van een heldere specificatie tot software die collega’s kunnen gebruiken. Over Omoda Brands Omoda Brands is het huis achter Assem, Omoda, Wehkamp en Kleertjes.com. Vier merken, ruim 2.000 collega’s en meer dan 3 miljoen klanten per jaar. Onze ambitie is de meest persoonlijke boutique op schaal. Daarvoor moeten ook de hulpmiddelen achter de schermen goed werken: van productinformatie en campagnes tot planning en service. We gebruiken al AI voor stylingadvies, productbeelden en klantvragen. Collega’s bouwen daarnaast zelf tools voor hun dagelijkse werk. Jij helpt zulke toepassingen verder te brengen en bouwt nieuwe producten voor de business. Wat je bij ons vindt Flexibel werken vanuit Zierikzee, Amsterdam of Zwolle. We komen gemiddeld 1 à 2 dagen per week samen op één van deze locaties. 32–38 uur per week, afhankelijk van jouw voorkeur. Een passend salaris op basis van jouw kennis, ervaring en de waarde die je meebrengt. Direct contact met de collega’s voor wie je bouwt. Ruimte om snel werkende software te maken en te verbeteren. AI Specialists en engineers met wie je kunt samenwerken. Vier merken waar bruikbare toepassingen breder ingezet kunnen worden. Een rol waarin praktisch bouwvermogen en businessinzicht samenkomen. Interesse? Laat ons zien wat je met AI-agents hebt gebouwd en hoe je van een gebruikersvraag tot een werkende toepassing kwam. Wat was jouw eigen bijdrage, hoe stuurde je de agents aan en hoe controleerde je het resultaat? Vertel ook wat je aanpaste nadat anderen de toepassing gebruikten. Hoe je dit deelt is aan jou: een korte beschrijving, link, screenshots of demo. Een beknopt voorbeeld is voldoende voor je sollicitatie; in het gesprek gaan we er samen …

items.desc: Forvis Mazars is a leading global professional services network providing audit & assurance, tax, and advisory services. Forvis Mazars in the UK spans 14 offices across the nation and has over 3,400 professionals, with 190 partners. We have a clear purpose and a shared commitment to shape a better future. See how businesses really work and make an impact from day one. Audit is about more than numbers. It's about understanding organisations, building trust in financial information, and helping businesses, investors and communities make informed decisions. You'll work with a diverse range of clients, gain insight into different industries, and develop skills that will benefit you throughout your career. At Forvis Mazars, you'll work towards a professional qualification, learn from experienced professionals, and gain hands-on experience using the latest technology and data-driven tools. With real responsibility, continuous learning, and exposure to a variety of businesses, Audit offers an exciting foundation for a successful career. Achieved or predicted a 2:1 degree classification (or equivalent). We know everyone’s circumstances are different. Love working with data and uncovering insights. Interested in technology, including R, Python, SQL, Power BI and Alteryx. Enjoy solving problems and thinking critically. Innovative and adaptable, always looking for better ways of working. A team player who values integrity, diversity and inclusion. Use technology to solve complex data challenges. Work closely with audit teams and stakeholders, providing updates and delivering high-quality solutions. Support live audit engagements, helping teams use data analytics tools effectively. Build an understanding of client businesses and how data supports audit decision-making. Prepare audit documentation. Develop your knowledge of financial statements, accounting processes and audit requirements. Contribute to audit proposals and business development activities when opportunities arise. Take on increasing responsibility, building technical expertise and strong stakeholder relationships as you progress. Your Development And Benefits You don't need prior audit experience before you join. We'll help you build your knowledge through professional study, hands-on client work and ongoing support from your team. Develop your technical expertise through funded ACA Certificate Level study, with opportunities for further qualifications as your career progresses. Build digital and analytical skills through practical experience with data, technology and innovative audit solutions. Learn in a supportive environment with a dedicated buddy, mentorship and guidance from experienced colleagues. Benefit from structured training through a blend of classroom, virtual and on-the-job learning, alongside dedicated study leave. Apply your learning to real client work, gaining valuable experience from day one. Grow your professional skills through development in client excellence, digital excellence, technical excellence and professional excellence. Receive regular coaching and support to help you build confidence, achieve your goals and reach your full potential. If you're curious, analytical and ready to keep learning, Audit offers the opportunity to develop sought-after skills, work with a diverse range of clients and build your confidence in a career that helps businesses grow, manage risk and maintain trust in financial reporting. At Forvis Mazars diversity, equity and inclusion are central to our values. We value our people's unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experience, and know this diversity create better outcomes for our clients. The next step of your career starts here, where you can bring your own unique mix of skills and perspectives to a fast-growing team. Metyis is a global and forward-thinking firm operating across a wide range of industries, developing and delivering AI & Data, Digital Commerce, Marketing & Design solutions and Advisory services. At Metyis, our long-term partnership model brings long-lasting impact and growth to our business partners and clients through extensive execution capabilities. With our team, you can experience a collaborative environment with highly skilled multidisciplinary experts, where everyone has room to build bigger and bolder ideas. Being part of Metyis means you can speak your mind and be creative with your knowledge. Imagine the things you can achieve with a team that encourages you to be the best version of yourself. We are Metyis. Partners for Impact. What We Offer Interact with senior stakeholders at our clients on regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change. Working with Data Scientists to take data throughout its lifecycle - acquisition, exploration, data cleaning, integration, analysis, interpretation, and visualization. Become part of a fast-growing international and diverse team. What You Will Do Perform data analysis in the field of Growth Revenue Management, Marketing Analytics, CLM/CRM Analytics and/or Risk Analytics. Conduct analyses in typical analytical tools ranging from SAS, SPSS, Eviews, R, Python, SQL, Teradata, Hadoop, Access, Excel, etc. Communicate analyses via compelling presentations. Solve problems, disaggregate issues, develop hypotheses and develop actionable recommendations from data and analysis Prepare and facilitating workshops Manage stakeholders and communicating with executives Coach and mentor team members What You Will Bring 3-5 years of professional work experience in the analytics domain. An advanced degree in a quantitative field (e.g. mathematics, computer programming, etc.). An ability to think analytically, decompose problem sets, develop hypotheses and recommendations from data analysis. Strong technical skills regarding data analysis, statistics, and programming. Strong working knowledge of, Python, Hadoop, SQL, and/or R. Working knowledge of Python data tools (e.g. Jupyter, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, Matplotlib). Ability to talk the language of statistics, finance, and economics a plus. Profound knowledge of the English language. We are united by our differences At Metyis, we are driven by curiosity and collaboration. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) in all its forms as it makes us stronger as an organisation and promotes creativity and innovation. We welcome all talents and are committed to creating a workplace where every employee can make a meaningful impact and grow. Recruitment Disclaimer Metyis only contacts candidates through verified and official channels: LinkedIn (official and verified recruiter profiles), emails ending in @metyis.com, and our Applicant Tracking System (Recruitee). We do not use WhatsApp, social media messaging platforms, or personal accounts for recruitment outreach. If you receive suspicious communication claiming to be from Metyis, please verify the sender and report it through our official website.

items.desc: I am working with a leading Financial Services client that is investing heavily in data and AI, with a particular focus on developing new reporting and analytics capabilities. The role is offering a base of circa £80,000 +excellent benefits, and they operate a remote-first model with occasional travel into the office. The team is developing AI-driven reporting and analytics capabilities using Snowflake, combining data modelling, business intelligence and natural language analytics to make data more accessible across the business. This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how the business uses data, working with modern technologies across BI, data engineering and AI. You will work closely with data engineers, analytical engineers and business stakeholders to build reliable, governed solutions that turn complex data into useful business insight. Experience and skills: Strong experience with Snowflake and modern cloud data platforms Strong SQL skills and experience in data modelling and semantic layers Experience with Power BI or comparable reporting and visualisation tools Experience with dbt or Python for data transformation and development Experience with AI-enabled reporting, natural language analytics or GenAI Strong stakeholder management and communication skills Experience working in fast-paced, forward-thinking organisations. Financial Services experience would be beneficial. The following would also be beneficial: Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Snowflake Intelligence or comparable conversational analytics tools Experience leading technical delivery, developing teams and establishing technical standards and governance Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving the adoption of new technologies The opportunity could suit people with strong BI, reporting or analytics engineering backgrounds who want to develop their expertise in AI, as well as those already working with AI-enabled analytics. If you are an experienced AI Reporting and Analytics professional with the relevant skills and experience, please send an up-to-date copy of your CV in the first instance for review.

Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to launch your career and make an impact on real-world projects from day one? 
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for graduates who want to be part of something extraordinary - shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 We are committed to developing our graduates into leading technical or business professionals, and as such we will also support you through your preferred route for professional development. 
 Our 18-month Graduate Programmes give you the opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects alongside industry leaders. 
On joining, you will receive a starting salary of £34,000 per annum, plus a £1,000 welcome bonus. You’ll also be eligible for a £1,000 exit bonus upon successful completion of the programme. In addition, you may be eligible for a Temporary Accommodation Allowance (TAA), subject to specific criteria. 
 We encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience. 
 We have a fantastic new opportunity for a graduate to join the Advanced Targeting line of business as an Optical Engineer. Your role as a Graduate Optical Engineer will be solve real-world engineering challenges, designing and developing mission-critical solutions that power some of the world’s most advanced defence and security systems under the guidance and support of experienced Optical Engineers. The Graduate programme will offer you 18 months of development, with placements in three phases of the product life cycle. You will learn how to use state-of-the-art tools and technology to explore all aspects of the development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, concept design, and design for manufacture, implementation, test, build and product support. 
 What you’ll do as a Graduate Optical Engineer 
 As a Graduate Optical Engineer, you will manage your own development towards attaining Optical Engineer level through the Graduate Development Scheme over 18 months.
 To achieve this goal, you will be placed in programmes responsible progressing different parts of a product life cycle:
 New product introduction: tasked with learning the core concepts required to increase the manufacturing rate, such as modelling an existing to designs to identify root-cause analysis of observed problems and use of metrology to validate theories.
 Detailed product design: responsible for developing or improving existing designs and supporting the transfer of optical models into a detailed optical and system requirements.
 Novel concepts: to develop technologies both future and improvement of existing products.
 Throughout these placements you will learn skills required to communicate technical concepts across a wide array of disciplines. You will be expected support optical procurement and the wider product team in the creation and changing of drawings, tolerancing and how to develop of experiments to prove capability of your designs. Finally, you will be tasked performing technical reviews to assess the limits on technical capability and for creating and conducting optical tests to lower the technical risks of novel EO-Systems and solutions identified as part of wider technological reviews. 
 What you’ll bring 
 A minimum of a 2:1 master’s degree or a higher, such as a EngD or PhD.
 Relevant experience of photonics, such as summer placements, internships or research projects.
 Experience with technical writing and project planning.
 Strong analytical, modelling skills and laboratory skills.
 Evidence of successfully working in a team.
 Enthusiasm for photonics and an interest in developing your technical capabilities.
 Experience of modelling tools such as Ansys Zemax Optics Studio, Matlab, LabVIEW, and COMSOL (or equivalent) is desirable.
 Security Clearance 
 Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.

 At Leonardo, we’re looking for graduates who want to be part of something extraordinary—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.

 Our Software Engineers have the opportunity to participate in all aspects of the product development, from solution concept through to system integration. 
 Leonardo is an international leader in electronic and information technologies for defence systems, aerospace, data, infrastructures, land security and protection, and sustainable ’smart’ solutions. 
 We want people who are passionate about software development, who want to continuously refine their technical skills and who want to be part of the cutting-edge and vibrant community that is Software Engineering at Leonardo. 
 Our 18-month Engineering Graduate Programme : 
 Our Graduate Programmes give you the opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects alongside industry leaders.

In addition, you may be eligible for a Temporary Accommodation Allowance (TAA), subject to specific criteria.

 As a Graduate Software Engineer you will: 
 Work on real-time projects alongside leading scientists and engineers within a globally renowned company. 
 Have the opportunity to participate in all aspects of the product development, from solution concept through to system integration. 
 Key Responsibility Areas 
 As a Software Engineer you are responsible for creating high quality and robust code, for fully documenting and recording your work products, keeping them under configuration management and providing plans and reports on progress to your supervisor. 
 You will develop practical skills in design techniques for aerospace applications and understanding of key processes and technologies. 
 You will work closely with Software, Systems, Firmware and Electronics Engineers to solve real integration problems on a complex system. There may be opportunities to contribute towards the investigation and analysis of leading edge development methodologies and influence the future path of software development within Leonardo. 
 What we need from you: 
 We are looking for graduates who are enthusiastic about Software design and eager to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. 
 All of our roles require a minimum of a 2:2 Bachelors/Integrated Master’s degree, or (b) a higher degree, such as a MSc or PhD. Relevant subjects include Software Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics or Electronic Engineering. 
 Highly desirable 
 Experience of agile development 
 programming in an object-oriented language such as C++ 
 knowledge of UML (Unified Modelling Language)

 Security Clearance

As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to launch your career and make an impact on real-world projects from day one? 
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for graduates who want to be part of something extraordinary - shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 We are committed to developing our graduates into leading technical or business professionals, and as such we will also support you through your preferred route for professional development. 
 Our structured 18-month Graduate Programme is designed to accelerate your development from graduate to professional engineer. From day one, you'll contribute to real projects, work alongside industry experts, and gain hands-on experience across the full hardware development lifecycle.
 This opportunity is based in Luton , with flexible and hybrid working arrangements available. Occasional travel within the UK and overseas may be required to support technical reviews, trials and customer engagements.
 On joining, you will receive a starting salary of £34,000 per annum, plus a £1,000 welcome bonus. You’ll also be eligible for a £1,000 exit bonus upon successful completion of the programme. In addition, you may be eligible for a Temporary Accommodation Allowance (TAA), subject to specific criteria.
 What You'll Do 
 As part of our Hardware Engineering team, you'll support the development of high-performance electronic hardware used within advanced Electronic Warfare solutions.
 Your activities will include:
 Designing and developing analogue, digital and mixed-signal hardware solutions for a range of defence platforms
 Supporting hardware development activities throughout the engineering lifecycle, from concept and detailed design through to integration, verification and qualification
 Creating circuit designs, schematics and supporting analyses using industry-standard design and simulation tools
 Conducting laboratory testing, debugging and validation using specialist electronic test equipment
 Analysing technical data and presenting findings to engineering teams and stakeholders
 Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across systems, firmware, software, RF and mechanical engineering to integrate hardware solutions into larger products
 Contributing to technical documentation, design reviews and customer deliverables
 Developing an understanding of the complete engineering lifecycle, from concept through to manufacture and in-service support
 What We're Looking For 
 We're looking for curious, motivated graduates with a passion for engineering, problem solving and technology.
 You should have, or be on track to achieve:
 A minimum 2:2 Bachelor's degree, Integrated Master's degree, MSc or PhD in a relevant STEM discipline, such as: Electronic Engineering
 Electrical Engineering
 Robotics Engineering
 AI & Cybernetics
 Physics or Applied Physics
 Engineering Physics
 Mathematics or Applied Mathematics
 Communications Engineering
 Information Engineering
 Space Engineering
 Computer Communication and Networks
 Cyber Security
 Related disciplines
 We'd also like to see:
 An interest in electronic hardware design, circuit development or embedded systems
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 The ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively
 A collaborative approach and willingness to learn from experienced engineers
 Experience of design, simulation, programming or laboratory-based testing gained through university projects, placements or personal interests (desirable, not essential)
 Familiarity with circuit design, schematic capture or simulation tools is beneficial but not essential, as training will be provided
 Our Graduate Programme has been designed to help you build the skills, knowledge and confidence needed to become a future engineering leader.

 At Leonardo, we’re looking for graduates who want to be part of something extraordinary - shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.

 At Leonardo, we develop the advanced technologies that help keep people safe. As a Graduate Firmware Engineer , you'll join a team delivering world-leading Electronic Warfare capabilities that protect fast jets, UAVs, naval vessels and land platforms operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.
 Our structured 18-month Graduate Programme is designed to accelerate your development from graduate to professional engineer. From day one, you'll contribute to real projects, work alongside industry experts, and gain hands-on experience across the full firmware development lifecycle.
 This opportunity is based in Luton , with flexible and hybrid working arrangements available. Occasional travel within the UK and overseas may be required to support technical reviews, trials and customer engagements.
 What You'll Do
 As part of our Firmware Engineering team, you'll support the development of high-performance digital systems used within advanced Electronic Warfare solutions.
 Your activities will include:
 Designing and developing FPGA firmware solutions for complex embedded and real-time systems
 Creating and verifying designs using hardware description languages and industry-standard development tools
 Supporting the development of digital processing technologies used in Electronic Warfare and sensing applications
 Conducting simulation, testing and validation activities to ensure firmware meets functional, timing and performance requirements
 Analysing technical data and presenting findings to engineering teams and stakeholders
 Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across systems, hardware, software and verification engineering to integrate firmware solutions into larger products
 Contributing to technical documentation, design reviews and customer deliverables
 Developing an understanding of the complete engineering lifecycle, from concept through to manufacture and in-service support
 What We're Looking For
 We're looking for curious, motivated graduates with a passion for engineering, problem solving and technology.
 You should have, or be on track to achieve:
 A minimum 2:2 Bachelor's degree, Integrated Master's degree, MSc or PhD in a relevant STEM discipline, such as: Electronic Engineering
 Electrical Engineering
 Computer Engineering
 Robotics Engineering
 AI & Cybernetics
 Communications Engineering
 Information Engineering
 Space Engineering
 Physics or Applied Physics
 Mathematics or Applied Mathematics
 Computer Science
 Cyber Security
 Computer Communication and Networks
 Related disciplines

 An interest in firmware development, FPGA design, embedded systems or digital signal processing
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 The ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively

 · Strong analytical, modelling skills and laboratory skills.
 · Evidence of successfully working in a team.
 · Experience of CAD modelling tools such as PTC Creo or similar parametric modellers are desirable.

 · Computer Aided Mechanical Engineering
 · Aero-Mechanical Engineering

items.desc: Job Description Are you looking for a role where you can combine theoretical computer vision, hardware integration, and robust software development? Trackman is looking for a Computer Vision Engineer to join our Golf Launch Monitor R&D team. You will join the team in building high-precision tracking systems engineered to perform reliably in challenging environments and satisfy the highest requirements of elite athletes. Whether you are a recent graduate or have a couple of years of experience in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded/mechatronics, or related fields, this is an opportunity to build deep technical expertise while working hands-on with some of the most challenging problems in computer vision and sensor technology. Since 2003, Trackman has been on the forefront of sports tracking technology,combining high-speed cameras, radar,and applied physics. Our products are used daily by professional athletes, coaches, club fitters, and broadcasters worldwide. Staying at the forefront requires more than developing new technology. It means continuously improving, testing, and hardening existing systems, so they work flawlessly every single day in real-world conditions. The Role As a Computer Vision Engineer, you will work across the development lifecycle: running feasibility studies on new optical sensors, helping design real-time tracking pipelines, and taking pride in diagnosing, maintaining, and improving products across demanding deployment environment. We are looking for motivated engineers who pair a strong theoretical academic foundation with the practical instinct to roll up their sleeves, diagnose tricky integration bottlenecks, and build technology that works. You will join the Golf Launch Monitors R&D team, a highly skilled, multidisciplinary group of specialists working across computer vision, radar signal processing, mathematical modeling, and software engineering. We are committed to excellence and operate with a first-principles mindset, constantly pushing physical and computational boundaries to ensure our tracking accuracy remains the global benchmark. Key Responsibilities Sensor & Hardware Integration: Evaluate next-generation camera sensors, optical setups, and custom illumination; diagnose hardware/software interface edge cases (e.g., latency, frame drops, synchronization). Algorithm & Pipeline Design: Develop, tune, and profile real-time 2D/3D vision tracking and calibration algorithms capable of handling all kinds of challenging cases. Production Engineering & Maintenance: Write clean, testable C++ and Python code. Maintain, refactor, and harden existing production codebases to ensure long-term stability and high uptime. Field-Data Validation: Analyze real-world datasets collected across challenging environments to identify vulnerabilities, eliminate subtle tracking bugs, and continuously raise tracking accuracy. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, firmware, and QA teams to translate ambiguous physical challenges into reliable, deployable software solutions. Job Requirements Who You Are: You are a recent MSc/PhD graduate or early-career engineer with approximately 0–3 years of experience in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field. You have gained hands-on experience with computer vision, sensors, image processing, You have a strong interest in – areas such as camera sensors, calibration, 3D geometry, feature tracking, or image-processing pipelines. You have gainedexperience in software engineering through professional research, or substantial university projects. You have strong academic or practical skills in C++ and/or Python and care about writing efficient, structured, and maintainable code. You enjoy solving complex technical problems, digging into code and data, and investigating issues until you understand their root cause. You are curious, highly motivated, organized, and comfortable taking ownership in a collaborative and informal engineering environment. Bonus Points For Experience or interest in any of the following is an advantage: High-speed or global-shutter imaging Embedded Linux or RTOS Camera-radar sensor fusion CUDA, SIMD, TensorRT, or similar acceleration technologies Sports technology, biomechanics, or golf tracking The Office We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff. Join the home of a powerful sports …

items.desc: Reaktor is looking for Machine Learning Engineers to join us in Helsinki. Turn proof of concepts and ideas into production-grade AI services. If you are interested in building and deploying bleeding edge machine learning models into production, where they continuously deliver tangible value to our customers, you might just be what we’re looking for. As a Machine Learning Engineer at Reaktor, your job is to turn proof of concepts and ideas into production-grade AI services, help your team succeed, and deliver results. At its core, Reaktor is a technology company that helps ambitious organizations become digital leaders. From premium software development to digital transformation, our global community of experts do it all – here are some of our most recent digital ventures to give you an idea of what that means. Your Daily Tasks Include Working together with the client’s tech and business teams and helping them pick the right technologies suitable for their needs Delivering the client and the team according to the needs of the project Building, deploying, and maintaining ML models that serve users reliably in production day after day. Creating architectures for the continuous gathering of new training data for ML models Building interfaces for delivering the results of ML models to end users Other software development-related tasks, such as debugging, designing, and participating in creating the architecture You enjoy designing scalable machine learning architecture that processes vast quantities of data and delivers refined results to end users. To thrive in this position, you'll need Hands-on experience in continuously developing and deploying machine learning models We don’t have a hard limit on years of experience, but we’ve noticed that these Machine Learning competencies often take 3+ years to accumulate Experience with common tools, libraries, and platforms in the field of machine learning A good grasp of common machine-learning techniques An understanding of infrastructure-as-code practices (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) Cloud development experience (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.) A solid programming foundation (Python required, other languages are a plus, for example, Java, Javascript/Typescript, C++) Experience working on data with SQL You are a software engineer at heart and you don't leave a legacy behind Good communication skills and the ability to work with clients to figure out their data needs Fluency in both English and Finnish is preferable Why join us? For two decades, we’ve been developing qualities and capabilities for adapting, reacting, and supporting change – building Reaktor to hold up in a fast-paced environment while ensuring the well-being of our people. While Working At Reaktor, We’ll Provide You With The ability to impact how you work. Together with the client, your team chooses the approach, technologies, and methodologies you think will work best in any given situation A community with as much support as your heart desires A team that’s not only experienced but considerate as well – they all want you to succeed A sustainable work-life balance and support for your daily life outside of work. (e.g., free moving day, Reaktor car share, sick child care services, office space to use for your private events, etc.) An opportunity to grow as a professional. In addition to the day-to-day work, we offer internal training courses, community events, and 15-minute coffee breaks to discuss hot topics in tech and design A possibility to take part in more extended academy-like studies like Cloud Academy 300+ hobby clubs, from winter swimming and running to knitting and archery, that bring people together outside of (and sometimes inside) office hours. Many of these are supported by Reaktor Check more benefits & perks below Diversity, equity, and inclusion Together, we are committed to making Reaktor an environment that embraces and values all of our employees for the whole of who they are. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply, knowing that studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they fully satisfy all of the requirements. If you're thinking twice about applying for this reason, we invite you to send us your application anyway. You could be just the person we're looking for. Read more about our DEI work here. Interested? Drop us a line – We'll be happy to hear from you!
