items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we need a Data Scientist to join our Anti Fraud Team. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to tackle fraud, one of the most impactful and fast-evolving challenges in insurance. You will do this from a global perspective. In fact, the team is responsible for detecting fraudulent claims across all Prima markets: the UK, Spain and Italy. You’ll collaborate with engineers, claims handlers and business leaders to improve the detection of fraud, directly influencing real-world fraud decisions with impact on the company’s bottom line measured in millions. This is a highly practical area of work where strong business judgment is just as important as technical expertise. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details What You’ll Do Design and improve fraud detection systems that prioritize high-risk claims, optimizing the trade-off between detection accuracy and operational efficiency Collaborate across teams and functions, working closely with fraud analysts, engineers, and product managers Develop deep expertise in fraud dynamics, identifying emerging fraud patterns, understanding how they evolve across the insurance lifecycle, and translating these insights into effective detection and prevention strategies, for example identifying suspicious networks of related claims, synthetic entities, or anomalous behavioral patterns What We’re Looking For Extensive experience (3+ years) in data science or applied machine learning, leading end-to-end initiatives in complex technical domains and delivering measurable business impact Strong analytical and quantitative mindset able to translate data into insights, assess model performance, and guide decision-making with evidence and clarity Structured problem solver skilled at framing ambiguous challenges, defining success metrics, and communicating results to both technical and non-technical audiences Strong Python programming skills, especially in the data domain, and fluent use of Git Knowledge of Spark, SQL or any other data-oriented programming language and proficiency with standard data wrangling and modeling libraries (Pandas, Sklearn, Keras, XGBoost, LightGBM, etc.) Nice-to-Have Experience in analytical fraud detection in the Insurance, Finance or Law Enforcement domain In-depth knowledge of graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) and analytics (NetworkX, GNN) or explainability applied to anomaly detection Knowledge of BI tools (Tableau or similar) €45,000 - €65,000 a year Why you’ll love it here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 💵 Competitive compensation: We offer a performance-based bonus of up to 5% of the fixed salary for this position. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy hybrid working, with a mix of home and office days. Plus, for up to 30 days per year, work from anywhere. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

items.desc: Department The Powertrain Manufacturing Engineering (PTME) Europe team is at the forefront of innovation, dedicated to equipping our manufacturing plants with world-leading systems. We are committed to modernising our business by designing and installing advanced manufacturing solutions that enable our plants to efficiently deliver our diverse portfolio of propulsion systems and cutting-edge battery solutions for vehicles. As manufacturing becomes increasingly connected and data-driven, PTME plays a critical role in combining engineering expertise, advanced analytics and digital technologies to improve quality, productivity, equipment performance and operational excellence across our manufacturing network. To support this mission, we are a travelling department with regular opportunities to work alongside manufacturing plants and suppliers across Ford's global operations. Opportunity As a key member of our PTME team, you will play a crucial role in shaping the future of automotive manufacturing through machine learning, advanced analytics and data-driven decision making. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities, developing analytical solutions and delivering measurable business outcomes across the full project lifecycle. This role offers the unique opportunity to combine technical data science expertise with real-world manufacturing problem solving. You will apply machine learning, statistical modelling and advanced analytics techniques to unlock insights from connected manufacturing data while working alongside a collaborative team of engineers, manufacturing specialists and business stakeholders. PTME is looking for an individual who can help expand the use of data science throughout the organisation. You will collaborate with a team of over 100 manufacturing engineers and must be comfortable working directly with stakeholders both in our Dunton office and at manufacturing facilities. This is not a traditional analytics role focused solely on model development. Successful candidates will be expected to take ownership from problem definition through data acquisition, solution development, deployment support and business adoption. Hybrid Worker (minimum 4 days on-site per week) Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required Your Role Will Develop and Maintain: Build machine learning, statistical and forecasting models to optimise manufacturing processes and extract actionable intelligence from equipment, process and operational data. Design and Build: Create and manage scalable data pipelines using Python and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to ingest, transform and prepare complex manufacturing data for analysis and deployment. Interface and Translate: Work directly with internal and external stakeholders to translate manufacturing and business challenges into structured analytical frameworks and data-driven solutions. Facilitate: Act as a strong facilitator to gather requirements, manage stakeholder expectations, validate analytical outputs and support organisational adoption of analytical solutions. Standardise: Perform data reconciliation, cleansing and standardisation across diverse manufacturing systems to ensure high data quality, consistency and analytical integrity. Support Launches: Provide technical assistance and data-driven insight during the launch of new manufacturing processes, equipment and programmes. Communicate: Present analytical findings and actionable recommendations clearly, adapting communication styles for both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborate: Work closely with innovation, software, data engineering and enterprise data teams to ensure analytical solutions are scalable, deployable and aligned with broader technology strategies. Mentor and Document: Teach, coach and mentor peers while documenting technical knowledge, analytical approaches and best practices to support long-term capability growth. Drive Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, technical excellence and data-driven decision making. On-Site Execution: Travel to Ford manufacturing plants and supplier locations globally, as required by project and programme needs, to understand operational challenges, support implementations and collaborate directly with on-site teams. Experience and skills for being effective in the role are: Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, machine learning and statistical modelling (e.g. pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn), alongside familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, preferably Google Cloud. Analytical Modelling: Proven experience developing analytical, statistical or machine learning solutions within complex operational environments, coupled with a strong desire to continuously improve model performance, data quality and business outcomes. items.desc: Position: Machine Learning Engineer Department: Estimations Reporting to: Data Science Manager Location: Berlin Hybrid role: 3 days a week from our London office & 2 days working from home Full/Part time: Full time Ready for a challenge? Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We're a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it's a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe. About This Role We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with passion for using machine learning to create intelligent applications. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will be part of the Data Science team inside the Product and Tech group with +2200 brilliant developers, engineers, analysts and researchers. You will work with brilliant people with world class knowledge, and a passion for sharing knowledge and solving interesting and complex problems. You will collaboratively design, build, and productionize machine learning systems. As a member of the logistics data science team, you will develop solutions to supply and demand challenges while optimizing logistics algorithms to ensure a reliable, efficient, and profitable service. From predicting ETAs to solving pricing problems, our ML pipelines form the backbone of our delivery operations. These are some of the key components to the role: Researching, implementing, and deploying innovative ML techniques applicable to logistics problems. Scaling and transferring novel machine learning solutions to improve our decision making processes and solutions in their different product use cases. Implementing and launching Data Science applications that coordinate with front facing solutions; constant improvements using performant and efficient ML models. Implementing tools, data pipelines, and evaluation frameworks to enable development, iteration, and launch of ML ideas within the product scope. What will you bring to the team? Strong experience in Machine Learning, developing real time data streaming technologies for forecast or logistics products. Strong coding and software engineering skills in Python. Able to work independently and solve complex problems, with a demonstrated ability to productise and deploy using cloud services (e.g. Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform). Strong background in working with microservices and event-driven architecture, serverless computing, and cloud architecture patterns. Familiarity with tools and packages including Kubernetes (deployment in production) is expected. A plus would be additional experience with Airflow/Mlflow/Docker/Flink. Experience collaborating closely with multi-functional teams, driving forward best practices. Real-time production systems at scale (millions of requests/transactions per day) is desirable. At JET, This Is How We Play Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side. At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again. Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition. Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day. What else are we delivering? Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys. Are you ready to join the team? Apply now!

items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth. As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details. What You’ll Do Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making; Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers; Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights. What We’re Looking For Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics; Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems; Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Nice-to-Have Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas; Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python; Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets. €38,000 - €75,000 a year Please note: this is the same position as the one referred as “Data Scientist” on our career site, posted with different job titles to reach STEM students and graduates who might not know a Data Scientist role suits them. Why you'll love it here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 💵 Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from €38k up to €75k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

items.desc: Hello. We’re Teya. Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better. They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business. Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work. We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand. If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you Data Scientist Your Mission We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Credit & Analytics team at Teya and help build the models that underpin our lending products. You will support the development of the credit risk and pricing models that help us make better decisions for the small businesses we serve across multiple geographies. You will work across the model lifecycle, from data exploration and feature development through to deployment and performance monitoring. Working alongside senior data scientists, you will learn how to develop models in a statistically sound way and see first-hand how they shape credit decisions, pricing and portfolio performance. You will collaborate with Credit Strategy, Analytics, Product, Engineering and Data Engineering, building your understanding of how data science creates real business value. From day one, your work will contribute to live products used by our Members. This is an excellent opportunity for someone at the start of their data science career, with a strong quantitative background and a genuine interest in credit and lending, who wants to learn fast in a high-growth fintech. Responsibilities Model development: Build and test components of credit risk and pricing models, under guidance from senior team members. Data exploration: Explore internal and external data sources, clean and prepare real-world datasets, and engineer features that could improve our models. Analysis: Carry out analysis of merchant behaviour, repayment performance and product performance to answer well-defined business questions. Model monitoring: Help track model performance, flag changes or drift, and support investigations into what is driving them. Model deployment: Support Data Engineering with deploying models onto the ML Platform and integrating them into the credit decisioning system. Documentation: Document your work clearly so models and analysis are easy to understand, review and build on. Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Engineering and Credit Strategy, and actively seek feedback from senior data scientists to develop your technical and commercial skills. Requirements 0–2 years' experience in data science, quantitative analysis or a related field. Degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline. Solid grounding in statistics and an understanding of core machine learning techniques. Working knowledge of Python and SQL, with experience handling and analysing real-world datasets. Ability to explain analytical work clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Curious, pragmatic and commercially minded, with a desire to understand how models drive business outcomes. Eagerness to learn, take on feedback and grow within a collaborative team. Exposure to credit risk modelling or financial services is a plus. The Perks We trust you, so we offer flexible working hours, as long as it suits both you and your team. Physical and mental health support through our partnership with WellHub, giving free access to over 1,500 gyms in the UK, 1-1 therapy, meditation sessions, and digital fitness and nutrition apps. Our company offers extended and improved maternity and paternity leave choices, giving employees more flexibility and support. Cycle-to-Work Scheme. Health and Life Insurance. Pension Scheme. 25 days of Annual Leave (plus Bank Holidays). Office snacks every day. Friendly, comfortable, and informal office environment in Central London. Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process …

items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth. As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details. What You’ll Do Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making; Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers; Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights. What We’re Looking For Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics; Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems; Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Nice-to-Have Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas; Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python; Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets. £80,000 - £160,000 a year Please note: this is the same position as the one referred as “Data Scientist” on our career site, posted with different job titles to reach STEM students and graduates who might not know a Data Scientist role suits them. Why you'll love it here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 💵 Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from £80k up to £160k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

items.desc: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. Stockholm | Full-time | Onsite, five days a week The team AI Enablement makes Legora AI-native by default. We work across three streams in parallel: building internal agents and tools, equipping teams to build their own, and owning the standards, access and guardrails that let everyone move fast safely. We own the AI platforms and the internal products built on them. So far that includes Leya, an internal knowledge agent live in Slack that answers questions about Legora with cited sources and automates parts of our RFP and security questionnaire work. A structured, agent-readable knowledge base assembled from knowledge each domain continues to own, where agents propose changes and humans approve them. Leyf, a platform for internally built apps that lands anyone's app on shared infrastructure with guardrails scaled to how much damage it could do. And a Skills Hub, so that something one person works out becomes something the whole company can use rather than staying on their laptop. The team is small and the mandate is large. That is the job. What makes this hard Legora is an AI company of around a thousand people, most already fluent and on current tools. Internal AI here is not an adoption problem. Nobody needs convincing, which means there is nowhere to hide behind change management or training. If something we build is not used, it is because it was not good enough. Our colleagues know what good looks like and will not use something worse than what they think they could build themselves in an afternoon. So we ship things people genuinely want, and the foundations arrive with them. That constraint does not go away. The mandate is also larger than the team. The part no individual can do for themselves is the infrastructure, the access model and the architecture underneath, and getting that right across a company this size is the actual work. It does not come with a specification. What you will do You will take broad ownership of how AI works inside Legora and of the platforms we build to make it work. Build internal agents, tools and platforms, and treat them as products rather than projects. Quality, reliability and whether they actually serve the business are yours, not someone else's Take a broad goal, work out what is actually required, and break it into the work yourself Own what you build end to end, from the architecture through to whether people use it and it holds up in production Shape what we should build and in what order, and argue for it Design the foundations: knowledge architecture, access and permissions, evaluation and monitoring, the guardrails that scale with risk Work directly with the people who will use what you build, across the whole company, including the parts furthest from engineering Who we are looking for Strong engineering fundamentals. You build production systems, not prototypes that need someone else to finish them Real depth with LLM-based systems. Agents, retrieval, evaluation, tool use. You know where these systems break and you design for it Ownership by instinct. You do not wait for a specification. When the requirement is unclear or wrong, you say so and propose something better Three kinds of understanding at once. Technical, domain and business. You can hold a conversation about architecture and a conversation about what the business actually needs, and connect them Openness. You take feedback, build on other people's ideas, change your mind when the evidence moves, and push for the strongest outcome rather than the one you proposed first Comfort with ambiguity. New team, fast growth, decisions that get revisited as we learn. That should sound …

Apply appropriate techniques for outliers, missing values, and exploratory data analysis to create data structures relevant to logistics problems. Production Standards: Apply engineering practices to your work — intermediate-level source code, unit tests, version control. Be mindful of production environment rules and help monitor predictive performance of models. What will you bring to the team? items.desc: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy’s AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. items.desc: AI Engineer-AI, Software & Business Impact (Amsterdam) Voor een Nederlandse private equity-investeerder zoeken we een AI Manager die kansen ziet, oplossingen bouwt en bedrijven helpt groeien met AI en software. De investeerder heeft een portfolio van mkb-bedrijven in onder andere industrie, technische dienstverlening, handel en bouw & infra. Je werkt niet aan theoretische AI-strategieën, maar aan oplossingen die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt en waarde toevoegen aan de business. Jouw rol Je werkt samen met verschillende bedrijven binnen het portfolio en krijgt de vrijheid om zelf te bepalen waar AI de meeste impact kan maken. Denk aan het automatiseren van repetitieve werkzaamheden, het ontwikkelen van AI-agents of het bouwen van applicaties die processen slimmer en efficiënter maken. Concreet ga je: Bedrijfsprocessen analyseren en kansen voor AI en automatisering identificeren. AI-agents, LLM-workflows en softwareoplossingen ontwikkelen en implementeren. Schakelen met directies, medewerkers en het investeringsteam om de juiste prioriteiten te bepalen. Zelfstandig projecten van idee tot werkende oplossing brengen. Op termijn mogelijk een eigen team opbouwen en externe specialisten aansturen. Wie ben jij? Je bent een technische bouwer met een ondernemende mindset. Je vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken te doorgronden, zelf software te ontwikkelen en direct resultaat te zien van je werk. Een sterke basis in softwareontwikkeling en praktische ervaring met AI. Ervaring met API's, applicaties, data, LLM's en AI-agents. Kennis van procesautomatisering en het integreren van AI in bestaande workflows. Het vermogen om technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete businesswaarde. Zelfstandigheid, analytisch vermogen en een hands-on mentaliteit. Benefits: -Salaris: 100k -Onbepaalde tijd contract; -Winstdeling; -Pensioen: Interesse? items.desc: What if you could help build AI capabilities that don't belong to just one product – but become part of how an entire product ecosystem evolves? At Assessio, our vision is Zero Talent Waste . We help organisations make fairer, more objective people decisions through science, technology and data – creating better outcomes for businesses while helping more people reach their full potential. We've now created a dedicated AI Squad to build AI-powered capabilities and shared services across our products, including pre- and post-hiring. Some of what we're building doesn't exist yet. The problems are real, but the technical solutions aren't always predefined. That's where you come in. About The Role As an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer in our AI Squad , you'll work across product, technology and codebases to turn ideas and business needs into scalable, production-ready solutions. You'll work closely with Product from discovery onwards – understanding the problem, challenging assumptions, identifying technical risks and helping decide how we should build the solution. You'll contribute across the stack, with a strong focus on backend services, APIs, data and system design. And while AI is central to the squad, you don't need to be an AI specialist . We're looking for a strong software engineer who already uses AI in their development work and is curious about what it can enable. What You'll Be Working On Designing and building backend services, APIs, frontend interfaces and integrations. Building AI-powered capabilities and shared services that can support multiple products. Taking solutions from discovery and technical design through implementation and production. Challenging solutions, identifying risks and making pragmatic technical trade-offs. Exploring unfamiliar technologies and codebases rather than staying within one preferred stack. Deploying, monitoring and improving production systems with reliability and maintainability in mind. Using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve how you develop, test and solve problems. Contributing to architecture decisions and engineering practices. Who are you? You're an experienced software engineer who is comfortable taking ownership of complex technical problems and making sound engineering decisions without needing the path to be predefined. You enjoy understanding why something should be built before deciding how to build it. You probably have technologies you know particularly well, but you don't define yourself by one language or framework. You're curious about unfamiliar systems, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to learn when the problem takes you outside your usual stack. Most importantly, you take ownership. You don't just execute tickets – you explore problems, propose solutions and take responsibility for getting them into production. We believe you have Strong software engineering fundamentals and the technical judgement to apply them across different languages, frameworks and architectural contexts. Genuine Full Stack experience across backend and frontend development. Strong backend, API and data experience, combined with solid system design thinking. Worked with AI-assisted development workflows and tooling. Experience building and maintaining software in production. The ability to learn new technologies and navigate unfamiliar codebases. A product mindset and pragmatic approach to technical decision-making. Good communication skills and excellent written and spoken English and Estonian. Experience with shared services, platform architecture or scaling SaaS applications. Worked with cloud environments, CI/CD, automated testing and observability. An understanding of security, privacy or compliance in software development. Why this role? You'll join a relatively new squad with the opportunity to influence both what we build and how we build it. You'll help create capabilities from scratch that can eventually be used across different products and technologies, while becoming part of our growing Tallinn office and collaborating with colleagues across Engineering, Product and the wider Assessio Group. Ein wesentlicher Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe ist die Mitgestaltung einer modernen AI-Plattform, deren Architektur, technologische Standards und Betriebsmodell aktuell entstehen. Du bringst Deine Ideen in technische Entscheidungen ein, unterstützt bei der Auswahl geeigneter Technologien und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team nachhaltige Lösungsansätze. Du entwickelst, erweiterst und betreibst Backend-Services, Schnittstellen, Integrationskomponenten und gegebenenfalls Frontend- oder UI-Anpassungen. Dazu gehört auch die Anbindung interner und externer Systeme, Datenquellen, APIs und Services, um durchgängige digitale Prozesse innerhalb der Inbound-Logistik zu ermöglichen. Im AI-Kontext konzipierst und implementierst Du Lösungen auf Basis moderner Large Language Models (LLM), Agenten und Retrieval-gestützter Systeme. items.card: The role has three equally weighted objectives: make K3 more efficient; create new or better value for clients; and improve colleagues' working lives by removing repetitive, low-value work. It sits at the intersection of three things that must move together - the Group AI & Data Strategy, the pace the business wants to move at and the obligations (cyber, data and regulatory) K3 already carries as a professional
items.desc: The AI Adoption Partner is a hands-on AI delivery role where progress is measured in hours and days, not months and years. Our AI is delivered through a defined, sanctioned toolset and inside a clear governance envelope, not through open experimentation with whatever tool is fastest to hand. Embedded in the business rather than in IT, each AI Adoption Partner finds where AI genuinely moves the needle for their cluster, builds it using internal and external tools and makes sure it is adopted, measured and where it works, spread to the rest of the Group. The role has three equally weighted objectives: make K3 more efficient; create new or better value for clients; and improve colleagues' working lives by removing repetitive, low-value work. It sits at the intersection of three things that must move together - the Group AI & Data Strategy, the pace the business wants to move at and the obligations (cyber, data and regulatory) K3 already carries as a professional services group. Why this role is different This is a live build role inside a Group that has already done the strategic groundwork: an approved AI assistant (Aimee), an approved no-code build environment (Claude Artifacts), a Group AI & Data Strategy and a Cyber Security Strategy already in flight. The AI Adoption Partner does not start from a blank page, they start from a governed platform and a live strategic portfolio, and their job is to turn that into delivered, measured value inside their cluster. Success is tangible and is tracked centrally: time released, stronger client outcomes, new revenue, reduced risk, and a measurably better colleague experience. Operating Boundaries — What “responsible And Fast” Means Here Speed in this role comes from working inside a known toolset and a known governance model, not around one. Every AI Adoption Partner works within: Approved toolset only: Aimee and Claude Artifacts. No shadow AI, personal AI accounts, or unapproved frontier-model access. K3's AI Policy and “Golden Rule,” data protection obligations and professional / client confidentiality duties, applied from the first prototype not at go-live. EU AI Act obligations relevant to K3's dual provider / deployer status, including mandatory risk-tiering of any new use case before it touches live client or candidate data. Cost governance: all model usage routed and monitored under the Group's model-routing policy. Person specification Essential Proven use of AI and generative AI to deliver measurable business outcomes, ideally including a named conversational AI assistant and a no-code AI build tool (e.g. a Copilot-class assistant, Claude Artifacts/similar). End-to-end delivery experience: problem definition, prototyping, rollout and adoption. Able to understand a business problem quickly and turn it into a working solution at pace, inside a defined toolset. Sound working knowledge of data protection, client confidentiality and responsible AI in a professional or regulated environment; able to apply a risk-tiering process without being told each time. Clear communicator, credible with partners, fee-earners and support teams alike. Curious and adaptable, willing to challenge established ways of working while maintaining trust, professional judgement and toolset discipline. Desirable Professional services or regulated-advisory experience. Change, product, process-mapping or lean delivery experience. With over 1,200 employees across the Group, 25 offices in the UK, and international bases in Malaysia and Cyprus

items.desc: Overview Join a fast-paced, high-impact team at the forefront of developer productivity and AI integration. As a Software Engineer in the DevDiv division, you’ll help create the next generation of development tools that empower millions of developers to bring their ideas to life more quickly and intuitively. We’re looking for engineers who share our belief that AI will fundamentally transform software development and who are eager to help shape that future. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, engage with the open-source community, and contribute to platforms that redefine how developers build, debug, and ship software. Our work spans from high-level developer experience to deep technical systems that require a strong understanding of low-level programming concepts such as memory management, performance optimization, and system architecture. We value engineers who enjoy digging into the fundamentals, whether it’s understanding how compilers work, optimizing runtime performance, or building scalable, efficient services from the ground up. At DevDiv, we foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement. We build tools that help developers work smarter, and we use the same tools ourselves to constantly improve how we build software. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong software engineering skills with a passion for low-level technologies and a desire to use AI to enhance development workflows. Responsibilities Design and develop robust, scalable, and maintainable software components that power modern developer tools. Leverage AI-powered technologies (e.g., GitHub Copilot, LLM-based code tools) to accelerate engineering workflows and contribute to the development of AI-assisted features. Dogfood internal AI tools and platforms, providing feedback and insights to improve usability, reliability, and effectiveness. Collaborate with engineers across product teams and the open-source community to co-design and iterate on developer experiences. Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and agile ceremonies, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning. Research and experiment with emerging AI techniques and integrate them into everyday engineering practices to boost productivity. Qualifications Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Solid programming skills in one or more of the following languages: C#, Java, C++, or Python. Passion for developer experience and an eagerness to understand what makes great tools. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across diverse, distributed teams. items.desc: L'entreprise Vous cherchez à développer vos talents en Cornouaille ? CORNOUALIA , c'est 25 ans d'expertise dans le recrutement et l'accompagnement de collaborateurs à temps partagé. Pour vous, un emploi construit sur mesure, ajustable et personnalisé par nos équipes: UN seul contrat et de nombreux avantages! 1 employeur, des entreprises, 1 CDI ! Chef de projet: Transition IA Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de projet intégration IA et transformation des processus métiers à temps partagé capable de faire le lien entre les besoins opérationnels, les possibilités offertes par l’IA et les enjeux humains de la transformation. Vous partirez du terrain pour comprendre les processus, identifier les tâches pouvant être simplifiées ou automatisées, faire émerger les cas d’usage les plus pertinents et accompagner leur mise en œuvre auprès des entreprises désireuses de s'approprier de maniere sécurisé la puissance de l'IA. Agents IA, automatisations, solutions no-code ou low-code, conduite du changement : vous transformerez les idées en solutions concrètes, utiles et mesurables, en collaboration avec les métiers, le SI, la direction et les partenaires techniques et vous les mettrez en place. Si vous souhaitez contribuer à une transformation numérique ambitieuse, responsable et ancrée dans les réalités du terrain, ce poste vous donnera l’occasion d’en être l’un des acteurs clés. A ce titre, vous accompagnez les entreprises adhérentes de Cornoualia pour: 2. Analyser et transformer les processus métiers 3. Qualifier et prioriser les cas d’usage IA 4. Concevoir et intégrer des solutions IA 5. Animer et accompagner l’adoption 6. Contribuer à la gouvernance et à la maîtrise des risques Construire et piloter la feuille de route numérique et IA Formaliser le plan de déploiement numérique et IA. Définir les priorités, les jalons, les responsabilités et les modalités de gouvernance. Définir des indicateurs permettant de mesurer la valeur créée, l’adoption et la qualité des solutions. Cartographier les processus, les flux d’information et les outils utilisés. Identifier les tâches répétitives, chronophages ou à faible valeur ajoutée. Repérer les opportunités de simplification, d’automatisation et d’intégration de l’IA quand nécéssaires, receuillir les besoins métiers Évaluer chaque cas d’usage selon sa valeur, sa faisabilité, son coût, ses risques et son niveau de maturité. Constituer et piloter un portefeuille de projets IA et automatisation. Identifier les projets pouvant faire l’objet d’une expérimentation rapide. Éviter les projets centrés sur l’outil sans bénéfice métier clairement défini. Traduire les besoins métiers en scénarios fonctionnels. Concevoir ou superviser des assistants, agents IA et workflows automatisés. Définir les données, les consignes, les règles de gestion, les connexions aux outils et les étapes de validation humaine. Réaliser ou faire réaliser des prototypes. Organiser les tests avec les utilisateurs. Piloter le passage du prototype à une solution réellement intégrée aux processus de l’entreprise. Développer l’acculturation aux usages de l’IA, notamment autour de Copilot et des autres outils retenus. Créer des supports, guides et méthodes d’utilisation. Suivre l’adoption et accompagner la levée des résistances. Participer à la diffusion et à l’application de la Charte IA. Intégrer les exigences liées à la confidentialité, à la protection des données et à la cybersécurité. Contribuer au volet sensibilisation de NIS2. Mettre en place des règles de contrôle, de traçabilité et de validation humaine. Veiller à la fiabilité des solutions et à la maîtrise des risques liés aux usages de l’IA. Assurer la documentation, le transfert de compétences et la pérennité des solutions. Profil recherché Nous recherchons un profil curieux, pragmatique et fédérateur, capable de dialoguer aussi bien avec les équipes opérationnelles qu’avec le CODIR. Un profil qui sait que la réussite d’un projet IA ne dépend pas seulement de la technologie, mais aussi de sa pertinence métier, de sa fiabilité et de son appropriation en interne. expérience en transformation numérique, amélioration des processus ou gestion de projets transverses ; maîtrise du recueil et de la formalisation des besoins métiers ; compréhension opérationnelle de l’IA générative, des agents IA et de l’automatisation ; capacité à concevoir ou superviser un prototype ; connaissance des outils no-code ou low-code, des API et des mécanismes d’intégration est un plus important sens pédagogique et capacité à rendre les sujets techniques accessibles ; compréhension des enjeux de gouvernance, de sécurité et de protection des données.

items.desc: Bouw mee aan de marketingmotor van Artura Stel je voor: een sterk product, tevreden klanten en een markt die er klaar voor is. Alleen weten nog te weinig mensen dat we bestaan. Daar kom jij in beeld. Over Artura Bij Artura geloven we dat system integrators beter verdienen dan versnipperde tools en eindeloos zoeken naar de juiste informatie. Daarom bouwen we één platform waarin systeemontwerp, engineering, productbeheer en projectinformatie samenkomen. Ons product werkt en onze klanten merken het verschil. Nu willen we dat verhaal bij veel meer mensen krijgen. We staan aan het begin van een groeispurt en zoeken iemand die die groei mee in gang zet. Waarom deze rol bijzonder is. Je stapt niet in een bestaande marketingafdeling met vaste processen. Je begint met een wit blad en de vrijheid om het goed te doen. Als Founding Marketeer bouw je onze marketing vanaf de basis op. Niet als een reeks losse campagnes of posts, maar als een slimme groeimotor die steeds meer zelf draait. Je bent architect en bouwer tegelijk: je bedenkt de strategie en je zet hem ook zelf om in de praktijk. AI is daarbij geen hype maar een echte hefboom. Wij moedigen je aan om te experimenteren, te automatiseren en met een klein team een grote impact te maken. Waar je mee aan de slag gaat Strategie & positionering : samen met ons scherp krijgen wie we zijn, voor wie we het doen en waarom dat ertoe doet. Content & thought leadership : verhalen vertellen die onze doelgroep echt verder helpen. Growth marketing & leadgeneratie : de juiste mensen bereiken en interesse omzetten in gesprekken. AI & marketingautomatisering : terugkerend werk slim automatiseren, zodat jij tijd overhoudt voor wat telt. Data & optimalisatie : meten, leren, bijsturen en een aanpak bouwen die beter wordt naarmate we groeien. Je hoeft dit niet allemaal al op dag één te beheersen. Belangrijker is dat je de mogelijkheden ziet, ze graag uitprobeert en ideeën echt laat werken. Herken je jezelf? Je krijgt energie van iets opbouwen en ziet kansen waar anderen vooral werk zien. Je denkt strategisch én doet het zelf : een plan uitwerken, een artikel schrijven of een automatisering opzetten voelt allemaal natuurlijk aan. AI hoort bij je dagelijkse werk. Je volgt nieuwe tools op de voet en zoekt altijd naar slimmere manieren. Je denkt in systemen en ziet hoe processen elkaar versterken. Je bent ondernemend , neemt initiatief en voelt je thuis als nog niet alles vastligt. Je wilt weten wat je werk oplevert en leert graag van de cijfers. Je maakt complexe dingen helder en aantrekkelijk in woord en beeld. Je leert snel en durft dingen uit te proberen. Ervaring in B2B, SaaS, growth, content of marketing automation is mooi meegenomen. Maar nieuwsgierigheid, initiatief en de drive om iets neer te zetten wegen voor ons zwaarder dan een perfect cv. Hoe jouw eerste jaar eruit kan zien De eerste maanden leer je onze klanten en markt kennen, scherp je samen met ons de positionering aan, kies je de eerste kanalen en leg je een stevige basis voor content en meting. Daarna bouw je aan een herhaalbare groeiaanpak: content verschijnt structureel, campagnes worden getest en verbeterd, en marketing en sales trekken steeds meer samen op. Op langere termijn groeit dit uit tot een geïntegreerd geheel waarin data, content, CRM en AI elkaar versterken. Een systeem dat continu leert en steeds meer zelf doet, terwijl jij de richting bepaalt. Succes meten we niet in aantallen posts of tools, maar in wat echt telt: naamsbekendheid, goede leads, demo’s en de groei van Artura. Wat je van ons mag verwachten Echt eigenaarschap : dit is jouw kans om marketing te bouwen zoals jij gelooft dat het moet. Impact die je ziet : jouw werk bepaalt mee hoe Artura groeit. Ruimte om te experimenteren : nieuwe ideeën zijn welkom, ook als ze anders zijn. Afwisseling : van storytelling tot technologie, data en commerciële groei. Korte lijnen : je werkt direct samen met het team en ziet snel resultaat. Groeiperspectief : groeit Artura, dan groei jij mee, richting marketing leadership en je eigen team. De concrete arbeidsvoorwaarden en werkvorm bespreken we graag in een persoonlijk gesprek. Zin om mee te bouwen? We maken graag kennis! Vertel ons niet alleen wat je al gedaan hebt, maar vooral wat je zou willen bouwen. Hoe zou jij Artura in de markt zetten? Wat zou je automatiseren? En hoe zou jij AI inzetten om met weinig mensen veel te bereiken? Geen kant-en-klaar antwoord nodig. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar hoe jij denkt. Let’s build the marketing engine. Samen.

items.desc: What does this team do? In Deloitte’s growing Forensic and Financial Crime team, we use our skills to combat all components of money laundering and terrorist financing, including international sanctions, fraud, bribery and corruption. We work across multiple industry segments, including financial services, energy and resources and the public sector. This is a role for people who want to combine financial crime knowledge, consulting and technology. You will work closely with clients to transform their financial crime risk management functions, using technology, data and AI to improve how they detect risk, make decisions and respond to change. You will learn how to understand client challenges, explain complex technical and regulatory concepts in a simple way, and help build practical solutions that make a real-world impact. We are looking for curious, energetic problem-solvers who enjoy working with data, learning new tools and turning complex ideas into clear, actionable insights. You do not need to arrive as an expert, but you should be excited by technology, confident learning quickly and ready to show how you have applied analysis, coding and structured thinking to solve real-world problems. What skills and academic qualifications do I need? You'll need to have obtained or be studying towards a minimum 2:1 in a STEM-related degree, ideally in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Engineering, or a related field, and have graduated by September 2027 for the Autumn 2027 intake. What kind of work will I do? No two projects are the same. You will work on live client challenges, learn from experienced consultants and technologists, and build skills that sit across data, technology, financial crime and client delivery. Skills You will combine hands-on technology delivery, data analysis, client interaction and consulting skills. From early on, you will contribute to client conversations, turn analysis into clear messages, and learn how to build strong professional relationships. Your work could include: Designing and improving technology solutions that help clients detect and prevent financial crime. Problem solving and consulting - structuring ambiguous questions and complex concepts into something that can be clearly communicated to our clients. Helping clients transform their financial crime risk management functions by applying technology, data and AI across people, process and controls. Using Python, SQL, AI, machine learning or BI tools to explore data, identify patterns and generate insights clients can use. Building data pipelines, dashboards, reports or analytical outputs that help clients monitor risk and make better decisions. Turning complex regulatory, operational or technology challenges into clear recommendations and delivery plans that clients can act on. Creating client-ready outputs such as analysis summaries, process maps, technical documentation, presentations and implementation plans, then presenting findings clearly and confidently. We also understand that our people need flexibility, which is why we operate a hybrid system, with a combination of office and home working. Please note your final assessment and induction will also be in-person, to give you the opportunity to network and build relationships. All our workspaces are accessible, however, if you require further flexibility due to a health condition or caring responsibilities, please discuss this with our team. How will I develop? During your first few weeks with the firm, you will receive training that has been designed to cover the core components of the work the team delivers for clients. Our ambition is to support our people to achieve their personal and professional goals by providing access to a wide range of quality learning materials and opportunities. As a new member of the team, you are empowered to become part of a client project and begin understanding and solving complex problems. We will provide support and ongoing training to allow you to learn how to handle confidential information, deliver quality work, and help build and maintain relationships with key clients. items.desc: Our Practice Solutions team leads the Firm’s innovation initiatives, supporting our lawyers in client delivery excellence. The team has deep expertise in working with established and emerging technologies, data analytics and data science, knowledge solutions and process re-engineering. The Practice Solutions team works with our lawyers to identify innovative solutions to support our clients. Through fostering a Firmwide culture of innovation, we encourage our lawyers to think creatively about how to deliver the best value to our clients and we ensure that White & Case remains at the forefront of advancements in the legal industry. Join White & Case’s Applied AI team to turn promising, rapidly developed prototypes into secure, reliable products that can be used and supported across the Firm. You will work directly with the Associate Director, Applied AI, to assess existing applications, decide what should be retained, refactored or rebuilt, and take ownership of the engineering needed to move them into production. This includes integration, security, testing, deployment, monitoring and early live support, working closely with Technology and security colleagues. Our backend centres on Python, using FastAPI and FastMCP. Django is likely to be used for the first project, but the framework may vary for later projects depending on their needs. Many applications will be accessed through AI assistants via the Firm’s MCP gateway, making backend services, data modelling and secure integration central to the role. We need a practical product engineer who can bring structure to incomplete or experimental code, make sensible trade-offs and get useful software safely into users’ hands. Over time, there will also be opportunities to shape and build new prototypes. Duties And Accountabilities Assess prototypes for production readiness, including architecture, code quality, dependencies, data handling, security, scalability, supportability and user value. Recommend whether each prototype should be hardened, refactored, rebuilt or stopped, and agree a practical route to production. Build Python services, relational data models, APIs and background processing; add lightweight frontend interfaces where useful. Develop MCP integrations through the Firm’s gateway, handling authentication, permissions and token exchange with downstream applications. Work with Technology on approved cloud deployments and connections to on-premises systems, resolving infrastructure and integration dependencies. Follow the Firm’s central SDLC and security policies; implement testing, access controls, audit logging and secure secrets handling. Take production applications through deployment, controlled release and early live use, then establish clear ownership, support procedures, service expectations and handover arrangements with the relevant Technology teams. Define and run evaluations for AI-enabled behaviour, including representative test cases, quality thresholds, regression testing and human review where appropriate. Monitor failures, latency, usage and consumption costs in production, and use the results to improve applications and contribute reusable engineering patterns as the team grows. Required Skills Professional software engineering experience that includes taking incomplete, experimental or early-stage applications into production and maintaining them afterwards. Experience working in an autonomous, fast-moving environment where you contributed across development, integration, deployment and live operation. Strong Python skills and experience with FastAPI or comparable Python frameworks. Strong SQL and relational database skills, plus experience designing and integrating APIs. Practical understanding of authentication and authorisation, including OAuth 2.0 or OpenID Connect. Experience with automated testing, Git, CI/CD, cloud deployment and production troubleshooting. Clear communication, pragmatic product and engineering judgement, and the ability to bring structure to unfamiliar or incomplete systems. You should be comfortable making progress with limited documentation, surfacing risks early and working with security, infrastructure and product specialists to resolve them. Preferred Experience Experience with FastMCP, Azure, Entra ID, API gateways, delegated access or token exchange would be valuable. Other useful experience includes cloud-to-on-premises integration, LLM applications and straightforward JavaScript/TypeScript interfaces. You do not need experience with every technology listed or a legal background. Location and Reporting: This role is based in London, United Kingdom. You will report to the Associate Director, Applied AI. The Applied AI team forms part of the wider Innovation & AI team. items.desc: Description Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming the business landscape. From automating mundane tasks to powering data-driven insights, AI promises increased efficiency, improved decision-making and a competitive edge. However, simply implementing AI tools isn’t enough. To realize the full potential of these technologies, organizations need a dedicated role focused on managing, optimizing and governing their AI deployments: the AI Administrator. This emerging role is quickly becoming essential for businesses of all sizes. We are seeking a dedicated AI System Administrator to manage and optimize our company’s AI systems and platforms. Requirements Cloud Computing: Proficiency in cloud platforms: Azure, Tool: Foundry, OpenAI, PaaS Services, IaaS ServiceNow Tools: Experience with ServiceNow tools for Managing Service request and Incidents Job responsibilities  Model Monitoring & Management: Continuously monitoring model performance, identifying drift, and triggering retraining or recalibration processes.  Infrastructure Management: Maintaining and scaling the infrastructure required to support AI workloadsб including cloud resources, servers and storage.  Cost Optimization: Monitoring resource utilization, identifying inefficiencies and optimizing costs associated with AI infrastructure and operations.  Security & Compliance: Implementing and enforcing data security policies and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.  Bias Detection & Mitigation: Analyzing models for bias and implementing techniques to mitigate it. Generating reports on model performance, data quality and security.  Collaboration with Data Science: Working closely with data scientists to deploy, monitor and improve models. Providing feedback on model performance and data quality.  Vendor Management: Evaluating and managing relationships with AI technology vendors. Your responsibilities will include maintaining the health of our AI systems, resolving technical issues, and ensuring the systems are secure and up-to-date. The ideal candidate is a tech-savvy professional with an in-depth understanding of AI technologies and system administration. The ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies is essential. Ultimately, the AI System Administrator should enhance our AI infrastructure and contribute to building high-quality AI applications that align with our business needs. Regular interactions with our teams ensure their engagement, motivation, and recognition. We empower our team members to pursue their career goals with confidence and enthusiasm. Comprehensive Benefits: In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment. items.desc: About The Role We are looking for a hands-on Security Engineer - Application Security, GRC & AI to join the R&D team of a rapidly growing international technology company serving more than 50 million users worldwide. As the company's sole dedicated Security Engineer , you will take end-to-end ownership of security operations, covering application security, vulnerability management, governance, risk assessment, internal IT security and emerging AI-related threats. This is a highly technical and autonomous position requiring someone who can personally investigate vulnerabilities, review code, implement security improvements and collaborate directly with developers and engineering leadership. You will play a central role in protecting a large-scale AI-powered consumer platform, coordinating external security assessments, maintaining security governance processes and strengthening the organisation's overall security posture. The ideal candidate combines strong application security expertise with practical coding skills, sound risk management judgment and the ability to independently identify and resolve security challenges. This is not a compliance-only or purely advisory role . We are looking for a proactive, technically capable Security Engineer who enjoys hands-on problem-solving and takes direct responsibility for security outcomes. Key Responsibilities Conduct security-focused code reviews to identify potential application vulnerabilities. Investigate, prioritise and remediate security weaknesses across applications and services. Collaborate directly with developers to implement secure coding practices and vulnerability fixes. Work within Git/GitHub development workflows to review code and contribute to security improvements. Coordinate external penetration testing engagements and security audits. Track identified vulnerabilities and ensure timely remediation in collaboration with engineering teams. Assess application security risks and recommend practical technical solutions. Develop, maintain and continuously improve the organisation's security risk register. Identify and assess security exposure across internal systems, applications and third-party services. Prioritise security improvements based on risk severity, operational requirements and business impact. Support security governance processes, documentation and audit preparation. Coordinate audit follow-up activities and track remediation progress. Strengthen internal security controls and risk management procedures. Monitor security alerts, emerging threats and relevant vulnerabilities. Investigate suspicious activity and coordinate appropriate responses. Organise security awareness initiatives and phishing simulations. Communicate security risks, best practices and emerging threats to internal teams. Provide occasional evening and weekend security monitoring coverage when required. Support secure employee onboarding and offboarding procedures. Review and manage user access permissions across internal systems. Strengthen identity and access management controls. Support device security management, including mobile device management (MDM). Identify opportunities to improve internal IT security processes and operational controls. Monitor emerging security risks affecting generative AI applications and platforms. Assess potential threats involving prompt injection, jailbreaks and content-filter bypasses. Track security vulnerabilities and incidents associated with third-party AI providers. Collaborate with engineering teams to identify and mitigate AI-related security risks. Research emerging AI security techniques, tools and defensive approaches. Requirements Minimum 2-3+ years of hands-on security engineering experience, with flexibility for exceptional candidates from fast-growing technology environments. Strong practical experience in application security, including code reviews, vulnerability identification and remediation. Proven experience conducting or coordinating security audits and penetration tests. Ability to work directly with application code and development teams using Git/GitHub. Practical scripting or automation experience, ideally using Python, Bash or equivalent technologies. Previous experience within an AI company or a technology scale-up with at least 50 employees. Sound understanding of security governance, risk assessment, vulnerability prioritisation and remediation processes. Ability to develop or maintain security risk registers and support audit-related activities. Strong technical problem-solving skills and an investigative, security-focused mindset. Ability to independently identify, investigate and resolve security vulnerabilities. Comfortable taking end-to-end ownership of security operations without relying on a large dedicated security team. items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Financial Analyst for Energy Projects, you will sit at the intersection of finance, business strategy, and AI enabled transformation. You will play a critical role in commercial bid and proposal activities, supporting sales calculations, finance processes and advanced financial analyses for energy projects. The position will focus on enhancing portfolio management, improving process efficiencies in commercial bid activities, and driving digital transformation. To achieve these objectives, the role is structured around two core areas: traditional financial analysis for energy project bids and the development of digital and AI-enabled financial workflows. This dual focus ensures that while core commercial bid support is maintained, the team's processes are simultaneously modernized to improve productivity and decision quality. Given the focus on financial analysis and digital enablement, the ideal candidate will possess a strong background in finance or a related field, combined with a high affinity for AI tools, data analysis, and process automation. Experience in bid management or sales finance is highly beneficial to effectively bridge financial logic with commercial strategy. How You’ll Make an Impact Execute and continuously improve sales calculations and financial models for energy project bids, ensuring competitive and profitable proposals. Develop and leverage AI-enabled financial workflows, automation solutions, and tools such as Microsoft Copilot to enhance productivity and decision quality. Translate complex financial information into actionable insights and recommendations for proposals, negotiations, and commercial strategies. Ensure contractual compliance and contribute to the development of effective pre-sales contract strategies. Analyze cost structures, financial processes, and commercial data to identify productivity opportunities and support management decision-making. Partner with Technical Bid Management, Engineering, Sales, IT, and regional stakeholders to drive digital transformation, process standardization, and commercial excellence. What You Bring Apprenticeship, Bachelor's, or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. 1–3 years of professional experience in finance, controlling, bid management, sales finance, project management, product costing, or a comparable function. Strong financial and business acumen, including financial analysis, business metrics, pricing strategies, budgeting, and commercial decision support. Advanced analytical and digital capabilities, including process improvement, business intelligence, AI tools, automation technologies, and Power BI. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex topics clearly to diverse, international audiences. Professional proficiency in English and German, combined with a proactive, quality-driven mindset, strong organizational skills, and a passion for innovation and continuous improvement. Projekty B2B z obszarów AI, MobilityTech, LegalTech i SaaS. Dużą autonomię i realny wpływ na wyniki biznesowe. Szybką ścieżkę rozwoju w kierunku Growth Lead / GTM Operations Lead. Po 4 miesiącach - wejście do programu ESOP. Nie szukamy osoby, która będzie tylko obsługiwać narzędzia. Szukamy kogoś, kto sprawi, że cały system będzie działał coraz skuteczniej.
