items.desc: AI Software Engineer · Mama Insurance · Milano (ibrido) Mama è l'assicurazione casa che si compra online, senza agente e senza telefonata. Fastweb e Vodafone sono nostri soci e partner commerciali, Chubb è la compagnia dietro ai nostri prodotti, e tutto gira su tecnologia che abbiamo scritto noi. Cerchiamo una persona che si prenda pezzi interi del prodotto e ne risponda, dalla decisione al rilascio a quello che succede dopo. Lavori accanto al CTO, con priorità chiare e condivise ogni settimana. Siamo una startup: le cose da fare sono tante, rilasciamo in pochi giorni e correggiamo il tiro guardando i numeri. Il ritmo è alto, la direzione è definita. QUALCHE ESEMPIO DI CIÒ DI CUI TI OCCUPERAI • Il percorso di acquisto, dalla prima domanda alla conferma del pagamento. È la superficie che vale di più: ogni punto di conversione che trovi lì è fatturato che non abbiamo dovuto comprare. Lo misuri, lo cambi, lo testi e guardi tu i numeri il giorno dopo. • L'area clienti: polizze, documenti, rinnovi, pagamenti. Chi la apre lo fa due volte l'anno e di solito in una giornata storta. Deve funzionare al primo colpo. • I pagamenti e le integrazioni con i partner. È il codice dove un errore non è un ticket ma un cliente rimasto senza copertura, e lo trattiamo di conseguenza. • L'assistente AI che accompagna il cliente all'acquisto in autonomia. È la parte più nuova di quello che facciamo e quella con meno risposte già scritte. • Le automazioni interne. Quello che il team fa due volte a mano, la terza volta diventa software, e spesso lo scrivi tu. • Tutto quello che non è codice. Ti chiederemo anche di analizzare dati, capire dove si inceppa un processo, montare un flusso con gli strumenti che abbiamo già. Cerchiamo chi ama smontare i problemi, non solo scrivere codice. • La produzione. Rilasci, monitoraggio, affidabilità. Quello che rilasci lo segui finché non hai la prova che funziona. • I prossimi prodotti. Il modello costruito sulla casa è pensato per estendersi ad altri rami: quello che scrivi quest'anno deve reggere anche il prodotto successivo. CHI CERCHIAMO • Da 2 a 4 anni su prodotti web in produzione, con utenti veri e soldi veri. TypeScript, React e Next.js sono il nostro stack quotidiano. Se arrivi da uno stack diverso ma hai lo stesso tipo di esperienza, parliamone: il linguaggio si impara, il giudizio no. • Full stack nel senso letterale. Nello stesso giorno ti può capitare l'interfaccia, il database e un'integrazione esterna. Non ti serve essere il migliore in ognuna, ti serve non fermarti davanti a nessuna. • Scrivi codice con gli agenti AI ogni giorno, e sai dove non fidarti. Qui è il modo normale di lavorare, non un esperimento. Ci interessa di più sentirti raccontare la volta che un agente ti ha fatto sbagliare, e cosa hai cambiato dopo, che l'elenco degli strumenti che usi. • Davanti a un numero che non torna apri i dati. Sai distinguere un bug da un problema di misurazione, e una spiegazione plausibile da una dimostrata. • Lavori in autonomia dentro priorità chiare. Sai cosa conta questa settimana e perché, e come arrivarci lo decidi tu. Hai accesso diretto al founder e al CTO, e una risposta lo stesso giorno in cui la chiedi. • Scrivi in modo che chi legge possa agire senza chiederti chiarimenti. In un team così piccolo, quello che non è scritto non esiste. COSA OFFRIAMO • RAL da 30k a 40k in base all'esperienza. Se porti risultati, la RAL cresce con te e valutiamo anche l'ingresso nel piano ESOP. • Milano, ibrido e flessibile. • Responsabilità vera. Quello che decidi resta, e si vede. • Velocità. Quello che scrivi va in produzione in pochi giorni, davanti a clienti che pagano. Tra una decisione e un rilascio non c'è nessuna coda. • L'AI come modo di lavorare. Budget per gli strumenti che vuoi usare, senza dover giustificare un abbonamento che ti fa risparmiare una giornata. • Un perimetro che si allarga. Il team tecnico cresce, e chi lo fa funzionare cresce con lui. COME FUNZIONA LA SELEZIONE Siamo veloci anche qui. Ogni candidatura viene letta con l'aiuto di un agente AI e confermata da una persona, poi i passaggi sono tre: • Una call tecnica con il CTO. Ci porti dentro qualcosa che hai costruito tu e noi insistiamo sul perché di ogni scelta. • Una conversazione con il founder, su come lavori e su cosa cerchi. • Un incontro finale, in cui parliamo dell'offerta. Dal primo contatto all'ultimo passaggio passano pochi giorni, non settimane. Rispondiamo a tutti, anche quando la risposta è no. PRIMA DI CANDIDARTI • Mandaci qualcosa che hai costruito: un repository, un prodotto online, un lavoro di cui vai fiero. Vale più del CV. • Due righe su come usi l'AI per scrivere codice oggi. La lettera di presentazione non serve. • Se ti riconosci in quasi tutto ma non in tutto, scrivici lo stesso e dicci su quale parte dovresti crescere. COME CANDIDARSI Scrivi a jobs@mamainsurance.it JD completa: https://www.notion.so/AI-Software-Engineer-3f8025bce8bc8182861effe6e53b4b79

items.desc: About The Role We are looking for a hands-on Security Engineer - Application Security, GRC & AI to join the R&D team of a rapidly growing international technology company serving more than 50 million users worldwide. As the company's sole dedicated Security Engineer , you will take end-to-end ownership of security operations, covering application security, vulnerability management, governance, risk assessment, internal IT security and emerging AI-related threats. This is a highly technical and autonomous position requiring someone who can personally investigate vulnerabilities, review code, implement security improvements and collaborate directly with developers and engineering leadership. You will play a central role in protecting a large-scale AI-powered consumer platform, coordinating external security assessments, maintaining security governance processes and strengthening the organisation's overall security posture. The ideal candidate combines strong application security expertise with practical coding skills, sound risk management judgment and the ability to independently identify and resolve security challenges. This is not a compliance-only or purely advisory role . We are looking for a proactive, technically capable Security Engineer who enjoys hands-on problem-solving and takes direct responsibility for security outcomes. Key Responsibilities Conduct security-focused code reviews to identify potential application vulnerabilities. Investigate, prioritise and remediate security weaknesses across applications and services. Collaborate directly with developers to implement secure coding practices and vulnerability fixes. Work within Git/GitHub development workflows to review code and contribute to security improvements. Coordinate external penetration testing engagements and security audits. Track identified vulnerabilities and ensure timely remediation in collaboration with engineering teams. Assess application security risks and recommend practical technical solutions. Develop, maintain and continuously improve the organisation's security risk register. Identify and assess security exposure across internal systems, applications and third-party services. Prioritise security improvements based on risk severity, operational requirements and business impact. Support security governance processes, documentation and audit preparation. Coordinate audit follow-up activities and track remediation progress. Strengthen internal security controls and risk management procedures. Monitor security alerts, emerging threats and relevant vulnerabilities. Investigate suspicious activity and coordinate appropriate responses. Organise security awareness initiatives and phishing simulations. Communicate security risks, best practices and emerging threats to internal teams. Provide occasional evening and weekend security monitoring coverage when required. Support secure employee onboarding and offboarding procedures. Review and manage user access permissions across internal systems. Strengthen identity and access management controls. Support device security management, including mobile device management (MDM). Identify opportunities to improve internal IT security processes and operational controls. Monitor emerging security risks affecting generative AI applications and platforms. Assess potential threats involving prompt injection, jailbreaks and content-filter bypasses. Track security vulnerabilities and incidents associated with third-party AI providers. Collaborate with engineering teams to identify and mitigate AI-related security risks. Research emerging AI security techniques, tools and defensive approaches. Requirements Minimum 2-3+ years of hands-on security engineering experience, with flexibility for exceptional candidates from fast-growing technology environments. Strong practical experience in application security, including code reviews, vulnerability identification and remediation. Proven experience conducting or coordinating security audits and penetration tests. Ability to work directly with application code and development teams using Git/GitHub. Practical scripting or automation experience, ideally using Python, Bash or equivalent technologies. Previous experience within an AI company or a technology scale-up with at least 50 employees. Sound understanding of security governance, risk assessment, vulnerability prioritisation and remediation processes. Ability to develop or maintain security risk registers and support audit-related activities. Strong technical problem-solving skills and an investigative, security-focused mindset. Ability to independently identify, investigate and resolve security vulnerabilities. Comfortable taking end-to-end ownership of security operations without relying on a large dedicated security team. Strong collaboration skills when working with developers, engineering leadership and external security providers. Excellent written and spoken English. Ability to operate …

items.desc: There's no secret to become number-one, it takes willingness to improve and determination to pursue it. At GRiT®, it’s all about the journey getting there. We trust talent and intelligence are important, yet passion and perseverance are key to achieving any goal. We are Tech Passionate People with a Purpose, delivering solutions while building strong long-term relations. Recognizing each person’s unique contribution to our collective success, we embrace inclusion and diversity, committed to creating a respectful and socially responsible environment. People. Technology. Innovation. All-around it. Are you GRiTTY enough to be part of our journey? Take the first step by applying now and let’s create our future together. 🌟 Job Description: We're looking for a security professional to embed themselves in our AI/GenAI journey — from early design through to production. You'll be the person who makes sure our AI platforms, APIs, agents, and integrations are built securely and responsibly. Day-to-day, this means reviewing AI architectures, setting guardrails around data usage (especially sensitive or regulated data), and keeping a sharp eye on risks like prompt injection, data leakage, and model misuse. You'll also shape our AI governance standards and work hand-in-hand with Product Security and engineering to make sure controls are real and enforceable — not just on paper. Logging, monitoring, and auditability of AI usage will be part of your world too. Must-Have A solid background in security — application, cloud, or architecture Hands-on experience with security reviews and defining technical controls A working understanding of GenAI and LLM-based solutions Familiarity with data protection and privacy principles Ability to translate security concerns into clear, actionable technical requirements Strong instinct for identifying and prioritising risk Comfortable challenging implementations and validating them against requirements Someone who collaborates well across security, engineering, and data teams Would Be Great If You Have Experience with AWS and/or Azure, particularly AWS Bedrock or similar GenAI platforms Databricks experience — securing ML pipelines, notebooks, jobs, and managing access control Knowledge of OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, SAIF, MCP (incl. MCP-38), or A2A architectures A background in DevSecOps or MLOps environments What’s In It For You Continuous Training and Certifications GRiT Prizes: GRiT Baby Gift, GRiT Birthday Prize, GRiT Recommendation Prize Exclusive Partnerships/Discounts: (Gym, Health, Well-being, Lifestyle, Financial, etc…) Unique Events Welcoming Office (Fruit, Coffee, Pool Table, etc.) Competitive Compensation Pay for Performance #TechWithPassion - Fuel your fire, join our tech tribe! 🫀

items.desc: Description Du Poste 🎯 Chargé(e) de Gouvernance Data & IA (H/F) 🎯 🚀 Votre rôle Au sein du Département Technologies, le Data Management Office (DMO) pilote la gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Il accompagne les métiers sur la valorisation, la qualité, la maîtrise et la conformité des données, ainsi que sur les usages de l'Intelligence Artificielle. Vous rejoignez une équipe de 9 personnes, dont trois collaborateurs dédiés à la gouvernance Data & IA. Aux côtés des deux collaborateurs déjà en poste, vous faites de la Data et de l'IA des leviers responsables, maîtrisés et créateurs de valeur. Votre rôle ne se limite pas à appliquer un cadre. Vous le faites vivre, vous le challengez et vous le faites progresser. Vous intervenez au croisement des métiers, de la technologie, de la réglementation et de la maîtrise des risques, dans un environnement bancaire où la confiance dans la donnée est un enjeu stratégique. 🧩 Vos missions Vos missions s'organisent autour de quatre axes. 1- Piloter les usages Data & IA Vous pilotez et suivez le développement des usages Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous accompagnez le déploiement de l'Offre de Service Data et diffusez les bonnes pratiques associées auprès des métiers. Vous analysez et challengez les dispositifs existants, identifiez les axes d'amélioration et contribuez à leur mise en œuvre. 2- Garantir la gouvernance, la conformité et la maîtrise des risques Vous contribuez aux travaux de gouvernance Data & IA de la Caisse régionale. Vous participez aux démarches de conformité et de maîtrise des risques, notamment BCBS 239 et le cadre normatif IA. Vous préparez et contribuez aux instances de gouvernance : Comité Data & IA, Comité de Qualité des Données, Comité d'Homologation IA. Vous assurez une veille sur les évolutions Data, IA, technologiques et réglementaires, et contribuez à leur prise en compte en interne. 3- Améliorer la connaissance et la qualité des données Vous accompagnez les métiers dans la connaissance et la documentation de leurs données. Vous les aidez à identifier les écarts de qualité et à mettre en place des actions d'amélioration concrètes. Vous transformez des problématiques complexes en recommandations claires et opérationnelles. 4- Diffuser une culture Data & IA Vous animez les communautés Data & IA et coordonnez les différents acteurs de la gouvernance des données. Vous concevez et déployez des actions de sensibilisation et d'acculturation à la Data et à l'IA. Vous animez des ateliers et vous faites le lien entre les experts et les métiers. 🧩 Environnement Une équipe DMO de 9 personnes, rattachée au Département Technologies. Un pôle gouvernance Data & IA de trois collaborateurs, dont vous. Des interlocuteurs variés : métiers, équipes techniques, risques, conformité et instances de gouvernance. ⚒ Environnement réglementaire et outils Réglementation : BCBS 239, cadre normatif IA Gouvernance : qualité des données, documentation, homologation des usages IA Outils appréciés : Python, SQL ou tout autre langage d'analyse de données Profil recherché 🧬 Profil recherché 🎓 Formation supérieure en data, gestion des risques, audit, finance, ingénierie ou équivalent. 💼 Expérience réussie en audit, contrôle interne, gestion des risques ou conformité, idéalement en environnement bancaire ou financier. Nous recherchons avant tout un profil hybride. Vous savez prendre de la hauteur sans perdre le fil opérationnel. Vous aimez les sujets complexes, vous savez challenger l'existant et vous formulez des recommandations qui se mettent en œuvre. La Data et l'IA vous passionnent, et vous voulez mettre cette curiosité au service d'usages utiles et maîtrisés. 🤝 Savoir-être et compétences clés Gestion de projet et coordination transverse. Capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de challenge. Connaissance ou forte appétence pour la gouvernance, la qualité et la valorisation des données. Intérêt marqué pour l'IA et ses enjeux de gouvernance, de maîtrise et de conformité. Aisance pour animer des ateliers, des communautés et des instances de gouvernance. Excellentes qualités relationnelles, rédactionnelles et pédagogiques. Curiosité, pragmatisme et sens du collectif. Ce poste ne sera malheureusement pas pour vous cette fois-ci si : vous n'avez aucune expérience en audit, contrôle, gestion des risques, conformité ou gouvernance des données ; Vous ne connaissez pas les principes BCBS239 vous recherchez un poste purement technique de développement ou de data engineering ; vous n'êtes pas à l'aise pour animer des communautés, présenter en comité et embarquer des interlocuteurs variés ; la Data et l'IA ne suscitent pas chez vous une vraie curiosité. 🎯 Ce qui fera la différence Votre capacité à relier les enjeux métiers, technologiques, réglementaires et de maîtrise des risques. Votre goût du challenge constructif, qui fait avancer les dispositifs sans bloquer les projets. Votre pédagogie pour rendre la Data et l'IA accessibles à tous. Une pratique de Python, SQL ou d'un outil …

items.desc: Job Description Join us to shape the future of web applications with innovative AI-driven solutions. You will have the opportunity to work across both backend and frontend technologies, collaborating with diverse teams to deliver impactful customer and internal platforms. Your expertise will help us build reliable integrations and drive experimentation and personalization. items.desc: Role Description The Centre for Reviews and Dissemination (CRD) at the University of York is recruiting a Grade 6 or Grade 7 Research Fellow in Health Economics. CRD is a world-leading academic research department specialising in evidence synthesis and health technology assessment (HTA). Our work spans a broad range of health and public health areas, providing high-quality evidence to inform national policy and practice decisions. The successful candidate will work primarily within our Technology Assessment Review (TAR) programme, undertaking research to support National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) decision-making as part of the York External Assessment Group (EAG). You will also contribute to our NIHR Evidence Synthesis Group (ESG) programme and broader health economic modelling projects across CRD, with scope to develop your own research interests. We welcome applications from candidates with a relevant Master’s degree and/or PhD (or equivalent experience) in health economics or another quantitative discipline, such as applied statistics or mathematics. Candidates must possess strong quantitative skills, a comprehensive knowledge of health economics and cost-effectiveness analysis, and a good understanding of HTA, systematic reviews, and meta-analysis. Candidates applying for Grade 7 must additionally have experience of critiquing, conceptualising, and constructing health economic decision models in an HTA context, as well as proven ability to lead research elements and supervise early-career researchers. Familiarity with UK health systems and research funding is desirable. Further training and career development will be supported. CRD offers a friendly, supportive environment and holds a Silver Athena SWAN award. We embrace hybrid and flexible working (minimum 0.8 FTE / 4 days per week). This is an open-ended full-time position. We actively encourage applications from underrepresented groups, particularly Black, Asian, and Minority Ethnic candidates. Please state on your application whether you are applying for Grade 6 or Grade 7. Interview date: To be confirmed Informal enquiries: Contact Matthew Walton (matthew.walton@york.ac.uk), Ash Bullement (ash.bullement@york.ac.uk), or Professor Sofia Dias (sofia.dias@york.ac.uk). The University strives to be diverse and inclusive – a place where we can ALL be ourselves. We particularly encourage applications from people who identify as Black, Asian or from a Minority Ethnic background, who are underrepresented at the University. We offer family friendly, flexible working arrangements, with forums and inclusive facilities to support our staff. #EqualityatYork As a Disability Confident employer, we will ensure that a fair and proportionate number of disabled applicants that meet the minimum (essential) criteria for each position will be offered an interview. Read more about the University of York’s commitments under the Disability Confident scheme.

items.desc: Are you a physicist or engineer passionate about solving complex technological challenges at the intersection of materials science, electromagnetism, and cutting-edge ultrasonic and eddy current technologies? Do you want to shape the future of non-destructive evaluation (NDE) for some of the most critical industries, including nuclear energy and next-generation Small Modular Reactors (SMRs)? If so, we want to meet you. Who are we? At INETEC, we push the boundaries of technology, designing and developing groundbreaking solutions for space, NDE, and the nuclear industry. Our innovations aren’t just theoretical, they’re applied globally, safeguarding vital infrastructure and advancing projects like ITER (International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor), and SMR technology, which are shaping the future of clean energy. We are looking for a top-tier R&D Expert ready to tackle fundamental technological challenges, and make a lasting impact through theoretical research, experimental validation, and transformative product design. What will you do? Role Your role will be a blend of advanced research, experimentation, and product innovation, with a focus on materials science, electromagnetism, and advanced NDE technologies: Research: Explore new ultrasonic and eddy current technologies and trends for industrial and space NDE applications, with a focus on advanced materials (e.g., ceramics, single crystals, thin and thick films). Materials development: Investigate and optimize piezoelectric, electromagnetic, and acoustically passive materials to enhance the performance of NDE systems. Conceptual design: Lead the development of next-generation ultrasonic and eddy current probes tailored for critical applications in industries such as nuclear energy and SMRs. Simulation and modeling: Design, simulate, and validate probe and instrumentation concepts using advanced computational tools. Product development: Collaborate on the design of state-of-the-art industrial instrumentation for NDE, integrating cutting-edge ultrasonic and electromagnetic technologies. Innovation: Continuously improve existing technologies to maximize quality, efficiency, and reliability while minimizing production costs. Documentation: Prepare comprehensive technical instructions, design documentation, and product procedures in compliance with international quality standards. Leadership: Manage small R&D teams and foster collaboration with business and academic partners to achieve ambitious goals. Exploration: Stay ahead of emerging technological trends in NDE, especially in the context of SMRs and other advanced nuclear technologies. Who are we looking for? We are searching for an exceptional individual with the following qualifications: A Master’s or PhD in physics, materials science, engineering, or a related field. Deep understanding of ultrasonic and electromagnetic (eddy current) technologies for NDE. Strong background in materials science and the ability to link material properties to advanced NDE solutions. Experience with computational modeling and simulation tools. A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to thrive in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment. Proficiency in English (written and spoken). A passion for innovation and a desire to work on impactful projects. What do we offer? At INETEC, You Will Find An Environment That Fuels Innovation And Supports Your Professional Growth. Here’s What You Can Expect Impactful work: Join a team that’s shaping the future of NDE for critical industries, including nuclear energy and SMRs. Cutting-edge projects: Work on groundbreaking technologies deployed globally, from nuclear power plants to fusion projects like ITER. Collaborative culture: Collaborate with leading experts in materials science, electromagnetism, mechanical engineering, software development, and electronics. Innovation-driven environment : Bring your ideas to life with full support from an organization that values creativity and problem-solving. Career development: Benefit from structured career plans and opportunities to grow through EU-funded projects and international collaborations. Global reach: Be part of a company whose technologies have a transformative impact worldwide. Your opportunity to shape the future starts here. Join us in advancing the science and technology that power the industries of tomorrow. Apply today! Submit your application by 26.10.2026.

As a Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer, working out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will own control law design and the system identification that feeds it,
items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role Harmattan AI is pushing the boundaries of high-speed autonomous flight, where control has to hold up at the edge of the envelope. Getting that right across a family of airframes is one of the most demanding parts of the flight software. As a Flight Control & Dynamics Engineer, working out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will own control law design and the system identification that feeds it, setting the control standard as the team grows. You will weigh classical against learning-based methods, from tuned control laws to reinforcement-learning policies trained in simulation and flown on hardware, and decide what actually flies. Responsibilities System Identification: Design excitation maneuvers and fit airframe models from flight data, with quantified error bounds. Control Law Design & Tuning: Inner rate and attitude loops through outer position loops, with allocation, gain scheduling, and manual or automated tuning across the airframe family and flight envelope. Sim-to-Real: Keep the in-house simulator faithful to the identified model, so control developed in simulation transfers to the aircraft. Model Consumption: Turn the stability derivatives and coefficient tables from Aerodynamics into flying control. Flight Test & Diagnosis: Verify across simulation, SITL, and HITL, including Monte Carlo campaigns, then fly and iterate from logs. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior control and GNC engineers. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, controls, robotics, or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree. System Identification & Control: Proven, hands-on identification and control on multirotor or fixed-wing platforms, validated in flight, with depth in at least one of MPC, INDI, or geometric control. Embedded Realization: Real-time control implementation on constrained targets, split cleanly between a microcontroller and a companion computer. Learning-Based Control: Familiarity with reinforcement learning and simulation-based training, and the judgment to know when a learned policy beats a classical design. Professional Attributes: Empirical and hardware-honest, disciplined about experiments and validation, grounded in real flight data. Communicates clearly, able to present control and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality. Bonus: Multi-airframe or hover-to-cruise transition experience. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.card: responsibilities Cleanroom work in CMi/Labwork (60%): Fabricate photonics chips using advanced semiconductor processing (etching, lithography, thin film depositions) Perform statistical analysis of in-line metrology of the fabrication process, develop measurements to ensure reproducibility Explore new material deposition techniques, etching techniques, cladding oxides, wafer platforms Test and learn to operate new
items.desc:
Mission
 The Laboratory of Photonics and Quantum Measurements (LPQM) at the Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) is seeking a nanofabrication engineer to develop advanced processes and techniques for next-generation photonic integrated circuits and lasers. This role will involve collaborating with Bühler Group on a 2-year industry research project, which has the potential for startup commercialization. 
 The researcher will be responsible for developing advanced thin film deposition and ion beam trimming techniques on various material platforms, such as SiN, LTOI and LNOI. He/she will lead the collaboration with the Bühler Group on in-house fabrication of wafer-scale integrated photonic circuits, ensuring optimal operation and reproducibility in the cleanroom facilities (CMi). The candidate will design, fabricate, and characterize PICs for the project, as well as develop and improve existing processes and explore new material platforms and tools available from Bühler. He/she will also regularly travel to the R&D facilities in Germany to assist in optimising the recipes. He/she will prepare quarterly reports and facilitate effective technical exchanges between LPQM and the Bühler Group. High-level publications are expected at the end of the project in collaboration with the industrial partner. The position also offers the potential for technology transfer to a startup. 
 Main duties and responsibilities
 Cleanroom work in CMi/Labwork (60%): 
 Fabricate photonics chips using advanced semiconductor processing (etching, lithography, thin film depositions) 
 Perform statistical analysis of in-line metrology of the fabrication process, develop measurements to ensure reproducibility 
 Explore new material deposition techniques, etching techniques, cladding oxides, wafer platforms 
 Test and learn to operate new tools 
 Characterize the photonic chip performance 
 Travelling to Bühler Group in Darmstadt and Leibniz (20%): 
 Assist in the process development and master the tools available at Bühler 
 Document progress and report back to the team
 Design photonic chips and process flows (10%): 
 Modify existing designs to test the tool capabilities 
 Design new PIC devices to demonstrate the capabilities of the developed processes, using new techniques, tools and materials 
 Documentation and coordination (10%): 
 Quarterly report preparation 
 Technical reports on each new process, as defined in the project tasks 
 Technical meeting organisation and reporting on a need to go basis 
 Publication of new results in high impact journals 
 Profile
 Qualification/experience: 
 PhD in engineering or sciences with micro-nanofabrication of PICs as the theme of the thesis 
 3-5 years equivalent experience in thin film process development, instrument operation, and/or the fabrication industry 
 Extensive cleanroom experience 
 Technical skills: 
 Ability to rigorously follow processes 
 Ability to operate instruments with a high level of patience and attention to detail 
 Willingness to maintain highly organized data records 
 Interpersonal skills: 
 Ability to work independently, with a high level of responsibility 
 Strong communication skills towards the other lab members, CMi staff and collaborators 
 Willingness to work in a multi-national team 
 Willingness to travel 
 Computer/software skills: 
 Proficiency with Microsoft Office 
 Familiarity with K-layout, COMSOL, Lumerical 
 Languages: 
 Working proficiency in English, German and/or French is a plus 
 We offer
 A young, dynamic, flexible and highly motivated R&D environment 
 A productive team of high scientific and industrial impacts 
 Excellent laboratory conditions at Center of MicroNanoTechnology at EPFL 
 Opportunity to work on technology development with potential continuation in industry 
 Potential for technology transfer to a startup 
 Information
 Contract Start Date : as soon as possible. Applications will be evaluated on a rolling basis. 
 Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. 
 Activity Rate : 100% 
 Contract Type: CDD 
 Duration: 1 year renewable 
 Reference: 2546 
 Contact
 For complementary information, please contact Prof. Tobias Kippenberg per e-mail: tobias.kippenberg@epfl.ch

 Strong customer communication, technical problem-solving and solution design skills, with fluent French and professional English.

 Experience migrating customers between enterprise SaaS platforms, including data migration, system configuration and service continuity. 
 Experience supporting both pre-sales solution design and post-sales implementation.

items.desc: Position description Category Materials, solid state physics Contract Internship Job title Development and Application of Time-Resolved Cathodoluminescence for Nanoscale Characterization H/F Subject The candidate will work on the development and application of advanced TRCL measurements on microLED structures. The internship will be carried out within the PFNC platform at CEA Leti which provides access to advanced nanoscale characterization facilities. The candidate will work in close interaction with researchers and engineers involved in III nitride and microLED technologies. Contract duration (months) 6 Job description Framework and context: MicroLEDs based on III nitride semiconductors are promising candidates for next generation display and optoelectronic technologies. Their performance is strongly influenced by carrier recombination and transport processes occurring at the nanoscale, particularly in the vicinity of sidewalls, interfaces and material defects. Time Resolved Cathodoluminescence (TRCL) is a powerful technique combining the high spatial resolution of electron microscopy with time and spectrally resolved luminescence measurements. It enables the investigation of local carrier dynamics and luminescence properties with nanometric spatial and sub nanosecond temporal resolution. The objective of this internship is to develop and apply TRCL characterization methodologies to III nitride microLEDs with a particular focus on understanding spatial variations in luminescence and carrier dynamics. Work description: The work will include: 1. Development and optimization of TRCL measurement protocols for microLED characterization including the control of electron beam energy, beam current and sample temperature, 2. Investigation of carrier dynamics in microLED structures with particular attention to the influence of device dimensions, sidewalls, interfaces and material defects, 3. Data processing and analysis of multidimensional TRCL datasets, combining spatial, spectral and temporal information, and correlation with complementary characterization techniques such as Time Resolved Photoluminescence and Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy. Methods / Means Time Resolved Cathodoluminescence (TRCL) Applicant Profile The applicant must be strongly motivated to learn how to handle advanced facilities and analyze the data. He will have the opportunity to develop transverse skills as the work will be carried out with academic collaborators, and will involve issues of intellectual property, industrial experience with the LETI partners and a daily practise of English. Proper background in solid state physics is essential. Basic knowledge about luminescence techniques is not mandatory but will be appreciated. Possible continuation as a PhD thesis. Depending on the results of the internship and the candidate's performance, the internship may lead to a PhD thesis starting after the internship. items.desc: Etude de la corrélation entre les paramètres de cycles de NEP sur l’efficacité de nettoyage en milieu laitier Réf ABG-140618 Sujet de Thèse 20/10/2026 Cifre Biodymia (Université Lyon1-Isara Lyon)/PAPC (UMR PAM, Université de Bourgogne, Agrosup Dijon) Lieu de travail Lyon - Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes - France Intitulé du sujet Etude de la corrélation entre les paramètres de cycles de NEP sur l’efficacité de nettoyage en milieu laitier Champs scientifiques Sciences de l’ingénieur Agronomie, agroalimentaire Mots clés NEP, TACT, efficacité de nettoyage, durabilité, lait, process Description du sujet Le nettoyage en place (NEP) constitue un enjeu majeur dans l’industrie laitière, en particulier pour les lignes de lait stérilisé, où se combinent exigences de sécurité microbiologique, maintien de la disponibilité des équipements et maîtrise de l’encrassement. Malgré le recours à des séquences alcalines et acides classiques, l’efficacité du NEP reste fortement dépendante de la nature des dépôts, des conditions hydrodynamiques et de la configuration réelle des installations. Le traitement thermique du lait, étape indispensable à l’industrie laitière, modifie fortement la nature des souillures. Dans le cas de traitement plus sévère comme la stérilisation, les dépôts deviennent plus protéino-minéraux et plus difficiles à éliminer. La nettoyabilité est également fortement conditionnée par la géométrie de la ligne. Les échangeurs, coudes, vannes, dérivations et changements de section créent des hétérogénéités locales de vitesse, de cisaillement et de temps de résidence, susceptibles de favoriser l’accumulation des dépôts et leur persistance après NEP, créant ainsi des réservoirs microbiologiques. Cette thèse vise à comprendre de manière intégrée le nettoyage en place (NEP) d’une ligne de lait stérilisée, en reliant les paramètres TACT du cycle, les signaux réellement observés pendant le nettoyage, la géométrie de la ligne, la nature des dépôts et l’état microbiologique des surfaces à la performance hygiénique et environnementale. L’objectif est de dépasser une lecture purement normative du NEP pour construire une approche explicative, puis prédictive par intégration de données dans un modèle d’IA, de la performance réelle du nettoyage. L’objectif est majeur : réduire l’utilisation de ressource (eau, énergie et produits chimiques) utilisés lors des cycles de NEP, sans compromettre l’hygiène des équipements de production en industrie laitière. Prise de fonction : 04/01/2027 Nature du financement Cifre Précisions sur le financement Présentation établissement et labo d'accueil Biodymia (Université Lyon1-Isara Lyon)/PAPC (UMR PAM, Université de Bourgogne, Agrosup Dijon) Origine et composition L’équipe BioDyMIA a été créée sur l’initiative conjointe de l’université et de l’ISARA en 2011. Elle résulte de l’accrétion du LRGIA (laboratoire de recherche en génie industriel alimentaire) de l’IUT de Bourg-en Bresse, alors dirigé par le Pr Pascal Degraeve, avec le LMA, le laboratoire de microbiologie alimentaire, dont la responsable était Marie Jeanne Blachier. L’équipe s’est enrichie de l’apport de la plateforme analytique de l’Isara, constituée de sept laboratoires et structurée en 2018 sous le nom d’AgroLab (animateur : Yann Demarigny, EC). Ces sept laboratoires sont : microbiologie, chimie, biologie, physique, agronomie, automatisme, technologie. Elle comporte actuellement huit enseignants-chercheurs, quatre agents techniques et un support administratifs cinq doctorants. Mais elle a accueilli depuis 2019, dix doctorants sur les deux sites que compte BioDyMIA. Organisation et ressources Le budget moyen entre 2019 et 2024 était de 226 k€ dont un cinquième environ reposait sur des fonds propres récurrents. La plupart des autres ressources sont issues des contrats types ANR, FUI, et Région. Le budget global de l’équipe BioDyMIA fluctue globalement entre 100 et 300k€ en fonction des contrats et des projets développés, d’une année sur l’autre. La nature des contrats portés par BioDyMIA est variable, couvrant des ressources de différentes origine : contrats nationaux, internationaux, collectivités territoriales, partenariat avec environnement socio-économique, contrat financé par des associations caritatives et des fondations. Thématique de recherche Depuis sa création en 2011, BioDyMIA s’intéresse à la biopréservation des aliments au sens large du terme. Il s’agit de contrôler le développement des flores d’altérations et/ou pathogènes des aliments en exploitant des microorganismes (au sens strict du terme, essentiellement des bactéries lactiques, LAB) ou des biomolécules au sens large. L’objectif consiste à prolonger la durée de vie et/ou d’améliorer la qualité de matrices alimentaires périssables sensibles en ciblant les flores responsables de leur altération. items.desc: Magnets Scientist Reference 2026-297 Deadline 03/11/2026 Division Accelerator Institution ALBA is the Spanish synchrotron light source, a large research infrastructure operating thirteen beamlines, complementary facilities, and an Electron Microscopy Center, this last in partnership with other institutions. Currently constructing multiple more beamlines, expanding the Electron Microscopy Center, and integrating advanced data analytics, it sums up a wide range of infrastructures geared toward finding solutions to societal challenges. Located in Cerdanyola del Vallès (Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain), it is funded by the Spanish Government (Ministerio de Ciencia e Innovación) and the Catalan Government (Generalitat de Catalunya, Departament de Recerca i Universitats). The synchrotron light produced by 3 GeV electrons is used by thousands of researchers to analyse and understand the properties and functionality of matter, spanning a wide variety of fields, such as catalytic research, health, energy production/storage, environmental research, communication technologies, or cultural heritage. Our highly motivated staff works in a multidisciplinary work environment with an atmosphere formed by lived diversity, inclusion and respect for our colleagues. One of the goals of our gender equality plan is to reach parity within the Consortium’s different divisions and offices, and several actions have been taken to encourage applications from women mostly in scientific, engineer and technical job positions. Located close to Barcelona in a natural park and well connected by car and public transportation, with excellent connectivity to the world and an employer who understands the importance of life-work balance. Facing an upgrade to ALBA II, a 4th generation facility, which will increase dramatically brightness and coherent flux, ALBA is in a phase of growth and dynamics. Being a part of the ALBA team will promote your career and will give you the opportunities to explore new territories. For more information, you can take a look on our history watching this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gHMqiH4qBAo Tasks .CELLS is looking for a scientist or engineer to join the Magnets Group of ALBA, within the Accelerator Division. The position will focus on the development and implementation of the magnets for the ALBA II accelerator, covering the complete magnet lifecycle from design and specification through procurement, manufacturing follow-up, validation and magnetic characterization. The position will also contribute to the operation and development of the Magnetic Measurements Laboratory used for the characterization and validation of accelerator magnets. The main functions of the position will include: Participation in the design and development of magnets for the upgraded ALBA II accelerator. Preparation of magnet specifications and technical documentation for procurement. Follow-up of manufacturing contracts for ALBA II magnets, including both prototypes and series production. Technical interaction with magnet manufacturers and monitoring of manufacturing progress, quality and compliance with specifications. Participation in the preparation and execution of magnet validation and acceptance procedures. Operation of instruments and measurement systems for the magnetic characterization of accelerator magnets. Participation in the preparation of magnetic measurement procedures and protocols. Acquisition and post-processing of magnetic measurement data and preparation of measurement reports. Participation in the magnetic characterization and validation of magnet prototypes and series magnets. Development and improvement of measurement systems at Magnetic Measurements Laboratory. The candidate shall be available to travel, including occasional periods away from home. In due course, and depending on the development of the ALBA II project and the requirements of the Accelerator Division, the candidate will be expected to take up additional tasks within their area of expertise, as defined by the Division Head. Applications that do not present the aforementioned or required documentation during the selection procedure will not be accepted. items.desc: DESCRIPTION Amazon is looking for a focused Security Engineer who can take on a leadership role in responding to security issues across the largest cloud provider in the world. The right candidate must thrive in high-pressure situations, think like both an attacker and defender, and drive relevant teams to take the right actions in the right timeframes to mitigate risks. We are looking for an individual who can balance technical risks against business risks and consistently drive for the right results. They must have the passion for engineering novel solutions to complex security challenges, and recognize and fill gaps in capabilities. The ability to quickly design and build internal-facing tools that enable scaled programmatic automation is a plus. The successful candidate will have a good mix of deep technical knowledge and a demonstrated background in information security. We value broad and deep technical knowledge, specifically in the fields of cryptography, network security, software security, malware analysis, forensics, security operations, incident response, and emergent security intelligence. An ideal candidate should be able to accomplish most of the following: Confidently and intelligently respond to security incidents, and proactively consider how to prevent the same type of incidents from occurring in the future. Design and coordinate cohesive responses to security events that involve multiple teams across the organization. Build security utilities and tools for internal use that enable you and your fellow Security Engineers to operate at high speed and wide scale. Evaluate the impact to the organization of current security trends, advisories, publications, and academic research. Coordinate responses as necessary across affected teams to do the right thing for our customers and our organization. Ability to communicate effectively at multiple levels of sensitivity, and multiple audiences. Recognize, adopt and instill the best practices in security engineering fields throughout the organization: development, cryptography, network security, security operations, incident response, security intelligence. Provide subject matter expertise on architecture, authentication and system security. Fulfill regular on-call responsibilities. Key job responsibilities An ideal candidate should be able to accomplish most of the following: Triage/assess security issues and engage with internal service teams to ensure timely remediation of issues, escalating internally as necessary to ensure appropriate levels of urgency and engagement. Participate in efforts to promote security throughout the Company and build good working relationships within the team and with others across Amazon. Demonstrate high capacity and tolerance for context switching and interruptions while remaining productive and effective. Develop pragmatic solutions that achieve business requirements while maintaining an acceptable level of risk. Mentoring of junior staff and proactively share knowledge sharing within the team and across the company. Assist with hiring new employees Fulfil regular on-call responsibilities. A day in the life AWS Cloud Response is responsible for the security of AWS Cloud services. Our primary focus is to ensure the security of the cloud by working with service teams, vendors, and other stakeholders (both internal and external) to solve security challenges at massive scale, from incident response to emergent patching to helping publish guidance for customer impacting issues. We also work to develop tools and systems, and implement changes to drive automation, scalability and continuous improvements for our organization and AWS as a whole. About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. This position will be focused on the Security Assurance function, leading on day-to-day security assurance activities, evaluating compliance and providing evidence of how they meet the requirements of our most security conscious customers. Users store all their context (background, expertise, preferences, goals) in one place, and any AI tool can access it via MCP and APIs. The user controls what gets shared, with whom, at what depth. We've just raised pre-seed funding and are assembling the founding engineering team. This is the ground floor of a company building core infrastructure for the AI era. What You're Gonna Do Design and build a knowledge/memory system that structures user context for precise, traceable retrieval Build data processing pipelines that enrich, classify, and structure information as it flows in Design retrieval mechanisms that are cheap, accurate, and traceable to their root sources Implement permission-aware access control at the retrieval layer - enforcing per-app consent boundaries Evaluate and compare architectural approaches (knowledge graphs, hybrid retrieval, structured extraction) through rapid prototyping and benchmarking Design prompt engineering strategies and LLM pipeline architectures using commercially available models Collaborate directly with the CTO to shape the core technical direction of the product What We Require From You 2+ years of professional experience building ML/NLP/LLM systems in production Strong Python proficiency Deep understanding of retrieval architectures beyond basic RAG - hybrid search, structured extraction, re-ranking, query decomposition Comfort with rapid prototyping - building POCs, running experiments, measuring results, iterating fast Experience with AI-first programming - items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Agentic Low Code: Du entwickelst als Agentic Low Code Developer mit Copilot Studio und der Power Platform agentische Geschäftslösungen für die Fachbereiche unserer Kunden – von intelligenten Apps und Hyperautomation bis zu Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Enterprise-Umfeld. Du verbindest Low Code, KI und Prozessautomatisierung zu produktiven Lösungen und unterstützt beim Aufbau skalierbarer Governance-Strukturen. Agentische Low-Code-Entwicklung mit Copilot Studio: Du entwickelst mit Copilot Studio maßgeschneiderte KI-Agenten und Copiloten – inkl. Anbindung an Microsoft 365, Dataverse und branchenspezifische Datenquellen – und etablierst agentische Low-Code-Entwicklungsprozesse als gelebte Praxis: von der Orchestrierung mehrerer Agenten über Qualitätskriterien und Evaluierung bis zur Überwachung im Produktivbetrieb. Intelligente Applikationen entwickeln: Du konzipierst und entwickelst Geschäftsanwendungen mit Power Apps und setzt dabei konsequent auf KI-gestützte Funktionen wie AI Builder und Copilot-Integration auf Basis unternehmensinterner Datenquellen. Prozessautomatisierung und Hyperautomation: Du entwirfst und implementierst intelligente Workflows mit Power Automate – von klassischen Geschäftsprozessen über RPA bis hin zu KI-gestützten Automatisierungen, die Daten analysieren, klassifizieren und Entscheidungen vorbereiten. Architektur und Integration: Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen, die Power Platform und Copilot Studio mit Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Azure-Diensten und Drittsystemen nahtlos verbinden. Beratung und Governance: Du führst Envisioning- und Discovery-Workshops durch, priorisierst Automatisierungs- und Agenten-Kandidaten und unterstützt beim Aufbau von Center-of-Excellence-Strukturen sowie Governance-Frameworks für den skalierbaren und sicheren Einsatz der Power Platform im Enterprise-Umfeld. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens drei Jahre im Power Platform-Umfeld und technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahre mit konkretem Fokus auf Microsoft Copilot Studio im produktiven Einsatz. Fundierte Ausbildung: Ein Studienabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten Bereich bildet die theoretische Basis. Power-Platform-Erfahrung: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio und Dataverse mit. Agentische und AI-Kompetenz: Du bist begeistert von Copilot Studio und den Möglichkeiten, die agentische KI in der Low-Code-Entwicklung eröffnet, und bringst Interesse oder erste Erfahrung in der Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten und Multi-Agenten-Szenarien im Low-Code-Umfeld mit. Integrations- und Architekturkompetenz: Du hast Erfahrungen mit Konnektoren, APIs und der Anbindung von Azure-Diensten oder Drittsystemen sowie die Fähigkeit, übergreifende Lösungen zu entwerfen, die Power Platform sinnvoll in bestehende IT-Landschaften einbetten. Beratungs- und KI-Kompetenz: Du überzeugst Fachbereiche und IT-Entscheider gleichermaßen, übersetzt technische Sachverhalte in Business-Sprache und nutzt KI-Tools souverän im Fachgebiet – inklusive kritischer Bewertung der Ergebnisse und Enablement von Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden. Sprachkenntnisse: Du hast sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.card: Your role and responsibilities At the ABB Corporate Research Center Germany ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vd4BLrNbvlc ), we research and prototype innovative technologies that shape ABB’s future product portfolio for sustainable automation, digitalization, and electrification. We work in cross-functional teams at the intersection of industrial research, end-customers, start-ups, and universities globally. The
items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
R&D Team Lead 
 __
 Your role and responsibilities 
 At the ABB Corporate Research Center Germany ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vd4BLrNbvlc ), we research and prototype innovative technologies that shape ABB’s future product portfolio for sustainable automation, digitalization, and electrification. We work in cross-functional teams at the intersection of industrial research, end-customers, start-ups, and universities globally. 
The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-Hybrid 
You will be mainly accountable for: 
 You bridge the gap between academic research and industrial applications and drive the innovation in simulation, system modelling and industrial digitalization to contribute to future ABB solutions.
 You develop and apply hybrid modeling that combines analytical approaches and data-driven methods to represent the behavior of assets in process industry and manufacturing. 
 You leverage physics-informed AI methods that combine first-principles knowledge of industrial systems to develop more interpretable, efficient, and reliable models for simulation and process optimization. 
 You bring a system integration perspective to your work, meaning you understand how components, control logic, and physical dynamics interact at plant or system level, rather than focusing on purely mathematical modeling.
 You build simulation models used to validate control logic, support scenario analysis, and enable process optimization and operator training for complex industrial processes.· 
 You converge domain expertise with engineering practice, translating knowledge of industrial plant dynamics into robust simulation and monitoring systems. 
 With your technical expertise, you initiate, guide, and contribute to applied research projects, and you provide consultancy to product development teams. 
 You collaborate internationally with ABB divisions, customers, partners, startups, and renowned academic institutes. 
 You build prototypes and demonstrators, and you bring a software development and architecture mindset to turn simulation models into usable, maintainable tools.
 You present your work to expert and management audiences within and outside ABB, as well as at scientific conferences/journals and trade fairs.
 You secure intellectual property by patent applications.
 Qualifications for the role 
 You hold a degree in engineering, scientific computing, mathematics, physics, or a related discipline with specialization on modeling and simulation, combined with either academic experience (PhD) or professional experience in applied modeling and simulation. 
 Experience with model based, data based, and/or physics-informed AI based simulation and monitoring methods for dynamic systems. 
 Domain knowledge of industrial plant or process dynamics, with a focus on system level behavior and system integration. 
 Experience with machine learning and AI methods, including neural networks, deep learning, or reinforcement learning, preferably applied to dynamical systems, process modeling, or real-world applications. 
 Experience in one or more of the following application areas is beneficial: automation engineering, industrial control, condition monitoring, advanced process control and optimization. 
 Hands on experience in software development and software architecture is a plus (for example Python, C++, Modelica, or similar).
 Hands on experience with simulation and modeling tools is a plus (such as OpenModelica, Julia, FMU based co-simulation, DWSIM, the IDEAS PSE framework, or commercial tools such as Dymola, Aspen HYSYS, Matlab Simulink / Simscape or similar). 
 Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal. German is a plus.We value cross-cultural communication skills, creativity, initiative, enthusiasm, and result-orientation to bring your innovations towards new products and digital offerings.
 Benefits 
We also offer our employees the following benefits: 
 Employee Share Acquisition Plan 
 Retirement Plan 
 Canteen 
 Flexible Work Practices 
 More about us 
 Take your next career step at ABB by joining a global team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.
 At ABB we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each and every one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences. 
Interested in joining our team? We are looking forward to receiving your complete application through our online tool.
 Would you like to receive further information? 
 Please contact Dr. Marco Lauricella: …

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Music team owns music and sound effects end to end at ElevenLabs. We turn research breakthroughs into APIs and creative tools, from the backend systems that bring in new models to the interfaces creators use inside ElevenCreative. Five new research engineers have just joined the music research group, and models for stem separation and MIDI transcription are in progress.

You’ll join as a Full-Stack Engineer with a backend lean. You’ll work with research and research engineering to bring model improvements into production, and build and run the APIs behind them. You’ll also sync with go-to-market to decide which features, including bespoke enterprise ones, get built next. Occasionally you’ll join customer calls when a customer wants someone technical.

Engineers act as PMs. You’ll be handed ambiguous goals and expected to break them down. That means working through the legal questions, choosing the engineering approach, and planning the launch with growth. Models set the limits, so you’ll design systems that let a better model be swapped in later. Engineering is often only half the job.

Requirements

 - A strong Full-Stack Engineer with a backend lean. You’ve built and shipped production APIs and backend systems.

 - A product decomposition mindset. You’ve taken a vague goal, weighed trade-offs and shipped without analysis paralysis.

 - Proactive ownership. You drive work end to end without a ticket board or someone assigning tasks.

 - Comfortable working across research, legal, safety, growth, design and enterprise customers.

 - Genuinely excited about music and AI. You’re the kind of person who prototypes ideas for fun and pushes the good ones into production.

Bonus: music or audio experience (even as a hobby), or experience shipping ML models into production.

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in Central European timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements

 - Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

 - Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

 - Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

 - Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

 - Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

items.desc:
OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

 

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one? 
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for industrial placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates. 
 What you will do as an Industrial Placement Software Engineer 
 You can look forward to working with highly skilled professionals who are passionate about their work of designing and developing cutting edge technology for a worldwide market. 
 It is likely that you will need to be in the office for a least 4 days per week, although you may be able to work some days from home, depending on your projects. You will report to an experienced Software Engineer who will provide day to day guidance and on-the-job training. You will be introduced to the software development processes and utilise state-of-the-art methods, technology and tools. You will also gain experience on one or more aspects of the software development lifecycle, which could include: applied research, requirements analysis, design, implementation, integration and test. 
 During your 1-year placement, you will spend half of your time working on an existing customer-facing project and the other half working on a project with other industrial placement software, systems, electronics, firmware, hardware and antenna engineers. There will also be opportunities to work as STEM ambassadors in schools, colleges and universities. 
 Particular emphasis will be placed on learning practical skills that may not be easily gained or experienced in the academic environment of a university. 
 Key Responsibility Areas 
 As part of our early careers community, you will work alongside developers and experts in an environment that is both challenging and rewarding. Your responsibilities will include: 
 Gaining experience, applying your knowledge of software engineering as part of an Integrated Project Team. 
 Developing practical skills in design techniques for land, sea or aerospace applications. 
 Growing your understanding of the business as well as the software engineering lifecycle. 
 What you will bring 
 Entry Requirements 
 All of our Industrial Placement roles require you to be currently studying a relevant degree discipline. 
 We would like to hear from you if you are currently studying the following degrees 
 Software Engineering 
 Computer Science 
 Need to have an understanding of software engineering principles with knowledge of programming in one or more software language(s). 
 Possess excellent communication and inter-personal skills and have the confidence and ability to challenge and contribute. 
 Have an enthusiasm and passion for software development. 
 Be able to demonstrate and apply system-level thinking. 
 Security Clearance 
 Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting 
 Why join us 
 At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, our teams are key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive. 
 Time to recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year. 
 Secure your future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer …
