items.desc:
Your mission 
 Put your software engineering skills to work for the energy transition. The Photovoltaics and Thin Film Electronics Laboratory (PV-Lab) at EPFL is seeking a motivated Software Engineer to take responsibility for its monitoring platform and dashboards, and to lead a work package within a Horizon Europe project.
 Based in Neuchâtel, you will develop reliable software that turns data from photovoltaic installations, weather stations and laboratory experiments into useful information for researchers and project partners. You will combine hands-on development with project coordination in an international, multidisciplinary team with strong links to CSEM and industry.
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 You will:
 Take ownership of the PV-Lab monitoring platform and dashboards, including maintenance, troubleshooting and further development. Work with colleagues and users to define requirements and prioritize improvements. Ensure traceability and consistent metadata.
 Develop applications to collect, validate, process and store data from monitoring sites, sensors and external APIs. Ensure data quality and reliable operation.
 Manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, and automate builds and deployments through GitLab CI/CD. Maintain logging, alerts, backups and secure configuration in coordination with EPFL IT.
 Lead Horizon Europe work packages: coordinate partners and tasks, plan resources, track milestones and risks, and ensure timely delivery of technical deliverables and progress reports. Organize meetings and represent the work package in project discussions.
 Write maintainable, tested and documented code. Support researchers using the platform and share technical knowledge within PV-Lab.
 Participate in internal scientific meetings and seminars, as well as local and international conferences. Contribute to writing scientific papers in collaboration with PV-Lab researchers and project partners.
 Supervise and mentor students working on software development, monitoring and data analysis, helping them plan their projects, review their code and interpret their results.
 Your profile 
 Essential qualifications and skills
 A degree in computer science, software engineering, data engineering, engineer in physics with strong software skills or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Strong Python programming skills and experience developing and maintaining applications used by others, including automated testing, debugging and documentation.
 Good command of SQL and relational database design, with experience in data processing and HTTP API integration.
 Experience with Git, collaborative development and Docker, together with an understanding of CI/CD and application deployment.
 Ability to translate user needs into reliable data visualization tools and usable dashboards.
 Strong organizational and communication skills, with experience coordinating technical activities and the ability to manage partner contributions, deadlines and deliverables independently.
 A clear motivation to contribute to the energy transition and to learn about photovoltaic technology systems. Excellent written and spoken English and a collaborative approach to working with researchers and engineers.
 Additional assets
 Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD and container registries, Grafana, SQLite, Linux administration or reverse proxies.
 Experience developing web interfaces with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, or Python-based web frameworks.
 Familiarity with time-series data, sensor integration, photovoltaic monitoring or energy performance analysis.
 Experience in Horizon Europe or other collaborative R&D projects, particularly work package coordination and technical reporting. French language skills are an advantage.
 We offer 
 A dynamic and stimulating work environment
 Access to state-of-the-art research facilities and laboratory resources
 Opportunity to collaborate with world-class scientists through a network of national and international stakeholders
 Opportunity to work at EPFL, an internationally renowned and top-ranking engineering university, which offers a dynamic, stimulating, interdisciplinary, international and friendly working environment, a broad range of scientific training and networking events and also hosts a vibrant entrepreneurial community
 Opportunity to combine research, scientific leadership, project management and industrial collaboration within a single role.
 Informations 
 Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. 
 Contract Start Date : 01/01/2027 
 Activity Rate Min : 80.00 
 Activity Rate Max : 100.00 
 Contract Type: CDD
 Duration: 1 year renouvelable 
 Reference: 2527

items.title: Research Associate on the structural biology of bacterial secretion systems
items.card: About the role We are seeking to recruit an enthusiastic and motivated structural biologist to join the group of Prof Harry Low, Department of Infectious Disease (www.thelowlab.org). The research project focuses on determining the molecular mechanism of bacterial secretion systems including the Tad and Type 4 pilus systems. The position is funded by an 8 year Wellcome Trust Discovery award. What you would be doing
items.desc: Job number MED06036 Faculties Faculty of Medicine Departments Department of Infectious Disease Salary or Salary range £50,733 - £59,484 per annum Location/campus South Kensington Campus - On site only Contract type work pattern Full time - Fixed term Posting End Date 16 Nov 2026 About the role We are seeking to recruit an enthusiastic and motivated structural biologist to join the group of Prof Harry Low, Department of Infectious Disease (www.thelowlab.org). The research project focuses on determining the molecular mechanism of bacterial secretion systems including the Tad and Type 4 pilus systems. The position is funded by an 8 year Wellcome Trust Discovery award. What you would be doing You will be leading your own project working from initial clones through to protein purification, structure determination and biochemical/biophysical mechanistic dissection. You will be working on challenging multi-component membrane complexes both in-vitro and in-cell. Specific methodology will include a range of structural biology techniques including cryo-electron microscopy (SPA, in-situ SPA and tomography), and TIRF microscopy combined with single molecule FRET to probe protein dynamics. What we are looking for You will have a PhD in structural biology, either cryo-EM, X-ray crystallography or NMR. Candidates who have not yet been officially awarded their PhD will be appointed as a Research Assistant within the salary range £45,399 - £48,876 per annum. Experience in the design and execution of workflow for structure determination of proteins, from molecular biology/biochemical experiments (e.g. DNA cloning and mutagenesis, protein purification) through to structural data collection, processing and model building is expected. Experience in cryo-EM workflows including sample preparation, data collection and processing is essential. Experience in light microscopy studies is desirable. You must have a strong research track record demonstrated by at least one first author publication in an international journal or bioRxiv. What we can offer you An inclusive and friendly lab environment that aims to support you in your mission to make important discoveries and generate impactful publications. A well-funded lab underpinned by world class facilities. Opportunities to attend national and international conferences to showcase your work and grow your academic network. The opportunity to continue your career at a world-leading institution and be part of our mission to continue science for humanity. Grow your career: gain access to Imperial’s sector-leading dedicated career support for researchers as well as opportunities for promotion and progression. Sector-leading salary and remuneration package (including 39 days off a year and generous pension schemes). Be part of a diverse, inclusive and collaborative work culture with various staff networks and resources to support your personal and professional wellbeing. Further information This is a full-time (35 h/w) and fixed-term for 24 months. Visa costs associated with moving to the UK will be covered. Recognized for its strong involvement in the socio-economic development of the Hauts-De-France region, the Inria center at the University of Lille maintains a close relationship with large companies and SMEs. By fostering synergies between researchers and industry, Inria contributes to the transfer of skills and expertise in the field of digital technologies, and provides access to the best of European and international research for the benefit of innovation and businesses, particularly in the region. For over 10 years, the Inria center at the University of Lille has been at the heart of Lille's university and scientific ecosystem, as well as at the heart of Frenchtech, with a technology showroom based on avenue de Bretagne in Lille, on the EuraTechnologies site of economic excellence dedicated to information and communication technologies (ICT). Contexte et atouts du poste The person will join the cross disciplinary project Loop (closed Loop neurOtechnologies: from sensOrs to aPplications). The project will implement an interdisciplinary strategy applied to the development of a mechanism-based therapy for drug-resistant hallucinations in patients with schizophrenia. The project will be structured around three main research pillars: 1) the algorithmic level of closed-loop systems (online signal processing, machine learning); 2) the design of a complete and non-invasive solution to address the question of refractory hallucinations, and study how closed-loop interaction schemes can be beneficial for highly impaired psychiatric patients; 3) the design of the sensors themselves and translational research with animal models, in order to enhance the quality of the recordings and pave the way for future invasive miniaturized solutions. In this context, the objective is to apply federated and decentralized learning techniques to learn predictive models. Mission confiée The objective is to adapt the declearn API to the specific case of FRMI and EEG data, time series and eventually to address the problem of federated learning in the neuromorphic paradigm. The work plan is the following Join the team that writes the data preparation pipeline. The challenges are the scalability with respect to data size, data dimensionality, and time dependent data. The declearn readers and data representation choices will be monitored and adapted to the new choices and constraints. Adapt and implement federated algorithms tailored to the learning problem specifications. A specific attention will be on the scalability and the efficiency of the communications. Extend DecLearn to the fully decentralized setting. Address the problem of privacy. Implement specific approaches for neuromorphic computation. Principales activités Develop code. Write documentation. Write tests. Launch experiments. Report activity in the consortium. items.desc: Department: Department of Physics contract duration: limited untill 30.06.2029 Salary / pay grade: E 13 TV-L FU Working hours: 75 % Requisition ID: 968 Application deadline: 09.11.2026 Salary calculator TV-L Salary Student assistant TV Stud III Who We Are The Mueller group studies nanoscale light-matter coupling phenomena in quantum materials. We use polaritons to shrink light to the nanoscale and employ ultrafast nonlinear optical techniques to bridge phenomena in the typically separate mid-infrared and visible spectral ranges. We aim to advance the understanding of 2D quantum materials, activate new coupling channels to convert light between different spectral ranges, and engineer materials through hybrid light-matter states. Our group is funded by the Emmy Noether Programme of the German Research Foundation (DFG). More about the group: www.physik.fu-berlin.de/en/einrichtungen/ag/ag-mueller/ The position is part of the Collaborative Research Centre CRC 1772 "mol2Dmat", which studies collective states and quantum phenomena in heterostructures of molecules and two-dimensional materials. 2D materials are atomically thin crystals that can be stacked into heterostructures with entirely new properties. CRC 1772 goes a step further by combining them with organic and inorganic molecules. The consortium brings together 20 physics and chemistry groups from Freie Universität Berlin, Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin, and Technische Universität Berlin. More about CRC 1772: www.crc1772.de What You Can Expect in Your New Role As a PhD student, you will work on the CRC project “Nonlinear imaging of structural order and symmetry breaking in mol2Dmat heterostructures” under the supervision of Dr. Niclas Mueller, starting as soon as possible. Specifically, you will: investigate how molecules self-assemble into ordered 2D lattices on van der Waals materials, and how collective excitonic states emerge in these heterostructures help build a new sum-frequency generation (SFG) microscope that combines ultrafast mid-infrared and visible lasers use nonlinear optical and photoluminescence microscopy to link the structural order of molecular lattices to the crystal structure of the underlying 2D material develop ways to tune the nonlinear optical response of these heterostructures through molecular charge transfer and electric fields collaborate closely with partner groups in the CRC, present your work at international conferences, and publish in leading journals What we offer: The structured, interdisciplinary graduate program of CRC 1772, with tailored training, workshops, retreats, and funding for conference travel A newly built, state-of-the-art nonlinear- and nano-optics laboratory Close, hands-on supervision in a young and growing group A large scientific network across Berlin's three major universities Key Requirements Master’s degree in Physics, Physical Chemistry, or a related discipline, completed by the start of the position. Desirable Research experience, for example from your Master's thesis, in at least one of these areas: nonlinear optics, 2D materials, organic semiconductors, or solid-state physics. Hands-on experience with experimental work, ideally optical setups Python programming skills, ideally including lab instrument automation Excellent command of written and spoken English; experience with scientific communication in English. Enthusiasm for teamwork and strong motivation to work on open scientific questions. We are committed to building a diverse research community and particularly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply. Have we sparked your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your application documents: A motivation letter explaining your interest in the project and relevant experience, as well as your earliest possible start date Your CV Certificates including transcripts of records from your Bachelor's and Master's studies. If you have not yet completed your Master's degree, please submit a current transcript of records and indicate when you expect to complete your degree. Please submit your application exclusively via our career portal by clicking the "Apply now" button. Applications submitted by post or by e-mail unfortunately cannot be considered. For further information, please contact Dr. Niclas Mueller (niclas.mueller@fu-berlin.de). Please note Freie Universität Berlin is an equal opportunity employer.

items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION A nutrition technician is required for Endocrinology and Nutrition research group to conduct research. The successful candidate will also be responsible for entering and managing the collected data in the REDCap database. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Performance of morphofunctional assessments of patients using bioelectrical impedance analysis (BIA), strength assessment, and anthropometric measurements, as well as the evaluation of the results. Performance of nutritional assessments and evaluation of the results. Data management: accurately entering patient data into the REDCap database within the established timelines. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE Hold a bachelor's degree in Human Nutrition and Dietetics. Willingness to work in the field of Endocrinology and Nutrition. Ability and willingness to work in a team. Proven prior experience in clinical research. Proven good level of English. WHAT WE OFFER Type of contract and working hours: Permanent, part-time employment contract (10 hours per week) under the Spanish Science Law / Ley de la Ciencia. Estimated start date: 01/11/2026. Gross annual remuneration inherent to the square objected to this call, will be fixed based on the experience provided and the skills of the candidate, distributed in 12 payments. Flexible payment (childminding vouchers). 23 days holiday and 5 days for personal matters. Training capsules by the company. Be part of an excellent multidisciplinary research centre with the HRS4R badge. Location on the Can Ruti Campus, a first-class translational research environment in the Barcelona area, in a very stimulating scientific environment. The IGTP offers a supportive, friendly and collaborative ecosystem to promote professional development and help you achieve your research goals. FOR MORE INFORMATION http://www.germanstrias.org/ HOW TO APPLY Interested persons must attach to the application: Motivation letter explaining their interest in the position. Updated CV. Contact of 2-3 references. Applications will be evaluated in accordance with the guiding principles and objectives of the supply systems, following the process described below: Curricular evaluation : analysis of the curriculum vitae to assess aspects related to training, professional career and experience in positions related to the job position under selection. Personal interview : once the résumé has been evaluated, the selected candidates will be called for a personal interview to verify and expand on the information detailed in the résumé and to evaluate aspects related to experience and professional skill s. Applications that do not meet the requirements, that are not included in the cases foreseen or that are not processed in accordance with the established procedure will not be considered in the selection process. DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS The call for applications will close on October 28th, 2026. About us The Germans Trias i Pujol Research Institute (IGTP) is a public research centre located in Badalona. Its main objective is to increase scientific knowledge in order to transform it into solutions to improve the health and medical care of patients and the community. The Institute is associated with one of the major university hospitals in the Barcelona area, the Germans Trias i Pujol Hospital, and is part of the Can Ruti biomedical campus. IGTP is a CERCA centre and is also accredited as a centre of excellence by the Instituto de Salud Carlos III (ISCIII) and is in charge of coordinating the management and scientific strategy of the campus, working in close collaboration with the other centres. The Germans Trias i Pujol Research Institute carries out research within 9 areas: Cancer Cardiovascular and Respiratory Diseases Community Health Diseases of the Liver and Digestive Tract Endocrine and Diseases of the Metabolism, Bones and Kidneys Immunology and Inflammation Infectious Diseases Neuroscience Science of Behaviour and Substance Abuse Scientists working in these areas publish an average of over 900 papers a year, contribute to improved treatment and healthcare protocols, produce patents and set up spin-off companies in order to improve the lives of patients. The following video is a bird's eye view of Campus Can Ruti a top-tier translational research environment in the Barcelona area, in a very stimulating scientific environment. items.desc: Shape the Future with Us. At Lubrizol, we’re bringing to life the chemistry behind clean water, efficient transportation, reliable infrastructure, critical medicines, and the products people rely on every day through science, sustainability, and a culture of inclusion. As part of our global team, you’ll be empowered to make a real impact - on your career, your community, and the world around you. Working alongside experienced laboratory technicians, chemists, and PhD scientists, you will contribute to projects that influence industry standards, support product claims, and drive product quality improvements. Genuine interest in scientific research, innovation, and product development. Confidence presenting scientific findings to a variety of audiences. Interest in automotive, industrial, or specialty chemical applications. We continuously invest in our facilities and technologies to support your wellbeing, productivity, and growth. Subsidised on-site restaurant facilities. Free on-site parking. Learning and development opportunities. Career and professional growth within a global organisation. Our Commitment Lubrizol is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. Next Steps Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until a sufficient number of candidates have been identified. We encourage you to apply as early as possible. items.desc: About Us: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Ideal Background: This role is ideal for engineers who have built production systems at companies like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Meta, or similar high-scale engineering organizations. We especially welcome graduates from top computer science programs such as Stanford, MIT, Carnegie Mellon, UC Berkeley, Georgia Tech, and comparable institutions — though exceptional experience and skill always take precedence over pedigree. Project Overview: As a Software Engineering evaluator, you will create cutting-edge datasets for training, benchmarking, and advancing large language models, collaborating closely with researchers. This includes curating code examples, providing precise solutions, and making corrections — with a primary focus on Python across backend services, data pipelines, and ML infrastructure, alongside JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go. You will evaluate and refine AI-generated code for efficiency, scalability, and reliability, and work with cross-functional teams to enhance enterprise-level AI-driven coding solutions. What Does a Typical Day Look Like? Work on AI model training initiatives by curating code examples, building solutions, and correcting code — primarily in Python, with additional work in JavaScript (including ReactJS), C/C++, Java, Rust, and Go. Evaluate and refine AI-generated code to ensure that it is efficient, scalable, and reliable. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance AI-driven coding solutions against industry performance benchmarks. Build agents and automated verification tools in Python that can verify the quality of code and identify error patterns. Hypothesize on steps in the software engineering cycle (prototyping, architecture design, API design, production implementation, launch, experiments, monitoring, operational maintenance) and evaluate model capabilities on them. Design verification mechanisms that can automatically verify a solution to a software engineering task. Required Skills: Several years of software engineering experience (3 years or more). Strong expertise in Python with deep knowledge of frameworks, tooling, and best practices for building production-grade software. Experience building full-stack applications and deploying scalable software using modern languages and tools. Deep understanding of software architecture, design, development, debugging, and code quality/review assessment. Excellent oral and written communication skills for clear, structured evaluation rationales. Engagement Details: Commitment: flexible engagement, minimum 10 hrs/week, up to 40 hrs/week. Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave). Duration: 1 month (potential extensions based on performance and fit). Location: Candidates must be based in the United States. Evaluation Process: The application process takes 15–30 minutes. Completion of an AI video interview is required.

Concevoir & déployer sur le cloud : vous designez, développez et déployez des architectures cloud modernes (principalement AWS) et des services backend scalables au service des produits d’IA. Construire des systèmes agentiques : vous développez des agents, des systèmes RAG et des pipelines sur
items.desc:
Chez Kiiro , nous accompagnons nos clients, de la scale-up aux grands comptes, dans la conception et l’industrialisation de leurs produits IA & data.
 En tant qu’ AI Engineer, vous construisez les systèmes qui orchestrent leurs modèles et résolvent leurs problèmes métiers.
En pratique, comptez environ 90 % de temps projet client (conception, build, industrialisation) et 10 % de contribution interne (partenariats, montée en compétence des équipes).
 Vous ne serez pas seul·e : rejoignez une équipe Data habituée au travail à distance, et vous vous appuyez sur nos partenariats Databricks et AWS. 
 Ce poste est ouvert aux profils ayant un background mixte en développement logiciel, Data Engineering ou Machine Learning, justifiant d’environ 1 an d’expérience concrète sur des architectures IA. 
 Vos missions : 
 Cadrer avec le client : vous êtes en première ligne pour comprendre le besoin et poser les bonnes questions.
 Concevoir & déployer sur le cloud : vous designez, développez et déployez des architectures cloud modernes (principalement AWS) et des services backend scalables au service des produits d’IA.
 Construire des systèmes agentiques : vous développez des agents, des systèmes RAG et des pipelines sur des données non structurées (documents, Speech-to-Text), principalement sur AWS et Databricks.
 Mettre en prod : CI/CD, conteneurs, infra as code, observabilité. Vous travaillez la latence, le coût des tokens et la tenue en charge.
 Évaluer & fiabiliser : vous mettez en place les évaluations et les garde-fous qui permettent de savoir si le système répond juste.
 Rester en veille & évangéliser : l’écosystème bouge très rapidement. Vous partagez ce qui mérite vraiment d’être adopté, en interne comme chez le client 🦸‍♂️
 Côté interne : 
 Partenariats : vous soutenez nos partenariats Databricks & AWS sur le volet technique.
 Diffusion de la culture Data & IA : webinars, événements en présentiel co-animés avec nos partenaires, publication d’articles.
 L’environnement technique : 
 Langages : Python, SQL
 Cloud & Serverless : AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, Bedrock, Secrets Manager, KMS), Databricks.
 Bases de données & stockage : PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cassandra.
 IA, Data & outillage : Python, SQL, architectures RAG, frameworks d’orchestration d’agents, Speech-to-Text, dbt, Fivetran, Airbyte.
 Pratiques : MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD, conteneurisation.

Nous ne cherchons pas un profil parfait !L’IA évolue trop vite pour ça. Ce qui nous intéresse, c’est quelqu’un qui a déjà mis un système d’IA en production, qui l’a vu casser, et qui sait pourquoi.Ce qui compte pour nous :Vous avez au moins 3 ans en développement logiciel, Data Engineering ou ML, en produit ou en ESN.Vous êtes hands-on : solide expérience en Python et SQL.Vous avez construit et mis en production au moins un système d’IA générative : RAG, orchestration d’agents (Agentcore, Agent Bricks etc), usage d’APIs LLM, traitement de données non structurées.Vous avez une connaissance pratique des services Cloud AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, Secrets Manager, KMS, Bedrock). Vous venez de GCP ou d’Azure, les réflexes se transfèrent.Vous avez de bonnes pratiques software & DevOps : de bonnes bases en industrialisation applicative (CI/CD, conteneurisation Docker, versioning, tests automatisés).Français professionnel obligatoire et anglais technique.Vous avez une posture conseil :Communication et force de proposition : vous êtes en capacité d’interagir efficacement avec les équipes de développement et les différentes parties prenantes.Autonomie et gestion des priorités, en équipe comme en solo.Les petits + qui font plaisir :Une expérience sur Databricks.Des certifications AWS ou DatabricksCe poste n’est probablement PAS pour vous si…Vous n’avez jamais écrit de code qui tourne en production : votre parcours en ESN s’est fait côté pilotage ou coordination.Vous êtes plus à l’aise avec le POC qu’avec la production et tout ce qu’elle implique (monitoring, évals, incidents).Vous préférez recevoir des specs toutes faites plutôt qu’aller cadrer le besoin chez le client.Ce que nous vous proposons :🤑 Rémunération : 40 à 60K€.💪 Développement des compétences : formations certifiantes AWS et Databricks prises en charge, accompagnement individualisé, budget conférences.🏡 Rythme : hybride, télétravail fréquent et horaires flexibles.🚀 Une aventure à construire : vous n’arrivez pas dans une case figée. Votre expérience, votre savoir-être et votre ambition participeront activement au développement de votre rôle. Une trajectoire qui se construit avec celle de l’entreprise. Si vous avez envie de laisser votre empreinte plutôt que d’appliquer un cadre existant, vous allez vous plaire ici 🫶

items.desc: Akkodis est une société internationale de conseil en ingénierie numérique (digital engineering) qui accompagne les organisations dans leurs efforts d'innovation et de développement grâce à des solutions technologiques permettant de repenser la conception et l'optimisation des processus et produits. Fort de nos expertises reconnues en ingénierie, performance industrielle, digital et IA, nous associons solutions technologiques, approches cross-sectorielles et solides capacités d'exécution pour fournir des services de pointe en conseil en technologie. Ce poste s'inscrit dans un contexte d'innovation en intelligence artificielle appliquée au secteur médical et d'industrialisation de projets de R&D. Vous interviendrez sur des missions à fort impact, en lien avec l'architecture de solutions IA et la transformation numérique des pratiques de santé. Responsabilités principales : Concevoir, développer et optimiser des modèles d'intelligence artificielle répondant aux besoins médicaux spécifiques. Analyser, interpréter et valoriser des données médicales complexes pour améliorer les diagnostics cliniques. Collaborer étroitement avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires pour intégrer l'IA dans les processus métiers et cliniques. Assurer la conformité des solutions IA avec les normes éthiques, réglementaires et de confidentialité en santé. Participer à la formation et à la sensibilisation des professionnels de santé à l'usage de l'IA. Réaliser le prototypage rapide, piloter des PoC et rédiger des rapports techniques et scientifiques. Effectuer une veille scientifique et technique, valoriser les travaux R&D et contribuer à la publication d'articles scientifiques. Environnement de travail : Vous rejoignez la Direction Recherche & Développement Appliqué d'Akkodis et travaillez sur une diversité de projets innovants en environnement pluridisciplinaire. Vous évoluez au sein d'une équipe dynamique, ouverte à l'exploration technique, avec des interactions fréquentes avec des partenaires industriels et académiques. Vous participez à la gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, à la veille scientifique et à la transformation commerciale des solutions développées. Profil du candidat Diplômé(e) d'un doctorat (Bac+8) ou d'un diplôme d'ingénieur Bac+5 avec au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la data science, de l'intelligence artificielle ou des technologies médicales. Vous maîtrisez les algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique et profond, la programmation en Python ou R, ainsi que la gestion et la sécurisation des bases de données médicales. Vous démontrez une compréhension des enjeux réglementaires et éthiques en santé, ainsi que des aptitudes pour la gestion de projets et le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire. Des compétences complémentaires en mathématiques appliquées, cybersécurité, modélisation probabiliste ou dynamique des systèmes sont appréciées. La maîtrise des outils de visualisation de données et un anglais courant sont requis. Akkodis accompagne ses clients dans la mondialisation de leurs projets, aussi un anglais courant est requis pour l'ensemble de nos collaborateurs.​

These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. items.desc: Depuis 2019, Nextra s’affirme comme un hub d’innovation dédié à la data et à l’intelligence artificielle, en rupture avec les codes traditionnels du conseil. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU. Contribute to prototypes using methods suited to the problem, including language models where appropriate, and test outputs carefully before sharing them. Curiosity about real client problems, willingness to ask questions and ability to explain your thinking in clear written and spoken English. items.desc: About ELTEMATE ELTEMATE is a Hogan Lovells legal technology company. We make clients’ lives easier by delivering practical solutions to complex, everyday legal problems. We combine a deep understanding of legal work with the speed and ambition of a technology company. Our portfolio spans artificial intelligence, eDiscovery, information analysis, regulatory intelligence, deal rooms, workflow and case management, document automation, risk assessment, reporting, and legal applications. The Role We are looking for a passionate Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and operate intelligent products in the age of agentic software development. You will develop AI systems that can reason, use tools, retrieve knowledge, automate workflows, and collaborate effectively with people. Working closely with product managers, legal experts, and software engineers, you will turn rapidly evolving AI capabilities into reliable, secure, and genuinely useful products. This role is ideal for someone who combines curiosity about emerging AI with strong software-engineering discipline. You enjoy moving quickly, communicating clearly, taking ownership, and shipping solutions that solve real-world problems. What You’ll Do Design, build, and operate agentic AI applications, workflows, and services. Develop systems using foundation models, open-weight models, retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, and multi-step orchestration. Evaluate model and agent behavior for quality, reliability, latency, cost, safety, and business impact. Write clean, maintainable, production-ready Python for inference, data processing, APIs, evaluation, and deployment. Build guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, observability, and failure-recovery mechanisms for AI systems. Develop APIs and integrate AI capabilities into existing products and backend services. Select the right model for each use case, balancing proprietary and open-weight alternatives. Prototype quickly, validate ideas with users, and turn successful experiments into scalable products. Monitor production systems and continuously improve their accuracy, robustness, and performance. Collaborate across engineering, product, legal, security, and data teams. Contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and responsible AI practices. Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to increase delivery speed without compromising quality. What We’re Looking For At least three years of professional experience with Python, machine learning, or AI engineering. Strong Python skills and solid knowledge of software architecture, algorithms, data structures, testing, and API design. Hands-on experience building applications with large language models or other foundation models. Experience with agentic patterns such as tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation, planning, memory, workflow orchestration, or multi-agent systems. Experience evaluating AI systems using automated tests, benchmarks, human review, and production feedback. Familiarity with open-weight models, including model selection, serving, fine-tuning, quantization, or optimization. Experience deploying and maintaining production services using technologies such as FastAPI, Docker, and Kubernetes. Knowledge of MLOps and modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, observability, versioning, experimentation, and model monitoring. Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Awareness of AI security, privacy, governance, and responsible deployment. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to non-technical colleagues. An ownership mindset: you clarify the problem, make sound decisions, follow through, and ship meaningful outcomes. items.desc: Job Title: AI Engineer Entity: Aventum Group Department: Technology Location: London This isn’t a job description. It’s your invitation. At Aventum Group, we don’t hire to fill seats. We bring people in to build something real. We want people to join us (that person might be you) on our mission to be the world’s most inspiring insurance group, not by playing it safe but by delivering the unexpected and creating meaningful impact. That means backing ideas early, trusting people to own their work and giving them the space to grow faster than they thought possible. If you’re looking for rigid career paths or a one-size-fits-all management, Aventum Group probably isn’t for you. However, if you do want responsibility from day one, honest feedback and a culture that expects you to speak up, take ownership and keep getting better, then you might just be a great fit. Some people join us knowing exactly where they want to go. Others figure it out once they’re here. Both work here - the question is, will you? What You’ll Take On (The Actual Job Description) So you’re looking for a new challenge? This is your chance to step into a role with real responsibility. You’ll be given the space to own your work, supported to move as fast as you want and expected to keep raising the bar for yourself and the business. AI Engineer – Behavioural & Decision Systems. This is a hands‑on engineering role for someone who wants their models to matter. You’ll take advanced behavioural and decision‑based AI and turn it into production systems that sit at the core of live digital products. Your work will shape how our platforms predict behaviour, make decisions and adapt in real time, powering Digital Twins, agentic systems and intelligent automation across the business. You’ll operate at the point where modelling meets delivery, with real ownership from data through to live impact. What you’ll do Turn behavioural and sequential models into production‑grade systems that directly influence real decisions and outcomes. Own end‑to‑end AI pipelines, from raw data to monitored, reliable inference in live products. Embed causal thinking into how we evaluate impact, helping teams understand what actually changes behaviour and why. Build AI services that integrate cleanly into existing platforms, shaping APIs, events and decision flows alongside engineers. Bring behavioural dynamics to life in Digital Twins and agentic systems, making complex decision processes observable and actionable. This role is built for someone who backs themselves, takes ownership and wants to see their work used not parked in notebooks. If you’re motivated by pace, accountability and the chance to build systems that genuinely change how products behave, you’ll feel at home here. What it’s Like to Work Here Expect high standards - and the support to meet them. Expect autonomy (not micromanagement) and the chance to collaborate across teams, brands and borders. Here, your ideas are taken seriously, wherever you sit in the business. We invest when the right tools don’t exist. We listen when our people say something can be better. And when we win, we make sure the people building the business win too. This is a place where performance matters - but so does enjoyment, curiosity and doing work you are proud of. Who Thrives at Aventum Group? We don’t expect you to tick every box. Experience helps, but curiosity matters more. If you are willing to learn, take ownership and ask questions when you don’t know the answer, you’re already off to a great start. We look for people who: Have experience relevant to the role, whether from a similar position, education or transferable skills Confidence in communicating with others and working together A mindset focused on learning, improvement and follow-through An interest in how things work (and how they could be improved) If this sounds like you, you sound ready for a new chapter of challenge at Aventum Group. Why Apply Because you want more than a job title. Because you want to grow, not wait your turn. Because you want to be trusted to do good work (and get recognised when you do it). And because you want to help build something inspiring, unexpected and meaningful. So… challenge accepted?

items.desc: About ve2ventures We're ve2ventures, a venture studio that invests in external startups and also builds our own companies from the ground up. We're a mix of entrepreneurs, product people and tech experts who love building innovative products. Together, we're building the world's largest sports and media tech ecosystem. In 2 years, we've grown to a team of 60+, working on over 20 ventures and supported by 35 investors. As our startups grow, so does our need for strong technical talent. That's where you, our new Machine Learning Engineer, come in. You'll join the data science team behind PadelPlay, our padel performance platform. It turns data from a wearable sensor into shot detection, technique feedback and AI coaching for thousands of players. The Role As a Machine Learning Engineer, you'll own models from the first look at the data through to production. You'll build, evaluate and ship the ML and AI features players use after every session. You'll work closely with the app, backend and product teams, and as you grow you'll take on more of the technical decisions about how we model, deploy and monitor what we build. What You'll Do - Own the full ML lifecycle: data collection and labelling, feature engineering, training, rigorous evaluation, deployment and monitoring. - Design evaluation that holds up in the real world. That means testing on users the model hasn't seen, and being honest about what the numbers can and can't tell us. - Build and maintain the data pipelines and serving infrastructure behind our models (serverless functions, queues, object storage, SQL/NoSQL databases) across dev, staging and production. - Build LLM-powered features such as our AI coach: prompt design, tool calling, retrieval, multi-language output and guardrails, using APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic and TypesafeAI. - Use AI-assisted, agentic development in your own workflow (e.g. Claude Code) to move fast without cutting corners. - Turn product questions from the PM and coaches into clear experiments, and explain the results to non-technical stakeholders. - Help improve our tooling, reproducibility and code quality as the team grows. What You Bring Required - 3–5 years of experience as an ML Engineer, Data Scientist or similar, with models you've taken to production. - Strong Python and the standard ML stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn; PyTorch or similar). - Solid grounding in classical ML and evaluation: cross-validation, avoiding leakage, handling class imbalance, choosing the right metric. - Experience deploying and maintaining models or data services on a cloud platform (Azure preferred ). - Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic or similar). - Comfort with SQL and working with messy, real-world data. - A strong sense of ownership, a pragmatic mindset, and clear written and spoken English. Nice to Have - Experience with time-series, sensor or wearable data (accelerometer/gyroscope, signal processing). - Sports, health or fitness tech experience. - Model explainability (e.g. SHAP) and turning model output into feedback people can act on. - LLM agents, RAG or LLM observability tooling. - Serverless and container-based deployment, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. - Experience in a startup or small, fast-moving team. Why This Role Is Interesting You'll work on a product where ML is the product. Your models run on real players' sessions every day, and the results go straight into what they see in the app. The problems are hard in the good way: noisy sensor data, a small number of expert reference players, and feedback that has to be accurate and useful to an amateur on court. You'll have real ownership, a short path from idea to production, and an AI-native workflow you can help push further.

items.desc: We are QUALCO, the technology arm of Qualco Group, with over 25 years of experience in delivering innovative solutions to the financial sector. We serve clients in over 30 countries, helping banks and other financial institutions manage credit and loans effectively while ensuring full regulatory compliance. Our advanced software leverages analytics, artificial intelligence, and digital technologies to support every stage of the credit and lending lifecycle, remaining at the forefront of fintech innovation. Qualco is building its Credit Institution (CI), a first-of-its-kind non-bank lending entity in Greece, currently in the licensing process with the Bank of Greece, targeting launch in H1 2027. The AI/ML Engineer will be a core builder of the credit decision engine that powers this new entity, working directly on Qualco ML Studio . This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of ML platform development, financial data integration and credit decisioning, building the flows that turn data into credit decisions at scale. Responsibilities: Design, implement and maintain ML flows on Qualco ML Studio powering the CI's credit decision engine — from data ingestion through feature engineering to model scoring and decision output; Build and own data integrations for model inputs from internal sources (application database, D3E data layer) and external bureaus (Teiresias credit bureau), ensuring data quality, latency and reliability standards are met; Implement end-to-end ML pipelines using ML Studio's Workflow Canvas and AutoML capabilities across credit risk use cases: application scoring, limit setting, fraud detection and behavioral monitoring; Collaborate with Data Scientists to translate model specifications into production-ready flows and with Product and Engineering to embed model outputs into the credit decisioning workflow; Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for model deployment, versioning and monitoring, ensuring traceability and governance requirements for a regulated financial entity are met; Contribute to MLOps best practices: model drift monitoring, retraining triggers, performance logging and audit trails required by the Bank of Greece regulatory framework; Support integration of ML Studio with Qualco's broader AI Suite (Data Studio → ML Studio → Agentic Studio) & non-AI Suite to ensure a coherent data-to-decision flow; Ensure all activities are carried out in full compliance with Credit institution regulatory requirements; and Ensure that all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements and supporting the continued implementation of the Group Anti-Bribery and Corruption Policy. Requirements 4+ years of professional experience in ML engineering or a closely related Data Engineering role; Proven track record building and deploying ML pipelines in prod — not just prototyping; Strong Python skills; proficiency with ML libraries (scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM or equivalent); familiarity with SQL and data pipeline tooling; Experience with CI/CD practices, Git, Docker/Kubernetes and MLOps tooling for model delivery and monitoring; Hands-on experience integrating data from multiple sources (APIs, databases, third-party bureaus or equivalent), having built the plumbing, not just the models; Understanding of model interpretability and explainability requirements — essential for a regulated credit context; Fluency in Greek and English oral and written. Nice to Have: Experience in financial services, Fin/Tech, banking, or any regulated environment where model governance and audit trails are non-negotiable; Familiarity with credit risk use cases: application scoring, behavioural models, PD/LGD, or collections prioritisation; Knowledge of credit bureau integrations (Teiresias or equivalent) or open banking data sources; Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and understanding of data lake / data warehouse architecture; Exposure to Qualco ML Studio or similar low-code/AutoML platforms for financial ML. items.desc: 🤖 The Job At Dataroots, we deliver end-to-end data and AI solutions, from strategy and platform design to data engineering and AI-enabled systems. That broad scope is reflected in our team: AI/ML engineers, data engineers, cloud architects, and data strategists. Each discipline brings its own expertise, but we share knowledge, perspectives, and a common way of thinking across disciplines. Within that team, you design, build and deploy AI solutions that deliver tangible business value for our clients across a variety of industries, spanning classical ML, modern GenAI, and Agentic AI use cases. Your work goes beyond getting the models to work; you help bring AI systems into production in a robust and scalable way, applying best practices in MLOps and LLMOps to ensure they are reliable, maintainable, and adaptable over time. 💼 What we’re looking for You bring the following qualities & experiences to the role: A deep passion for Artificial Intelligence and its applications. A minimum of 2 years of experience developing AI-driven applications or systems. Strong foundation in software design principles ; Proficiency in Python & SQL is a must. A solid understanding of core machine learning techniques and how to apply them pragmatically in production settings. Familiarity with modern generative AI and agentic approaches , including retrieval-based systems and LLM orchestration patterns. Experience deploying AI systems into production, with a solid grasp of model lifecycle management and cloud-native deployment practices. Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and a solid understanding of cloud-based AI and data workflows. Front-end experience is considered a plus. Strong communication skills and the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for clients. A pragmatic, business-oriented mindset : able to translate business problems into technical scopes and help AI solutions land, with a focus on product thinking and real business value. Fluency in English and Dutch . Not every box needs to be ticked to be a great fit. If you’re excited about the role and eager to grow, we’d still love to hear from you. 🎉 Why choose Dataroots? We’re a data & AI consulting company where people, growth, and impact go hand in hand. Since our early days, we’ve built a culture that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and an environment where individuals can thrive. This focus has allowed us to grow steadily while staying true to what matters: delivering meaningful results for our clients and creating a place where people enjoy doing their best work. Working at Dataroots means gaining exposure to a wide range of industries, challenges, and technologies. You’ll have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone, while being supported by experienced colleagues who are always ready to share their expertise. As part of the Talan Group, we further extend these opportunities by offering an international dimension to your career path. 💰 The Offer An attractive salary with extralegal benefits, including: + Mobility budget or a company car with fuel/charging card + Hospitalisation and group insurance + High-end laptop + Smartphone with subscription + Substantial amount of holidays + Meal vouchers + ... Diverse and welcoming work environment , where you’ll collaborate & unwind with colleagues from different cultures and disciplines. The organization of both fun & professional events and initiatives is actively encouraged and supported. A training budget for individual and team learning opportunities. Tons of team-building events and sports initiatives to stay connected and unwind. 📍 Where you’ll work Our main offices are in Leuven and Ghent . These spaces are perfect for both focusing and unwinding with colleagues, as well as brainstorming sessions and team events. While much of your work can be performed remotely, you will also work on-site with clients . 🎯 Ready to join Dataroots? Excited to shape the future of AI with us? items.desc: Entra nel nostro mondo. Trasforma insieme a noi. JUNIOR AI ENGINEER Quale sarà la tua sfida? Il nostro team di Artificial Intelligence Engineering si impegna a supportare i clienti nel percorso di adozione dell’intelligenza artificiale attraverso la realizzazione di factory di soluzioni di AI, azionabili e integrate nell'architettura e nei processi aziendali. La figura dell’AI Engineer progetta soluzioni software di Machine Learning (ML) scalabili per i casi d'uso dei clienti e le industrializza per l’esecuzione in produzione garantendo i livelli richiesti di performance, sicurezza e governabilità. L’AI Engineer lavora a stretto contatto con altre figure di Bip xTech, come Cloud Data Architects, Data Scientists e Data Engineer, per realizzare soluzioni ML di alta qualità sotto ogni aspetto: disegnando e implementando per il team strumenti di lavoro come le piattaforme di MLOps, fornendo linee guida e best practice sulle architetture dati e di AI, supportando l’implementazione del software e funzionalità di osservabilità dell’AI, e altro ancora. L’AI Engineer inoltre contribuirà alla Bip xTech Data Community con attività di ricerca, scouting tecnologico, concept di nuove soluzioni e sviluppo del business sui clienti di BIP. Sarai tu a entrare nel nostro team? Requisiti fondamentali Da 0 a 3 anni di esperienza nel ruolo; Laurea specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science, Informatica o discipline affini (STEM). Esperienza nello sviluppo di software in almeno un linguaggio, come per esempio: Python, Scala, Java, e/o simili; Esperienza nel disegno di soluzioni software e nell’implementazione di strutture dati, algoritmi; Esperienza nell’utilizzo degli strumenti di Code Repository, come per esempio: GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps e/o simili. Conoscenza dei concetti, algoritmi e metodologie di Machine Learning. Esperienza con linguaggi SQL per il design, query e gestione dei database; esperienza nell’utilizzo di linguaggi SQL per le attività di ETL. Indispensabile la conoscenza fluente di Italiano e Inglese professionali. Plus Esperienza nell’utilizzo delle principali piattaforme cloud (Google, AWS, Azure); Conoscenza dei concetti e tecnologie di Big Data e Data Warehousing (esempio: Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Kafka); Esperienza con framework e metodologie di Deep Learning (esempio: Tensorflow, PyTorch, HuggingFace Transformers, LangChain). Conoscenza di framework di versionamento di dati e/o modelli (esempio: MLFlow, DVC, WanDB…). Esperienza con framework di lavoro AGILE (esempio: Scrum, Kanban). Famiglia e Genitorialità Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99). Il pacchetto complessivo può includere ulteriori componenti variabili, correlate al raggiungimento di specifici obiettivi individuali e/o aziendali, welfare e benefit aziendali. La proposta economica finale sarà definita in base alle caratteristiche del profilo selezionato e alla coerenza con i requisiti della posizione. items.desc: About Axom Axom is a venture-backed AI company building a marketing automation platform that helps businesses choose the next best action for each customer. We combine behavioural data, predictive models and decision optimisation to personalise customer interactions and deliver measurable commercial value. Our existing clients include online casino operators, where high volumes of customer activity create complex, real-time decision problems. Our platform is designed to work across sectors, and we are expanding our partnerships to bring intelligent personalisation to other businesses and platforms. Our next phase is agentic AI for next-best-action (NBA) systems: agents that can use models and tools, recommend or orchestrate marketing actions, and learn from outcomes and user feedback. We are developing this capability around clear business objectives, human oversight and reliable evaluation. We move quickly, with a small, highly technical team and a practical approach to testing ideas and shipping improvements. You will work closely with colleagues across data science, engineering and product, with real ownership of the decisions our platform makes. The role We are looking for a Data Scientist with commercial experience, strong Python skills and practical machine learning experience to help improve the models and analysis behind Axom. You will join a talented and ambitious engineering team, contributing to established systems and learning new techniques as our product develops. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with data and solving business problems. You will have ownership of defined projects, with support from the wider team on specialist modelling, production deployment and agentic AI development. This is a hybrid role, working three days per week in the office. What you will do • Explore and prepare customer data, investigate patterns and help answer questions about product and client performance. • Build, train and evaluate machine learning models, and improve existing models through feature engineering and validation. • Contribute to our predictive models for customer lifetime value, churn and response to marketing actions, including the deep neural networks we use, with support from colleagues. • Write clear, maintainable Python code and use AI coding agents to support development, reviewing and testing the code they produce. • Work with engineers to put models and analysis into use, and help monitor their performance and investigate issues. • Contribute to experiments and analysis that help us understand whether changes improve customer decisions and commercial outcomes. • Contribute to our agentic AI and next-best-action capabilities alongside the wider team. • Explain your findings clearly and collaborate with colleagues to turn analysis into practical product improvements. What we are looking for Must have • At least 3 years of commercial work experience in data science, analytics, software development or a related technical role. • A university degree in a technical subject, such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics or engineering. • Strong Python skills, including practical experience using pandas to prepare, analyse and work with data. • SQL skills and experience working with behavioural or transactional datasets. • Practical experience applying supervised machine learning to real-world problems, including training models, evaluating performance and understanding overfitting and data leakage. • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents or assistants, such as Codex, Claude, or Cursor, to write and improve code, with the ability to understand, review and test their output. Nice to have • Experience across different model types, including regression, random forests, gradient boosting models and neural networks. • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. • Experience using Git, working through code review, or helping deploy and monitor machine learning models. • Knowledge of statistics, A/B testing, experimental design or measuring incremental business impact. • Experience with LLMs, AI agent workflows or frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph. • Experience with Azure, Databricks or Synapse, real-time analytics, or data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Power BI. • Experience with customer lifetime value, churn, recommendation systems, or marketing optimisation. • Familiarity with causal inference, uplift modelling, contextual bandits or reinforcement learning. You do not need to have worked with every technology listed above. We are looking for strong core skills, clear communication, curiosity and a willingness to learn. Why join Axom You will work on real business problems, see how your work influences customer decisions, and develop your skills alongside a highly technical team. As Axom expands its agentic AI capabilities, you will have opportunities to contribute and build experience in this area.

Commercial Data Scientist (Flip Team) FLIP is the leading refurbished consumer electronics platform in Southeast Europe, operating across Romania, Hungary, Bulgaria, and Greece. As part of the eMAG ecosystem, we are building the most trusted marketplace for pre-owned devices, and growing fast. We run a data-driven, performance-obsessed commercial operation, and we are looking for someone who loves turning complexity into clear decisions. The Commercial Data Scientist acts actually as A Decision Intelligence operator . Are we taking the right decisions based on our strategy and objectives? Is the planning reflecting reality? What are the Risks & Opportunities and how can we tap them? Your role will build and consolidate models & frameworks that recommend the best way forward to hitting our targets and creating clarity for strategic choices & their trade-offs. This is a high-exposure role. You will present to senior leadership, challenge assumptions with data, and engage directly with Commercial/Growth, Marketing, Supply, Finance, Operations, and Product & Tech to turn insight into action. You will also co-create the engine behind FLIP’s forecasting capability: building the process, challenging the inputs and co-owning the accuracy. What you’ll have to do: What This Role Is Really About The core of the job is triangulation: reconciling several independent angles on the same number until you can defend it and explain what moved it. We expect you to triangulate three sets of drivers: GMV: what is driving growth, or holding it back. Profitability: the quality of that growth, not just its size. Forecast accuracy: how much confidence we can put behind the plan. Triangulate means you never take a single number at face value. You cross-check top-down against bottom-up, model against actuals, volume against price, and you can always say which driver moved and by how much (by having a clear view of correlation and causality between drivers). Responsibilities Build and scale price elasticity models for the shop: conversion versus price at product level, feeding the Pricing engine directly, with clear guardrails on Gross Margin. Industrialize the Pricing engine: evolve it from its current Excel and Python setup toward an automated, product-level system. Design and execute pricing experiments and A/B tests across shops, and convert results into recommendations with quantified impact. Act as the sounding board for the Commercial team: pressure-test plans, assortment choices and price moves with data before they land. Be a sparring partner to the Demand/Growth team: challenge and sharpen the demand and pricing thinking behind the growth plan, not just report on it. Generate insights on elasticity, customer behavior and market dynamics per market, using fair like-for-like comparisons. Establish best practices for analytics, experimentation and AI usage, including automated reporting against budget and current forecast. Build models and frameworks that make trade-offs explicit: price versus volume, category mix versus margin, promotional cost versus incremental units. Act as a trusted analytical partner to growth, marketing, supply, finance, and product leadership, and navigate competing priorities across them. What makes you a good fit: 5+ years in data science / commercial analysis, business intelligence, management consulting, or a similar role in a data-intensive environment. A quantitative degree (Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related). Strong foundations in statistics, predictive modeling and machine learning. Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL. Proven experience in time-series forecasting (modeling, feature engineering, evaluation at scale). A/B testing and experimental design experience with measurable business impact. Daily use of AI tools in your workflow. FLIP runs Claude Enterprise across the company; we expect you to build with it, not around it. A proactive, self-starting mindset with end-to-end ownership of your domain. Strong stakeholder management: you can hold your ground in a commercial debate and explain what a model implies for the P&L to senior leadership, in plain language. items.desc: AI Engineer: agentic systemen voor de tandartspraktijk Fulltime · €5.000 – €7.000 per maand + aandelenopties Aivory heeft net €2 miljoen opgehaald en groeit hard. Daarom zoeken we een AI Engineer die met ons de volgende stap zet. Over Aivory Een tandartspraktijk draait op honderden kleine handelingen: telefoon opnemen, afspraken plannen, verwijzingen verwerken, declareren, patiënten herinneren. Nu doen mensen dat met de hand. Aivory automatiseert die handelingen. In acht maanden gingen we van nul naar 100 praktijken. Na de eerste omzetting leek het een onmogelijke klus. Nu zetten we een praktijk om in iets meer dan een uur. In oktober en november doen we in sommige weken tien per week, met drie mensen. De bottleneck zit niet meer in het omzetten. Die zit in zorgen dat een praktijk ons systeem vanaf de eerste dag maximaal gebruikt. Daar hebben we goede ideeën voor. Daar zoeken we iemand voor. Dit is geen 9-tot-5-baan We zitten midden in hypergroei gemiddeld 10% week over week. Er komen elke week nieuwe praktijken bij, en wat vandaag af is, moet volgende maand op veel meer volume werken. Dat vraagt tempo, eigenaarschap en soms een avond doorwerken als iets live moet. Daar krijg je iets voor terug wat je bij een groot bedrijf niet leert. Je bouwt van idee tot iets wat zorgverleners elke dag gebruiken. Je zit dicht op de oprichters, ziet hoe beslissingen worden genomen en draagt zelf verantwoordelijkheid voor grote stukken van het product. Wat je gaat doen • Agents bouwen die echt werk overnemen in de praktijk, van de AI-receptioniste aan de telefoon tot agents die administratie en planning afhandelen • Bepalen hoe agents bij de juiste context komen: tool-design, retrieval, geheugen en de koppeling met onze bestaande data • Evaluaties en monitoring bouwen, zodat we weten wanneer een agent het goed doet en wanneer niet. In de zorg is "meestal goed" niet goed genoeg • Meewerken in de codebase (TypeScript, NestJS, Angular, PostgreSQL) en features opleveren die productie halen • Meedenken over architectuur, kosten en betrouwbaarheid van LLM-gebruik op schaal Wat je meeneemt • Je hebt agentic systemen gebouwd die in productie draaien, niet alleen demo's. Je weet waar ze stukgaan • Je hebt een stevige basis als software engineer: je schrijft onderhoudbare code, denkt na over datamodellen en test je werk • Je hebt ervaring met LLM-API's, tool calling, prompt- en contextontwerp en evaluatie • Je hebt affiniteit met privacy en security. We werken met medische gegevens onder AVG en NEN 7510 • Je krijgt energie van tempo en onzekerheid, en je pakt dingen op zonder te wachten tot iemand het vraagt • Pré: ervaring met voice agents, TypeScript/NestJS of multi-tenant SaaS Wat wij bieden • €5.000 – €7.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring • Aandelenopties • Werk dat direct effect heeft: wat jij bouwt, gebruiken zorgverleners de week erna • Een klein team, korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en veel verantwoordelijkheid Interesse? Reageer op deze vacature of mail Ties op ties@aivory.nl. Vertel kort over een agent die je hebt gebouwd: wat het deed, en wat er misging.

items.desc: Wil jij zélf kunnen bepalen bij welke opdrachtgever je werkt — en daar het verschil maken met slimme AI-oplossingen? Én werk je graag in een omgeving vol kennis, innovatie en collega’s die net zo enthousiast zijn over AI als jij? Dan pas jij perfect als expert bij Data Talents. Dit ga je doen Als AI Engineer zet jij je expertise tijdelijk in bij grote opdrachtgevers, waar jij werkt aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante AI-uitdagingen. Denk aan het ontwikkelen van herbruikbare AI componenten, het ontwikkelen van data pipelines voor LLM`s of het realiseren van vector search systemen. Jij vertaalt abstracte vraagstukken naar werkende AI-oplossingen, en dat doe je niet alleen — wij staan altijd voor je klaar met begeleiding, sparring en kennisdeling. Jouw nieuwe thuisbasis Data Talents is een open, platte organisatie waar jouw ontwikkeling voorop staat. Je maakt deel uit van een team van ruim 80 collega’s — data engineers, scientists én AI-specialisten — met wie je kennis deelt, ervaringen uitwisselt en af en toe ook gewoon leuke dingen doet. Denk aan kennissessies, peer reviews, of een weekendje Texel. We zijn groot genoeg om veel expertise in huis te hebben, en klein genoeg om persoonlijk te blijven. Dit mag je van ons verwachten Je gaat bij ons aan de slag als midlancer. Dat betekent: de autonomie van een ondernemer én de zekerheid van een vast dienstverband. Je bepaalt zelf welke opdrachten je oppakt, hoe je je werkweek inricht en hoe je je ontwikkelt. En dat zie je terug: 70% van je uurtarief is voor jou. Via onze House of Talents Academy zorgen we voor verdieping in je vakgebied, met trainingen in onder andere: deep learning, NLP, MLOps en ethische AI. Jouw persoonlijke Business Manager (met inhoudelijke kennis van AI!) begeleid je bij elke stap. In het kort betekent werken bij Data Talents: Zelf kiezen welke AI-uitdaging bij je past Werken aan modellen die écht worden gebruikt 70% van het uurtarief bij de klant is voor jou Salaris tussen €7.000 en €11.000 per maand Onbeperkt vakantiedagen opnemen Sparren met een community van AI- en dataspecialisten Een thuisbasis in Utrecht Permanente scholing en training Elk kwartaal iets leuks doen met je collega’s (niet verplicht, wél leuk) Onkosten- en reiskostenvergoeding Dit verwachten wij van jou Wij zoeken AI Engineers die energie krijgen van complexe vraagstukken en graag samenwerken aan slimme oplossingen. Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en weet technische concepten helder uit te leggen. Daarnaast zijn er een aantal ‘vinkjes’ die we graag zetten voordat we het gesprek met je aangaan: Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in het datadomein, waarvan 3 jaar ervaring met AI, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Image Recognition of Operational Research. Je hebt ruime kennis van RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Je hebt ervaring met LLM platformen zoals OpenAI/ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Hbo- of academisch werk- en denkniveau Je programmeert soepel in Python Je hebt ervaring met dataplatforms zoals Databricks en Snowflake Je hebt ervaring met TensorFlow, PyTorch, Spark of soortgelijke frameworks Je bent bekend met MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes en cloud (AWS, Azure of GCP) Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en woont in Nederland Klinkt dit als iets voor jou? Bij Data Talents zijn de lijnen kort – ook in onze sollicitatieprocedure. Dus: spreken de werkzaamheden, het team én onze organisatie je aan? Stuur ons dan jouw sollicitatie. Als jij de expert bent die we zoeken, plannen we snel een digitale kennismaking met je in. Heb je eerst nog vragen? Neem dan contact op met Erik van Galen via 06 – 824 91 411 (appen kan ook) of via erik.van.galen@data-talents.nl. We kijken ernaar uit om je te leren kennen! Onderdeel van House of Talents Data Talents is een van de domeinen van House of Talents Nederland, waar we dagelijks met meer dan 1.000 topexperts werken om de verwachtingen van onze opdrachtgevers én onszelf te overtreffen. Ook zijn we - net als House of Talents België - onderdeel van de internationale holding World of Talents, waardoor we de mooiste opdrachtgevers met de meest uitdagende interim opdrachten aantrekken en onze expertise kunnen delen.

items.desc: BrightAnalytics is een ambitieuze, internationale Fintech scale-up die bedrijven helpt om hun financiële inzichten sneller, beter en visueler te maken. We groeien razendsnel en zoeken versterking voor ons business analisten team in Roeselare. Heb je de technische skills van een Full Stack Developer en werk je graag met de nodige autonomie aan nieuwe, tastbare projecten? Bij BrightAnalytics wachten we niet op de toekomst, we bouwen hem zelf. Als onze eerste Python / Full Stack Developer word je de technische motor achter onze nieuwste MVPs. Geen legacy code of trage processen, maar snelheid, AI en business impact. Wat doet een Full Stack Innovation Developer? In deze rol werk je niet in het reguliere development team, maar zij aan zij met onze Business Analisten. Je krijgt de unieke autonomie om een slim idee razendsnel om te zetten in een verkoopbaar product. Omdat de lijnen extreem kort zijn, zie je direct het resultaat van jouw werk in interne pilots en demo’s. Building MVPs & Impact: Onze Business Analisten (BA's) experimenteren in tools zoals Google AI Studio & Lovable. Jij pakt hun ideeën op en bouwt de nodige code en integraties om hier een werkend prototype van te maken. Jouw code vormt de blauwdruk voor nieuwe features in ons platform. Vibe Coding naar Marktvalidatie: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het technische fundament van nieuwe features. Samen met de BA’s vertaal je AI-gestuurde prototypes naar eerste werkbare versies. Je bouwt een solide basis waarop interne validatie en demo's uitgevoerd kunnen worden. De brug naar Productie: Zodra de product-market fit bewezen is, verzorg je een gestroomlijnde overdracht naar ons Core Engineering team. Zij integreren jouw MVP vervolgens definitief binnen het BrightAnalytics platform. Speed to Market: Je hebt een sterke drang om zaken 'live' te zien gaan. Je werkt autonoom en begrijpt de essentie van een MVP: focus op de kernfunctionaliteit zonder je te verliezen in details, maar wel rustend op een kwalitatieve technische basis. Welke waarden breng jij naar ons Business Analist team? Technical Stack: Je bent minstens twee jaar ervaring als developer. Jouw focus ligt op Python (voor AI/data). Kennis van design patterns is een plus, zodat je begrijpt hoe jouw innovaties uiteindelijk landen in ons core platform. AI Obsessed: Je volgt de razendsnelle AI-evolutie niet alleen, je experimenteert er dagelijks mee. Je begrijpt de logica achter LLM’s en technical prompting, waardoor je AI-gegenereerde concepten razendsnel vertaalt naar robuuste oplossingen. Startup Mentaliteit: Je houdt van snelheid. Je bent comfortabel met onzekerheid en vindt het leuk om vanaf een wit blad te vertrekken. Business Mindset: Je denkt graag mee over de waarom achter de code. Je vindt het interessant om te begrijpen voor welke uitdagingen onze klanten (zoals CFO’s of finance managers) staan, zodat jouw technische keuzes ook een functioneel schot in de roos zijn. Communicator: Je kunt technische uitdagingen helder uitleggen aan je collega's en staat open voor hun feedback vanuit de markt. Daarnaast communiceer je vlot met ons Development team, dit zowel voor hun UX experience als technische insights. Welke voordelen kan je van BrightAnalytics verwachten? Een plekje in één van de snelst groeiende fintech bedrijven in België Wij zijn een internationale, financieel gezonde en ISO-gecertificeerde scale-up met veel ambitie Een open en ondernemende cultuur waar jouw ideeën écht het verschil maken Je maakt deel uit van een gedreven, dynamisch en enthousiast team en je kan ook rekenen op een job vol variatie On-the-job coaching en groeikansen Maar liefst 20 wettelijke + 12 extra vakantiedagen Flexibele werkuren, dat wil zeggen opstarten tussen 7u30 en 9u30 en jouw pc dichtklappen vanaf 16u30 tot 18u30 Bedrijfswagen Maaltijdcheques van 10 euro per gewerkte dag; Ecocheques Hospitalisatieverzekering Alan Health Benefits (jouw aanvullende complete gezondheidsverzekering) Friday after work drinks, legendarische teambuildings en een jaarlijks weekend met het voltallige BrightAnalytics team Interesse? Solliciteer vandaag en groei mee met BrightAnalytics!
