items.desc: Als Workplace AI & Automation Specialist bouw je AI- en automatiseringsoplossingen die collega's door heel Coolblue slimmer en efficiënter laten werken. Je voert projecten van idee tot resultaat uit en bouwt aan AI-agents die processen zelfstandig kunnen uitvoeren. Je weet precies wanneer je een AI-tool inzet en wanneer een nieuw te bouwen integratie nodig is. Wat je doet Je voert automatiseringsprojecten van begin tot eind uit. Je maakt handmatig, repetitief en tijdrovend werk overbodig. Dat doe je door het slim te automatiseren. Dat kan van alles zijn: een proces dat steeds dezelfde handelingen vraagt, werk dat informatie uit verschillende hoeken moet samenbrengen, of taken die continu opvolging nodig hebben. Zo houden teams tijd over voor het werk dat er écht toe doet. Steeds vaker doe je dit met agentic AI. Je bouwt AI-agents die zelfstandig stappen zetten, keuzes maken en taken afronden. Je geeft ze de juiste skills en tools, test hoe ze werken en verbetert ze steeds verder. Soms bouw je daarbij, samen met een Data Engineer, een integratie via een API. Soms los je het zelfstandig sneller en slimmer op met LLM-tooling. Jij kiest de beste route en maakt het werkend. Past onze huidige tooling niet bij het probleem? Dan stel je een betere oplossing en tooling voor. Door de hele organisatie liggen kansen om werk slimmer te automatiseren, en daar ga jij mee aan de slag. Steeds een ander team, steeds een andere uitdaging. Jij bent de schakel die die kansen herkent, de juiste vragen stelt en weer vertrekt met een werkende oplossing. Zo voeg je voor de hele organisatie waarde toe. Wat je kan Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld richting (data) engineering, informatica, (business) informatiemanagement of een vergelijkbare technische richting. Minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring, bij voorkeur in automation, development of data-gerelateerd werk. Affiniteit met AI, LLM-tooling en het bouwen van AI-agents. Ervaring met SQL, Python en API's. Inschatten wanneer AI past en wanneer een andere oplossing beter werkt. Makkelijk schakelen met stakeholders en ideeën omzetten in werkende oplossingen. Goed Nederlands en Engels, in woord en geschrift. Wat je krijgt Geld. Ongekend goede werksfeer. Waar we met elkaar omgaan als vrienden en je gewoon jezelf kan zijn. Maandelijkse borrels, versbereide happen, legendarische Coolblue-feesten en de leukste teamactiviteiten Een fijne combinatie van werken op kantoor en vanuit huis. Natuurlijk zorgen we dat je thuis een top werkplek hebt. Inclusief bureaustoel, laptop en blauwe slingers. Alle ruimte voor jouw eigen ideeën, initiatieven en keuzes. Jij doet je werk op jouw manier. Reiskostenvergoeding, pensioenregeling en een vergoeding voor als je thuiswerkt. 25 vakantiedagen. Als je belooft dat je terugkomt. Een kantoor waar je foto's van wilt maken op een toplocatie. items.desc: At the Institute for the Protection of Maritime Infrastructure in Bremerhaven, we research and develop innovative solutions to strengthen the resilience of maritime infrastructure and ensure it is adaptable, safe and sustainable. Working closely with partners from research, industry and other stakeholders in maritime security, we combine technological innovation with practical expertise and offer you the chance to work on pioneering projects. What To Expect We develop innovative sensing and imaging technologies to address challenges in the protection and security of critical infrastructures. One of our key research areas is muon tomography, a non-destructive imaging technique that uses elementary particles to investigate dense, shielded and difficult-to-access objects. We are now exploring the use of artificial muon sources based on laser-plasma accelerators, which offer the potential to significantly reduce measurement times, improve imaging performance and open up new applications beyond conventional cosmic-ray muon tomography. This emerging field brings together particle physics, accelerator technology, computational modelling and advanced image reconstruction. We are looking for a motivated researcher to join our interdisciplinary team and contribute to the development of these next-generation muon imaging technologies. The position offers the opportunity to work on challenging scientific questions, develop and validate new simulation and reconstruction methods, and collaborate with international research partners on experimental campaigns and innovative European research projects. Your tasks Develop innovative methods for muon tomography using artificial muon sources based on laser-plasma accelerators. Perform computational modelling, Monte Carlo simulations and scientific data analysis to investigate and evaluate novel imaging concepts. Develop and optimise image reconstruction, material characterisation and AI-based data analysis methods for accelerator-based muon tomography. Plan, conduct and evaluate experimental validation campaigns in close collaboration with an interdisciplinary research team and international project partners. Contribute to the advancement of muon imaging technologies through scientific publications, conference presentations and international collaboration. Support the preparation of national and European research proposals and contribute to the development of new research activities. Your profile A completed academic degree (university diploma or Master’s degree) in a natural science subject (e.g. physics) or an engineering discipline (e.g. computer science), or other degree programmes relevant to the role Experience in experimental physics gained through involvement in a research collaboration or a multinational research project Experience in data analysis, Monte Carlo modelling (for example, in Geant4) and handling experimental data from particle physics Very good programming skills in Python and/or C/C++ Very good communication skills Experience in authoring scientific publications and presenting results Fluency in spoken and written English We look forward to getting to know you! If you have any questions about this position ( Vacancy-ID 5833 ) please contact: Sarah Barnes Tel.: +49 471 924199 49 Maurice Stephan Tel.: +49 471 924199 42

items.desc: Job Description FICC Quantitative Researcher, Associate / VP, London We are a team of FICC Quantitative Researchers who work to transform the Fixed Income, Currencies, and Commodities (FICC) business through quantitative trading, automating the key decisions taken every day. Our team has a wide remit across product types such as Interest Rates (IR), Foreign Exchange (FX), Credit, and Commodities, with strategies including market making, automatic quoting, central risk books, systematic trading, and algorithmic execution, trading on venues around the world. We deploy statistical analysis techniques and mathematical models, including advanced machine learning and AI, to improve business performance while working closely with traders and salespeople on the trading floor to bring value to our clients and the firm. Role Responsibilities Take a leading role on our Quantitative Trading & Market Making desk, building market making and quoting strategies across FICC products. Use advanced statistical analysis and quantitative techniques such as neural networks, machine learning, and factor models to build models that drive systematic alpha strategies which make real-time trading and risk management decisions. Implement frameworks to manage risk centrally and build optimal portfolios across FICC asset classes. Build model calibration frameworks for our advanced statistical and AI models, operating at scale with large quantities of time series data, ensuring accuracy and compliance. Drive our market making strategy development using a range of technologies, and collaborate closely with Quant Developers and core engineering teams to enhance core analytics infrastructure and trading tools. Develop and enhance critical pricing, trading, and risk tools, and create new frameworks leveraging trade and franchise data to optimize and systematize market making and hedging strategies. Basic Qualifications Excellent academic record in a relevant quantitative field such as physics, mathematics, statistics, engineering, or computer science. Strong programming skills in an object-oriented or functional paradigm such as C++, Java, or Python. Self-starter with strong self-management skills, ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver in a high-pressure environment. items.desc: Our team of engineers, scientists, and software developers explores the potential of Artificial Intelligence to solve some of the world's most challenging problems. We integrate machine learning, systems modeling, advanced control, and mathematical optimization to tackle complex engineering challenges. Our ultimate mission is to develop sustainable technologies that drive progress and contribute to the advancement of human development. About The Position We are looking for a passionate and analytical Researcher in Computational Biology & Bioinformatics to join our growing R&D team. In this role, you will be at the intersection of data science, artificial intelligence, and biotechnology, developing models that translate complex biological data into actionable, real-world solutions for industrial and environmental sectors. Key Responsibilities Genome-Scale Metabolic Modeling: Develop, curate, and validate genome-scale metabolic models; define objective functions (e.g., growth maximization), constrain metabolic fluxes, incorporate nutrient availability and cultivation conditions, and perform sensitivity and robustness analyses. Algorithmic Development: Design, implement, and optimize algorithms and computational models to analyze complex biochemical and multi-omics datasets. Experimental Design: Formulate and conduct computational experiments to test biological hypotheses and rigorously validate results. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with wet-lab scientists to seamlessly integrate experimental data with computational pipelines. AI Integration: Contribute actively to the development and deployment of cutting-edge, AI-driven tools for advanced biological data interpretation. Scientific Dissemination: Prepare project deliverables and technical reports for the European Commission, present findings at international conferences, and co-author manuscripts for high-impact scientific publications. Continuous Innovation: Stay updated with the latest advancements in bioinformatics, machine learning, and AI technologies to keep Idener at the forefront of the industry. Minimum Requirements Education: MSc (or equivalent) in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Data Science, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative/life-science discipline. A strong foundational understanding of biochemistry, microbiology, molecular biology, and genomics. Proficiency in programming languages essential for data analysis (e.g., Python, R, or C++) and experience applying statistical analysis to biological problems. Sharp analytical skills, critical thinking abilities, and a strong willingness to learn and adapt to emerging technologies. Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset tailored for multicultural and multidisciplinary teams. Excellent written and spoken English (working language for international projects). What We Offer Impactful Work: Opportunity to work on cutting-edge European Commission projects with a direct impact on sustainability and biotechnology. Professional Growth: Continuous learning environment with access to the latest AI and bioinformatics tools. Flexible Environment: Flexible working hours and options for hybrid work to promote work-life balance. Collaborative Culture: A young, dynamic, and international team of scientists and engineers. Career Path: Clear opportunities for professional advancement within the company’s R&D tracks.

Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 The 13-week Summer Industrial Placement Programme 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one?
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for summer placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates.
 We have created a programme across our UK sites that not only increases your technical skills, but gives you the opportunity to work on meaningful real-life projects, alongside experienced engineers and graduates across our business.
 You will receive coaching and support to achieve your personal goals and work in multidisciplinary teams to gain as much experience across the product lifecycle from your time in industry as possible. Our aim is to see you through your undergrad years and successful placements may result in an offer to return for further placements or for an offer on our Graduate Development programme.
 This programme is remunerated £26,228 per annum.
 The programme will run from 1st June- 27th August 2027
 What you’ll do as a Summer Placement Systems Engineer 
 Systems Engineers are involved in all aspects of design and development; from initial product design through to in-service support.
 They look at the big picture, determine how the system needs to operate and collaborate to produce the required overall operational behaviours. They also dive into the deepest level of detail – taking the system piece-by-piece and defining its design to the finest point. Our Systems Engineers can also actively engage in R&D, developing new concepts and conducting fundamental research into our future technologies.
 As a Summer Placement Systems Engineer, you will work on real engineering problems within either the Radar or the Advanced Targeting business area.
 You will have the opportunity to be involved in supporting a wide range of tasks across multiple projects/products, such as:
 The radar for the Typhoon fighter jet
 The radar for the SAAB Gripen fighter
 Our family of Surveillance AESA (Active Electronically Scanned Array) radars
 An IRCM (Infra-Red Counter Measures) system
 Our laser target designator or laser ranging systems
 Core activities within Systems Engineering include:
 Requirements capture, design documentation, verification and validation.
 Algorithm design and test.
 Performance modelling; building physics-based models to test our designs through computer simulation.
 Data analysis; end-to-end systems analysis using synthetic and ‘real world’ data.
 Applied research; from product improvements to blue-sky thinking.
 You will work with an experienced engineer who will provide day-to-day guidance and on-the-job training. You will be introduced to systems engineering processes, methods, technology and tools, with particular emphasis placed on learning practical skills that may not be easily gained or experienced in the academic environment of a university.
 What you’ll bring 
 Be a self-motivated individual, willing to take on new challenges and drive continuous personal development
 Strong communication skills across a variety of mediums i.e. written, verbal, digital, etc.
 The ability to develop effective working relationships with peers and stakeholders
 Adaptable to the ever-changing demands that will be encountered within the role
 Offer novel ideas and methods for solving technical problems, drawing on personal experiences and knowledge learned during academic studies
 Role Requirements 
 All of our Summer Placement roles require you to be currently studying a relevant degree discipline such as Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or other STEM subject degrees. This should be a minimum of a Bachelors level degree.
 All successful candidates must be returning to university after their Summer Placement, i.e. not in their final year.
 In addition to this, we would be interested in hearing from you if you have experience in:
 Coding/programming.
 Relevant project work and/or placements in industry.
 Applying your science and technology knowledge to solve a real-world problem
 This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.

 At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations.  Skills, Qualifications & Knowledge Required 
 Qualifications

You are expected to have an appropriate gap in studies.
 Be enthusiastic and passionate about designing software and writing code with experience of doing this from education or outside interests.

items.desc:
Research Assistant Position on Biomarkers and Pre-emptive Intervention in Infants at-risk for Autism - IT | Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia 
 Research Assistant Position on Biomarkers and Pre-emptive Intervention in Infants at-risk for Autism 
 Italy 
 Commitment & contract: fellow position, collaboration contract 
 Location: Rovereto (TN), CNCS@UniTn - Trento 
 Project: FIRRST: Fostering Infant Responsivity and Reciprocity - Support to Thrive. A Multisite Randomized Control Trial of a Preemptive Telehealth Intervention for Infants with Early Signs of Autism Spectrum Disorders, ” CUP J33C24000910006, funded by the European Union – Next Generation EU – PNRR M6C2 - Investment 2.1 Enhancement and strengthening of biomedical research in the SSN. 
 Step into a world of endless possibilities, together let’s leave something for the future! 
 At IIT, we are committed to advancing human-centered Science and Technology to address the most urgent societal challenges of our era. We foster excellence in both fundamental and applied research, spanning fields such as neuroscience and cognition, humanoid technologies and robotics, artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, and material sciences, offering a truly interdisciplinary scientific experience. Our approach integrates cutting-edge tools and technology, empowering researchers to push the limits of knowledge and innovation. With us, your curiosity will know no bounds.
 We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering diversity in all its forms, creating an inclusive environment. We value the unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives of our people. By embracing diversity, we believe science can achieve its fullest potential.
 THE ROLE 
 The Neurodevelopmental Disorders Research Unit at Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia - IIT ( https://www.iit.it/research/lines/neurodevelopmental-disorders) , led by Dr. Michael Lombardo, is looking for a talented Research Assistant as part of ongoing research partly-funded by a PNRR project (FIRRST) examining pre-emptive intervention in infants screened as at-risk for developing autism. The position will require individuals to be focused on data organization and analyses of EEG and phenotypic data from at-risk infants collected from other collaborative sites working on the project. The Neurodevelopmental Disorders research unit at IIT has the general goal of delineating important distinctions within the population of individuals with autism. The laboratory uses multidisciplinary methods such as observation behavioral methods, neuropsychological testing, eye tracking, EEG, MRI, and fMRI. The successful candidate will aid other lab personnel (PI, post-docs, PhD students, other RAs) in actions relevant to the research program’s aims.

 You will be working in a multi-disciplinary group, where people with different backgrounds collaborate, each with their own expertise, to support IIT research activity. The Human-Robot Interfaces and Interaction (HRI²) research unit is coordinated by Dr. Arash Ajoudani. We develop intelligent robots that can enable timely, natural, and human-in-command interactions with humans on both cognitive and physical levels, representing the concept of socio-physical interaction. Our multidisciplinary approach spans the theoretical, technical, and practical dimensions of modern collaborative systems.
 This position focuses on the design and development of innovative robotic and mechatronic systems, combining advanced mechanical design with sensing, actuation, and control integration. The main goal is to create human-centered robotic platforms that are reliable, ergonomic, and adaptable to real-world applications, enabling intuitive interaction and safe, efficient collaboration with users.
 Within the team, your main responsibilities will be:
 Designing, prototyping, and assembling mechanical and mechatronic components for robotic platforms.
 Supporting the integration of sensors, actuators, and electronic hardware into novel robotic systems.
 Performing testing, validation, and troubleshooting of robotic and mechatronic prototypes.
 Collaborating with researchers to translate conceptual designs into functional hardware .
 Contributing to maintenance, upgrades, and documentation of laboratory equipment and robotic platforms.
 Supporting experimental setups for robot–human interaction studies .
 ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS 
 A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related discipline.
 Documented experience in mechanical design, prototyping, or hardware integration.
 Proficiency in 3D CAD tools (e.g., SolidWorks, Inventor, or similar).
 Good knowledge of the English language.
 Familiarity with the Microsoft Office Suite.
 Strong focus on stakeholder needs and expectations.
 ADDITIONAL SKILLS 
 Experience with rapid prototyping technologies (e.g., 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting).
 Knowledge of electronics, embedded systems, or control hardware for robotics.
 Familiarity with simulation software (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, ROS-based tools).
 Ability to work in a challenging and international environment.
 Capacity to work autonomously and collaboratively in a highly interdisciplinary setting.

items.desc: About Proton Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives! We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top :1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here! The team MSA is a highly multi-disciplinary group started in 2019 to tackle difficult mail delivery, spam, abuse, and account security problems that impact the Proton ecosystem. We built sophisticated systems from scratch that combine big data, human intelligence, machine learning, and AI agents to make tens of millions of realtime or asynchronous decisions each day. Our custom systems have reduced spam filter misclassifications by over 80% and protected millions of users from account compromise by attackers. In order to move fast with limited resources, we are organized into autonomous teams responsible for the whole system, with fullstack expertise across infrastructure, data storage, backend, frontend, machine learning, and AI agents. We are looking for humble, mission-driven, systems-thinking people who want to make a big impact in a startup environment. What You Will Do MSA builds and operates services responsible for different domains. You will: work with other engineers and analysts to design, build, and operate these systems work on user-facing features involving frontend and backend software development You will have the opportunity to play Product or Project Managers roles and lead the whole planning and development process be responsible for the operational excellence of the systems/features and their interaction with other systems You may work on MSA's custom systems written in Python or on the Proton API written in PHP or on Web apps written in React Job Requirements Deep experience with backend development (Python, PHP, or Go) Deep experience with using AI agents for coding Experience with frontend design and development (JavaScript, React, or Typescript) Experience building complex production systems Experience with data processing and storage (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Elastic, Ceph, ClickHouse) Able to work autonomously and lead the whole development process, from design to QA Excellent English communications, both written and spoken Bonus points for: Experience with machine learning and real-time prediction systems Experience with infrastructure-as-code and Kubernetes What We Offer Office First: Collaboration is easier and more effective in person, which is why we have offices in Geneva, Zurich, Prague, Barcelona, Paris, London, Vilnius, Skopje, and Taipei. You can also enjoy working from home up to 30% of the time, while enjoying great company during our three core days in the office. Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals. Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices. Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location. Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us. Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings. Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning. Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs. Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. items.desc: AI Product Evaluators, AI QA Testers & Model Evaluation Specialists. Remote AI Project We are seeking experienced AI Product Evaluators, AI QA Testers, Model Evaluation Specialists, and detail-oriented technology professionals to contribute to a remote AI project focused on testing advanced models and agents. You will follow structured evaluation scenarios, execute operational test cases, assess AI behavior, document anomalies, and submit high-quality evaluation data according to detailed project guidelines. What You’ll Do Evaluate AI models and AI agents using predefined scenarios, instructions, and grading criteria. Execute structured tasks designed to test model accuracy, reasoning, responsiveness, reliability, and instruction-following. Compare model behavior against expected outcomes and identify incorrect, incomplete, inconsistent, or unexpected responses. Document findings, errors, unusual behaviors, and evaluation results in structured written reports. Repeat evaluations when required to verify consistency or test behavior across multiple sessions. Reset usage limits or testing environments according to project procedures and continue evaluation workflows. Record findings and submit evaluation datasets through designated AI training or assessment platforms. Follow detailed project instructions precisely and apply the same standards across large volumes of tasks. Escalate unclear scenarios, unexpected platform behavior, or ambiguous evaluation cases when necessary. Maintain strong accuracy, consistency, and documentation quality across all assigned evaluations. Who Can Apply Relevant backgrounds include AI Product Evaluators, AI Evaluators, Model Evaluators, AI Testers, and AI Quality Specialists. We also welcome AI Trainers, Human Data Specialists, AI Data Annotators, RLHF Contributors, and Model Response Reviewers. Software quality backgrounds may include QA Testers, Software QA Analysts, Quality Assurance Engineers, Manual Testers, and Product Quality Specialists. Product testing backgrounds may include Product Testers, User Acceptance Testers, Digital Product Evaluators, and Application Testers. Operations backgrounds may include Operations Specialists, Process Analysts, Workflow Specialists, Data Operations Professionals, and Research Operations Specialists with strong attention to detail. Additional relevant backgrounds include Technical Support Professionals, Product Operations Specialists, Research Assistants, Trust and Safety Reviewers, and technically proficient professionals who use AI tools extensively. Requirements Experience using AI products, AI models, AI agents, or similar digital tools. Strong ability to follow complex instructions precisely and consistently. Exceptional attention to detail and operational accuracy. Regular use of AI tools in daily life or professional work. Ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and unexpected model behavior. Strong written communication and documentation skills. Comfortable completing repetitive or high-volume evaluation tasks. Strong time management and self-organization skills. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Preferred Background Experience with AI model evaluation, AI product testing, RLHF, human data, or response rating. Experience with software QA, manual testing, user acceptance testing, or digital product evaluation. Experience reviewing AI-generated text, code, images, research outputs, or agent behavior. Experience working with annotation platforms, evaluation dashboards, or structured grading systems. Experience documenting bugs, test results, or operational findings. Experience participating in AI research, digital product testing, or software quality projects. Experience with high-volume operational workflows or structured data collection is valuable. The H4DES project revolves around exploring how state of the art 3D printing technologies can support people in understanding data. We develop techniques for haptic information encoding using fabrication techniques and study the limits of human perception in the context. Specifically, we target the representation of time-dependent, multidimensional, or multivariate data in a 3D context by controlling the behavior of elastic objects in response to specific stimuli. Additionally, we explore how to create 3D-printed sensing artifacts using conductive materials that allow us to measure deformation, for example, for use in VR simulations. You will be part of a collaborative team that values innovation, precision, and continuous improvement. items.desc: Rejoindre Davidson, ce n’est pas seulement intégrer un groupe de 3000 consultants dans 6 pays et 2 continents, c’est intégrer LA société qui a été élue par ses salariés Great Place To Work France et Europe pendant 4 ans mais aussi une des plus grandes B Corp de France, nommée Best of the World dans la catégorie “collaborateurs” en 2022 ! (Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde). Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts : Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté. Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme. Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone… Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Quality and Audit Support Participate in internal audits of the factory in Sevlievo and provide support to implement required changes resulting from audits. Several years of professional experience, preferably in R&D or field closely related with new product introduction. Experience with quality tools, such as DFM, FMEA and problem-solving methods (8D & Ishikawa). 3D design Software and SAP experience is an advantage. High technical understanding and interest in business and process workflows. Fluent in English both spoken and written. Fluent Bulgarian is an advantage. Sprache: Deutsch - Fließend (C1), Englisch - Fließend (C1) Deine Skills Du bist Software Engineer durch und durch und liebst die Herausforderung riesiger Datenmengen. Du verwandelst die Komplexität von Terabytes an Daten in eleganten und effizienten Code. Engineering-Erfahrung: Bring fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit, idealerweise mit einem starken Fokus auf JVM-Sprachen wie Scala oder Java und/oder Python. Big-Data-Know-how: Arbeite sicher mit Spark, Hadoop oder vergleichbaren verteilten Systemen. Erfahrung mit Trino, Flowman oder Delta Lake ist ein zusätzliches Plus. Infrastruktur-Know-how: Kenne dich mit CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes und AWS aus und setze diese Technologien sicher ein. Qualitätsanspruch: Liefere keinen Code ohne Tests aus. Setze auf Effizienz, eine saubere Architektur und pragmatische Lösungen. Open-Source-Fan: Schätze die Freiheit und Transparenz von Open-Source-Software. Bei uns findest du keine Closed-Source- oder Microsoft-Stacks. Mindset: Bring eine „Wir finden eine Lösung“-Mentalität, Hands-on-Mentalität sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit. Tätigkeiten Deine Mission Entwickle skalierbare Plattformen: Entwirf und implementiere technische Lösungen für Big-Data-Anwendungen in einem agilen, leistungsorientierten Umfeld. Optimiere Datenflüsse: Entwickle unsere Daten-Aggregations-Pipelines für TV-Daten, Werbung und Forecasting kontinuierlich weiter und optimiere sie – hauptsächlich auf Basis von Spark und Scala. Setze Cloud-Native-Lösungen um: Betreibe, verwalte und skaliere deine Lösungen mit Docker und Kubernetes in der AWS-Cloud. Setze auf Qualität: Treibe Testautomatisierung konsequent voran – von Unit Tests bis hin zu komplexen Integrationstests. Für uns ist Test Driven Development (TDD) der Weg, um zuverlässige Systeme zu bauen. Erkunde neue Technologien: Bewerte neue Frameworks und Tools, teile deine Erkenntnisse mit dem Team und hilf uns dabei, technologisch an der Spitze der Big-Data-Entwicklung zu bleiben. Team Was dich bei uns erwartet Remote Work mit gezielten Treffen: Wir arbeiten überwiegend remote und kommen gelegentlich für Workshops, Team-Sessions und den gemeinsamen Austausch in unserem Tech-Office in Berlin zusammen. Außerdem veranstalten wir über das Jahr verteilt Team-Events, darunter unser jährliches Company Offsite, das jedes Jahr an einer anderen Location in Deutschland stattfindet. Die Bereitschaft, für diese Treffen anzureisen und daran teilzunehmen, gehört zur Rolle. Eigenverantwortung statt Mikromanagement: Übernimm Verantwortung für deine Themen und bringe sie selbstständig voran. Build > Talk: Früh ausprobieren, früh danebenliegen, früh dazulernen. Hohe Ansprüche, wenig Ego: Wir geben direktes Feedback und arbeiten offen und respektvoll zusammen. Weiterentwicklung: Nutze Hackathons, Konferenzen und Community-Austausch, um fachlich dazuzulernen. Und natürlich stimmen auch die Rahmenbedingungen: 30 Urlaubstage plus frei am 24. und 31. Dezember, Smart Fridays mit der Möglichkeit einer Vier-Tage-Woche, Deutschlandticket und JobRad, Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote, Unterstützung für die mentale Gesundheit, Corporate Benefits, Zugang zu RTL+ und vieles mehr. Our proprietary advertising technology is custom-built for the needs of European broadcasters and publishers — enabling media owners to implement smarter monetisation strategies. We are committed to delivering the most innovative ad experiences spanning in-stream, out-stream, addressable TV, connected TV, audio, and gaming — ultimately empowering brands with true cross-screen storytelling opportunities on all devices. items.desc: Psychology researchers to build the behavioral science scenarios frontier AI labs use to test model judgment. AfterQuery builds the expert evaluation data that frontier AI labs use to measure and improve their models. We're hiring psychology researchers as contractors to author and grade the behavioral science scenarios those evaluations run on. This is our social science listing, and every psychology specialty is welcome. What you'll actually do Author realistic behavioral science scenarios from study design through interpretation, the kind a working researcher actually reasons through. Write reference answers with the methodological reasoning behind each conclusion, constructs, confounds, and effect sizes weighed. Grade model output for construct validity, inference quality, and replication awareness. Flag claims that read plausible but overstate what the evidence supports, the misses only a trained researcher would catch. Who this is for Psychology researchers with an advanced degree in psychology or a closely related behavioral science. Academics, UX researchers, and applied behavioral scientists with at least two years of human subjects or behavioral data research. Researchers who reason from methods and evidence, and know what the replication crisis taught the field. People with strong written English who can turn methodological judgment into clear, teachable reasoning. Contract and pay $60 to $120/hr, paid weekly via Stripe. Your rate is set from your experience, not negotiated down after you start. Fully remote, fully async. No fixed hours. Minimum 10 hours per week, no maximum. Scale up or down week to week. No screen recording, no keystroke monitoring, no idle timers. Independent contractor. Ongoing project work rather than single task batches. How our hiring process works Apply at /apply/psychology-research-expert. About five minutes. Resume plus a few structured questions. Resume review. Every application gets read against a published rubric and gets a decision. Written assessment. You may be asked to take a written assessment for further placement. Onboarding. Sign the contractor agreement, connect Stripe, and get platform access. Project match. You're matched to live work in your specialty, usually within a week of onboarding. About AfterQuery AfterQuery is an expert data lab. We build the evaluation and training data that frontier AI labs use to measure what their models can and can't do in real professional work. Our contributors are practicing professionals, not annotators, and the work is credited, reviewed, and paid at professional rates. Responsibilities Author realistic behavioral science scenarios from study design through interpretation Write reference answers with the methodological reasoning behind each conclusion Grade model output for construct validity, inference quality, and replication awareness Flag claims that read plausible but overstate what the evidence supports Required Qualifications Advanced degree in psychology or a closely related behavioral science 2+ years of research experience with human subjects or behavioral data Working command of study design, measurement, and statistical inference Clear written English for documenting behavioral reasoning Able to commit at least 10 hours per week Preferred Qualifications PhD and peer reviewed publications Cognitive, social, clinical, or industrial organizational specialty depth UX research or applied behavioral science industry experience Why apply Work stays in your specialty, judged on methodological judgment rather than output volume Set your own hours and scale up or down week to week Weekly pay via Stripe at a rate set from your experience Your judgment shapes how the next generation of AI handles human behavior

items.desc: Chaque moment compte. Surtout ceux que vous vivez à fond. Bienvenue chez Consort Group. Consort Group, accompagne depuis plus de 30 ans les entreprises dans la valorisation de leurs données et infrastructures. Elle s'appuie sur deux leaders, Consortis et Consortia, et place l’humain et la responsabilité sociétale au cœur de ses valeurs. C’est votre future équipe Mobilisée pour la réussite de ses clients, l’équipe de Consort Belgium incarne les valeurs et partage les expertises de Consort Group à Bruxelles, dans ses environs, et sur l’ensemble du territoire belge. Forte de 45 collaborateurs, elle propose depuis 2016 une offre de services en Infrastructures et Solutions Applicatives, portée par des équipes locales et appuyée, lorsque nécessaire, par les compétences et ressources du groupe. Analyste Intégration Sénior H/F C’est votre mission Vous êtes passionné·e par les API, les architectures d’intégration et la fiabilité des échanges de données ? Ce poste est fait pour vous. En tant qu’ Analyste Intégration Senior , vous jouez un rôle clé dans la conception, la validation et l’évolution des flux d’intégration. À l’interface entre les équipes métier, les architectes et les développeurs, vous transformez les besoins en spécifications techniques claires et garantissez la qualité des échanges de données, de l’analyse jusqu’à la mise en production. Côté build : Recueillir et analyser les besoins d’intégration auprès des équipes métier, des Product Owners et des partenaires. Rédiger les spécifications d’interface (IDD), incluant les contrats d’API, les mappings de données et les règles de transformation. Analyser et revoir les contrats d’API REST (OpenAPI) et SOAP (WSDL/XSD). Définir les modèles d’échange adaptés : synchrones, asynchrones, événementiels, batch ou publish/subscribe. Contribuer à l’analyse et à la migration des flux d’intégration vers des solutions cibles adaptées. Concevoir et exécuter les tests d’API, fonctionnels, de contrat et de non-régression avec Postman. Participer à l’automatisation des tests et à l’intégration des contrôles qualité dans Azure DevOps. Côté run : Analyser et diagnostiquer les anomalies d’intégration, notamment les erreurs HTTP, les problèmes d’authentification et les incohérences de données. Assurer le suivi des incidents de niveau 2 et 3 en collaboration avec les équipes techniques. Exploiter les logs et les outils de monitoring pour identifier les causes des dysfonctionnements. Valider la qualité, la performance et la non-régression des flux avant leur mise en production. Participer aux décisions de mise en production (Go/No-Go) et au suivi des anomalies. Maintenir à jour la documentation technique, les catalogues d’API, les mappings et les procédures d’exploitation. Veiller au respect des standards d’architecture, de sécurité et de gouvernance des API. C’est votre parcours Vous disposez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience en analyse d’intégration, analyse d’API et/ou tests d’API . Vous avez participé à des projets d’intégration de bout en bout, de l’analyse des besoins jusqu’à la mise en production. Vous aimez comprendre les problématiques métier, traduire les besoins en solutions techniques et garantir la fiabilité des échanges de données. Vous recherchez un environnement où votre expertise, votre autonomie et votre sens de la qualité contribuent directement à la réussite des projets. C’est votre expertise : Vous maîtrisez les API REST et SOAP, les contrats OpenAPI et WSDL/XSD, ainsi que les formats JSON et XML. Vous possédez une solide expérience de Postman et des tests d’API, incluant les tests fonctionnels, les tests de contrat et la non-régression. Vous connaissez les mécanismes de sécurité des API : OAuth2, JWT, TLS/mTLS et gestion des certificats. Vous avez travaillé avec une plateforme d’intégration telle qu’Azure Integration Services, MuleSoft, BizTalk ou Boomi. Vous maîtrisez SQL pour vérifier la cohérence des données et contribuer au diagnostic des anomalies. Une expérience d’Azure DevOps, d’Application Insights, de Log Analytics/KQL et des architectures événementielles constitue un atout. Une connaissance de MuleSoft, de DataWeave et des projets de migration vers Azure Integration Services sera particulièrement appréciée. C’est votre manière de faire équipe : Vous faites preuve d’un esprit analytique et d’une grande rigueur dans l’analyse des besoins, la rédaction des spécifications et la validation des interfaces. Vous êtes autonome, proactif·ve et orienté·e solutions, avec le souci constant de la qualité et de la fiabilité. Vous communiquez efficacement avec des interlocuteurs métier et techniques et appréciez le travail collaboratif ainsi que le partage de connaissances. C’est notre engagement Chez Consort Group, vous êtes un·e expert·e qu’on accompagne pour que chaque mission devienne une étape qui compte. Un onboarding attentif et humain Une vraie proximité managériale Des formations accessibles en continu Des engagements concrets : inclusion, égalité, …

Automatiser la collecte, la consolidation, la vérification des éléments de preuve et l’analyse de données issues de multiples sources. Développer des prototypes et des outils d’automatisation à l’aide du Vibe Coding et des capacités IA internes de l’entreprise. Rédiger des prompts structurés et traduire les besoins métier en solutions simples, efficaces et reproductibles. Produire des tableaux de suivi, des synthèses de contrôle et faciliter la gestion des plans d’actions correctives. Capitaliser sur les réalisations en formalisant les procédures, les modes opératoires et la documentation technique et fonctionnelle associée. Votre futur impact Dans 4 à 6 mois Vous aurez conçu une arborescence documentaire structurée et mis en place un référentiel des principaux documents et contrôles d’audit. Vous aurez développé plusieurs outils ou traitements automatisés pour simplifier la préparation des audits et réduire les tâches répétitives. Vous aurez acquis une bonne compréhension des enjeux de gouvernance et d’Audit IT au sein d’un grand groupe informatique. Compétences requises : Vous possédez une bonne compréhension des systèmes d’information et de la manipulation des données. Vous disposez de connaissances de base en développement ou scripting, notamment en Python, ainsi qu’une maîtrise des formats de données courants (Excel, CSV, JSON). Vous avez une première expérience des outils de développement assisté par IA. Vous montrez un réel intérêt pour l’intelligence artificielle générative, le Prompt Engineering et le Vibe Coding. Vous faites preuve de rigueur, de méthode, de curiosité et d’un bon esprit d’analyse pour comprendre les besoins métier. C'est un + Une sensibilité aux enjeux de sécurité, de confidentialité et de traçabilité des données est très appréciée.

items.desc: Sei una persona appassionata di AI Generativa , Microsoft Copilot e innovazione dei processi aziendali ? Per il nostro cliente, un rinomato gruppo industriale agroalimentare italiano , siamo alla ricerca di una figura di AI Functional Analyst che agisca come consulente interno, guidi l'adozione dell'AI e sviluppi soluzioni operative al fianco dei vari reparti aziendali. Il ruolo: Cerchiamo un profilo funzionale, che riportando direttamente all' IT manager di gruppo, con forte autonomia pratica capace di analizzerà le esigenze di business, configurerà strumenti e guiderà le persone nell'uso quotidiano dell'AI. Sperimentazione & Adozione Copilot: Seguirai verticalmente l'utilizzo delle licenze Microsoft 365 Copilot , affiancando gli utenti e proponendo nuovi spunti/casi d'uso per migliorare la produttività quotidiana. Creazione di Agenti AI e Chatbot: Progetterai e configurerai direttamente agenti virtuali e bot conversazionali su MS Teams (es. per processi HR, FAQ interne, automazione documentale). Analisi di Processo & Business Partnering: Raccoglierai le esigenze dei reparti aziendali (HR, Finance, Operations) e le tradurrai in soluzioni pratiche, valutando la fattibilità e l'integrazione con i nostri sistemi (ERP, Data Center locale). AI Governance & Sicurezza del Dato: Collaborerai con il team IT per garantire la corretta gestione del dato e l'allineamento con le policy interne e normative vigenti (es. AI Act). Collaborazione a 360°: Sarai l'interfaccia tra gli utenti interni, il team IT e i fornitori/partner esterni per i progetti più complessi, partecipando attivamente anche ad altre iniziative digitali dell'area IT. Requisiti: Esperienza 2-4 anni in ruoli di Analista Funzionale IT, Consulente M365, PM o Junior AI Product Specialist. Ottima conoscenza dell'ecosistema Microsoft 365 , di Microsoft Copilot e strumenti come Copilot Studio / Power Platform . Padronanza delle logiche di Prompt Engineering, conoscenza del funzionamento di LLM e chatbot conversazionali. Buona comprensione delle dinamiche di integrazione tra architetture Cloud (M365) e sistemi aziendali tradizionali (ERP / Data Center On-Premise). Capacità di muoverti in autonomia nell'ambiente IT per creare prototipi, verificare flussi e testare soluzioni senza dipendere esclusivamente da partner esterni. Luogo di lavoro: provincia di Vicenza Retribuzione annua lorda: 35.000-40.000 euro Summary On-site Permanent Camisano Vicentino

items.desc: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: €34.000,00 - €62.000,00 Location: Treviso,ITA You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . We are seeking multiple Equipment Trainer Engineer to deliver high‑quality training to our Field Service Engineers on installation, start‑up, maintenance, and commissioning of advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This role combines technical expertise, classroom and hands-on instruction, global collaboration, and project leadership. The ideal candidate brings deep technical knowledge, strong communication skills, and a passion for developing others in a high‑tech environment. General Profile We offer selected candidates advanced training pathways, including comprehensive hands‑on and classroom learning experiences delivered worldwide. In this position, after training, you will deliver both theoretical and hands‑on courses, support global training initiatives, and maintain expert-level knowledge of our semiconductor equipment. You will work independently with minimal guidance, solve complex technical and instructional challenges and serve as a key technical resource for colleagues worldwide. Key Responsibilities Deliver high-quality technical training classes—both theoretical and hands‑on—on advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment at our Global Technical Learning Center in Treviso, Italy. Collaborate with the global technical training team to develop, implement, and maintain training and certification programs, as well as ongoing learning activities. Leverage modern learning technologies to enhance both online and in‑person training experiences. Support the installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of training lab equipment and tools at the local site. Manage day-to-day operational activities related to the training organization at the Treviso facility. Deliver technical training both in-house and at customer sites, with a focus on specialized and customized courses; this includes domestic and international travel, as well as occasional off‑shift or weekend training as required. Stay current with internal technology advancements and partner with business units to ensure the latest systems, tools, and processes are incorporated into all training programs. Lead and manage multiple projects with diverse scope and complexity, including coordination of project team members. Collaborate with Technical Publications and Product Business Groups to optimize technical documentation; create or enhance documentation to address gaps; evaluate instructor performance; and train others in standard course development processes, including Instructional System Design (ISD). Provide advanced technical expertise and troubleshooting support for system repairs; ensure training systems meet course requirements and adhere to all safety retrofits and standards. Maintain deep technical knowledge of assigned products to prepare and deliver product-specific courses; share new information with the training team; complete and maintain certifications across multiple platforms and processes, including safety modules; and participate in certifying others. Review published training materials and recommend updates or revisions to maintain accuracy and relevance. Provide coaching, leadership, and mentorship to other instructors; support their technical development, classroom delivery, and certification; and proactively address customer satisfaction issues. From global health to climate change, AI to business leadership, here at Imperial we navigate some of the world’s toughest challenges. items.desc: Du bist interessiert an der Stelle als Data Scientist (w/m/d) – Applied AI bei smartclip Europe GmbH ? Auf Instaffo kannst du dich für diesen und weitere Jobs ohne großen Aufwand bewerben. Erstelle dein Profil in unter 2 Minuten und starte den Bewerbungsprozess mit nur wenigen Klicks. Anforderungen Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland erforderlich ist. Sprache: Deutsch - Fließend (C1), Englisch - Fließend (C1) Deine Skills Fundierte technische Grundlagen: Bring Kenntnisse in Informatik, Softwareentwicklung oder Data Science mit – erworben durch Studium, Promotion oder praktische Erfahrung. Du kannst deine Methodenwahl begründen und Ergebnisse kritisch bewerten. Verständnis für AI: Du musst keine Modelle in PyTorch trainieren. Du kannst aber den Unterschied zwischen Prefill und Decode erklären und wie dieser für Latenz und Kosten relevant ist. Eigenständiges AI-native Development: Nutze Coding-Agenten, um schneller zu entwickeln. Validiere den generierten Code, teste die Ergebnisse und verstehe, wie deine Anwendung und ihre Komponenten funktionieren. Strukturiertes Experimentieren: Formuliere klare Specs, definiere eine Definition of Done und prüfe mit passenden Tests und Evaluationen, ob deine Umsetzung das richtige Problem löst. Offene Zusammenarbeit: Teile Wissen, diskutiere technische Entscheidungen und gib respektvolles, direktes Feedback. Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erfahrung mit NLP/Computerlinguistik, Agentic Retrieval oder der Entwicklung von LLM-Agenten. Tätigkeiten Deine Mission Eine Stelle, zwei Schwerpunkte. Ob du einen vertiefst oder beide, entscheiden dein Können und deine Vorlieben. AI gehört immer dazu. Knowledge Agents & Agentic Retrieval Wie beantwortet ein Agent eine Frage, deren Antwort über Tausende Dokumente verteilt ist? Wie erkennt er Widersprüche zwischen Entwürfen und finalen Fassungen? Und wie belegt er seine Antworten zuverlässig? Entwickle Agenten, die Informationen über große Dokumentbestände hinweg erschließen. Untersuche, wie sich Vollständigkeit, Widersprüche und die Qualität von Quellen bewerten lassen. Sorge dafür, dass Antworten nachvollziehbar bleiben und Unsicherheiten sichtbar werden. Machine Learning at Scale Wir messen das Werbegeschehen bei mehr als 150 TV-Sendern in Europa. Unser Ziel: lineares Fernsehen so planbar und messbar machen wie digitale Werbung. Entwickle Prognosemodelle für die Leistung von Werbeblöcken. Bewerte Unsicherheiten, Messfehler und die Aussagekraft deiner Modelle. Verarbeite große Datenmengen mit Spark auf unserem Cluster und untersuche, wo Datenqualität oder Verarbeitung die Ergebnisse beeinflussen. In beiden Bereichen machst du aus einer guten Frage etwas, das läuft: Experimentiere und evaluiere: Formuliere Hypothesen, entwirf aussagekräftige Tests und lerne aus Ergebnissen, auch wenn diese nicht deine Erwartungen erfüllen. Übernimm Verantwortung: Entwickle deinen Ansatz eigenständig bis zum belastbaren Prototyp. Hol dir einen zweiten Blick oder denk mit deinem Team am Whiteboard weiter. Arbeite mit Engineering: Begleite die Überführung deines Prototyps in ein Produkt und bringe dein Wissen über Problem und Lösung ein. Unterstütze andere Teams: Bewerte Datenfragen, zeige sinnvolle Einsatzmöglichkeiten von AI auf und liefere je nach Bedarf eine fundierte Empfehlung oder einen Prototyp. Team Unser Stack Knowledge Agents: Python (Pydantic AI), TypeScript, vLLM/SGLang Daten und Pipelines: Spark, Trino, StarRocks, Postgres und Prefect Infrastruktur und Observability: OpenTelemetry, Docker/Kubernetes Kennst du eher Ray, LangChain, Airflow, passt das genauso: Die Konzepte zählen, nicht die Logos. Was dich bei uns erwartet Was dich bei uns erwartet Remote Work mit gezielten Treffen: Wir arbeiten überwiegend remote und kommen gelegentlich für Workshops, Team-Sessions und den gemeinsamen Austausch in unserem Tech-Office in Berlin zusammen. Außerdem veranstalten wir über das Jahr verteilt Team-Events, darunter unser jährliches Company Offsite, das jedes Jahr an einer anderen Location in Deutschland stattfindet. Die Bereitschaft, für diese Treffen anzureisen und daran teilzunehmen, gehört zur Rolle. Eigenverantwortung statt Mikromanagement: Übernimm Verantwortung für deine Themen und bringe sie selbstständig voran. Build > Talk: Früh ausprobieren, früh danebenliegen, früh dazulernen. Hohe Ansprüche, wenig Ego: Wir geben direktes Feedback und arbeiten offen und respektvoll zusammen. Weiterentwicklung: Nutze Hackathons, Konferenzen und Community-Austausch, um fachlich dazuzulernen. Und natürlich stimmen auch die Rahmenbedingungen: 30 Urlaubstage plus frei am 24. und 31. Dezember, Smart Fridays mit der Möglichkeit einer Vier-Tage-Woche, Deutschlandticket und JobRad, Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote, Unterstützung für die mentale Gesundheit, Corporate Benefits, Zugang zu RTL+ und vieles mehr. items.desc: Job Description Dołącz do NATEK Polska jako Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist i wesprzyj projekt w branży FMCG, który koncentruje się na budowie i rozwoju modeli ML służących do predykcji oraz analizy wpływu działań promocjyjnych w obszarze retail. Jest to środowisko o wysokim stopniu złożoności, w którym wykorzystywane są nowoczesne metody modelowania, w tym sieci neuronowe oraz zaawansowane algorytmy Machine Learning. Poszukujemy osoby, która posiada doświadczenie w realizacji pełnego cyklu życia modeli ML, od analizy problemu biznesowego i doboru metod modelowania, przez rozwój, trening i walidację modeli, aż po ich wdrożenie, monitorowanie oraz dalszą optymalizację. Your Responsibilities Prowadzenie prac badawczych i dobór odpowiednich metod modelowania. Budowa i rozwój modeli Machine Learning. Trenowanie, walidacja oraz utrzymanie modeli produkcyjnych. Automatyzacja procesów związanych z cyklem życia modeli. Rozwijanie istniejących rozwiązań i optymalizacja ich działania. Zarządzanie eksperymentami oraz wersjonowaniem modeli z wykorzystaniem narzędzi MLOps. Współpraca z interesariuszami biznesowymi przy interpretacji wyników oraz przekładaniu ich na rekomendacje biznesowe. Udział w rozwoju kilku równolegle funkcjonujących modeli wykorzystywanych w procesach biznesowych (obecnie ok. 5–6 modeli). Our Requirements Minimum 4–5 lat doświadczenia w obszarze Machine Learning lub Data Science. Doświadczenie w samodzielnym realizowaniu projektów Machine Learning w modelu end-to-end. Praktyczna znajomość budowy, treningu, walidacji i wdrażania modeli produkcyjnych. items.desc: About The Role We already run two kinds of agent alongside our teams. AI agents diagnose performance problems and tell people the root cause. Rule-based agents recommend marketing actions to our advertising teams. The quality of their decisions shows up directly in our revenue. Next, both take a greater role in the day-to-day running of our lead generation business, moving from recommending, to acting with a person's approval, to acting on their own where it is safe. We need an engineer to build agents that are dependable in production, measurable, and safe to trust with more. This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll own agents end to end, from understanding the workflow to running them in production, alongside our existing AI engineer, data scientists, product managers and the people who use the agents every day. Today we use Claude and open-weight models such as GLM, chosen per task on quality and cost, on an agent framework we build ourselves. What You'll Do Build agents Start from the workflow. Sit with the operators, map how the work is actually done, and build for that, not for the process as documented. Build on shared rules. Rule-based and LLM agents that call shared, versioned rules and tools, not logic hard-coded inside each agent. Connect them to the business. Using our data warehouse, internal services, and the APIs into the systems agents act in. Turn outputs into results people trust. Structured outputs, validation and clear application logic. Make them safe to trust Log every decision. Each action records its context, what was chosen, and whether a person accepted or overrode it, so agents can be evaluated and improved. Build the path to autonomy. Per decision, agents move from recommend, to act with approval, to act alone. Our data scientists propose the bar from agreement and override data and point people in the business sign it off; you build the mechanism that enforces it on our shared agent framework, with permissions and guardrails in the code, not the prompt. Evaluate behaviour, not just code. Test sets, agreement with expert operators, and evaluation before and after every change. Run what you ship. Tracing, failure handling, and tracking quality, latency and cost. There's no on-call rota. What we're offering you: Summer Fridays Competitive holiday benefits - 25 days a year paid holiday, plus 8 bank holidays (increases 1 day a year up to 30 days) Hybrid working - 3 days a week in the office Closed for Christmas holidays - Extra days not taken from your annual holiday allowance. Work from anywhere for 2 weeks a year Life Assurance and Income Protection to protect your loved ones Benefits allowance for health, dental, and vision coverage Six months paid maternity leave, and one month paid paternity leave (subject to qualifying conditions) inclusive of same-sex and adoptive parents Defined Contribution Pension and Salary Sacrifice Scheme Be Well: Our award-winning wellbeing and mental health programme to support all MVFers and their families Family Forward support for our MVF parents and their mini-mes 2 charity days a year What We're Looking For 3+ years of engineering, including at least one LLM application or agent shipped to real users. Python and TypeScript: production-grade in one and productive in the other, with typed, tested code and clear interfaces. You'll work in both here. LLM engineering: tool calling, structured outputs, context management, and evaluating agent behaviour on representative test sets. Integration and operations: SQL, HTTP APIs, containers, CI/CD and a cloud platform, and debugging from logs and traces. Nice to have Agents used daily by operators, with a feedback loop. AWS SageMaker, AWS ECS/Fargate, Terraform and CircleCI. Snowflake and dbt. Event logging for analytics or machine learning. Lead generation or ad tech. How You'll Work Commercial impact. You understand how the business creates value and use that to make better choices about what gets built, prioritised or stopped. You define the intended impact before starting, consider the cost of the work and evaluate what happened afterwards. Delivery and ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes and move at a pace matched to the cost of delay. You follow work through until it is delivered, handed over or deliberately stopped, and remain accountable for what happens after delivery. Candour and communication. You surface important information early, including when it is uncomfortable, with evidence and a view on what to do about it. You communicate what is known, assumed and uncertain in a form the audience can understand and act on. Making others better. You create lasting improvement in other people's and the team's work through teaching, feedback or challenge, and take challenge on your own work as readily as you give it. Growth and mastery. You deepen your capability through deliberate practice, feedback and experience, build the skills the work will need next, and change established practices …

items.desc: About The Role We are looking for an AI Engineer to help build Blue Yonder's next generation of AI-powered products. As part of Blue Yonder's Autonomy Labs, you will work with experienced software engineers, model-training teams, data engineers, researchers, and product owners to develop agents that operate within real supply chain and retail workflows. You will contribute to the services, APIs, evaluation systems, data flows, and development environments that allow us to train, test, deploy, and continuously improve these systems. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for a software engineer who wants to work close to the model-development lifecycle. You do not need to be a model-training researcher, but you should be curious about how model behavior, evaluation results, traces, and data can be used to build better models and more reliable products. Your Mission Help turn capable AI models into dependable software. You will implement and improve well-defined parts of our agent systems, contribute to technical design, and work with teammates to understand how agents behave in realistic workflows. The challenge is not simply to make a model produce a convincing response. It is to build agents that can use tools, interact with APIs, follow business constraints, manage failures, and complete useful work reliably. What You'll Do Build and maintain backend services, APIs, tools, and integrations used by AI agents and model-development workflows. Contribute to training and evaluation environments that represent realistic business workflows through APIs, simulations, test scenarios, and reproducible state. Implement pipelines and application components that collect and process agent traces, tool calls, workflow outcomes, evaluation results, and user feedback. Develop automated evaluations and verification checks for model and agent behavior, including task completion, tool-use correctness, and regression testing. Review agent traces and test results to identify failure modes, reproduce issues, and help determine whether improvements are needed in software, tools, data, prompts, or models. Work with model-training teams to integrate and assess new models and turn observed behavior into useful engineering feedback. Write clean, tested, maintainable Python code and contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, and team engineering practices. Improve the reliability and operability of services through logging, monitoring, automated testing, error handling, and support for safe deployments. Collaborate with senior engineers on system design and take ownership of scoped components from implementation through testing and operation. Learn quickly, share findings, and contribute practical ideas as the team develops new approaches to agent training, evaluation, and production use. What We're Looking For Around three or more years of software engineering experience, or equivalent practical depth, building and maintaining production software. Strong Python skills and experience with backend development, including APIs, data processing, automated testing, and service integration. Hands-on experience developing with LLMs, AI agents, machine learning systems, or other data-intensive software. Familiarity with tool calling, prompt and context management, retrieval, structured outputs, or agent orchestration. A practical understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including maintainability, testing, version control, observability, and secure development. Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP and familiarity with containers and CI/CD workflows. The ability to investigate unfamiliar systems, break down problems, incorporate feedback, and deliver reliable work within a larger technical design. Clear communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with engineers, researchers, data specialists, and product teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience creating evaluation cases, reviewing model traces, diagnosing agent failures, or testing nondeterministic systems. Familiarity with model-training or post-training concepts such as supervised fine-tuning, preference data, reinforcement learning, reward or verifier design, or checkpoint evaluation. Experience with data pipelines, dataset preparation, synthetic data, experiment tracking, or model deployment workflows. Experience building simulations, test harnesses, developer tools, or integrations with complex enterprise systems. Experience with supply chain, retail, or other environments involving multi-step workflows, permissions, business constraints, and human approvals. What Makes This Role Different This role offers the opportunity to develop as a software engineer at the intersection of model development and production AI. You will contribute to real systems that make agent behavior measurable and improvable, while working closely with engineers and model-training specialists on problems that span APIs, data, …

Du hjälper våra kunder att gå från traditionell kvalitetssäkring till intelligenta, skalbara och datadrivna kvalitetsprocesser där AI-agenter, automation och moderna plattformar blir en naturlig del av leveransen. Du blir en strategisk rådgivare, teknisk expert och förändringsledare i ett. I den här rollen spelar du en nyckelroll i: Designa och implementera AI-first-strategier för kvalitetssäkring, testautomation och kontinuerlig kvalitet i komplexa kundmiljöer. Arbeta nära kunder för att identifiera affärsutmaningar och omsätta dem till värdeskapande lösningar med hjälp av Agentic AI, automation och moderna kvalitetsplattformar. Leda och driva initiativ där AI-agenter förstärker testning, analys, kravvalidering och kvalitetsarbete genom hela utvecklingslivscykeln. Skapa återanvändbara ramverk, acceleratorer och assets som möjliggör skalbar leverans över flera kunder och branscher. Flera års arbetslivserfarenhet inom testning, kvalitetssäkring och/eller testautomation i konsultuppdrag hos kunder i varierade branscher. Dokumenterad förmåga att kombinera teknisk förståelse med stark affärsförståelse och problemlösning. Erfarenhet av AI-lösningar, inklusive arbete med Agentic AI, AI-agenter eller liknande intelligenta arbetsflöden. items.desc: We're Capital on Tap 👋 💳 Capital on Tap started because small businesses were underserved. Big banks were slow, their products weren't fit for purpose, and small business owners often couldn't access what they needed. We set out to fix that. Today we're a financial platform - not just a credit card company. We offer a best-in-class business credit card, SME-focused spend management platform, a savings product that hit £1 billion in funds within its first year, and a growing suite of tools and financial products that make running a small business easier. 1,000+ employees, £20bn in annual card spend, 200,000+ customers, 17,000+ Trustpilot reviews averaging 4.7 stars, and we're profitable. We've done a pretty good job so far, but we're just getting started! 📍 London (Moorgate) | 🏢 3 Days in Office The Role Most companies talk about AI. We're building the infrastructure to make it stick. This role exists to close the gap between AI's potential and what our teams actually use every day. You'll embed with a team, find the highest-impact opportunities, build the tools that solve them, and train the team to run them long after you've moved on. This isn't a research or strategy role. You'll be shipping automations, MCPs, plugins, agentic workflows, and the training that goes with them. You'll be measured on impact and weekly active users, not on launches or tools rolled out. If you'd rather be doing than advising, this is for you. What You'll Be Doing Analyse where AI can move the needle most. Map a team's processes end-to-end before proposing a single tool, and prioritise the workflows where AI can take real cost, time, or rework off the table. Build the right stack for the problem - production-grade agentic workflows that bridge LLMs, internal APIs, and case management tools, plus MCPs, Claude skills and plugins, n8n automations, and integrations with internal systems. You build it, debug it in production, and iterate live with users sitting next to you. Train the people who'll use it. Run hands-on sessions, write documentation people actually read, and coach AI champions inside every team you work with so they're self-sufficient before you move on. Roll out and measure. Active automations running unsupervised matter more than trainings delivered or pilots launched. Track weekly active AI users and impact per team, intervene when usage drops, and keep iterating until AI is part of how the team works. Maintain Capital on Tap's AI playbook. Document repeatable patterns, package them as reusable skills and templates, and make every engagement start faster than the last. Partner with senior stakeholders to decide where to point next, and what good looks like before you start. We're Looking For Deployed AI tools in environments where downtime, errors, or rework have real cost - not sandbox experimentation. Hands-on, proven experience with Claude, Cursor, n8n, Zapier, or similar in a real business context. Technical fluency across low-code/no-code tools, APIs, MCPs, and integrations; comfortable in SQL and familiar with BI tooling. 2-5 years in product ops, operations, strategy, technical programme management, internal consulting, or a similar hands-on role. Strong communicator. You can run a workshop that lands, write documentation people actually read, and translate jargon for any audience. Comfortable with ambiguity. You diagnose fast, prioritise ruthlessly, and ship a working v1 inside a week even when the team you're working with isn't yet sure what they want. High ownership. You figure out what needs doing and do it, without waiting to be told. Even if you don't have all of the necessary skills, we still encourage you to apply. Diversity & Inclusion 🌈 We welcome, consider and encourage applications from anyone who shares our commitment to inclusivity. Join us in creating a space where authenticity thrives, and everyone can do their best work. Great Work Deserves Great Perks We try not to take ourselves too seriously (all the time) so we make sure our office is decked out with a pool table, arcade machine, beer tap, and a couple of office dogs thrown in for good measure. items.desc: Descrizione azienda MC Engineering è una dinamica società di consulenza informatica , con sedi a Torino, Milano, Roma e Bari. Lavoriamo a stretto contatto con realtà innovative nel mondo ICT, portando avanti progetti che spaziano tra vari settori. Per noi, le persone sono al centro di tutto : puntiamo su un continuo aggiornamento, sulla crescita costante e sull’ eccellenza , per affrontare insieme sfide innovative e fare la differenza nel nostro settore. Posizione Cosa farai con noi? Come AI Integration Engineer avrai l’opportunità di lavorare su progetti innovativi orientati all’integrazione di soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale Generativa all’interno di ecosistemi enterprise complessi. Sarai coinvolto nello sviluppo e nell’orchestrazione di integrazioni AI-based, contribuendo alla progettazione di architetture moderne basate su Large Language Model (LLM), AI Agents e sistemi di automazione intelligente. Ti occuperai dell’integrazione di modelli AI all’interno di piattaforme e applicazioni aziendali tramite API, microservizi e workflow avanzati, collaborando con team multidisciplinari per garantire scalabilità, qualità e sicurezza delle soluzioni implementate. Opererai in un contesto collaborativo e strutturato, orientato alla qualità e all’innovazione, dove il tuo contributo sarà valorizzato attraverso un percorso di crescita professionale. Requisiti Competenze richieste Laurea o diploma tecnico Esperienza di almeno 3 anni nello sviluppo software, system integration o AI Engineering Ottima conoscenza di Python Esperienza nell’integrazione di API REST e servizi enterprise Buona conoscenza dei Large Language Model (LLM) Esperienza con piattaforme AI come OpenAI, Azure OpenAI o soluzioni analoghe Conoscenza di architetture a microservizi e integrazione applicativa Familiarità con ambienti cloud (Azure, AWS o GCP) Esperienza con strumenti DevOps e CI/CD Capacità di troubleshooting e ottimizzazione di workflow AI-driven Conoscenza di database SQL/NoSQL. Lingua inglese Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (livello B2) Modalità e/o Sede di Lavoro Modalità Full Remote Completano il profilo Un’elevata attitudine al lavoro in team Doti di precisione e flessibilità mentale Capacità proattiva nella gestione delle problematiche professionali Forte orientamento all’innovazione e all’apprendimento continuo Ottime capacità comunicative verso interlocutori tecnici e business. Altre informazioni Cosa offriamo Inserimento in organico con un inquadramento commisurato all’esperienza professionale pregressa e una retribuzione in linea con le reali capacità del candidato. Se sei una persona appassionata di tecnologia e Intelligenza Artificiale, desiderosa di crescere in un ambiente che promuove innovazione, qualità ed eccellenza tecnologica, questa è l’occasione che fa per te! Unisciti a MC Engineering: dove le idee diventano innovazione!
