The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience designing research experiments, running benchmarks and ablation studies , analyzing model behavior, and conducting research in areas such as robustness, interpretability, evaluation, or statistical machine
items.desc: Role: Machine Learning Research Scientist Engagement: Remote | Contract / Freelance Experience: 4+ years hands-on research experience; 5+ years preferred Education: Master’s degree or higher About the Role We are looking for experienced Machine Learning Research Scientists focused on experimental ML research rather than production ML engineering. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience designing research experiments, running benchmarks and ablation studies , analyzing model behavior, and conducting research in areas such as robustness, interpretability, evaluation, or statistical machine learning . Key Responsibilities Design and execute rigorous machine learning research experiments. Develop and run benchmarks, baselines, and ablation studies . Evaluate model performance using statistically sound methodologies. Investigate model robustness, interpretability, generalization, and failure modes . Formulate research hypotheses and validate them experimentally. Conduct quantitative analysis of experimental results using Python and statistical methods. Compare models and methodologies using reproducible experimental frameworks. Document research findings, assumptions, limitations, and conclusions. Required Qualifications 4+ years of hands-on ML research experience; 5+ years preferred. Master’s degree or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a closely related field. Strong proficiency in Python and statistics . Hands-on experience conducting ML experiments and research. Experience with benchmarking and ablation studies . Strong understanding of statistical evaluation and experimental design. Experience in one or more areas such as: Robustness Interpretability Model evaluation Generalization Statistical machine learning Experimental ML research Active and credible professional LinkedIn profile. Preferred Background Research Scientist, ML Research Scientist, Applied Research Scientist, Researcher – Machine Learning, or Statistical ML Researcher. Important: This is a research-focused position, not an ML Engineering role .

items.card: What you'll do at Jamf: At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. As a Software Engineer II on a new team enabling secure, governed adoption of autonomous and agentic workflows, you'll help build production systems where AI agents do real work on real code - authoring changes inside deterministic gates, with independent verification and a full audit trail. This is a greenfield build
items.desc: At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple. The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf. This role is offered as a hybrid in Brno, the Czech Republic . We are only able to accept applications for those based in the Czech Republic or who have sponsorship to live and work in the Czech Republic . What you'll do at Jamf: At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. As a Software Engineer II on a new team enabling secure, governed adoption of autonomous and agentic workflows, you'll help build production systems where AI agents do real work on real code - authoring changes inside deterministic gates, with independent verification and a full audit trail. This is a greenfield build inside a mature platform, starting with Security. What you can expect to do in this role: Build the production systems where AI agents do real work on real code – authoring changes that run inside deterministic gates, with independent verification and a full audit trail behind every one. Take customer and platform problems, break them into workable pieces with your agile team, and own most of them end to end. Draw the line on autonomy: design the trust boundaries, blast radius, and least-privilege model for the automation itself, which holds elevated access to production. Build the evaluation and observability that keeps non-deterministic systems honest – measuring accuracy and catching silent degradation before anyone else does. Make the systems answer the auditor's "show me" – producing evidence that a control worked, not just the claim that it did. Work shoulder to shoulder with security engineering and PDD developers, and explain the tricky parts clearly to the rest of the organization. Bring engineering best practices to the table: ask the sharp questions, solve the hard problems, and help others level up. What we are looking for: Must-have: 3+ years building enterprise-grade software commercially, with a solid grasp of testing and QA. 3+ years of commercial experience in Java or Python. Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs and agentic frameworks – tool calling, multi-step execution, structured output – well beyond using AI coding assistants. Hands-on experience with AI-driven coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) to speed up your own work. Sound judgment about where automation should and shouldn't act on its own – and the ability to articulate exactly where that line sits. You think in trust boundaries, blast radius, and least privilege by default. You treat vulnerability management as a discipline: severity and exploitability, SLAs, and exception handling. Experience in an agile organization and with build systems like Jenkins or Bamboo. You build trust and rapport across all levels, and do your best work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Nice-to-have: Software supply chain security – SBOMs, provenance and attestation, image signing and verification, policy-as-code. Experience running AI coding agents at repository scale, and building the harness that makes their output trustworthy. Familiarity with AI governance in a security context – model-use policy, data handling, and the audit questions that follow an agent-initiated production change. Experience in a regulated environment (SOC 2, FedRAMP, or similar) and a feel for what auditors actually ask for. Why Jamf? We are progressive but laid back. You are free to be yourself and work how you work best. Here, you manage your own day and your own work style. You will have the opportunity to work with a small and empowered team where the culture is based on trust, ownership, and respect. With hybrid and remote roles, we offer an open flexible culture based on respect and trust. Benefits are a critical part of the "whole employee experience". Our benefits package includes 30 days of paid time off, 3 paid days to volunteer, Benefit Plus cafeteria, Multisport Card, and more. Visit our Jamf Engineering blog to learn more about the innovative projects our team is working on and what we learn from each challenge we solve. A blog written by engineers, for engineers at medium.com/jamf-engineering What it means to be a Jamf? We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that …

Job
items.desc: Summary You will become part of the AI and Automated Detection sub-division in Bratislava. Backed by a major AI investment program across the company, we build systems that defend against real-world cyber threats at scale, from automated threat detection processing terabytes of behavioral data, to multi-agent AI systems that help security analysts work faster, to SOAR platforms that automate incident response. Job Description Our work spans distributed backend services, machine learning pipelines, LLM-powered agents, and production security tooling. items.desc: Why this role exists SevenLab is an Amsterdam-based AI solutions company. We (help) build AI agents, AI applications and sovereign AI infrastructure for organisations that take data seriously: healthcare, the public sector, logistics and manufacturing. We work as an NVIDIA partner, we are ISO 27001 certified, and we deliver through a Software Development as a Service model: fixed monthly partnerships instead of hourly billing. Our entry point is a €7K fixed-scope POC. From there, clients move into a monthly partnership (Private AI, AI Applications or Governed Build). Our differentiator is that everything we build can run on EU infrastructure, backed by Sluis, our own AI governance and gateway layer with EU data residency. The demand is there. What we lack is a repeatable outbound system that identifies these organisations at the moment they start caring about AI and data sovereignty, and books a qualified conversation in our Account Executive's calendar. Building and running that system is your job. You build it, you run it, and you own the results it produces. Tasks What you'll actually do First 30 days: take over our current sales systems: Attio, Clay, our email sequences and the partner motions we already run. Audit them. Tell us honestly what's broken. Fix the worst thing and propose what else to change. Days 30–90: build our core outbound motion from scratch, starting with the Dutch market. Define the ICP per segment (public sector, healthcare, logistics, manufacturing), build the enrichment waterfall, design the signal triggers, write and test the sequences, and get the Attio data model to a state where pipeline reporting isn't a work of fiction. Day 90 onwards: you own top-of-funnel. You run experiments weekly, kill what doesn't work fast, and document what does so it survives you. You feed qualified meetings to our Account Executive and work with commercial leadership on which segments and partner channels to scale next. Requirements Must have 2–4 years of hands-on experience building and running outbound systems (GTM engineering, growth, RevOps or SDR-plus roles) Proven, practical experience with Clay, Attio (or a comparable CRM) and an outbound email tool such as Instantly, including deliverability and inbox management Track record of building signal-based lists and enrichment waterfalls, and of measuring what they produced Comfortable doing 15-minute intro calls with prospects, or a clear willingness to learn Understanding of GDPR-compliant data sourcing and able to explain the origin of every contact in a list Professional Dutch and English, spoken and written Able to work from our Amsterdam office at least two days a week Nice to have Python, or experience with Clay's HTTP API and Claygent Experience selling into the public sector, healthcare or other regulated industries Familiarity with Dutch tender and procurement signals (TenderNed, aanbestedingen) German or French Who this is for You've built outbound systems and you find the building genuinely satisfying You're allergic to spray-and-pray. You'd rather send 40 good emails than 4,000 bad ones You want to be closer to the buyer, not further from them You want a company where the thing being sold is technically interesting and adds tangible value Who this is not for Classic SDRs looking for a dialler and a script Pure RevOps people who want to stay in the tooling Benefits Practicalities Amsterdam-based (Danzigerbocht 39g), hybrid. You'll be in the office at least twice a week, more at the start. Working languages are Dutch and English. Most of our clients are Dutch organisations, so professional Dutch is required. You report to the CCO and work daily with our Account Executive and the delivery team. Compensation €3,500–€5,500 monthly base, plus OTE 8% holiday allowance 28 days paid leave per year (full-time basis) 10% pension contribution Our Process Intro Call (20-30 min) A mutual filtering session. Practical Case (2–3 hrs) You'll build a real outbound motion for our DACH launch. Live Session (45 min) Present your build, troubleshoot an issue in real-time, and conduct a mock 15-minute intro call. Final Conversation with Leadership + References The process typically takes two to three weeks from start to finish. We provide feedback and a decision after each stage. How to Apply Send us your CV along with an answer to the following question; a few paragraphs will do: Describe an outbound system you built that produced poor results. How did you discover the issue, what did you do about it, and how did you communicate this to the people relying on it? We read this answer before your CV. Applications without it will not be considered.

items.desc: Expert public de la météo et du climat, Météo-France est à vos côtés pour contribuer à votre sécurité au quotidien et vous aider à prendre les meilleures décisions, dans un climat qui change. Face à des épisodes météo dangereux encore plus intenses et plus fréquents sous l’effet du changement climatique, nos missions au service de votre sécurité sont cruciales. Nous mobilisons notre expertise, notre excellence scientifique et technologique pour vous permettre d’anticiper les phénomènes météorologiques et climatiques à enjeux, et de vous y adapter. Retrouvez-nous en ligne : https://meteofrance.com/carte-didentite-de-meteo-france Rejoindre Météo France, C'est Intégrer Une Organisation Multi-sites, Situés En Hexagone, En Outre-mer, Etc. L'organisation De Météo-France S'appuie Sur Des Directions Centrales Et Des Directions Interrégionales. Ci-dessous, La Présentation De La Direction Que Vous Pourriez Rejoindre La Direction de l'Enseignement Supérieur et de la Recherche (DESR) rassemble les entités de recherche de Météo-France (principalement CNRM, SAFIRE, LACy), l'Ecole Nationale de la Météorologie, et les services partagés de soutien administratif et informatique (PGA). Le Centre National de Recherches Météorologiques (CNRM) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche (UMR 3589) avec la double tutelle Météo-France et CNRS. Le CNRM conduit des recherches dans le domaine de la météorologie et du climat, de l'observation, la compréhension et la modélisation des processus jusqu'à la mise au point de systèmes de prévision météorologique et de projection climatique pouvant être transférés aux services opérationnels de Météo-France. Le Groupe de Modélisation et d'Assimilation pour la Prévision (GMAP), basé à Toulouse, est l'un des 6 groupes ou centres de recherche du CNRM. Sa mission est de maintenir et développer les systèmes de prévision numérique du temps (PNT) opérationnels de Météo-France et de conduire des recherches qui préparent les futures versions. L’équipe Observations (OBS) fait partie du groupe GMAP, et est en charge de l’utilisation de tous les types d’observations pour améliorer les prévisions des modèles de Prévision Numérique du Temps (PNT). Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Embarquez pour une aventure stimulante et au service de tous aux côtés d’hommes et de femmes engagés quotidiennement face aux défis posés à notre société par la météo et le climat. Et ainsi bénéficiez des avantages suivants : horaires flexibles, RTT, télétravail, restaurant administratif ou ticket restaurant, participation à hauteur de 75% pour les transports en commun, participation pour la mutuelle, associations sportives et culturelles en fonction du site concerné, (escalade, gym, poterie, théâtre etc..). D'autres avantages vous attendent, venez les découvrir ! Le poste proposé est situé au Centre National de Recherches Météorologiques de Toulouse, unité mixte de recherche de Météo-France et du Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (CNRS). Le candidat ou la candidate intégrera l'équipe Observations du Groupe de Modélisation et d'Assimilation pour la Prévision. Ce groupe a en charge le développement des futurs modèles opérationnels de prévision numérique du temps de Météo-France. L'équipe Observations développe l'intégration des observations météorologiques dans les modèles pour définir l'état initial de la prévision. Pour mieux tirer profit des observations dans les modèles de Prévision Numérique du Temps (PNT), les méthodes d’assimilation de données ont réalisé des progrès significatifs au cours des dernières décennies. À Météo-France comme pour les autres centres de PNT, l’utilisation d’une information ensembliste dans les algorithmes d’assimilation de données atmosphériques est désormais centrale. Le modèle global ARPEGE utilise une algorithme d’assimilation de données hybride 4DVar pour l’altitude qui utilise des covariances 3D ensemblistes issues d’un ensemble d’assimilation. Proche de la surface, de récentes avancées ont permis de mettre en place une méthode du même type, dite variationnelle ensembliste bidimensionnelle 2DEnVar, pour initialiser les variables dans le sol dans le modèle à aire limitée AROME (Marimbordes et al., 2024). Grâce à ce système, l’introduction de nouveaux types d’observations, provenant de satellites, est ainsi facilitée (Marimbordes et al., 2025). Ce système a été récemment étendu au modèle global ARPEGE. L’objectif du travail proposé est d’étudier, dans le modèle de grande échelle ARPEGE, l’intérêt d’assimiler une nouvelle observation satellitaire, la température de surface continentale provenant du sondeur IASI-NG, puis IRS, dans un système d’analyse de surface avancé, basé sur une approche variationnelle ensembliste. Ce travail s’inscrit dans le cadre d’un projet européen, nommé CHERRI (Climate Hazards Enhanced Reanalyses & Reasoning with AI), porté par le CEPMMT (Centre Européen pour les Prévisions Météorologiques à Moyen Terme) qui porte sur l'assimilation de la température de surface continentale …

Other benefits await you, come and discover them! The position is opened at the Centre National de Recherches Météorologiques in Toulouse, UMR Météo-France and CNRS. The candidate will be recruited in the Observations team in the Groupe de Modélisation et d'Assimilation pour la Prévision (GMAP). This group is in charge of the development of future Météo-France operational numerical weather prediction models. The Observations team develops the integration of meteorological observations into model to define the initial state of forecasts. Data assimilation methods have made significant progress in the past decades and are now able to ingest a large variety of observations from different observing systems with the aim of improving Numerical Weather forecasts at different scales. At Météo-France as well as in other NWP centres, the use of ensemble information in data assimilation algorithms is now central. ARPEGE global model uses a hybrid 4DVar data assimilation algorithm for upper-air assimilation with the use of 3D ensemble covariances. Near the surface an ensemble variational method has been recently developed to initialise soil variables in the AROME limited-area NWP model (Marimbordes et al., 2024). With this system, the introduction of new types of observations from satellites is now made easier (Marimbordes et al., 2025). This system was recently extended to the ARPEGE global model. The objective of this work is to study the possibility of assimilating a new satellite observation, the land surface temperature from IASI-NG and/or IRS sounder into the ARPEGE global model using an advanced surface data assimilation system based on an ensemble variational approach. This study happens in the framework of CHERRI European project (Climate Hazards Enhanced Reanalyses & Reasoning with AI) lead by ECMWF (European Centre for Medium range Weather Forecast). Assimilation of land surface temperature in the global NWP model ARPEGE with a bidimensional ensemble variational method (2DEnVar) in the framework of CHERRI Horizon Europe project. The study will be divided into four steps Assessement of land surface temperature observations from IASI-NG and/or IRS quality to prepare their assimilation. Assimilation of these observations into a surface data assimilation system based on a variational ensemble approach (2DEnVar). These developments will take place in the ARPEGE global model. Evaluation of results and sensitivity tests to find the configuration that improves low atmospheric forecasts. Preparation of a report and a scientific publication. Presentation of results at conferences in the framework of CHERRI project. Additional Information This position is open to people with disabilities. Office hours. Fixed-term contract of 24 months. items.desc: About The Program The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI. In partnership with Scale Labs, we are building a small cohort of researchers to work on the empirical foundations of AI safety. That work includes finding where models fail, checking whether safety controls hold up under pressure in realistic settings, and studying how AI agents (mis-)behave over long-horizon tasks. Scholars take open research questions like these and turn them into work that improves how frontier AI systems are evaluated and safeguarded. Each scholar owns a substantial part of a safety research project. You'll work alongside a mentor from the research question through the experiments to deciding what to test next. Research Areas Mentors will guide Research Scholars on projects in selected AI safety research areas in select AI safety research areas, such as: AI control and chain-of-thought monitoring: Developing techniques to oversee and constrain AIs, including detecting harmful intent or deception. Alignment auditing and evaluations: Building scalable methods to test whether models have hidden goals, misaligned behaviors or unsafe tendencies. Multi-agent safety: Studying the risks that emerge when multiple agents interact, such as collusion, coordinated failures, or unexpected collective behavior. Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) safety: Investigating how to keep AI systems safe and aligned as AIs increasingly contribute to their own development. Science of Evaluations: examining when and how models recognize they're being tested, and how situational awareness affects the reliability/validity of evaluations. Misuse risks and evaluations: Developing methods to assess how AI systems could be exploited by malicious actors, including evaluating their potential to enable harmful activities. Projects are matched to demonstrated expertise; we don’t expect any candidate to cover every area. Representative Research ASPI: 728 task–attack scenarios testing how clarification-seeking changes prompt-injection vulnerability in LLM agents. PropensityBench: simulating real-world pressure to choose between safe or harmful behavior BioRiskEval: evaluating whether safeguards for open-weight bio-foundation models remain robust under fine-tuning and probing. See more work from the Human Frontier Collective. What You'll Do Projects are mentor-guided. By default, you will be given a list of research proposals and match you with one based on your research interests and background. You’ll meet weekly with a Scale researcher who sets the direction and gives feedback, and you will drive the day-to-day work. Own research end to end: Turn a high-level safety question into hypotheses, baselines, and controlled experiments, and produce work that others can inspect and build on. Build the measurement: Implement and debug evaluation harnesses, agent environments, datasets, monitoring methods, or post-training experiments. Exercise research judgment: Identify confounds, separate what a model can do from what it tends to do, make sense of negative results, and decide what to try next without step-by-step direction. Make the work legible: Produce reproducible code, experiment logs, analysis, and precise technical writing. External outputs, where appropriate, remain subject to research, security, and communications review. Outputs also include research papers, which will be submitted to top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR). Who We're Looking For You may be a good fit if you: are motivated by reducing catastrophic risks from advanced AI systems; are interested in technical safety research, such as alignment evaluations, AI control, monitoring, multi-agent safety, or open-weight model safety; are pursuing or have completed a PhD in CS, ML, statistics, mathematics, or a related field (we also encourage researchers with an equivalent track record to apply); can make progress with high-level guidance, including implementing, debugging, getting unstuck, interpreting results, and proposing next experiments; communicate research clearly and handle confidential information and internal systems responsibly. Application Process Apply: Submit your resume or CV, your Google Scholar profile if you have one, and one research project you substantially owned, with 2–3 sentences on your contribution. Research background discussion: Walk us through a past project, including what you tried, what didn't work, and what you learned. Research design: Work through a research problem with us and propose how you'd approach it. Onboarding: Successful candidates complete the applicable recruiting, work-authorization, security, and project-onboarding steps. PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants. items.desc: Vous êtes une personne passionnée par l’interaction laser-matière à haute intensité et de l’optique relativiste et souhaitez contribuer à l'excellence scientifique ? Rejoignez le laboratoire PHI (Physique à Haute Intensité) en tant que chercheur·euse afin d'exercer une activité scientifique expérimentale de haut niveau. Vous serez notamment en charge du développement et de l’optimisation de miroirs plasmas pour manipuler la lumière extrême, ainsi que de sources de particules pilotées par laser utilisant des approches prometteuses. vous exploiterez les caractéristiques uniques de la plateforme UHI100 (laser Ti:Sa de classe 100TW dont la puissance sera prochainement portée à 200TW) du LIDYL, ainsi que d’autres plateformes expérimentales accessibles de type multi-PW en France et/ou à l’étranger. L’activité, principalement expérimentale, pourra s’accompagner d’une composante numérique et dans tous les cas pourra bénéficier d’un soutien fort des membres du groupe spécialistes de la modélisation numérique, qui développent leur propre code PIC exploitant au mieux les nouvelles générations de supercalculateurs. Vous aurez en particulier l’opportunité de développer une activité en lien avec le projet ERC Synergy NP-QED (« Probing the non perturbative regime of Quantum Electrodynamics with extrem light »), piloté par Henri Vincenti, visant à explorer les limites de l’électrodynamique quantique (QED) en champ fort (SF-QED). Vous intégrerez un environnement de recherche international de premier plan au sein du groupe PHI. Vous développerez des projets de recherche innovants, contribuerez au montage de financements nationaux et européens, et participerez à l’évolution de la plateforme UHI100. Le poste implique une forte interaction avec des partenaires académiques et industriels, ainsi qu’une participation active à la vie scientifique du groupe et à la formation des jeunes chercheurs (stagiaires, doctorants et post-doctorants). Vos missions : Développer une activité scientifique expérimentale originale de très haut niveau dans le domaine de l’interaction laser-matière à ultra-haute intensité, initialement en lien avec le projet ERC Synergy NP-QED, qui exploite non seulement les performances de la plateforme laser UHI100 mais aussi celles d’autres installations laser multi-PW (Apollon, ELI-NP, …). Vous avez le goût du travail en équipe, disposez de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et de communication en anglais et savez assurer la visibilité de son activité à l’échelle internationale. Vous avez l’opportunité d’apprendre, de vous développer et de jouer un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement des chercheurs et le suivi des projets au sein d’un institut de référence. …Et ce n'est pas tout ! Les à-côtés de votre mission principale peuvent vous intéresser : Un écosystème de recherche à la pointe, dédié à des thématiques à fort enjeu sociétal. Des formations pour renforcer vos compétences et booster votre carrière. The Optoelectronics Section provides functional support to ESA projects and carries out technological research (R&D) in the field of optoelectronic device technologies and applications. In particular, the Optoelectronics Section deals with the specification, development and characterisation of photonic component subsystems and active optical instruments, such as detectors and lasers operating in the UV to FIR wavelength ranges, fibre-optic sensors, lidars, optical communication systems and quantum technologies. The Section is staffed with around 25 engineers supporting all ESA projects and offers a unique opportunity to contribute on the challenges relating to optoelectronic technologies required for ESA missions, spacecraft, instruments and equipment. Duties Reporting to the Head of Section and within the technical fields described above, your main tasks and responsibilities will include: providing expert technical support and consultancy to ESA projects, programmes and general studies involving optical atomic clocks, optical frequency combs, lasers and integrated photonic technologies for space and related technologies and testing techniques throughout all project phases; participating in feasibility studies, project reviews and the evaluation of procurement proposals; identifying critical development problems and assisting in their resolution; contributing to the definition of technology development requirements and work plans for the Agency’s technology programmes; defining, initiating and managing R&D activities covering both long- and short-term needs; fostering new application areas for multidisciplinary activities, placing emphasis on innovative concepts, cutting-edge technologies and system architectures; laboratory activities, as required; monitoring applicable scientific and technological trends and maintaining state-of-the-art expertise; contributing to the dissemination of the results of the activities performed and the transfer of knowledge across the Agency. Your duties may also include supporting other activities within your field of competence. Technical competencies General background and specific experience in the technical domains covered by the position optical atomic clocks, including related subsystems, such as frequency combs, ultra-stable lasers, cavities, metrology and T&F distribution related quantum and photonics technologies, such as atom/ion trapping and cooling, photonic integrated circuits and fibre optics Experience with laboratory and field testing of relevant technical equipment and hands-on hardware experience Understanding of related technologies, R&D trends and industrial landscape Project support experience in a relevant domain Experience in the coordination and preparation of procurement activities for technology development and innovation, such as statements of work and proposal evaluation Behavioural competencies Result Orientation Operational Efficiency Fostering Cooperation Relationship Management Continuous Improvement Forward Thinking For more information, please refer to the ESA Core Behavioural Competencies guidebook. Education And Professional Experience A master’s degree in physics, photonics, optoelectronics, optical engineering or a related discipline is required for this post, together with at least four years of relevant professional experience. Additional Requirements Solid experience in the design, definition, development and testing of complex optoelectronics systems. The following will be considered assets: Knowledge of environmental testing of space hardware. Knowledge of working on projects with a formal security framework. A PhD in a relevant discipline. items.desc:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together. 
We are seeking a skilled machine learning engineer (ML Eng) to join one of our agile development teams in our ML & AI ART. In this role, you will play a key part in designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable AI solutions within a DevOps environment. You'll contribute across the entire lifecycle - from concept to deployment - and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality digital solutions. 
 YOUR CHALLENGE 
 • Develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning and AI solutions that address complex business challenges.
 • Create multi-agent systems and equip AI models with function/tool-calling capabilities
 • Design and implement RAG systems to ground AI responses in enterprise data
 • Assess and integrate AI models (e.g. LLMs) ensuring optimal performance and reliability
 • Optimize agentic workflows and AI agents for production use cases
 • Testing and optimizing system prompts and few-shot example to ensure accurate , consistent, and safe AI outputs
 • Performance evaluation of machine learning and AI models using appropriate metrics, evaluation sets and techniques, and continuously iterate and improve upon them
 • Collaborate with platform teams, data engineers, data scientists, and other stakeholders to integrate machine learning solutions into existing systems and processes
 • Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure the quality and reliability of machine learning solutions
 YOUR PROFILE 
 • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to think critically and creatively about complex challenges
 • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels of the organization
 • Ability to manage personal workloads effectively, to prioritize tasks, manage timelines, and deliver high-quality results on schedule
 • Continuous learning mindset, with a passion for staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in machine learning and artificial intelligence
 • Attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality, reliable, and maintainable code
 • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
 • Strong programming skills in Python with experience in machine learning libraries and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch
 • Proven experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs)
 • Good understanding of AI agents & agentic workflows, LLM orchestration frameworks and reasoning patterns
 • Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model selection and evaluation techniques
 • Knowledge of statistical and mathematical concepts relevant to machine learning, such as probability, linear algebra, and optimization
 • Understanding software development best practices, including version control, testing, and documentation
 • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly and effectively
 • Relevant work experience in machine learning, data science or a related field

items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
Design Manager 
 __
 Design Engineer (Power Electronics) 
 Your role and responsibilities 
 We are looking for a Design Engineer to strengthen our team at ABB Oy, High Power division. High Power division is further investing in drive system development into different fields of applications and thus strengthening its design organization. Look no further – we have an interesting opportunity for you! You will get to work with our power electronics design group and will be located in Pitäjänmäki, Helsinki, Finland.
 Members of the power electronics design group are responsible for main circuit and power electronics design in various product development projects. In this role, you will have the opportunity to deep-dive with world-class technology in demanding projects as a part of highly skilled team. Project related responsibilities will be agreed based on your background and experience. In addition, you will have the opportunity to further your career in a global company. 
 The work model for the role is: hybrid
 You will be mainly accountable for:
 Designing, dimensioning and verifying the main circuit and power electronics of frequency converters
 Specifying verification tests and analyzing results
 Creating design documentation
 Research of new components and topologies
 Co-operating with subcontractors and with other design disciplines (e.g. mechanics, electronics, verification)
 Qualifications for the role 
 M.Sc. in power electronics or in a related field
 Knowledge of electrical drives’ main circuit components
 Ability to demonstrate your experience in product development of power electronics
 Experience in simulation tools (e.g. Simulink)
 Fluent communication in English, both written and spoken. Finnish is a plus.
 Knowledge of industrial electrical installations, wind turbine drivetrains and/or DC grids is beneficial
 Effective communication and interpersonal skills
 Benefits 
 Our culture and benefits reflect our values: courage, care, curiosity and collaboration. The most appreciated benefits according to our personnel are at the moment e.g. an annual performance bonus, employee share acquisition program, continuous learning opportunities, bicycle and other wellbeing and family benefits. We have a hybrid working model.
 More about us 
 ABB High Power division is the market leader in high-power, high-performance drives, drive systems and packages for industrial process and large infrastructure applications, and a leading supplier of power conversion equipment for renewable energy and other applications. The Division offers global support to help customers, partners and equipment manufacturers with asset reliability, performance improvement and energy efficiency in mission critical applications.
 For more information, contact Design Manager Tommi Liukko, tel. +358 50 3323931. Interested in joining the crew? Apply for the position by November 8, 2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

Join our 2-year rotational program in Technical Research and Development (TRD) Biologics and gain hands-on experience across Drug Product Development, Drug Substance Development, Global Device & Packaging Development and Analytical Development. 
 Job Description 
 During each 6-month rotation, you’ll be embedded in expert teams, contributing to real projects: 
 Examples of Past and Current Projects: 
- Development of a new bioassay to detect host cell proteins in biologics 
- Evaluation of new packaging modalities (e.g., pre-filled syringes, cartridges) 
- Biophysical characterization of biologic drug products to support stability predictions 
 - Assessment of surfactants for silicon oil depletion in pre-filled syringes 
 - Development of Raman spectroscopy-based models using Python for real-time impurity monitoring 
 Location: Basel, Switzerland, #LI-On-Site 
 This Postgraduate program is limited to 2 years, with the start date in April 2027. 
 Please note that we can only accept applicants who are eligible to work in Switzerland . 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Contribute to lab-based (80 %) and office-based (20 %) TRD-biologics projects 
 Conduct experiments and generate data on TRD-biologics projects 
 Document and present results related to projects activities 
 Collaborate with internal and external development partners and stakeholders 
 Acquire an understanding of the TRD-Biologics organizations and how the different units within work together 
 Essential Requirements: 
 Education: Master’s degree or equivalent (PhDs will not be considered). 
 Languages: Fluent in English 
 Work Style & Adaptability : Independent, fast learner, and easily adaptable to new environments. 
 Lab & Scientific Expertise : Hands-on lab experience with autonomous project handling. 
 Pharma & Technical Knowledge: Basic understanding of pharmaceutical development, including container closure systems. 
 Specialized Skills : Familiarity with one or more areas such as protein production, analytical (HDPB, RPC, SEC, particle analysis) and bioanalytical methods (ELISA, cell-based assays, flow cytometry), molecular biology (cloning methods, PCR, viral vector, CRISPR), or programming/data modeling (e.g., Python, R).

items.card: In this role, you will investigate chemical processes occurring on material surfaces, understand degradation and contamination mechanisms, and develop solutions for future lithography applications. The successful candidate will combine a fundamental understanding of chemistry with a hands-on experimental approach to solve complex technological challenges requiring atomic and molecular level insight. Role and
items.desc:
Introduction to the job 
 To strengthen the chemistry and materials science competence, ASML Research is looking for an Surface Chemist /Catalysis Scientist who can add value to the understanding and development of chemical reactions at the surfaces.
 Job Mission 
 ASML is seeking a scientist with expertise in surface chemistry, catalysis and reaction mechanisms at solid-gas and solid-liquid interfaces. In this role, you will investigate chemical processes occurring on material surfaces, understand degradation and contamination mechanisms, and develop solutions for future lithography applications.
 The successful candidate will combine a fundamental understanding of chemistry with a hands-on experimental approach to solve complex technological challenges requiring atomic and molecular level insight.
 Role and Responsibilities 
 The main focus of this position will be: 
 Understand and investigate chemical reactions occurring at material interfaces and surfaces.
 Study adsorption, desorption, catalytic reactions and degradation mechanisms relevant to lithography applications.
 Investigate contamination, cleaning and surface modification processes.
 Establish relationships between surface chemistry, material properties and product performance.
 Design and execute experiments to understand reaction mechanisms and chemical pathways.
 Develop and demonstrate feasibility of novel materials, coatings and surface treatments.
 Apply advanced surface analytical techniques to characterize interfaces and reaction products.
 Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams.
 Document, present and communicate scientific findings to stakeholders and development teams.
 Education 
 PhD with a strong background in surface chemistry, heterogeneous catalysis.
 Experienc e
 Proven experience in studying chemical reaction mechanisms and catalytic processes.
 Experience with adsorption, surface functionalization, thin-film chemistry or contamination control.
 Experience in catalyst development, reaction kinetics and mechanistic studies.
 Knowledge of gas-surface and liquid-surface interactions.
 Experience with advanced characterization techniques such as XPS, ToF-SIMS, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, SEM, TEM, AFM or related methods.
 Experience correlating surface chemistry and nano-scale characterization with functional performance.
 Familiarity with data analysis and scientific programming tools (MATLAB, Python or equivalent).
 Excellent analytical, experimental and problem-solving skills.
 Thrives in a laboratory environment and enjoys translating scientific questions into experiments, generating data and uncovering root causes through hands-on investigation.
 Personal skills 
 Have excellent written and oral communication skills and a commitment to achieving results on time while under time constraints; High energy, high ownership, high level of dedication.
 Be willing to jump in on new issues, identify root cause and propose practical solutions.
 Be able to break down complex problems with limited data to come to solutions – strong critical thinking capability.
 Have demonstrated “team player” with a quality orientation and interpersonal skills.
 Be able to interface with multidisciplinary groups and work effectively in a team and be willing to take on responsibility.
 Be a passionate experimental scientist who enjoys working in the laboratory, developing new experiments, operating advanced characterization tools and uncovering root causes through hands-on investigation.
 Be able to quickly acquire technical knowledge from documentation and on-the-job training and be capable of thoroughly investigating technical issues (analytically and hands-on in a lab).
 Context of the position 
 The Research Materials Science and Chemistry group is part of the Research department of ASML. This group identifies and addresses technological gaps in the future roadmap of lithography and the lithography market.
 Our focus is on advanced materials, surface chemistry, contamination control, plasma-surface interactions and the interaction of light (13.5 nm) with gases and materials within lithography systems. We seek to understand the fundamental mechanisms governing material performance, degradation and functionality in demanding operating environments.
 We work in multidisciplinary teams and deliver solutions that can be transferred to Development and Engineering. We collaborate extensively with leading universities, research institutes and industrial partners worldwide to bring new scientific insights into ASML products.
 This position offers a unique opportunity to apply fundamental chemistry and catalysis knowledge to solve highly complex challenges at the forefront of semiconductor technology
 This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. …

Job Description: 
 In order to support our structure development team, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for an 
 Airframe Design Approver (d/f/m) 
 Are you motivated to work in an international environment where collaboration is key? Here, you will be part of our dedicated team of development engineers in the fuselage area for the primary/secondary structure of all our commercial Airbus aircraft programs and their derivatives. You will therefore be involved with your expertise from the concept study through detailed design to certification.
 This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.
 Your location 
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Guarantee product quality and airworthiness by taking full responsibility for design approval according to established processes
 Develop and optimize metal, composite, and hybrid components and assemblies with regard to weight, cost, performance, manufacturing, and assembly requirements.
 Collaborate in multifunctional teams alongside structural analysis, production, program, project, configuration, and systems functions to achieve optimal technical solutions.
 Evaluate design changes, estimate implementation efforts, and ensure full compliance with regulations, design principles, and guidelines.
 Manage engineering partner and supplier activities, serving as their key technical contact.
 Drive digitalization and automation innovations actively, taking all relevant regulations and stakeholders into account.

 Technical university degree or similar professional qualification.
 First experience in structural design. 
 Solid understanding of metal, composite, and hybrid design principles, including manufacturing/assembly requirements and tolerance definition.
 Practical knowledge in project management and motivation to work with agile methodologies.

 Our world is changing. And so are we. From our commitment to zero-carbon flight) to cleaning up space , sustainability is at the heart of our purpose . So what's your next change? 
 We have an exciting opportunity where you can be part of defining the next generation of aircraft! 
 In Aircraft Aerodynamics, we master the complex aerodynamics of our aircraft to understand how they perform across the entire envelope of their missions. Through the generation and analysis of aerodynamic data, our work has a direct impact on aircraft operations, safety and fuel burn, meaning we play a pivotal role in securing the sustainable aviation of the future. 
 We are looking for a highly motivated Aerodynamic Icing Engineer, to join our team as we grow to prepare for the next generation of Airbus aircraft! 
 With primary stakeholders in Future Projects and R&D departments, you will be contributing directly to the development of our future aircraft programmes. 
 HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM 
 State of the art computer modelling and simulation of aerodynamic icing accretion and its effects on aircraft performance, handling qualities and safety 
 Participating and steering the aerodynamic icing certification of future aircraft, and using data- and engineering-driven methods for influencing future icing certification requirements 
 Defining, attending and analysing results of wind tunnel tests at world leading facilities across the globe 
 Defining, attending and analysing results of flight tests, including steering flight test decisions in real-time based on live telemetry data 
 ABOUT YOU 
 Knowledge of aerodynamics, including the factors that influence the generation of aircraft lift and drag 
 The ability to communicate complex messages simply and adapt those messages to your audience 
 The ability to lead other team members technically or subcontractors operationally on a given project in an international environment 
 Experience in Python coding (or similar) for data analysis 
 Additionally, any of the below would be of benefit for this role: 
 Knowledge of aerodynamic icing phenomena, the conditions and factors that influence this, its effect on the aircraft performance, handling qualities, and safety, and the associated certification requirements 
 Knowledge or experience of aircraft flight operations and performance, for example the factors that influence take off and landing performance, aerodynamic safety limitations, and the flight phases of a commercial aircraft. 
 Knowledge of CS-25 or FAR25 icing certification standards 
 A solid understanding or practical experience of modelling the aerodynamics of 2D or 3D geometries in CFD, including the suitability and effect of different mesh types and turbulence models, the appropriate use of time-averaged modelling, convergence criteria, and interpreting results 
 A solid understanding or practical experience of planning, supporting and analysing wind tunnel tests and/or flight tests, including the measurement techniques, practical limitations, and common aerodynamic considerations and corrections 
 Aerodynamics has a wide and varied exposure to the full Airbus Commercial product range, with many opportunities to get hands-on testing and aircraft experience. This is an exciting time to be part of Airbus, as we fly towards the next generation of sustainable aviation. 
 Come and join us pioneering sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world! 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customised development solutions.

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for an Aircraft Performance Engineer - External Performance Models (BADA / ANP) has arisen within Airbus Operations, Getafe (Madrid).
 The selected candidate will join the In-Flight Performance and Operations team within Airbus Engineering Aircraft Performance. Aircraft Performance is at the heart of the aeronautic industry and a key decision criterion for airlines. 
 Our subdomain is responsible for modeling, evaluating, and simulating aircraft operational performance, acting as the reference for data-driven analysis to optimize flight operations, flight safety, and in-service support for airlines and aeronautical stakeholders.
 The jobholder will act as the primary owner and central point of contact for External Aircraft Performance Models (such as BADA and ANP), bridging strategic governance with deep technical validation and driving the long-term improvement roadmap.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 The main tasks of the jobholder will be:
 Serve as primary focal point and lead strategic governance for external partners (Eurocontrol, EASA) and internal stakeholders, managing queries, licensing, decision boards, and improvement roadmaps.
 Execute technical validation and risk assessment by designing in-depth studies to compare external model outputs against Airbus reference data and quantify accuracy deviations.
 Develop and maintain internal automation tools using Python and scripting languages to ensure robust model comparison, validation, and assessment processes.
 Manage ANP dataset generation and validation for EASA and internal stakeholders, ensuring all dataset outputs meet required quality standards.
 Monitor the broader ecosystem landscape (TIM, Piano, OpenAP, EU Flight Label, EEA, CO2 calculators) to identify service opportunities, technical risks, and market intelligence.
 Animate the internal community and knowledge management by creating technical notes, defining oriented-usage guidelines, and sharing best practices across Airbus teams.
 SKILLS 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you:
 Education: Aeronautical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline degree.
 Experience: More than 3 years of professional experience in aircraft performance modeling principles or related engineering environments.
 Technical knowledge: Advanced proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for tool development, technical autonomy in troubleshooting, and strong analytical rigor in scientific data comparison.
 Languages: Advanced level in English.
 Soft skills: Project management capabilities, proactivity to identify opportunities and escalate technical alerts, and strong communication skills to synthesize complex technical data.
 Valuable / Nice to have: Familiarity with external industry benchmarks and environmental performance models (such as BADA, ANP, OpenAP, or CO2 calculators).

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a Tactical Communications Lab Test Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid) .
 Department Mission 
 The selected candidate will join the Flight & Integration Test Centre. Our department is in charge of Integration, Verification, and Validation (IV&V) testing across all major defense programs within the Spanish portfolio (Eurofighter, A400M, MRTT, C295, Eurodrone, SIRTAP, Helicopters, and FCAS).
 We are a multidisciplinary and dynamic team passionate about solving complex technical challenges, conducting hands-on tests from Virtual Environments and Laboratory Rigs up to supporting Ground & Flight testing, ensuring the maximum performance and clearance of critical Tactical, Mission, Safety, and Connectivity Communication Systems.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Analyze technical documentation and test requirements to define and build coherent Rig Test Cases, Procedures, and Requirement Specifications for integration rigs.
 Generate required test datasets, simulation requirements, test scripts, initialization files, and tactical scenarios prior to test execution.
 Execute rig test procedures, managing pre-run activities (crypto/software loading) and run-time operation using specialized lab equipment (e.g., MaTE, AIDASS, TIGER, MIGATO) and bus analyzers.
 Assess system behavior post-test execution, preparing comprehensive test reports and supporting root-cause investigations for declared problem reports.
 Manage the lifecycle of equipment and system issues using dedicated configuration and tracking tools (e.g., DOORS, Octane, FTNet).
 Specify and qualify ad-hoc test tools for decoding, recording, translation, emulation, and process automation.
 SKILLS 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you:
 Education: Degree or Master’s in Telecommunications, Radiocommunications, Electronics, or Aeronautical Engineering.
 Experience: Between 2 to 6 years of experience in system testing, IV&V activities, or hands-on rig testing (demonstrable testing background is highly preferred over pure design).
 Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of COMMS Systems Under Test (Tactical Datalinks like Link 16/22, VMF, Mission Comms, SATCOM, Connectivity/ALIMS, JRE).
 Hands-on command of lab test equipment (MIL-STD-1553 bus analyzers, sniffers, datalink simulators, Test Support Systems).
 Requirement partitioning, test data creation, and traceability management.
 Soft Skills: Proactive problem solver with a "can-do" mindset, highly adaptable, rigorous, and capable of working autonomously under strict project milestones within multifunctional teams.

items.desc:
About the team / job 
 Do you enjoy using advanced electron microscopy to help scientists answer their biological questions? Then join the Electron Microscopy Core Facility (EMCF) at EMBL Heidelberg.
 We specialise in cellular electron microscopy. Our work covers the full workflow, from sample preparation to imaging. We have a particular focus on correlative light and electron microscopy (CLEM) and volume electron microscopy (vEM).
 Our mission is to enable research. We support research groups from all EMBL sites, as well as external academic and industry users. Some users ask us to carry out their experiments. Others are trained to book and use our instruments themselves.
 We are a team of five operational staff, led by the Head of the facility. We have complementary expertise and work together as one team. We are now looking for a new colleague to join us.
 Your rol e
 You will work on a wide range of biological projects, using our portfolio of EM techniques. You will:
 Perform EM experiments for users, from sample preparation to imaging and analysis
 Meet users before their projects start and advise them on the best approach
 Guide users through their experiments and train them on our workflows and instruments
 Analyse data and report results clearly to users
 Organise and teach in courses and workshops
 Help develop and introduce new methods in correlative and volume EM
 Operate our electron microscopes and carry out first-line maintenance
 Contribute to the day-to-day running of the facility
 You hav e
 A degree in biology, life sciences, biophysics or a related field, or an equivalent technical qualification (e.g. BTA/MTA)
 Substantial hands-on experience in electron microscopy for the life sciences
 Expertise in several of the following:
 Sample preparation: chemical fixation, cryo-fixation, resin embedding and ultramicrotomy
 Transmission electron microscopy
 Volume EM: electron tomography, FIB-SEM, SBF-SEM or array tomography
 Correlative imaging: CLEM or CXEM
 Experience with EM software for acquisition, processing or analysis, such as SerialEM, SBEMimage, IMOD, MIB, Amira or Dragonfly
 A service mindset. You enjoy helping users succeed and can explain techniques clearly.
 Good organisational skills. You can manage several projects at once.
 Good communication skills in English. You are a team player who likes to share knowledge.
 You might also hav e
 Research experience involving electron microscopy on biological samples
 Experience working in a core facility or another service environment
 Experience maintaining electron microscopes
 Programming skills (e.g. Python, Java) to automate workflows
 Experience developing new EM or correlative methods
 Experience teaching practical courses
 Salary guidance: Grade 5 or 6 with a monthly salary starting from 4.147,92 EUR net of tax, excluding health insurance and pension contributions, plus additional EMBL benefits.
 Contract duration: 3 years (renewable up to 9 years) 
 Other helpful information 
 The position can be filled at Research Technician or Scientific Officer level. The duties are the same at both levels. Your grade will depend on your qualifications and experience.
 Why join us 
EMBL is curiosity-driven, community-oriented and international. As an inclusive, equal opportunity employer, we believe that diversity enables us to collaborate more effectively and be innovative in our approaches. We are, therefore, committed to creating an inclusive and flexible culture - one where everyone can realise their full potential and make a positive contribution to our organisation. 
 We encourage applications from individuals who can complement our existing team – we believe that success is built on having teams whose backgrounds and personal experiences reflect the diversity of the populations that our science serves. We actively encourage applications from all genders and cultures, ethnic groups and all demographics to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights at this transformational point in our people strategy.
 Enjoy lots of benefits: 
 Financial incentives: Salary free of income tax, Monthly family, child and non-resident allowances, annual salary review, pension scheme, death benefit, long-term care, accident-at-work and unemployment insurances
 Flexible working arrangements 
 Private medical insurance for you and your immediate family (including all prescriptions and generous dental & optical cover)
 Generous time off: 30 days annual leave per year, in addition to public holidays
 Relocation package including installation grant (conditions apply) 
 Campus life: Free shuttle bus (Heidelberg), library, subsidised on-site cafeteria, casual dress code, extensive sports and social club activities (on campus and remotely)
 Family benefits: Kindergarten (Heidelberg), 10 days of child sick leave, generous paid maternity/parental leave and monthly family & child allowances
 Benefits for international newcomers: Visa exemption, education grant for …

items.desc:
Wer wir sind 
 Helsing ist ein KI-Unternehmen für Verteidigung. Unsere Mission ist der Schutz von Demokratien. Wir streben eine technologische Führungsrolle an, damit offene Gesellschaften weiterhin souveräne Entscheidungen treffen und ihre ethischen Standards kontrollieren können. 
 Wir glauben, dass wir als Demokratien eine besondere Verantwortung haben, über die Entwicklung und den Einsatz von leistungsstarken Technologien wie KI nachzudenken. Wir nehmen diese Verantwortung ernst. 
 Wir sind ein ehrgeiziges und engagiertes Team von Ingenieuren, KI-Spezialisten und Programmmanagern mit Kundenkontakt. Wir suchen engagierte Mitarbeiter für unsere europäischen Teams, die ihre Fähigkeiten einsetzen, um die komplexesten und bedeutendsten Probleme zu lösen. Wir pflegen eine offene und transparente Kultur, die gesunde Debatten über den Einsatz von Technologie in der Verteidigung, ihre Vorteile und ihre ethischen Implikationen begrüßt. 
 Die Rolle 
 Als Lagermitarbeiter (m/w/d) bist du eine vielseitige und unverzichtbare Stütze im täglichen Lagerbetrieb. Du unterstützt aktiv den gesamten Materialfluss innerhalb des Lagers – von internen Transportaufgaben bis hin zur Durchführung von Inventuren. Darüber hinaus übernimmst du bei Bedarf Vertretungstätigkeiten in angrenzenden Lagerbereichen und trägst so zur Flexibilität und Stabilität des gesamten Warehouse-Betriebs bei.
 Dein Alltag 
 Du führst innerbetriebliche Transporte zwischen dem Lager, der Produktion und den angrenzenden Bereichen durch
 Du bedienst Flurförderzeuge wie Ameisen und Hubwagen sicher und zuverlässig
 Du be- und entlädst Transportmittel und stellst eine termingerechte Materialversorgung unter Einhaltung aller Sicherheitsregeln sicher
 Du arbeitest aktiv bei Jahres-, Stichtags- und Permanentinventuren mit und übernimmst das Zählen, Erfassen und Dokumentieren von Lagerbeständen
 Du unterstützt flexibel im Inbound- und Outbound-Bereich sowie in angrenzenden Lagerbereichen
 Du übernimmst allgemeine Lagertätigkeiten wie das Ein- und Auslagerer von Waren an die vorgesehenen Lagerplätze, Unterstützung bei Verpackungs- und Kommissionierarbeiten
 Du solltest dich bewerben, wenn du folgendes mitbringst 
 Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrungen im Lager- oder Logistikbereich mit
 Du besitzt idealerweise Grundkenntnisse im Umgang mit Scannern und Handhelds
 Ein gültiger Staplerschein ist ein gern gesehener Vorteil
 Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
 Du bringst die Bereitschaft mit im 2-Schicht-System zu arbeiten
 Hinweis: Wir arbeiten an einer Schnittstelle, an der Frauen sowie andere Minderheitengruppen systematisch unterrepräsentiert sind. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, auch wenn Du nicht alle aufgelisteten Qualifikationen erfüllen kannst; Fähigkeiten und Einfluss können nicht in wenigen Aufzählungspunkten zusammengefasst werden. 
 Komm zu Helsing 
 Deine Arbeit bei Helsing zählt. Du leistest einen direkten Beitrag zur Sicherheit demokratischer Länder und trägst dazu bei, dass hohe ethische Standards eingehalten werden. 
 Unsere Produkte erfüllen höchste Anforderungen an Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit. Deshalb ist sorgfältiges, verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten bei uns besonders wichtig. 
 Helsing ist Teil einer zukunftsorientierten Branche, die sich dynamisch weiterentwickelt. Wir wachsen schnell und wurden bereits für mehrere bedeutende Aufträge ausgewählt. 
 Bei uns zählt jede Meinung: Wir fördern eine offene, respektvolle Arbeitskultur und setzen auf eigenverantwortliches Handeln, Teamgeist und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. 
 Was wir bieten 
 Du erhältst eine attraktive Vergütung sowie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge 
 Wir übernehmen den Großteil der Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket
 Bleib fit und ausgeglichen dank Sport-Zuschüssen und professioneller mentaler Unterstützung (Nilo)
 Empfiehl uns weiter und sichere dir erstklassige Prämien für erfolgreiche Einstellungen
 Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here .

Lieu : Toulouse, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants. 
 Le Centre de Compétence Hardware Electronic France (CCHEF) est un acteur clé dans le développement de solutions électroniques avancées pour les télécommunications, l'observation, la navigation, l'exploration et le radar.
 Au sein du CCHEF, vous intégrez le service Digital Solutions composé d’une cinquantaine de collaborateurs expérimentés avec lesquels vous serez en charge du développement d'algorithmes de traitement du signal intégrés dans nos équipements numériques embarqués sur satellites.
 En nous rejoignant, vous avez pour principales missions : 
 Contribuer à la définition et à la performance de la solution globale en étroite collaboration avec les équipes systèmes de nos Business Lines, les architectes solution et les designers de composants numériques du CCHEF
 Définir, modéliser, développer l'architecture détaillée et concevoir des algorithmes de traitement du signal en Matlab/C++
 Implémenter physiquement vos algorithmes sur cible
 Rédiger la documentation technique associée, les plans et des rapports de validation, assurant ainsi la conformité des fonctions complexes aux exigences techniques.
 Partager et transmettre vos résultats et vos connaissances dans le département
 Respecter les enjeux programmatiques QCD (qualité, couts, délais)
 Votre profil : 
 Vous souhaitez mettre à profit vos compétences en traitement du signal sur des projets d’envergure ?
 Vous disposez d’un diplôme d’ingénieur BAC+5 en microélectronique / traitement du signal ou équivalent, d’une expérience confirmée (3 ans minimum) et des compétences en :
 Traitement du signal dans les Télécommunications, observation, navigation, exploration et/ou radar
 Conception et architectures d’algorithmes
 Validation de fonctions complexes et implantation sur cible Hardware
 Langages de programmations Matlab, C++ et/ou Python
 Rédaction de plans et rapports de validation
 Anglais courant
 Esprit d’équipe, rigueur, autonomie et force de proposition sont des atouts que l’on vous reconnait ?
 Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands 
 About us 
 ‘The people we all rely on to make the world go round – they rely on Thales’. In een wereld die steeds sneller, onvoorspelbaarder en complexer wordt, ontwikkelen wij technologieën die bijdragen aan een veiligere samenleving. Met 68.000 medewerkers wereldwijd en 2.500 collega's in Nederland behoort Thales tot de grootste hightech-werkgevers op het gebied van veiligheid, defensie en geavanceerde technologie.
 De afdeling Industrial Engineering 
 Binnen het Industrial Competence Center is de afdeling Industrial Engineering
 verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen, industrialiseren en continu verbeteren van productie- en testprocessen voor de geavanceerde systemen van Thales. Het team bestaat uit circa 25 gespecialiseerde professionals met expertise op het gebied van productie-, assemblage- en testtechnologie. De afdeling vormt de schakel tussen productontwikkeling, leveranciers, productie en kwaliteitsborging. 
 De belangrijkste doelstellingen van de afdeling zijn:
 Het ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van betrouwbare, efficiënte en schaalbare productieprocessen.
 Het industrialiseren van nieuwe producten en technologieën.
 Het waarborgen van kwaliteit en compliance.
 Het ondersteunen van productie en leveranciers bij technische vraagstukken.
 Het introduceren van innovatieve technologieën en het delen van kennis binnen de organisatie. 
 About the job 
 Als Technoloog binnen Industrial Engineering ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen, implementeren en optimaliseren van productieprocessen voor onze hightech producten. Je werkt nauw samen met productontwikkeling, productie, testontwikkeling en leveranciers om nieuwe technologieën succesvol naar serieproductie te brengen.
 Je week is afwisselend en uitdagend. Je bent betrokken bij nieuwe productintroductie, onderzoekt en implementeert innovatieve productietechnologieën, ondersteunt productie bij technische vraagstukken en zorgt ervoor dat productieprocessen voldoen aan de hoogste eisen op het gebied van kwaliteit, veiligheid, kosten en betrouwbaarheid.
 Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in het voorwaartse ontwikkeltraject. Je adviseert engineeringteams over maakbaarheid, risico's en proceskeuzes volgens Design for Manufacturing-principes en draagt actief bij aan de industrialisatie van nieuwe producten.
 Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden 
 Ontwikkelen, definiëren en optimaliseren van productieprocessen en tooling.
 Ondersteunen van ontwikkelteams op het gebied van Design for Manufacturing.
 Introduceren en industrialiseren van nieuwe technologieën, processen en
 productiemethoden.
 Opstellen, valideren en vrijgeven van productieprocessen en werkinstructies.
 Specificeren, selecteren en implementeren van productiemiddelen en apparatuur.
 Ondersteunen van productie bij verstoringen, root-cause analyses en continue
 verbeterinitiatieven.
 Opzetten en uitvoeren van kwalificaties, validaties en testen voor nieuwe processen.
 Borgen dat processen voldoen aan kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieueisen.
 Samenwerken met interne en externe stakeholders om de produceerbaarheid van
 producten te verbeteren.
 Signaleren van technologische ontwikkelingen en vertalen hiervan naar kansen voor Thales.
 About you 
 Wij zoeken een enthousiaste technoloog die technologie weet om te zetten in praktische productieoplossingen.
 Je beschikt over:
 Een HBO- of WO-opleiding in een technische richting, zoals Werktuigbouwkunde,
 Technische Natuurkunde, Mechatronica, Elektrotechniek of vergelijkbaar.
 Ervaring met productieprocessen, industrialisatie of manufacturing engineering binnen een hightech omgeving.
 Affiniteit met productie-, assemblage- en/of testtechnologie.
 Een sterk analytisch vermogen en een pragmatische instelling.
 Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om op verschillende niveaus te schakelen.
 Eigenaarschap, initiatief en een continue verbetermentaliteit.
 Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.
 Thales offers 
 Een interessante functie binnen een innovatieve en internationale hightechomgeving.
 Veel ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en eigen initiatief.
 De mogelijkheid om door te groeien in technische, management-, commerciële ofinternationale rollen.
 Een open en flexibele werkomgeving met aandacht voor een gezonde werkprivébalans.
 Een moderne werkplek in Hengelo.
 Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder 40 vakantiedagen per jaar.
 De kans om te werken aan geavanceerde producten en technologieën die wereldwijd impact maken. 
 Interested? 
 Ben jij de technoloog die innovatie weet te vertalen naar robuuste productieprocessen en wil je bijdragen aan de technologische voorsprong van Thales? Dan ontvangen wij graag jouw sollicitatie. Sluit je aan bij ons Industrial Engineering team en help mee de technologie van morgen realiseerbaar te maken.
