items.desc: Your job As a Research Funding Officer, you help turn new research ideas into concrete projects. You identify and assess opportunities for research funding and support the development of proposals, grant applications, and collaboration initiatives. In doing so, you work closely with researchers, project leaders, clients, and support departments within WMR and Wageningen University & Research (WUR). You will be part of the Acquisition Support & Project Management Team, a team of approximately nine colleagues who support researchers in acquiring and delivering research projects. You will work in an international, applied scientific environment where marine and freshwater ecological challenges are at the core. Projects range from field and experimental research to data management, modelling, and policy-oriented research. As a result, you will gain broad insight into the research activities of Wageningen Research and be involved in a wide variety of societal and scientific challenges. What does a typical day look like? You start the day by reviewing new requests, project proposals, and incoming questions. You then coordinate with project leaders regarding grant applications, proposals, and the progress of ongoing submissions. You align budgets, co-funding arrangements, and investments with finance colleagues and discuss contractual conditions with the legal department. Throughout the day, you critically review proposals and provide advice on their fit with grant requirements, tenders, or a client’s request. Researchers also approach you with questions about proposals, projects, and internal processes. In this way, you collaborate daily with a variety of colleagues to successfully move new research projects forward, from initial idea to contract award or grant application. Your tasks and responsibilities as a Research Funding Officer include: identifying and monitoring relevant contracts, tenders, and funding opportunities; assessing grant and tender requirements and advising on opportunities, risks, co-funding, and collaboration structures; coordinating proposal and grant application processes from initiation through submission; advising researchers and project leaders on acquisition, proposal, and grant procedures; coordinating with financial, legal, and scientific stakeholders to ensure successful applications and projects; monitoring the progress of acquisition, proposal, and research projects and identifying bottlenecks in a timely manner; supporting project leaders in the areas of planning, budgeting, quality assurance, and communication; maintaining relationships with clients, collaboration partners, and internal stakeholders; managing project administration, documentation, and reporting; improving and professionalising acquisition, proposal, and project management processes. Where you will work Wageningen Marine Research (WMR) is one of the nine research institutes that form part of Wageningen Research. WMR is a leading independent research institute with locations in IJmuiden, Den Helder, and Yerseke, specialising in strategic and applied marine ecological research. Our products and services are delivered on a project basis and are highly diverse, including field research, large-scale experiments, laboratory-based exploratory studies, data management, and modelling. We offer a varied position at the intersection of business development and project management; a professional and stimulating working environment; collaboration with dedicated researchers and project management professionals; the opportunity to contribute to societally relevant marine research; plenty of opportunities for personal development and growth. Your qualities You are proactive, results-oriented, and possess excellent organisational skills. You are able to maintain oversight of complex processes, work accurately, and feel comfortable in an environment where different interests and disciplines come together. Qualifications a completed academic degree (BSc, MSc level or equivalent) in a field relevant to the position; several years of experience in a role where process coordination is a key component; excellent command of both Dutch and English (C1 level), in speaking and writing; knowledge of and experience with research projects, grant processes, or business development activities is an advantage; affinity with marine ecological or other scientific research topics; strong communication and organisational skills. We offer Wageningen University & Research offers excellent terms of employment. A few highlights from our collective labour agreement include: working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance; sabbatical leave, study leave, and partially paid parental leave; a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%; excellent pension scheme. In addition to these first-rate employee benefits, you will of course receive a good salary. We offer, depending on your experience, a competitive gross …

The current phase covers three connected workflows: Processing and routing service requests Ranking and recommending hotels Closing cases with billing reconciliation and downstream system handoff You will turn operational knowledge and existing software into a working, testable system with explicit human approvals and traceable decisions. This is technical leadership, not architecture-only advice or task execution. You will work directly with operational experts, the client’s technology partners and our engineers, challenge assumptions constructively, and carry the technical solution from discovery through implementation and evaluation. How you will work You own the technical approach, engineering plan, implementation quality and evidence of readiness. You partner with the engagement Principal, who owns the integrated delivery plan, commercial scope and client commitments. You provide feasibility assessments before commitments are made and escalate unresolved dependencies or scope changes with options and their impact. What you will own 1. Establish an evidence-based technical baseline Inspect the code, infrastructure, APIs and operator workflows before estimating the build. Translate discovery into concise specifications with inputs, outputs, exclusions, acceptance tests and source references. Distinguish confirmed requirements from analyst recommendations and assumptions. Resolve contradictions with the appropriate owner. Do not implement them silently. 2. Make integration work early Build and review critical components, guide engineers and prove a thin end-to-end path in the client’s test environment: receive a request, retrieve operational data, produce a recommendation, obtain approval and perform the agreed system handoff. Verify API access, write capabilities, event contracts and error paths. Do not treat documentation or isolated components as proof of readiness. 3. Make rules and knowledge maintainable Design a clear separation between operational facts, business policies and software logic. Work with named business owners to define rule precedence, exceptions, validation and approval. Keep draft or inferred rules separate from approved rules. Support versioned updates without a software release, with historical replay, traceable approval and rollback. Use grounded reasoning and human escalation where rules do not resolve a case. 4. Own engineering quality and evaluation Review and test code, including AI-generated code, against the agreed architecture. Establish automated CI checks, integration tests and representative operational cases. Track the exact application, rule and data versions evaluated. Implement decision logs, monitoring, access controls and failure recovery. Define test-readiness evidence and agree workflow-quality, latency and operating-cost measures with the team and client. 5. Keep technical decisions and progress clear Maintain a concise architecture and decision record that shows what works, what remains and why. Raise blockers early with evidence, an owner, a decision needed and delivery impact. Propose simpler alternatives and update estimates when assumptions change. Demonstrate working increments, and clearly distinguish prototypes from integrated functionality. Leave the team with maintainable code, documentation and a practical handover. What good looks like Before build commitments: a reviewed technical baseline, verified critical dependencies and explicit assumptions behind the estimate. During delivery: a working end-to-end increment, automated tests running in CI, and demonstrated progress against agreed acceptance cases. For rule changes: a named business approver, a versioned baseline and recorded replay results before promotion. At evaluation: reproducible results, decision traces and documented limitations that support the agreed Go/No-Go decision, not just a successful demo. Specific targets will be agreed after the baseline is established. You will stay involved from the initial working sessions through delivery and evaluation. What you bring Evidence of taking an applied AI or LLM-enabled workflow beyond a prototype into operational use. Strong hands-on software engineering, architecture, API integration and code-review skills. Experience turning incomplete or conflicting discovery material into implementable, testable specifications. Sound judgment about structured rules, retrieval, AI reasoning and human review, including their failure modes. Practical experience with evaluation datasets, regression testing, CI and production observability. Confidence to challenge assumptions, explain alternatives and escalate decisions constructively across business and engineering teams. Du analyserar behov och möjligheter, utformar insatser tillsammans med sakkunniga och följer utvecklingen inom ditt teknikområde. Du ansvarar också för att handlägga och följa upp finansierade projekt. I arbetet har du löpande dialog med företag, forskningsaktörer, myndigheter och andra organisationer i Sverige och internationellt. Många av Vinnovas uppdrag rör banbrytande tekniker. Följande teknikområden pekas ut som strategiskt viktiga för Sverige: artificiell intelligens/autonoma system, avancerad digital teknik (inklusive halvledare), rymdteknik, kvantteknik, energiteknik, material- och produktionsteknik och bioteknik. Se https://www.vinnova.se/publikationer/strategiska-tekniker-for-sverige/ Exempel på arbetsuppgifter: Utforma insatser i samarbete med andra sakkunniga Representera Vinnova nationellt och internationellt Arbeta operativt i beslutsprocessen, samordna och kommunicera resultat i olika sammanhang Kvalifikationer Utbildning: - Forskarutbildning på minst licentiatnivå eller motsvarande med relevans för utpekade strategiska teknikområden, se https://www.vinnova.se/publikationer/strategiska-tekniker-for-sverige/ Erfarenhet: - Några års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom näringsliv, offentlig sektor eller akademi. - Erfarenhet av att självständigt leda projekt. Erfarenhet av att presentera för olika målgrupper. - Erfarenhet av internationell samverkan inom forskning och innovation. Vi söker dig som motiveras av Vinnovas uppdrag att främja strategiska tekniker, en hållbar samhällsutveckling och ett näringsliv som bygger lösningar som är ekonomiskt, socialt och miljömässigt hållbara. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du kunna ta ansvar för ditt arbete och självständigt driva frågor framåt. Du samarbetar väl med personer med olika kompetenser och bygger förtroendefulla relationer, både inom och utanför Vinnova. Du kan strukturera ditt arbete, prioritera mellan parallella uppgifter och anpassa dig när förutsättningarna förändras. Du är också bekväm med att presentera komplexa frågor för olika målgrupper. Vinnova är en lärande organisation och vi ser gärna att även du delar med dig av dina idéer och kunskaper. Våra värderingar: respekt, ansvarstagande och mod genomsyrar ditt dagliga arbete. items.desc: TIKK TAKK söker fyra seniora systemutvecklare inom .NET för konsultuppdrag hos en statlig myndighet inom transportsektorn i Örebro. Myndigheten inför en ny och förbättrad uppbördshantering och sidoordnad bokföring för skatter och avgifter inom vägtrafikområdet, vilket innebär förändrade verksamhetsprocesser och nya IT-system. Du blir en del av ett agilt leveransteam som bygger, vidareutvecklar och förvaltar verksamhetskritiska system i en komplex och distribuerad miljö. Rollen passar dig som är trygg i .NET och C# och vill bidra i hela utvecklingskedjan. Uppdraget kan även komma att omfatta andra produktområden eller projekt hos myndigheten. Om rollen Du deltar i alla steg i utvecklingsarbetet och levererar IT-system tillsammans med leveransteamet på ett agilt sätt. Arbetet omfattar både nyutveckling, vidareutveckling och förvaltning. Arbetet sker inom myndighetens flextid mellan 06.30 och 18.30. I samband med produktionssättningar kan planerad övertid förekomma. Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar att: - Förstå och tolka kravspecifikationer. - Planera och genomföra kodning, testning och felsökning av mjukvarukomponenter. - Leverera IT-system tillsammans med leveransteamet enligt agila arbetssätt. Arbeta med nyutveckling, vidareutveckling och förvaltning av befintliga system. - Dokumentera systemdesign och implementation. Arbetsuppgifterna kan utvecklas utifrån verksamhetens behov och din kompetens. Vi söker dig som har - Erfarenhet av agilt arbete under senare tid. Minst sju års erfarenhet av .NET Core och C#. - Minst sju års erfarenhet av komplexa distribuerade system med många integrationer. - Minst sju års erfarenhet av tjänste- och händelseorienterade lösningar. - Minst fyra års erfarenhet av Blazor. Minst fyra års erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL-databaser och datalager. - Minst fyra års erfarenhet av SQL Server och databasoptimering. - Minst fyra års erfarenhet av testdriven utveckling (TDD) och automatiserade tester. - Minst fyra års erfarenhet av ServiceBus och NServiceBus. Minst fyra års erfarenhet av SpecFlow. - Minst två års erfarenhet av att dokumentera systemdesign och implementation. - Ett referensuppdrag som styrker din erfarenhet i rollen behöver kunna lämnas. Du behöver kunna arbeta från Örebro. Meriterande erfarenhet Det är ett plus om du har arbetat med något av följande: - Kundreskontra, betalningsavvikelsehantering eller ärendehanteringssystem, minst tre år. - Telerik UI for Blazor, minst två år under senare tid. - SSIS-paket för SQL Server, minst två år under senare tid. - Arbete hos en myndighet eller i en stor organisation med komplexa system och höga säkerhetskrav, under senare tid. Som person Du är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten och tar ansvar för att din kod håller över tid. Du samarbetar gärna i team, delar med dig av din kunskap och bidrar aktivt till att teamet förbättrar sitt arbetssätt. Om uppdraget Plats: Örebro Omfattning: Heltid, 100 procent Antal tjänster: Fyra Planerad start: En tjänst med start 1 februari 2027 och tre tjänster med start 1 april 2027 Uppdragsperiod: Enligt avtal, med möjlighet till förlängning Ansökan Skicka ett uppdaterat CV och en kort motivering till varför du passar för uppdraget. Beskriv hur du uppfyller varje krav med antal år, bifoga ett referensuppdrag som styrker din erfarenhet i rollen och ange vilken startdag som passar dig. Urval sker löpande. Ansök snarast, senast den 24 oktober 2026.

items.desc: At GSK, we want to supercharge our data capability to better understand our patients and accelerate our ability to discover vaccines and medicines. The Onyx Research Data Platform organization represents a major investment by GSK R&D and Digital & Tech, designed to deliver a step-change in our ability to leverage data, knowledge, and prediction to find new medicines. We are a full-stack shop consisting of product and portfolio leadership, data engineering, infrastructure and DevOps, data / metadata / knowledge platforms, and AI/ML and analysis platforms, all geared toward: Building a next-generation, metadata- and automation-driven data experience for GSK’s scientists, engineers, and decision-makers, increasing productivity and reducing time spent on “data mechanics” Providing best-in-class AI/ML and data analysis environments to accelerate our predictive capabilities and attract top-tier talent Aggressively engineering our data at scale, as one unified asset, to unlock the value of our unique collection of data and predictions in real-time Our Compute Platform Engineering team is building a first-in-class platform of toolchains and workflows that accelerate application development, scale up computational experiments, and integrate all computation with project metadata, logs, experiment configuration and performance tracking over abstractions that encompass Cloud and High-Performance Computing (HPC). This metadata-forward, CI/CD-driven platform represents and enables the entire application and analysis lifecycle including interactive development and explorations (notebooks), large-scale batch processing, observability and production application deployments. A Compute Platform Engineer II is a technical contributor who can consistently take a poorly defined business or technical problem, work it to a well-defined problem / specification, and execute on it at a high level. They have a strong focus on metrics, both for the impact of their work and for its inner workings / operations. They are a model for the team on best practice for software development in general (and their specialization in particular), including code quality, documentation, DevOps, and testing. They ensure robustness of our services and serve as an escalation point in the operation of existing services, pipelines, and workflows. A Compute Platform Engineer II should be familiar with the tools of their specialization and of their customers and engaged with the open-source community surrounding them – potentially, even to the level of contributing pull requests. Key Responsibilities: Designs, builds, and operates tools, services, workflows, etc that deliver high value through the solution to key business problems, Responsible for development of key components of a hybrid on-prem/cloud compute platform for both interactive and scalable batch computing and establishing of processes and workflows to transition existing HPC users and teams to this platform Responsible for code-driven environment, applications, and container/image builds as well as CI/CD driven application deployments. Consult science users on application scalability to PBs of data by having a deep understanding of software engineering, algorithms, and underlying hardware infrastructure and their impact on performance. Confidently optimizes design and execution of complex solutions within large-scale distributed computing environments Produces well-engineered software, including appropriate automated test suites, technical documentation, and operational strategy Ensure consistent application of platform abstractions to ensure quality and consistency with respect to logging and lineage Fully versed in coding best practices and ways of working, and participates in code reviews and partnering to improve the team’s standards Adhere to QMS framework and CI/CD best practices and helps to guide improvements to them that improve ways of working Why You? items.desc: ServiceNow Technical & Enablement Architect Why Us! At GSK, we unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We are a global biopharma company with a special purpose – to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We’re proud to be leading a healthcare revolution, and we’re looking for people who can help us deliver on our ambition Job Purpose The ServiceNow Technical & Enablement Architect is accountable for setting the technical standards, patterns, and engineering practices that govern how solutions are built across the ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools domain, ensuring consistent, scalable, and secure delivery aligned to enterprise architecture direction. The role translates platform strategy into reusable standards and development guardrails, and builds the engineering capability to apply them — through enablement, coaching, and hands-on guidance across ServiceNow development, configuration, and integration practices. This role supports Core platform capabilities for NLU, Chat and Service Portal in partnership with the Platform Manager and Product Managers, specifically the ServiceNow Data Intelligence & Experience Product Manager, who is accountable for ensuring UX experience aligned across the platform. Operating at a senior technical leadership level, the role provides design assurance, owns the technical skills path for engineers, and raises the consistency and craft of the engineering organization. It partners with the Automation Engineering Architect, Platform Architecture, and engineering leads to close capability gaps and reduce technical debt from inconsistent practices. The role sets standards and builds capability; it does not own delivery. Solution build sits with engineering teams, automation design with the Automation Engineering Architect, backlog priority with the Product Owner, and target architecture with Enterprise Architecture Key Responsibilities Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture. Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations. Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational. Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after. Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity. Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim. Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work. Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions. Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why. Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it. Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted. Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build. Why You! We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems). Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform). Experience in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to. Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace. Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard. Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets. Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context. Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet. Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations Other Job-Related Skills/Background Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented. Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard. Clear design documentation, since patterns …

We are committed to excellence and innovation, ensuring we provide industry leading services to our clients and stakeholders. Join us to be part of a dynamic and growing team that values diversity and fosters professional growth. Department: Thames Water is the UK's largest water and wastewater company, serving around 16 million customers across London and the Thames Valley. As a trusted delivery partner, Lanes Group plays a vital role in maintaining one of the UK's most critical infrastructure networks, delivering essential wastewater and drainage services that protect communities and the environment. Our teams carry out everything from sewer maintenance and network cleansing to CCTV inspections and pollution response, ensuring customers receive a safe, reliable, and resilient service every day. Purpose of the role: Due to continued growth and development, we are now looking for customer focused people to join us in our Utility Division, working on our Thames Water contract service to deliver real and effective solutions to waste-water network and drainage problems. Location: Deephams Sewage Treatment Works, Enfield Job Type: Permanent, full-time Hours: 4 days on, 4 days off, Salary: £35,573 per annuum Key Responsibilities: Travelling to residential sites via a HGV in a two person team, around the region, powering a high-pressure water jet for restoration Clean, clear and maintain drainage systems Record each job report correctly on the specialist equipment provided Run diagnostics and repairs on drains Delivering good customer service Maintaining good health and safety practise while carrying out works Ensure vehicle stock is full and replenished Comply with health and safety responsibilities, i.e. PPE / safe site setups protecting Lanes Group employees, the public and other road users Utilise VISTEC and Salesforce platforms Operate JHL specification vacuum tankers and associated equipment Safely access vehicle cabs, sites and offices using correct procedures (e.g., three points of contact...) Manipulate (including loading and unloading to / from tanker pipe storage trays) flexible pipework in a safe manner utilising correct manual handling techniques Work unsupervised in all weather conditions, wearing correct PPE or utilising the lone worker system Dynamically risk assess site access and working conditions depending on specific circumstances on arrival Liaising with the client regarding process and any updates Provide support to your colleagues Conduct thorough inspections of tools, equipment and plant before and after use Report any defects or malfunctions Carry out risk assessments and have a mature approach to risk perception Be aware of all Lanes Group policies and your responsibilities towards them Any other reasonable ad-hoc tasks, duties or projects as requested by management Please note: full training will be provided Living the Company Values By embedding our companies core values and purpose into each role, ensures that every employee, regardless of their role or level, understands how their individual development and contributions align with our purpose of ‘improving today for a better tomorrow’. Each role and value has an alignment to set proficiency levels and expectations; this role holder is expected to: Leading : Acts as a role model, shaping the learning agenda and influencing change. Agile : Anticipates learning needs, adjusts quickly to changing operational contexts. Nurturing : Supports the development of others through coaching and structured development plans. Engaging : Inspires and motivates learners, builds trust and credibility Safe & Secure: Ensures all learning is aligned to safety and compliance standards. Your Contribution to the company: Strive to be always positive and constructive Adhere to all company policies Straight talking about the facts of the situation – open discussions are the best way to find solutions Help others through communicating clearly Deliver on commitments Ensure that any ideas that may enhance the productivity or systems of the company are brought to the attention of Senior Management, or your colleagues Deliver our Company Values understanding that by working together in unity we are ‘Stronger Together’ Equality, Diversion & Inclusion At Lanes Group, we are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We believe that our differences make us stronger and are committed to providing equal opportunities for all employees. items.card: La ligne de service Consulting & Solutions d’Akkodis France renforce ses équipes en région et recrute un Forward Deployed Engineer / AI Ops Engineer H/F en CDI à Villeurbanne. Ce poste s’inscrit dans le contexte de transformation digitale des opérations, où vous serez le lien entre les équipes métiers et technologiques d’Akkodis pour concevoir, déployer et optimiser des solutions d’automatisation basées sur l’IA.
items.desc:
La ligne de service Consulting & Solutions d’Akkodis France renforce ses équipes en région et recrute un Forward Deployed Engineer / AI Ops Engineer H/F en CDI à Villeurbanne. Ce poste s’inscrit dans le contexte de transformation digitale des opérations, où vous serez le lien entre les équipes métiers et technologiques d’Akkodis pour concevoir, déployer et optimiser des solutions d’automatisation basées sur l’IA. Vous contribuerez à la création de workflows agentiques innovants, apportant une valeur mesurable aux processus opérationnels.
 Responsabilités principales : 
 Collaborer avec les équipes métiers pour diagnostiquer les besoins opérationnels et concevoir des solutions IA sur mesure.
 Déployer et intégrer des modèles IA dans l’infrastructure IT existante, en garantissant leur fonctionnement optimal.
 Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des workflows d’automatisation agentiques à grande échelle.
 Assurer la surveillance de la performance des systèmes IA et proposer des améliorations fondées sur l’analyse de données.
 Résoudre les incidents techniques et assurer la fiabilité et la sécurité des solutions en production.
 Former et accompagner les utilisateurs sur les outils et plateformes IA, en créant de la documentation et des retours d’expérience.
 Développer des bonnes pratiques et des modèles réutilisables pour les projets clients.
 Faire le relais entre le terrain et les équipes AI Ops pour capitaliser sur les succès et identifier les axes d’amélioration.
 Environnement de travail : 
Vous évoluerez dans un environnement technique avancé, au sein d’une équipe multidisciplinaire et en interaction directe avec les directions opérationnelles, delivery, ventes, finance et RH. Les projets sont sponsorisés au plus haut niveau, avec une collaboration étroite entre les équipes IT et métiers. Le poste est basé à Lyon avec des déplacements limités, et implique une forte dimension collaborative, ainsi qu’une veille constante sur l’écosystème IA et agentique.

Issu(e) d'une formation d'ingénieur ou titulaire d'un master en informatique, vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle, dont une pratique significative des solutions IA en production (LLM, workflows agentiques). Vous maîtrisez Python, FastAPI, FastMCP, les environnements cloud (Azure apprécié), la conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes), et les outils de monitoring. Vous avez une solide compréhension des architectures IA, du déploiement en production, et des principes DevOps (CI/CD). Votre capacité à diagnostiquer les besoins métiers, à analyser des données complexes et à traduire les enjeux business en solutions techniques vous distingue. Une expérience en management transverse et en accompagnement du changement est un atout. La maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (niveau business) est indispensable. Akkodis accompagne ses clients dans la mondialisation de leurs projets, aussi un anglais courant est requis pour l'ensemble de nos collaborateurs.​

 Hardware Security Engineer for Silicon Lifecycle Management Tools 
 Tessent is looking for a highly motivated, creative, and energetic engineer with a background in digital circuit design and verification, with an emphasis on hardware/software security, to strengthen our Research & Development team.
 Security is a critical aspect of solutions deployed for Silicon Lifecycle Management. We are seeking a hardware security expert who can help protect our Test IPs and Test Access Mechanisms (TAMs) against cyber-attacks.

 Designing secure architectures.
 Implementing cryptographic and authentication mechanisms.
 Performing adversarial assessments to identify vulnerabilities.
 Working closely with peer teams to ensure security requirements are integrated throughout the product lifecycle.
 The candidate will work as part of an international team of software and hardware development engineers, alongside Quality Assurance, Customer Support, Documentation, and Product Marketing teams.
 Together, we continuously strive to develop innovative products using the latest tools and technologies across multiple domains, including Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
 This role offers the opportunity to lead the overall security strategy for our products and solutions, while continuing to develop both personal and professional skills and expertise.

 Strong understanding of semiconductor design.
 Experience designing and developing secure hardware and firmware solutions to defend against physical and side-channel attacks.
 Experience implementing: Hardware roots of trust Secure boot Secure key storage Hardware-accelerated encryption mechanisms
 Knowledge of: Cryptographic primitives Side-channel attacks Fault injection methods
 Expertise in hardware design, Verilog, and SystemVerilog.
 Demonstrated analytical and creative problem-solving skills.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

 Hands-on experience in semiconductor design.
 Knowledge of design flows and EDA tools in one or more of the following areas: HDL simulation Logic synthesis Integrated Circuit (IC) place and route Static Timing Analysis (STA) Logic Equivalence Checking Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) Reset Domain Crossing (RDC)
 Experience with industry standards and compliance frameworks, such as: FIPS Common Criteria ISO 26262 ISO/SAE 21434 (Automotive Cybersecurity)

 Are you ready to shape the future of transportation with cutting-edge electronic design? Join us and make a real impact on sustainable mobility.
 Siemens Mobility: Shaping the Future of Transportation
 For over 160 years, Siemens Mobility has been a global leader, innovating transportation solutions that move the world. As a separately managed Siemens company, we are dedicated to making mobility more efficient, sustainable, and enjoyable for everyone.
 We lead the way in Rolling Stock, Rail Automation & Electrification, Turnkey Systems, Intelligent Traffic Systems, and comprehensive Related Services. Through digitalization, we empower operators worldwide to create intelligent infrastructure, enhance passenger experience, and ensure unparalleled availability.
 Join us in transforming Mobility Management, Turnkey Projects, Electrification, Mainline & Urban Transport, and Customer Services. If you're ready to make a real impact on a more connected and sustainable future, your journey starts here.
 Your mission in our team
 As a Hardware Development Engineer, you will be a key player in our international and multidisciplinary development team, designing the electronic foundation for our next-generation railway solutions. Your work will directly contribute to the safety, reliability, and efficiency of our products.
 Challenges that await you:
 Designing robust analogue electronic circuits, including power electronics, signal amplification, filtering, and isolation.
 Collaborating on the design and implementation of communication and control boards for railway field elements.
 Conducting rigorous laboratory testing to verify designs functionally and non-functionally (EMC, climatic, etc.).
 Participating actively throughout the entire hardware development lifecycle, from requirements specification to testing.
 Driving innovation by researching and applying new technologies to our products.
 What will make your application stand out:
 A Degree in Industrial Engineering, Telecommunications, or an equivalent field, with a strong focus on Electronics.
 Fluent spoken and written English to thrive in our international environment.
 Proven experience in analogue electronics design, ideally within the railway, avionics, defense, or automotive industries.
 Strong analytical skills, self-motivation, and a creative approach to complex problem-solving.
 Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
 You’ll thrive even more if you also bring:
 Experience in digital electronics design, particularly with microprocessors and FPGAs.
 Hands-on experience with laboratory tasks, common electronic equipment, and debugging tools.
 Familiarity with manufacturing documentation processes.
 Knowledge of electronic board design and simulation tools like PSPICE, MatLab, or Simulink.
 Even if you don't meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We'd love to get to know you and explore the possibilities.
 What awaits you when you join:
 At Siemens Mobility, we are committed to sustainability, developing technologies that minimize environmental impact and promote green practices. We focus on our customers, delivering innovative solutions through digital transformation to enhance the passenger experience and optimize infrastructure. We believe in creating social value, fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, learn continuously, and enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work model.
 If we all thought the same, we would never think of anything new! That’s why we recruit great minds from all walks of life. We recognise that building a diverse workforce is essential to the success of our business, therefore we encourage applications from a diverse talent pool. We welcome the opportunity to discuss flexibility requirements with our applicants to encourage agile working and innovation. Flexibility is our main benefit. We combine remote and presence work because work-life balance and wellbeing are essential for our teams. We are convinced that stay at home allow us to focus on activities that need more time for concentration and being at the office enhance our creativity collaborating and learning from others.
 Siemens aboga por la igualdad de oportunidades entre mujeres y hombres, así como en la Diversidad como fuente de creatividad e innovación. Contar con diferentes tipos de talento y de experiencias nos hace ser más competitivos y estar mejor preparados para responder con éxito a las demandas de la Sociedad. items.title: Data Scientist
items.card: the role. Your day-to-day impact: ✔ Turn raw, messy or unstructured data - article text, usage data, and new data arriving from external sources - into clean, ready-to-use formats for downstream products. ✔ Apply light ML/NLP techniques (e.g. entity extraction, classification, tagging) to structure unstructured text. ✔ Adapt existing pipelines to ingest and normalise new data types as they come online. ✔ Bring in
items.desc: Our client is the leading source of actionable intelligence for the global insurance, reinsurance and ILS markets. They are building a new AI-powered data product and need someone to help them turning their growing pool of data into the structured, ready-to-use formats that power search, personalisation and new features. They need a Data Scientist with a software or data engineering background who has moved into data science over the past few years and wants to keep developing in that direction. Or a generalist who's happy moving between engineering and data science work rather than a deep specialist in either. They'll soon be bringing in a lot of new data and new data types from external sources, which will make this data structuring and manipulation work even more central to the role. Your day-to-day impact: ✔ Turn raw, messy or unstructured data - article text, usage data, and new data arriving from external sources - into clean, ready-to-use formats for downstream products. ✔ Apply light ML/NLP techniques (e.g. entity extraction, classification, tagging) to structure unstructured text. ✔ Adapt existing pipelines to ingest and normalise new data types as they come online. ✔ Bring in new datasets - scraped or paid-for/third-party - and merge them with our existing data to create new, value-add content sets. ✔ Build personalisation logic that blends usage data with content suggestions, helping surface the right content to the right customer. ✔ Work with product and editorial to define the signals and rules behind personalised recommendations and content creation. Data Science tasks: ✔ Use statistical and ML methods (e.g. classification, clustering, embeddings) to analyse usage and content data, surfacing patterns and insights that inform personalisation and product decisions. ✔ Use LLMs to extract structure - keywords, entities, topics - from unstructured article text, and check the accuracy and quality of that output. ✔ Prototype and test simple models or scoring logic (e.g. for recommendations or content matching), working with product to validate they add value before scaling. ✔ Try different approaches to a data or personalisation problem, evaluate what works, and explain the trade-offs in plain terms to non-technical stakeholders. Data Engineering tasks: ✔ Maintain and extend our Databricks/Python pipelines - ingestion, transformation, scheduling and monitoring. ✔ Identify new data sources relevant to the product and help scope their integration. AI-Assisted Development: ✔ Use AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to build and iterate on data pipelines and structuring work quickly. ✔ Work across product, editorial and commercial teams to understand data needs and communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences. ✔ Monitor data quality in production, flagging issues and improving tooling and documentation. Your profile looks like that: ✔ 3–5 years' hands-on experience in data engineering, with strong Python and SQL. ✔ Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, ideally with Databricks, Spark or a comparable cloud data platform. ✔ Some exposure to - or a strong interest in developing - data science/ML techniques, e.g. classification, clustering, NER, embeddings. ✔ Experience turning raw or messy data into structured, ready-to-use formats for downstream use. ✔ Comfortable working independently and using AI coding tools to move quickly. You are a great fit if you have: ✔ Experience with personalisation, recommendation systems, or blending usage/behavioural data with content. ✔ Exposure to using LLMs to extract structure (keywords, entities, topics) from unstructured text. ✔ A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field - or equivalent experience. ✔ Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster or Databricks Workflows. They offer, not just a nice team and environment, but: ✔︎ Flexibility with true hybrid working - expected to be in the office 1-2 days a week. ✔︎ 25 holiday days per year, plus your birthday off. ✔︎ Opportunities for professional growth and development. ✔︎ Competitive compensation and benefits package. A re you still here? Great! Let’s discuss further at katrin@cadabra.bg (Recruitment License № 2709/ 17.01.2019)

items.desc: Information sur l'entreprise La délégation à la transformation et à la performance ministérielles (DTPM) assure, pour le compte du secrétaire général pour l'administration (SGA), la mission générale de modernisation de l'administration du ministère. Elle concentre à cet effet ses actions sur trois axes complémentaires, le conseil, le numérique et l'innovation et intervient, selon le cas, sur différents périmètres, ministériel, fonctionnel ou organique, aussi bien pour mettre en œuvre des actions relevant d'une administration centrale classique que d'une administration de mission. La DTPM est forte de près de cent trente agents, répartis en trois départements : une agence ministérielle de conseil (AMC), un nouveau service de transformation numérique (STN) et un département du management et de la transformation interne (DMTI). Le centre d’expertise données et intelligence artificielle (CEDIA) du SGA est rattaché au sein du STN. Le centre est chargé de contribuer au domaine de l’intelligence artificielle organique de défense plus précisément le périmètre administration et soutien. Il est un des acteurs clé du domaine IA au sein du ministère. Description Le Data Scientist Confirmé intègre l’équipe en tant que référent technique/ scientifique, il est chargé d’accompagner les juniors dans leur montée en compétences tout en participant à la réalisation des projets data 360 et IA. Il est également en charge de l’utilisation des technologies Big Data et IA, dans le but d’aider à la prise de décision et faire de la veille technologique sur les architectures Big Data et IA Vous aurez la responsabilité de : • Analyser des données pour traduire une problématique métier en problème mathématique statistique, et réciproquement • Anticiper avantages/inconvénients de différents modèles ou méthodes calcul dans environnement métier après comparaison et évaluation de ces modèles • Apporter expertise pour exploration/analyse complexe de données au moyen techniques variées : statistiques, analyse texte, comportementale, images • Caractériser des données (qualité, richesse, contenu) en vue de leur intégration dans le système d'information cible du métier et créer des algorithmes de recherche de données permettant d'explorer les données utiles • Produire des rapports et des représentations graphiques à partir des données pertinentes afin de synthétiser et traduire des informations pour faciliter la prise de décision Profil Ingénieur diplômé d’une école spécialisée (ENSAE, ENSAI, Polytechnique…) ou d’un master en data science, vous justifiez de 5 ans d’expérience sur un poste similaire. Vous êtes doté de solides compétences techniques autour de Python et packages adaptés, Docker, Git. Vous avez également de très bonnes capacités interpersonnelles et de communication dans le travail quotidien.

items.desc: AI Software Engineer Responsa è la practice di Generative AI del Gruppo Euris . Nati nel 2013, ci siamo evoluti da piattaforma FAQ a pionieri dei chatbot, fino a sviluppare oggi una piattaforma modulare di AI generativa proprietaria (agenti testuali multicanale, agenti vocali VoIP, elaborazione documenti e Knowledge Hub). Gestiamo il prodotto interamente in-house come servizio SaaS cloud multi-tenant, servendo oltre 40 grandi clienti (utilities, finanza, retail, industria) per più di 1 milione di conversazioni all'anno. Stiamo cercando AI Software Engineer Di cosa ti occuperai: Sviluppo e migrazione dei servizi verso un’architettura event-driven e multi-tenant; Scrittura di specifiche dettagliate per gli agenti AI e revisione critica del codice generato (sicurezza, performance, manutenibilità); Collaborazione diretta con il CTO e il team per la definizione e la documentazione dell’architettura; Gestione dell’intero flusso di rilascio, dai test e pipeline di deploy fino al monitoraggio in produzione; Sviluppo di connettori e integrazioni tra modelli linguistici e sistemi dei clienti tramite protocollo MCP; Supporto diretto sui progetti per analizzare requisiti e vincoli di business con i clienti. Hard skill Must Have Esperienza concreta di sviluppo backend su sistemi in produzione, indicativamente almeno 3-4 anni; Ottima conoscenza di Node.js e TypeScript. Valutiamo con piacere anche background in altri linguaggi backend, purché ci sia una forte solidità sui fondamentali della programmazione; Basi solide di architettura del software: progettazione di API, modellazione dei dati, sistemi distribuiti e asincroni, gestione degli errori, sicurezza; Familiarità con database (lavoriamo soprattutto con MongoDB), container (Docker) e servizi cloud (AWS); Critica tecnica e comunicazione: Capacità di analizzare il codice (umano/AI) e argomentare con chiarezza interventi migliorativi; Lingue: Italiano fluente e inglese tecnico scritto. Nice to have Non è una checklist rigida e non serve averli tutti, ma il primo punto è quello per noi fondamentale. Usi già ogni giorno Claude Code, Codex, Cursor o strumenti simili, e sai raccontarci cosa affideresti a un agente e cosa invece terresti per te; Hai esperienza full-stack, o almeno ti muovi senza difficoltà anche sul frontend; Hai portato LLM in applicazioni reali: RAG, valutazione della qualità delle risposte, gestione di costi e latenze delle chiamate ai modelli; Conosci NestJS, le architetture event-driven o protocolli di messaggistica come MQTT; Hai già lavorato su prodotti SaaS multi-tenant. Cosa offriamo? Contratto a tempo indeterminato, retribuzione commisurata alla tua esperienza ( range € 40.000 - € 50.000 ); Ticket Restaurant, welfare aziendale, assicurazione sanitaria; Licenze dei principali strumenti di AI per lo sviluppo; Un prodotto in piena evoluzione, tecnologie recenti e un team che studia di continuo i temi che oggi muovono il mercato: agenti, modelli linguistici, automazione dei processi. Modalità di lavoro : smart working o full remote dall’Italia. Sono previste trasferte saltuarie per gli incontri di team o per esigenze dei clienti. La ricerca è naturalmente rivolta a candidature di entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77)

items.desc: Seleccionamos Ingeniero/a de Automatización e IA para incorporar a nuestras oficinas de Barcelona. Vilar Riba somos una organización de asesoramiento global en los ámbitos fiscal, legal, laboral, consultoría, auditoría y M&A. También formamos parte de la red Geneva Group Internacional (GGI) la sexta firma mundial de servicios profesionales a empresas. Que buscamos? Buscamos un perfil técnico que construya las soluciones de automatización e inteligencia artificial que están transformando el trabajo de la firma, trabajando codo con codo con los profesionales de las diferentes áreas de negocio y manteniéndonos por delante de un entorno tecnológico que continuará cambiando rápidamente. Esta persona tendrá que convertir las oportunidades de mejora en soluciones reales, robustas y efectivamente adaptadas a los equipos profesionales de la firma. Entre las tareas y funciones a realizar, destacamos: Construir soluciones de automatización e IA: automatizaciones de procesos, integraciones con nuestro software, soluciones basadas en LLM (procesamiento de documentos no estructurados, extracción de datos a formato estructurado, agentes), trabajando principalmente sobre Power Platform y el entorno Microsoft 365. Garantizar la calidad técnica del que es despliega: soluciones robustas, mantenibles y bien documentadas, no prototipos frágiles. Hacer vigilancia tecnológica: probar herramientas y enfoques nuevos y proponer mejoras técnicas a la dirección. Qué valoramos: Formación en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física o similar. Conocimientos de programación en Python, Javascript/Typescript, y SQL. Experiencia mínima de 3 años en automatización de procesos. Perfil analítico, proactivo y metódico, con capacidad para interpretar indicadores de negocio y proponer mejoras. Experiencia con modelos de lenguaje (LLMs) y tecnologías de inteligencia artificial generativa ( embeddings, fine-tuning , RAG, etc.). Conocimiento de entornos cloud com AWS, GCP o Azure. Qué ofrecemos: Un proyecto profesional con recorrido, basado en el aprendizaje continuo y la participación en proyectos para organizaciones de primer nivel. Un excelente ambiente de trabajo. La posibilidad de formar parte de un equipo joven, motivado y altamente especializado. Autonomía y responsabilidad en los proyectos. Formación técnica, idiomas e itinerarios adaptados a tus necesidades profesionales. Plan de conciliación. Modelo de teletrabajo híbrido. Vilar Riba tratará los datos personales recibidos para la revisión y valoración de la información proporcionada con el objetivo de participar en el proceso de selección. En caso de que sea de su interés, se podrá contactar con el candidato con la intención de valorar su candidatura. Para más información sobre el tratamiento de los datos personales y sobre como ejercer los derechos de acceso, rectificación, supresión, limitación, oposición o portabilidad, los candidatos pueden consultar la política de privacidad de Vilar Riba (https://vilarriba.com/politica-de-privacitat/).

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). items.desc:
Amazon moves millions of packages every day through the world's largest transportation network of planes, trucks, and delivery vehicles. Before any package can be assigned to a route, someone needs to design that network - figure out which lanes exist, how much capacity each node and lane can handle, and what changes are needed as demand shifts. That's what we build.
Global Transportation Tech Services (GTTS) creates software that manages the foundation of Amazon's outbound transportation network. Your work has direct financial impact on network efficiency and directly affects whether customers get their packages on time.
Here's what we actually do: We build the platform that transportation teams use to design and change the network - from evaluating new lanes to putting them live. We calculate how much capacity each node and lane will have, so the network can handle the volume. We identify where capacity will fall short and alert operators before it becomes a problem. We spot packages at risk of missing delivery and give operators tools to protect them. When a hurricane hits Florida or a snowstorm shuts down highways in the Midwest, our systems detect the disruption, protect customers by adjusting delivery promises, and help move volume to keep packages flowing.
The challenges are real: modeling capacity across a massive global network, managing thousands of network changes safely, predicting capacity gaps weeks in advance, detecting and responding to disruptions in real-time, and keeping systems running 24/7.
We regularly build new greenfield products while also modernizing existing systems. You'll have space to explore new technologies and approaches to solve customer problems. We work with AWS services, big data processing (Spark/Scala), optimization algorithms, machine learning models, and GenAI.
Key job responsibilities
- Working independently to own end-to-end delivery (from design through release) of features and medium-sized projects
- Working with AWS technologies such as Lambda, ECS Fargate, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, EMR
- building customer-facing applications and APIs
- Building data pipelines using Spark + Scala that process Tb of data per day
- Working with customers to understand the business context of new features
- Contributing to design reviews and code reviews
- Participating in operational support for our products by joining a regular on-call rotation
- Driving reliability and process improvements
- Mentoring SDE-I engineers and helping them grow technically
- Participating in regular hackathons to bring new ideas to GTTS
About the team
We're a global team with members in Hyderabad and Luxembourg. The team includes software engineers, product managers, technical program managers and applied scientists working on transportation problems.
What to expect:
- You build and operate your software - we handle on-call for what we create
- Work spans multiple technologies: big data processing, backend services, frontend development, and integration with optimization and ML models. You'll also use GenAI to both augment your skills and build agents that automate workflows
- Regular interaction with users of the software
- Team members work across different time zones
- We value different perspectives and encourage open discussion
- Opportunity to work on problems that affect transportation operations globally
- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design, or experience in development in the last 3 years
- Experience with distributed, multi-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases
- Experience in the full secure software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Experience in managing and troublshooting network, or experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems and experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities

- Experience with AWS technologies
- Experience with big data processing technology (e.g., Hadoop or ApacheSpark), data warehouse technical architecture, infrastructure components, ETL, and reporting/analytic tools and environments

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
 Therapeutic Modality (TMo) organization, accountable for translating disease biology into high-quality drug candidates across small molecules, large molecules, oligonucleotides, and genomic medicines. By integrating deep modality expertise with cross-disciplinary collaboration, TMo drives innovation within and across platforms to enable differentiated, sustainable therapeutic impact.
 As an experienced Scientist in Oligonucleotide Chemistry, you will serve as a key architect behind our therapeutic pipeline, translating advanced chemical concepts into optimized lead candidates. In this strategic role, you will champion the rational design and chemical modification framework for next-generation small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) and antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs). Collaborating seamlessly with our computational platforms and discovery teams, you will guide the creation of proprietary libraries and establish structure-activity relationships to accelerate candidate selection. By synthesizing cutting-edge literature, emerging technologies, and external innovations, you will continuously elevate our core chemical design strategies and position our platform at the forefront of genetic medicine.
 The Opportunity
 Design and champion the rational chemical modification framework for next-generation oligonucleotides—including siRNAs and ASOs—to advance critical drug discovery projects.
 Collaborate seamlessly with computational experts and synthesis teams to create high-value, novel oligonucleotide libraries, bridging theoretical chemistry with data-driven design.
 Analyze experimental data using advanced computational methods, applying continuous learning cycles to systematically refine and elevate chemical designs.
 Translate innovative chemical concepts into synthetically accessible structures with precision and attention to detail.
 Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and external breakthroughs to identify novel ways to improve safety profiles, durability, and therapeutic performance.
 Partner across multidisciplinary teams—including biology, pharmacology, and toxicology—to evaluate biological impacts and guide strategic decisions in a highly collaborative environment.
 Who You Are
 You hold a Ph.D. in Oligonucleotide Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, or a related discipline, complemented by 3 to 5 years of industry experience in the biotech or pharmaceutical sectors. Experience across different oligonucleotide modalities is highly desirable.
 You bring deep expertise in translating chemical modifications of oligonucleotides into innovative drug candidate designs.
 You possess a comprehensive understanding of modern oligonucleotide modification patterns (such as 2'-O-methyl, 2'-fluoro, LNA, cEt) and how they influence therapeutic properties.
 You are familiar with delivery technologies (like GalNAc, lipid, or peptide conjugates), and any insights you have into linker design are highly valued.
 You combine scientific creativity and attention to detail with independent problem-solving skills, and you thrive in a collaborative environment where you can inspire and guide cross-functional teams.
 At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

 The Position
 In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. 
 Strategy, Portfolio & Operations (SPO) is a unified function that serves as the strategic and operational backbone enabling pRED's strategy from lab to clinic. Operating under a dynamic Chapter Model, SPO centralizes specialized skills across critical areas including Sites & Lab Services, Program & Project Management, Strategy, Clinical Operations, External Operations, Capability Development, Core Lab Technology Platforms (360Labs) and Asset Team Leadership. SPO’s mission is to drive enterprise value creation by delivering operational excellence, and accelerating portfolio productivity. As a trusted partner, SPO fosters a culture of collaboration and accountability to ensure pRED transitions assets smoothly from early research to late-stage development. 
 360 Labs Chapter at a Glance 
 The primary mission of the 360 Labs Chapter within SPO is to provide greater access and support for the use of cutting-edge biomedical research technologies by scientists across our discovery portfolio. 360 Labs delivers core scientific technologies, expertise and enabling activities, as well as facilitating knowledge sharing in close collaboration with our therapeutic areas and functions. Our ambition is to bring to life a thriving workplace environment, where your collaborative mindset is as valued as your professional expertise. Our goal is to act as a highly integrated ecosystem, supporting research and development, working collaboratively, and focused on fostering excellence and sustainability. Together, these efforts will serve to increase the speed, enhance the robustness and improve the sustainability of our exploratory research and early discovery activities. 
 The Opportunity 
 The Microscopy Technology Platform in the 360 Labs Chapter is seeking an experienced, highly motivated, collaborative, and customer-centric lab-based senior scientist. The successful candidate will have a strong theoretical and practical background in the use of state-of-the-art optical microscopy techniques. Candidates with a solid understanding of how to best design and execute optical microscopy-based assays as applied to a variety of 2D and 3D sample types (including complex cell and organoid cultures and fixed cell/tissue preparations) are strongly desired. You will work with a sense of urgency as part of a matrix team, collaborating with specialists from each of our therapeutic disease areas and functions to advance early drug discovery programs, and you will also contribute to the ongoing development and operations of the Microscopy Technology Platform within the pRED organisation.

 You will embrace a continuous learning mindset by actively engaging with the scientific literature to stay abreast of emergent technologies/approaches in the advanced optical microscopy field.

Role and responsibilities As integrated optics researcher in the Optics and Photonics group you will be responsible for developing cutting edge
items.desc:
Introduction to the job 
 ASML is relentlessly driving the semiconductor industry’s ongoing quest for producing faster, smarter and more energy efficient chips. We are a young, dynamic, international and highly skilled workforce creating, with strong support of our suppliers, the lithographic tools the industry needs to achieve its goals. 
Are you looking for a challenge to ensure the ultimate photonic solutions in our scanners and metrology instruments? Then you will enjoy this position in the Optics and Photonics group at ASML research. You will be part of the group responsible for demonstrating how new or existing technological solutions can be adapted to meet and exceed the needs of our metrology and lithographic tools.
 Role and responsibilities 
 As integrated optics researcher in the Optics and Photonics group you will be responsible for developing cutting edge photonic solutions and demonstrating their applicability to our industrial context. You will work in a fast paced and multi-disciplinary environment. Your responsibility is to take ownership of the experimental and theoretical work with the rest of the team and drive feasibility studies towards clear conclusions. This includes contributions to the definition of the photonic system’s architecture, design, specification, development, and documentation, as well as communication of the results towards various stakeholders. Using your technical knowledge, analytical thinking and people skills, you will work closely together with the team and other researchers at ASML.
 You will join a project team whose mission is to focus on the development of photonic solutions for both our lithographic as well as our metrology tools. The job consists of:
 Understand optical sensing concepts and their photonic equivalent in an industrial context
 Understand requirements, architecture and technology development needs for the photonic solutions
 Design and specification of photonic integrated circuits
 Definition of experiments for evaluation of these PICs
 Design and specification of the experimental set-up for PIC characterization
 Work together with other researchers towards better understanding of the technologies
 Generate new ideas and solutions for current and future photonic solutions
 Education and experience 
 PhD in Electrical engineering, Physics or Applied Physics in the field of integrated photonics.
 Experience in developing photonic integrated circuits: design and specification.
 Experience in designing photonic components using numerical methods such as FDTD, EME, and FEM and optics modeling software (e.g. Lumerical).
 Experience with experimental evaluation of PICs
 Experience with designing the experimental set-up for characterization of PICs
 Experience with manufacturing of PICs and interacting with foundries.
 Skills 
 Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.
 To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:
 Deep understanding of optical sensing concepts and their integrated optics equivalent
 Proficiency modeling and designing photonic integrated circuits according to specifications
 Ability to conduct laboratory experiments and hands-on work
 Proactive team player focused on contributing toward common goals within a highly skilled team. Ability to propose practical and pragmatic solutions
 Good communicational skills
 Flexible, committed, result driven with the ability to plan and prioritize
 Self-propelling, showing initiative and drive, pragmatic attitude
 Strong analytical skills and drive for quality
 This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology. 
 Inclusion and diversity 
 ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.

Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) is part of IS&T and delivers global-scale platforms and services that keep Apple's operations secure and running. The team manages identity, device security, and anti-abuse platforms — covering everything from manufacturing and repairs to software updates and activations. ETS also oversees supply chain, manufacturing, and partner integration platforms, protecting data on more than 2.5 billion devices worldwide. And when Apple prepares for a global product launch, ETS owns the systems that ramp factory production managing serial numbers, network credentials, and verified software. 
The Insight team runs one of Apple's most critical Big Data ecosystems — a multi-petabyte, highly-available infrastructure that underpins manufacturing operations for every Apple product, globally. Every iPhone, iPad, and Mac has touched our systems. We are establishing a new EMEA operational team in Cork, not only as an extension of our US/India/China operations, but also a team with its own identity, perspective, and contribution to how Insight runs at global scale. This is a new regional team being built from the ground up, and the people who join early will help shape what it becomes. 
We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer who has operated in the European high-tech landscape, who brings the rigor and perspective that comes from that environment, and who wants to shape the practices of a new team. As one of the first few SREs in Cork, you will have real influence over how this team works, what it builds, and how it contributes to Apple's manufacturing infrastructure worldwide.

Amaze yourself. Amaze the world. Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Together we build products and experiences people once couldn’t have envisioned - and now can’t imagine living without. Are you excited by the idea of making a real impact? Are you prepared to dream big? Then a career with Apple might be your dream job. 
Apple Cork has a phenomenal opportunity to work within our AMP Partner Operations team as part of a 23 month Graduate Training program. This position will provide you excellent development opportunities, within a global company, to build the career you have always wanted! 
Services at Apple encompasses some of the world’s most innovative software including Apple Music, App Store, Apple Books, Podcasts, Apple TV+, Apple News+ and more. Services reach millions of iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Apple Watch and Mac customers in over 150 countries Worldwide. 
We are looking for an astute, upbeat graduate, to work within the Partner Support Team which is part of AMP Partner Operations team. You will have the outstanding opportunity to gain experience working with the team responsible for scaling Apple’s first party services (Apple Music, iCloud, TV+, Arcade, Fitness+ etc.) through strategic integrations with third party (carrier, retail, auto and financial service, etc.) partners. Graduates of BIS, BComm, Commerce or other similar fields are of particular interest, however, if you feel you have the skills and background required, we would love to hear from you.
Before applying, please note: applications will close at 6pm UK time on 30 October 2026. The start date for this program is negotiable between June to mid-August 2027 and the contract duration is 23 months.
This role is for recent graduates (summer 2026) or final-year students graduating in summer 2027, who are based in Ireland, ideally Cork. We require a minimum 2:1 honours degree (Level 8) in BIS, BComm, Commerce, or other similar qualification. We’re sorry that we can’t consider applications outside of these criteria for this programme.

Job Description: 
 Ready to join one of our Airbus Programs in Spain? 
 AIRBUS offers an internship (curricular practicum) program aimed at students who are in the last year of their degree with the main objective of acquiring professional skills through the development of a project in the company.
 What do we offer? : Internship (curricular practicum) program + Bachelor’s Degree Final Project (TFG).
 Mission: You will prepare a final year training project that will allow you to complete your official studies.
 About practical training:
 6 months of curricular practicum at AIRBUS from February to July 2026
 Part time: 5h / day - 25 hours per week (8h-13h)
 Tutor assignment for continuous monitoring
 Final project (TFG) to be carried out by the student: 
 Develop and apply new CFRP sizing and design methods applied to Rear Fuselage and Empennage Airframe new technologies. 
 Required skills #AirbusDiversity 
 Main Task: The main task consists of analyzing and mapping manufacturing data from diverse streams (design, engineering, and operations). The student will identify improvement opportunities to enhance, standardize, and digitally streamline the department’s processes, supporting data-driven decision-making. 
 Learning & Scope: Student shall acquire deep knowledge of Operations and lean workflows from design definition to final assembly, understanding how digital standardization directly impacts the End-to-End (E2E) efficiency of an Aircraft Final Assembly Line (FAL). 
 Department & Collaboration: Student will work inside the Manufacturing Engineering Dept., acting as a bridge to facilitate communication and drive consensus between stakeholders in Planning, Production Control, and Operations. 
 Focus & Documentation: Analytical mindset and process modeling skills are the main drivers for this position. The objective is to establish robust digital methodologies and document standard operating procedures for future development and continuity. 
 As a successful candidate, you will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:
 Studying Degree in Engineering / IT
 English: Fluent level.
 Skills valued: 
 Communication skills
 Analytical and problem-solving skills
 Team spirit and great collaboration skills
 Ability to work in international environment
 Why should you apply? 
 Foster your development with a strong academic background and an in-depth collaboration in AIRBUS projects.
 Expand your network within the aeronautical industry.
 Meet our people working with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place.
 Be part of our diversity and teamwork culture that propel us to accomplish the extraordinary - on the ground, in the sky and in space.
 Get in touch with the industrial sector at a leading company in Spain
 Are you interested? Apply and make it fly!

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a Materiel Solutions and IP Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).
 The selected candidate will join the Materiel Solutions & Services Team. The department is responsible for researching and analyzing spares planning and logistics data to convert findings into high-value contracts for Initial Provisioning, Customized Spares Logistics, and Customized Lead-Time. In this role, you will support customer process improvements and define robust material solutions across major defense programs, including Eurodrone.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Participate in Eurodrone supplier selection, analyzing material services contributions and part requirements.
 Develop customized spare parts lists (IPL and RSPL) using aircraft configuration systems knowledge to meet Customer and ADS requirements.
 Represent Airbus Defence and Space directly in front of the Customer during Initial Provisioning milestones.
 Generate comprehensive technical and operational documentation to support overall Material Solution definitions.
 Align all Materiel Services functional and performance aspects across internal Airbus teams, Partner Companies, Suppliers, and Nations.
 Consolidate integrated data, cost bases, and assumptions to build precise Bidding Dossiers and enhance Spares Modelling accuracy.
 SKILLS 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you:
 Education: Aeronautical or Industrial Engineering degree or a related discipline.
 Experience: 2 to 5 years of experience in MRO, engineering design, or manufacturing.
 Soft skills: High adaptability to work on new topics, emerging business needs, and in a collaborative networking mode.
 Languages: Advanced level in English (written and spoken).
 Technical knowledge: Strong understanding of aircraft maintenance, technical manuals, and advanced Microsoft Excel.
 Valuable / Nice to have: Experience with spares dimensioning tools and prior knowledge of Airbus Defence & Space products.

 Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year.
 Attractive salary.
 Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting work-life balance.
 Collective transport service in some sites.
 Benefits such as health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.
 On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office.
 Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives.
 Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment.
 Special rates in products & benefits.
