items.desc: Über uns Wir bei Predict42 sind das „AI-First“ B2B-SaaS-Scale-Up hinter dem MIGO Feedback Hub. Wir verwandeln verstreutes Feedback für globale Marktführer in nutzbares Wissen - mit KI als echtem Herzstück unseres Produkts statt als bloßem Trend-Feature. Um unser Wachstum zu skalieren, arbeiten wir in drei fokussierten Streams: Platform (Data & ML), Innovation (Chat & AI) und Web Application (unser MIGO Hub). Deine Mission: Während unser Plattform-Team den KI-Motor im Hintergrund skaliert, übernimmst du die End-to-End-Verantwortung für das primäre, nutzerorientierte Web- und Mobile-SaaS-Produkt, um so aktiv an unserer Erfolgsstory mitzubauen. Deine Aufgaben Product Execution & Delivery: Du übernimmst die volle Ownership für das Web Application Backlog. Du übersetzt High-Level-Roadmaps in umsetzbare, glasklare User Stories und sorgst für einen verlässlichen, agilen Entwicklungsfluss (Sprints, Refinements, Reviews). Design & Frontend Alignment: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem UX-Design-Team zusammen, um intuitive, erstklassige Dashboards zu definieren. Du übersetzt visuelle Designs in funktionale Anforderungen für unsere Entwickler im Flutter-Framework (Erfahrung mit BI-Dashboards und Custom Widgets ist ein riesiges Plus). Data & Feature Logic: Du besitzt ein starkes logisches Verständnis für Datenstrukturen (z. B. wie verschiedene Informationen zusammenhängen). Gemeinsam mit unserem Tech PO stellst du sicher, dass unsere Daten- und API-Strukturen so aufgebaut sind, dass sie die optimalen Features für unsere Nutzer ermöglichen. Interface Management: Du schlägst die Brücke zwischen den Datenservices der Plattform (Core Services, ML-Modelle) und deiner Applikation, welche diese Daten für bahnbrechende User-Features konsumiert. Das bringst du mit Experience: Mindestens 2–3 Jahre fundierte Praxis als Product Owner oder Product Manager in einem dynamischen B2B-SaaS-Umfeld. Technical Foundation: Du hast ein starkes analytisches Verständnis. Du kannst JSON lesen und verstehst Datenbankschemata. AI & Data Literacy: Ein gutes Verständnis für KI-Konzepte – insbesondere Natural Language Processing (NLP) – ist für dich selbstverständlich, da unser Kernwert auf der Analyse von unstrukturiertem Feedback basiert. Analytics Savvy: Du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Metriken und Daten, nicht auf Basis von Annahmen, und nutzt Analytics-Tools sicher. Communication & Language Skills: Du kannst fließend zwischen der Diskussion über „User Value“ (mit Stakeholdern) und „Technischer Implementierung“ (mit Engineers) wechseln. Für unsere DACH-Kundenbasis bringst du verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch mit. Was wir dir bieten Strategic Impact: Du bist der Owner des Haupt-Interfaces für Tausende von Enterprise-Nutzern und beeinflusst direkt deren täglichen Workflow. True Ownership (VSOP): Wir sind alle Mitunternehmer. Über einen dedizierten Mitarbeiter-Share-Pool profitierst du direkt und wirtschaftlich vom Erfolg und Wachstum unseres Unternehmens. Engineering & Product Culture: Eine "Product-First" Organisation ohne endlose Bürokratie. Wir managen technische Schulden proaktiv, damit du dich voll auf das Liefern von echtem User Value konzentrieren kannst. Mentorship: Lerne von einem erfahrenen Management-Team und arbeite Seite an Seite mit unserem CPO Patrick und Senior Engineering Leadern. The Package: Attraktives Gehalt, Erfolgsbeteiligung, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Weiterbildungsbudget, kostenloser Parkplatz in Mainz und regelmäßige Teamevents. Interessiert? Bewirb dich gerne mit deinem Lebenslauf unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung sowie deiner frühestmöglichen Verfügbarkeit direkt über indeed - wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Leistungen: Flexible Arbeitszeiten Gleitzeit Homeoffice-Möglichkeit Kostenlose Getränke Kostenloser Parkplatz Mentoring-Programm für Mitarbeiter Arbeitsort: Zum Teil im Homeoffice in 55122 Mainz

items.desc: Locations : Germany | Austria Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. Practice Area BCG’s Tech and Digital practice area focuses on helping clients deliver competitive advantage and business superior performance through the use of data, technology and digital. Tech and Digital is the fastest growing practice at BCG and at the heart of the strategic impact we have with our clients. Our consultants and experts globally work across all industries and provide deep experience and expertise across a number of topics including Digital Transformation, Data & Digital Platforms, AI at Scale, Agile, Cybersecurity and Digitizing the Tech Function. Our Tech and Digital offer encompasses tech experts across BCG and Platinion, providing seamless multidisciplinary solutions to our clients. What You'll Do Are you passionate about topics such as: Digital Transformation & Strategy Big Data & Analytics Software & Agile Transformation of the Technology Function ERP and Enterprise Systems Transformation Then BCG's Tech & Digital Advantage Practice (TDA) is for you! We are looking for new team members to join our offices in Germany and Austria and support our clients across a variety of industries gain competitive advantage through data, technology, and digital. We operate at the intersection between business and technology, and help our clients think strategically about how technology will change the shape of their business. As a Consultant, you will: Take end-to-end responsibility for larger and more complex "modules" within a BCG project, developing specialized knowledge to help solve our clients' problems Work on a variety of digital topics, ranging from ERP and enterprise systems transformations to data platforms and AI, applying generalist consulting skills to strategic digital & technology questions Partner with clients to understand their issues, create strategies for change, and win buy-in for your recommendations Collaborate with fellow BCGers as an integral part of BCG's core consulting team, working side-by-side with practice areas to create value and competitive advantage for clients You'll help your clients answer questions such as: "How will AI disrupt my business model?" "How can businesses use data and analytics to create personalized outreach delivered through a seamless omnichannel experience?" "How can I ship higher digital services to my customers faster by using agile?" "How can we modernize our core ERP and enterprise systems landscape to enable faster, data-driven decision-making?" ...and many more. Pair daily with product and design; turn ambiguous problems into shippable increments. Build scalable services, APIs, data pipelines, and frontends; instrument, observe, and optimize them in prod. Own the solution. Reliability, scalability, performance, availability. Work directly with the clients: clarify requirements, validate solutions, and close the loop. Fast. Document clearly and present effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Required Skills Senior-level expertise in designing, engineering, and implementing large-scale solutions. Up to 30 days PTO; public holidays (location-based); high-end laptop + tools; learning budget; extensive AI tooling. Fully remote from the EU, the UK or the US, with occasional travel. FAQ Remote? Process evangelists, architecture astronauts, meeting enthusiasts, or anyone needing constant supervision. Equal Opportunity We’re an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate only on the ability to ship great software.

items.desc: Job Title: Associate Scientist – Cell Culture Department: SBT Grange Castle Position Reports to: Senior Manager, Process Centric Team Lead What You Will Achieve As an Associate Scientist, you will support scientific and technical activities within Pfizer's Sterile Injectables and Biotech Technology (SBT) portfolio while developing laboratory, process and analytical expertise. You will: Support execution of laboratory studies supporting commercial manufacturing, technology transfer, process characterisation, lifecycle management and development programmes. Generate, document and organise experimental data in support of technical and business objectives. Apply scientific knowledge to support routine technical investigations and laboratory activities. Contribute as a member of multidisciplinary project teams. Perform laboratory operations in accordance with Pfizer safety, quality and compliance requirements. Support senior scientists with execution of experimental programmes and technical activities. Assist with laboratory organisation, equipment management and documentation activities. Support continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory. Develop technical knowledge across Pfizer's Sterile Injectables and Biotech Technology (SBT) platforms, specifically mammalian cell culture processes. Build scientific, technical and problem-solving skills through coaching, training and practical laboratory experience. How You Will Achieve It Pfizer's Sterile Injectables and Biotech Technology portfolio comprises multiple approaches for the creation of effective biotherapeutics. This laboratory-based role supports experimental programmes associated with commercial products and development assets. The Associate Scientist will perform laboratory work, generate technical data and support development and manufacturing technology activities. You will: Support execution of laboratory studies related to process characterisation, technology transfer, process optimisation and lifecycle management activities. Conduct laboratory experiments safely and efficiently while meeting quality and compliance requirements. Generate, document and organise experimental data using established scientific methods. Prepare technical summaries and documentation under guidance from senior colleagues. Support troubleshooting activities and technical investigations through data generation and laboratory support. Collaborate with analytical, manufacturing, quality and technology colleagues to support programme objectives. Maintain laboratory equipment, materials and documentation in accordance with approved procedures. Participate in scientific discussions and technical problem-solving activities. Support implementation of new technologies, automation tools and digital laboratory capabilities. Contribute to continuous improvement activities that enhance laboratory effectiveness and efficiency. Maintain awareness of scientific and technical developments relevant to assigned activities. Support inspection readiness and compliance activities as required. Qualifications: Must have Education/Experience: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or related discipline. 0-2+ years of directly relevant experience in the biopharmaceutical industry. Technical Requirements Foundational knowledge of biotechnology, biologics manufacturing, biochemistry, cell biology, chemistry or related scientific disciplines. Exposure to academic, research or industrial laboratory environments. Understanding of basic experimental design and laboratory techniques. Ability to generate, document and organise scientific data. Strong attention to detail and organisational skills. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams. Understanding of laboratory safety principles and quality requirements. Demonstrated initiative, learning agility and scientific curiosity. Nice-to-Have Industrial placement or internship experience within the biopharmaceutical industry. Exposure to mammalian cell culture, downstream processing. Familiarity with GMP-regulated environments. Experience using laboratory digital systems and data management tools. Basic knowledge of statistical analysis techniques. Experience supporting laboratory investigations or improvement initiatives. Work Location Assignment: On Premise We will only accept applications from colleagues via the formal route within Workday. Competitive Salary Private Medical Allowance for Yourself Competitive Contributory Pension Scheme Employee Share Acquisition Plan Internal Mobility Opportunities, Mentorships & Access To Projects Globally Employee Assistance Programme Generous Employee Referral Scheme 25 Days Annual Leave Plus Bank Holidays Company Car More about us ABB Robotics Business area provides robotics, and machine and factory automation including products, software, solutions and services. Revenues are generated both from direct sales to end users as well as from indirect sales mainly through system integrators and machine builders. www.abb.com/robotics Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world. Run What Runs the World. #RunwithABB #ABBCareers We value people from different backgrounds. items.desc: We're looking for someone for evenings and weekends: one weekday evening and two shifts at the weekend. Revival is a float centre and sauna in Raheen. Ideally you already work in wellness, in a spa, salon, gym, yoga studio or therapy room. We want someone trustworthy, interested in self-development and growth, with a passion for the wellness/holistic industry and helping people. If you're detail-oriented and a bit of a perfectionist, you'll flourish here. We have many rooms and there's always something to be done. The job combines customer service with a lot of cleaning, tidying and looking after our clients. We have a friendly, positive, growth-focused work environment, with opportunities for advancement within the company. The pay is €14.50 an hour, with free use of our facilities. Your duties will include (full training provided): Front desk customer service: answering phones, emails and web chat, booking appointments, taking payments Coaching first-timers on how to float Cleaning and maintaining the float rooms and float tanks, inside and out Deep cleaning, changing filters, floor drains, topping up water and salt, and checking pH, H2O2, buoyancy and water levels so every float is sparkling clean Closing the centre and having it fully ready for the morning floats Helping with our online shop: packing orders, adding new products to our Shopify store and keeping stock counts right Creating and scheduling social media posts with Canva and Buffer Essential Person Characteristics Free one weekday evening and for two shifts every weekend Fluent spoken and written English: you'll be explaining floating to first-timers, answering phones and web chat, and often running the centre on your own Responsible enough to work alone, with little to no supervision Attention to detail Kind, caring, warm and friendly with clients Great communication skills Sees what needs doing and gets it done without being asked The shifts: one weekday evening (until we close, around 10pm) and two shifts at the weekend, about 15 hours a week in all. Extra hours covering holidays and summer if you want them. For the right person there is a chance to grow into a supervisor or manager role. Once you're competent and willing to take on more, promotion and pay increases will follow. Good, But Not Required Experience (full training provided) Work in a spa, salon, gym, yoga studio or therapy room Online retail or Shopify experience Time floating, or a meditation or yoga practice Time maintaining float tanks, pools or spas Evening shift, cleaning or hospitality experience To show you've read the whole ad, please put the phrase "Floating towards wellness" at the top of your application. Job Type: Part-time Pay: From €14.50 per hour Expected hours: 15.0 per week Benefits: Employee discount Ability to commute/relocate: Raheen, County Limerick: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required) Application question(s): This job is one weekday evening and two shifts every weekend. Can you do that, and which weekday evening suits you best? Tell us about any work you've done in wellness (spa, salon, gym, yoga, therapy) or online retail (Shopify, packing orders, product listings). Do you feel like you are responsible enough to work alone, with little to no supervision? How would you describe your spoken English: fluent, good, or still learning? Language: English (required) Work Location: In person

items.desc: About us At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future. At Davy, you are the difference. Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors. Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally. An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Adviser to join Davy's newly established nationwide Affluent business. The Affluent Private Client Adviser team supports clients with increasingly complex financial needs who require ongoing financial planning and advice to build, protect, and transfer wealth. This is a unique opportunity to help build a next-generation wealth proposition that combines personalised financial advice with market-leading digital tools and client experiences. Working with a diverse portfolio of affluent clients, you will help individuals, families and corporates work through bespoke financial planning led investment, protection and pension journeys. Unlike traditional private client advisory roles, this position operates within a technology-enabled advice model, allowing advisers to focus more of their time on client engagement, financial planning and business development. Advisers will utilise advanced digital financial planning and client engagement tools to deliver high-quality advice at scale while playing an active role in shaping the future evolution of the proposition. The successful candidate will: Build trusted relationships with affluent clients, understanding their financial objectives, personal circumstances and long-term goals. Convert referral opportunities into new business through effective advice conversations and relationship management. Deliver holistic financial advice across investments, pensions, retirement and protection solutions. Develop and present financial plans using Davy's digital financial planning platform and client engagement tools. Eventually manage a portfolio of approximately 300 clients, ensuring clients receive an appropriate level of proactive service and advice. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients through referrals and lead generation opportunities. Partner closely with Bank of Ireland, Davy and wider Group colleagues to maximise referral opportunities and deliver joined-up client outcomes. Identify opportunities to deepen client relationships and broaden the range of solutions provided to clients. Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of the Affluent proposition by providing feedback on client journeys, advice processes and technology capabilities. Support the development of a scalable and efficient operating model as the business grows. Work collaboratively with product, proposition, technology and operations teams to improve client and adviser experiences. Ensure all activities are carried out in accordance with regulatory requirements, Davy's Risk Management Framework and internal policies. Take ownership of client outcomes and proactively resolve issues while identifying opportunities to improve processes and service delivery. What Will Make You Stand Out? ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. Job Description Job Title: Shift Supervisor Location: Limerick Job Summary: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Shift Supervisor to join our team within the Equipment department. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing technician schedules, ensuring safety protocols are followed, and overseeing equipment maintenance activities. This role requires strong leadership skills, attention to detail, and the ability to respond effectively to emergencies. The applicant will understand and execute the key Business Objectives associated with the role under the headings of Safety, Quality, Output, and Value for Money. Key Responsibilities: Team Management: Manage technician holidays and shift coverage. Conduct 1:1 reviews with team members. Carry out performance discussions. Liaise with the training coordinator to create and improve training plans for team members. Maintain training records and ensure compliance with STAR and other training requirements. Conduct interviews for new technicians. Safety Management: Serve as a member of the Emergency Response Team (ERT). Respond to ERT alerts and safety concerns across the fab, subfab, and mezzanine. Complete incident reports. Manage work permits, including approval and gas/fire sensor isolation. Equipment Maintenance: Oversee fab equipment activities. Attend manufacturing bunker meetings and liaise with the production supervisor on equipment priorities. Document shift handover reports. Coordinate maintenance work with external contractors and facilities groups. Manage preventive maintenance (PM) task lists across workcentres. Initiate escalations and call-outs for critical equipment issues. Scrap ownership, investigation, and diagnosis. Work closely with the Equipment Engineering & Days/Evenings Technicians to meet & exceed the Department & Site KPIs. Performance Management: Achieve shift and departmental KPIs, including Shift Activity, MTTR, MTBF, Tool Availability, and Costs. Manage cover and overtime budgets. Manage daily on-shift activities, prioritize and allocate resources effectively for PMs and UMs. Required Skills & Competencies: A strong base knowledge of the complex activities and interactions involved across cleanroom operations. Recognised technical expertise. The ability to influence reports in a positive and enthusiastic manner. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Demonstrated problem-solving knowledge, skills, and execution. items.desc: Trasforma le tue aspirazioni professionali in una storia di successo, entra in PwC come: Regulatory Risk Associate Your Perspectives Il team Risk Capital & Reporting affianca i clienti finanziari nella gestione integrata dei rischi e del capitale, combinando competenze quantitative, regolamentari e di reporting, con focus su capital management, framework di Risk Governance, analisi degli impatti normativi sul business e sviluppo di soluzioni per il monitoraggio e la misurazione dei rischi. In particolare, all’interno del nostro team prenderai parte a progetti in ambito Regulatory Risk e Capital Management, supportando primari gruppi bancari nell’evoluzione dei propri framework di gestione integrata dei rischi e del capitale. Entrando nel nostro team avrai l’opportunità di: Supportare l’evoluzione dei framework di Risk Governance, contribuendo all’analisi dei rischi e alla definizione di metriche, soglie e processi di monitoraggio. Partecipare a progetti di Recovery & Resolution Planning, affiancando i clienti nell’adeguamento alle aspettative regolamentari, nella preparazione alle ispezioni e nel confronto con le Autorità di Vigilanza. Contribuire a progettualità di Capital Management, tra cui Capital Planning, Capital Allocation supportando l’analisi dell’adeguatezza patrimoniale e degli impatti delle scelte di business sul capitale. Supportare l’integrazione tra pianificazione, budgeting e gestione dei rischi, sviluppando analisi sulle principali dinamiche economiche, finanziarie e patrimoniali degli intermediari. Contribuire allo sviluppo di metodologie e strumenti di analisi, monitoraggio e reporting, anche attraverso soluzioni data-driven, automazione e intelligenza artificiale. Your unique strengths Hai conseguito una laurea in Economia, Finanza, Banca e Intermediari Finanziari o discipline affini. Hai maturato da 1 a 3 anni di esperienza in primarie società di consulenza, istituzioni finanziarie o realtà bancarie, preferibilmente su tematiche di Risk Management, con focus sui processi di Risk Governance, Recovery & Resolution, Budgeting e Capital Management Possiedi una buona conoscenza delle principali logiche di gestione dei rischi bancari. Hai familiarità con le principali componenti del bilancio bancario e con le logiche sottostanti alla composizione e gestione del capitale. Hai un’ottima conoscenza del Pacchetto Office, in particolare Excel e PowerPoint, e costituisce titolo preferenziale la conoscenza di SAS. Parli e scrivi in inglese fluentemente. Sei unə team worker, hai buone capacità analitiche e possiedi ottime doti relazionali e comunicative. Set your expectation higher PwC ti sorprenderà con un’opportunità di carriera che ti farà sentire al centro della società, dell’innovazione e del cambiamento. Il talento e la curiosità avranno tutto lo spazio che meritano e contribuirai a garantire la qualità dei servizi che offriamo al nostro interno. In questo percorso di crescita ti supporterà un team esperto e avrai una formazione continua e su misura grazie alla quale potrai mettere le tue competenze a disposizione della clientela interna. Feel at home Ci prendiamo cura delle nostre persone, abbracciando le diversità e creando valore per la clientela, le persone e la comunità, nel rispetto dell'ambiente. items.desc: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: €38.400,00 - €52.800,00 Location: Treviso,ITA You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors. We are looking for a PLC Software Develope r to design, develop, and maintain software solutions for industrial automation systems and semiconductor equipment. This role combines PLC programming with object-oriented software development, offering hands-on experience in installation, configuration, and troubleshooting while collaborating with global teams to deliver high-quality projects. Key Responsibilities Design, prototype, and develop moderately complex software solutions for industrial automation and semiconductor equipment. Develop and maintain PLC software applications (preferred: TwinCAT – Beckhoff). Create common software modules and libraries for use across multiple products. Prepare software documentation and test procedures. Support commissioning and troubleshooting activities on-site. Communicate with internal and external stakeholders for requirements analysis, project scheduling, and software troubleshooting. Analyze and resolve software issues; design and implement bug fixes. Collaborate with global teams to ensure smooth project execution. Required Skills Post Diploma ITS with related experience or University Degree in Computer Science, Software/System Engineering, Automation, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Mathematics, or related field. English proficiency: Fluent in speaking and writing. Solid knowledge of PLC programming languages (preferred: TwinCAT – Beckhoff). Proficiency in C/C++, .NET, C#, operating systems, networking principles, algorithms, and multi-threading. Willingness to travel frequently national and international. Hands-on attitude and ability to work directly with tools and hardware. Preferred Qualifications Basic understanding of object-oriented programming principles. Familiarity with industrial automation concepts and drive systems. Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics. Knowledge of high-level programming languages (C++, C#) is a plus. Strong conceptual understanding of software engineering and eagerness to learn. Soft Skills Strong problem-solving skills and critical thinking. Effective communication and collaboration in interna Workplace : Applied Materials Italia - Olmi di San Biagio di Callalta (TV) - Office based. items.desc: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Mollie has an important role and responsibility in the financial ecosystem, handling customer funds with a high degree of diligence and scrutiny. The financial services domain sits at the core of Mollie, it orchestrates all money movements to power all of Mollie's financial products. Analytics engineering plays an important role in this ecosystem, as these core financial processes handle massive, complex volumes of data originating from different internal systems. By establishing robust data pipelines, maintaining automated data quality checks, and fostering deep collaboration with cross functional partners in Engineering and Treasury & Merchant Finance, the Analytics Engineering team ensures full data integrity and enables the daily reconciliation of Mollie's books. You will be working on creating and maintaining critical data assets that enable Mollie to reconcile their books. This involves creating and maintaining solid dbt data models from raw source data to consumable mart tables. You will play a part in creating and maintaining tooling to visualize and report the required data, mostly in our BI tooling that makes it easy for the end user to extract the required data. To do this, you will be working closely with engineers to understand the inner workings of Mollie's money movements and, most importantly, get the correct data. You will also be collaborating with Merchant Finance & Treasury to make sure they can do daily reconciliation in our BI tooling. What you'll ship Build and maintain dbt data models, from raw source data to consumable mart tables, powering dashboards that monitor critical payment metrics and track payment method performance across the Payments domain Build and maintain BI tooling that makes it easy for end users to visualize and extract the data they need Work closely with engineers to understand how Mollie's money movements work and make sure the data is correct. Partner with stakeholders across Merchant Finance, Treasury, and the Payments domain to define and track key financial data, and enable daily reconciliation Create compelling data visualisations and narratives that communicate your findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, through presentations, reports, and memos Implement data quality validation checks, testing frameworks, and proactive monitoring to ensure high trust in the data used for analysis and decision making Contribute to a culture of technical rigour and data literacy by mentoring team members on analytics best practices and keeping documentation well organised and accessible What you'll bring Strong technical foundation in SQL and Python; experience with data modelling and automation Strong experience with cbt; additional experience in BigQuery/GCP and Airflow is a plus Ability to zoom out and to zoom in to support implementation, often on the same day Skilled at stakeholder management, especially across technical and non-technical teams Experience in financial data and financial processes is a big plus Business-aware, impact-driven, and curious Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. items.desc: NHOA Energy designs, delivers and services Battery Energy Storage Systems for utility-scale and industrial applications worldwide, based on proprietary technology. We operate through four regional hubs: Milan for EMEA, Houston for the Americas, Perth for Australia Pacific, Taipei for Asia. Our western power electronics secures performance, guarantees absolute cybersecurity and enables optimized system sizing, while our preferential Asian access offers a reliable, competitive, quality-assured battery supply. World-class engineering and grid integration and forming expertise, coupled with local construction and commissioning capabilities, make for a bankable turnkey delivery platform. NHOA Energy’s service platform combines global best practice with client proximity, enabling a tailored offering. Posizione: NHOA Energy is looking for an Electrical Engineer to join our Design Engineering team! In this role, you will contribute to the design and engineering of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) , working on innovative projects that support the energy transition. You will be involved throughout the engineering process, from product development and technical proposals to detailed design, testing and project execution, collaborating with R&D, Project Execution and multidisciplinary engineering teams. What you’ll do Design and develop electrical systems for BESS projects, including AC/DC systems, MV and LV distribution, auxiliary systems and grounding. Contribute to the design of HV substations and grid connection infrastructure. Perform electrical calculations and studies, including cable sizing, short-circuit analysis, protection coordination and arc flash assessments. Support technical proposals, product development and project execution, from detailed engineering to Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT). Collaborate with R&D, Mechanical, Software and Control teams to ensure seamless system integration. Interface with suppliers, contractors and consultants, providing technical support during manufacturing, installation and site activities. Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal engineering standards, design tools and best practices. Requisiti: What we’re looking for MSc in Electrical Engineering. At least 3 years of experience in electrical design and engineering of MV/LV power generation and distribution systems. Solid knowledge of international electrical standards, regulations and industry practices. Proficiency in electrical engineering software such as ETAP, EPLAN, Integra, Cableizer, Dehn or Dialux. Good knowledge of 2D CAD tools (AutoCAD, DraftSight or similar). Experience working with suppliers and managing technical interfaces. Good communication skills in both English and Italian. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. Availability for occasional short business trips, mainly within Italy (typically less than one week). ➕ Nice to have Experience in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) or renewable energy projects. Familiarity with HV substations, grid connection systems and electrical protection studies. Experience supporting electrical equipment manufacturing, FAT or on-site installation activities. Altre informazioni: Location : Hybrid remote and Milan Offices. items.desc: Do you enjoy working with cutting-edge technology? Would you like to help shape the future of our global energy? Join our Team! Our Industrial & Energy Technology (IET) team provides industry-leading products and services that optimize the extraction, production and processing of energy. We help a diverse range of customers across the value chain to reduce operating costs and improve productivity. Our team is responsible for the assembly of high-quality and innovative products. Partner with the best As Production Controller , you will be responsible for: Deploying the master production plan into detailed execution schedules, ensuring alignment with customer demand and operational priorities. Preparing, managing, and continuously updating production schedules to optimize resource utilization and meet fulfillment targets. Monitoring production progress, identifying deviations, and driving corrective actions to maintain schedule adherence. Coordinating with Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, Logistics, Quality, and Engineering to ensure material availability and smooth production flow. Managing production priorities, balancing workload, and resolving capacity constraints to maximize throughput. Leading daily production reviews and driving recovery plans for critical shortages, bottlenecks, and overdue orders. Overseeing Work-In-Process (WIP) levels and inventory performance, supporting actions to improve inventory turns and reduce lead times. Ensuring operational alignment with production plans, business priorities, and key plant performance indicators. Driving continuous improvement initiatives focused on planning processes, operational efficiency, productivity, and delivery performance. Maintaining accurate system data and production records to support planning accuracy and manufacturing traceability. Supporting Farm-In and Farm-Out activities when required, coordinating external suppliers and internal stakeholders to achieve fulfillment commitments. Complying with company policies and processes, including Quality, EHS, Compliance, HR, Lean Manufacturing, and Operational Excellence. Fuel your passion To be successful in this role you will: Have a Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college, or equivalent experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, or Manufacturing. Demonstrate experience in Production Planning, Production Control, Manufacturing Operations, or Supply Chain Management. Be able to work independently, prioritize multiple activities, and drive process improvements. Show strong analytical and problem-solving skills in a dynamic manufacturing environment. Demonstrate the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams in a matrix organization. Be proficient in ERP/MRP systems and advanced Microsoft Office applications. Have strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Be fluent in Italian, both written and spoken. Desired Characteristics Strong oral and written communication skills in English. Strong interpersonal, leadership, and influencing skills. Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate analysis into operational actions. Ability to manage changing priorities while maintaining focus on customer commitments. Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence. Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, and other productivity tools. Experience with production scheduling, capacity planning, inventory management, and fulfillment processes. Work in a way that works for you We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other. items.desc: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. Let's build together. Your impact Mollie has an important role and responsibility in the financial ecosystem, handling customer funds with a high degree of diligence and scrutiny. The financial services domain sits at the core of Mollie, it orchestrates all money movements to power all of Mollie's financial products. Analytics engineering plays an important role in this ecosystem, as these core financial processes handle massive, complex volumes of data originating from different internal systems. To do this, you will be working closely with engineers to understand the inner workings of Mollie's money movements and, most importantly, get the correct data. You will also be collaborating with Merchant Finance & Treasury to make sure they can do daily reconciliation in our BI tooling. Vi søker derfor etter nye forskere. Hos oss kombinerer du det beste fra akademia og næringslivet. Du vil ikke bare bruke algoritmene i spennende oppdrag, du får også muligheten til å utvikle dem og forstå dem til bunns. Vi jobber med alt fra mer tradisjonell statistisk modellering og maskinlæring til noe av det nyeste innen dyp læring/kunstig intelligens. Om stillingene og kvalifikasjoner Vi søker to forskere med master- eller doktorgrad i maskinlæring eller lignende. Du må ha dyp faglig forståelse, evne til metodisk nyutvikling og helst noen års erfaring etter utdannelsen. Det siste gjelder spesielt dem som ikke har doktorgrad. Stillingene ligger i forskningsavdelingen «Statistisk modellering og maskinlæring» med cirka 30 forskere. Vi jobber med mange typer data, fra tabelldata og tidsrekker til nettverksdata, sensormålinger og språkdata. Du må være genuint interessert i både metodeutvikling og anvendt forskning, der vi løser konkrete utfordringer for kunder og partnere. Ved siden av å være faglig sterk, må du være god til å programmere og interessert i nye utviklingsverktøy, også KI-baserte. Norsk er det primære arbeidsspråket i avdelingen og i møte med mange av våre kunder og samarbeidspartnere. Det er derfor ønskelig at du enten behersker norsk eller er villig til å lære det relativt raskt. Hva vi jobber med Våre forskere får muligheten til å arbeide med mange ulike metoder, prosjekter, kunder og samarbeidspartnere, og vi jobber med anvendelser innen et bredt spekter av områder, inkludert finans, forsikring, teknologi, industri, helse, marin, klima og miljø. Vi utvikler for eksempel risikomodeller for banker og forsikringsselskaper, metoder for tallfesting av konsekvenser av klimaendringer og ekstremvær, prognoser for kraftpriser, metoder for deteksjon av anomalier i tidsrekker, modeller for spredning av lakselus mellom oppdrettsanlegg, kunstig intelligens mot algoritmisk prissamarbeid og metoder for ansvarlig og forklarbar kunstig intelligens. Vår hverdag er variert, utfordrende og spennende. Vi samarbeider nært med fagfolk hos de ulike kundene og samarbeidspartnerne våre. Prosjektene er stort sett finansiert av private bedrifter, offentlige virksomheter, Norges forskningsråd eller EU-kommisjonen. Arbeidsoppgaver Avhengig av din erfaring, interesse og kompetanse, kan stillingene inneholde elementer av alle oppgaver på et forskningsinstitutt: prosjektarbeid, prosjektledelse, markedsføring, nettverksbygging, søknadsskriving og akademisk publisering. Har du spesiell interesse for eller erfaring med å bygge opp et oppdragsmarked, for eksempel fra et annet forskningsinstitutt eller konsulentbransjen, ønsker vi at du fremhever det i søknaden. Norsk Regnesentral holder til i Kristen Nygaards hus ved Forskningsparken på Blindern i Oslo. Tiltredelse etter avtale. Søknaden skal inneholde søknadsbrev, CV, vitnemål og karakterutskrifter fra din høyere utdanning og attester. Ta gjerne kontakt med en av våre forskningssjefer for mer informasjon. items.desc: Location: Wroclaw, Poland Seniority: Middle Technologies: Data Our partner is one of the largest retail e-commerce companies in North America, serving millions of customers each year and ensuring a secure and seamless shopping experience across digital and in‑store channels. We are looking for skilled and motivated engineer Data engineer to join the innovative team. The Orchestration team manages platforms within Insights Delivery Technology organization and offers self-service solutions designed to empower engineers, data scientists, and analysts to seamlessly perform ETL/ELT operations on data from diverse sources such as Kafka, S3, GCS, BigQuery, and Postgres, and write processed data back to these sources via batch or real-time processes. Increasingly, the team also owns the metadata, governance, and data-lineage layer that makes this data discoverable and trustworthy across the company. As an Orchestration Team Engineer, you will play a critical role in developing and maintaining this robust platform, ensuring that users can efficiently extract actionable insights without being burdened by the complexities of big data technologies. Your work will enable the client to scale its operations while keeping technical demands on non-engineering staff to a minimum. Platform Development: Evolve, design, and maintain our orchestration platforms which aim to abstract the complexities of big data technologies and simplify ETL/ELT operations for users Platform Support: Perform ongoing production support and on-call support duties. Work with both onsite and offshore resources daily to resolve incidents and issues. Infrastructure as Code: Provision and manage cloud data infrastructure declaratively with Terraform, delivering self-service platform capabilities through automated, version-controlled pipelines. Integration: Develop seamless connectivity to diverse data sources and destinations, ensuring high performance and reliability. Data Governance & Metadata: Build and operate metadata, cataloging, and data-lineage capabilities that make data across Nordstrom discoverable, trustworthy, and well-governed — including integrations across transformation, streaming, BI, and ML platforms. Scalability: Design solutions that are scalable and resilient, capable of handling large data volumes, high velocity, and diverse data formats. Innovation: Stay up-to-date with emerging big data, ETL, and AI-assisted tooling, incorporating them into the framework as needed to enhance functionality and user experience. Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, ensuring users can easily understand and utilize the framework Experience building, developing, and maintaining data platforms, particularly self-service platforms that enable engineering teams, data scientists, and analysts to configure and manage data processing workflows with minimal manual intervention. Proficiency in SQL (e.g., BigQuery). Solid understanding of ETL/ELT processes, data pipeline architecture, and modern transformation frameworks such as dbt. Strong programming skills in Python, with the ability to build and maintain CLIs, services, and automation. Experience with cloud data platforms, primarily GCP (BigQuery, Dataproc Serverless, GCS); AWS experience a plus. Experience with Infrastructure as Code — particularly Terraform — for provisioning and managing cloud data infrastructure. Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines with Airflow and Kubernetes. Experience with streaming / event data using Kafka (e.g., Confluent Cloud). Working understanding of data governance concepts — metadata management, data cataloging, and data lineage. Familiarity with CI/CD and Git-based workflows (GitHub Actions) for platform and pipeline delivery. Proficiency with AI-assisted developer tooling — LLMs, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and "copilot"-style productivity tools — and a track record of using them to work more effectively. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment. Nice to Have Hands-on experience with a metadata / data-catalog / lineage platform such as DataHub (or Collibra, Amundsen, or similar). Experience with BI / semantic-layer tools such as Looker / LookML. Experience with data quality, observability, SLOs / error budgets, and on-call operations for data platforms. Familiarity with distributed processing frameworks such as Spark; Java / Scala a plus. Benefits: Paid Vacation Sick Days Sport/Insurance Compensation English Classes Charity Training Compensation

The financial ranges specified in the announcement are adjusted and may differ from the range specified in the remuneration regulations. At ING we value and support our employees before recruiting external talent. If you think this vacancy is the right next step in your ING career, we’d encourage you to apply. Should you have questions about the vacancy or need to hear more before you feel you can apply. We are looking for you if: You are passionate about quantitative risk modelling, have 3+ years of experience and want to shape the future of credit risk management in a leading international banking group. You have academic or professional experience in statistics, econometrics, data science, or financial engineering. You are familiar with regulatory frameworks such as Basel (AIRB) and IFRS9, or eager to learn and grow in this space. You enjoy working in diverse, cross-functional teams and thrive in a collaborative, international environment. You are comfortable with programming languages such as SAS, Python or R, and have experience (or interest) in working with large datasets. You communicate clearly, document thoroughly and enjoy collaborating in agile squads. You'll get extra points for: Hands-on experience in developing, monitoring, or validating AIRB or IFRS9 models. Knowledge of banking portfolios (retail, corporate, SME, etc.) and credit risk models’ lifecycle. Familiarity with regulatory expectations from ECB, EBA, or local supervisors. Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Professional certifications such as FRM, PRM or CFA. Your responsibilities: Depending on your seniority level, you will: Specialists : Contribute to model design, coding, and testing; participate in regulatory submissions and internal reviews. Senior Specialist : Lead monitoring of AIRB/IFRS9 models and development of model parameters, coordinate with validation and audit teams, ensure compliance with regulatory standards. Experts : Lead development of AIRB/IFRS9 models, mentor junior staff, represent the team in regulatory discussions. Senior Experts : Lead complex projects, engage with senior stakeholders across risk, finance, and compliance. Information about the team: The Retail Credit Risk Model Development team is a center of expertise within ING Group, responsible for the development, enhancement and monitoring of regulatory and accounting models across multiple jurisdictions and portfolios. We are transitioning from project-based setup to portfolio-oriented team, enabling deep collaboration with local entities across the Group. This structure offers a unique opportunity to work on international projects, gain exposure to diverse asset classes and model types and specialize in specific portfolios – making a tangible impact on the broader risk management function. We work closely with business units, model validation, and regulatory affairs to ensure our models are robust, compliant, and fit-for-purpose. We value diversity, curiosity, and continuous learning. Whether you're just starting your career or bringing years of experience, we offer a supportive environment where you can grow and make a real impact. We work in a hybrid model. You’re always welcome to join us in our state-of-the-art Warsaw office whenever you prefer. The role naming convention in the global ING job architecture will be Model Developer II / III / IV or V. items.desc: Do you want to help shape how risk decisions are made at some of the highest levels of a major European bank? As a Governance Officer in our Governance & Reporting PL team, you will keep decision-makers informed and well-prepared, contributing to a risk management framework that builds trust with customers and society alike. What you will be doing: You will join a small, collaborative team that acts as the secretariat for more than ten All-Risk and Product Governance Committees and Product Decision-Desks . Working as part of Business Controls & Product Management, the first line of defense, you will build relationships across Large Corporates & Institutions, Business Customers, Personal Customers, the Finland, Norway and Sweden Branches, and seven product domains. Your work connects daily governance tasks to Danske Bank's Forward '28 Strategy and its broader contribution to society. More specifically, you will: Plan and facilitate committee meetings, build risk-driven agendas, and document decisions accurately. Support adherence to the Group Internal Governance Policy within the first line of defense. Contribute to an aligned risk management agenda across business segments, country branches, and product domains. Improve the integration of digital tools into how governance forums are run. Develop process enhancements that move the risk agenda forward at senior management level. About you: At least two years of experience in risk, compliance, governance, or a related field. Degree in law, political science, economics, finance, business, or a related subject . Experience navigating decisions through delegated authorities and committee structures in a large organization. Familiarity with operational risk or Enterprise Risk Management frameworks. Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to facilitate and understand nuanced committee discussions. Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple workstreams. Experience in the financial sector or another regulated industry is a distinct advantage, as is experience in a corporate secretariat role. Fluency in a Scandinavian language and experience using AI tools to improve productivity are also welcome. What We Offer: At Danske Bank, we promote a collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diversity and encourages personal and professional growth. Our office premises in Warsaw are attractive and inspiring, and you have the flexibility to work from home 1-2 days a week. Are you ready for the next step? If you are interested in this position, we encourage you to apply by 9 November . For more information, please contact Michael Anker Kristensen | LinkedIn . We review applications on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Join us in shaping the future of risk management at Danske Bank.

items.desc: The Practical Detail Location: Warsaw, Poland Working model: Hybrid Why this role matters In your first year, you will activate global nutrition science materials locally, ensuring they resonate with healthcare professionals and consumers in Poland. This role is essential for translating complex nutrition science into clear, relevant guidance that supports product development and communication. You will be the trusted nutrition expert on the ground, connecting global strategies with local market needs. Your work will help Flora Food Group deliver better food that meets real nutritional needs and builds trust in our brand. What you'll do Activate and adapt global nutrition strategies and communication materials for the Polish market, ensuring local relevance and compliance. Monitor local nutrition science developments, media, and competitor activities to provide timely insights to the global nutrition team. Build strong partnerships with marketing, sales, and communications teams to become the go-to nutrition expert locally. Deliver internal nutrition education and training to enhance team knowledge and capability. Support Healthcare Professional programmes by preparing scientific content and evidence summaries. Performance You will own the local execution of global nutrition science initiatives, ensuring consistent application of nutrition standards and evidence-based communication. Your data-driven insights and proactive approach will improve decision-making and strengthen our market position. Success will be measured by the effective local activation of nutrition materials, stakeholder engagement, and the quality of nutrition guidance provided. Care This role reports to the global nutrition team and works closely with cross-functional teams including marketing, sales, communications, regulatory affairs, and product development. You will foster collaboration and accountability, ensuring nutrition science is applied responsibly and sustainably. Your long-term focus will help build a trusted nutrition foundation that supports both consumer health and business growth. Passion As a food lover and nutrition enthusiast, you will bring curiosity and energy to translating nutrition science into practical, consumer-friendly messages. You will stay ahead of emerging nutrition trends and innovations, helping Flora Food Group raise the bar in taste, nutrition, and functionality. Your passion for better food will inspire both internal teams and external partners. About you You hold a Master's degree in Nutrition or a related qualification and are a Registered Dietitian or equivalent. You are fluent in Polish and preferably bring experience working with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in Poland, with a solid understanding of the local HCP landscape and how these networks operate. You bring practical experience in applied nutrition science, ideally within the food industry or fast-moving consumer goods. You are confident in analysing nutrition data, applying nutrition standards, and navigating claims frameworks. You communicate complex science clearly to diverse audiences and work independently with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. You build strong relationships and manage stakeholders firmly yet collaboratively. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences. Where this could lead to This role offers a clear path to becoming a Senior Nutritionist or moving into cross functional roles locally. There is also potential for mobility within the global nutrition team, allowing you to broaden your impact and expertise over time. What's next If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you. Apply before: 02-Nov-2026 For questions about the role, please contact: Elif Kocoglu elif.kocoglu@florafg.com We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias. No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.

Reporting to the Senior GRC Manager, the role is responsible for translating security requirements into practical, risk-based controls and driving their consistent adoption across both central services and decentralised environments. The position acts as a key link between Group Information Security, central platform teams and OpCos, ensuring that security standards, risk management practices, and compliance requirements are effectively implemented and embedded across the organisation. This role plays a critical part in reducing cyber risk at scale, enabling a consistent security posture while respecting the operational realities of a federated, multi-country business. Key Tasks and Responsibilities In this role, you will: Develop and maintain cyber security policies, standards, and control frameworks, ensuring alignment with CRH Group requirements and applicability across both central platforms (UnITy) and OpCo-managed environments. Drive consistent adoption of security standards across central technology services and OpCos, balancing global governance with local implementation models. Provide risk-based guidance across both centrally delivered services and decentralised OpCo environments (e.g. IAM, network, endpoint, vulnerability management). Perform and support cyber risk assessments across UnITy platforms and OpCos, maintaining risk registers and tracking remediation to reduce enterprise risk exposure. Coordinate and support compliance and assurance activities, acting as a central interface between UnITy service teams, OpCos, and auditors. Support the delivery of the CRH International cyber programme, ensuring alignment between central technology initiatives and OpCo execution. Interpret and translate regulatory, legal, and contractual requirements into scalable and consistent controls applicable across both central and local operating models. Support third-party and supply chain risk management across both centrally managed services and OpCo suppliers, ensuring consistent security expectations and remediation tracking. Key Functional Competencies You possess the following: Strong understanding of cyber security frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS) Experience in risk management, control design, and audit support Ability to translate technical risks into business impact Strong stakeholder management across technical and non-technical audiences Structured, pragmatic, and delivery-focused mindset Experience operating in a federated or multi-entity organization Exposure to third-party risk and regulatory environments Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar GRC tooling Security certifications (e.g. CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001) Key Characteristics For this role you should be/have: Pragmatic approach to GRC and willing to learn and adopt Problem solver and resolves conflicts. items.desc: Location Calle Bergara 13 8002 Barcelona Employment Area IT - Cloud Services Level Experienced professionals Working Model Full-time Reference ID 48365 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. Your Tasks You develop and improve our Cloud Foundry platform, ensuring the platform's functionality and scalability. You ensure high software quality and optimal application performance through testing and code reviews. You provide seamless integration of the platform into surrounding STACKIT services, creating a user-friendly and customer-oriented platform. You contribute actively to our open-source projects, including the BOSH Cloud Provider Interface for STACKIT IaaS. You assume responsibility for the deployed services together with the product team ("You build it, you run it"). You handle day-to-day platform operations and L3 support during business hours and participate in a night-time on-call rotation for incident escalations. Your Profile You possess extensive programming experience, preferably in Go. You are familiar with the methods of professional software development (from development standards to build and release management). You bring several years of experience in software system architecture design, including design patterns, scalability, and resilience. You have practical experience with CI/CD workflows and automated software delivery pipelines. You have experience operating and maintaining scalable applications or cloud platforms in a live production environment. Your English forms the basis for successful communication in international, agile teams. Good to have: You have experience with Cloud Foundry and Kubernetes Operator Pattern.

Du kombinerar din kreativa förmåga med kunskap inom generativ AI för att ta fram innehåll som håller hög kvalitet och följer varumärkets riktlinjer. Du arbetar med hela produktionsprocessen, från idé och brief till färdig leverans, och bidrar till att effektivisera och skala upp innehållsproduktionen med hjälp av AI. En viktig del av rollen är också att utforska nya verktyg, utveckla kreativa arbetsflöden och hitta innovativa sätt att använda AI i det dagliga arbetet. Du samarbetar nära kollegor inom marknadsföring, produktion och media för att säkerställa att innehållet möter både kampanjernas behov och verksamhetens kvalitetskrav. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Skapa innehåll med hjälp av AI-verktyg för bild-, video- och innehållsgenerering. Projektleda innehållsproduktion från brief till färdig leverans. Utveckla och optimera AI-baserade arbetsflöden, prompts och produktionsprocesser. Samarbeta med team inom marknadsföring, kreativ produktion och media för att ta fram kampanjmaterial. Säkerställa att innehållet följer varumärkets riktlinjer samt relevanta juridiska krav och kvalitetsstandarder. Utforska och utvärdera nya AI-verktyg för att utveckla och effektivisera innehållsproduktionen. Bidra till att utveckla gemensamma arbetssätt och stärka organisationens kompetens inom generativ AI. Kvalifikationer Dokumenterad erfarenhet av innehållsproduktion och digitalt innehållsskapande. Gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av generativ AI och AI-baserade arbetsflöden. Goda kunskaper i Adobe Creative Cloud och moderna verktyg för innehållsproduktion. Erfarenhet av projektledning och av att samordna olika intressenter. God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med olika team. Ett starkt intresse för innovation och den senaste utvecklingen inom AI. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift. Vem söker vi? Vi söker dig som har en kreativ ådra, ett intresse för ny teknik och en god förståelse för hur generativ AI kan användas i professionell innehållsproduktion. Du trivs med att kombinera kreativt skapande med struktur och projektledning, och du motiveras av att hitta nya sätt att arbeta smartare och mer effektivt. Vi tror att du är lösningsorienterad, initiativtagande och nyfiken på att testa nya verktyg och metoder. Du har lätt för att samarbeta med olika kompetenser och kan driva ditt arbete framåt med fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet och slutresultat. Om uppdraget Tjänsten är ett konsultuppdrag via The Place hos vår kund i centrala Stockholm. Uppdraget är på heltid med start omgående och pågår initialt till och med den 31 mars 2027. items.desc: Vill du bidra till medicinsk forskning av toppkvalitet? Vi söker en mycket motiverad forskningsassistent till vår forskargrupp inom cancerbioinformatik vid Karolinska Institutet. Vår forskning kombinerar artificiell intelligens, digital patologi och cancergenomik för att öka förståelsen av tumörbiologi och identifiera biomarkörer som kan förbättra patientvården. I detta projekt kommer du att arbeta med storskaliga histopatologiska bild- och genomikdata och använda avancerade beräkningsmetoder för att studera cancerrelaterade biologiska processer och cancerhallmarks i friska och tumörvävnader. Projektet genomförs i nära anslutning till SciLifeLab och TEF-Health (Testing and Experimentation Facility for Health), ett EU-finansierat initiativ inom Digital Europe-programmet som bygger en europeisk infrastruktur för testning och validering av AI och digitala teknologier inom hälso- och sjukvård. Karolinska Institutet och SciLifeLab utgör en central del av det svenska TEF-Health-konsortiet. Du blir en del av en tvärvetenskaplig och internationell forskningsmiljö vid BioClinicum och kommer att arbeta i samverkan med SciLifeLab och TEF-Health, med forskare inom bland annat cancerbiologi, bioinformatik, digital patologi och datavetenskap. Din roll Du kommer att arbeta i ett forskningsprojekt som använder artificiell intelligens och metoder inom beräkningspatologi för att studera cancerbiologi med hjälp av storskaliga histopatologiska och genomiska datamängder. Projektet använder offentligt tillgängliga resurser såsom The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) och Genotype-Tissue GTEx) för att undersöka cancerhallmarks i friska och tumörvävnader. Arbetet omfattar analys av digitala patologibilder, tillämpning och utvärdering av djupinlärningsmodeller, integrering av bild- och genomikdata samt statistisk analys av kliniska utfall. Du kommer att bidra till utvecklingen av beräkningsflöden i Python och R samt genomföra analyser med hjälp av högpresterande beräkningsresurser. Arbetet kommer även att bidra till aktiviteter inom TEF-Health och SciLifeLab med fokus på testning, utvärdering och validering av AI-baserade metoder för hälsodata. SciLifeLab är en nationell infrastruktur för life science i Sverige som erbjuder avancerade teknologier och datadrivet forskningsstöd. Genom projektets koppling till SciLifeLab och TEF-Health får du möjlighet att arbeta i en miljö där AI, biomedicinsk forskning och utveckling av metoder för framtidens hälso- och sjukvård möts. Vem är du? Du har en examen inom bioinformatik, datavetenskap, biostatistik, datalogi, biomedicinsk teknik, beräkningsbiologi eller ett närliggande område. Vi söker en motiverad, nyfiken och analytisk kollega med ett starkt intresse för artificiell intelligens, beräkningspatologi och cancerforskning. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet. Krav och intressen: Starkt intresse för att tillämpa beräkningsmetoder på biomedicinska forskningsfrågor. Erfarenhet av programmering i Python och av att utveckla och anpassa beräkningsflöden för analys av biomedicinska data. Praktisk erfarenhet av att tillämpa och utvärdera djupinlärningsmodeller för prediktion av genuttryck från digitala histopatologiska helglasbilder (whole-slide images, WSI). Erfarenhet av förbehandling av WSI, inklusive vävnadsmaskering, uppdelning i bildrutor (patches) och extraktion av bildrepresentationer (features) Erfarenhet av att sammanföra och analysera matchade histopatologiska bilder, RNA-seq-data och kliniska metadata från offentliga cancerdatabaser, såsom TCGA. Erfarenhet av kvantitativ jämförelse av modellprediktioner med uppmätta genuttrycksdata, exempelvis med korrelationsmått och prediktionsfel. Erfarenhet av statistisk analys i R, inklusive överlevnadsanalys med Kaplan-Meier-metoden och log-rank-test. Erfarenhet av att köra beräkningsflöden i Linuxmiljö på högpresterande beräkningssystem (HPC). God samarbetsförmåga och förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och i grupp. Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på engelska i tal och skrift. Meriterande: Praktisk erfarenhet av SEQUOIA, HE2RNA, Path2Space eller motsvarande modeller för prediktion av bulk- eller spatialt genuttryck från histopatologiska bilder. Erfarenhet av att beräkna och utvärdera genuttrycksbaserade signaturer, exempelvis CIN70, och analysera deras samband med kliniska utfall och tumöregenskaper. Erfarenhet av analys av bröstcancerdata, inklusive molekylära subtyper Erfarenhet av analys av normalvävnadsdata från GTEx eller av spatial prediktion av genuttryck. Erfarenhet av att anpassa befintliga modellimplementationer och hantera förtränade modellvikter och programvaruberoenden. Erfarenhet av GPU-baserad inferens och batchkörning av storskaliga bildanalyser på HPC. Erfarenhet av tvärvetenskapliga forskningsprojekt inom AI, hälsodata eller precisionsmedicin. Vad erbjuder vi? En kreativ, internationell och inspirerande miljö fylld av kompetens och nyfikenhet. Karolinska Institutet är ett av världens ledande medicinska universitet. …
