Technical Security Architect Location: Hampshire (5 days per week onsite) Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations. The Technical Security Architect is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining technical security architectures that protect the organisation's information systems, data, and infrastructure. Embedded within the Technical team, this role leads the tech refresh and evergreening of security toolsets - ensuring the security technology estate remains current, supported, effective, and aligned with evolving threat landscapes, client policies, and cross-domain architectural patterns. This is a hands-on architecture role, not a governance-only position. The Technical Security Architect is expected to produce detailed technical designs, evaluate and select security technologies, define integration patterns, and guide implementation teams through delivery. The role requires deep technical expertise across cloud security, identity and access management, boundary and perimeter security, secure platform architectures, and security tooling ecosystems. Key Responsibilities Design and deliver security architectures across cloud, on-premise, hybrid and air-gapped environments. Produce technical designs including HLDs, LLDs, architecture patterns and data-flow diagrams. Lead the refresh and evergreening of security technologies, including IAM, PAM, firewalls, EDR/XDR, SIEM, vulnerability management and cloud security. Evaluate new technologies through PoCs/PoVs and make clear, evidence-based recommendations. Design and review cloud, identity, network, perimeter and platform security solutions. Apply Zero Trust, defence-in-depth and threat-informed design principles. Ensure security architectures align with NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, NCSC and client security requirements. Act as a security design authority, providing technical guidance and architectural decisions. Work closely with enterprise, infrastructure, network and application architects to embed security across the technology landscape. Support security accreditation, risk assessments and client security reviews. Keep pace with emerging threats and technologies and identify opportunities to improve and simplify the security estate. What you'll bring Significant experience as a Technical Security Architect, Security Architect or Senior Security Engineer. Strong technical expertise across multiple security domains, particularly IAM, network security, cloud security, endpoint security and secure platforms. Proven experience delivering security technology refresh, migration or modernisation programmes. Strong experience with AWS, Azure and/or GCP security architecture. Experience producing detailed technical architecture documentation. Strong understanding of threat modelling, risk and security architecture principles. Experience working within complex, regulated or formally accredited environments. Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence both technical and senior stakeholders. CISSP (or equivalent) and TOGAF and/or SABSA. Desirable: Zero Trust, DevSecOps, MITRE ATT&CK, SIEM, PAM, Kubernetes/container security, PKI and security automation experience. At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. Nursing and AHP vacancies are also open to Student Nurses and Newly Qualified Nurses/AHPs. The NHS is changing. More emphasis on community-based care means there’s never been a better time to join us. We are looking for an enthusiastic and organised WorkWell Administrator to join our professional service on a part time basis. We’re a close team but we’re never exclusive, if you can bring a professional approach and fresh ideas we would love to hear from you. Please note, this vacancy does not meet the criteria for skilled worker sponsorship and therefore, we are unable to accept applications from candidates that cannot provide documentary evidence of right to work in the United Kingdom. Could you use your skills and experience to support the NHS to deliver great patient care? Great patient care needs great people to support clinical teams. That’s where you come in. We’re always looking for enthusiastic, responsive, and adaptable people to join our outstanding trust. This role is an important one as you’ll be using your knowledge, experience and expertise to provide support to our hard-working frontline NHS teams. We put patients first and we expect all of our colleagues to do the same, so although NHS experience isn’t a requirement for this role you’ll need to share our passion for delivering excellent patient care and keep that passion at the forefront of your professional activity at all times. The challenges come thick and fast in this role but you’ll know that your input is contributing to the excellent experience our patients and service users have every day. Kent Community Health NHS Foundation Trust is currently undertaking a significant programme of transformation to align our community services to the new Neighbourhood Model of care delivery, there will be a period of consultation which may result in changes affecting some services, teams or roles. Depending on the area you are applying to work in, this could include potential changes to your role, work base, reporting arrangements, or terms and conditions of employment. Any changes would be subject to consultation and managed sensitively and in line with relevant employment processes. Please do contact the recruiting manager if you have any concerns about this so they can answer any questions you might have. Rated ‘Outstanding’ by CQC, we deliver high-quality care that improves the health of our communities. We are looking for people who share our values: Compassionate, Aspirational, Responsive and Excellent . We are proud to be an inclusive, welcoming organisation and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. We use protected characteristic information for monitoring only and it is not seen by recruiting managers, except where applicants choose to be considered under our disability guaranteed interview scheme. We know life outside work matters. As a flexible working-friendly organisation, we welcome conversations about arrangements that help you thrive while supporting excellent care for our patients. To play a key role in the important ‘Early Days in Custody’ of prisoners, working closely with other departments to ensure that all risks are assessed and managed, providing a presence, with other team members. To function fully within the Integrated Mental Health Team, assessing and treating patients through their journey in prison. To accept referrals and triage patients with the team. To undertake comprehensive assessments alone or with colleagues and feedback to the Multi-disciplinary Team, ensuring that planned care is individual and appropriate to the needs of the patient. To provide effective case management to a defined caseload in accordance with the Care Programme Approach, in conjunction with the team, appropriate prison departments and external health, social care and probation services. To ensure effective pre-release care planning Promote the health and well-being of patients and maintain a safe, caring and therapeutic environment based on an individualised approach. Working with the Mental Health Nurse Lead to provide an environment that promotes training and development among the workforce. To work under the direction of the Deputy Head of Healthcare (Mental Health Lead) and Mental Health Nurse Lead to ensure that clinical priorities are clearly understood and met to an agreed standard. To assess health and social care needs and negotiate care plans with Patients and staff teams. To undertake risk assessments including the formulation of a comprehensive plans developed jointly with the Patients and staff teams. To work within the Prison Service safer custody framework for managing Suicide and self-harm (SASH procedures) to support Patients requiring this. To provide a service sensitive to age, culture, ethnicity and gender, sexuality and disability. To contribute to the effective multi-disciplinary team working within the team and the rest of the Prison. To participate in the reception/induction process, and any other model that the local team adopts, in order to identify individuals with mental health problems at the earliest opportunity. We’re passionate about delivering first-class patient-centred, safe and effective care, whether it is in a hospital setting, in a community clinic, in the patient’s own home or in a Prison. Patients are at the heart of everything we do. Providing top quality care depends on our ability to employ the best people. We’re always looking to recruit outstanding people who will go the extra mile to support our patients, colleagues, teams and the Trust. With every new employee we’re hoping to find our future leaders and we’ll support our staff by providing opportunities to develop your career. With a diverse culture and equally diverse range of opportunities across mental health, community services, addictions, eating disorders, learning disabilities, Health & Justice and more – whatever stage of your career you're at, there's always a place for you at CNWL. To have an active presence and act as a resource for all staff and prisoners, in addition to those patients under your care, in the Segregation unit and Clinical Assessment Unit. To work with the agreed Core Assessment Tool within all relevant Prison Departments To carry out duties in accordance with Prison / NOMS policies. To undertake comprehensive assessment of individuals: to include all areas of need and information gathering from all relevant Prison Departments and external agencies. To case manage an identified caseload of clients, in conjunction with the multidisciplinary team and relevant agencies and carers. To include the planning and implementation of effective care plans, regular review meetings, timely referral to external agencies, within the framework of the CPA, to ensure effective pre-release planning. To communicate effectively with all relevant internal departments and external agencies regarding clients, within the restrictions of a prison environment. To work closely with the MDT and identify and facilitate an effective range of therapeutic interventions for this particular client group. To respond to urgent referrals and to assess whether input from the team is indicated/appropriate. To offer a range of evidence based interventions and proactive risk management approaches to help the patient reduce and manage symptoms, high risk behaviour and other disabling effects of their conditions and enable, as far as possible, full and sustained recovery. To ensure that both CNWL Safeguarding Adults and Children Guidelines and procedures are fully understood and to ensure the safety needs of adults and children involved are met at all times and take appropriate action when either the adult or/and child is felt to be at risk or in need.

The role will involve the undertaking of national and international projects, with relevant travel requirements as needed. To succeed in this role, you must have experience in undertaking and managing complex air quality assessments and have a desire to make a positive difference to future developments. In the UK we work on a wide variety of air quality projects including environmental impact assessments of major developments, large infrastructure schemes, urban developments and assessments of industrial emissions for both planning and permitting. items.desc: About Union Maritime Union Maritime Limited is a London-based shipowner and operator. Its core business is the product tanker market, focused on MR2 and larger vessels, alongside a presence in the dry bulk sector. The company is also investing in its future fleet, with newbuild hulls at Wuhu Shipyard in China. Decisions on when to buy, sell and build are central to the business, and the S&P / Strategy team sits at the heart of that work. Role Purpose The Junior Analyst will support the S&P / Strategy team in tracking the secondhand, newbuilding and demolition markets, analysing potential acquisitions and identifying areas for investment across tanker and dry bulk. Working closely with Guy Blunden, the Senior Associates and the Analyst, you will turn market data and broker intelligence into clear analysis, practical tools and well-reasoned recommendations. Key Responsibilities Market Monitoring & Intelligence Monitor vessel sales, asset values, newbuilding orders and contracting, and demolition activity on a daily and weekly basis across the tanker and dry bulk markets. Review broker reports and market intelligence, track comparable sales, and flag notable transactions, price movements and emerging trends to the team. Asset Screening & Acquisition Analysis Screen and evaluate secondhand and newbuild acquisition candidates, reviewing vessel specifications, age, building yard, and inspection and class information. Assess valuations against recent comparables and model earnings potential to test the investment case for each candidate. Prepare clear, well-supported acquisition recommendations for review by the Head of Strategy and senior team members. Prepare and maintain candidate vessel lists, target and watch lists, owner lists and sales candidate lists. Investment Research Research segments, vessel types and market trends to identify areas for investment and support the company's investment strategy. Analyse the drivers of asset values, such as fleet age profiles, the orderbook, demolition and regulatory change, and summarise the implications for the business. Tools, Models & Databases Build and refine models and analytical tools for vessel valuation, fleet analysis and market analysis, primarily in Excel and, ideally, using Python or Power BI. Maintain and develop the vessel sales register, asset value database, and fleet and market databases, taking ownership of data quality. Reporting Compile the weekly S&P market round-up, presenting tanker and dry bulk separately for asset values, sales and newbuildings. Consolidate broker reports into concise internal summaries, and prepare analysis, charts and slides for internal management presentations. Development Path This role is designed for someone who wants to build a long-term career in shipping. It begins with a strong analytical foundation and offers a clear opportunity to grow into a more commercial position over time. As your knowledge and judgement develop, you will gain increasing exposure to brokers and counterparties, take part in deal negotiations and support transaction execution alongside senior colleagues. Requirements Essential A strong degree in a numerate discipline such as economics, finance, engineering, maritime/shipping or similar. Advanced Excel skills, including building and maintaining models. Analytical rigour, close attention to detail, and clear, concise written communication. A genuine interest in shipping and the markets that drive it. Desirable 2 years' experience in shipping S&P, chartering, ship finance or broking. Working knowledge of Python, SQL or Power BI, and familiarity with data sources such as Clarksons, VesselsValue or IHS. An MSc in Shipping, or ICS (Institute of Chartered Shipbrokers) qualifications completed or in progress. Personal Attributes Curious and proactive, with the initiative to dig into data and ask the right questions. Organised and reliable, taking ownership of tasks and balancing recurring deadlines with ad hoc requests. Commercially minded, with the confidence to form a view and support it with evidence. Discreet and professional when handling commercially sensitive information. Benefits Salary: [Competitive – to be confirmed], with [bonus arrangements to be confirmed]. Benefits: [Benefits package to be confirmed, e.g. pension, private medical cover, holiday entitlement]. Direct exposure to senior decision-makers and to live S&P and newbuilding activity. [Training and professional development support to be confirmed].

items.desc: The Surgical Care Practitioner (SCP) is an advanced clinical practitioner working within the Urology theatres. The role is characterised by a high degree of clinical expertise, autonomous decision making, professional accountability and leadership across the peri-operative patient pathway. The post holder will work in partnership with Consultant Urological Surgeons, Anaesthetists, Nursing Staff, Allied Health Professionals and the wider multidisciplinary team to deliver high quality, evidence-based care for patients undergoing urological surgery. The SCP will undertake advanced clinical practice within agreed governance frameworks and Royal College of Surgeons guidance, providing expert assessment, peri-operative management, intra-operative surgical assistance and post-operative care. The post holder will undertake credentialed surgical interventions within their agreed scope of practice including robotic bedside assistance, port placement, tissue retraction, wound closure and other delegated surgical procedures under consultant supervision. The SCP will function as an autonomous advanced practitioner, contributing to service leadership, workforce development, education, governance, quality improvement and research across the Urology Service. Provide advanced surgical assistance during urological and robotic-assisted procedures, including port placement, tissue retraction, haemostasis, suturing and wound closure. Identify and escalate post-operative complications and contribute to discharge planning, enhanced recovery and optimisation of the robotic surgical pathway. Provide specialist advice and support to patients, carers and multidisciplinary colleagues, acting as an expert clinical resource. Provide professional leadership and contribute to service planning, workforce development, clinical governance and patient safety. Lead and support education, training, mentorship and competency development for theatre staff, junior doctors, trainee SCPs and other MDT members. Lead and contribute to clinical audit, quality improvement, service evaluation and research, supporting evidence-based practice. Contribute to the development and implementation of policies, procedures and service improvements relating to SCP and robotic surgery practice. Bristol NHS Foundation Trust values all people as individuals. As an equal opportunities employer actively working towards a diverse workforce we aim to recruit and retain a workforce which represents the rich diversity of the local population at all levels and are committed to designing our services around the needs of individual patients and those around them. items.desc: What’s Yonder? “It's as if Time Out, Amex and Monzo had a baby” - Will T, Yonder Member We’re building the financial membership of the future. One that works for how you live now. Not how your parents banked in the ‘90s. Yonder combines credit or debit in one membership, designed to be fair, flexible, and actually enjoyable to use. No confusing terms. No dusty points system. Just rewards that actually feel rewarding - from bao to beer to a boarding pass. Sounds cool. What’s my part in this? Over the last year we've added a debit card, a free membership tier, hundreds of new independent partners around the country, countless product improvements and our personal favourite, Yonder Flights, a new way to use Yonder points on any flight with any airline globally. We've maintained a 4.5 TrustPilot rating and our customers really love us (and we love them back... hi!). Over the last 24 months, we’ve grown from just an idea to a beautiful, fully regulated financial product that our members absolutely love. Why design matters at Yonder Design isn’t just making something look good. It’s how a new member decides they can trust us with their money. It’s how we take something as complex as a credit account and make it simple, clear and fun. It’s how we turn rewards into something you actually look forward to using, rather than just a bunch of useless points you never touch. That’s why design sits right at the centre here. You’ll work on some of the most important problems we have, alongside people who’ll help you crack them. The expectation is that you care deeply about the quality and detail of your work, as much as the larger ambition driving everything we do. About the role You’ll join a small team where design carries real weight, as the designer in a lean squad with a senior product manager and two engineers. Your PM sets the direction for the squad, and you’ll own the design that brings it to life, taking work from early concepts to something in members’ hands. You won’t be doing it alone. Our designers work closely across squads, with product and design crits every week, and you’ll have a lot of support from Craig, our VP of Design, and our senior designers as you grow into the role. What you’ll be doing: Turning complex problems into simple experiences. Working closely with your PM, you’ll take complex problems and design the flows and prototypes that make them feel simple and effortless for members. Crafting experiences people love using. Yonder feels different from other finance apps because of how much we obsess over the craft. You'll design beautiful, enjoyable products that feel premium and worth coming back to. This is where we expect you to shine. Running research. Designers here don’t sit at arm’s length from members. You’ll run research alongside your PM, testing concepts and running usability sessions, and build up to leading your own research projects. If this is newer to you, we’ll help you get there. Working shoulder to shoulder with your squad. You'll work in the open with your PM and engineers from the first sketch, solving problems together so the final product feels like it was built by one team. Balancing speed with polish. Some weeks you’ll put scrappy ideas in front of members just to learn. Other times you'll slow right down to get the details right. Knowing which a problem needs takes judgement, and we’ll help you build it. Contributing to our design system. You’ll add to it and refine it, so it helps the whole team move fast without losing consistency or quality. You're a great fit if... Your craft is the strongest thing about your work. Typography, layout, colour, spacing, hierarchy, motion. Visual execution is where you stand out, and you can’t leave the details alone until they’re right. You have a few years of experience, including some in product. You’ve been designing for a few years, and for at least the last couple you’ve been working on digital products and shipping work people use. You might have started out in brand or marketing design and moved across, and now you want an in-house product role where you can learn how great products get made. You care about how things feel on a phone. Yonder lives on a smartphone. Ideally you’ve shipped native mobile experiences, but if not, you’ve designed digital interfaces and you’re keen to treat mobile as its own craft. You want to be involved end to end. You might have a specialism, but you want to be part of every stage, from talking to members and shaping ideas to sweating the final details. We don’t have researchers, content designers or copywriters, so you’ll get to grow across all of it, with support. You want feedback. You ask for it, take it well and act on it. You’ll get a lot of it here, and the people who grow fastest are the ones who go looking for it. You communicate openly and often. You share early, bring people into your process and see engineers and PMs as creative partners. You care about impact, not output. You believe …

items.desc: Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) | £75,000 Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. items.desc: On behalf of the Advisory, Conciliation and Arbitration Service (ACAS), we are looking for a Conversation Designer (Outside IR35) for a 4 month contract based REMOTELY UK wide. Role Purpose: ACAS is seeking an experienced Conversation Designer to support the design and development of AI-powered conversational experiences on the ACAS website. Working within a multidisciplinary agile team, you will define, design, prototype, and test chatbot journeys that help users access workplace rights, employment law guidance, and ACAS services through natural language interactions. You'll collaborate with service designers, user researchers, product managers, content designers, and technical teams to create user-centred, accessible, and effective experiences, while designing conversation flows, mapping user journeys, establishing guardrails, and using user insight and data to inform decision-making. This is an opportunity to support a high-profile AI initiative from discovery through to delivery, helping ACAS improve how users access trusted information and advice online. As a Conversation Designer, your main responsibilities will be: Design and deliver end-to-end conversational experiences for AI-powered digital services, ensuring they are intuitive, engaging, and user-centred. Create detailed conversation flows, dialogue structures, and recovery pathways that support effective user interactions. Develop and maintain conversational design artefacts, including user journeys, flow diagrams, wireframes, and prototypes. Partner with user researchers to understand user needs, validate design decisions, and continuously improve conversational experiences. Work closely with subject matter experts and content specialists to develop clear, accurate, and accessible conversational content. Analyse conversation data, user feedback, and performance metrics to identify insights and drive ongoing optimisation. Ensure all conversational designs meet accessibility requirements and align with inclusive design principles and best practice. Collaborate with developers, technical teams, and stakeholders to align conversational solutions with platform capabilities, AI guardrails, and organisational objectives. Essential: Proven experience designing and delivering conversational experiences for chatbots, virtual assistants, or AI-powered digital services, with expertise in conversation flows, interaction models, and conversational content design. Strong understanding of generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and conversational AI technologies, alongside user-centred design, accessibility standards, and inclusive design best practices. Experience using user research, analytics, and testing insights to inform design decisions, validate solutions, and continuously improve user experiences. Demonstrated ability to work effectively within agile multidisciplinary teams, collaborating with stakeholders to facilitate workshops, gather requirements, and drive design outcomes. Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to create clear, engaging, and accessible content using plain English principles. Background in producing and maintaining design artefacts, including conversational prototypes, journey maps, service blueprints, and flow diagrams, to support the design and delivery process. Desirable: Experience delivering digital products and services within UK public sector or Government Digital and Data (DDaT) environments, with an understanding of government delivery frameworks and multidisciplinary ways of working. Knowledge of GOV.UK Service Standards and best practices for designing accessible, user-centred, and high-quality digital services. Experience working within legal, regulatory, or other highly governed environments, with an appreciation of the challenges associated with communicating complex information accurately and effectively. Please be aware that this role can only be worked within the UK and not Overseas. Disability Confident As a Disability Confident employer, CA encourage applications from disabled and neurodivergent candidates. Applications from candidates who identify as having a disability and meet the essential criteria for the role will be prioritised for review. Where application volumes are high, additional role-specific and desirable criteria may be applied as part of the shortlisting process which may include holding active security clearance. Armed Forces commitment As a signatory of the Armed Forces Covenant, CA welcome applications from veterans, service leavers, reservists and military spouses or partners. Applications from eligible candidates who meet the essential criteria for the role will be prioritised for review. Where application volumes are high, additional role-specific and desirable criteria may be applied as part of the shortlisting process which may include holding active security clearance.

 Hello World, We are hiring! 
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future.
 Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant team.
 Siemens Software, a business unit of the Siemens Digital Industries, is a leading global provider of software solutions to drive the digital transformation of industry, creating new opportunities for manufacturers to realize innovation.
 What you will be doing: 
 We're looking for Junior/Senior Front-End Web Development Engineer(s) to help build our Enterprise Physics AI solution — a product that gives customers a complete workflow around physics AI models that reduce computational time from days/hours to minutes/seconds As part of the front-end team, you'll work closely and collaborate with stakeholders across engineering, product management, and design to turn ambitious ideas into an intuitive, high-performing user experience. It's a great opportunity to grow your technical skills in a rapidly evolving product at the leading edge of AI in engineering and see your work shape what customers experience from day one.
 •Develop responsive, user-friendly UI components using React, TypeScript, JavaScript.
 •Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create intuitive designs.
 •Participate in code reviews.
 •Participate in development meetings as part of Agile/Kanban process.
 •Participate in user testing and apply feedback to improve interfaces.
 •Interact with and analyze business requirements by engaging with relevant partners.
 •Write clean, maintainable code and follow standard processes.
 What You'll Bring: 
 •Degree in Computer Science/Engineering with good academic record.
 •Extensive demonstrable experience in software development.
 •Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React/Angular.
 •Knowledge of programming best practices, state management, lazy loading, etc.
 •Knowledge in Web Application development.
 •Experience with version control systems such as Git, JIRA, Confluence.
 •Hands-on experience with extensive unit testing.
 •Experience in debugging and troubleshooting.

items.desc: La Direction des Applications Militaires du CEA, acteur clé de la souveraineté et de la compétitivité numérique pour la France, se mobilise pleinement autour des enjeux liés à l’Intelligence Artificielle. Intégré(e) à nos équipes en tant qu’ingénieur de recherche en IA appliquée au traitement automatique du langage, vous contribuerez sur des projets internes et pluridisciplinaires à optimiser l’extraction d’informations à partir de documents structurés et non structurés (PDF, images, scans, etc.) via des modèles d’OCR et à concevoir et déployer des systèmes de RAG pour améliorer l’accès aux connaissances internes et automatiser des tâches de recherche ou d’analyse. Ce poste s’inscrit dans une démarche d’innovation technologique et de souveraineté des données, avec un fort accent sur l’évaluation, l’intégration et le déploiement en environnement on-premise. A ce titre, vos principales missions seront : Sélectionner et optimiser des Modèles d’OCR, en évaluant les modèles open-source et propriétaires en fonction des besoins métiers, en adaptant les modèles aux spécificités des documents du CEA, et en les comparant en termes de précision, latence, et robustesse. Concevoir et déployer des systèmes RAG, en indexant (postgreSQL, ElasticSearch) et retrouvant des informations, en choisissant les composants clés comme les modèles d’embeddings, les bases de données vectorielles, les modèles de langage (LLM), les mécanismes de re-ranking. Modéliser la multimodalité, en fusionnant via des modèles cross-modaux pour lier images, texte, et audio ; en déployant des générations Texte → Image pour la visualisation de concepts techniques et Audio → Texte/Image (ex. : transcription + analyse sémantique) ; en proposant des stratégies de modération (guardrails). Industrialiser les processus de développement et de déploiement, en garantissant la sécurité et l'intégrité des données. Rejoindre le CEA c’est évoluer dans un environnement scientifique d’excellence au service de projets à forts enjeux tout en bénéficiant d’un cadre de travail équilibré. Parcours professionnels variés et accompagnés (formations, mobilité interne), équilibre vie pro/perso (jusqu’à 52 jours de congés/RTT) dispositifs d’épargne salariale et avantages facilitant le quotidien (restauration, transport, conciergerie, CSE, etc.). Avec un Family Score de 98%, le CEA est à la tête du Label Parents on board qui récompense notre engagement en matière de parentalité. Ce poste bénéficie de télétravail, conformément aux accords et modalités en vigueur au sein du CEA. Il est également possible d’occuper le poste à distance sur un autre centre CEA DAM, notamment au CESTA en Nouvelle Aquitaine. Conformément aux engagements pris par le CEA en faveur de l'intégration des personnes handicapées, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l'inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. Profil du candidat Titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 en école d'ingénieur ou en université spécialisé en informatique, vous justifiez d'une premiere expérience dans l'IA. Vous êtes à l'écoute et organisé, avec une capacité à fédérer. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos qualités de communication et la tenue des objectifs. Participant à la protection nationale, une enquête administrative est réalisée pour tous les salariés du CEA afin d'assurer l'intégrité et la sécurité de la nation. Localisation du poste Site DAM Île-de-France Localisation du poste France, Ile-de-France, Essonne (91) Ville 26 Rue de la Piquetterie, 91680 Bruyères-le-Châtel Demandeur Disponibilité du poste 01/09/2026

items.card: The role As part of our AI team, you will own our learning stack and its integration into our robot fleet, from low-level policies on the robots up to policies for fleet management running in the cloud. items.desc: About Embodied AI Embodied AI builds robots that do real work in factories of leading industrial manufacturers. Our amazing team operates in Amsterdam, Lausanne and Rome; we build and own the hardware and software stack to make our robots move. The role As part of our AI team, you will own our learning stack and its integration into our robot fleet, from low-level policies on the robots up to policies for fleet management running in the cloud. We take a pragmatic approach: we deploy policies to our customers to solve their problems, and our focus is on integrating our technological breakthroughs of the past years into a production-ready stack. You will set the technical direction of this stack and make sure the policies we deploy work on the factory floor, not only in the lab. What You Will Do Own the learning stack end to end: data collection, training, evaluation and deployment of policies to our robot fleet. Own its integration into the fleet, across edge and cloud. Decide what to learn and what to engineer, and choose approaches that meet the customer's target. Work with the AI, hardware and field teams, including on customer sites. What You Bring 5+ years in robot learning, with policies running on real robots. Hands-on knowledge in imitation learning for manipulation Deploying models on edge and cloud compute. A pragmatic mindset: you ship to customer milestones and pick the method that works. Nice to have Experience with the NVIDIA ecosystem: Isaac, Jetson. Vision-language models for robotics. DevOps and MLOps (Docker, ROS 2): shipping policies into production. Experience managing a team of AI engineers. Contact-rich or bimanual manipulation, reinforcement learning, sim-to-real. What We Offer Robots deployed with leading manufacturers, and the chance to shape how they learn. Real ownership in a fast-growing team, with our own hardware to work on. An office in central Lausanne with a dedicated robot test area. Equity. Logistics On site in Lausanne. Start: as soon as possible. How To Apply Send your CV, a few sentences on what you are strongest at, and links to robot work you are proud of (videos, code, papers). Embodied AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone.

items.desc: En tant qu’Expert IA, vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des projets d’intelligence artificielle, de l’identification des besoins jusqu’à l’industrialisation des solutions. Vous serez un interlocuteur privilégié des équipes métiers et techniques afin de transformer leurs besoins en solutions opérationnelles à forte valeur ajoutée. Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Identifier et qualifier les cas d’usage liés à l’intelligence artificielle et à l’IA générative. Concevoir, développer et industrialiser des solutions d’IA adaptées aux besoins métiers. Développer des prototypes, des agents IA, des assistants conversationnels et des automatisations intelligentes. Intégrer les solutions développées au système d’information via des API, des applications ou des plateformes cloud. Garantir la qualité, la sécurité, la conformité et la performance des solutions déployées. Assurer une veille technologique et proposer des innovations permettant d’optimiser les processus et d’améliorer l’expérience utilisateur. Accompagner les équipes dans l’appropriation et l’utilisation des technologies d’intelligence artificielle. Formuler des recommandations techniques et contribuer à la définition de la stratégie et de la feuille de route IA. Vos réalisations Vous serez amené à produire différents livrables selon les projets confiés : Études d’opportunité et de faisabilité. Proofs of Concept (PoC) et prototypes fonctionnels. Agents IA, copilotes métiers et solutions d’automatisation. Solutions d’intelligence artificielle industrialisées et documentées. Recommandations techniques et contributions à la feuille de route IA. Profil candidat: Issu d’une formation supérieure en informatique, en intelligence artificielle ou en Machine Learning (Bac+5), vous justifiez d’au moins 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle hors alternance dans le développement et le déploiement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle. Vous maîtrisez notamment les domaines suivants : Intelligence artificielle, IA générative et Machine Learning. Développement en Python, conception d’API et intégration applicative. Plateformes cloud telles qu’Azure, AWS ou GCP, ainsi que leurs services d’IA associés. Gestion, exploitation et valorisation des données. Architecture de solutions, cybersécurité et gouvernance des systèmes d’IA. Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes capable de comprendre les enjeux métiers et de les traduire en solutions concrètes. Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, d’esprit d’innovation et de pédagogie, et appréciez le travail en transversal avec des interlocuteurs variés.

items.desc: Job Description: ML Engineer Sept 2026 Job Title : Machine Learning Engineer Location : Remote, UK based Reporting to : Lead Developer Company Overview Wyser is a dynamic and innovative digital transformation company that helps organisations improve their efficiency and productivity through the use of responsible AI. Wyser designs, builds and operates production AI systems for regulated and frontline services. Wyser is currently seeking a skilled Machine Learning Engineer who can assist with readying and supporting our models from inception to production. Job Responsibilities We require someone to develop, deploy and support AI models in all parts of the AI life cycle: Design, implement and improve LLM application pipelines for speech-to-text, structured summarisation / information extraction, document classification and retrieval-augmented generation. Build and tune hybrid RAG systems over documents and transcripts. Integrate and operate third-party AI services, including Google’s Gemini Agent Enterprise Platform (Gemini), speech providers (e.g. AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs, DeepGram), Azure Document Intelligence and embedding models, with multi-tenant configuration. Own evaluation and quality loops: regression test matrices, STT benchmarking (WER/CER), feedback triage, prompt / schema iteration, and release gates for accuracy-sensitive features. Collaborate with product, engineering and data science to turn domain requirements into robust ML behaviour. Desired skillset: Essential: Strong Python experience building production services (FastAPI or similar, async patterns, testing with pytest). Hands-on LLM application engineering ideally with Gemini or comparable providers. Experience with RAG or document intelligence systems. Solid understanding of cloud platforms, ideally Azure (Blob Storage, queues / Service Bus, Container Apps or equivalent containerised workers, Application Insights). Comfortable with Git, Docker and collaborative delivery in a product engineering team. Experience with vector databases such as QDrant or similar. Nice to have / beneficial: Experience with Google’s Gemini Agent Enterprise Platform. Experience with Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry). Terraform. SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL. Speech-to-text / audio pipelines: working with STT APIs, VAD or multilingual transcription / translation quality. OCR and document parsing (Azure Document Intelligence or similar). Experience in regulated domains where auditability matters. Required Experience : A minimum of 2 years of experience within a research and development (R&D) or product engineering environment shipping ML/AI features into production. Why Join Wyser? At Wyser, you'll have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced, innovative environment where your contributions directly impact our success. We offer competitive compensation, flexible working arrangements, and the chance to be part of a talented and supportive team. You must be based in the UK and have the right to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Si estás listo para enfrentarte a nuevos desafíos, crecer profesionalmente y aportar tu experiencia a proyectos que realmente marcan la diferencia, este es el lugar para ti. Lideramos el desarrollo de soluciones tecnológicas punteras que refuerzan la seguridad nacional e internacional. 💻 ¡Únete a nuestro equipo de proyectos europeos! Perfil especializado en procesamiento del lenguaje natural, recuperación de información e ingeniería de conocimiento , con capacidad para desarrollar componentes software integrables en IMAGINE (capa de agentes de IndraMind). 💡 ¿Qué harás? 🚀 Preparación y estructuración del conocimiento: desarrollar pipelines de ingesta y extracción, gestionar metadatos y versiones, y preservar relaciones relevantes entre textos, tablas, figuras, entidades y documentos. 🚀 Recuperación e integración: implementar y comparar búsqueda semántica e híbrida, filtrado por metadatos, recuperación por resúmenes, reordenación de resultados y uso de grafos; exponer estas capacidades mediante servicios consumibles por los agentes. 🚀 Evaluación de calidad y fundamentación: construir conjuntos de evaluación, comprobar relevancia y cobertura, analizar errores y verificar referencias; detectar respuestas sin evidencia suficiente o sustentadas en información desactualizada. 🎯 ¿Qué buscamos en ti? No te preocupes si no cumples el 100% de lo que buscamos. ¡Anímate, conoce nuestra propuesta y cuéntanos lo que nos puedes aportar! 🚀: ✅ Desarrollo y procesamiento de datos. Python , preparación y transformación de datos, desarrollo de servicios, Git y pruebas automatizadas. Capacidad para construir pipelines reproducibles y mantenibles, no solamente experimentos aislados. ✅ NLP y recuperación de información. Conocimientos sólidos de NLP, embeddings, segmentación documental, indexación y recuperación . Experiencia práctica construyendo soluciones de generación aumentada con recuperación —RAG— , trabajando con metadatos y fuentes, y evaluando por separado la recuperación y las respuestas generadas. ✅ Ingeniería documental y evaluación. Experiencia en extracción y tratamiento de documentación, preservación de referencias y análisis de errores. Conocimientos de extracción de entidades y relaciones, representación del conocimiento e integración de modelos multimodales y herramientas de procesamiento documental. Lo que te ofrecemos Estabilidad y Futuro 🏢✨: Proyectos a largo plazo en una empresa líder de Defensa con más de 50.000 profesionales, con seguridad financiera. Proyectos Innovadores y de Alto Alcance 🚀: Trabajarás con tecnologías de vanguardia, con un impacto tanto a nivel nacional como internacional. Ambiente Cercano y Transparente 🤝 : Disfrutarás de una comunicación directa y fluida con responsables y compañeros, en un entorno colaborativo y abierto. Autonomía y Flexibilidad ⏳: Tendrás libertad para organizar tu trabajo, con una conciliación real y adaptada a tu ritmo. Plan de carrera adaptado a ti 📈: Diseñado para impulsar tu crecimiento y desarrollo profesional. Formación continua 📚: en Open University y Udemy for Business (¡más de 6.000 cursos para especializarte!). Descuentos exclusivos para tu bienestar 🎁 : Disfruta de ventajas en gimnasios, restaurantes, tiendas, ocio y mucho más al ser empleado de Indra. Retribución competitiva 💰 y planes de compensación flexibles 💸📊a tus necesidades. 🕓 ¿Cómo es nuestro proceso de selección? Revisión de tu perfil 🔍: Evaluamos tu experiencia y habilidades para determinar si encajas con lo que buscamos. Primera toma de contacto (5-10 min) 📞: Si recibes una llamada de un número desconocido, ¡es nuestro equipo! Será una conversación rápida para conocerte y resolver cualquier duda. items.desc: Vill du arbeta med AI och mjukvaruutveckling i framkant och samtidigt bidra till vårt totalförsvar? Som Senior AI Engineer på Combitech i Skövde blir du en del av vårt AI-team och arbetar i olika kundprojekt som expert inom AI och mjukvaruutveckling. Här får du möjlighet att utveckla lösningar inom bland annat generativ AI, LLM, RAG och maskininlärning, samtidigt som du får möjlighet att utvecklas inom ditt eget intresseområde. Din roll som AI Engineer I den här rollen får du möjlighet att: Arbeta nära våra kunder med att utveckla skräddarsydda AI-lösningar och bidra till både deras och vår egen utveckling. Stödja företag i utvecklingen mot en mer datadriven och intelligent organisation genom att vägleda och implementera framtidens lösningar. Designa, implementera och införa avancerade AI-lösningar baserade på exempelvis LLM, RAG, MCP och maskininlärning. Sätta upp AI-agenter och flöden för automatisering. Analysera och tolka data för att identifiera värdefulla insikter som gynnar våra kunder. Tillämpa CI/CD, Git och DevOps/MLOps-praktiker för kontinuerliga leveranser av hög kvalitet. Utforska och utvärdera avancerad hårdvara för att ligga i teknisk framkant och stärka våra AI-lösningar. Växla mellan olika uppdrag och tekniker utifrån ditt intresse och kundernas behov. Vi söker dig som Har en kandidat- eller masterexamen inom relevant område. Har minst fem års erfarenhet som Data Scientist, AI Developer eller i en liknande roll med tillämpad AI-kunskap i komplexa system. Har goda kunskaper i Python eller liknande språk samt erfarenhet av Docker, containers, Kubernetes, Git, Linux och virtualisering. Har en god analytisk förmåga och är kvalitetsmedveten med ambitionen att leverera lösningar av hög kvalitet. Har förmåga att tänka kreativt och hitta innovativa lösningar på tekniska utmaningar. Trivs med att ta initiativ och arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du samarbetar effektivt i team. Då tjänsten innebär arbete som omfattas av försvarssekretess krävs det att du genomför och godkänns i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll. Urval sker löpande. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Kom & gör skillnad På Combitech har vi ett löfte: vi investerar i våra medarbetare. items.desc: Description ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, aviation, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU. You will help deliver data science and AI solutions across client projects, working with subject matter experts to frame questions, analyse evidence and deliver findings. This is a hands-on technical and consulting role: you will discuss needs with specialists, present approaches and results to varied audiences, and contribute to proposals. You will join an established team and work across technically diverse projects. What You Will Do Speak with subject matter experts and clients to define the problem, success measures, data needs and an appropriate analytical approach. Prepare and analyse data, develop and evaluate models or prototypes using statistical methods, forecasting, machine learning or language models where suitable. Present findings, assumptions and limitations to subject matter experts, clients and nontechnical audiences, invite challenge and adapt the work to their feedback. Collaborate with colleagues across different technical disciplines to document work, make results reproducible and develop promising prototypes into reliable solutions. Contribute technical ideas, estimates and evidence to proposals, and manage your work across several concurrent projects. Share methods and reusable approaches with colleagues across the data science team. What You Will Bring Hands-on experience in Python for analysis and modelling, including common data and machine learning libraries, ability to use SQL to extract, join and check data. Sound grounding in statistics and machine learning, including regression or classification, forecasting, validation, baseline comparisons and appropriate performance measures. Practical familiarity with using large language models in analysis or prototyping, including prompting, checking outputs against evidence and recognising privacy, accuracy and reliability risks. Experience preparing imperfect data, building reproducible analyses and writing maintainable code with version control and testing. Ability to take an ambiguous question from discovery to a working demonstration, explain assumptions and uncertainty, and judge whether a solution is worth developing for operational use. Confidence working independently and engaging stakeholders across teams, clear written and spoken English for technical and nontechnical audiences. A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field. Useful Additional Experience Experience working in public policy, government, research or evaluation Experience in consulting, public policy research or client-facing delivery, familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data pipelines or deployment. Experience building AI agents or applications that connect language models to data and tools, such as retrieval-based systems. We can train someone with strong core skills. What You Can Expect You will work alongside colleagues with a wide range of technical and subject expertise, tackle varied client challenges from discovery to delivery. We will support your career development with ongoing training and opportunities to deepen both your technical and consulting skills. Right to Work, Location & Sponsorship Role We welcome applications from candidates based anywhere in the world. For roles located in the UK, Belgium, Spain, or Germany , applicants must: Hold the right to work in the country where the role is based, or be eligible for visa sponsorship, which we may consider on a case-by-case basis, and Be physically present in that country by their first day of employment (or able to relocate beforehand). Unless stated otherwise, relocation support is not automatically provided. #Indeed Bot and Third-Party Applications Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance. Working at ICF ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future. Candidate AI Usage Policy At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair and equitable interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. …

items.desc: AI Engineer Wir suchen dich – werde Teil unseres Teams Du erweiterst unser Engineering-Team bei ti&m, eine breit aufgestellte Gruppe von Expertinnen und Experten, die gemeinsam innovative Lösungen entwickelt. Für ganz unterschiedliche Unternehmen setzen wir spannende Projekte um, oft auf der grünen Wiese, wo wir unsere Expertise von Beginn weg einbringen. In dieser Rolle steht Generative AI im Zentrum: Du baust Applikationen auf Basis von Large Language Models und bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Team in den produktiven Einsatz. Wir suchen dich: Mit Leidenschaft und Herzblut baust du erstklassige GenAI-Lösungen und passt fachlich wie menschlich gut zu uns. Dich erwartet eine kollegiale Atmosphäre und eine Arbeitsplatzkultur, bei der Können vor Hierarchie kommt. Was dich erwartet Spannende und innovative GenAI-Projekte für unsere Kunden: von Kreativ-Workshops über Proof-of-Concepts bis zur gemeinsamen Umsetzung produktiver Lösungen Konzeption und Implementierung von LLM-basierten Applikationen Design und Umsetzung von Retrieval-Augmented-Generation-Systemen (RAG) Umsetzung von Structured Information Extraction aus unstrukturierten Dokumenten Design und Realisierung von agentischen Systemen und AI-Workflows Prompt- und Context-Engineering zur gezielten Steuerung von LLM-basierten Lösungen Sorgfältige Evaluation deiner Lösungen nach dem Prinzip des Evaluation Driven Development (EDD), inklusive Observability über AI-Evaluation- und Observability -Plattformen Du bringst deine Expertise auch in die Angebotsphase ein und gestaltest Offerten fachlich mit Optionale Berührungspunkte mit klassischem Software Engineering und MLOps: Wo es Sinn ergibt, arbeitest du eng mit unseren Software- und ML-Engineers zusammen Fortwährendes Lernen und stetige Weiterbildung im Bereich GenAI sowie Einblicke in die verschiedenen Branchen unserer Kunden Abwechslung und spannende Zusammenarbeit in internen Projektteams sowie vor Ort bei unseren Kunden Was du mitbringst Einige Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von GenAI-Anwendungen, idealerweise im produktiven Einsatz für Kunden oder eigene Produkte Ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Informatik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet Nachgewiesene Expertise bei der Implementierung und Betrieb von Retrieval-Augmented-Generation-Systemen (RAG) Erfahrung mit agentischen Systemen und AI-Workflows sowie dem Model Context Protocol (MCP) Sorgfältiger Umgang mit der Evaluation von LLM-Lösungen, vertraut mit Evaluation Driven Development (EDD) und AI-Evaluation- und Observability -Plattformen (AEOPs) Vertraut mit modernen Vektordatenbanken, z. B. Qdrant, sowie mit Embedding- und Re-Ranking-Modellen Verständnis von Open-Weight Large Language Models, inklusive multimodaler Modelle Erfahrung mit LLM-Runtimes sowie LLM-Proxies bzw. Gateways Sicherer Umgang mit Python und Software-Engineering-Best-Practices Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Team und Kunden Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift Von Vorteil: Cloud-Erfahrung in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), sowie Erfahrung mit Guardrailing von LLM-Anwendungen Warum wir Swiss Arbeitgeber Award, Best of Swiss Apps oder Digital Economy Award. Unsere Arbeitsplatzkultur und unsere Projekte gewinnen Preise. Für unsere Kunden aus Banking, Retail oder Governance entwickeln wir nutzerzentrierte Digitalisierungslösungen. Abseits von vorgegebenen Pfaden kannst du bei uns Neues ausprobieren und dich so richtig austoben. Hier findest du alles, was dein Techie-Herz begehrt: In einem dynamischen und kollegialen Umfeld treibst du deine innovativen Ideen voran – natürlich immer mithilfe der neuesten Technologien. Apropos Arbeitsplatzkultur: Agilität fordern wir nicht nur bei unseren Projekten, sondern fördern sie auch für unsere Mitarbeitenden. Mit ti&m liquid working bieten wir einfach anpassbare Arbeitszeitmodelle und die Möglichkeit, Auszeiten zu nehmen. Und mit unserer ti&m academy entscheidest du, wo und wie du dich weiterbilden willst.

items.desc: Om arbetsplatsen Landskrona är på frammarsch på många plan. Nya områden med havsnära boende växer fram och allt fler företag väljer att etablera sig just här. Läget mitt i Öresundsregionen med närhet till bad och stad, natur och kultur lockar allt fler till inflyttning, etablering och besök. I Landskrona stad med drygt 3300 medarbetare arbetar vi efter vår värdegrund BRA, där B står för bemötande, R för resultat och A för ansvar. Vår värdegrund ska genomsyra all vår verksamhet och vi ska vara en arbetsplats där du känner arbetsglädje och stolthet. Här finns utrymme för dig med mod och handlingskraft och du får möjlighet att utvecklas. Vill du vara med och påverka utvecklingen i en av Skånes mest spännande städer? Välkommen med din ansökan! Arbetsuppgifter Vill du vara med och skapa moderna effektiva lösningar för både invånare och anställda som gör skillnad? Nu söker vi en driven och engagerad AI-tjänstutvecklare med fokus på verksamhetsutveckling som tillsammans med oss vill vara med och utveckla och bidra till en smartare stad att leva och verka i. Som AI-tjänstutvecklare hos oss får du bidra till att forma framtidens offentliga tjänster och arbetssätt. Du utvecklar AI-lösningar samtidigt som du hjälper våra verksamheter att identifiera behov, utforska möjligheter och omsätta idéer till praktisk nytta. Du kommer att arbeta nära stadens AI-samordnare, projektledare, tekniker och verksamhetsrepresentanter och vara med och driva Landskrona stads utveckling inom AI-området. I rollen som AI-tjänstutvecklare kommer du bland annat att: Identifiera verksamhetsbehov och driva utvecklingen av AI-lösningar. Utveckla, testa, validera och dokumentera AI-baserade lösningar, såsom assistenter, agenter, modeller och applikationer. Stödja och vägleda verksamheterna i användningen av AI, bland annat genom att utveckla assistenter, skapa effektiva prompts och sprida kunskap om AI:s möjligheter. Leda och delta i workshops, behovsdialoger och andra aktiviteter. Omvärldsbevaka utvecklingen inom AI samt omsätta nya tekniker, arbetssätt och regelverk till praktisk nytta för staden. Förvalta stadens centrala AI-plattformar och följa upp användning, kostnader och vidareutveckling av dessa. Vårt erbjudande Hos oss får duen strategiskt viktig roll där du kombinerar teknik, innovation och verksamhetsutveckling för att skapa nytta för både medarbetare och invånare. Landskrona stad har höga ambitioner inom digitalisering, korta beslutsvägar och stora möjligheter att påverka. Du kommer att arbeta brett över stadens verksamheter tillsammans med engagerade kollegor i en miljö som präglas av samarbete, utveckling och nytänkande. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som kombinerar teknisk kompetens med ett starkt intresse för verksamhetsutveckling och AI. Du är nyfiken, initiativrik och drivs av att omsätta idéer till lösningar som skapar nytta. Rollen kräver att du är kommunikativ, lyhörd och har lätt för att bygga förtroendefulla relationer samt förstå verksamheternas behov. Du trivs med att ta ansvar, driva frågor framåt och samarbeta med olika funktioner. Samtidigt är du prestigelös, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till andras utveckling. Du arbetar strukturerat och lösningsorienterat, är flexibel och har förmåga att se både helhet och detaljer. Framför allt motiveras du av att använda teknik för att förenkla, förbättra och skapa värde för verksamheten och invånarna. Krav Relevant högskoleutbildning inom exempelvis systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, datateknik eller motsvarande kompetens från arbetslivserfarenhet. Några års erfarenhet av systemutveckling, från arbete eller egna projekt. Praktisk erfarenhet av att utveckla AI-baserade lösningar, exempelvis med generativ AI. God förståelse för LLM:er och hur AI-tjänster integreras i applikationer. Goda programmeringskunskaper i exempelvis Python eller annat relevant språk samt erfarenhet av att arbeta med API:er, RAG och MCP. Erfarenhet av att analysera verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dem till tekniska lösningar. Erfarenhet av att leda workshops och behovsdialoger samt att förklara tekniska möjligheter och begränsningar för målgrupper med olika förkunskaper. Kunskap om GDPR, informationssäkerhet och dataskydd. Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift. Utöver dessa krav är det meriterande med erfarenhet av AI-arbete inom offentlig sektor. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas. I denna rekrytering ber vi dig att bifoga ditt CV samt besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor. Syftet med urvalsfrågorna är att skapa en effektivare och mer rättvis rekryteringsprocess, där alla kandidater bedöms utifrån samma kompetensbaserade kriterier. Välkommen med din ansökan! items.desc: Functie omschrijving Samen met je collega's help je opdrachtgevers bij complexe data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je brengt hun uitdaging terug tot een heldere aanpak en vertaalt data naar inzichten, modellen en toepassingen die in de praktijk gebruikt kunnen worden. Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe vragen vertalen naar praktische oplossingen. Je kunt opdrachtgevers niet alleen technisch, maar ook op strategisch niveau adviseren. Je hebt ruime ervaring met Python, SQL en databases. Je hebt ervaring met ETL-tooling en het ontwikkelen van datapipelines. Je hebt gewerkt met Azure en/of Google Cloud Platform. Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen en toepassen van algoritmes en machinelearningmodellen. Je hebt ervaring met generatieve AI en large language models. items.desc: Rejoignez un environnement de conseil en ingénierie où votre expertise en vision industrielle contribuera directement à la conception de solutions technologiques utiles, fiables et adaptées aux réalités des sites de production. Dans le cadre de projets menés pour un client industriel, vous intervenez sur des systèmes de computer vision destinés à améliorer le contrôle qualité, la détection de défauts, le guidage robotique ou encore l’analyse automatisée de procédés. Votre rôle combine compréhension du besoin métier, choix des architectures techniques, développement algorithmique et accompagnement de l’intégration sur le terrain. Vous travaillerez en interaction avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires réunissant ingénieurs systèmes, automaticiens, roboticiens, équipes qualité et responsables industriels. La fonction laisse place à l’exploration, tout en exigeant une approche structurée : observer, formuler des hypothèses, tester, mesurer les résultats et transformer les conclusions en solutions déployables. Vous serez également amené(e) à partager vos choix techniques, à sécuriser les performances des applications et à contribuer à une démarche de progrès collectif. Analyser les besoins fonctionnels et les contraintes d’environnement des applications de vision industrielle. Concevoir et développer des solutions de computer vision pour l’inspection, la mesure, la classification ou le guidage. Sélectionner et paramétrer les caméras, optiques, éclairages, capteurs et composants nécessaires. Développer, entraîner et évaluer des algorithmes de traitement d’image et, selon les projets, des modèles de deep learning. Réaliser les essais, caractériser les performances et contribuer à la validation des solutions. Participer à l’intégration avec les automates, robots, systèmes de supervision et équipements de production. Documenter les choix techniques, les protocoles d’essai, les résultats et les conditions de maintenance. Collaborer avec les parties prenantes du projet et proposer des ajustements fondés sur les données observées. ​ Pour réussir dans cette mission, vous disposez d’une expérience suffisamment solide pour prendre en charge un sujet de vision industrielle avec autonomie, tout en sachant solliciter les expertises nécessaires lorsque le contexte l’exige. Nous recherchons une personne capable de relier les concepts de traitement d’image aux contraintes concrètes d’une ligne de production : variabilité des pièces, tolérances, cadence, luminosité, vibrations, disponibilité des équipements et exigences de traçabilité. Votre parcours vous a permis de développer une méthode de travail rigoureuse, depuis la compréhension du problème jusqu’à la mise en service et au suivi des performances. Au-delà de la maîtrise technique, votre capacité à expliquer une décision, à faire dialoguer plusieurs métiers et à transformer une difficulté en piste d’amélioration sera déterminante. Vous appréciez les environnements où les idées se construisent collectivement, où l’on confronte les approches et où l’on recherche une réponse proportionnée aux priorités du client. Une curiosité technique, associée à un sens pratique affirmé, vous permettra d’explorer de nouvelles voies sans perdre de vue la fiabilité attendue. Formation supérieure de niveau Bac+5, diplôme d’ingénieur ou master en vision industrielle, informatique, traitement du signal, automatique, robotique ou domaine proche. Expérience professionnelle de 5 à 10 ans dans la vision industrielle, le traitement d’image ou le développement de systèmes automatisés. Maîtrise des principes de formation d’image, calibration, segmentation, détection, reconnaissance, mesure et classification. Expérience avec des outils ou bibliothèques de vision tels qu’OpenCV, HALCON, Cognex, Keyence ou équivalents. Bonne pratique d’un langage de programmation adapté aux projets, notamment Python, C++ ou C#. Connaissances en apprentissage automatique et en deep learning appliqués à l’image, selon les besoins de la mission. Compréhension des environnements industriels, des contraintes d’intégration et des échanges avec les automates ou équipements de production. Capacité à rédiger une documentation technique claire et à présenter les résultats à des interlocuteurs techniques ou métiers. Anglais professionnel apprécié pour la lecture de documentation et les échanges dans un contexte international. Autonomie, esprit d’analyse, sens du collectif et aptitude à avancer de manière structurée face à un problème complexe. ​ Le salaire proposé pour ce poste se situe entre 35 000 € et 50 000 € brut par an, selon votre expérience et vos qualifications. ​ HOUSE OF ABY : un terrain de jeu unique pour nos talents ! Le Groupe HOUSE OF ABY rassemble 10 marques complémentaires au sein d’un même écosystème, couvrant des secteurs variés tels que l’aéronautique, le digital, le nucléaire, le pharmaceutique, le ferroviaire et l’infrastructure... Cette diversité fait de HOUSE OF ABY un véritable terrain de jeu professionnel, …

items.desc: Contribuer à relever les défis actuels et futurs pour préserver notre monde et construire celui de demain tout en prenant soin de la santé de chacun, c'est stimulant pour vous. Pour nous aussi. En rejoignant le groupe Orano, acteur international de référence dans le nucléaire, vous êtes au bon endroit. Chaque jour nous nous mobilisons pour produire une énergie bas carbone efficace, pour lutter contre le réchauffement climatique, pour trouver des solutions économes en ressources naturelles et participer au progrès en matière de santé. Nos atouts ? Sur l'ensemble du cycle du combustible : une grande maîtrise des technologies de pointe, des produits et services sûrs et à forte valeur ajoutée, des expertises pointues et une grande capacité d'innovation. Autant d'arguments qui révèlent les fortes compétences de nos 18 000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices que nous veillons à faire évoluer constamment. Riches de leur différence en termes de profils ou d'expériences, preuve de notre ouverture à tous les talents; ils partagent la même ambition : donner toute sa valeur au nucléaire. Orano MELOX, implanté à Bagnols-sur-Cèze, est un site industriel de référence dédié à la fabrication de combustibles MOX. Dans le cadre de sa transformation digitale et de l'amélioration continue de sa performance industrielle, l'établissement développe la valorisation de ses données afin de mieux comprendre les phénomènes affectant les installations, détecter les signaux faibles et éclairer les décisions opérationnelles. Au sein de la Direction Qualité Performance (DQP), vous rejoignez une fonction Data Science en interface avec l'ensemble des directions du site. Vous contribuez au développement d'une culture de la donnée et au déploiement de solutions Data et Intelligence Artificielle au service de la performance, de la qualité, de la productivité et de la pérennité de l'usine. Missions principales -Collecter, explorer et structurer les données industrielles issues des différents systèmes de l'usine. -Développer et maintenir des pipelines de traitement et de valorisation des données. -Concevoir des bases de données et des outils permettant d'exploiter efficacement les données métier. -Réaliser des analyses statistiques et développer des indicateurs d'aide à la décision. -Développer des applications et des outils internes répondant aux besoins opérationnels des équipes. -Participer à la conception et au développement de solutions innovantes basées sur la donnée (IA générative, RAG, Computer Vision, analyses avancées, agents IA, etc.). -Collaborer avec les métiers afin de comprendre leurs problématiques, identifier les opportunités de valorisation de la donnée et proposer des solutions adaptées. -Accompagner les projets depuis l'identification du besoin jusqu'au démonstrateur (POC), puis participer à leur transfert vers les équipes d'industrialisation. Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une formation Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur, Master universitaire ou équivalent) avec une spécialisation en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou Science des données Vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences au service de projets concrets au sein d'un environnement industriel stimulant ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Vos atouts : Excellente maîtrise de Python et des bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel. Solides connaissances en traitement, analyse et valorisation des données . Bonne compréhension des concepts de Data Science , de Machine Learning et d' Intelligence Artificielle . Intérêt marqué pour les environnements industriels et la compréhension des enjeux métiers. Capacité à intervenir sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée : collecte, structuration, analyse, développement d'outils et restitution des résultats. Goût pour l'innovation et aptitude à développer rapidement des POC , démonstrateurs ou prototypes. Esprit d'initiative, autonomie et capacité à transformer des besoins opérationnels en solutions à forte valeur ajoutée. Excellentes qualités relationnelles permettant de collaborer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs variés.

items.desc: 🚀 UST is looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our family! More in detail, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer and Great Place to Work company with over 35.000 employees all over the world and a presence in more than 35 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large-scale technologic solutions to big companies. 🔍 What are we looking for? We are looking for a AI Software Engineer to contribute in a project with one of our global customers in wealth management. We are building a very strong team comprised of high caliber professionals that will work closely with the client’s IT and Business stakeholders to deliver impactful programs. You will have the opportunity to work on challenging projects with talented colleagues in an international environment while developing your domain knowledge working for a top company. Work model is hybrid in Madrid (3 days at the office, 2 WFH), feel free to apply if you are also open for relocation! Your main tasks and accountabilities will be: Own the engineering and integration layer of AI capabilities into the software delivery toolchain, ensuring secure, scalable, and maintainable delivery of AI solutions through automation and collaboration with platform teams. Collaborate closely with AI Product Engineers and platform teams to define and scope opportunities for AI-driven innovation. Prototype and validate Large Language Model (LLM)-based or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines to drive business value. Contribute to AI-driven automation efforts across developer productivity platforms, enhancing efficiency and effectiveness. Develop and maintain APIs, pipelines, and service integrations for AI features within existing platforms, such as Corporate Identity (CI)/Corporate Design (CD), observability, and developer workplace. Ensure traceability, logging, and compliance of integrated solutions, adhering to enterprise standards and security best practices. Drive best practices for automation, monitoring, and reproducibility, promoting a culture of continuous improvement. What do we expect from you? 3-5 years of experience as a software engineer or DevOps/MLOps specialist, with expertise in AI integration and process automation. In-depth understanding of CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms, containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and APIs. Hands-on experience integrating Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI solutions into production environments, emphasizing scalability, security, and maintainability. Strong focus on security, with familiarity with enterprise-grade tools and adherence to data protection and compliance standards. Skilled at working within agile, cross-functional teams, paired with excellent communication and collaboration abilities. Holds a bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science or a related field, or demonstrates equivalent professional experience. items.desc: Job Description Utvikler (AI) Bygg løsninger som skaper verdi Å velge Capgemini betyr å velge et selskap der du former din egen karriere, med støtte fra et sterkt fellesskap av kolleger – lokalt og globalt. Bli med og bidra til å skape verdi for noen av verdens ledende organisasjoner. Om rollen Capgemini Kristiansand er et ledende teknologi- og rådgivningsmiljø på Sørlandet. Vi kombinerer tett lokal lagånd med kraften i Capgeminis globale nettverk på over 400 000 ansatte, og leverer til kunder blant annet innen telekom, industri, energi og offentlig sektor. Hos oss står nytenkning i fokus – kunstig intelligens er et kjerneelement i løsningene vi bygger. AI og agentisk AI er i kjernen av Capgeminis strategi, med egne AI-laber og forskningsmiljøer i ryggen. Nå søker vi en utvikler som vil bygge løsninger der AI er en integrert del av funksjonaliteten, og være med å forme hvordan utvikling gjøres når AI sitter i teamet. Vi bygger i Java og C#/.NET på Azure, AWS og GCP, og jobber med modeller og plattformer fra blant annet OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft og Google. I denne rollen vil du blant annet: Bygge løsninger der AI er en integrert del av funksjonaliteten – fra intelligente assistenter og RAG-baserte kunnskapstjenester til automatiserte prosesser. Bruke agentisk AI og verktøy som GitHub Copilot, Claude Code og OpenAI Codex til å skrive og forbedre kode raskere. Jobbe i tverrfaglige team fra idé og prototyping til produksjon, og utforske ny teknologi der den gir reell verdi. Job Description - Grade Specific Din profil Minst 3 års erfaring som utvikler, og god i Java eller C#/.NET. Erfaring med skyteknologi (Azure, AWS eller GCP), for eksempel containere og CI/CD. Bruker AI aktivt i utviklingsarbeidet, eller er nysgjerrig på å komme dit. Kommuniserer flytende på norsk og engelsk, og trives i tverrfaglige team. Erfaring fra konsulentbransjen, telekom eller industri er et pluss. Hvorfor vi tror du vil trives hos oss Et miljø der AI er en naturlig del av hverdagen – du er med og former hvordan programvare lages fremover. En variert prosjektportefølje, fra vekstselskaper til store internasjonale virksomheter. Sterkt fokus på din utvikling: mentorer, personlig utviklingsplan og gode kurs- og sertifiseringsmuligheter. Konkurransedyktige betingelser: fleksibel arbeidshverdag, fem uker ferie og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Søknad Send oss din CV og søknad snarest – søknader vurderes fortløpende. Spørsmål? Kontakt Øyvind Mjølund, Subpractice Lead, Cloud & Custom Applications Sørlandet: oyvind.mjolund@capgemini.com Som en del av vår rekrutteringsprosess vil identitetsverifisering bli gjennomført ved kontroll av ID-kort, og bakgrunnssjekker kan utføres ved behov.
