Har du en stark bakgrund inom fullstackutveckling och vill arbeta i framkant med AI, interna agenter och moderna plattformslösningar? Då kan det här vara nästa steg i din karriär! OM ROLLEN Som AI-utvecklare hos Martin & Servera blir du en viktig del av ett mindre AI-team som befinner sig i en spännande uppbyggnadsfas. Tillsammans utvecklar ni AI-drivna verktyg, interna agenter och affärsnära lösningar som frigör tid, höjer kvaliteten och effektiviserar verksamhetens processer. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från analys och design till utveckling, test, release, drift och kontinuerlig förbättring. Rollen har ett tydligt fullstackfokus där du bygger användarvänliga lösningar i React och TypeScript samt robusta API:er och integrationer i Node och TypeScript. Martin & Servera bygger en egen AI-plattform med flera interna lösningar som redan används inom bland annat HR, utvecklingsstöd, kundservice, artikeldata, e-handel samt kategori och inköp. Här får du möjlighet att vidareutveckla befintliga lösningar och vara med och forma plattformens fortsatta utveckling. I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att Utveckla och vidareutveckla Martin & Serveras AI-plattform, interna AI-agenter och affärsnära lösningar. Bygga tillgängliga och snabba användarflöden i React och TypeScript. Utveckla API:er och integrationer i Node och TypeScript. Arbeta med AI-relaterade områden som RAG, agentiska lösningar, minne, verktyg, guardrails och felhantering. Säkerställa kvalitet, datasäkerhet, spårbarhet och hantering av personuppgifter. Bidra till testautomation, CI/CD, observability och stabila releaseflöden. Samarbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå behov, testa idéer och skapa mätbar användarnytta. Delta i code reviews, dokumentation, kunskapsdelning samt incident- och problemhantering. Du blir en del av ett produktteam med ansvar enligt principen ”you build it, you run it”. Det innebär att du får vara med och påverka hela vägen från idé till en långsiktigt hållbar lösning i produktion. DIN PROFIL Vi Söker Dig Som Har Flerårig erfarenhet av systemutveckling. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av React och TypeScript. Erfarenhet av React med SSR. Erfarenhet av API-utveckling och integrationer, gärna i Node och TypeScript. Erfarenhet av hela utvecklingslivscykeln, från design och utveckling till driftsättning och förvaltning. Erfarenhet av Azure och CI/CD-flöden. God förståelse för datasäkerhet och hantering av personuppgifter. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska. Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Meriterande Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av AI-SDK:er, agentiska ramverk, RAG eller LLMOps/MLOps. Vi ser även positivt på erfarenhet av observability, testautomation och kvalitetssäkring av AI-lösningar. Tidigare yrkeserfarenhet inom AI är meriterande, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är att du har en stark fullstackbakgrund, ett stort teknikintresse och en vilja att utvecklas vidare inom AI. För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är initiativtagande och van att driva ditt arbete framåt. Du samarbetar väl med andra, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och har ett tydligt fokus på användar- och verksamhetsnytta. Eftersom AI-området utvecklas snabbt behöver du också vara nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och bekväm med att arbeta i en miljö där alla svar inte finns från början. OM ORGANISATIONEN Tillsammans gör vi på Martin & Servera skillnad för alla som älskar mat och dryck. Med omtanke om varandra, våra kunder och planeten driver vi varje dag restaurangbranschen framåt. Och som medarbetare hos oss är du en viktig del av helheten. Här tas dina erfarenheter, idéer och kunskaper tillvara. Stabilt och långsiktigt Vi har en stark och långsiktig ägare i form av familjeägda Axel Johnson, vilket skapar både trygghet och stora utvecklingsmöjligheter inom koncernen. Vi erbjuder dig Hos oss får du ett spännande jobb med goda förmåner som till exempel ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag, sjukvårdande bidrag och lunchsubvention. Vi utmanar oss själva och värdesätter prestationer på samma sätt som vi värnar om en bra balans mellan jobb och privatliv. Vi erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete två dagar i veckan. En trygg och säker arbetsmiljö är grundläggande för oss. Därför följer vi upp vår alkohol- och drogpolicy genom test under den inledande anställningsperioden och därefter genom kontinuerliga slumpmässiga tester på samtliga arbetsplatser. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Placeringen är på Martin & Serveras kontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm. Välkommen till oss! Kontakt I denna rekrytering samarbetar Martin&Servera med Wise. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail, utan du söker enkelt med ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil på wise.se. Vi använder kompetensbaserad rekrytering som metod. Det gör vi i vår strävan efter en mer potentialbaserad matchning. …

items.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
items.card: The Role CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them. These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs: They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts.
items.desc: About CircuitHub CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries. We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies. The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further. The Role CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them. These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs: They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts. They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part. They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines. They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs. They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session. What you'll do Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance. How We Build Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level. Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change. Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters. Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice. Recent work Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked. A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half. Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice. Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66. A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people. What we look for You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working. You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security. You build the eval before you trust the result. You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°. Bonus: computer vision, optimisation or electronics. Stack Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Claude and OpenAI APIs, MCP, skills in plain Markdown Code: TypeScript (Bun, React), Python (FastAPI, Dagster, OpenCV, OR-Tools), PostgreSQL Infra: Nix and NixOS, Nomad, Terraform, Vault, AWS, Modal sandboxes, OpenTelemetry Pay UK £80k–£125k US $125k–$250k, depending on experience, plus equity. Compensation Range: £80K - £125K

items.desc: T'apassiona la tecnologia i vols participar en projectes de desenvolupament d'IA? Tenim l'oportunitat ideal per a tu! Per a empresa tecnològica, dedicada a la implantació i desenvolupament de solucions de negoci per a empreses industrials, busquem un/a Desenvolupador/a IA i processos. Reportant directament a Direcció, la persona tindrà un paper clau en l'optimització de processos de negoci i en la implementació pràctica de la intel·ligència artificial. Busquem una persona amb curiositat i passió que vulgui analitzar i entendre els processos de gestió de les empreses per millorar-los i automatitzar-los, aplicant solucions tecnològiques i eines d'IA per donar valor real al seu negoci. Principals funcions: Analitzar els processos de negoci (compres, vendes, magatzem, administració, etc.) per identificar oportunitats de millora, simplificació i automatització. Dissenyar i simplificar els processos abans de digitalitzar-los, automatitzant fluxos de treball i integracions entre sistemes (ERP, CRM, correu, gestió documental). Crear i implementar agents i assistents basats en LLMs connectats a dades reals de negoci. Desenvolupar integracions via API/MCP, enginyeria de prompts, RAG i cerca semàntica sobre documentació corporativa. Automatitzar processos documentals (extracció de dades en PDFs/OCR, validació creuada i registre automàtic). Desenvolupar i evolucionar mòduls de negoci i eines internes en entorns .NET / C# i web (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript). Modelar i optimitzar bases de dades sobre SQL Server (consultes complexes, procediments emmagatzemats en T-SQL i millora de rendiment). Acompanyar en la posada en marxa de les solucions i validar el seu funcionament en el dia a dia. Es requereix: Mentalitat de startup, iniciativa, curiositat i passió per la tecnologia. Comprensió dels processos empresarials i orientació a la resolució de problemes de negoci. Interès i motivació per explorar i implementar constantment noves eines d'IA. Capacitat de treure idees endavant amb autonomia i adaptabilitat als canvis tecnològics. Bones habilitats per treballar en equip i integrar-se en un entorn dinàmic. Horari flexible amb entrada de 7:30 h a 9:00 h, jornada diària de 8 hores i divendres de jornada intensiva. Possibilitat de teletreball (1 dia a la setmana) un cop superat el període d'adaptació. items.desc: Forward Deployed Engineer | AI Startup | London | upto £160k + Equity What do aircraft, medical devices, lifts and electric vehicle batteries all have in common? They all need to be tested, inspected and certified before they can be used. Yet much of the industry responsible for this still runs on PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Imagine what you could build with AI to change that. The company I'm working with an early-stage AI startup that's just raised $4.5m in seed funding, in a round that was 14 times oversubscribed and backed by two of the world's leading venture capital firms. They're building AI-powered software for an enormous industry that most people probably haven't thought much about. Every aircraft, medical device, lift, battery and building needs to go through testing, inspection and certification processes. Despite how important this work is, much of the industry still relies on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and emails. That's what this company is changing. The traction has been pretty remarkable. They've gone from one customer to having their technology deployed within six of the ten largest enterprises in their industry in just a year. They're now looking to hire five Forward Deployed Engineers as they continue to grow. The challenge How do you turn decades of messy documents, manual processes and complex enterprise workflows into software that actually works? And how do you do it quickly, without compromising on engineering quality? Those are the problems you'll be solving. This isn't a role where you'll spend months building features without ever speaking to the people using them. You'll be working directly with customers, understanding how their businesses operate and building software that solves their actual problems. You'll have ownership across the entire product, from frontend and backend engineering through to data models and AI-powered workflows. You'll be building and shipping: Full-stack applications using TypeScript, React, Node.js and Python AI-powered workflows and LLM integrations Backend systems, APIs and data models Solutions to complex enterprise problems, working directly with customers End-to-end products, from initial concept through to production You'll own technical decisions, ship quickly and improve what you build based on real customer feedback. What are we looking for? 3–6 years of full-time software or product engineering experience Early employee or founding engineer at a top-tier, venture-backed startup Degree from a highly regarded university, ideally UK top 10 or equivalent Strong full-stack skills across TypeScript, React, Node.js and Python Experience designing APIs, databases and backend architecture Proven track record of building and shipping end-to-end products to production Experience working directly with enterprise customers, gathering requirements and delivering solutions Comfortable taking technical ownership and making decisions in a fast-paced startup Able to work onsite in Shoreditch five days per week Nice to have Previous Forward Deployed Engineering experience Experience with LLMs, AI applications or document intelligence Previous experience as a founder or founding engineer The package £100,000–£160,000 base salary Meaningful equity Shoreditch, London, five days per week onsite Visa sponsorship considered Why would you leave a comfortable engineering job to join a 20-person startup? How about £160k, meaningful equity, backing from two of the world's leading VCs and a product already being used by some of the biggest companies in its industry? This is a business with serious backing, genuine enterprise adoption and an opportunity for engineers joining now to have a real influence on what gets built. They're particularly interested in people who have already experienced the early stages of building a successful technology company and want to do it again. The interview process An initial 25-minute conversation with the hiring manager, followed by a 40-minute technical discussion with the Lead Engineer, a three-hour take-home assessment and a final conversation with the CTO. Interested? Reach out to me directly or click the apply button and let's get talking. Contact Mo at Kairos Talent : 📞 020 3769 9017 | ✉️ mo@kairostalent.ai | For more AI/ML jobs check out 🌐 kairostalent.ai/jobs #ForwardDeployedEngineer #FullStackEngineer #SoftwareEngineering #AI #TypeScript #Python #React #StartupJobs #LondonJobs #Hiring

items.desc: About the Role We are looking for a curious, hands-on engineer to help Newsmatics identify and build practical AI agents that solve real problems. You will work with people across the company, turn promising ideas into prototypes, and develop the most useful ones into reliable solutions. For example, you might build an agent that discovers newly launched online publications and adds relevant information to our data workflows. Some agents will support our internal teams, while others may develop into customer-facing products. This role suits someone early in their career who already has practical experience experimenting with AI agents, enjoys building things, and learns quickly. About Us Newsmatics is a privately held global News Tech company headquartered in Washington, D.C. We build platforms for media monitoring, analytics, news distribution, and news transparency. Our brands include EIN Presswire, Affinity Group Publishing, Newsmatics News Index, and Perspectify. We collect and structure large volumes of global news and publisher data. Our international remote-first team values autonomy, curiosity, accountability, and measurable impact. What You Will Do Identify useful opportunities for AI agents across Newsmatics. Build and test agents for internal and customer-facing use cases. Connect agents to company data, documents, APIs, search systems, and external tools using MCP. Gather feedback and evaluate the impact, reliability, security, and cost of different solutions. Follow new AI models, tools, and best practices, and explore how they could apply at Newsmatics. What We Are Looking For Practical programming skills in Python or TypeScript. Hands-on experience building AI agents or LLM-powered applications, including working with agent frameworks, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and connecting agents to external tools or data sources. Familiarity with APIs, databases, and backend development. Awareness of how to test AI solutions and assess their limitations, security risks, and costs. Ability to recognize when simpler automation or conventional software may be a better choice than an AI agent. Curiosity about applied AI, a habit of following emerging tools and best practices, and the ability to turn an open-ended problem into a working solution. Initiative and the ability to collaborate effectively in English within a remote international team. Experience with cloud services or deploying AI solutions to production is an advantage, but not a requirement. We value practical skills, curiosity, and the ability to learn more than years of professional experience. Environment & Technologies Our environment includes Python, TypeScript, REST APIs, AWS, Linux, LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and Docker. You do not need experience with all of these technologies. What We Offer The opportunity to build AI agents with visible impact across an international news technology company. Long-term, full-time contractor engagement with 100% remote work and flexible working hours. A collaborative international environment with regular communication via Slack and Google Meet. How to Apply Please send us your CV in English and show us an AI agent or LLM-powered application you have built. It may be a professional, university, open-source, hackathon, or personal project. Briefly describe what it does and how it works.

Cette équipe de 10 personnes accompagne les 16 domaines de la DSI (730 licences Claude) dans l’intégration de l’IA dans leurs pratiques quotidiennes : automatisation du process projet IRIS, évolution des métiers augmentés (AMOA, MOE, développeurs, architectes…), réduction du time-to-market et des coûts. Au sein de l’équipe IA, le/la Chef.fe de projet IA générative / Adoption IA contribue au développement, à l’industrialisation et à la mise à disposition des services d’IA générative auprès des collaborateurs. Le poste porte notamment les outils et services IA , leur évolution et leur qualité de service : Hub IA, Marketplace, gestion des sollicitations, indicateurs de pilotage, licences et dispositifs associés. Pourquoi choisir AMEG GROUP ? Proximité et Accessibilité : Bénéficiez de la flexibilité et de la réactivité d'un groupe à taille humaine, avec des agences locales proches de vous et des Managers à votre écoute. Projets Ambitieux : Participez à des projets innovants, tout en bénéficiant de l'accompagnement personnalisé. Développement et Évolution : Profitez d'une culture d'entreprise qui favorise l'échange, la reconnaissance, le développement et la mise en valeur continus des compétences. Rejoignez-nous pour une carrière enrichissante, où votre talent et votre engagement feront la différence ! Poste: Dans le cadre de la fiabilisation et de l’amélioration continue d’un système d’inspection par vision industrielle (SIS) sur une ligne de production industrielle, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur en Vision Industrielle. Missions : Diagnostic & Caractérisation Analyser les performances actuelles du système d’inspection (taux de détection, faux positifs, faux négatifs). Caractériser les défauts produits (typologie, variabilité, criticité). Identifier et cartographier les causes d’instabilité et de dérive (éclairage, réglages, algorithmes, conditions de prise de vue). Optimisation & Amélioration du Système Optimiser les algorithmes de détection et de classification des défauts. Re-paramétrer et mettre à jour le système de vision pour réduire la surdétection (faux défauts) et éviter les non-détections. Améliorer la robustesse, la répétabilité et la reproductibilité du système dans le temps. Analyse de Données & Pilotage de la Performance Structurer et exploiter les données de détection (SQL, bases d'images, historiques). Mettre en place des indicateurs de performance (KPI vision : taux de faux rejets, taux de non-détection, stabilité). Créer et déployer un tableau de bord de suivi. Validation & Qualification Industrielle Définir un protocole de validation (échantillonnage, tests). Valider industriellement les améliorations apportées et établir des standards de vérification périodique. Transfert de Compétences & Autonomisation Former les équipes de journée aux réglages et au paramétrage du système. Former les opérateurs et équipes postées à l’utilisation et au diagnostic du système. Rendre les responsables d'exploitation et de production autonomes dans le pilotage de l'outil. Documentation Technique Rédiger le dossier documentaire complet : modes opératoires, fiches de réglage standardisées, guides d'utilisation simplifiés, fiches réflexes et aides au dépannage/diagnostic. Profil: Formation & Expérience : Diplôme d'Ingénieur ou Bac+5 spécialisé en vision industrielle, traitement d'image ou automatisme. Expérience avérée d'au moins 5 ans sur un poste similaire en environnement industriel. Compétences Techniques : Solide expérience sur les systèmes de vision industrielle (ex: Cognex, Ametek, Deepgray ou équivalents). Maîtrise des techniques de traitement d'image (des connaissances en Deep Learning sont un plus). Maîtrise des bases de données (SQL, Access, etc.). Compétences Transversales : Esprit d'analyse, capacité de diagnostic sur le terrain, rigueur et pragmatisme.

items.desc: ¡Hola! Somos OGA Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo. Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico. Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico. Sobre la posición. Buscamos Doctores/as que quieran desarrollarse en el entorno de la Inteligencia Artificial para unirse a nuestro equipo. ¿Qué harás? Análisis de datos y desarrollo de aplicaciones de optimización de procesos complejos con técnicas tanto de Inteligencia Artificial como de Investigación Operativa, utilizando entre otros, lenguajes de programación como Python, Java, JavaScript o C++. Analizar, depurar, transformar, visualizar, etc. los datos disponibles para proyectos de IA, utilizando las herramientas y tecnologías necesarias en cada caso concreto. Realizar el EDA (Exploratory Data Analysis) de los datos para proporcionar un buen conjunto de datos a los modelos de IA. Utilización de diferentes modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning, los cuales serán entrenados, validados y testados en función de los objetivos de cada proyecto. Tuning de modelos ML/DL. Investigación e implementación de algoritmos y herramientas de ML/DL. Implementación del pipeline completo de un modelo de ML/DL (Datasource, Limpieza datos, Ingeniería de Variables, Entrenamientos, Validación, Puesta en producción y Monitorización/Operación). Desarrollarás e implementarás soluciones tecnológicas avanzadas basadas en investigaciones de vanguardia. Diseñarás y supervisarás proyectos complejos en áreas como Inteligencia Artificial, sistemas distribuidos, ciberseguridad o big data. Realizarás investigaciones originales para resolver problemas informáticos y tecnológicos novedosos. Publicarás resultados de investigaciones en revistas científicas y participarás en conferencias internacionales. Colaborarás con equipos multidisciplinarios para integrar tecnologías en diferentes sectores. Asesorarás y liderarás proyectos de innovación tecnológica en empresas o instituciones. Diseñarás y optimizarás algoritmos para mejorar la eficiencia y el rendimiento de sistemas informáticos. Supervisarás y mentorizarás a estudiantes de maestría o doctorado en proyectos de investigación. Implementarás prototipos y validarás soluciones en entornos reales o simulados. Te mantendrás al día con las últimas tendencias y avances tecnológicos para aplicarlos en investigaciones y proyectos. Timing de primeras semanas en OGA Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación. ¿Qué requerimos? Doctorado en Ingeniería Informática. Haber participado en proyectos de Inteligencia Artificial, técnicamente complejos. Tratamiento de datos: Captura, almacenamiento, normalización, limpieza y visualización de datos masivos. ETLs, modelos de datos. Identificación proactiva de los casos de uso de LLMs/NLP más relevantes en colaboración con stakeholders. Imprescindible nivel alto: Python. Valorable el conocimiento de otras plataformas y lenguajes. ¿Qué valoramos? Conocimientos en evaluación de los pros y los contras de diferentes enfoques de NLP y plataformas de Inteligencia Artificial generativa. Conocimientos en Bases de datos Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL y MS SQL/SQL Azure y del entorno de desarrollo en Microsoft Azure. Nivel de inglés C1. Nivel medio-alto en lenguajes de programación (C++ o Java y Python). Interés por el desarrollo de una carrera técnica y vocación por la especialización tecnológica. Pasión por la tecnología y por la creación de valor para el cliente. Trabajo en equipo y espíritu colaborativo. Orientación a resultados, proactividad, trabajo en equipo. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla. items.desc: Senior Quantitative Researcher – Sports betting Hedge fund Football – London *Please note this role cannot sponsor. Please do not apply if you are seeking sponsorship* Job Summary Quantitative Researcher is required for exciting and progressive Sports betting Hedge fund Company with office in London. You will be developing statistical models to compute the probabilities of outcomes in football. Sports modelling is their core expertise and the company is structuring the company around creating the best possible technical and cultural environment to enable you to rapidly explore and test alternative models. You will join a highly skilled and experienced team answering a variety of complex sporting questions. You will work on building probabilistic models, the quality and evolution of which are central to the company’s success. You will find innovative ways of extracting information from various sporting and market data sources. Modelling and predicting sports outcomes is a uniquely challenging field, and you will have plenty of opportunities to use your experience, judgement and imagination to solve difficult problems. As Quantitative Researcher you will need: Advanced degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science or a related quantitative discipline 3+years experience in football within sports betting industry Proven experience building profitable betting models with real-money results — not just impressive backtests. Deep expertise across probability, statistics and ML , with strong instincts around leakage, overfitting, calibration, uncertainty and realistic validation. Strong Python + engineering skills — enough to build pipelines, connect APIs, deploy, monitor and debug models end-to-end. A genuinely AI-native workflow , with hands-on experience using LLMs and coding agents to accelerate research, development and debugging. An owner mentality — you care about whether the strategy works, not just whether the model works. The Opportunity Opportunities to progress your quantitative developer career. Working in GLMs, BMMs, Kalman filters, MCMC and the TrueSkill Ranking system Working with some of the brightest Quants within the industry.

items.desc: Quantitative Researcher - Systematic Equities. High-calibre systematic investment firm - Central London/Hybrid Compensation: £200,000 - £250,000 + Up to 100% performance related bonus Location: London (1 day a week on-site) My client are looking to hire experienced Quantitative Researchers for an opportunity within a high-calibre systematic investment environment in London. This isn’t a role where your research disappears into a presentation. You’ll work close to the investment process, with the opportunity to originate ideas, develop models, test signals and see successful research progress towards real investment decisions. We’re particularly interested in researchers who combine strong scientific thinking with commercial judgement, understanding the difference between an interesting backtest and a signal that is robust, scalable and realistically implementable. You’ll be joining an environment where high-quality research, technology and data are central to the investment process, with significant scope to influence how new systematic strategies are developed. This is a front-office research role focused on systematic equities, alpha research and signal generation, working with large and complex datasets to identify, test and ultimately implement new investment ideas. You’ll work closely with senior investment professionals across the full research lifecycle, from initial hypothesis and data exploration through to modelling, backtesting, portfolio analysis and implementation. You’ll be responsible for: Researching and developing new alpha signals and systematic equity strategies Working with large, complex and alternative datasets to identify predictive relationships Building and testing quantitative and statistical models Applying machine learning and statistical-learning techniques to investment research Developing robust backtesting and research frameworks Assessing signals across transaction costs, turnover, capacity and changing market regimes Supporting portfolio construction and the progression of successful research towards implementation Developing and improving Python-based research tools Working closely with experienced Quant Researchers, Portfolio Managers and Engineers Ideally, you’ll have: 3-7 years’ professional experience within Quantitative Research, systematic investing or quantitative trading Previous exposure to systematic equities and/or equity alpha research Strong Python programming capability Excellent foundations in statistics, mathematics and quantitative modelling Experience across alpha research, signal generation and/or predictive modelling Knowledge of machine-learning techniques applied to financial data Experience working with large, complex and/or alternative datasets A strong understanding of backtesting and robust research methodology Exposure to statistical arbitrage or systematic trading strategies would be highly advantageous A Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Machine Learning or another highly quantitative discipline would be highly relevant. Sound interesting? If you have 3-7 years’ experience across Quant Research, Systematic Equities, Alpha Research or quantitative trading and would be open to a confidential conversation, please apply. All conversations will be treated confidentially.

items.desc: Job Description Laser Development Engineer – Ultrafast DPSS Lasers Help shape the next generation of ultrafast lasers for industrial micromachining. As part of Coherent’s Advanced R&D Group, you’ll develop laser concepts and turn them into high-performance, reliable products. You’ll work with an international team in a supportive environment that values collaboration, professional development and a good sense of humour. What You’ll Be Doing Developing new lasers and improving existing products, modules, components and related products for industrial applications. Designing high-end laser sources and optics for ultrafast pulses, including nonlinear optics for frequency conversion from the mid-infrared to ultraviolet. Planning and managing development projects, including contributing to requirements specifications and preparing progress, interim and final reports. Designing, building and testing development prototypes. Defining specifications for laser characterisation equipment and documenting measurement protocols. Designing and verifying optical and electronic test fixtures. Conducting and documenting short- and long-term tests, and preparing and presenting development results. Working with international colleagues and partners in the US and Asia. Supporting international customers and suppliers with technical problem-solving. What You’ll Bring A Diploma or Master’s degree in Physics; a PhD is preferred. Strong knowledge of laser technology and hands-on laboratory experience with complex, high-power picosecond or femtosecond laser systems, amplifiers, and infrared, visible or ultraviolet lasers. Engineering experience with diode-pumped solid-state lasers. A strong understanding of laser measurement and characterisation techniques. Excellent English and strong communication skills. Experience in an industrial environment or education in electronics would be an advantage. Familiarity with simulation tools and mathematical software would also be an advantage. items.desc: Company Description PartnerRe is a leading, privately owned, multi-line global reinsurer with a reputation of financial stability and strength, and a commitment to rebuilding businesses and communities after risk events around the world. Our mission is to continue to be a financially stable and predictable business partner, supporting our clients with solutions tailored to their needs, delivering superior returns to our owner, providing rewarding opportunities for our people and making a positive contribution to society. To achieve this, we live by our values of Integrity, Performance, Collaboration, Straightforward Communication and Respect and Care. Core to The PartnerRe Experience is our global nature. No matter where you sit in the company, you are part of something bigger. Our teams represent our truly international mindset, forging connections across office locations and all levels of the organization and building a network of mutual success. The result is a day-to-day experience that will allow you to: Shape your own career Grow in a supportive environment Connect with a community of experts Make an impact View Home - PartnerRe Experience e-book to find out more about what it’s like to work at PartnerRe. We are always looking for bright, proactive individuals to join our team! Please follow our Careers page for all updates on new positions. We look forward to receiving your application. PartnerRe is an equal opportunities employer. Please join our company LinkedIn Page for all updates on new positions that are coming live. Compensation And Benefits The expected base salary range for this position, when hired into our Toronto location, is CAD $100-150K per year. For positions based in other jurisdictions, compensation will be determined in alignment with local regulations, market benchmarks, and internal compensation frameworks. The above range reflects the typical base salary range for candidates hired into this position. The actual salary will vary depending on a number of factors, including job location, experience, qualifications, education/training, skills, market conditions, and alignment with the role’s requirements. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in our annual incentive program, payment under which is at the discretion of PartnerRe and subject to individual and company performance. Eligible employees also have the opportunity to participate in an array of benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, a health spending account, a defined contribution pension plan, life insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, etc. Working Arrangement PartnerRe operates with a hybrid work approach that balances in‑office collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our employees are required to be in the office 3 days a week. Our goal is to create an environment where employees can connect, innovate, and perform at their best. This position is for an existing vacancy within our organization. PartnerRe is committed to an inclusive, accessible recruitment experience. Reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities are available upon request throughout the hiring process. This role's initial and primary focus is medical underwriting in life insurance: turning data and medical research into insight that shapes how we assess biometric risk over the years ahead, not necessarily how we operate today. This is not a subject matter expert role in medical underwriting. We are data scientists who support and inform underwriters and medical officers, not a team building independent underwriting authority. items.desc: Am Institut für den Schutz maritimer Infrastrukturen in Bremerhaven erforschen und entwickeln wir innovative Lösungen, um die Resilienz maritimer Infrastrukturen zu stärken und diese anpassungsfähig, sicher und nachhaltig zu gestalten. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern aus Forschung, Wirtschaft und weiteren Akteuren der maritimen Sicherheit verbinden wir technologische Innovation mit praxisnaher Expertise und bieten dir die Chance, an zukunftsweisenden Projekten mitzuarbeiten. Das erwartet dich Wir entwickeln innovative Sensor- und Bildgebungstechnologien, um Herausforderungen beim Schutz und bei der Sicherheit kritischer Infrastrukturen zu begegnen. Einer unserer Forschungsschwerpunkte ist die Myonentomographie, ein zerstörungsfreies Bildgebungsverfahren, bei dem Elementarteilchen zur Untersuchung dichter, abgeschirmter und schwer zugänglicher Objekte eingesetzt werden. Aktuell erforschen wir den Einsatz künstlicher Myonenquellen auf Basis von Laser-Plasma-Beschleunigern. Diese bieten das Potenzial, Messzeiten erheblich zu verkürzen, die Bildgebungsqualität zu verbessern und neue Anwendungsmöglichkeiten über die konventionelle kosmische Myonentomographie hinaus zu erschließen. Dieses aufstrebende Forschungsgebiet verbindet Teilchenphysik, Beschleunigertechnologie, computergestützte Modellierung und moderne Bildrekonstruktionsverfahren. Wir suchen eine motivierte wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiterin oder einen motivierten wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeiter zur Verstärkung unseres interdisziplinären Teams, um gemeinsam die nächste Generation der Myonenbildgebung zu entwickeln. Die Stelle bietet die Möglichkeit, an anspruchsvollen wissenschaftlichen Fragestellungen zu arbeiten, neue Simulations- und Rekonstruktionsverfahren zu entwickeln und zu validieren sowie mit internationalen Forschungspartnern an experimentellen Messkampagnen und innovativen europäischen Forschungsprojekten zusammenzuarbeiten. Deine Aufgaben Entwicklung innovativer Methoden für die Myonentomographie auf Basis von Laser-Plasma-Beschleunigern unter Verwendung künstlicher Myonenquellen Durchführung von Modellierungen, Monte-Carlo-Simulationen und wissenschaftlicher Datenanalyse zur Bewertung neuartiger Bildgebungskonzepte Entwicklung und Optimierung von Methoden zur Rekonstruktion, Materialcharakterisierung und KI-basierten Datenanalyse Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung experimenteller Validierungskampagnen in Zusammenarbeit mit einem interdisziplinären Forschungsteam und internationalen Projektpartnern Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung zukünftiger Myonenbildgebungstechnologien durch wissenschaftliche Publikationen und Konferenzbeiträge Unterstützung bei der Erstellung nationaler und europäischer Forschungsanträge Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Universitätsdiplom oder Master) in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich (z.B. Physik) oder einem ingenieurwissenschaft lichen Bereich (z.B. Informatik) oder andere, für die Tätigkeit relevante Studiengänge Erfahrung in der Experimentalphysik durch Tätigkeit in einer Forschungskollaboration oder in einem multinationalen Forschungsprojekt Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse, mit Monte-Carlo-Modellierungen (beispielsweise in Geant4) und im Umgang mit experimentellen Daten der Teilchenphysik Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python und/oder C/C++ Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit Erfahrung im Verfassen wissenschaftlicher Veröffentlichungen und in der Präsentation von Ergebnissen Fließende Beherrschung der englischen Sprache in Wort und Schrift Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! items.desc: ¡Hola! Somos OGA Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo. Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico. Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico. Sobre la posición. Buscamos Doctores/as en Matemáticas o Estadística que quieran desarrollarse en el entorno de la Investigación Operativa y más concretamente en la resolución de problemas de optimización de procesos. ¿Qué harás? Modelado matemático de problemas de optimización. Resolución con soluciones comerciales como GUROBI, CPLEX, HEXALY o similares. Diseño, implementación y validación de algoritmos de optimización (evolutivos, poblaciones y/o trayectoriales). Optimización multi-objetivo. Retos, ventajas, desventajas, enfoques, etc. Revisión y análisis de los datos proporcionados por el cliente. Validación de pruebas end-to-end de aplicaciones en la nube. Desarrollarás e implementarás modelos matemáticos y estadísticos para la optimización de procesos. Aplicarás técnicas de Investigación Operativa para resolver problemas complejos de decisión y planificación. Analizarás y validarás datos para identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos. Diseñarás algoritmos y soluciones computacionales eficientes para la optimización. Colaborarás con equipos interdisciplinarios para la implementación de soluciones óptimas. Documentarás y comunicarás los resultados de los análisis y propuestas a los stakeholders. Explorarás nuevas metodologías y herramientas en el ámbito de la Investigación Operativa y optimización. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación. ¿Qué requerimos? Doctorado en Matemáticas - Doctorado en Estadística. Se valorarán otros doctorados afines con implicación en la optimización de procesos. Tener experiencia en la participación en proyectos de optimización de procesos complejos utilizando programación matemática o heurísticas (como algoritmos evolutivos, metaheurísticos como algoritmos genéticos, búsqueda tabú, búsqueda dispersa o evolución diferencial), tener conocimientos en problemas reales como optimización logística, cadena de suministro, planificación, secuenciación de tareas y/o planificación de horarios, y colaborar con equipos de Investigación Operativa y desarrollo de software para crear productos que maximicen el valor para nuestros clientes. Imprescindible nivel alto de programación Python. Valorable el conocimiento de otras plataformas y lenguajes. ¿Qué valoramos? Conocimiento en programación matemática, programación por metas, optimización multi-objetivo… Manejo de herramientas como CPLEX, LocalSolver (Hexaly), Gurobi, XPress o similares. Nivel de Inglés C1. Interés por el desarrollo de una carrera técnica y vocación por la especialización tecnológica. Pasión por la tecnología y por la creación de valor para el cliente. Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras. items.desc: Are you driven to build the hardware that will power the next generation of quantum technologies? Do you enjoy hands-on experimental work, turning measurement data into insights, and collaborating closely with device design and fabrication? Join SemiQon as a Cryogenic and Quantum Devices R&D Engineer and help advance cryogenic electro-thermal and quantum devices from concept to working components. Role overview As a Cryogenic and Quantum Devices R&D Engineer at SemiQon, you will contribute to the development, measurement, and optimization of cryogenic electro-thermal and quantum devices. In this role, you will plan and perform low-temperature electrical measurements, analyze device data, and use modeling and design work to guide experimental development. You will work closely with researchers, engineers, and the fabrication team to connect device concepts, fabrication processes, measurement feedback, and performance improvements. ‍Key responsibilities Perform cryogenic electrical measurements of electro-thermal and quantum devices Model and design devices to guide experiments and support performance optimization Plan and execute experiments in collaboration with the R&D and fabrication teams Analyze measurement data and communicate findings to guide device and process improvements Work closely with the fabrication team to connect device design, process development, and measurement feedback Qualifications Must have Ph.D. degree, or equivalent experience, in physics, electrical engineering, nanotechnology, semiconductor devices, quantum technology or a related field Hands-on experience with electronic transport measurements Hands-on experience with cryogenic experimental setups, especially in the sub-1 K temperature range Strong understanding of solid-state physics, electrical transport, and device physics ‍ Additional assets Understanding of component fabrication, with hands-on fabrication experience considered a strong advantage Experience in modeling, simulation, or theoretical analysis of semiconductor, thermal, electro-thermal, or quantum devices Experience in characterizing electro-thermal devices, such as Peltier devices or NIS-junction-based components Experience with custom thermometry, such as on-chip thermometry ‍ Note: Security clearance vetting may be required for this position. ‍ Join us in shaping the quantum future At SemiQon, you will join a fast-growing deep-tech company building the hardware to scale up quantum computing. If you are motivated by hardware R&D and want to contribute to device development at the intersection of physics, engineering, and manufacturing, we encourage you to apply for the Cryogenic and Quantum Devices R&D Engineer role. ‍ ‍About us SemiQon’s mission is to realize the promise of quantum computing by delivering scalability through powerful, resilient, and cost-effective silicon-based quantum hardware. Its technology builds upon decades of development and know-how from the semiconductor industry, making its cryo-optimized CMOS electronics commercially competitive and well-suited for mass-manufacturing. SemiQon’s first-in-the-world cryo-optimized CMOS electronics deliver scalability and power efficiency to wide-ranging applications in quantum, space, and beyond. ‍ Send us your application Please send your application to careers@semiqon.tech following these guidelines: Subject line: “Cryogenic and Quantum Devices R&D Engineer: your full name” CV as a PDF attachment A brief motivation letter in the message body and your earliest possible start date

items.desc:
Huawei's Ohm Research Center (Nuremberg) is responsible for Advanced Technology Research, Architecture Evolution Design and Strategic Technology Planning. 
 The Power Conversion Technology Laboratory within the Huawei Ohm Research Center (Nuremberg) is responsible for Advanced Digital Power Technology Research, Architecture Evolution Design and Strategic Technology Planning, and plays an important role in the Huawei Digital Power business in the design and development of power converters and control systems for applications such as PV Solar & Battery Energy Storage Field, Data Centers, Electric Vehicle, and Embedded Power Supply. 
 Join us as a
 Expert – Medium Voltage Power Conversion System & Control Architecture (m/f/d) 
 Your mission 
 Lead the research and development of control system architectures for next-generation medium-voltage power conversion systems, targeting applications in data centers, solar PV, energy storage and other emerging energy scenarios, including SST, STATCOM and E-STATCOM technologies. 
 Define the system-level control hierarchy and functional architecture, covering supervisory control, power control, converter-level control, protection, monitoring and fault management. 
 Architect the control hardware and software platforms, including centralized and distributed controllers, functional partitioning, computing resources, real-time execution and system interfaces. 
 Design the communication and synchronization architecture across controllers, power cells, converter modules and system-level equipment, ensuring deterministic operation, reliability and scalability. 
 Define system-level protection, fault handling, redundancy and fault-tolerant operation strategies, including coordination between control, communication, power electronics and protection hardware. 
 Guide the development and integration of key control functions, including active/reactive power control, voltage/current regulation, energy and capacitor balancing, multilevel modulation and grid synchronization. 
 Evaluate system-level dynamic performance, stability and interactions between converter modules, control layers, communication networks and external power systems. 
 Lead system integration and validation from architecture design, simulation and HIL testing through prototype commissioning, product qualification and field deployment. 
 Drive technical decisions and establish reusable control architectures, design guidelines and engineering methodologies across multiple medium-voltage product platforms. 
 Your areas of expertise 
 Deep expertise in system-level control architecture for medium-voltage or high-power conversion systems, with a strong understanding of hierarchical and distributed control concepts. 
 Strong knowledge of converter control systems, including supervisory control, power regulation, multilevel converter control, synchronization, energy balancing and coordinated system operation. 
 Proven experience in control hardware and embedded software architecture, including controller platform selection, functional partitioning, real-time scheduling and hardware-software interfaces. 
 Solid understanding of industrial real-time communication, distributed synchronization, communication latency, reliability and fault-tolerant system design. 
 Strong knowledge of system-level protection coordination, redundancy, fault detection, isolation, recovery and degraded-mode operation. 
 Practical experience in system modelling, control architecture validation, HIL testing, power prototype commissioning and troubleshooting of complex converter systems. 
 Ability to lead cross-disciplinary technical decisions involving power electronics, control algorithms, embedded software, controller hardware, communication and system engineering. 
 Demonstrated ownership of the control system architecture of at least one relevant industrial product, from architecture definition and system integration through validation and field deployment or series production. 
 Experience with SST, STATCOM, E-STATCOM, HVDC, medium-voltage drives, utility-scale energy storage PCS or comparable modular power conversion systems is highly preferred. 
 Hands-on experience with distributed control platforms, industrial real-time communication, redundancy design and system-level commissioning is highly valued. 
 By applying to this position, you agree with our Recruitment Privacy Statement. You can read in full our privacy policy here .
 Your rewards of working here 
 Our culture is characterized by innovative power and team spirit as well as the intensive exchange of knowledge and experience within our global network.
 We offer healthy meals ranging from traditional Chinese to western delicacies in our famous company canteen.
 To keep your development ongoing, you will find a broad range of training opportunities. Many online and face-to-face training programs incl. language courses in German and Mandarin.
 Our diverse and welcoming environment is …

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
As an Engineering Maintenance Technician, you will join our Cheltenham based Facilities and Maintenance team on a 3.5-year level 4 apprenticeship rotational scheme that will enable you to understand and get hands on experience across all aspects of the Facilities and Maintenance programme. You will do this whilst studying a Level 4/5 HNC/HND in General Engineering. This apprenticeship aligns with the Institution of Engineering and Technology for Engineering Technician (EngTech). The role is heavily electrical and mechanically focussed. Our apprenticeship is focused on supporting your personal and professional development and is an opportunity to begin a career as part of a global business within the aerospace industry. 
 Job Description 
 About GE Aerospace 
 Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world!
 With over 1,700 employees, GE Aerospace based in Cheltenham is one of the largest sites outside the USA and a major contributor to the local economy. 
 Our heritage dates back to 1940 yet our technology is cutting-edge. Located in the heart of Gloucestershire, the Power Distribution & Controls (PD&C) site focuses on the design, development and manufacture of state-of-the-art aircraft power distribution and avionics systems for the global aviation industry. Our customers include all major aerospace manufacturers - covering commercial, business jet and military applications. The scale and complexity of engineering projects offer our employees unique opportunities to work on major international projects, developing critical aircraft systems that will be relied on by many people for decades to come. 
 At GE Aerospace we strive to be an employer of choice by offering internships, apprenticeships, mentoring and staff development programmes that create a workplace where everyone can be themselves and achieve their full potential. 
 Innovation, a commitment to engineering excellence and leadership development places GE Aerospace based in Cheltenham as a pioneering force in building the future of flight. 
 Role Description 
 As an Engineering Maintenance Technician Apprentice, you will be based within our Facilities and Maintenance team at our 1800 employee Campus in Bishops Cleeve, Cheltenham. Throughout your 3.5-year apprenticeship, you will be supported through, and study, a Level 4 Engineering Maintenance Technician Apprenticeship, completing an HNC/D with Gloucestershire Engineering Training (GET), based at their Gloucester campus. Teaching is typically delivered via 1-day college release, every week during term time for the duration of the course. 
 The Engineering Maintenance Technician is responsible for ensuring the continuous operation, safety, and reliability of all plant machinery, production equipment, and facilities infrastructure. You will perform routine preventative maintenance (PPM), rapid reactive repairs, and system improvements to minimize production downtime and support operational targets.
 A heavy focus of the role will be to support fault finding and maintenance of environmental stress screening test equipment.
 We want to support your personal and professional development, which is why you will be given the opportunity build your network and develop soft skills. At GE Aerospace we see personal development as a key driver of success at a business level. Apprentices are also given additional time to complete ‘off the job learning’ when on site. We aim to arrange team building activities during non-teaching time to help continue to develop your skills.
 Our apprentice community partake in, and often lead enrichment teams and activities that help to connect apprentices across different schemes. This is with a view to giving back to the business and local community. You will have access to mentors and may wish to join one of GE Aerospace employee resource groups, such as Women’s network, STEM, Pride Alliance, Including & Diversity, and more.
 You will be supported by your Apprentice Manager, Rotation Managers, experienced maintenance personnel and the wider apprentice network, to ensure you are meeting the requirements of your course and getting the most out of your apprenticeship. Apprentices who complete this scheme have the transferable skills needed to work in facilities, maintenance and test equipment departments; therefore, roll-off opportunities are not limited to a specific business unit.
 This apprenticeship is new to the GE Aerospace campus and has been established based on the long-term need for, and opportunity for, this …

Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one? 
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for summer placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary —shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates. 
 Our Summer Placement Programme 
 Our 13 weeks Summer Placement Programme gives you the chance to work in the Materials Testing Laboratory; a lab that supports the production of our world leading radar and electro-optic products. Working under the guidance of experienced Material Engineers, you will be introduced to state-of-the-art methods, technology and equipment used to characterise materials and analyse failures. You will explore all aspects of the materials test lifecycle, which may include requirements analysis, design of samples, implementation of new processes, sample testing, and product support.
 Throughout your placement, you’ll receive coaching and support from a dedicated team, with the potential to return for future placements or progress onto our Graduate Development Programme. 
 The programme will run from 01/06/2027 to 27/08/2027.
 We expect you on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience with the laboratory equipment. 
 As a Summer Placement Mechanical Engineer you will: 
 · Be immersed in a busy materials laboratory environment, gaining practical experience across a wide range of material characterisation and testing activities that support critical engineering programmes. You will contribute directly to cutting-edge failure analysis on various materials, components and hardware. Including, additively manufactured metallic materials; where you will help to develop sample preparation techniques and document new laboratory processes.
 · Gain a broader understanding of the Materials & Processes Department; working alongside experienced engineers and scientists to see how materials engineering influences the performance, safety and reliability of advanced aerospace systems.
 · Have the chance to gain a wider knowledge of the business through various awareness sessions.
 · Be given responsibility for delivering a specific project task, providing an excellent opportunity to develop your technical, project management and soft skills.
 What you’ll bring 
 · Be enrolled on a Bachelor’s/Integrated Masters degree from an accredited degree course.
 · Relevant engineering or science work experience, such as summer placements or internships.
 · Experience with technical writing and project planning.
 · Strong analytical, modelling skills and laboratory skills.
 · Evidence of successfully working in a team.
 · Experience of working in a laboratory and following laboratory procedures is desirable.
 For the Summer Placement Mechanical Engineer role, the acceptable degree programmes are typically:
 · Engineering Materials
 · Materials Science
 · Mechanical Engineering
 · Chemical Engineering
 · Aerospace Engineering/Manufacturing/Technology
 · Physics
 · Applied Physics
 · Engineering Physics
 · Engineering Management
 This is not an exhaustive list, and we are keen to hear from you even if you might not have experience in all the above. The most important skill is a good attitude and willingness to learn.
 Security Clearance 
 Many of our roles are subject to security requirements and, where applicable, export control restrictions arising from UK Government requirements and customer obligations many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

Job Description: 
 Your Impact 
 Do you want to work on real-time projects alongside leading Scientists and Engineers within a globally renowned company?
 The role requires an enthusiastic individual who has a passion for overcoming technical challenges. As an Electronics Summer Placement you will form part of a multi-discipline Team of Engineers undertaking the collective objective of advancing our World leading products in the Defence domain.
 The 13-week Summer Placement Programme 
 The placement will not only increase your technical skills, but gives you the opportunity to work on meaningful real life projects, alongside experienced engineers and graduates across our business.
 You will receive coaching and support to achieve your personal goals and work in multidisciplinary teams to gain as much experience across the product lifecycle from your time in industry as possible. Our ultimate aim is to see you through your undergrad years and successful placements will result in an offer to return for further placements or for an offer on our Graduate Development programme.
 What you’ll do as a Summer Placement Electronics Engineer: 
 You will be responsible for:
 Building the skills required to work effectively within a Professional Engineering environment.
 Support the design and development of our world leading electro-optical, communications and information system products under the guidance of experienced Electronics Engineers
 You will interface with engineers from other disciplines including Mechanical, Software, Systems, Supportability and Design Integrity. Electronics Engineers design, document, build and test electronics circuits and firmware designs to go into our various systems.
 There will be opportunities to develop expertise in the design of circuits, FPGAs and subsystems at various stages in the product lifecycle. This will include requirements capture, performance analysis, design, code, verification, validation and support to integration and qualification. You will gain exposure to other engineering disciplines and business areas.
 What we need from you: 
 Skills, Qualifications and Experience: 
 Currently undertaking a minimum of a Bachelors level degree Electrical/Electronics Engineering (or similar field) including modules covering topics such as digital design, analogue design and signal processing. Experience of using PCB design and simulation tools is highly desirable.
 Be a self-motivated individual, willing to take on new challenges and drive continuous personal development
 Strong communication skills across a variety of mediums i.e. written, verbal, digital, etc.
 The ability to develop effective working relationships with peers and stakeholders
 Adaptable to the ever-changing demands that will be encountered within the role
 Offer novel ideas and methods for solving technical problems, drawing on personal experiences and knowledge learned during academic studies
 Demonstrate relevant project work and/or placements in Industry are beneficial, but not essential
 Security Clearance 
 At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years.
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.
 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting 
 Why join us 
 At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
 We offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your wellbeing, learning and development, and work–life balance:
 Time to recharge : Our employees are entitled 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays. As a Summer Placement student you will receive this allowance pro rata.
 Secure your future : Award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution
 Your wellbeing matters : Free access to mental health …

Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one?
 At Leonardo Newcastle, we’re looking for summer placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates.
 Leonardo’s Summer Placement Programme offers you a paid opportunity (£26,228) to develop your current skillset in an innovative and practical environment that can lead to a place on our award-winning Graduate Development programme.
 Come and join one of our multi-disciplinary integrated project teams, in Newcastle and contribute to the solving of real-life engineering problems on state-of-the-art avionics sensor systems, such as: the radar for the Typhoon fighter jet; the radar for the SAAB Gripen fighter; one of our family of Surveillance AESA Radars (Active Electronically Scanned Array); an IRCM (Infra–Red Counter Measures) system; or perhaps on one of our laser target designator or laser ranging systems.
 The 13-week Summer Placement Programme 
 We have created a programme across our UK sites that not only increases your technical skills but gives you the opportunity to work on meaningful real-life projects, alongside experienced engineers and graduates across our business.
 You will receive coaching and support to achieve your personal goals and work in multidisciplinary teams to gain as much experience across the product lifecycle from your time in industry as possible. Our ultimate aim is to see you through your undergrad years and successful placements may result in an offer to return for further placements or for an offer on our Graduate Development programme.
 The programme will run from 1st June 2027 to 27th August 2027.
 As a Summer Placement Software Engineer you will: 
 1. Provide support to real projects.
 2. Be required to apply knowledge gained while studying in a practical way.
 3. Undertake activities including designing, testing, qualifying and supporting technology across our range of products. The challenging tasks will involve communicating with other team members to gain information before completing objectives and examining outcomes.
 4. Working as part of an established engineering community, and supported by a team of experienced engineers, you will be responsible for:
 Delivering small packages of work to time, cost and quality.
 Working within a team to achieve project targets, collaborate across multiple disciplines and solve problems.
 Communicating with team members to share knowledge.
 Completing tasks to a high standard in accordance with appropriate processes and procedures.
 Using the opportunity to develop engineering skills. A supervisor will be available to provide mentoring whilst working as a fully integrated member of the team.
 At the start of your placement, prepare a short presentation to introduce yourself and discuss what you will be working on to the Head of Software and the wider team.
 At the end of your placement, showcase what you have learned and achieved during your time at Leonardo to the Head of Software and the wider team.
 Particular emphasis will be placed on learning practical skills that may not be easily gained or experienced in the academic environment of a university.
 What you will bring 
 Our Summer Placement roles require a minimum of a predicted 2:2 grade in a relevant degree discipline e.g. Software Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics or Electronic Engineering (BSc (Hon) / BEng (Hon) / MEng) to have the opportunity to experience a 13-week paid industrial placement working as a Software Engineer within Leonardo.
 Competencies we look for: 
 You should demonstrate an interest in Software Engineering in the area of real time development for avionic systems.
 You should have some experience of computer programming and be enthusiastic and passionate about designing software and writing code.
 Experience of an object-oriented programming language such as C++ and knowledge of UML (Unified Modelling Language) is an advantage but not essential.
 A full statement of courses and projects studied at university and corresponding grades/marks/percentage should be included in your CV.
 Applications are also welcomed from candidates who have completed a first degree and are looking to gain industrial experience prior to commencing a relevant higher degree (i.e. PhD, MSc).

 Self-motivated with lots of drive and enthusiasm.
 Able to use own initiative to achieve overall objectives.
 Able to work under pressure and achieve challenging deadlines within an environment of changing priorities.
 Highly responsive with strong customer focus.
 Thorough, seeing job through to completion while maintaining high standards.

 Our Industrial Placement Programme 
 As an Industrial Placement Firmware Engineer , you'll join a team delivering world-leading Electronic Warfare capabilities that protect fast jets, UAVs, naval vessels and land platforms operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.
 Our Programme offers you the chance to spend a year with us, working on meaningful projects alongside subject matter experts, within multidisciplinary teams, and across the product lifecycle. You’ll receive a salary of £26,228, with coaching and support from a dedicated team to help you achieve both your placement objectives and personal development goals.
 Successful completion of an Industrial Placement with Leonardo may also lead to an offer on our Graduate Development Programme.
 During your placement, we encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience. This Opportunity is based in Luton.
 What You'll Do 
 As part of our Firmware Engineering team, you'll support the development of high-performance digital systems used within advanced Electronic Warfare solutions.
 Your activities will include:
 · Supporting the design and development of FPGA firmware solutions for embedded and real-time systems
 · Assisting with firmware verification and simulation activities
 · Using industry-standard development tools and hardware description languages
 · Supporting testing and validation activities to ensure designs meet performance requirements
 · Analysing technical data and presenting findings to engineering teams
 · Working closely with systems, software and hardware engineers to integrate firmware solutions
 · Contributing to technical documentation and design reviews
 Your Industrial Placement Project 
 Approximately 50% of your placement will be dedicated to a cohort-led Industrial Placement project.
 Alongside fellow placement students, you'll help define, manage and deliver a substantial project over the course of your year placement. This is your opportunity to develop leadership, project management and stakeholder engagement skills while creating a meaningful business outcome.
 What We're Looking For 
 You should be studying towards a degree in:
 · Electronic Engineering
