Working Hours: This role is available on a part-time, job-share and full-time basis 
 Location: 
 Salary: Total Package value of over £65,000, including a competitive salary of up to £57,594 depending on experience. 
 Car: Essential Car User 
 So what’s it all about:  
 At Zurich, our Engineer Surveyor workforce is central to our continued success, being the ‘Face of Zurich’ to our large and varied client base. You’ll find a fully flexible offering that means you can manage your own diary to service your own client area. This will allow you to broker and develop your relationships whilst representing Zurich Engineering. 
 No two days will ever be the same, as you’ll work in a variety of interesting environments and you will have control over your own work/life balance, as we believe our people are what makes us successful. 
 Our Engineer Surveyor roles allow you to develop your mechanical engineering skills further and work for a market-leading engineering inspection provider. 
 Zurich Engineering is looking to expand our highly skilled, field-based, Engineer Surveyor team, and we currently have a vacancy for the Castle Donnington area for a LEV (Local Exhaust Ventilation)/Electrical Engineer Surveyor. 
 What will I be doing? 
 You’ll start with our industry-leading, bespoke training and move swiftly to carrying out hands-on statutory inspections, providing your expert opinion on a wide range of equipment, enabling our clients to comply with all relevant legislation and to the exacting standards both we and our clients demand. Following your inspection, we’ll need you to report back using a rugged laptop, and then issue electronically to our clients, so good IT skills and high levels of literacy are required. You will be an excellent communicator, and confident in your ability to make sound engineering judgements. 
 What skills/qualifications will I have? 
 You will be an experienced engineer with a sound knowledge of your engineering discipline and be part of our multi-disciplined inspection team within your geographic area. You will report to a Team Manager and be based from home, with your client base a reasonable travelling distance from your home. 
 Because this role is SAFEd governed, we need you to ideally have obtained: 
 A Level 3 qualification in a relevant engineering field, support is available to allow you to achieve IEng status whilst working as we want to help you gain professional membership. 
 Compex qualified - advantageous 
 A P601 LEV qualification is advantageous 
 An inspection & test qualification (C&G 2391-52 or equivalent) 
 Acurrent Edition of the Electrical Wiring Regulations (C&G 2382) 
 You will have completed, either a time served or Modern Apprenticeship 
 Hands-on experience in a relevant engineering discipline 
 A background, working with pumps and motors - preferable 
 A full valid UK driving licence. 
 Be willing and able to work paid overtime. 
 What will you get in return? 
 Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich, we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday. 
 Follow the link for more information about our benefits - Employee benefits | Working at Zurich Insurance UK 
 As an inclusive employer we want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply. 
 Who we are: 
 At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world and the best global insurer. Together we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet. 
 With over 55,000 employees in more than 170 countries , you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company who are a long-standing player in the insurance industry. 
 We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee; to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future.

We Are Waiting for You 
 Hi there! 
 I am Álvaro Gallego, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you! 
 First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at ServiZurich: The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at the Zurich ! 
 Let me take a wild guess: you’ve probably sifted through countless job offers today, and they all seem to blur together. Sound familiar? Well, here’s the scoop: At Zurich, we might not have all the answers (and we’re not striving for perfection!), but we’ve got something special. Curious? Keep reading! 
 First off all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier. 
 Our Opportunity 
 Are you ready to embark on your career in the multinational insurance space? We are seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Knowledge Operations Specialist to join our multinational Business Transformation team. In this role, your keen eye for accuracy and dedication to high standards will be essential as you manage, refine, and ensure the integrity of various data sets. 
 This position offers you the opportunity to collaborate with stakeholders across Zurich and around the world, elevating our data quality to best-in-class levels for our multinational customers. As a Knowledge Operations Specialist based in Spain, you will play a pivotal role in upholding the standards that empower informed decision-making and drive operational excellence globally. You will build a solid understanding of how data is captured, transformed, and utilized across the various systems supporting multinational operations. With curiosity and analytical thinking, you will understand dependencies and contribute to improvement and transformation initiatives that help make our operations more efficient, consistent, and scalable. 
 What Can You Expect? 
 And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at Zurich? I’m glad you asked. 
 You will have the opportunity to: 
 Support the collection, review and completion of General and Wording Capabilities data across products for Zurich’s global network of 200+ territories. 
 Review submitted data for completeness, consistency, and accuracy . Help organize and track data collection activities, follow up on outstanding inputs, and maintain a clear audit trail of updates and changes. 
 Proactively foster collaboration and clear communication with stakeholders across countries and central functions. 
 Maintain an ongoing engagement with the countries, underwriting and project teams to help finalize technical content, and ensure data is maintained in line with agreed standards. 
 Support the launch of new propositions by helping to set up and maintain reference systems that reflect updated global wording, while working with stakeholders to ensure solutions meet business needs. 
 Maintain internal guidelines and standard operating procedures so they remain accurate, clear, and aligned with current data management processes. 
 Contribute to transformation and continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring issues, supporting analysis, and helping improve efficiency, consistency, and service quality. 
 What Makes You a Great Fit? 
 While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you! 
 1–2 years of experience in insurance, operations, data management, business administration, finance, or a related field; multinational insurance exposure is an advantage. 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Economics, Insurance, Finance, Tax, Law, Data Science, Statistics or a related field. 
 Interest in working with structured data, ensuring data quality, and understanding how information is used across systems and business processes.

 Exposure to process improvement, digital transformation, reporting, automation, or project work through studies, internships, or early professional experience is an advantage. 
 Fluency in English and Spanish; additional languages are an advantage.

 The future of moblity for us. Professional excellence for you. 
 At the BMW Group, everything starts with passion. It turns a profession into a vocation. It drives us to keep reinventing mobility and bring innovative ideas onto the roads. Enthusiasm for joint projects turns a team into a strong unit where every opinion is valued. It is only when expertise, highly professional processes and enjoyment of work unite that we can shape the future together.  As a PLC Specialist at BMW Group Plant Debrecen, you will be responsible for the production-related support of all control technology scopes of our production systems in the Assembly.
 What awaits you? 
 Work environment – a highly automated production area equipped with robots, PLC controls, which our team sets up, operates, and maintains to ensure the required quality.
 Team – you will join our Maintenance team in the Assembly.
 System Optimization & Fault Elimination – you support operations in long-term fault elimination and lead projects aimed at improving system availability, safety, and efficiency.
 Project Execution – you ensure the timely delivery of production area projects (modifications, optimizations, and replacements) while managing suppliers within a standard project management framework.
 Problem Solving - you coordinate all on-site control systems and assist suppliers with emerging technical issues.
 IT System Support - you utilize various production-related IT systems in your daily routine.
 Strategic Planning - you apply electrical standards and contribute to the development of new control technologies and systems up to series production . 
 Administration - you prepare inquiry and RFP (Request for Proposal) documents to round off your scope of work.
 What should you bring along? 
 Education background - vocational/high-school degree in a relevant field (electrical, electronics); university degree would be an advantage.
 Work experience – Minimum 2 years of experiences in the commissioning of PLC controls.

¿QUÉ ES TELEFONICA TECH? 
 Telefónica Tech es la compañía líder en trasformación digital del Grupo Telefónica. Contamos con una amplia oferta de servicios y soluciones tecnológicas integradas de Ciberseguridad, Cloud, IoT, Big Data, Inteligencia Artificial y Blockchain, con la que acompañamos a nuestros clientes en su transformación digital. 
 Somos un grupo de más de 6200 personas valientes que trabajamos a diario desde distintos puntos del mundo para alcanzar la excelencia, a través de un liderazgo basado en la transparencia y en el espírItu de equipo. Si te identificas con nuestros pilares, ¡estamos deseando conocerte! 
 www.telefonicatech.com 
 ¿QUÉ HACEMOS EN EL EQUIPO? 
 En la unidad de Seguridad Ofensiva de Telefónica Tech tenemos por objeto proporcionar a las organizaciones una postura de seguridad precisa y real que nos permiten ofrecer a nuestros clientes descubrir vulnerabilidades críticas en su entorno y ayudar a priorizar y abordar los riesgos en función de su explotabilidad e impacto. 
 En nuestro equipo nos encargamos de gestionar las vulnerabilidades de los sistemas, redes y aplicaciones de organizaciones. Lo que hacemos es identificar, evaluar y priorizar las posibles amenazas y debilidades de seguridad para asegurarnos de que todos los activos digitales estén protegidos de posibles riesgos. Utilizamos herramientas especializadas y métodos de pruebas para detectar vulnerabilidades, luego analizamos su nivel de gravedad y trabajamos en su mitigación a través de parches, configuraciones de seguridad y otras medidas preventivas. 
 ¿CÓMO SERÁ TU DÍA A DÍA? 
 Tu misión será la gestión del ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades. 
 Tu día a día será el siguiente: 
 Alta y provisión de activos en herramientas de gestión de vulnerabilidades. 
 Análisis de las vulnerabilidades reportadas de manera continua con el fin de evaluar la probabilidad e impacto reales para ajustar la criticidad/severidad, así como la revisión y limpieza de falsos positivos. 
 Soporte en la definición de planes de remediación priorizados. 
 Generación de informes mensuales y KPIs. 
 Instalación de sondas de escaneo de vulnerabilidades. 
 Revisión y mejora de los perfiles de escaneo. 
 Apertura y gestión de solicitudes de cliente en plataforma de ticketing. 
 Reuniones de seguimiento del servicio. 
 Realizar automatizaciones mediante scripts. 
 Y PARA ELLO, CREEMOS QUE SERÍA IDEAL QUE CONTARAS CON… 
 Experiencia 
 Experiencia mínima de 1 año y medio en proyectos de gestión del ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades. 
 Formación 
 Formación universitaria, título de FP grado medio/superior o experiencia profesional equivalente. 
 Deseable: 
 Estar en posesión de certificaciones relativas a los fabricantes Tenable o Qualys. 
 Conocimientos técnicos 
 Conocimiento técnico en herramientas de escaneo de vulnerabilidades (Nexpose/Nessus Professional/Tenable/Qualys/Nuclei/etc..). 
 Lenguajes de programación y scripting en Python, bash, powershell, etc... 
 Para desempeñar el rol, las skills que encajarían con el equipo y el proyecto serían : 
 Apasionado por la tecnología y la seguridad ofensiva. 
 Creatividad y con instinto hacker. 
 Proactividad, capacidad para asumir retos. 
 Capacidad de transmitir ideas técnicamente complejas a audiencia no técnica. 
 Capacidad de trabajo en equipo. 
 Idiomas 
 Necesario: 
 Español nativo. 
 Ingles B2

VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 500 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 300 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 200 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 700 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Ak Ťa zaujíma svet bankovníctva, si komunikatívny/komunikatívna a máš prax v práci s hotovosťou, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku vo VÚB!
 Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
 Okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Vítame u nás skúsených bankárov, ale ak ešte bankovú prax nemáš, nevadí. U nás vo VÚB Ťa na to pripravíme celkom od začiatku.
 ČO TI DÁME NA ÚVOD?
Vďaka silnej podpore manažérov pobočky, nápomocným kolegom a priateľskému prístupu našich lektorov sa:
postupne začneš orientovať vo VUB bankových produktoch a službách,
naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.
 PREČO SA TI PRÁCA VO VÚBKE BUDE PÁČIŤ?
 Budeš pracovať v jednej z najväčších a najvýznamnejších bánk na Slovensku.
 Na pobočke ste jeden tím – obchodné plány plníte spoločne a vzájomne sa podporujete.
 Rozširuješ si odbornosť a získavaš skúsenosti, ktoré využiješ v Tvojej kariére.
 Pri práci s klientom sa zlepšuješ v mnohých oblastiach, ktoré oceníš aj v osobnom živote.
 TVOJOU ÚLOHOU AKO PORADCU KLIENTA BUDE:
 podieľať sa na podpore predaja a spolupracovať s tímom,

 Viši/Glavni analitičar (m/ž) na poslovima razvoja kreditnih politika, procesa i pravila kreditiranja 
 (mjesto rada Zagreb) 
 Radno mjesto obuhvaća operativno sudjelovanje u procesu razvoja politike upravljanja kreditnim rizikom, uređenju kreditnih procesa i ključnih elemenata poslovnog odlučivanja te unaprjeđenja sustava unutarnjih kontrola. 
 Radni zadaci uključuju: 
 analizu i dizajn procesa i pravila odobravanja plasmana , te razvoj i održavanje dijelova aplikacija koji podržavaju navedeni proces 
 razvoj sustava automatskog odlučivanja temeljem internih modela 
 aktivno sudjelovanje na projektima vezanim uz digitalizaciju i optimizaciju procesa odobravanja kredita u skladu s najnovijim trendovima digitalnog poslovanja 
 dohvat i analizu podataka o klijentima i kreditnim proizvodima, s ciljem identifikacije „clustera“ povećanog rizika te praćenja uspješnosti pravila odlučivanja 
 sudjelovanje u razvoju internih modela za kreditni rizik (PD), dizajn procesa dodjele internih kreditnih rejtinga te implementaciju internih modela u kreditne procese 
 specifikaciju zahtjeva i funkcionalnosti za implementaciju novih, kao i unaprjeđenje postojećih aplikativnih rješenja, osiguravanje kvalitete IT isporuka te razvoj i testiranje centralnog sustava za podršku odlučivanju i aplikacija koje se koriste u kreditnom procesu 
 pisanje i održavanje procedura i uputa procesa odobravanja i praćenja kreditnog rizika 
 Formalni uvjeti koje svi kandidati moraju zadovoljavati su: 
 VSS (prednost informatički ili matematički smjerovi) 
 minimalno 3 godine relevantnog radnog iskustva 
 poznavanje kreditnog procesa i/ili modela mjerenja kreditnog rizika 
 iskustvo rada s bazama podataka (poželjno znanje SQL-a ili rada u SAS alatima) 
 napredno poznavanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu

Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 5 500 EUR/mesiac
 Ponúkame diskusiu o mzde začínajúcu na tejto sume. Finálna úroveň mzdy závisí od profesijnej kvalifikácie a skúseností. Ročné odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 40% v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj skupinových cieľov.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Do nášho tímu hľadáme skúseného lídra/líderku, ktorý/ktorá prevezme zodpovednosť za riadenie obchodných aktivít v rámci príslušného regiónu. 
 Hľadáme strategicky mysliacu osobnosť s výbornými obchodnými schopnosťami, skúsenosťami s vedením tímov a schopnosťou ovplyvňovať rozvoj firemného bankovníctva. 
 Ponúkame Vám: 
 príležitosť viesť obchodnú sieť v rámci regiónu stredné a východné Slovensko a ovplyvniť jej rozvoj,
 možnosť formovať obchodnú stratégiu a rozvoj SME segmentu,
 motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie a atraktívne benefity,
 podporu profesionálneho rastu a rozvoja líderských zručností.
 Vašou úlohou bude:
 riadiť obchodné aktivity v rámci regiónu stredné a východné Slovensko a zabezpečiť plnenie obchodných cieľov a KPI’s,
 viesť a rozvíjať tím riaditeľov 5 firemných obchodných centier,
 prijímať rozhodnutia v oblasti obchodných aktivít, optimalizácie obchodnej siete a efektívnosti obsluhy klientov,
 vypracovávať návrhy pre koncepciu rozvoja a zmien firemnej obchodnej siete v regióne,
 analyzovať dynamiku vývoja regionálneho trhu, sledovať trhové trendy, konkurenciu a vývoj klientskych segmentov,
 nastavovať a realizovať obchodnú stratégiu v súlade s cieľmi banky,
 aktívne budovať a udržiavať vzťahy s kľúčovými firemnými klientmi,
 pripravovať a predávať špeciálne ponuky produktov a služieb banky a jej finančnej skupiny definovanému segmentu klientov,
 spolupracovať s ostatnými oddeleniami banky na zlepšovaní klientskych riešení a procesov,
 prezentovať úverové návrhy pre klientov na úverovom výbore banky.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov! 
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 vysokoškolské II. stupňa (ekonomický smer výhodou)
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máš vysokoškolské vzdelanie II. stupňa (ekonomický smer výhodou),
 máš minimálne 7 rokov skúseností v oblasti firemného bankovníctva, ideálne v SME segmente,
 máš preukázateľnú skúsenosť s vedením väčších tímov alebo riadením obchodnej siete,
 máš schopnosť analyzovať finančné výkazy (súvaha, výsledovka, cash-flow),
 máš znalosť bankových produktov a potrieb firemných klientov,
 ovládaš anglický jazyk na úrovni B2 a vyššie,
 máš vodičský preukaz skupiny B – aktívny vodič,
 máš výborné komunikačné a prezentačné schopnosti, orientácia na výsledky, strategické myslenie.

items.desc: You'll join a small applied-AI team and own the ML behind Hirivo. That covers the job-matching and ranking models, the LLM agents that read job adverts and fill application forms, and the systems that tell us whether they're working. You'll take features from prototype to production, then measure and monitor them. What you'll do Build and improve LLM-powered agents that read job adverts and application forms and complete them accurately from a candidate's profile and CV (tool use, multi-step workflows, handing questions to the candidate when needed). Build job-to-candidate matching and ranking using embeddings, retrieval (RAG) and vector search, behind the campaign match score. Create evaluation sets and automated evals for form-fill accuracy, match quality and agent success rate, then iterate on prompts, models and fine-tunes. Train, fine-tune and benchmark models (PyTorch), for example to parse CVs and job descriptions and to classify job fit. Deploy models and agents as scalable APIs and services on the cloud (AWS/GCP) with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD, integrated with our Node backend. Add observability : tracing of agent runs, latency/cost dashboards, failure and drift monitoring. Build data pipelines that collect and clean job listings from many sources. Work with product and with candidates to turn real job-seeker problems into shipped features, and care about responsible AI : candidates' data, fairness and accuracy. Essential Strong Python and solid software-engineering fundamentals (APIs, backend services, testing). (Python appears in 64% of the sampled postings; APIs/backend in 54%.) Hands-on experience building with LLMs: OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, prompting, agents or RAG. (LLMs 60%, agents 69%.) Experience shipping ML or AI systems to production and running them at scale. (Production 63%, scale 67%.) Experience training and evaluating models, plus familiarity with PyTorch. (Training/experimentation 48%.) Cloud experience (AWS, GCP or Azure) plus Docker/Kubernetes. (Cloud 40%.) A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. A product mindset: you care about users and measurable impact. (36%.) (55%) Open-source contributions or a public portfolio of AI projects. (36%) A second language such as TypeScript, Go, C++ or Rust. (TypeScript/JS 31%, Go 16%) GPU / CUDA / inference-performance optimisation. (22%) Fine-tuning (LoRA, RLHF/DPO). (18%) Familiarity with AI safety or responsible AI. (21%) Recommender/ranking systems, MLOps tooling (MLflow, model registry), web scraping/data pipelines. items.desc: Askara est une start-up SaaS en forte croissance qui développe un logiciel basé sur l'intelligence artificielle et piloté à la voix pour les dentistes. Notre mission : simplifier le quotidien des dentistes en automatisant leurs tâches administratives , de la dictée vocale à la rédaction de documents médicaux complexes. Aujourd'hui, plus de 4 000 praticiens utilisent notre solution, nous avons généré plus de 400 000 documents , et nous traitons plusieurs dizaines de milliers d'heures d'audio chaque mois. Nous avons une équipe qui écoute les besoins des praticiens et construit le produit. Il nous manque la personne dont le métier est de le faire tourner . Vos missions Nous recherchons un(e) Technical Operations Engineer (TechOps) , dont la mission tient en une phrase : Askara marche, de façon fiable et sûre . Concrètement, vous prenez la responsabilité de tout ce qui fait qu'un produit livré reste un produit qui fonctionne : la sécurité , l' IT interne, la qualité et les tests , la réponse aux incidents . Ce poste est une création . Aujourd'hui, ces sujets sont portés par le CTO, en parallèle du reste. Vous n'héritez donc pas d'une page blanche (ISO 27001 obtenue, EDR déployé, CI/CD en place, tests Playwright, monitoring Sentry, procédure d'incident formalisée) mais d'un périmètre réel, éclaté, qui n'a jamais eu de propriétaire à plein temps. Vous serez le pivot entre : la tech le support la conformité la direction Un mot d'honnêteté sur la nature du poste : c'est un rôle très opérationnel et très interne . On y écrit des procédures, mais surtout on les applique. On y rédige un plan de test, puis on le joue. On y documente une politique d'accès, puis on va révoquer les comptes un par un. Si vous cherchez un poste de méthodologie pure, ce n'est pas celui-là. Si vous aimez que les choses soient carrées et que ça se voie, c'est exactement celui-là. Qualité produit et tests (environ 40% du temps) Prendre la stratégie de test de bout en bout : plans de test, tests automatisés (Playwright), smoke tests, tests de non-régression Définir les critères de sortie d'une release : ce qui bloque un déploiement, ce qui ne le bloque pas Jouer la QA sur les parcours critiques avant chaque livraison web, desktop et mobile Fiabilité et incidents (environ 30% items.desc: Location: Bucharest, Romania The Network Engineers goal is to support the company in the daily management of the IS/IT function by delivering high-availability network infrastructure in order to sustain the users' online and on-site information technology activities. To do so, the Network Engineers work hand in hand with other IS/IT professionals (architects, security engineers …). On a daily basis, the Network Engineers design and implement network configurations, troubleshoot performance issues, carry out network monitoring and configure network systems such as routers, switches, and wireless infrastructure. They have to make sure that operations’ workflow, practices, and server maintenance are working effectively and efficiently to aid the improvement of performance, security system, and availability of systems and dependent ecosystems. Network Engineers interface with various stakeholders, within the company and throughout IS/IT Function, in order to deliver stakeholders satisfaction by managing capacity and carrying out remote and/or on-site support. COMPETENCIES: You are able to maintain and control computer networks and related computing environments together with structures software, programs software, hardware, and configurations. You can carry out the configuration of network and security infrastructure equipment. You have experience in monitoring network performance by troubleshooting, diagnosing and resolving software, hardware, and other network and system problems. You have the ability to define the detailed functional behavior of infrastructure building blocks. You have the ability to prevent service interruption, data loss and/or other technical disasters. You have experience in managing complex recovery operations. You can stay value driven, propose smart ideas, be disruptive, take smart risk You have the creativity to lay out smart designs, think out of the box You have the ability to implement new solutions for your users’ satisfaction. You contribute on purchase process in way to describe requirement, analyse & challenge offers and advise on tenderer’s selection. You are able to define a product roadmap and norms & standards You are autonomous, organized, dynamic and can be an actor of change management, promote teamwork You have the strong ability on writing of technical document TECHNICAL SKILLS: You can define and implement networking requirements in a variety of production processes. You have good analytic skills and provide a real expertise on level 3 support. You can configure network and security devices and other IT assets like: Firewalls: Juniper, Palo Alto, FortiGate, Stormshield, Checkpoint, L3/L4 Filtering, User-ID, App-ID. Proxies: zScaler, SSL inspection, WL/BL, URL categorization, web filters, content filter, CAS Gateway VPN: Cisco Firepower, Any Connect client Load balancer: F5 (LTM, APM), VMware NSX. Radius: Cisco ISE PSN, PAN, Dot1.x You have a good knowledge on transversal infrastructure and security domain like : Directories: Active Directory, LDAPS. IAM: Kerberos, SAML, Single Sign On, MFA, etc. PKI: x509 certificate, CMS, AEP. Cloud computing: SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, Infra as Code, and Automation with scripts development (Python/Shell). Cloud security: Zero Trust Network Access, SASE. Virtualized environment (ESX and VMs). SOFT SKILLS: You have strong communication and documentation skills. You are proactive and self-motivated with a problem-solving mindset. You have the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative agile environment. You are independent and self-organizing. At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world. Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of defence and security, aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. In Romania, we are advancing innovation through software engineering, research and development, delivering solutions in key markets in which Thales Group operates. Our engineers design, develop and integrate solutions that impact global industries – from fully operational systems and subsystems for naval warfare and maritime security operations, to air traffic management systems, satellite-based solutions, tactical indoor simulations, identity and biometric technologies and more.

items.desc: About the role Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join an exciting technology-driven assignment focused on building scalable data solutions and backend services. Duration: 1 Year Contract. Are you passionate about data engineering, distributed processing, and solving complex technical challenges? This role offers the opportunity to build and maintain data pipelines, develop backend APIs, and contribute to solutions used across a collaborative engineering environment. We’re looking for someone who combines strong programming skills with a proactive mindset, takes ownership of deliverables, and enjoys sharing knowledge with fellow engineers. Location: Malmö, Sweden Work model: Hybrid – on-site at the client’s office 3 days per week About the Role As a Data Engineer, you will contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data-processing solutions. You will work with modern data technologies and backend frameworks to ensure reliable access to data and efficient data workflows. You will collaborate closely with other engineers, provide technical guidance where needed, and help drive continuous improvements across the team's data engineering capabilities. Key Responsibilities Build, maintain, and improve data pipelines using distributed data-processing technologies. Develop and maintain scalable data solutions that support the team's needs. Build backend APIs and services to enable efficient and reliable access to data. Provide technical support and share knowledge with colleagues on data engineering topics. Identify opportunities for technical improvements and drive initiatives from idea to implementation. Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to design practical, scalable solutions. Take end-to-end ownership of your work and ensure high-quality delivery. Contribute to a collaborative, high-trust, and fast-paced engineering environment. Skills Python Scala Java Skills & requirements ✅ Required Skills & Qualifications Professional experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role. Strong programming skills in Python and Java or Scala. Solid backend development experience, ideally with Scala Play Framework or an equivalent framework. Strong general software engineering and problem-solving skills. Experience developing and maintaining software solutions and data-processing workflows. A bachelor's degree in a relevant field; a master's degree is a strong advantage. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to work independently, take responsibility, and drive tasks forward. A collaborative mindset with a willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues. Ability to work on-site at the client's office in Malmö three days per week. ⭐ Nice-to-Have Skills & Technologies Experience with one or more of the following technologies will be an advantage: Apache Spark and Apache Flink for distributed data processing. Apache Iceberg for modern data lake architectures. Microservices deployed on Kubernetes. Snowflake for cloud data warehousing. Apache Kafka for event streaming and data integration. Akka for concurrent and distributed applications. Grafana for monitoring and data visualisation. Machine learning concepts, tools, or practical ML projects. Our Ideal Candidate You thrive in an environment where you are trusted to take ownership and make independent decisions. You are analytical, creative, and comfortable tackling challenges with limited guidance. At the same time, you value teamwork, communicate your ideas clearly, and enjoy helping others succeed. You balance technical innovation with practical delivery and continuously look for ways to improve existing systems and workflows. Interested in This Opportunity? If you have strong Python and Java/Scala skills, backend development experience, and an interest in scalable data engineering, we’d like to hear from you. Send us your updated CV highlighting your data engineering projects, programming expertise, backend experience, and relevant technologies.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications for application development. Design and implement RESTful APIs to enable seamless communication between different software components and external services. Maintain version control using tools like GitHub, SVN, and Git to ensure code integrity and facilitate team collaboration. Optimize database interactions by writing efficient SQL queries for systems like MySQL and SQL Server; manage data storage solutions on AWS and Azure cloud platforms. Integrate third-party APIs and services to enhance application functionality while ensuring security and scalability. Participate in code reviews, debugging sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives to uphold high-quality standards across all projects. Strong experience with back-end technologies such as Java, C#, Python, Ruby on Rails, C++,.NET framework, and Linux environments. You will develop tools to determine whether a robot design can perform real-world tasks before committing to hardware . Your
items.desc: Here at Humanoid, we believe in a future where robots amplify human potential. That’s why we’ve set out on a mission to build the world’s most capable, commercially-scalable, and safe humanoid robots. We’re bringing that mission to life with HMND‑01 - our rapidly developed humanoid platform being deployed in real industrial environments - and we’re growing the team to take it even further. About The Role We design robots in simulation before building them in hardware . As a Robotics Simulation & RL Engineer , you will help design and validate future generations of our robotic platforms - including bipedal and wheeled systems - using physics simulation and reinforcement learning. You will develop tools to determine whether a robot design can perform real-world tasks before committing to hardware . Your work will directly inform robot architecture, actuator selection, sensor placement, and control strategies . A key responsibility of this role is owning and validating the canonical robot models (URDF and simulation assets) used across simulation and control stacks. What You’ll Do Design and evaluate new robot platforms using physics simulation; Analyze robot capabilities including workspace, manipulability, dynamic balance, and torque limits; Use reinforcement learning to stress-test robot designs and explore capability limits; Own and maintain URDF models of current and future robot platforms; Maintain the CAD URDF simulation pipeline; Develop tools and benchmarks to evaluate locomotion, manipulation, and platform robustness; Provide quantitative feedback to hardware teams on actuator sizing, joint placement, mass distribution, and sensor layout; Collaborate with mechanical, control, and perception teams to guide platform design decisions. What We're Looking For M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Control, or a related field; Strong foundation in robot kinematics and dynamics; Experience with robot simulation environments (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, Gazebo, or similar); Experience with reinforcement learning in robotics or physics-based simulation; Experience working with URDF or similar robot description formats; Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++; Experience training RL locomotion or manipulation policies. Nice to have: Experience with legged, humanoid, or wheeled robots; Experience with whole-body control or torque-controlled robots; Experience with simulation-driven hardware design; Experience building large-scale RL training pipelines. What We Offer Competitive equity: stock options with meaningful upside as we scale. 30+ paid days off, including 23 days of annual leave, all UK bank holidays, and additional company closure days (including Christmas–New Year shutdown). Private healthcare, including virtual and in-person care. Pension scheme with 8% total contribution (5% employee, 3% employer) on full earnings. Free daily breakfast, catered lunch, and snacks in-office. Work at the frontier - collaborate daily with world-class engineers, researchers, and product experts building the next generation of AI and humanoid robotics. Real ownership - direct access to founding leadership, meaningful input on product direction, and the ability to drive key initiatives from day one.

items.desc: DESCRIPTION Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account. AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it. You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver. Key job responsibilities Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified. Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil. Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work. Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes. Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability. Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers. Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices. A day in the life You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place. You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written. On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur. You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back. You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap. About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. Why Amazon Security? At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. items.desc: AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. Job Title: Product Intelligence Data Scientist Location: Cambridge/London, United Kingdom (Hybrid) Employment Type: full-time The Job We are looking for a Product Intelligence Data Scientist to build a unified intelligence layer that transforms raw usage signals, behavioral data, and lifecycle events into predictive, prescriptive insights — enabling teams to act on what the product is telling us, not just what gets reported. You will own the analytical models and frameworks that connect product behavior to business outcomes across acquisition, activation, adoption, expansion, and renewal. Key Responsibilities Partner with Product to define and validate hypotheses around feature adoption, friction points, and growth levers using experimentation methods Translate complex product signals into lifecycle intelligence that drives prioritization — surfacing what to build, fix, or sunset Build and own predictive models that quantify adoption maturity, churn risk, expansion propensity, and feature-market fit from product telemetry Design behavioral segmentation and cohort frameworks that reveal how users derive value — and where they don’t Develop causal and inferential analyses that connect product interactions to revenue outcomes (NRR, LTV, expansion) Create automated scoring systems (product-qualified leads, customer health, engagement intensity) that feed into GTM, Customer Success, and in-product workflows Build early-warning detection models that identify at-risk accounts from behavioral shifts before lagging indicators appear Communicate findings to senior leadership as clear, actionable business narratives, and democratise intelligence findings for the wider team Essential Requirements 5+ years in data science or advanced analytics — ideally in a hybrid PLG/sales-led SaaS environment Strong Python and SQL; experience with data modelling and pipeline tools (dbt, Airflow, Dagster) Deep expertise in predictive modelling, causal inference, survival analysis, and experimentation (A/B, diff-in-diff, instrumental variables) Experience working directly with product telemetry and event-stream data at scale Solid understanding of SaaS lifecycle mechanics (ARR, NRR, LTV, PQLs, activation funnels) Ability to translate statistical findings into product and commercial strategy for non-technical stakeholders Degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or equivalent) Desired Skills And Competencies Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field Cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Azure Synapse) Product analytics instrumentation experience (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo, or custom event pipelines) MLOps — model deployment, monitoring, and retraining in production Experience building propensity or scoring models that integrate into CRM/CS platforms Familiarity with industrial software or enterprise SaaS contexts UK Benefits include: Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program. items.desc: Organisation NAVAL GROUP Acteur international du naval de défense, Naval Group est partenaire des États dans la maîtrise de leur souveraineté maritime. Grâce à des savoir-faire et des moyens industriels exceptionnels, il conçoit, réalise, intègre, maintient en service et modernise des sous-marins, des navires de surface et des drones ainsi que leurs systèmes, leurs armes et leurs équipements, jusqu'à la déconstruction. UN ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL POSITIF Implantés sur 9 sites en France et dans 17 pays, nous valorisons un environnement de travail agréable, favorisant la diversité des profils, l'esprit d'équipe et le bien-être. Cela se concrétise par une mixité sociale, des accords pour la qualité de vie au travail, un engagement dans le développement professionnel via la formation continue et l'implication des collaborateurs et collaboratrices dans la mise en œuvre collective de notre stratégie de responsabilité sociétale de l'entreprise (RSE). NOS CHIFFRES CLEFS 17 170 collaborateurs et collaboratrices 4,6 milliards d'euros de chiffre d'affaires Description Du Poste Naval Group recrute, pour son site de Lorient, au sein de la direction de la Transformation digitale et des Systèmes d'information (DTSI). Quelles sont les missions de la DTSI ? Elle assure l'exploitation des systèmes d'information du groupe, garantit la maîtrise de la gestion des projets SI et le fonctionnement des applicatifs, tout en s'engageant dans une démarche ambitieuse de transformation digitale ! Au sein de la nouvelle entité IA FACTORY rattachée à notre Direction de la Transformation Digitale et des Systèmes d’Information, vous intégrez l’équipe Plateforme IA et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le Tech Lead. Ensemble, vous serez en charge de la construction, de l’évolution et du maintien en condition opérationnelles de notre Plateforme IA et de ses services. Votre rôle est d’opérer ce socle technique pour qu’il soit performant, sécurisé et dans une orientation « self-service » pour les cas d’usages IA. Plus précisément, vous devrez : Participer à la mise en place et à l’optimisation de clusters Kubernetes dédiés à l’IA Garantir la disponibilité, la résilience et la montée en charge de la plateforme pour supporter de multiples cas d’usage simultanés Intégrer et maintenir les services transverses de la plateforme. Exemple : Model Registry, Model Serving, Feature Store … Assurer l’observabilité complète de la plateforme (infrastructure, services, modèles) en définissant avec le Tech Lead les SLO/SLI critiques à surveiller Appliquer la politique de sécurité de la plateforme (exemple : gestion des identités, secrets, scan de conteneurs …) et s’assurer que l’exposition des APIs et des modèles respecte les standards de sécurité (exemple : authentification, throttling) Les entretiens de recrutement vous permettront d’échanger avec le manager du pôle et ainsi d’en apprendre davantage sur l’ensemble de vos missions. LES AVANTAGES NAVAL GROUP Une rémunération attractive comprenant un salaire fixe et des éléments additionnels individuels et/ou collectifs (participation et intéressement). Un Comité social et économique (CSE) dynamique proposant des activités sociales et culturelles, des chèques vacances, des aides financières pour la garde d'enfants (dispositif de chèques emploi-service CESU), des voyages, etc. Une excellente protection sociale 5* (mutuelle et prévoyance). Épargne salariale attractive (abondement sur PEG et PERCOG). Un environnement de travail agréable et un accès au restaurant d'entreprise avec une participation employeur. Profil ET VOUS ? Votre formation : Vous êtes diplômé.e d’une école d’ingénieur ou équivalent dans une formation spécialisée dans l’informatique et détenez une expérience minimum de 5 ans Vos compétences : Vous avez un profil technique complet. Vous comprenez les enjeux d’une plateforme mutualisée : vous aimez construire des outils et mettre en place des services robustes qui servent à d’autres produits et équipes techniques. Vous maitrisez la chaine DevSecOps et avez développé une expertise sur des spécificités liées à l’IA (MLOps / LLMOps). Vous êtes dans un état d’esprit orienté « Platform Engineer » et « SRE ». Vous connaissez : - L’écosystème technique autour de Kubernetes (certification CKA appréciée) et IA - Helm et gestion avec des opérateurs - Scaling et eventing : KEDA (autoscaling sur métriques externes) - Serving & inférence : KServe, NVIDIA Triton Inference Server … - Model Registry avec MLflow - GPU & Hardware : NVIDIA Device Plugin, gestion des drives CUDA, monitoring GPU - GitOps : ArgoCD ou Flux pour la synchronisation infra - Observabilité : Prometheus / Grafana, traces distribuées en cohérence avec OpenTelemetry Des compétences en développement (backend) pour du développement d’APIs (Python/FastAPI) ou de services (Rust/Golang) sont un plus. Vous êtes à l’aise pour : - travailler en équipe : interagir avec des collaborateurs internes ou externes du groupe, travailler en mode projet - …

items.desc: Colaboramos con una scale-up de software de recursos humanos nacida en Barcelona, con más de 3.000 clientes en más de 60 países, un equipo de más de 600 personas y reconocida por LinkedIn como Top Startup. Buscamos un/a Offensive Security Engineer que se incorpore al equipo de seguridad para atacar, de forma proactiva, las aplicaciones, las APIs, la infraestructura y las funcionalidades con IA de la compañía, y que además construya las herramientas y automatizaciones que ayudan a corregir antes. 📍 Híbrido en Madrid, Barcelona o A Coruña · 42.000–60.000 € brutos/año según experiencia Qué harás Hacer pentesting proactivo de las aplicaciones, APIs, infraestructura y funcionalidades con IA de la empresa. Reproducir y validar vulnerabilidades reportadas por terceros, como el programa de bug bounty. Colaborar con los equipos de desarrollo para remediar los hallazgos y reforzar las prácticas de código seguro. Mejorar cómo se validan, priorizan y remedian las vulnerabilidades que llegan por bug bounty, por pruebas internas, por herramientas automatizadas y por revisiones externas. Detectar patrones recurrentes o heredados de vulnerabilidades a partir de la causa raíz, incidentes anteriores y hallazgos de seguridad. Construir y mejorar automatizaciones, agentes, skills y checks de CI/CD que ayuden a los equipos de ingeniería a detectar y corregir problemas antes. Ayudar a asegurar el uso de IA en productos y flujos internos: LLMs, agentes, acceso a datos, herramientas, permisos y escenarios de abuso. Contribuir al desarrollo de las herramientas, automatizaciones e infraestructura de seguridad. Estar al día en investigación, amenazas, técnicas de ataque y riesgos emergentes de seguridad en IA. Qué buscamos Imprescindible 4+ años de experiencia profesional en seguridad de aplicaciones, seguridad ofensiva o pentesting. Es obligatoria la experiencia en pentesting de aplicaciones web. Formación en Ingeniería o Informática y buen conocimiento de aplicaciones web, bases de datos, protocolos de red y sistemas operativos. Fundamentos sólidos de ciberseguridad, CVSS, metodologías de pruebas y herramientas. Fluidez con scripting o lenguajes de programación para automatizar la seguridad, como Python o Bash. Perfil técnico y curioso, cómodo moviéndote entre distintas áreas de seguridad en lugar de especializarte solo en una. Inglés fluido. Valorable Curiosidad y ganas de aprender sobre seguridad de IA: inyección de prompts en LLMs, agentes, exposición de datos, permisos de herramientas, seguridad de RAG y adopción de IA. Certificaciones como BSCP o eWPTX. Experiencia con aplicaciones Ruby / Ruby on Rails. Te gusta atacar sistemas, pero también construir herramientas, automatizaciones, guardarraíles y soluciones prácticas que hagan la seguridad escalable. No hace falta ser experto en todo: buscamos a alguien que razone con criterio, aprenda rápido, use bien la IA y proponga soluciones pragmáticas. Valores del equipo We own it: asumimos responsabilidad y tomamos decisiones decididas. We learn and teach: invertimos en aprendizaje continuo y compartimos conocimiento. We partner: decidimos como equipo y confiamos unos en otros. We grow fast: actuamos rápido y aprendemos de cada resultado. Beneficios Entorno colaborativo, multicultural y de alto crecimiento. Seguro médico privado. Acceso a gimnasio, piscinas y programas de bienestar. Ahorro en gastos y clases de idiomas. Desayunos y fruta ecológica en la oficina, descuentos en comidas, café y té gratis. Oficina pet-friendly.

items.title: R&D Specialist Duurzame warmte
items.card: Wil jij onderzoek doen dat niet op de plank blijft liggen, maar direct wordt toegepast in duurzame energieprojecten? In deze rol werk je aan de ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van complete energiesystemen en warmtepompoplossingen. Je combineert theoretische diepgang met praktische toepassing en krijgt veel vrijheid om jouw ideeën uit te werken. Wat ga je doen? Als R&D Specialist Duurzame warmte werk je aan het
items.desc: Wil jij onderzoek doen dat niet op de plank blijft liggen, maar direct wordt toegepast in duurzame energieprojecten? In deze rol werk je aan de ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van complete energiesystemen en warmtepompoplossingen. Je combineert theoretische diepgang met praktische toepassing en krijgt veel vrijheid om jouw ideeën uit te werken. Wat ga je doen? Als R&D Specialist Duurzame warmte werk je aan het modelleren, simuleren en optimaliseren van energiecentrales en warmtepompsystemen. Je onderzoekt vanuit een sterk theoretisch kader, maar altijd met de praktijk als uitgangspunt. Jouw werk helpt om snel te bepalen welk energieconcept technisch en energetisch het beste past bij een project. Je houdt je bezig met process design, thermodynamica en het ontwikkelen van modellen waarmee complete systemen kunnen worden doorgerekend. Daarbij werk je onder andere met simulatiesoftware zoals EES. Je kijkt niet alleen naar één onderdeel van een installatie, maar juist naar het totaalplaatje en de samenhang tussen verschillende technieken. Het interessante aan deze omgeving is dat onderzoek en uitvoering dicht bij elkaar liggen. Ideeën die jij ontwikkelt, kunnen relatief snel worden getest en toegepast binnen echte projecten. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met engineers en andere technische specialisten. Wat wordt er van je verwacht? Je hebt een universitaire technische opleiding afgerond, bij voorkeur in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt een sterke interesse in warmtepomptechniek, thermodynamica en process design en wordt enthousiast van modelleren, simuleren en technisch complexe vraagstukken. Tegelijkertijd ben je praktisch ingesteld. Je wilt niet alleen onderzoeken waarom iets technisch zou moeten werken, maar ook zien wat er gebeurt wanneer een oplossing daadwerkelijk wordt toegepast. Je werkt gemakkelijk samen met verschillende technische disciplines, communiceert helder en kunt ook onder druk creatief blijven zoeken naar een goede oplossing. Wat kun je verwachten? Je komt terecht binnen een technisch familiebedrijf met korte lijnen, weinig bureaucratie en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Je krijgt vrijheid in de manier waarop je jouw werk organiseert en kunt vanuit jouw expertise daadwerkelijk invloed uitoefenen op de technische keuzes die worden gemaakt. Daar staat een goed salaris tot € 5.500,- bruto per maand, aangevuld met een pensioenregeling en winstuitkering. Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen en er is volop ruimte voor opleidingen, trainingen en verdere inhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Daarnaast werk je vanuit een moderne werkomgeving en krijg je de middelen die je nodig hebt om jouw werk goed uit te voeren. Reiskosten worden vergoed en afhankelijk van de functie kan een leaseauto tot de mogelijkheden behoren. Ook kun je gebruikmaken van een fietsleaseplan. Na je proeftijd ontvang je bovendien een welkomstbonus van 50% van één bruto maandsalaris. Zoek jij een R&D-omgeving waarin je technische diepgang kunt combineren met zichtbare impact in de praktijk? Dan is dit een interessante volgende stap. To our foreign friends, speaking Dutch is a must for this role. Please don’t apply if you’re not fluent in Dutch.

items.card: Söker du en meningsfull sysselsättning där du som forskare kan bidra till samhällskritiska funktioner? Söker du en plats där dina modeller och beräkningar kan bidra till att rädda liv? I så fall kanske FOI är din nästa arbetsgivare! Om tjänsten Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut arbetar tillsammans med förvars-, beredskaps- och sjukvårds­myndig­­heterna för att säkerställa att Sveriges vårdsystem är robust i
items.desc: Söker du en meningsfull sysselsättning där du som forskare kan bidra till samhällskritiska funktioner? Söker du en plats där dina modeller och beräkningar kan bidra till att rädda liv? I så fall kanske FOI är din nästa arbetsgivare! Om tjänsten Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut arbetar tillsammans med förvars-, beredskaps- och sjukvårds­myndig­­heterna för att säkerställa att Sveriges vårdsystem är robust i händelse av kris och krig. Det innebär bland annat prognosering av förväntade skadetyper från masskadehändelser, estimering av det resulterande vårdbehovet samt dimensionering av sjukvårdsresurser och logistikkedjan som behövs för att möta detta behov. I den här tjänsten blir du en del av det team som för hela Sveriges räkning utför forskning, modellering och beräkningar till detta samhällskritiska arbete. Som forskare inom skadeverkan på människor och sjukvårdsbehov kommer du tillsammans med andra drivna forskare inom ämnet arbeta med att utveckla modeller, prognoser och beräkningar för dessa ändamål. Forskningen kommer att delas mellan områdena skadeverkan på människa och sjukvårdsbehov, men alltjämt med det explicita syftet att stödja den svenska sjukvårdsberedskapen med beräkningar, modellering och analys. Om enheten Du kommer att ingå i enheten för befolkningsskydd som tillhör avdelningen försvarsanalys. Befolkningsskydd är en tillväxtsenhet med inriktning på det civila försvaret och i synnerhet skydd av civilbefolkningen. Läs gärna mer om vad vi gör på FOI:s hemsida: Försvarsanalys. Delar av tjänsten delas med enheten för verkansvärdering på avdelningen för vapen skydd och säkerhet, men tjänsten är förlagd till Kista. Har du den kompetensprofil vi behöver? Krav Doktorsexamen inom relevant område (exempelvis fysik eller matematik), alternativt masterexamen i kombination med relevant arbetslivserfarenhet. Goda kunskaper inom matematisk modellering. Erfarenhet av att arbeta med komplex, ofullständig eller på annat sätt rörig data. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Arbetet är i sitt fundament tvärvetenskapligt och komplext. Förmågan att analysera komplex data och att skapa förenklade modeller baserat på sådan data är avgörande för att bli framgångsrik i denna tjänst. Du är också kreativ och kommer ofta med idéer och nya angreppssätt. Eftersom du kommer att vara en del av ett multidisciplinärt team bestående av scenariokonstruktörer, modellerare och mjukvaruutvecklare, kommer framgången att vara avhängig en god samarbetsförmåga. Vi ser även att du är självgående och tar ansvar för ditt arbete som du genomför på ett strukturerat sätt för att leverera efterfrågade resultat i tid. Vidare ser vi att du har god kommunikativ förmåga som gör att du kan beskriva komplexa idéer och problem på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper. Meriterande Dokumenterade forskarerfarenheter. Kunskaper inom anatomi, fysiologi eller sjukvård med särskilt vikt på traumavård. Vana av att utföra kvantitativa analyser. Vad erbjuder vi dig? Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut (FOI) är en statlig myndighet som bedriver världsledande forskning inom försvar och säkerhet till stöd för Sveriges militära och civila försvar. Vi erbjuder en unik arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta med det som är viktigt för totalförsvaret och hela samhället. Forskningen tillämpas både inom försvarsmyndigheter och hos civila aktörer och spelar en avgörande roll i att bygga en relevant och effektiv försvarsförmåga. Vi arbetar medvetet för en god arbetsmiljö med en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Utöver detta erbjuder vi en rad förmåner. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss: https://www.foi.se/jobba-hos-oss.html Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Vill du vara med och söka svaren för en säkrare värld? Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV och personligt brev via ansökningsknappen senast den 18 oktober 2026! För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta enhetschef David Andersson. Fackliga företrädare är Monia Lougui (Saco-S) och Lisa Bergsten (OFR/S – ST). Samtliga nås på 08-555 030 00. Då anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). Inför säkerhetsprövning efterfrågas vidimerade kopior på de utbildningar och tjänstgöringsintyg som är relevanta för tjänsten. FOI är en myndighet varmed inlämnade ansökningshandlingar blir allmän handling som på begäran kan lämnas ut till utomstående enligt offentlighets- och sekretesslagen. Erbjudanden från rekryteringsföretag undanbedes.

Als Campusuniversität mit sehr guter Grundausstattung bietet sie beste Voraussetzungen für hochqualitative Lehre und Forschung. In unserem Selbstverständnis verstehen wir uns als familienorientierte Einrichtung, die für Gleichstellung, Vielfalt und Chancengerechtigkeit steht. Das Munich Center for Space Communications (MCSC) am Lehrstuhl für Informationsverarbeitung betreibt eine der technisch leistungsfähigsten universitären Experimental-Satellitenbodenstationen Europas. Die Anlage umfasst mehrere nachgeführte Tracking-Antennensysteme für LEO-, MEO- und GEO-Satelliten, HF-Frontends vom UHF-Bereich über S-, X- und Ka-Band bis hin zu Q/V-Band, sowie eine optische Bodenstation für Freiraumlaserkommunikation. Diese Infrastruktur dient der experimentellen Analyse, Verifikation und Demonstration neuartiger Übertragungsverfahren in realen Weltraumkommunikationskanälen. Die ausgeschriebene Position verbindet wissenschaftliche Forschung im Bereich fortgeschrittener Signalverarbeitung und Satellitenkommunikation mit der technischen Weiterentwicklung und dem Betrieb dieser Infrastruktur. Eine Weiterqualifizierung zur Promotion wird angestrebt, ist jedoch keine zwingende Voraussetzung. Aufgaben Sie führen experimentelle Forschung durch, zur Charakterisierung und Nutzung höherer Frequenzbänder in der Satellitenkommunikation, z. B. Q/V-Band und darüber hinaus, einschließlich Untersuchung atmosphärischer und sonstiger Kanaleinflüsse. Sie entwickeln und bewerten neue Wellenformen, Modulations-, Codierungs- und Signalverarbeitungsverfahren unter realen Kanalbedingungen. Sie arbeiten an der Gewinnung, Analyse und Modellierung von Messdaten aus Echtzeit-Experimenten an der Bodenstation; Ableitung robuster Kanalmodelle. Sie sind zuständig für die Konzeption und Umsetzung von experimentellen Messkampagnen, einschließlich Multi-Orbit-Szenarien (LEO, MEO, GEO). Sie verfassen wissenschaftliche Publikationen und Beiträge für Konferenzen; Mitwirkung in Drittmittelprojekten und Forschungskonsortien. Sie sind verantwortlich für den Betrieb, die Überwachung und die Weiterentwicklung der Satellitenbodenstation, einschließlich HF-Subsysteme sowie benötigter Messgeräteausstattung. Sie arbeiten am Aufbau, der Integration und der Inbetriebnahme von experimentellen Komponenten für neue Frequenzbänder oder Messsysteme. Sie entwickeln Softwaretools (Python, MATLAB etc.) zur Automatisierung, Steuerung, Datenerfassung und Analyse. Sie betreiben die Fehlerdiagnose und die Wartung der technischen Systeme sowie Dokumentation der Infrastruktur. Sie wirken bei sicherheitsrelevanten Prozessen mit (HF-Strahlenschutz, Laserschutz); Qualifikationen können erworben werden. Erfahrung im Umgang mit HF-Messtechnik (z. B. Spektrumanalysatoren, Netzwerkanalysatoren, Signalgeneratoren, Modems, etc.). Programmierkenntnisse in Python, MATLAB oder vergleichbaren Umgebungen. Fähigkeit zur strukturierten Fehleranalyse und zum Betrieb komplexer technischer Anlagen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Kenntnisse im HF-Strahlenschutz oder Laserschutz sind von Vorteil; eine entsprechende Qualifikation kann bei Bedarf erworben werden WAS FÜR UNS ZÄHLT Motivation zur wissenschaftlichen Arbeit, analytisches Denken und Freude an experimenteller Forschung. Bereitschaft, sich in komplexe Experimentalanlagen einzuarbeiten und diese eigenständig weiterzuentwickeln. Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsvermögen und strukturiertes Arbeiten. Selbstständigkeit in der Umsetzung technischer und wissenschaftlicher Aufgaben sowie Verantwortung im Betrieb einer Forschungsinfrastruktur. Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Messkampagnen außerhalb regulärer Zeiten. items.desc: Söker du en tjänst inom hälsa och sjukvård utöver det normala? Vill du använda dina färdigheter inom anatomi, fysiologi och medicin för att främja beredskap och stödja totalförsvaret? I så fall kanske FOI är din nästa arbetsgivare! Om tjänsten Ur ett medicinskt perspektiv studerar FOI människan från två perspektiv: vapenverkan och vårdbehov. Det första av dessa perspektiv studerar vilken direkt eller indirekt skadeverkan som åsamkas människor efter bekämpning med något vapensystem, såsom penetrativt och trubbigt våld eller tryckskador. Det andra perspektivet rör vilka vårdinsatser och vårdresurser som krävs för att omhänderta personer som åsamkats sådana skador. Den här tjänsten rör båda dessa perspektiv. FOI utför analyser om, förmedlar metodstöd för, och skapar matematiska modeller av vapenverkan och vårdbehov för såväl den civila som den militära sjukvårdens räkning. Den här tjänsten handlar om att bistå denna verksamhet. Den framgångsrika kandidaten förväntas göra detta på tre sätt: 1. Genom att bedriva forskning inom dessa områden. 2. Genom att bidra med sakkunskap till övriga på myndigheten som arbetar inom dessa områden. Samt 3. Genom att arbeta med att främja att resultat som presteras inom dessa områden nyttas på bästa sätt hos våra slutanvändare (företrädelsevis hälso- och sjukvårdsmyndigheter, regioner och försvarsmyndigheter). Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans i en kompetensintensiv miljö tillsammans med kollegor med företrädelsevis en naturvetenskapligt kvantitativ bakgrund, för att tillsammans möta de utmaningar som våra sjukvårdskedjor och -system kommer att ställas inför i händelse av krig och kris. Om enheterna Du kommer att ha hemvist på enheten för befolkningsskydd som tillhör avdelningen försvarsanalys i Kista. Befolkningsskydd är en tillväxtsenhet med inriktning på det civila försvaret och i synnerhet skydd av civilbefolkningen. Därutöver kommer du att stödja enheten för verkansvärdering på avdelningen för vapen skydd och säkerhet. Har du den kompetensprofil vi behöver? Krav Läkar- eller sjuksköterskelegitimation. Fördjupade kunskaper inom en för tjänsten relevant medicinsk disciplin, såsom traumatologi, anatomi eller fysiologi. Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Som medicinsk forskare och sakexpert i ett team med en stark bas i modellering och kvantitativa analyser kommer tjänsten att ställa stora krav på vara självgående , att ha hög samarbetsförmåga , samt att pedagogiskt kunna kommunicera komplexa idéer. Vi ser även gärna att du är kreativ och har en problemlösande analytisk förmåga , vilket kommer att hjälpa dig att bidra forsknings- och utvecklingsarbetet som bedrivs på myndigheten. Meriterande Disputerat inom ett för tjänsten relevant område. Kunskaper inom matematisk modellering. Erfarenhet av programmering. Vana av att arbeta med kvantitativa data. Erfarenhet av prehospital sjukvård. Vad erbjuder vi dig? Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut (FOI) är en statlig myndighet som bedriver världsledande forskning inom försvar och säkerhet till stöd för Sveriges militära och civila försvar. Vi erbjuder en unik arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta med det som är viktigt för totalförsvaret och hela samhället. Forskningen tillämpas både inom försvarsmyndigheter och hos civila aktörer och spelar en avgörande roll i att bygga en relevant och effektiv försvarsförmåga. Vi arbetar medvetet för en god arbetsmiljö med en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Utöver detta erbjuder vi en rad förmåner. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss: https://www.foi.se/jobba-hos-oss.html Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Vill du vara med och söka svaren för en säkrare värld? Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV och personligt brev via ansökningsknappen senast den 18 oktober 2026! För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta enhetschef David Andersson. Fackliga företrädare är Monia Lougui (Saco-S) och Lisa Bergsten (OFR/S – ST). Samtliga nås på 08-555 030 00. Då anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). Inför säkerhetsprövning efterfrågas vidimerade kopior på de utbildningar och tjänstgöringsintyg som är relevanta för tjänsten. FOI är en myndighet varmed inlämnade ansökningshandlingar blir allmän handling som på begäran kan lämnas ut till utomstående enligt offentlighets- och sekretesslagen. Erbjudanden från rekryteringsföretag undanbedes.

items.desc: Job Description Summary In the 12-month Data Science Placement, you may be combining data and analytics with engineering or applications knowledge. Job Description About GE Aerospace Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft. You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world! Roles And Responsibilities In the 12-month Data Science Placement, you may be combining data and analytics with engineering or applications knowledge. GE Aerospace combines unrivalled strength in the Aviation domain with digital capability to provide business changing outcomes. Our Data Science projects include working with GE Commercial Engines to support all aspects of the engines business from in-service deployment, fleet monitoring and management to repairs, supply chain and financial operations. A typical Data Science project starts with a problem statement and dataset, and our job is to work alongside our internal GE customers to develop, test and deploy analytics which solve their problems or provide significant insights to improve to their business impact. We also develop custom in-house analytic tools which help us deliver our projects efficiently and effectively. Every project is different and gives the opportunity to learn something new. The Data Scientist role combines data and analytics with engineering or applications knowledge. We make extensive use of AI, Machine Learning and Advanced Analytics including Computer Vision; Neural Networks; Multivariate Modelling, Anomaly Detection; Segmentation; NLP; Bayesian Reasoning, as well as working with wide-ranging and big data sets. Every project is different and gives the opportunity to learn something new. Responsibilities Include Applying analytical or ML methods to monitor trends and identify issues Assisting in the development, test and deployment of analytics including dashboards/reports and the maintenance of existing capabilities Assisting in the preparation of clear and insightful presentations A structured approach to problem solving Ability to deliver required tasks to timelines Comfortable working within a team or independently Communicating technical information to a range of stakeholders – e.g., peers, experts and non-experts, customers. Our Data Science projects vary from site to site, specific project details will be provided at the interview stage You will be guided by structured goals and objectives and will have responsibility to deliver on inspiring projects supported by your People Leader and team around you. We will guide you throughout the year to ensure you make the best of your GE Aerospace experience. Your People Leader will offer coaching and mentoring, and you will be provided with the opportunity to connect with other placement students across the UK. This opportunity is offered in our Eastleigh site. GE Aerospace, Eastleigh is a small, friendly office (c 65 employees) located in Chandlers Ford, within easy walking distance of local railway and bus links. With a deep history of developing and supplying condition monitoring technology and products to the aerospace sector, GE Aerospace Eastleigh combines unrivalled strength in the Aviation domain with digital capability to provide business changing outcomes. We are seeking highly motivated individuals to contribute to our digital future and have been successfully running internships since 2018. The site has opportunities in Data Science. Our job is to work alongside Aviation customers to develop, test and deploy analytics or software which solve their problems or provide significant insights and improvements to their business. We also develop custom in-house tools to help us deliver our projects efficiently and effectively. We support a wide range of customers both internal and external to GE. Every project is different and gives the opportunity to learn something new. This placement role is an intended pipeline for our Digital Technology Leadership Programme (DTLP) based in Cheltenham. Towards the end of the placement year, we will open graduate applications for our current placement students with an aim to secure a role prior to the end of their placement year.
