Job Summary Lumentum d.o.o. – Optična vlakna is looking for an early-career engineer to help develop new equipment for the automated manufacture of high-precision optical assemblies. The role combines mechanical and mechatronic design, precision positioning, sensing, software and process automation. You will design equipment, build and test prototypes, integrate hardware and develop the control sequences needed to turn a laboratory process into a reliable production capability. This is a hands-on engineering role with broad technical ownership. You will work closely with optical, process and manufacturing engineers while taking the equipment from initial concept through detailed design, integration and validation. Key Responsibilities Develop mechanical and mechatronic equipment for precision optical assembly. Create concepts, detailed CAD models, drawings and specifications for mechanisms, fixtures and machine assemblies. Select and integrate motion stages, actuators, cameras, sensors, optics and other equipment components. Design for positioning accuracy, repeatability, mechanical stability, accessibility and manufacturability. Develop automated sequences for component loading, positioning, alignment, processing and verification. Create software for equipment control, instrument communication, data collection and process reporting. Develop calibration methods and quantify system accuracy, drift, backlash and other sources of variation. Build, commission and troubleshoot prototypes, identifying whether problems originate in mechanics, controls, sensing, software or the process itself. Work with process engineers to translate laboratory requirements into practical equipment specifications. Support equipment validation and transfer into manufacturing. What We Are Looking For Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to apply them to real machines and hardware. Practical experience with CAD and an understanding of mechanisms, tolerances, materials and manufacturing methods. Interest or experience in automation, robotics, motion control, sensing or machine development. The ability to break a complex system into manageable functions, identify the main technical risks and test proposed solutions. Programming experience in Python, C++, C#, LabVIEW, PLC environments or a similar engineering platform. A hands-on approach to building, testing and improving equipment. Clear communication and the ability to work across mechanical engineering, software, optics and manufacturing. Suitable backgrounds include mechanical engineering, mechatronics, automation, robotics, electrical engineering, applied physics and related fields. We welcome exceptional graduates and early-career engineers. University projects, internships, technical competitions, previous employment and serious personal projects all count as relevant experience. Additional Experience We Value Experience with precision mechanics, optomechanical design, machine vision, active alignment, motion systems, laboratory equipment or production automation would be useful. Evidence of Technical Ability With your application, please include one example of a technically demanding system, machine or device that you designed, built, programmed or improved. It may come from your studies, previous employment, an internship, a competition or a personal project. Tell us what the problem was, what you personally contributed, the main engineering decisions you made and how you verified the result. Links to drawings, photographs, code, reports or test data are welcome. We will discuss this work with you during the technical interview. What You Can Expect From Us You will work on a core development problem with direct access to experienced engineers, laboratory equipment and manufacturing feedback. As your understanding grows, so will your ownership of the technology. We also offer a competitive compensation package, including base salary, performance bonus, equity participation and a broad range of employee benefits. items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As an Embedded Software Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to own the embedded software stack on the compute modules used across our platforms. You will take a new module from bare board to a maintained, securely booting Linux platform, covering the boot chain, kernel, drivers, and the verification around them. This is a high impact role that combines deep Linux and kernel work with hands on bring up on new hardware, taking a board from first power up through to flight. Responsibilities BSP and Reference Images: Build and maintain the BSP layer, device trees, and the reference images for each board, including custom layers and SDK generation, and carry them forward across kernel upgrades and silicon revisions. Boot Chain and Secure Boot: Own the boot chain, including bootloader porting, signed boot, verified rootfs, and A/B system update. Drivers and Low Level Interfaces: Develop and validate Linux device drivers across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI, including camera and sensor interfaces. Board Support on MCU Targets: Provide startup, clock, and peripheral support on the microcontrollers of boards the team designs. Board Bring Up and Hardware Validation: Lead software bring up on new hardware, take part in design reviews, and debug system level issues across the hardware and software boundary. Verification and Documentation: Define verification test plans and acceptance criteria, automate boot and peripheral test on real targets, and document each milestone. Cross Functional Collaboration: Work with the hardware team on new boards, and with Systems and Embedded Software Platform on interfaces and integration. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, mentor junior embedded engineers. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: MSc in engineering (electrical, computer, or a related field). PhD a plus. A hands on bring up record matters more than the specific degree. Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded software, with BSPs owned through their lifecycle and kept reproducible as the hardware evolved. Build Systems: Strong command of an embedded Linux build system such as Yocto or OpenEmbedded, across custom layers or packages, BSP integration, image build, and SDK generation. Experience with in house or non standard build systems is an advantage. Technical Expertise: Kernel space driver development on ARM targets, validated against real peripherals across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI. Device tree work on new boards and hardware revisions. Board bring up from first power up to a booting Linux image. Boot and Update: Bootloader porting, kernel configuration, signed boot, and firmware update mechanisms on production hardware, with security conscious and deterministic engineering practice throughout. Programming: Strong C and C++, including kernel space coding, and strong Python scripting skills, with solid version control practice (Git). Debugging Expertise: Able to isolate whether a fault sits in the driver, the kernel configuration, or the board, using GDB, JTAG, OpenOCD, kernel tracing, ftrace, and perf. Professional Attributes: Rigorous, structured, and systematic, able to work autonomously, unfazed by a board that will not boot. Excellent communication and documentation skills, able to present platform and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Additional Skills: Bare metal or RTOS firmware on microcontroller targets, experience enabling hardware accelerators on embedded SoCs including VPU and NPU drivers and runtimes, familiarity with the perception or control workloads that run on the module, and UAS, drone, or defense experience are strong advantages. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc: Digital Design Engineer – High-Speed Communications / ASIC Lausanne, Switzerland | UK options available CHF 120,000–130,000 + benefits What if the architecture wasn’t already decided before you joined? I’m recruiting Digital Design Engineers for a small advanced semiconductor R&D team exploring new approaches to high-speed communications silicon. This is not simply a role where you receive a finished specification and spend the next year implementing one RTL block. The team is working on new digital and mixed-signal architectures, with the freedom to question existing approaches, investigate new ideas and help turn the strongest concepts into production silicon. What you’ll work on You’ll contribute to the digital architecture and RTL development of advanced communications ICs, working closely with analog, architecture and wider design teams. The Work Can Include RTL design and microarchitecture High-speed digital design SerDes and high-speed interfaces Mixed-signal digital blocks Digital communications architectures Design exploration and architectural trade-offs Taking new concepts from R&D towards implementation in silicon The projects have a 2–4 year R&D horizon, so there is genuine room to investigate new approaches rather than simply following an existing standard or product roadmap. Who they’re looking for You’ll Likely Come From An ASIC / Digital IC Design Background With Strong RTL Experience And Exposure To At Least Some Of The Following High-speed digital design SerDes Mixed-signal ICs Communications silicon Advanced digital architectures You don’t need to tick every box. More important is that you enjoy solving problems where the answer isn’t already written in the specification. Why it’s interesting The team is deliberately small and collaborative. You’ll be working closely with experienced engineers, discussing ideas at architecture level, whiteboarding solutions and having considerably more influence over the direction of the design than you might get in a larger organisation. The objective is also very clear: this is exploratory engineering intended to become real silicon, not research that disappears into a presentation deck. The primary R&D team is based in Lausanne, with engineers typically onsite around three days per week. There is also some location flexibility for the digital positions, including opportunities in the UK. If you’re a Digital Design Engineer who enjoys asking “could we build this differently?”, I’d be very interested in speaking with you please contact Steph Hutchinson.

L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Laboratoire Interdisciplinaire des Sciences du Numérique Type de Contrat Chercheur en contrat CDD Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 91190 GIF SUR YVETTE Durée du contrat 6 mois Date d'Embauche 01/02/2027 Rémuneration Entre 3131,32 et 3569,85€ brut mensuel Postuler Date limite de candidature : samedi 7 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions Ce projet postdoctoral vise à faire avancer la compréhension de la variation socio-phonétique chez des communautés peu étudiées, ici les micro-travailleurs d’Amérique latine et du Brésil, en développant des méthodes hybrides intégrant des hypothèses linguistiques avec des approches d’apprentissage automatique supervisé et non supervisé. Le projet s’inscrit dans une initiative interdisciplinaire à l’intersection de la linguistique, de la sociologie du travail et des technologies de la parole, avec un accent sur les inégalités dans le travail numérique et leur lien avec les pratiques linguistiques. L’étude exploite un corpus unique d’environ 70 entretiens en espagnol latino-américain avec des micro-travailleurs interrogés par des sociologues dans plusieurs pays, ainsi que 50 enregistrements en portugais brésilien. Ce corpus est richement annoté avec des métadonnées sociodémographiques (sexe, pays, revenu, niveau d’éducation, etc.), ce qui est rare dans les corpus sociolinguistiques traditionnels, où les annotations se limitent généralement à des variables bien étudiées comme la région ou le genre. La multiplicité des variables sociodémographiques offre à la fois une opportunité et un défi : si elle permet des analyses plus approfondies, elle réduit également la taille effective des échantillons pour chaque sous-ensemble de variables, nécessitant des méthodes adaptées aux petits jeux de données. À ces données s’ajoutent des corpus comparables composés de données préexistantes en espagnol et en portugais (par exemple, les corpus sociolinguistiques publics comme PRESEEA (2014-) et les grands corpus disponibles au LISN via des projets antérieurs en technologies de la parole et en linguistique de corpus (Vasilescu et al. 2018, Vasilescu et al. 2020)). L’objectif principal est d’étudier les interactions entre les patrons de variation linguistiques ( de la phonétique acoustique au niveau sémantique) et les profils sociodémographiques, en allant au-delà des méthodes linguistiques quantitatives traditionnelles grâce à l’intégration d’approches d’apprentissage automatique supervisé et non supervisé. Ce Projet Postdoctoral a Pour Principaux Objectifs État de l’art de la littérature existante en sociolinguistique et en traitement automatique de la parole/modélisation par apprentissage automatique des variétés hispanophones et lusophones, avec un focus sur la relation entre les variables sociodémographiques et les schémas de variation. items.card: About The Role As an Embedded Software Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to own the embedded software stack on the compute modules used across our platforms. You will take a new module from bare board to a maintained, securely booting Linux platform, covering the boot chain, kernel, drivers, and the verification around them. This is a high impact role that combines deep Linux and kernel work with
items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As an Embedded Software Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to own the embedded software stack on the compute modules used across our platforms. You will take a new module from bare board to a maintained, securely booting Linux platform, covering the boot chain, kernel, drivers, and the verification around them. This is a high impact role that combines deep Linux and kernel work with hands on bring up on new hardware, taking a board from first power up through to flight. Responsibilities BSP and Reference Images: Build and maintain the BSP layer, device trees, and the reference images for each board, including custom layers and SDK generation, and carry them forward across kernel upgrades and silicon revisions. Boot Chain and Secure Boot: Own the boot chain, including bootloader porting, signed boot, verified rootfs, and A/B system update. Drivers and Low Level Interfaces: Develop and validate Linux device drivers across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI, including camera and sensor interfaces. Board Support on MCU Targets: Provide startup, clock, and peripheral support on the microcontrollers of boards the team designs. Board Bring Up and Hardware Validation: Lead software bring up on new hardware, take part in design reviews, and debug system level issues across the hardware and software boundary. Verification and Documentation: Define verification test plans and acceptance criteria, automate boot and peripheral test on real targets, and document each milestone. Cross Functional Collaboration: Work with the hardware team on new boards, and with Systems and Embedded Software Platform on interfaces and integration. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, mentor junior embedded engineers. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: MSc in engineering (electrical, computer, or a related field). PhD a plus. A hands on bring up record matters more than the specific degree. Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded software, with BSPs owned through their lifecycle and kept reproducible as the hardware evolved. Build Systems: Strong command of an embedded Linux build system such as Yocto or OpenEmbedded, across custom layers or packages, BSP integration, image build, and SDK generation. Experience with in house or non standard build systems is an advantage. Technical Expertise: Kernel space driver development on ARM targets, validated against real peripherals across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI. Device tree work on new boards and hardware revisions. Board bring up from first power up to a booting Linux image. Boot and Update: Bootloader porting, kernel configuration, signed boot, and firmware update mechanisms on production hardware, with security conscious and deterministic engineering practice throughout. Programming: Strong C and C++, including kernel space coding, and strong Python scripting skills, with solid version control practice (Git). Debugging Expertise: Able to isolate whether a fault sits in the driver, the kernel configuration, or the board, using GDB, JTAG, OpenOCD, kernel tracing, ftrace, and perf. Professional Attributes: Rigorous, structured, and systematic, able to work autonomously, unfazed by a board that will not boot. Excellent communication and documentation skills, able to present platform and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Additional Skills: Bare metal or RTOS firmware on microcontroller targets, experience enabling hardware accelerators on embedded SoCs including VPU and NPU drivers and runtimes, familiarity with the perception or control workloads that run on the module, and UAS, drone, or defense experience are strong advantages. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world! On our Digital Technology team, you’ll have a hand in designing, deploying, and maintaining technologies and systems to address the ever-changing needs of our customers and business. Roles And Responsibilities In the 12-month placement in Digital Technology (DT) you’ll gain hands-on experience in IT operations, project management, data analytics, and software development. You’ll work on exciting projects to improve business processes, support IT systems, and drive digital transformation. We have different types of roles in this area; here is a brief snapshot into each: Digital Technolog y (Cardiff) - you will play a key part in developing a Digital Toolset to drive productivity within the business functions. You will lead various projects utilising applications from the GE Toolset and new Analytics Tools. You will partner with these business functions to understand requirements and translate these into Operational Tools. Digital Technology (Caledonian) - Development of prototype local applications for SQDIP improvements. DT Technology and Operations Team (Cheltenham) - providing support for iPhone and iPad devices, including setup, upgrades, compliance, and issue resolution. You will manage requests for new network port installations, remote access, and GUEST WiFi changes, while assisting users with supply chain applications. Responsibilities also include managing a Raspberry Pi-based signage solution, covering procurement, build, and configuration of devices. Project activities may involve supporting application deployments and upgrades, as well as managing small-scale equipment deployments and installations. Digital Technology ( Dowty) - improving how the business uses data and digital technologies to drive better decisions and performance. You will help enhance data maturity by improving data quality, structure, standardization, governance, and accessibility, and work with business and digital teams to understand reporting needs and develop dashboards and visualizations for key metrics. The position involves gathering, cleaning, validating, and analyzing data to support operational and strategic decisions, while identifying opportunities where AI can create business value and building clear business cases for adoption. You will research digital and AI trends and best practices, help evaluate AI use cases for impact, feasibility, risks, and data readiness, and lead or coordinate a digital technology project from scope definition through milestone tracking and stakeholder communication. In addition, you will support cross-functional collaboration to ensure solutions align with user needs, prepare presentations and updates for reviews, and contribute to process improvements that enhance efficiency, visibility, and decision-making. In the final two months, the student can choose one of these areas to focus on. Throughout the placement, they will receive training and hands-on experience with cyber tools used by the UK Cyber Team, explore topics aligned to their course such as malware analysis and networking, and have opportunities to participate in Cyber Capture the Flag events during the year. items.desc: Som systemutvikler hos Accelerate blir du en del av et miljø som bygger moderne, sikre og skalerbare løsninger for noen av Norges mest spennende virksomheter. Om rollen Som seniorutvikler hos Accelerate blir du en sentral bidragsyter i design, utvikling og videreutvikling av moderne løsninger for våre kunder. Du jobber i tverrfaglige team der du får påvirke tekniske valg, arkitektur og leveransemåte, fra idé og design til produksjon og videreutvikling. Mange av våre ansatte går inn som tech leads hos kunder, med ansvar for teknisk retning, arkitektur og gjennomføring i tverrfaglige team. Vi jobber aktivt med AI-assistert utvikling, kodegenerering, agentbaserte løsninger og bruk av LLM-er i både nye og eksisterende systemer. Våre kunder stiller krav om gode norskkunnskaper så dette er en forutsetning for rollen. Eksempler på ting du vil jobbe med Utvikling av moderne applikasjoner og tjenester i Java og Kotlin, TypeScript eller C# Skyplattformer som Azure, AWS og/eller GCP Løsningsdesign, arkitektur og mikroservicearkitektur Cloud Native og kontainerteknologi som Docker og Kubernetes DevOps, Infrastructure as Code og CI/CD pipelines Sikkerhet, identitet og observability AI-drevet utvikling: Bruk av AI-assistenter i utviklingsløp Integrasjon av LLM-er i applikasjoner Utforsking av agentbaserte løsninger og automatisering Hvem er du? Det gir oss tilgang til spennende kunder både innen privat og offentlig sektor, komplekse problemstillinger og store utviklingsmuligheter, samtidig som vi beholder korte beslutningsveier og stor grad av frihet. Hos oss får du muligheten til å påvirke hvordan vi utvikler både fagmiljøer, tjenester og satsingsområder. Vi tror de beste idéene kommer fra menneskene som jobber tett på kundene, og derfor er veien fra initiativ til handling kort. Gjennom våre AI-forum, sikkerhetsforum og faglige møteplasser deler vi erfaringer, bygger kompetanse og utforsker ny teknologi sammen. Vi legger stor vekt på fellesskap og samarbeid, og skaper arenaer der vi lærer av hverandre – både med månedlige samlinger faglig og sosialt. Vi heier på initiativ og gir rom for å teste, utforske og utvikle nye løsninger. Im Rahmen eines mehrjährigen Transformationsprogramms gestaltet Liebherr die Vision der Software-Defined-Machine (SDM). Ziel ist der Aufbau einer produktübergreifenden Plattform, die Maschinenapplikationen standardisiert, Skalierung ermöglicht und die technologische Weiterentwicklung über Standorte und Sparten hinweg beschleunigt. In diesem Zusammenhang bieten wir dir die Chance, tief in die Software-Defined-Machine und die Entwicklung der Maschinen-Applikationen einzutauchen und dabei auch über den Tellerrand zu blicken. In drei unterschiedlichen Werken bekommst du für jeweils ein Jahr detaillierten Einblick in die Produkte der Erdbewegung, des Spezialtiefbaus sowie der Maritimen Krane und die Möglichkeit, dir gleichzeitig ein starkes bereichsübergreifendes Netzwerk aufzubauen. Das sind deine Aufgaben Du arbeitest an strategisch relevanten Zukunftsthemen im Umfeld der Software-Defined-Machine, von Maschinen-Applikationen über gemeinsame Entwicklungsplattformen bis hin zu Methoden und Standards für skalierbare Lösungen. Du überführst Ideen in konkrete Umsetzung. Von der Analyse und Strukturierung von Anforderungen über Architekturkonzepte sowie prototypische Implementierungen bis hin zur Anwendung in realen Produkten. Du arbeitest eng mit der Vorentwicklung und den Fachbereichen der Standorte zusammen, gibst Perspektiven, förderst Wissenstransfer und unterstützt die Umsetzung gemeinsamer Standards und Methoden. Du entwickelst dich fachlich und persönlich gezielt weiter und bereitest dich auf eine mögliche spätere Rolle mit hoher Wirkung in der Weiterentwicklung unserer Maschinenapplikationen und Plattformansätze vor. Drei bis fünf Jahre Praxiserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, Systementwicklung oder in technologiegetriebenen Innovationsprojekten. Hohe Lernbereitschaft sowie die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Technologien, komplexe Zusammenhänge und unterschiedliche fachliche Kontexte einzuarbeiten. Eine teamorientierte Arbeitsweise, Freude an bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit, Eigeninitiative sowie ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für technologische Trends und deren Nutzen für die industrielle Anwendung. Sehr gute Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Gezielte persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung durch Mentoring, Feedback und Einblicke in unterschiedliche Entwicklungs- und Organisationskontexte. Die Möglichkeit, ein starkes standort- und bereichsübergreifendes Netzwerk aufzubauen und die technologische Weiterentwicklung aktiv mitzugestalten. Eine Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung einer möglichen späterer Schlüsselrolle in der Maschinen-Applikations-Entwicklung sowie deren Weiterentwicklung. Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Home-Office-Möglichkeit Hauseigene Betriebskantine inkl. items.desc: Introduction In order to make an application, simply read through the following job description and make sure to attach relevant documents. Saab UK is part of Scandinavia's largest defence company, bringing together the best of Swedish and British innovation. Saab offers world-leading solutions and services in defence, aviation, space, and civil security to keep people and society safe. Our UK presence has been growing at pace, meaning we can offer a wide range of opportunities for personal fulfilment and career growth. We currently employ over 600 people across eight sites in the UK, and our specialisations include software engineering, underwater robotics, radars, AI, and armed forces training. The Role This role is part of Saab Bluebear Business in Bedfordshire. It will be reporting into the Head of Digital Systems Engineering. In this exciting, dynamic role you will support a mixture of R&D and product development activities within a leading autonomy and unmanned systems company. Blue Bear continuously innovates within the core area of Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS/UAV) such as flight management systems, autopilots, mission systems, ground control stations, and all supporting systems and infrastructure. Your role as a Flight Control Systems Engineer will involve developing, maintaining and testing safety critical software that contribute to the flight systems of our aircraft. You will contribute to requirements definition, and use MATLAB/Simulink tools to generate software such as novel flight control laws and data manipulation algorithms. After verification and validation performed using bespoke simulations, you will then be expected deploy the software on to the target hardware, and conduct real world flight testing at our test facility less than 1km from the office. You may be asked to present the findings of the testing in reports or customer facing presentations. As well as undertaking technical tasks, you will be expected to take an active role in the team. This will include contribution to the development of standard operating processes, continuous improvement of methods and techniques, and ensuring quality targets are satisfied. Working as part of a team in a multidisciplinary environment you will have good communication skills. A can-do attitude and a genuine passion for innovative technology. The opportunity will enable the successful candidate to gain knowledge of cutting-edge autonomous systems and offer a large scope for career development. Essential Qualifications & Skills: Degree in aerospace engineering or similar. Understanding of aerodynamics and flight mechanics, and their impact on flight control. Experience in using MATLAB/Simulink for developing algorithms and control laws. Hands-on experience in designing and commissioning control systems. Existing SC Clearance. Desirable Experience designing and implementing guidance, navigation and control algorithms for fixed and/or rotary wing vehicles. Knowledge of state-of-the-art for sensing systems. Hands-on experience with small UAS. Mathworks' Stateflow, Simulink Coder and Embedded Coder packages. Experience developing mathematical algorithms e.g. Data fusion, state estimation etc. Experience working with embedded systems, real-time systems, safety critical systems. Knowledge of communication systems. Version control systems e.g. git. C++, Java, Python development skills. Experience with quality standards for software (e.g. DO-178, ED-20x). As a National Security Vetting clearance is required for this role, applicants will be required to hold National Security Vetting clearance to SC level or have the ability to gain it. By submitting an application to Saab UK you consent to undertaking workforce screening activities that may include but are not limited to: Baseline Personnel Security checks, National Security Vetting, reference checks, verification of working rights and in all circumstances preferred candidates will be placed through a security interview

items.desc: Software Verification Engineer Location: Delft, Netherlands | Hybrid – 2 days per week on-site Salary: Up to €90,000 per annum (Visa sponsorship is offered for candidates who are already based in the Netherlands) We are looking for a Software Verification & Modelling Engineer to join an innovative deep-tech engineering team developing advanced technology at the intersection of software, signal processing and hardware. This role will focus on developing and validating software models, building automated verification frameworks, and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of complex algorithms and software implementations. You will work closely with software and hardware engineers to compare implementation outputs against trusted reference models, investigate numerical discrepancies, and improve the robustness of verification processes across the development lifecycle. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer with strong C++ programming skills, a background in mathematical modelling or digital signal processing, and a passion for software quality, numerical accuracy and automated testing. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain and debug software verification frameworks using C++ and Python. Build and validate mathematical and behavioural reference models to verify software implementations. Perform golden-reference comparisons and numerical error analysis to identify discrepancies and ensure implementation accuracy. Design and maintain automated testing frameworks and continuous integration (CI) regression tests. Analyse algorithm behaviour, numerical precision and error propagation across complex processing chains. Investigate fixed-point arithmetic, quantisation effects and numerical accuracy where applicable. Develop reference models using Python libraries such as NumPy and SciPy, or MATLAB/Simulink. Implement testing strategies incorporating property-based testing, randomised test cases and automated regression analysis. Collaborate with software, FPGA and hardware engineers to validate models and investigate system-level issues. Contribute to the development of reliable, maintainable and scalable verification processes. Requirements Strong C++ programming and debugging skills. Professional experience in software testing, verification or test automation. A solid understanding of digital signal processing (DSP), mathematical modelling or numerical methods. Experience with reference models, numerical comparisons, algorithm validation or numerical error analysis. Proficiency in Python for verification, testing or automation. Experience developing or maintaining automated tests and CI regression pipelines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues. A relevant degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics or a related technical discipline. Desirable Experience Developing reference models using MATLAB/Simulink, NumPy or SciPy. Fixed-point arithmetic, quantisation analysis and numerical precision. Stateful DSP processing chains, including numerically controlled oscillators (NCOs), mixers and filters. Property-based testing and randomised verification techniques. FPGA or ASIC verification and digital hardware development. Hardware/software co-simulation, SystemC or cycle-accurate modelling. Validating software models against measurements from physical hardware.

Wir suchen jemanden, der: Embedded Linux und Cloud zusammen denkt, nicht nur einen der zwei Layer beherrscht Schnittstellen sauber implementiert (TRDP, MQTT, REST) und auch real beim Kunden zum Laufen bringt Bugs nicht eskaliert, sondern in Logs und Code reingeht, bis sie verstanden sind Verantwortung für das Gesamtsystem übernimmt, nicht nur für „seinen Task" in Datenflüssen denkt, nicht in Tickets Und etwas ausführlicher. Du arbeitest an: Fahrzeugintegration & Embedded Linux: Softwarekomponenten auf Embedded-Plattformen (Linux-basiert) für Datenaufnahme, Verarbeitung und Weiterleitung Backend & Datenverarbeitung: Verarbeitung, Speicherung und Visualisierung von Betriebsdaten für Statistik, Diagnose und Monitoring Schnittstellen & Standards: Implementierung und Test gegen TRDP, MQTT, REST. Anpassung an Fahrzeug- und Kundenumgebung. Softwaretests & Qualität: automatisierte Tests, Debugging, CI/CD, Container und virtuelle Test-Umgebungen, Versionskontrolle. Stabilität ist Standard, nicht Ausnahme. Hardware-Schulterschluss: enge Zusammenarbeit mit Hardware-Entwicklern und externen Partnern, vom Sensor bis zur Cloud Anleitung & Mentoring: du strukturierst Arbeitspakete für Werkstudent:innen und Praktikant:innen und entwickelst sie fachlich weiter Softwareprojekt-Lead (je nach Erfahrung): Planung, Aufwandsschätzung und technische Verantwortung für Software-Teilprojekte, von Anforderung bis Rollout Qualifikation Das passt zu dir, wenn: ✅ Du in Python produktiven Code schreiben kannst und in C/C++ tief genug bist, um auf Embedded-Layer-Bugs einzusteigen ✅ Du Embedded Linux, Datenbanken und Backend-Technologien (z. B. Flask oder Node.js, dazu MQTT, REST) zusammenführen kannst. Full-Stack vom Sensor bis in die Cloud. ✅ Du schon Verantwortung für ein Software-Stück bis in den Produktivbetrieb übernommen hast, nicht nur Features rausgeschoben ✅ Du Probleme nicht eskalierst, sondern löst. Auch wenn du dich erst reindenken musst. ✅ Du beim Kunden vor Ort genauso souverän bist wie im technischen Deep Dive ✅ Du Entscheidungen triffst, auch wenn nicht alle Informationen da sind, und sie bei neuen Erkenntnissen anpasst ✅ Du kleinere Teams oder Werkstudent:innen anleiten kannst und Lust hast, andere fachlich weiterzuentwickeln ✅ Bonus , aber kein Muss: Containerisierung und Virtualisierung (Docker, KVM, leichte Hypervisor-Erfahrung), Fahrzeugprotokolle (TRDP, CAN), Echtzeitdaten, Performance-Optimierung. Tech-Lead-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, perspektivisch besetzen wir die Lead-Rolle nach. ✅ Formales: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Informationstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbare Ausbildung. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch ab B2. Wohnsitz Karlsruhe oder Umzugsbereitschaft. Die Stelle ist hands-on und nicht vollständig remote. Benefits 📍 Performance Bonus 📍 Echtes Produkt, echte Kunden, echter Betrieb. Kein Proof-of-Concept. 📍 Direkter Zugang zu Fahrzeugen, Werkstätten und Kundenprojekten 📍 Schnelle Entscheidungen, wenig Bürokratie 📍 Setup steht: Kunden, erfahrenes Entwicklerteam, starker Experten-Support aus dem Codewerk-Netzwerk AI CORN entwickelt Steuerungssysteme und Cloud-Lösungen für den Schienenverkehr. Herzstück ist die Steuerungseinheit der Digitalen Automatischen Kupplung (DAK). Wir sind eine Ausgründung aus der Codewerk GmbH und verbinden Start-up-Tempo mit über zehn Jahren Erfahrung aus 150+ Bahnprojekten. Wenn du Lust hast, Software zu bauen, die wirklich fährt: Verantwortung statt Tickets, Code statt Folien. Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Bitte häng passende Zeugnisse (Arbeit, Studium, Ausbildung, höchster Schulabschluss) an.

items.title: Air Combat Simulation Engineer
items.card: The Role This role is part of Saab BlueBear in Bedfordshire. You will work as part of the Air Combat Simulation team supporting customers in the modelling and simulation of aircraft and associated systems, including the development and V&V of models and analysis tools. Key Responsibilities Work collaboratively as an integral part of a small team delivering a customer focused task-based modelling and simulation
items.desc: Introduction Have you got what it takes to succeed The following information should be read carefully by all candidates. Saab UK is part of Scandinavia's largest defence company, bringing together the best of Swedish and British innovation. Saab offers world-leading solutions and services in defence, aviation, space, and civil security to keep people and society safe. Our UK presence has been growing at pace, meaning we can offer a wide range of opportunities for personal fulfilment and career growth. We currently employ over 600 people across eight sites in the UK, and our specialisations include software engineering, underwater robotics, radars, AI, and armed forces training. The Role This role is part of Saab BlueBear in Bedfordshire. You will work as part of the Air Combat Simulation team supporting customers in the modelling and simulation of aircraft and associated systems, including the development and V&V of models and analysis tools. Key Responsibilities Work collaboratively as an integral part of a small team delivering a customer focused task-based modelling and simulation support service. Develop Requirements from initial customer brief. Build models and analysis tools to meet the customer requirements. Update, debug and V&V of models and simulation tools. Analyse results from model integration and simulation development to provide understanding of the component models performance and their interactions. Develop and maintain tools for the translation of data files between formats in use within the community. Develop Simulink models of aircraft and aerospace systems and auto-code to C/C++ and dll. Integrate Models (Simulink and dll) into System-of-Systems models. Undertake simulation development, testing and application with results analysis to provide understanding of component models and their interactions. Develop and test models for integration into Distributed Simulations. Extend the Distributed Simulation capabilities and functionality. Sanity checking model performance and simulation results through cross-checking with other sources of information and engineering estimates. Validation and Verification of model performance and simulation results against requirements. Review documentation for accurate technical content and quality to ensure it meets the required high standards. Investigate modelling and simulation tools to support new customer requirements. Generate documentation (User Guides, Interface Control Documents, Delivery Notes, Verification and Validation reports) for models, simulations and applications developed by the team at an appropriate level for the expected end user's technical ability. Report on technical issues encountered with 3rd party provided models and simulations covering the issues, significance and potential resolutions. Qualifications And Skills Degree Educated - Engineering degree in relevant subject. Matlab and Simulink (and Stateflow), Auto-coding to C/C++ and DLL Programming languages (Preferably C++, C#, Delphi) Flight Dynamics and aircraft performance modelling Pilot modelling Modelling of Sensors and Signatures (RF and EO/IR) Knowledge of Earth coordinate systems (Flat, spherical, WGS-84) Distributed Simulation (DIS, HLA) & Source Control (Git) Solving optimisation problems. Model integration into e.g. system-of-systems models and distributed simulations Dealing With Aerospace Vehicle And System Models Including Flight performance multiple degree-of-freedom (3+) equations of motion transformations between multiple frames of reference using Euler angle and quaternions Sensors and signatures Solving optimisation problems Investigate, Understand And Resolve Problems With Simulink model development Model integration into e.g. system-of-systems models and distributed simulations As a National Security Vetting clearance is required for this role, applicants will be required to hold National Security Vetting clearance to SC level, or have the ability to gain it. By submitting an application to Saab UK you consent to undertaking workforce screening activities that may include but are not limited to: Baseline Personnel Security checks, National Security Vetting, reference checks, verification of working rights and in all circumstances preferred candidates will be placed through a security interview

items.desc: Job Description About Altium Altium is transforming the way electronics are designed and built. Our cloud platform, Altium 365, enables distributed teams to collaborate seamlessly across the entire electronics development lifecycle - from design to manufacturing. By connecting people, processes, and data, Altium 365 helps teams move faster, reduce errors, and deliver high-quality hardware products at scale. We are looking for a UX Researcher to shape end-to-end experiences across Altium 365. You'll be the person who keeps our product decisions connected to real users. You'll run the conversations, test the ideas before we build them, and make sure everything we learn stays findable instead of getting lost in old Slack threads and someone's notebook. You'll work closely with designers, PMs, and engineers throughout the whole cycle, from early problem framing to post-launch validation. This is a hands-on role with a lot of autonomy. You'll own the research practice rather than execute someone else's plan. What You'll Do Talk to users, regularly Own the participant pipeline: recruiting, screening, scheduling, incentives, consent Run interviews, contextual inquiries, diary studies, and surveys Build a steady cadence of user contact so the team is never more than a couple of weeks from fresh input Validate ideas and prototypes Partner with designers and PMs to turn open questions into research questions Run usability tests and concept tests on wireframes, prototypes, and live features Choose the right method for the decision at hand, including quick, scrappy studies when speed matters more than rigor Deliver findings that clearly state what to change and what the trade-offs are Build and maintain the insights repository Set up and curate a searchable database of findings, tagged by product area, user segment, and theme Connect new findings to old ones so patterns surface over time Make it genuinely usable for the rest of the team, not just an archive Track which insights led to which decisions, and revisit assumptions that haven't held up Raise the team's research literacy Coach designers and PMs to run their own lightweight studies well Share findings in formats people actually read and watch: short readouts, highlight reels, workshops Push back when a decision is being made on opinion where evidence is available or cheap to get Qualifications What we're looking for 3+ years in UX/product research, or a closely adjacent role with substantial hands-on research work Solid command of qualitative methods, plus enough quantitative literacy to design a survey and interpret product analytics Experience testing prototypes at different fidelities and knowing what each stage can and can't tell you Clear communication: you can make findings land with a skeptical stakeholder in five minutes Comfort working in ambiguity and scoping research to fit real timelines Familiarity with research ops tooling (Dovetail, Condens, Maze, UserTesting, or similar) English at a professional level Nice to have Experience setting up an insights repository from scratch Background in our domain: Engineering, PCB design or other complex domain Basic familiarity with Figma and design workflows Additional Information Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development. From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

As Sweden’s only SMR developer, we are on a mission to decarbonize industries and enable safe, scalable, and sustainable energy solutions. items.desc: Die Freigabe in kerntechnischen Anlagen entscheidet darüber, wann Stoffe, bewegliche Gegenstände aber auch ganze Gebäude oder Bodenflächen aus der atom- und strahlenschutzrechtlichen Überwachung entlassen und damit auf konventionellem Weg wiederverwendet, entsorgt oder recycelt werden können. Das ist ein wichtiger Prozess, um unsere Sanierungs- aber auch Rückbau- und Neubauprojekte in der Praxis voranzubringen und dabei das Volumen radioaktiver Abfälle für das Endlager so gering wie möglich zu halten. Somit ist die Freigabe nach innen und außen ein wichtiges Bindeglied, um unsere Unternehmensziele zu erreichen. Das Team Freigabeverfahren übernimmt die verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe, eine effiziente und trotzdem sichere und gesetzeskonforme Freigabestrategie für die einzelnen Projekte zu entwickeln und deren Umsetzung zu planen und durchzuführen. Die Kerntechnische Entsorgung Karlsruhe GmbH (KTE) übernimmt Aufgaben von nationaler Bedeutung: Den sicheren Rückbau der stillgelegten kerntechnischen Anlagen am Standort Karlsruhe. Mit rund 700 Mitarbeitenden schaffen wir eine sichere Zukunft. Unser Fundament sind dabei das Know-how, der hohe Sicherheitsanspruch und der starke Zusammenhalt unserer Teams. Die Vergütung der ausgeschriebenen Position richtet sich nach den für uns einschlägigen Tarifverträgen der chemischen Industrie Baden-Württemberg. Die Stelle ist nach dem Bundesentgelttarifvertrag der chemischen Industrie Baden-Württemberg in einer Spanne zwischen den Entgeltgruppen E 9 T - E 11 T eingeordnet. Aufgaben Sie erstellen in enger Abstimmung mit den internen Nahtstellen komplexe und wissenschaftlich fundierte Konzepte zur Ermittlung spezifischer Nuklidverhältnisse unter Berücksichtigung der messtechnischen Anforderungen für unsere vielfältigen Freigabeprojekte. Sie entwickeln standhafte Konzepte zur repräsentativen Probenahme und dokumentieren diese sowie deren Messergebnis-Bewertung in methodischer und wissenschaftlicher Arbeitsweise zum Zweck der Nuklidverhältnisermittlung im Rahmen der Freigabe. Sie planen die Konzepte so, dass diese möglichst wenig Einfluss auf den Fortschritt des Rückbaus bzw. auf den Anlagenbetrieb haben und auf die örtlichen sowie radiologischen Besonderheiten der jeweiligen Anlage abgestimmt sind. Sie vertreten die Plausibilität Ihrer Konzepte in Fachgesprächen mit den Behörden und Sachverständigen und organisieren die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Messlaboren. Sie erstellen plausible und aussagekräftige Berichte und entwickeln übergreifende Standards und Mindestanforderungen an die Erstellung von Nuklidvektoren im Rahmen der Freigabe. Gemeinsam mit den internen Nahtstellen sorgen Sie für einen sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelnden anlagenübergreifenden Wissenstransfer. Sie entwickeln statistische Modelle und Unsicherheitsbetrachtungen in Bezug auf die Freigabe in der KTE und überführen diese in Regelwerke. Profil Sie haben einen Hochschulabschluss in einer naturwissenschaftlichen Fachrichtung mit Vertiefung im kerntechnischen Bereich (z.B. Kernphysik, Radiochemie). Sie konnten bereits Erfahrung im Strahlenschutz einer kerntechnischen Anlage sammeln und bringen im Idealfall bereits fundierte Kenntnisse in der Freigabe mit. Sie sind sehr gewissenhaft, sind es gewohnt wissenschaftlich zu arbeiten und entsprechende statistische Methoden sowie mathematische Gesetzmäßigkeiten in Ihre Arbeit einzubeziehen und zu dokumentieren. Sie agieren souverän und selbstbewusst in fachlichen Diskussionen und können Ihren fachlichen Standpunkt vertreten und durchsetzen. In der Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern (m/w/d) besitzen Sie diplomatisches Geschick und können so zwischen den Anforderungen unserer Anlagenverantwortlichen (m/w/d) und der Vertreter (m/w/d) der Aufsichtsbehörden vermitteln. Sie verfügen über Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf C1-Niveau und sind ausdrucksstark im Gesprochenem sowie im Geschriebenen Die arbeitsmedizinische Eignung für Tätigkeiten in Strahlenschutzkontrollbereichen setzen wir voraus. Die jeweiligen Voraussetzungen und Einzelregelungen erläutern wir Ihnen gerne im weiteren Verfahren. items.desc: Job Description About Altium Altium is transforming the way electronics are designed and built. Our cloud platform, Altium 365, enables distributed teams to collaborate seamlessly across the entire electronics development lifecycle - from design to manufacturing. By connecting people, processes, and data, Altium 365 helps teams move faster, reduce errors, and deliver high-quality hardware products at scale. We are looking for a UX Researcher to shape end-to-end experiences across Altium 365. You'll be the person who keeps our product decisions connected to real users. You'll run the conversations, test the ideas before we build them, and make sure everything we learn stays findable instead of getting lost in old Slack threads and someone's notebook. You'll work closely with designers, PMs, and engineers throughout the whole cycle, from early problem framing to post-launch validation. This is a hands-on role with a lot of autonomy. You'll own the research practice rather than execute someone else's plan. What You'll Do Talk to users, regularly Own the participant pipeline: recruiting, screening, scheduling, incentives, consent Run interviews, contextual inquiries, diary studies, and surveys Build a steady cadence of user contact so the team is never more than a couple of weeks from fresh input Validate ideas and prototypes Partner with designers and PMs to turn open questions into research questions Run usability tests and concept tests on wireframes, prototypes, and live features Choose the right method for the decision at hand, including quick, scrappy studies when speed matters more than rigor Deliver findings that clearly state what to change and what the trade-offs are Build and maintain the insights repository Set up and curate a searchable database of findings, tagged by product area, user segment, and theme Connect new findings to old ones so patterns surface over time Make it genuinely usable for the rest of the team, not just an archive Track which insights led to which decisions, and revisit assumptions that haven't held up Raise the team's research literacy Coach designers and PMs to run their own lightweight studies well Share findings in formats people actually read and watch: short readouts, highlight reels, workshops Push back when a decision is being made on opinion where evidence is available or cheap to get Qualifications What we're looking for 3+ years in UX/product research, or a closely adjacent role with substantial hands-on research work Solid command of qualitative methods, plus enough quantitative literacy to design a survey and interpret product analytics Experience testing prototypes at different fidelities and knowing what each stage can and can't tell you Clear communication: you can make findings land with a skeptical stakeholder in five minutes Comfort working in ambiguity and scoping research to fit real timelines Familiarity with research ops tooling (Dovetail, Condens, Maze, UserTesting, or similar) English at a professional level Nice to have Experience setting up an insights repository from scratch Background in our domain: Engineering, PCB design or other complex domain Basic familiarity with Figma and design workflows Additional Information Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development. From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

items.desc: Overview About Certara Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries. Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization. About Chemaxon Chemaxon is an industry-leading cheminformatics software company helping early-stage drug discovery and chemistry research for more than 20 years. Our clients are top pharmaceutical companies, innovative biotech startups, and leading academic institutions. We are agile, innovative and friendly, offering compelling opportunities for frequent collaboration and cross-training with teammates and stakeholders. We have recently been acquired by Certara, a US-based model-informed drug development services and software company. We are in an exciting time of organizational and business growth, so now is the perfect time to join our team! About The Role We are mainly looking for a seasoned scientist eager to transition into UX research, ready to move from doing science to studying how scientists use the tools built for them. To make that leap possible, we offer a structured onboarding program where you'll learn everything you need for the transition. Our hiring priority for this role is domain expertise plus curiosity and coachability, not existing UX credentials. If you're already an experienced UX researcher with an interest in complex, data-heavy B2B tools, we'd also love to hear from you. We work daily with scientists, which is challenging and super exciting at the same time. About The Team Our UX team engages with complex and inspiring projects with a strong mix of expertise. Of our eight team members, some focus exclusively on UX research while others focus on UX design. Our team spends most of its time in cross-functional product teams, but we also work on horizontal UX operational tasks. We also use AI tools as part of our everyday workflow for almost every step of UX research, from creating custom research tools and product prototypes, to research data analysis and synthesis, to pattern-finding across studies. We use AI to speed up the busywork, so more time goes toward talking to scientists and generating insight. About The Product The product you will work on is a chemical drawing tool. It's exciting, complex, and B2B. It may sound cliché, but there needs to be chemistry between us and our users. This doesn't mean that you must comprehend this science to the level of a scientist, but you should be willing to learn about it. The dynamic team working on this is quite mature from a UX perspective. Research is an integral part of their operation, so you can expect that your work will have a significant impact here. Responsibilities Define the scope of research plans: Collaborate with stakeholders to define main research questions, objectives that bring the most value based on business goals Plan research studies: prioritize needs, define methodologies, and estimate possible deadlines for delivering the study results Conduct diverse product research activities such as competitor analysis, interview, usability test, user journey mapping, co-creation workshops, target audience segmentation Analysis & synthesis research results (both qualitative and quantitative) into product insights Communicate the research insights in an understandable and transparent way both on team and cross-team level Advocate a research-based culture across the company Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or a related field The ideal candidate will possess an energetic personality with excellent communication skills, attention to details, and patience Candidate must be able to excel in a dynamic, hands-on and creative environment Collaboration skills working across UX team, product owners and domain specialists Communication skills to distill insights from research Experience with a broad range of user research methods Knowledge of when to apply which techniques and how to combine them to answer complex questions Ability to translate complex research findings into actionable insights Basic knowledge of agile development processes Highly proficient in spoken and written English What We Offer Hybrid-way of working (8 days/month home office) Private health insurance (Medicare) Daily entry into Life1 Fitness Clubs We work with global Top500 companies (R&D) and leading …

items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As an Embedded Software Engineer at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to own the embedded software stack on the compute modules used across our platforms. You will take a new module from bare board to a maintained, securely booting Linux platform, covering the boot chain, kernel, drivers, and the verification around them. This is a high impact role that combines deep Linux and kernel work with hands on bring up on new hardware, taking a board from first power up through to flight. Responsibilities BSP and Reference Images: Build and maintain the BSP layer, device trees, and the reference images for each board, including custom layers and SDK generation, and carry them forward across kernel upgrades and silicon revisions. Boot Chain and Secure Boot: Own the boot chain, including bootloader porting, signed boot, verified rootfs, and A/B system update. Drivers and Low Level Interfaces: Develop and validate Linux device drivers across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI, including camera and sensor interfaces. Board Support on MCU Targets: Provide startup, clock, and peripheral support on the microcontrollers of boards the team designs. Board Bring Up and Hardware Validation: Lead software bring up on new hardware, take part in design reviews, and debug system level issues across the hardware and software boundary. Verification and Documentation: Define verification test plans and acceptance criteria, automate boot and peripheral test on real targets, and document each milestone. Cross Functional Collaboration: Work with the hardware team on new boards, and with Systems and Embedded Software Platform on interfaces and integration. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, mentor junior embedded engineers. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: MSc in engineering (electrical, computer, or a related field). PhD a plus. A hands on bring up record matters more than the specific degree. Experience: 5 years minimum in embedded software, with BSPs owned through their lifecycle and kept reproducible as the hardware evolved. Build Systems: Strong command of an embedded Linux build system such as Yocto or OpenEmbedded, across custom layers or packages, BSP integration, image build, and SDK generation. Experience with in house or non standard build systems is an advantage. Technical Expertise: Kernel space driver development on ARM targets, validated against real peripherals across I2C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, and MIPI. Device tree work on new boards and hardware revisions. Board bring up from first power up to a booting Linux image. Boot and Update: Bootloader porting, kernel configuration, signed boot, and firmware update mechanisms on production hardware, with security conscious and deterministic engineering practice throughout. Programming: Strong C and C++, including kernel space coding, and strong Python scripting skills, with solid version control practice (Git). Debugging Expertise: Able to isolate whether a fault sits in the driver, the kernel configuration, or the board, using GDB, JTAG, OpenOCD, kernel tracing, ftrace, and perf. Professional Attributes: Rigorous, structured, and systematic, able to work autonomously, unfazed by a board that will not boot. Excellent communication and documentation skills, able to present platform and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Additional Skills: Bare metal or RTOS firmware on microcontroller targets, experience enabling hardware accelerators on embedded SoCs including VPU and NPU drivers and runtimes, familiarity with the perception or control workloads that run on the module, and UAS, drone, or defense experience are strong advantages. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. Thrives in a fast paced environment where priorities shift and no task is too small. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc: About Neo4j Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. The Team Neo4j's managed cloud offering, Aura, brings the power of graph databases to the cloud. We're forming a new Product Analytics Platform team. As Neo4j Aura’s platform and product surface area have grown, so has the need for a consistent, purpose-built way to capture what's happening across them. Today, each product tracks its own data, but retrieving it can be difficult. This team will own the Analytics API and infrastructure that collects raw product analytics events from across Neo4j's products so every team integrates with one contract instead of inventing their own. The Role In this role you’ll be one of the founding members of the Product Analytics Platform team. You’ll help define the technical foundations for how product analytics data is captured across Aura, building the Analytics API and underlying infrastructure that provides a consistent integration point for engineering teams across Neo4j. You’ll have significant ownership over the design of the API, balancing the needs of multiple product teams with the long-term maintainability of the platform. You’ll work closely with Product Management and other engineering teams to shape the solution, drive adoption, and evolve it as the platform grows. Primary Responsibilities Design, build, and operate the Analytics API and the underlying infrastructure, defining the schema and integration contract used by teams across Aura. Make pragmatic architectural decisions around event ingestion, data contracts, reliability, and scalability as the platform grows. Build a simple, well-defined integration layer that makes it easy for product teams to send analytics events without coupling them to the underlying data infrastructure. Drive adoption across the Engineering organisation, working with teams to integrate with the API and providing the guidance and documentation they need. Keep product analytics and billing concerns cleanly separated, even where the underlying data flows or infrastructure may be similar. Evaluate build vs. buy across the existing analytics and data stack, including tools such as Segment and BigQuery, keeping the API focused on collection rather than reimplementing downstream capabilities. Partner closely with the team building the downstream data pipeline to ensure raw events are reliable, well-structured, and usable for analytics. Define and evolve the platform through RFCs, technical documentation, and close collaboration with Product Management and other engineering teams. What You'll Need Strong backend software engineering experience, with Go as your primary language, building and operating APIs, services, or ingestion systems that other teams depend on. Experience designing well-defined APIs and integration contracts, including thinking about schemas, backwards compatibility, validation, and how other engineering teams will consume them. Experience building production services in Go, from smaller utilities and scripts through to larger, long-running services or microservices. Some experience with TypeScript or JavaScript and an ability to work comfortably in a codebase that spans backend and frontend technologies. This is primarily a backend role — you won't be responsible for UI development. Familiarity with event-driven systems, data ingestion, or data pipeline tooling such as Segment, BigQuery, or similar. Ability to work independently in a new area, make pragmatic technical decisions, and drive work forward with limited direction. Comfortable writing RFCs and technical documentation, and working across teams to establish and drive adoption of a new integration point. Clear, concise communication — a lot of this role involves defining contracts, documenting decisions, and helping other engineers integrate with what you build. What's Nice To Have Experience with …

items.desc: Lieu : Toulouse, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 81 000 collaborateurs dans 68 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée Un package de rémunération attractif Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu Votre quotidien Le site de Toulouse Champollion regroupe les activités de l’ingénierie de systèmes satellites, de la conception et réalisation de charges utiles, et du développement et qualification de segments sol. Il intègre également un centre de recherche et un accélérateur industriel de start-up et ventures, ainsi que les activités relevant de la science des très basses températures, avec le développement et la production de refroidisseurs micromécaniques pour des marchés exigeants. VOTRE QUOTIDIEN L’évolution du marché des télécommunications par satellite conduit Thales Alenia Space à proposer de plus en plus de charges utiles dites flexibles (allocation fréquences ou/et formes d’onde ou/et couverture géographique) et reprogrammables en vol (Software Defined Radio, incluant la reprogrammation logiciel et bitstream des FPGA). Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons des ingénieurs charge utile Télécom numérique (connaissances HW et SW) pour rejoindre les équipes d’ingénierie Payload. Au sein d’une équipe Payload & Système d’environ 20 personnes, amenée à grossir, les enjeux porteront sur l’affermissement de la solution technique charge utile en très étroite collaboration avec l’ensemble des acteurs et la fixation des exigences majeures permettant d’engager à tous les niveaux les activités de développement et derisking appropriées. En nous rejoignant, vous vous verrez confier les missions suivantes : Spécifier des équipements bord, Suivre le développement et l’acceptation technique des équipements. Etablir les bilans gains/niveaux répéteur en cohérence avec les équipes d'implantation, Réaliser des prédictions de performances de la charge utile à l’occasion des revues client PDR, CDR, puis pour les différentes phases de tests. Définir et suivre les tests AIT (Assemblage Intégration et Tests) des Charges Utiles. Interfacer avec divers spécialistes et experts intervenant dans des domaines techniques pointu (RF, EMC, thermique, etc) Enfin, vous pourrez aussi être appelé pour du support dans des domaines aussi variés que les investigations pour la résolution de problèmes pouvant apparaître sur les charges utiles les analyses de Non-Conformité et les présentations clients les équipes Offre client, système ou mission chaque fois que pertinent la modélisation fonctionnelle de système complexe VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes Ingénieur Télécom ou Doctorant, passionné par la radiofréquence et curieux de relever des défis techniques et humains ? Avez-vous des compétences en traitement du signal , une bonne maîtrise de Python, Matlab ou C++ , et une capacité à modéliser des systèmes électroniques (type ADS ) ? Une expérience en conception de charge utile, TCR ou transmission serait un atout ! Parlez-vous anglais au niveau technique et êtes-vous prêt à collaborer avec des équipes multimétiers et multiculturelles , sur des projets innovants et variés ? Souhaitez-vous contribuer à des travaux en co-ingénierie , en lien avec des clients et fournisseurs , et participer à des phases de test hors site , notamment en dehors de Toulouse ? Vous trouvez stimulant de collaborer avec des clients , des partenaires techniques et des experts métier ? Vous avez le goût du travail en équipe, du challenge et de l’innovation ? Vous parlez anglais ? Vous vous reconnaissez ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! LE MOT DE L’EQUIPE « Rejoignez une équipe passionnée qui va façonner l'avenir de notre secteur en relevant des défis technologiques majeurs, tout en bénéficiant d'opportunités uniques de développement personnel et professionnel ! » Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives. Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world! Engineering Engineering is at the centre of what we do, and we are looking for talented, innovative engineers who can help us design and develop products for today, tomorrow, and in the future. If you are a dreamer, doer, and inventor who wants your voice to be heard and see your ideas take flight, this is the opportunity for you. You explore and share advances in tools, frameworks, and AI for engineering, focusing on options that improve Quality, accelerate Delivery, and reduce Cost. You also apply AI to summarise technical articles and documentation for the team, helping spread knowledge quickly and efficiently, supporting Quality and Delivery at low Cost. Software Tools (Cheltenham) - maintains, supports, and improves the engineering toolchains used across NPI projects. You will be supported by experienced engineers and a strong learning and continuous improvement culture as you learn the toolchains, contribute to support and enhancement work, and develop through hands-on projects, mentorship, and training. Key responsibilities include optimising day-to-day use of engineering tools (issue triage, root cause analysis, resolution), implementing and testing enhancements to improve usability, reliability, and performance, and translating stakeholder requests into requirements, design changes, implementation, and verification. You will document configurations, changes, known issues, and test evidence according to engineering policies, prepare and present technical findings and status updates, participate in cross-functional initiatives and continuous improvement activities, and provide timely updates on risks, issues, and progress to support short-term planning and unblock delivery.
