items.desc: About Chyron Chyron is a global leader in products, services, and solutions for professional broadcast and live production. Our products help create content viewed by audiences around the world every day across television, news, sports, corporate, government, house of worship, esports, and education markets. Product Summary Chyron Video Core is a new, largely greenfield application providing shared video I/O, routing, synchronization, switching, and compositing capabilities across the company’s product portfolio. Its modern, extensible architecture will create a common foundation for integrating video hardware, network streams, and external rendering engines. This will help standardize video workflows across a diverse range of company products while supporting reliable, frame-accurate, low-latency operation on Windows and Linux. Role Summary We are looking for a technically experienced Product Owner who will guide the development of Video Core while also contributing directly to its C++ implementation. The role will be more focused on product ownership—understanding the needs of internal product teams, defining requirements, maintaining priorities, and coordinating delivery. The remaining capacity will involve hands-on C++ development, prototyping, technical investigation, and code review. You will work closely with Product Management, your development and QA team, and development teams that will integrate Video Core into their products. The role is suited to someone who can connect product needs with engineering realities, make practical scope and priority decisions, and remain technically involved in the solution. Regular onsite presence is required to work with SDI hardware and laboratory-based testing setups. Responsibilities Own, maintain, and communicate the roadmap and development priorities for Chyron Video Core as a shared internal platform, balancing the needs of consuming products with architectural, technical, and operational requirements. Understand the video I/O, processing, and integration needs of product teams across the company. Translate product goals and technical use cases into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development priorities. Own and maintain the product backlog, ensuring that upcoming work is sufficiently understood and ready for implementation. Define practical delivery phases, including prototypes, foundational capabilities, integration milestones, and production-readiness objectives. Balance feature value, technical complexity, product dependencies, platform consistency, and long-term maintainability. Coordinate requirements, API contracts, and expectations among engineering, SQA,, and integrating product teams. Review development progress, validate completed functionality, and ensure that delivered capabilities address the intended use cases. Identify product, integration, capacity, timing, and hardware-related risks early and help drive them toward resolution. Support the adoption of Video Core by other product teams through clear integration guidance and technical communication. Contribute hands-on to the implementation of Video Core using modern C++. Develop prototypes and selected production components related to video I/O, routing, synchronization, switching, or compositing. Participate in architectural discussions, technical investigations, debugging, testing, and code reviews. Work with SDI, NDI, SMPTE ST 2110, streaming, external-rendering, and hardware-based workflows as the product evolves. Must Haves Professional experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, product-focused technical lead, or in a comparable role. Ability to understand stakeholder needs and translate them into clear, actionable engineering requirements. Strong prioritization skills and the ability to make practical decisions involving scope, value, risk, and technical complexity. Professional software development experience with modern C++ and the ability to contribute to production code. Understanding of multithreading, synchronization, and thread safety. Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. Clear written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical teams. Ability to work independently, organize work proactively, and maintain focus across both product and development responsibilities. Willingness to work with hardware-connected workflows, existing components, and onsite testing environments. A degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related subject, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to Have Experience with broadcast, professional video, media processing, or other real-time systems. Experience with SDI, NDI, SMPTE ST 2110, or IP-based production workflows. Experience defining shared platforms, SDKs, APIs, or infrastructure used by multiple product teams. Familiarity with Blackmagic, Deltacast, Matrox, or similar video I/O hardware. items.desc: Description The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon’s global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon’s business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions. The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems. The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you’ll help build and manage services that detect and automate the mitigation of cybersecurity threats across Amazon’s infrastructure, including advanced persistent threats. You’ll work with security engineers, data scientists, and other software development engineers across multiple teams to develop innovative security solutions at a massive scale. Our services protect the AWS cloud for all customers and help preserve our customers’ trust in us. You’ll get to use the full power and breadth of AWS technologies to build services that proactively protect every single AWS customer, both internally and externally, from security threats – not many teams can say that! We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers. We want someone who will help us amplify the positive and inclusive team culture we’ve been building. You will raise the bar on our software architecture and development practices. You will share ownership of our operational excellence, ensuring our system is properly tuned and has appropriate alarms for warning or error conditions. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. items.desc: Introductie Erasmus School of Law (ESL) is op zoek naar een getalenteerde en gemotiveerde onderzoeker en docent voor een zesjarige aanstelling als docent/onderzoeker binnen de afdeling Law & Markets. De kandidaat zal onderwijstaken combineren met promotieonderzoek naar de privaatrechtelijke aansprakelijkheid van Europese havens. De beoogde startdatum is 1 januari 2027. De functie combineert onderwijs (60%) met promotieonderzoek (40%). De onderzoekstijd van 40% is gegarandeerd en bedoeld om het hieronder beschreven promotieproject tot een goed einde te brengen. Functieomschrijving Het onderwijsgedeelte wordt ingevuld binnen het brede werkterrein van Law & Markets en zal nader bepaald worden op basis van de expertise van de kandidaat en de onderwijsbehoeften van de afdeling. In eerste instantie wordt verwacht dat een aanzienlijk deel van het onderwijs plaatsvindt in de Master Commercial Law. Als richtlijn kan aangegeven worden dat de onderwijsverplichtingen zich zullen richten op een beperkt, samenhangend pakket van vakken; deze verplichtingen kunnen ook werkcolleges, het nakijken van tentamens en scriptiebegeleiding omvatten, dit alles onder begeleiding van ervaren collega’s. De verantwoordelijkheden worden afgestemd op de ervaring en ontwikkelingsfase van de kandidaat; zelfstandige cursuscoördinatie en substantiële onderwijsontwikkeling worden in het begin niet verwacht. De precieze verdeling kan van jaar tot jaar variëren in overleg met de afdeling, waarbij de 60/40 balans tussen onderwijs en onderzoek gehandhaafd blijft. Promotieonderzoek Het promotieonderzoek ziet op de privaatrechtelijke aansprakelijkheid van Europese zee- en binnenhavens in het kader van de digitale transitie. Havens opereren in toenemende mate op het snijvlak van particuliere ondernemingen, openbare infrastructuur en Europese regelgeving. Zij zijn onderworpen aan steeds verdergaande regelgevende en wettelijke verplichtingen op het gebied van cyberveiligheid, digitalisering, kritieke infrastructuur, gegevensbeheer en duurzaamheid. Deze verplichtingen kunnen niet altijd eenduidig worden gecatalogiseerd als publiekrecht of privaatrecht. Sommige van deze verplichtingen krijgen vorm in privaatrechtelijke relaties, bijvoorbeeld via contractuele afspraken over de beveiliging van de toeleveringsketen. Havens organiseren ook veel van hun activiteiten via privaatrechtelijke instrumenten, zoals toegangsovereenkomsten, terminalcontracten, regelingen voor het delen van gegevens en contractuele aansprakelijkheidsbeperkingen. De centrale vraag is hoe deze verplichtingen doorwerken in privaatrechtelijke relaties en privaatrechtelijke zorgplichten, aansprakelijkheidsnormen, handhaving en de contractuele toewijzing of beperking van risico’s beïnvloeden. Het onderzoek zal onder meer de relevantie onderzoeken van de EU-verordening inzake havendiensten, het NIS2-raamwerk en aanverwante Europese en nationale regels inzake cyberbeveiliging en kritieke infrastructuur, waaronder de Nederlandse Cyberbeveiligingswet. Bijzondere aandacht zal worden besteed aan de mate waarin wettelijke verplichtingen open privaatrechtelijke normen en contractuele relaties vormgeven, en aan de juridische doeltreffendheid van bepalingen die erop gericht zijn om de risico’s van cyberincidenten te toe te wijzen aan de betrokken partijen. Het project heeft betrekking op zowel zee- als binnenhavens en zal geselecteerde Europese rechtssystemen en havens ter vergelijking gebruiken. Ook zal worden onderzocht of, en zo ja hoe, het vaak publieke karakter van havenbedrijven van invloed is op de verhouding tussen publiekrecht en privaatrecht en de daaruit voortvloeiende aansprakelijkheidspositie. De belangrijkste methode is juridisch-doctrinair onderzoek op het snijvlak van privaatrecht, handels- en zeerecht, publiekrecht en EU-recht, aangevuld met een functionele vergelijkende analyse. Indien nuttig en haalbaar kan de juridische analyse worden onderbouwd met interviews met relevante belanghebbenden, met inachtneming van de geldende vereisten inzake onderzoeksintegriteit en privacy. Het project draagt in de eerste plaats bij aan de onderzoeksprioriteit „Digitalisering“ van ESL. Binnen deze thematische prioriteit brengt het expertise op het gebied van privaatrecht, zeerecht en publiekrecht samen om te onderzoeken hoe digitale haveninfrastructuur en datagestuurde activiteiten de zorgplichten en de contractuele risicoverdeling hervormen. Het onderzoek naar cyberveiligheid, kritieke infrastructuur en de juridische toewijzing van digitale risico’s sluit tevens aan bij de prioriteit „Veiligheid, rechtsstaat en maatschappelijke veerkracht“. De voorgestelde begeleidingsteam bestaat uit prof. Jolien Kruit als eerste promotor, dr. Frank Stevens als medepromotor en prof. Pim Jansen als tweede promotor, die in het bijzonder verantwoordelijk is voor het raakvlak tussen publiekrecht en privaatrecht. items.desc: Job Description About Altium Altium is transforming the way electronics are designed and built. Our cloud platform, Altium 365, enables distributed teams to collaborate seamlessly across the entire electronics development lifecycle - from design to manufacturing. By connecting people, processes, and data, Altium 365 helps teams move faster, reduce errors, and deliver high-quality hardware products at scale. We are looking for a UX Researcher to shape end-to-end experiences across Altium 365. You'll be the person who keeps our product decisions connected to real users. You'll run the conversations, test the ideas before we build them, and make sure everything we learn stays findable instead of getting lost in old Slack threads and someone's notebook. You'll work closely with designers, PMs, and engineers throughout the whole cycle, from early problem framing to post-launch validation. This is a hands-on role with a lot of autonomy. You'll own the research practice rather than execute someone else's plan. What You'll Do Talk to users, regularly Own the participant pipeline: recruiting, screening, scheduling, incentives, consent Run interviews, contextual inquiries, diary studies, and surveys Build a steady cadence of user contact so the team is never more than a couple of weeks from fresh input Validate ideas and prototypes Partner with designers and PMs to turn open questions into research questions Run usability tests and concept tests on wireframes, prototypes, and live features Choose the right method for the decision at hand, including quick, scrappy studies when speed matters more than rigor Deliver findings that clearly state what to change and what the trade-offs are Build and maintain the insights repository Set up and curate a searchable database of findings, tagged by product area, user segment, and theme Connect new findings to old ones so patterns surface over time Make it genuinely usable for the rest of the team, not just an archive Track which insights led to which decisions, and revisit assumptions that haven't held up Raise the team's research literacy Coach designers and PMs to run their own lightweight studies well Share findings in formats people actually read and watch: short readouts, highlight reels, workshops Push back when a decision is being made on opinion where evidence is available or cheap to get Qualifications What we're looking for 3+ years in UX/product research, or a closely adjacent role with substantial hands-on research work Solid command of qualitative methods, plus enough quantitative literacy to design a survey and interpret product analytics Experience testing prototypes at different fidelities and knowing what each stage can and can't tell you Clear communication: you can make findings land with a skeptical stakeholder in five minutes Comfort working in ambiguity and scoping research to fit real timelines Familiarity with research ops tooling (Dovetail, Condens, Maze, UserTesting, or similar) English at a professional level Nice to have Experience setting up an insights repository from scratch Background in our domain: Engineering, PCB design or other complex domain Basic familiarity with Figma and design workflows Additional Information Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development. From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 
 The Position
 The Position
 Field Service Engineers - Carlisle, Dumfries, South West Scotland 
Are you an experienced field service engineer seeking a meaningful role in the healthcare industry?
 Are you excited about the prospect of joining a forward-thinking, high-tech business that is passionate about improving patients' lives?
 If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you at Roche Diagnostics, the world's leading provider of diagnostic equipment. Roche covers territories throughout the UK, Scotland, Ireland and Wales England
 The Role 
As a field service engineer with experience in diagnosing and repairing electro-mechanical, fluidic, and electronic systems. Applicants with a background in biomedical engineering, industrial engineering, automation, or aerospace (to name a few) are encouraged to apply. If you have a strong foundation in troubleshooting at the component level and have progressed to systems-level expertise, we want to hear from you.
In this important position within the Technical Services group, you will provide technical support for a variety of medical equipment. With exciting product launches and significant R&D investment in our portfolio, you will have the chance to support the growth of key business accounts across your territory and the UK. You will report to a Regional Technical Manager and be responsible for preventative, corrective, modification, installation, and out-of-hours support for specified products ranging from large to medium-sized equipment.
 Who You are 
To be considered for this role, you should have an engineering or electrical qualification and be able to confidently represent the company at client sites. You should have good previous field service experience with high-value capital equipment and be able to build productive customer relationships in a complex environment. You may be required to travel throughout the UK on occasion.
At Roche Diagnostics, we are committed to investing in our people as well as our business. In addition to a competitive salary and benefits package, we offer a recognized product training program and continuous support to help you develop your knowledge, skills, and potential. If you are ready to take the next step in your professional development and make a positive impact in the healthcare industry, we encourage you to apply for this exciting field service engineer opportunity.
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of Roche Products Ltd. At Roche Products we believe diversity drives innovation and we are committed to building a diverse and flexible working environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion or belief, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, disability or age. We recognise the importance of flexible working and will review all applicants’ requests with care. At Roche difference is valued and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

items.title: Associate Credit Services Representative with Slovak and Czech language
items.card: you will support credit and collections activities for assigned customer accounts while developing expertise in customer engagement, financial operations, and digital service delivery. You will collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve outstanding balances, maintain accurate account records, and contribute to operational excellence within a technology-enabled Credit Services organisation.
items.desc:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life 
The Credit Services function supports Medtronic’s order-to-cash operations by partnering with customers and internal stakeholders to manage credit and collections activities, resolve account issues, and support healthy cash flow. The team operates within a modern shared-services environment that leverages digital workflows, data-driven decision-making, and AI-enabled tools to deliver efficient and compliant customer outcomes. 
We are seeking graduates and early-career professionals with professional proficiency in Slovak and Czech language support customers across our EMEA markets. As an Associate Credit Services Representative, you will support credit and collections activities for assigned customer accounts while developing expertise in customer engagement, financial operations, and digital service delivery. You will collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve outstanding balances, maintain accurate account records, and contribute to operational excellence within a technology-enabled Credit Services organisation.
 Primary Responsibilities 
 Manage assigned customer accounts and perform collection activities to support timely payment of outstanding balances.
 Communicate with customers by phone and email in English and the required market language to resolve payment issues, clarify account information, and support payment arrangements.
 Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, account activities, and collection outcomes within designated systems.
 Partner with Finance, Customer Service, and other internal stakeholders to investigate and resolve account discrepancies.
 Escalate complex customer, account, or workflow issues in accordance with established policies and procedures.
 Follow documented processes, controls, and compliance requirements to ensure accurate and consistent service delivery.
 Utilise approved digital and AI-enabled tools to support workflow execution, information gathering, prioritisation, and customer communications.
 Contribute feedback on recurring issues, process gaps, workflow improvements, and automation opportunities to support continuous improvement initiatives.
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree and no prior professional experience required.
 Fluent English and minimum C1 proficiency in Slovak and Czech with the ability to communicate effectively in a business environment both verbally and in writing.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
 Ability to learn and work effectively across multiple systems, workflow technologies, and AI-enabled tools.
 Availability to work on-site in Warsaw during onboarding, training, certification, and operational readiness activities as required.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Up to one year of experience in finance, accounting, shared services, customer service, or a related business environment.
 Experience using enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems such as SAP.
 Experience supporting customers across EMEA markets.
 Experience working with customer account management, collections, or order-to-cash processes.
 Demonstrated interest in process improvement, digital transformation, and technology-enabled service delivery.
 Physical Job Requirements 
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

items.desc:
Location: Bucharest, Romania The Network Engineers goal is to support the company in the daily management of the IS/IT function by delivering high-availability network infrastructure in order to sustain the users' online and on-site information technology activities. To do so, the Network Engineers work hand in hand with other IS/IT professionals (architects, security engineers …). 
 On a daily basis, the Network Engineers design and implement network configurations, troubleshoot performance issues, carry out network monitoring and configure network systems such as routers, switches, and wireless infrastructure. They have to make sure that operations’ workflow, practices, and server maintenance are working effectively and efficiently to aid the improvement of performance, security system, and availability of systems and dependent ecosystems. 
 Network Engineers interface with various stakeholders, within the company and throughout IS/IT Function, in order to deliver stakeholders satisfaction by managing capacity and carrying out remote and/or on-site support. 
 COMPETENCIES: 
 You are able to maintain and control computer networks and related computing environments together with structures software, programs software, hardware, and configurations. 
 You can carry out the configuration of network and security infrastructure equipment. 
 You have experience in monitoring network performance by troubleshooting, diagnosing and resolving software, hardware, and other network and system problems. 
 You have the ability to define the detailed functional behavior of infrastructure building blocks. 
 You have the ability to prevent service interruption, data loss and/or other technical disasters. 
 You have experience in managing complex recovery operations. 
 You can stay value driven, propose smart ideas, be disruptive, take smart risk 
 You have the creativity to lay out smart designs, think out of the box 
 You have the ability to implement new solutions for your users’ satisfaction. 
 You contribute on purchase process in way to describe requirement, analyse & challenge offers and advise on tenderer’s selection. 
 You are able to define a product roadmap and norms & standards 
 You are autonomous, organized, dynamic and can be an actor of change management, promote teamwork 
 You have the strong ability on writing of technical document 
 TECHNICAL SKILLS: 
 You can define and implement networking requirements in a variety of production processes. 
 You have good analytic skills and provide a real expertise on level 3 support. 
 You can configure network and security devices and other IT assets like: Firewalls: Juniper, Palo Alto, FortiGate, Stormshield, Checkpoint, L3/L4 Filtering, User-ID, App-ID. 
 Proxies: zScaler, SSL inspection, WL/BL, URL categorization, web filters, content filter, CAS 
 Gateway VPN: Cisco Firepower, Any Connect client 
 Load balancer: F5 (LTM, APM), VMware NSX. 
 Radius: Cisco ISE PSN, PAN, Dot1.x 
 You have a good knowledge on transversal infrastructure and security domain like : Directories: Active Directory, LDAPS. 
 IAM: Kerberos, SAML, Single Sign On, MFA, etc. 
 PKI: x509 certificate, CMS, AEP. 
 Cloud computing: SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, Infra as Code, and Automation with scripts development (Python/Shell). 
 Cloud security: Zero Trust Network Access, SASE. 
 Virtualized environment (ESX and VMs). 
 SOFT SKILLS: 
 You have strong communication and documentation skills. 
 You are proactive and self-motivated with a problem-solving mindset. 
 You have the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative agile environment. 
 You are independent and self-organizing.

Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world. 
 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of defence and security, aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

items.desc:
¡Hola! 
 Soy Mariana, recruiter de esta posición. Viajar es una de mis mayores alegrías, y lo que lo hace aún más especial es poder vivir esas experiencias con mi familia y nuestra querida gata Rosita. 
 Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales. 
 ¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo. 
 Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega! 
 ¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN: 
 Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2025 hicimos más de 28.000 horas de activismo. 
 En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección). 
 ¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas. 
 Y te preguntarás: Marian ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento): 
 Buscamos un/a Suscriptor de Mercado Pymes en Alicante, dentro de la Dirección Territorial Este-Baleares, para responsabilizarse de la búsqueda proactiva de oportunidades de negocio en mercado de corredores con el fin de hacer crecer la cartera y lograr los resultados requeridos del plan (nuevo negocio, objetivos de retención, siniestralidad, etc.). 
 Tus responsabilidades serán: 
 Buscar de forma proactiva nuevas oportunidades de suscripción de Pymes. 
 Seguimiento mensual y consecución del plan de su zona (cartera, Nuevo Negocio, siniestralidad, retención...) 
 Seguimiento y revisión de la correcta ejecución de las iniciativas de suscripción. 
 Apoyar en la suscripción en el proceso de renovaciones importantes de nuestra cartera de empresas. 
 Evaluación y comprensión pormenorizada de carteras de corredores para detectar oportunidades de crecimiento de cada mediador de empresas asignado a tu panel. 
 Realizar ventas cruzadas con otras líneas de negocio, para aumentar la densidad de productos por cliente. 
 Interaccionar con los equipos de ventas que guarden relación con el territorio o los corredores asignados. 
 Servir de contacto principal para el segmento de Pymes para el panel de corredores de Alicante y Murcia asignado. 
 Crear redes sólidas de corredores relacionados con los seguros para Negocios. 
 Reportar feedback de la mediación internamente para poner en marcha las mejoras oportunas. 
 Colaborar con marketing para corredores y dinamizar el lanzamiento de productos. 
 Diagnosticar y elaborar recomendaciones para solucionar problemas específicos de la unidad de negocio, del corredor. 
 Investigar, recomendar e implantar soluciones basadas en la Gerencia de Riesgos, que satisfagan las necesidades de corredores. 
 A estas alturas, te estarás preguntando, ¿Cómo sé si encajo? 
 No te preocupes, no te voy a pedir que salves el planeta ni que cumplas el 100% de los requisitos. 
 Licenciatura en ADE, Empresariales, Económicas, Ingeniería o equivalente. 
 Experiencia mínima de 5 años en suscripción, relacionada en riesgos de Empresas/Pymes. 
 Conocimientos sobre los productos de suscripción específicos para Pymes. 
 Buenas habilidades de negociación, así como capacidad de interacción con mediadores y equipos de mercado. 
 Enfocado a resultados y a objetivos 
 Proactividad. Clara actitud de servicio. 
 Habilidades de comunicación. 
 Residencia en Alicante, puesto que el ámbito de acción será la zona de Alicante y Murcia principalmente, dentro de la dimensión de la DT Este-Baleares. 
 Ahora mismo, o estás con la emoción de cuando un pantalón te entra perfecto o estás pensando: “esto no es para mí” (si no es para ti, no pasa nada, ya nos volveremos a encontrar en el futuro). Puedes hacer de celestina compartiendo mi contacto con quien creas que pueda encajar. 
 En Zurich somos muy disfrutones , nos gusta vivir la vida. Ya me contarás cómo podemos hacerte feliz, pero a mí me encanta poder conciliar mi trabajo con mi vida personal. Aquí la flexibilidad horaria y la desconexión digital son reales. 
 #PorSerDeZurich , puedes escoger los beneficios que mejor se adaptan a tus necesidades. Ya sabemos que, para gustos, los colores. 
 Te ofrecemos un modelo híbrido mega flexible para trabajar.

Team – you will join our interdisciplinary team in the Assembly. System Optimization & Fault
items.desc:
The future of moblity for us. Professional excellence for you. 
 At the BMW Group, everything starts with passion. It turns a profession into a vocation. It drives us to keep reinventing mobility and bring innovative ideas onto the roads. Enthusiasm for joint projects turns a team into a strong unit where every opinion is valued. It is only when expertise, highly professional processes and enjoyment of work unite that we can shape the future together. All employees can and should contribute with their special skills to the unique culture of the BMW Group. We're searching for people who are as passionate as we are. Your expertise, your skill set, your motivation, and your individuality are what drive us forward.
 As a PLC Specialist at BMW Group Plant Debrecen, you will be responsible for the production-related support of all control technology scopes of our production systems in the Assembly.
 What awaits you? 
 Work environment – a highly automated production area equipped with robots, PLC controls, which our team sets up, operates, and maintains to ensure the required quality.
 Team – you will join our interdisciplinary team in the Assembly.
 System Optimization & Fault Elimination – you support operations in long-term fault elimination and lead projects aimed at improving system availability, safety, and efficiency.
 Project Execution – you ensure the timely delivery of production area projects (modifications, optimizations, and replacements) while managing suppliers within a standard project management framework.
 Problem Solving - you coordinate all on-site control systems and assist suppliers with emerging technical issues.
 IT System Support - you utilize various production-related IT systems in your daily routine.
 Strategic Planning - you apply electrical standards and contribute to the development of new control technologies and systems up to series production . 
 Administration - you prepare inquiry and RFP (Request for Proposal) documents to round off your scope of work.
 What should you bring along? 
 Education background - vocational/high-school degree in a relevant field (electrical, electronics); university degree would be an advantage.
 Work experience – Minimum 2 years of experiences in the commissioning of PLC controls.
 Technical knowledge - knowledge of drive, control and automation technology, PLC programming, S7 Classic and TIA Portal, SEW and SINAMICS drive technology. Advanced knowledge of creating/editing visualizations in WinCC, network technology and bus systems (Ethernet, ProfiNet) and knowledge of Kuka robot programming.
 Language skills - communicational level of English and Hungarian is needed, German would be an advantage.
 Work schedule - willingness to work in two rotating shifts (06:00-15:00, 15:00-24:00).
 Soft skills - team spirit and joy to working independently or in a structured manner. Proactivity and good analytical mindset and problem-solving skills.
 What do we offer? 
 Our goal is to motivate our employees and recognize their performance, which is why our benefits package includes the following elements in addition to the base salary:
 Bonus – performance-based bonus calculated based on corporate and personal results.
 Cafeteria – annual cafeteria allowance paid out monthly.
 Commuting Support – free, direct bus and train services from major cities in the region, aligned with shift schedules. Travel cost reimbursement for personal car usage is provided at the legally prescribed rate.
 Healthcare Services – high-quality healthcare services, physiotherapy, and therapeutic exercise options are available at the on-site health center.
 Private Health Insurance – after probation time, all associates entitled for health insurance, which contains outpatient care, laboratory- and diagnostics tests, outpatient and one-day surgery, screening tests, patient transport.
 Accident and Life Insurance – in work and out of work group accident and life insurance.
 Subsidized Meals – one daily discounted hot meal at the company cafeteria.
 Employee car rental programme .

 A BMW csoportnál minden az elhivatottsággal kezdődik, amely képes egy szakmát hivatássá változtatni. Elhivatottságunk késztet bennünket arra, hogy folyamatosan újra értelmezzük a mobilitást, és innovatív ötleteket vigyünk az utakra. A közös projektek iránti lelkesedés alakít egy csapatot erős egységgé, ahol minden ötletet és véleményt értékelünk. Csak ha a szakértelem, a professzionális folyamatok és a munka élvezete egyesül, akkor alakíthatjuk együtt a jövőt. Olyan kollégákat keresünk, akik ugyanolyan elhivatottak, mint mi. A szakértelmed, a készségeid, a motivációd és az egyéniséged visznek minket előre.
 Mint a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen PLC Specialista munkatársa, felelős leszel a gyártó rendszereink összes vezérléstechnikai területének gyártáshoz kapcsolódó támogatásáért az Összeszerelő Üzemben.
 Mi vár rád? 
 Munkakörnyezet – magasan automatizált, robotokkal, PLC rendszerekkel ellátott gyártósor, melyeket a munkatársaink állítanak be, üzemeltetnek és tartanak karban a szükséges minőség biztosítása érdekében.
 Csapat – az Összeszerelő Üzem interdiszciplináris csapatának tagja leszel.
 Rendszeroptimalizálás és hibaelhárítás – támogatod az üzemeltetést a hibák hosszú távú kiküszöbölésében, valamint a rendszer rendelkezésre állásának, biztonságának és hatékonyságának növelését célzó projektek vezetésében.
 Projektek lebonyolítása – Felelsz a termelési területen zajló átalakítások, optimalizálások, cserékre határidőre történő megvalósításáért, illetve a beszállítók koordinálásért a klasszikus projektmenedzsment keretein belül.
 Problémamegoldás – koordinálod a helyszínen az ellenőrzéssel kapcsolatos valamennyi feladatot, illetve támogatást nyújtasz a beszállítóknak a felmerülő problémák kezelésében.
 IT rendszertámogatás – mindennapi munkád során különböző, a termeléssel kapcsolatos informatikai rendszereket használod.
 Adminisztráció – elkészíted a szükséges vizsgálati dokumentumokat, amelyek kiegészítik és alátámasztják a feladatkörödet.
 Mit várunk tőled? 
 Végzettség – Középfokú végzettséget szereztél kapcsolódó szakterületen (ipari villanyszerelés, elektronika); egyetemi diploma előnyt jelent.
 Munkatapasztalat – minimum 2 éves szakmai tapasztalattal rendelkezel a PLC-vezérlések üzembe helyezésében, működtetésében.
 Technikai háttér - a hajtás-, vezérlő- és automatizálási technológiákat ismered, PLC-programozási ismeretekkel rendelkezel, S7 Classic és TIA Portal, valamint a SEW és SINAMICS hajtástechnika. A WinCC-ben történő vizualizációk létrehozásának és szerkesztésének magas szintű ismerete, hálózati technológia és buszrendszerek (Ethernet, ProfiNet) ismerete, valamint a Kuka robotok programozásának ismerete.
 Nyelvtudás – angol nyelvtudásod kommunikációs szintű, a német nyelv ismerete előnyt jelent.
 Munkarend – kész vagy két, váltott műszakban dolgozni (06:00-15:00 és 15:00-24:00).
 Készségek – csapatjátékos vagy, könnyen tudsz együttműködni a kollégákkal, képes vagy önállóan és csapatban dolgozni. Proaktivitás, analitikus gondolkodásmód és jó problémamegoldó képesség jellemez.
 Mit kínálunk? 
 Célunk, hogy munkatársainkat motiváljuk és teljesítményüket elismerjük , ezért juttatási csomagunk az alapbéren felül az alábbi elemekből áll:
 Bérfejlesztés – évente, teljesítményértékelés alapján . 
 Bónusz – vállalati és személyes eredmények alapján számított bónuszok.
 Cafeteria – éves cafeteria keretösszeg havi folyósítással.
 Támogatott munkába járás – ingyenes, a műszakbeosztáshoz igazított, közvetlen busz és vasút járatok a régió nagyvárosaiból. Gépkocsi használat esetén a törvényben előírt mértékű költségtérítés.
 Egészségügyi szolgáltatások – magas szintű egészségügyi szolgáltatások, fizikoterápia és gyógytorna lehetőség a debreceni gyárban található egészség központban.
 Magán egészségbiztosítás – próbaidő után minden munkatársunk számára elérhető egészségbiztosítás, amely magában foglal járóbeteg szakellátást, labor- és diagnosztikai vizsgálatokat, ambuláns és egynapos sebészetet, szűrővizsgálatokat, betegszállítást.
 Baleset és életbiztosítás – munkaidőben és azon kívül is bekövetkező eseményekre csoportos baleset és életbiztosítás.
 Kedvezményes étkezés – napi egyszeri támogatott árú melegétel a vállalati étkezdében.
 Munkavállalói autóbérlési program 
 Tudj meg többet juttatásainkról ezen a linken : https://www.bmwgroup.jobs/hu/hu/about-us/our-benefits.html 
 Foglalkoztatás típusa: 
 Teljes munkaidős, határozatlan idejű foglalkoztatás.
 Kérünk, hogy pályázatod angol nyelven nyújtsd be. További kérdés esetén keresd toborzó partnerünket a +36 52 333 603 telefonszámon hétköznap 8:00 és 16:30 között.
 A BMW Group Gyár Debrecennél nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk az egyenlő bánásmódra és az esélyegyenlőségre. Toborzási és kiválasztási döntéseink a jelentkezők személyiségén, tapasztalatán és képességein alapulnak.
 Tudj meg többet itt .

items.desc:
START WITH WHAT INSPIRES YOU. 
 Everything starts with passion at Rolls-Royce Motor Cars. It turns a profession into a vocation. It drives us to keep reinventing mobility and to bring innovative ideas onto the roads. Our teams work as a strong unit where every opinion is valued. We have set future-focused goals within a practical and long-term framework —all with the intention to enact positive change and continue our pursuit of proactive responsibility. Plus, we pride ourselves on providing a friendly, supportive environment and management style, having some great benefits for our employees (including a car scheme), career development, progression and work-life balance.
 We’re committed to providing an environment where you can be yourself and be your best. This includes welcoming you into an inclusive culture, investing in your continuous learning and development, giving you access to breadth and depth of experience. We want to provide you with challenging and rewarding opportunities to make a difference, offering flexible working options and giving ample reward and recognition.
 Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, Goodwood, West Sussex (UK) – Product Management Graduate– 2 Year Graduate Programme (September 2027) 
 We have the opportunity for someone new to join our team as a Product Graduate where the primary role will be to support the Product Managers in ensuring the success of the current series vehicles during the lifecycle in all worldwide markets.
The role will have primary responsibility to support, align and resolve sales and marketing product topics for the vehicle throughout the organisation. You will also be responsible for the creation of Product Bulletins and Market Intelligence within the Product Management team. Note that in addition to the placement within Product Management, you will have the opportunity to experience two 3 month placements in other areas of Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, which will be designed to provide a broad overview of the Company
What will you be doing? 
 Product Management - to support product feature content and pricing to establish a competitive product offering and ensure market success on an International level.
 Product Definition - to support delivery of Brand and Client requirements into deliverable engineering metrics, to ensure successful product development in-line with business case targets.
 Product Communications (Bulletins) - to develop, distribute and present Product Bulletins to ensure the product is fully understood by dealers and regional partners.
 Market Intelligence - to collate and analyse Competitor data to ensure the competitiveness of Rolls-Royce products in the market.
 Bespoke Collection Cars - to manage and deliver product feature content and pricing to produce a profitable and successful global product, capable of creating marketing impulses and driving dealer traffic.
 Show cars – provide support in determining show car proposals for all Rolls-Royce Motor Cars model lines.
 Model Year pricing - to support the process of harmonising and communicating Model Year pricing information, base pricing, options and bespoke.
 Qualifications 
 Graduated or working towards a degree in a Business or Technical related area, with a 2:1 or above
 High appreciation for the Automotive and Luxury industries
 Client Orientation
 Good communication skills, both written and oral
 Willingness to work in a flexible, multi-disciplinary team
 What can you look forward to? 
 Great Pay – A competitive annual salary, 27 days holiday per annum (pro rata to your contract) and an attractive pension scheme.
 Rewarding Work-Life Balance 
 Exciting Additional Benefits – You will have the opportunity to enjoy other employee benefits, a subsidised on-site restaurant and access to our Advantages scheme which gives you a range of offers and discounts.
 What do you need to do now? 
 If you apply, the next stages of the recruiting process will include a face to face assessment centre.
 To be eligible for this position, you must be able to provide proof of your legal right to work in the UK. 
 Successful candidates will be required to complete background screening checks and the offer of employment will be subject to results which we consider are satisfactory. Checks may include references, right to work, IT system Compliance Integrity Check (COIN), CV and relevant qualifications. Checks may also include criminal records, adverse financial (credit), directorships, address, internet research and/or driving licence. If you have any queries on any of these checks, please discuss with us and we will be happy to go through with you in more detail.
 At the BMW Group, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. Our recruiting decisions are based on the personality, experience, and skills of the applicants.
 Closing date for applications: Sunday 18th October 2026. 
 Any further questions? Email us on Recruitment-UK@bmwgroup.com

items.desc:
Entdecke, was du bei der KUKA Group bewegen kannst. 
 Die KUKA Group bietet ein enormes Spektrum an Möglichkeiten, um deine Karriere voranzutreiben, deiner Leidenschaft zu folgen und dein Potenzial zu entfalten. Wir sind einer der weltweit führenden Automatisierungsspezialisten und bieten globale Möglichkeiten in Bereichen wie Robotik, Automatisierung, Logistik, Softwarelösungen und Elektronik. Wenn du ein Macher bist, ein Visionär mit kühnen Ambitionen und dir Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiger Respekt wichtig sind, dann bist du hier bei KUKA Group auf Erfolgskurs.
 Hier bewirkst du etwas 
 Als Applikationsingenieur programmierst Du Roboteranwendungen vor Ort beim Kunden in den verschiedensten Branchen und Einsatzbereichen. 
 Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören ebenso Inbetriebnahmen, Konfigurationen, Störungsbehebung und Anlaufbegleitung von Robotersystemen. Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt ist die Optimierung von Robotersystemen die sich bereits im Produktionsbetrieb befinden. 
 Deine Einsätze finden vorzugsweise im Süddeutschen Raum statt. In einigen Projekten unterstützen wir aber auch unsere Auslandsniederlassungen oder begleiten die Wiederinbetriebnahme eines Kundenprojektes, das ins Ausland geliefert wird. 
 Im Rahmen eines Projektes bist du in Projektgesprächen und in Entscheidungen mit eingebunden. Für besondere Einsatzfälle passt Du Kuka Standardsoftwarepakete auf Kundenbedürfnisse an. Nach erfolgter Umsetzung führst Du Einweisungen des Kundenpersonals durch und begleitest die Abnahme. 
 Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt ist den Kunden im Rahmen unseres Dienstleistungsportfolio „SafetyServices“ bei der Beratung und bei der Ausführung im Umgang mit der Robotersicherheit zu unterstützen. 
 Nach Deiner Einarbeitung unterstützt Du in der Planungsphase bei der Klärung der technischen Anforderungen und arbeitest bei der Erstellung technischer Angebotsvorlagen mit. Des Weiteren beinhaltet dein Aufgabengebiet Kundengespräche im Hause oder vor Ort. Bei komplexeren Anfragen validierst Du die technische Machbarkeit im Laborumfeld und präsentierst gegenüber Vertrieb/Kunde Ihre Lösungsansätze. Innerhalb des Unternehmens arbeitest Du eng mit Vertrieb, der Simulationsabteilung und anderen Abteilungen/Niederlassungen des Customer Service zusammen. 
 Außerdem bist du für die Simulationsuntersuchungen zur Erreichbarkeits-, Zugänglichkeits- und Zykluszeitanalysen in der Planungs- und Konzeptphase sowie die Programmierung von KUKA-AMRs für kundenseitige Logistiklösungen inkl. Flottenmanagement verantwortlich. 
 Das bringst du mit 
 Die Basis deines Profils bildet dein abgeschlossenes Studium zum Bachelor/Master/Ingenieur oder Techniker der Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Mechatronik, Maschinenbau oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse. 
 Weitergehend bringst du gute Kenntnisse in MS Office, Windows und Computernetzwerken mit. Deine Erfahrung im Bereich Robotik und Anlagenbau ist von Vorteil. 
 Deine Teamfähigkeit und Interesse an anderen Kulturen kombiniert sich mit einem selbstständigen, projektorientierten und strukturierten Arbeitsstil . 
 Du zeichnest dich durch deine Mobilität, Flexibilität und Einsatzbereitschaft für unsere Kunden aus. Zudem bist du im Besitz einer gültigen Fahrerlaubnis Klasse B für PKW . 
 Ergänzend verfügst Du über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Programmierung von Robotern als auch übergeordneten SPS-Steuerungen und Kenntnisse in Hochsprache z.B. Java, C# sind wünschenswert. 
 Dein Profil wird durch deine sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift abgerundet. 
 Unser Versprechen an dich 
 Unsere Kultur ist tief in unserer Leidenschaft, Robotik und Automatisierungslösungen für jeden zugänglich und einfach nutzbar zu machen, verwurzelt. Das Ergebnis? Wir machen das Leben der Menschen einfacher und sicherer, überall auf der Welt. Vielfalt ist das Herzstück unseres Unternehmens – und wir schätzen jeden einzelnen unserer klugen und kreativen Köpfe. Wir ermutigen jeden, sich bei der Arbeit voll und ganz einzubringen, und fördern so ein Umfeld, in dem Inspiration, Fachwissen und persönliches Wachstum gedeihen können. Unser gemeinsames Ziel? Wir wollen Großes erreichen und innovative, positive Veränderungen anstoßen - nicht nur innerhalb der Automatisierungsbranche, sondern auch über deren Grenzen hinaus. Im Gegenzug legen wir großen Wert darauf, eine unterstützende, fördernden und fürsorgliche Umgebung für alle zu schaffen.
 Vorteile und Leistungen 
 Als Teil unseres Engagements für das Wohlergehen unserer Mitarbeitenden bieten wir eine Reihe umfassender Vorteile und Leistungen. Von wettbewerbsfähigen Gehaltspaketen über flexible Arbeitszeiten bis hin zu beruflichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten - wir wollen einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz für die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden bieten. Es ist uns wichtig, die harte Arbeit und das Engagement unserer Mitarbeitenden anzuerkennen und zu würdigen, und unsere Zusatzleistungen spiegeln dies wider. Unser Ziel ist es, einen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an …

Discover your impact with KUKA Group 
 KUKA Group offers an enormous spectrum of possibilities to advance your career, live your passions and unlock your potential. We´re one of the world's leading automation specialists, offering global opportunities in areas such as robotics, automation, logistics, software solutions and electronics. If you´re a go-getter, a visionary with bold ambitions and believer in collaboration and mutual respect, then you're poised for success here at KUKA Group.
 Make an impact 
 Ensure full operation of a global Salesforce platform with approximately 4,000 users in around 40 countries, 
 advising business units (e.g. Sales, Marketing, and Customer Service) on the implementation of Salesforce functionalities to adapt to business requirements, 
 continuous development of the Salesforce platform using agile project methodologies (Scrum) in collaboration with stakeholders, 
 Analysis of global business processes to identify optimization potential using Salesforce and develop implementation strategies, 
 technical implementation and configuration of the Salesforce platform according to client requirements, 
 conducting system tests, quality assurance, and troubleshooting for features and interfaces, 
 managing first-level support and maintenance, providing ongoing knowledge transfer on Salesforce topics such as requests, login issues, and system questions, 
 conducting second level support and Salesforce support tickets, 
 agile work in interdisciplinary teams with close coordination between business units, SAP, and Salesforce development,

This role offers the opportunity to work independently, take ownership, become a trusted point of contact and play a key part in a high-tech environment. Ideally, you are based in the Rotterdam region.
 Please note: You will start your journey with us, working closely with Quooker. After 2 to 3 years, the plan is for your employment contract to transition to Quooker, offering you the opportunity to become a permanent member of their organisation.
 As a Maintenance Engineer at Swisslog, you play a key role within the Customer Service organisation, and you will:
 Provide electro-mechanical preventive and corrective maintenance on automated material handling systems, including conveyors, in line with Swisslog quality standards.
 Diagnose and resolve mechanical and electronic faults, escalating to remote specialists when needed.
 Ensure safe, efficient operations by following planned preventive maintenance (PPM) schedules.
 You will be responsible for maintaining advanced material handling equipment such as pallet stacker cranes, conveyors and robotics systems.
 You will make sure customer system operation is always kept to the maximum, ensuring adherence to all the relevant instructions and technical standards
 Work safely by following all relevant safety procedures and guidelines, carrying out tasks responsibly and contributing to a safe work environment by identifying and reporting risks.
 Act as the on-site representative of Swisslog, building and maintaining strong customer relationships with Quooker.
 What you need to succeed 
 You hold a Technical education in mechanical / electrical maintenance or mechatronics.
 Customer service drives you and you have strong communication skills.
 Knowledge of preventative maintenance methods and schedules.
 Ability and willingness to work at heights, as you will perform work on 30 metres height.
 You reside within 45 minutes driving distance from Ridderkerk.
 It is advantageous if you have experience working in an automated industrial or automated material handling environment and able to read and find error codes in PLC. 
 You are fluent in Dutch and confident communicating in English.
 #LI-DJ1
 Our promise to you 
 Swisslog is a world of opportunity for people who can deliver a game changing mission: driving the future of intralogistics, by shaping an era of robotic and data-driven automated solutions that create exceptional customer value.
 Join us on this journey and you’ll be part of a global enterprise that’s proud of its Swiss roots - and hugely excited by the worldwide opportunities open to everyone in the Swisslog family. So come and realize your potential, in a team that’s united by passion and driven by the OneSwisslog team spirit.

 Swisslog is shaping the future of intralogistics. As part of the KUKA Group, we work on the latest technologies that are reimagining the world of logistics. We’re a team of 3,000+ experts from 50 countries, serving some of the world's largest and most exciting brands. Together, we’re implementing smart and innovative approaches - including flexible robot-based and data-driven automation solutions that are transforming the supply chain. So join our team and share your unique perspective.

 Primijeni stečena znanja iz škole i s fakulteta u realnom sektoru, u jednoj od vodećih banaka u Hrvatskoj, obavljanjem stručne neplaćene prakse u PBZ-u. 
 Što te očekuje: 
 mogućnost stjecanja prvih radnih iskustava u trajanju do četiri tjedna (160 sati) u različitim organizacijskim dijelovima Banke, uzimajući u obzir tvoje sklonosti i interese te trenutačne organizacijske mogućnosti

 ugodna i poticajna radna klima 
 stjecanje novih osobnih i poslovnih kontakata

 redovit si učenik/ca ili student/ica (potvrdu o upisu s prijepisom ocjena priložiti u isto polje prijave kao i životopis) 
 imaš dobre ocjene 
 barem te jedan od profesora preporučuje za ovu praksu (priložiti u isto polje prijave kao i životopis) 
 motiviran/motivirana si za rad u određenom organizacijskom dijelu Banke 
 spreman/spremna si posvetiti se radnim zadatcima koji će ti biti dodijeljeni tijekom izvršavanja prakse.

items.desc:
VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 2 050 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 650 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 400 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1800 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Ak pre Vás nie sú bankové a investičné produkty neznáme pojmy, máte v sebe ducha obchodníka, rád/rada komunikujete a dokážete klientom pomôcť nájsť to najideálnejšie riešenie, ste skvelý typ na osobného bankára/bankárku pre VÚB! 
 Čakajú Vás u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie. 
 Na pozícii Osobný bankár/bankárka bude Vašou úlohou:
 identifikovať potreby klientov, analyzovať ich požiadavky a hľadať pre nich tie najideálnejšie riešenia,
 poskytovať odborné poradenstvo v oblasti produktov a služieb existujúcim a potenciálnym klientom z portfólia afluentných klientov,
 budovať si s klientmi dôverný vzťah,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
 Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov! 
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Prax na pozícii/v oblasti:
 minimálne 2 roky skúsenosti s priamym predajom finančných produktov
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máte minimálne 2 roky skúsenosti s priamym predajom finančných produktov,
 viete aktívne využívať MS Office a nebojíte sa virtuálneho prostredia,

items.desc: This is a dual role, split between approximately 60% AI-assisted development and agent orchestration, and 40% SQL Server development supporting large-scale data migration. You’ll work within the development team and report to the Software Manager, combining practical AI skills with strong SQL expertise to deliver reliable, efficient solutions. Key Responsibilities AI-Assisted Development & Agent Orchestration (c. 60%) Use AI coding assistants, such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, across the development lifecycle, including code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation and review. Build and maintain effective prompts, system instructions, reusable skills and context to produce consistent, reliable AI outputs. Design and orchestrate agents and multi-agent workflows, including task decomposition, tool use, agent hand-offs and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Connect agents to internal systems, databases and APIs, for example through MCP or function calling. Evaluate AI output for accuracy, regression, cost and latency, and refine workflows based on results. Apply appropriate safeguards for data privacy, security and hallucination risk, particularly when customer or school data is involved. Identify and prototype opportunities to apply AI to development and data migration, and share best practice by supporting and coaching colleagues. SQL Server & Data Migration (c. 40%) Design, develop and maintain scalable SQL Server T-SQL solutions and related tools for data cleansing, migration and reconciliation. Provide database performance-tuning expertise for internal and third-party systems, using AI tooling where appropriate. Define technical requirements with non-technical colleagues in the Data Migration Team, and work with third parties to understand their software and support migration projects. Manage SQL Server database environments used for data migration, including backup and recovery in test environments. Prepare and expose data safely for agents and AI workflows, using AI to support SQL query generation, code review and optimisation. Plan and prioritise work independently, managing tasks against project timelines and requirements. The Ideal Candidate You’ll combine hands-on AI-assisted development skills with substantial SQL Server experience. You’ll be curious and adaptable, communicate clearly, and use good judgement to assess AI-generated output rather than accepting it uncritically. Demonstrable experience using AI coding tools and writing effective prompts, with practical examples of workflows or agents you have built. Substantial SQL programming experience and strong knowledge of the techniques and capabilities of Microsoft SQL Server 2017 or later. A strong grounding in data modelling, data management and data manipulation, alongside Git, version control and attention to detail. The ability to investigate problems independently, collaborate with colleagues and communicate clearly in writing and in person. Essential Skills Practical experience with AI coding assistants and strong prompting skills, supported by examples. Strong SQL Server T-SQL development and performance tuning, including experience supporting SQL Server in a large-scale environment. Experience with Git and version control. Excellent teamwork, communication and documentation skills. Desirable Skills Experience building agents or multi-agent workflows using Claude Code, MCP or similar frameworks. Familiarity with LLM APIs, evaluation approaches and prompt testing. Scripting or programming experience in Python or a similar language. Awareness of AI data protection and security considerations. A reasonable understanding of operating systems, infrastructure and networking.

items.desc: Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases. We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients. We are currently looking for a Scientist to join our dynamic R&D team in our facility in Gent/Zwijnaarde. The candidate should have a high drive to generate qualitative results through hands-on lab work and take scientific ownership of defined discovery projects, coordinating research activities in close collaboration with other members of the project team. This all happens in a dynamic, informal and stimulating environment where you and your colleagues work to reach the set goals and co-develop novel therapeutics to bring to patients. Work description The candidate will be accountable for the scientific progress of one or more defined discovery projects, spanning the discovery, characterization, and optimization of novel therapeutic antibodies, next to conceptual evaluation and experimental derisking of complex and emerging biology. The Scientist will own the experimental workplan, integrate data generated internally and externally, and coordinate activities toward decision-enabling milestones in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. Key responsibilities include: Scientific Leadership & Strategy : Take end-to-end scientific ownership of defined discovery projects by mastering target immunobiology, positioning it within the broader immunology landscape, building and adapting the experimental workplan, and driving project decisions through robust in vitro and in vivo studies in collaboration with internal and external partners. Data Quality & Communication : Ensure the highest standards of data integrity by planning, executing, interpreting, and reporting experiments , while critically reviewing data generated by colleagues, CROs, and collaborators. Integrate the complete data package into clear conclusions, recommendations, and next steps, and communicate key insights , risks, and trade-offs to multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders. Collaborative Problem-Solving & Project Delivery : Proactively engage with colleagues, external experts, and CROs to address scientific challenges , coordinate internal and external activities, maintain project timelines, and advance decision-enabling data packages toward defined milestones and go/no-go decisions . Team Development & Mentorship : Foster a collaborative team environment by organizing work, setting priorities, guiding the scientific quality and reporting of project contributors, and supporting the development of more junior colleagues, with or without formal reporting responsibility . Ambassador for argenx’s Immunology Innovation Program : Contribute to immunology innovation within a defined thematic area by scouting novel disease biology, promising targets, and biological insights that could lay the foundation for the next argenx molecule. Help build validation plans and make science-based recommendations when reviewing new targets and collaborative opportunities with internal and external experts . Profile PhD with a background in immunology, autoimmune/-inflammatory diseases or biological drug discovery is required. Experience in an industrial setting or with regular industry interaction is a plus. Experience with FcRn and FcγR biology as well as Fab, Fc and antibody format engineering is a plus. items.desc: Je baan in een notendop Zet je volgende stap in data-analyse en datamodellering binnen een moderne dataomgeving. Leer on the job van ervaren collega's en bouw expertise op in SQL, DBT, Fabric en Power BI. Maak impact door businessnoden te vertalen naar duidelijke inzichten en kwaliteitsvolle data-oplossingen. Klinkt dat goed? Let's go Wat jij mag verwachten Als Data Analyst help je meebouwen aan ons centrale datamodel en de semantische laag. Je werkt met moderne tools zoals Microsoft Fabric, DBT en Power BI en krijgt de kans om je verder te ontwikkelen in datamodellering en analytics binnen een ervaren team. Je rapporteert aan de Teamlead Resource Pool Data en werkt voornamelijk op de gold layer, waar je businessnoden helpt vertalen naar consistente en gebruiksvriendelijke datamodellen. Zo ziet jouw takenpakket eruit Je werkt mee aan het ontwerpen en onderhouden van businessgerichte datamodellen in DBT. Je ondersteunt de verdere uitbouw van het centrale datamodel (gold layer). Je past bestaande standaarden rond modellering, naming conventions en versioning toe. Je helpt data uit verschillende bronnen integreren tot bruikbare en consistente datasets. Je draagt bij aan de kwaliteit, consistentie en herbruikbaarheid van data. Je werkt nauw samen met data engineers en andere collega's binnen het datalandschap. Je helpt businessvragen vertalen naar KPI's, measures en semantische definities. Je ondersteunt self-service analytics via duidelijke datasets en goede documentatie. Je denkt mee na over optimalisaties binnen het dataplatform. Je deelt actief kennis en bouwt stap voor stap expertise op binnen data-analyse en datamodellering. Wat wij verwachten Must-haves Eerste relevante ervaring in data-analyse, business intelligence of datamodellering Goede kennis van SQL Basiskennis van datamodellering en analytische concepten Ervaring met Power BI of een vergelijkbare BI-tool Sterke analytische vaardigheden Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een samenwerkingsgerichte houding Leergierigheid en interesse in moderne dataplatformen Nice-to-haves Ervaring met DBT Kennis van Microsoft Fabric of een vergelijkbaar dataplatform Basiskennis van dimensionele modellering (facts & dimensions) Kennis van Git Interesse in data governance en datakwaliteit Ervaring in een agile/scrum-omgeving Wij als Baloise Waarom wij een match kunnen zijn? Omdat bij Baloise niet alleen de klant en makelaar centraal staan, maar ook jij als medewerker. Stap mee in ons verhaal en ontdek een bedrijf waar jouw frisse ideeën worden omarmd. We koesteren een menselijke aanpak, waarbij we het leren van fouten aanmoedigen om zo ieders persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. Groei dus samen met ons, want alleen samen kunnen we vooruitgaan. Ook zijn we meer dan een traditionele verzekeringsmaatschappij. In onze zoektocht naar vernieuwing en sociaal engagement gaan we duurzame partnerships aan. Ook beschouwen we digitalisering niet als een uitdaging, maar als een kans om onze dienstverlening nog duurzamer, innovatiever en klantgerichter te maken. Maak jij mee de shift? #togetherweshapebaloise #togetherwegrow #growbeyond Baloise als werkgever Ontdek of we een match zijn! Doe de test. Sustainability Baloise in België Onze voordelen Bij Baloise zetten we sterk in op een menselijke aanpak en vinden we jouw ontwikkeling heel belangrijk. We bieden je tal van opleidingen om jou te ondersteunen in je groei en ambities. Dat doen we niet alleen bij de start maar ook doorheen je verdere carrière. Er is een mogelijkheid om tot 3 dagen van thuis uit te werken. Werk je op kantoor? Dan kun je in ons bedrijfsrestaurant lunchen aan zachte prijsjes, een ‘koffiebreak’ nemen in onze eigen in-house koffiebar en voor je weer naar huis gaat nog een stop maken in de fitness voor je dagelijkse portie sport. Naast een goede work-life balance bieden we je uiteraard ook een aantrekkelijk loonpakket. Zijn wij een potentiële match? Laat dan zeker van je horen! We ontmoeten jou heel graag. Kom bij ons werken: Data Analyst Vragen? Neem op! Sarah Venstermans Staffing Consultant Sarah.Venstermans@baloise.be Sophie De Cae Sophie.DeCae@baloise.be
