items.desc: En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Wavestone recherche actuellement des profils : Dans un monde où savoir se transformer est la clé du succès, l'ambition de Wavestone est d'apporter à ses clients des réponses uniques sur le marché, en les éclairant et les guidant dans leurs décisions les plus stratégiques. Wavestone est un nouveau cabinet de conseil, issu du rapprochement début 2016 de Solucom et des activités européennes de Kurt Salmon (à l'exclusion de consumer goods & retail en dehors de France). Notre cabinet rassemble 2800 collaborateurs présents sur 4 continents, figure parmi les leaders indépendants du conseil en Europe, et constitue le 1er cabinet de conseil indépendant en France. Pour satisfaire nos clients, nous développons 18 terrains d’excellence, à la fois sectoriels, fonctionnels, et technologiques. Sur chacun d’eux, nous nous engageons à apporter à nos clients une profondeur d’expertise de premier plan. Mais surtout, et c’est là le cœur de notre proposition de valeur, nous combinons ces 18 terrains d’excellence sans couture et sans silos. Enfin, pour enrichir notre offre, nous investissons dans 5 assets à forte valeur ajoutée : le Research Knowledge Center, parce que pour prendre de bonnes décisions il faut de bonnes informations, le Creadesk, qui permet de stimuler la créativité et l’innovation, la Faktory, pour prototyper des idées en mode « test and learn », le Machine Learning et Data Lab, pour exploiter les gisements de valeur qui se cachent dans les données de nos clients et Shake Up', pour accompagner des start-ups dans leur croissance et leur développement. Nous recrutons des talents aux parcours diversifiés, de tous niveaux d'expérience. Des personnalités engagées, reconnues pour leur goût d'entreprendre et leur esprit d'équipe. Venez vivre une expérience unique au sein de Wavestone ! \n\n Description de l'entreprise Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques. Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux·ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif. Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain. Description du poste Rejoindre la Business Unit AI, c’est intégrer une équipe de près de 200 consultant·e·s passionné·e·s qui accompagnent les grandes organisations dans la transformation de leurs modèles par la donnée et l’intelligence artificielle. Nous intervenons de bout en bout , de la détection de cas d’usage IA à fort impact métier à la conception de plateformes technologiques de pointe, jusqu’à la définition de modèles de gouvernance responsables et scalables . Nous opérons auprès de clients grands comptes, en France et à l’international , en synergie avec les autres expertises du cabinet pour maximiser l’impact de nos interventions. En tant que Consultant.e Expérimenté.e en data science et IA, vous serez au cœur de l'industrialisation de l'IA dans les grandes organisations : Gestion de projet data science et IA : Participer à des projets de data science , de l’identification des besoins métier à la mise en production des solutions, en passant par le développement d’algorithme. Accompagner les organisations dans la transition de l'IA traditionnelle vers l'agentique Conception et industrialisation de solutions : Concevoir, développer et déployer des modèles de machine learning, deep learning et IA générative pour répondre à des problématiques métiers variées. Contribuer aux échanges avec les équipes techniques du clients (Data Engineer, Architect, ML Engineer, DSI) pour garantir l’intégration de la solution dans le SI Clients Innovation et expertise technique : Réaliser des benchmarks d’algorithmes, frameworks et technologies pour proposer des solutions innovantes. Contribuer à l’exploration de nouveaux cas d’usage en IA (vision par ordinateur, NLP, IA générative, etc.). Qualifications Nous cherchons des candidat.e.s avec une envie d'apprendre et de se challenger dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution. Type de profil : Diplômé.e d’une grande école d’ingénieurs, école de commerce ou université avec spécialisation data / IA. 1 à 3 ans d’expérience en CDI en conseil, data, IA ou environnement technologique …

items.desc: Descriptif et missions La Ville des Ulis (25 000 habitants), au cœur du territoire d'innovation Paris-Saclay, conduit une transformation ambitieuse de son système d'information afin d'offrir des services numériques performants, résilients et sécurisés à ses agents comme à ses administrés. Notre Direction des Systèmes d'Information investit durablement dans ses infrastructures et prépare dès aujourd'hui les usages numériques de demain : cybersécurité, cloud, virtualisation, automatisation et intelligence artificielle. Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Systèmes, Réseaux et Cybersécurité capable d'accompagner cette dynamique et de contribuer activement aux choix techniques qui structureront notre système d'information pour les années à venir. Pourquoi rejoindre notre DSI - Contrairement à de nombreuses organisations, vous n'arrivez pas sur une infrastructure en fin de vie. Vous intégrerez une DSI disposant : d'une infrastructure moderne et performante ; d'une faible dette technique ; d'une politique d'investissement soutenue ; d'une forte autonomie dans les choix technologiques ; d'une équipe impliquée, agile et force de proposition. Ici, votre rôle ne se limitera pas au maintien en condition opérationnelle : vous contribuerez directement à la stratégie technique de la collectivité. Missions / conditions d'exercice Les grands projets qui vous attendent Déployer un véritable Plan de Secours Informatique Participer à la conception et à la mise en œuvre d'un dispositif complet de continuité et de reprise d'activité afin de renforcer la résilience du système d'information. Repenser l'identité numérique de la collectivité Piloter la refonte de l'environnement Microsoft Active Directory / Entra ID afin de moderniser la gestion des identités, renforcer la sécurité et accompagner les nouveaux usages numériques. Introduire les technologies de conteneurisation Accompagner la mise en œuvre des technologies Docker afin de moderniser les méthodes de déploiement applicatif et préparer les futures architectures. Développer une approche cybersécurité "by design" Participer au renforcement continu de la sécurité des infrastructures : sécurisation des infrastructures Microsoft ; évolution des architectures réseau ; amélioration de la supervision ; renforcement de la protection des données ; amélioration de la résilience des services numériques. Participer à l'introduction de l'Intelligence Artificielle La Ville des Ulis souhaite intégrer progressivement les technologies d'IA afin d'améliorer les services rendus aux agents et aux usagers. Vous participerez à la mise en œuvre des infrastructures nécessaires à ces nouveaux usages : recherche documentaire intelligente ; automatisation de tâches ; assistants numériques ; nouveaux services basés sur l'IA. Votre quotidien Vous serez l'un des acteurs majeurs de l'évolution des infrastructures de la collectivité. À ce titre, vous serez amené à : administrer les infrastructures Windows Server et Linux ; faire évoluer les environnements VMware ; administrer Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Active Directory et Entra ID ; administrer les solutions de sauvegarde Veeam ; maintenir les infrastructures réseau, Wi-Fi et téléphonie ; garantir la disponibilité, la performance et la sécurité des systèmes ; piloter ou contribuer aux projets techniques structurants ; assurer une veille technologique permanente ; participer aux choix d'architecture et aux orientations techniques de la DSI ; accompagner les techniciens dans les projets d'évolution. Ces missions s'inscrivent dans les responsabilités définies par la fiche de poste de la collectivité. Profil recherché Le profil que nous recherchons Vous êtes avant tout un ingénieur passionné par les infrastructures et les nouvelles technologies. Vous aimez : concevoir des architectures robustes ; automatiser et industrialiser ; renforcer la cybersécurité ; résoudre des problématiques complexes ; proposer des solutions innovantes ; partager vos connaissances. Vous maîtrisez idéalement plusieurs des technologies suivantes : Windows Server ; Active Directory / Entra ID ; VMware ; Microsoft 365 ; Exchange Online ; Veeam Backup ; Fortinet ; réseaux LAN, WAN et Wi-Fi ; Docker ou les technologies de conteneurisation Powershell avancé Une sensibilité forte aux enjeux de cybersécurité constitue un véritable atout. Ce que nous vous proposons : Un poste à fort impact Vous participerez directement aux décisions techniques et aux projets structurants de la collectivité. Des projets ambitieux Vous interviendrez sur des projets d'infrastructure, de cybersécurité, de continuité d'activité, de cloud Microsoft et d'intelligence artificielle. Une DSI tournée vers l'innovation Les initiatives sont encouragées et les nouvelles idées trouvent rapidement leur place. Un environnement technique stimulant Vous évoluerez dans une infrastructure moderne, où la qualité technique, la sécurité et l'amélioration continue sont des priorités. Un développement professionnel continu La …

Leadership truly cares about maintaining a positive culture and employee well-being. We offer hybrid work options, flexible schedules along with annual bonus and more! Check out how much our employees love working here: https://www.comparably.com/companies/simulations-plus . The Associate Product Specialist (Modeling and Simulation Scientist) will work with internal and external users to understand scientific challenges and improve how modeling and simulation are performed with MonolixSuite. The role contributes across the full product cycle, from understanding user needs and defining new features to testing them before release and sharing applications through demonstrations, training, publications, and other scientific content. This is an excellent opportunity for a scientist with a background in systems biology, mechanistic ODE-based modeling, pharmacometrics, or another quantitative life-science field who wants to apply their scientific skills to a broad range of modeling and simulation problems while developing experience in customer-facing and product-oriented activities. Previous experience in pharmacometrics or with MonolixSuite is welcomed but not required. MonolixSuite is one of the company’s scientific software platforms, dedicated to population pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic modeling and simulation. It helps scientists characterize drug behavior and understand variability between patients. By helping researchers make more informed development decisions, MonolixSuite contributes to the development of safer and more effective medicines. The position requires a minimum of two days on site every two weeks. items.desc: L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Laboratoire Interdisciplinaire des Sciences du Numérique Type de Contrat Chercheur en contrat CDD Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 91190 GIF SUR YVETTE Durée du contrat 6 mois Date d'Embauche 01/02/2027 Rémuneration Entre 3131,32 et 3569,85€ brut mensuel Date limite de candidature : samedi 7 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions Ce projet postdoctoral vise à faire avancer la compréhension de la variation socio-phonétique chez des communautés peu étudiées, ici les micro-travailleurs d’Amérique latine et du Brésil, en développant des méthodes hybrides intégrant des hypothèses linguistiques avec des approches d’apprentissage automatique supervisé et non supervisé. Le projet s’inscrit dans une initiative interdisciplinaire à l’intersection de la linguistique, de la sociologie du travail et des technologies de la parole, avec un accent sur les inégalités dans le travail numérique et leur lien avec les pratiques linguistiques. L’étude exploite un corpus unique d’environ 70 entretiens en espagnol latino-américain avec des micro-travailleurs interrogés par des sociologues dans plusieurs pays, ainsi que 50 enregistrements en portugais brésilien. Ce corpus est richement annoté avec des métadonnées sociodémographiques (sexe, pays, revenu, niveau d’éducation, etc.), ce qui est rare dans les corpus sociolinguistiques traditionnels, où les annotations se limitent généralement à des variables bien étudiées comme la région ou le genre. La multiplicité des variables sociodémographiques offre à la fois une opportunité et un défi : si elle permet des analyses plus approfondies, elle réduit également la taille effective des échantillons pour chaque sous-ensemble de variables, nécessitant des méthodes adaptées aux petits jeux de données. À ces données s’ajoutent des corpus comparables composés de données préexistantes en espagnol et en portugais (par exemple, les corpus sociolinguistiques publics comme PRESEEA (2014-) et les grands corpus disponibles au LISN via des projets antérieurs en technologies de la parole et en linguistique de corpus (Vasilescu et al. 2018, Vasilescu et al. 2020)). L’objectif principal est d’étudier les interactions entre les patrons de variation linguistiques ( de la phonétique acoustique au niveau sémantique) et les profils sociodémographiques, en allant au-delà des méthodes linguistiques quantitatives traditionnelles grâce à l’intégration d’approches d’apprentissage automatique supervisé et non supervisé. Ce projet postdoctoral a pour principaux objectifs : 1. État de l’art de la littérature existante en sociolinguistique et en traitement automatique de la parole/modélisation par apprentissage automatique des variétés hispanophones et lusophones, avec un focus sur la relation entre les variables sociodémographiques et les schémas de variation. 2. Confrontation entre la littérature et les corpus de contrôle (ex : PRESEEA) et les données des micro-travailleurs, en exploitant la richesse des métadonnées pour explorer de nouvelles corrélations et tester des hypothèses linguistiques et sociologiques à l’aide de l’apprentissage automatique. 3. Identifier le niveau de granularité linguistique approprié et les traits les plus informatifs (de la variation segmentale — voyelles et consonnes — à la variation au niveau du vocabulaire) afin de développer des modèles capables d’apprendre des schémas sociolinguistiques interprétables et significatifs. Les modèles formés sur les données des micro-travailleurs seront ensuite évalués par : une validation inter-corpus sociolinguistique (ex : PRESEEA) ; une généralisation plus large entre corpus (ex : Common Voice (Mozilla), VoxCeleb/FLEURS). Cela permettra d’évaluer si les schémas appris à partir des données des micro-travailleurs se généralisent à travers différents locuteurs, régions, profils démographiques, conditions d’enregistrement et conceptions de corpus. 4. Fournir un pipeline reproductible pour l’analyse linguistico-sociodémographique dans des contextes peu dotés en ressources. L'Activité Revue de la littérature sur la variation sociolinguistique et le traitement automatique de la parole/apprentissage automatique appliqués aux variétés hispanophones et lusophones. Prétraitement des données : Travailler avec un corpus composé d’enregistrements transcrits manuellement et de données transcrites automatiquement. Vérifier la qualité des données, en s’assurant de l’alignement correct entre l’audio et les transcriptions. Documenter les phonèmes mal alignés et évaluer leur impact sur les analyses. Enrichissement du jeu de données et analyses : Enrichir le jeu de données pour l’aligner sur les objectifs du projet (ex. : étiquetage en parties du discours (POS), variantes de prononciation). Proposer et mettre en œuvre des méthodes supervisées et non supervisées (ex. : clustering, classification) pour analyser les données. Confrontation des résultats avec la littérature existante. Dans l’aéronautique, le spatial, la défense, l’énergie ou encore l’industrie manufacturière, les entreprises doivent aujourd’hui relever simultanément de nombreux défis : montée en cadence, maîtrise des coûts et des
items.desc: Chez CGI Business Consulting, nous accompagnons les acteurs industriels dans leurs transformations stratégiques et opérationnelles, au plus près de leurs métiers et de leurs enjeux de performance. Dans l’aéronautique, le spatial, la défense, l’énergie ou encore l’industrie manufacturière, les entreprises doivent aujourd’hui relever simultanément de nombreux défis : montée en cadence, maîtrise des coûts et des délais, robustesse de la Supply Chain, amélioration de la qualité, transformation des organisations, décarbonation et accélération des usages de la Data et de l’Intelligence Artificielle. Dans ce contexte, l’Excellence Opérationnelle évolue. Il ne s’agit plus seulement d’optimiser les processus existants, mais de repenser durablement la manière dont les opérations sont conçues, pilotées et exécutées, en combinant expertise métier, performance opérationnelle, technologie, Data et Intelligence Artificielle. Pour accompagner le développement de nos activités auprès des grands acteurs industriels, notamment dans l’écosystème aéronautique, nous renforçons nos équipes Business Consulting à Toulouse. Fonctions et responsabilités Vous accompagnerez les Directions Industrielles, Opérations, Supply Chain, Qualité et Transformation dans leurs programmes d’amélioration de la performance et de transformation. Du diagnostic au déploiement, vous interviendrez sur des enjeux concrets : montée en cadence, optimisation des flux et processus, performance Supply Chain, qualité, Operating Model, digitalisation des opérations et conduite du changement. Dans ce cadre, vous serez amené(e) à : Réaliser des diagnostics de performance et analyser les chaînes de valeur, processus et irritants opérationnels Identifier les causes racines et les leviers de création de valeur Concevoir des processus cibles et des Operating Models Construire et piloter des plans d’amélioration et feuilles de route de transformation Définir les dispositifs de pilotage de la performance et accompagner leur mise en œuvre Animer des démarches d’amélioration continue et de conduite du changement auprès des équipes. L’Intelligence Artificielle ouvre de nouvelles perspectives pour l’Excellence Opérationnelle. Notre ambition n’est pas d’ajouter de l’IA partout, mais d’identifier les situations dans lesquelles elle peut réellement améliorer la performance des opérations. Vous contribuerez à identifier et déployer des usages Data, automatisation et IA apportant une valeur concrète aux opérations : aide à la décision, analyse de la non-qualité, résolution de problèmes, Process Intelligence, capitalisation des connaissances ou encore assistants et copilotes métiers. L’objectif : repenser les processus en combinant expertise humaine, excellence opérationnelle et nouvelles technologies, tout en accompagnant leur adoption par les équipes. Parce qu’une transformation industrielle se construit sur le terrain, vous travaillerez aussi bien avec les Directions qu’avec les équipes Production, Supply Chain, Qualité, Méthodes ou Engineering. Votre capacité à comprendre rapidement un environnement industriel, challenger l’existant et embarquer les équipes fera la différence. En nous rejoignant, vous bénéficiez notamment des avantages suivants : Offre complète de formations : techniques, métiers, développement personnel Qualité de vie au travail : jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine, 27 jours de congés payés, RTT, congés ancienneté et enfant malade, programme santé & bien-être Avantages sociaux : régime d’achats d’actions, participation, PEE, Compte Epargne Temps Et bien d'autres encore ! Qualités requises pour réussir dans ce rôle Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur, de commerce ou d’un Master universitaire, vous disposez d’au moins 4 années d’expérience dont plusieurs en cabinet de conseil et vous maîtrisez l’anglais oral et écrit (B2 -C1). Vous avez contribué à des projets d’amélioration de la performance ou de transformation industrielle et maîtrisez plusieurs approches parmi : Operational Excellence / Lean Management, Manufacturing Excellence, Supply Chain, Qualité, optimisation des processus et des flux, pilotage de la performance ou transformation des organisations. Vous connaissez les méthodes ou référentiels tels que Lean, Six Sigma, APICS, SCOR, BPMN, ISO 9001 ou APQP constitue un atout. Pragmatique, vous combinez capacité d’analyse, goût du terrain et aisance relationnelle. Vous savez travailler avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques, animer des ateliers et embarquer les équipes dans la transformation. Le plus : Une expérience Airbus ou Thalès. Vous êtes ou vous avez : Esprit curieux Autonome Sens du collectif Bonne analyse d’un processus sur le terrain Communication claire pour présenter vos recommandations à une Direction Industrielle. Chez CGI, nous cultivons un environnement de travail respectueux, où chacun peut trouver sa place et développer son potentiel. Nous sommes engagés en faveur d’un recrutement inclusif, fondé sur l’égalité des chances …

This is an excellent opportunity for a scientist with a background in systems biology, mechanistic ODE-based modeling, pharmacometrics, or another quantitative life-science
items.desc: Simulations Plus stands as a global leader in model-informed and AI-accelerated drug development. We create value for our clients by accelerating the discovery, development, and commercialization of pharmaceuticals and other products through innovative science-based software and consulting solutions. Leadership truly cares about maintaining a positive culture and employee well-being. We offer hybrid work options, flexible schedules along with annual bonus and more! Check out how much our employees love working here: https://www.comparably.com/companies/simulations-plus. The Associate Product Specialist (Modeling and Simulation Scientist) will work with internal and external users to understand scientific challenges and improve how modeling and simulation are performed with MonolixSuite. The role contributes across the full product cycle, from understanding user needs and defining new features to testing them before release and sharing applications through demonstrations, training, publications, and other scientific content. This is an excellent opportunity for a scientist with a background in systems biology, mechanistic ODE-based modeling, pharmacometrics, or another quantitative life-science field who wants to apply their scientific skills to a broad range of modeling and simulation problems while developing experience in customer-facing and product-oriented activities. Previous experience in pharmacometrics or with MonolixSuite is welcomed but not required. MonolixSuite is one of the company’s scientific software platforms, dedicated to population pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic modeling and simulation. It helps scientists characterize drug behavior and understand variability between patients. By helping researchers make more informed development decisions, MonolixSuite contributes to the development of safer and more effective medicines. The position requires a minimum of two days on site every two weeks. Department: Product and Technology Internal Grade: 10 Direct Reports: No Status: Exempt Location: Hybrid from Antony, France Office Contract Type: CDI Job Responsibilities: Scientific Modeling and Problem Solving Help scientists address a wide range of modeling and simulation questions Investigate scientific and methodological questions arising from real-world applications Develop examples, case studies, and tutorials illustrating good modeling practices Contribute to scientific publications, webinars, and other technical content Scientific Software and Product Development Work with users to understand their scientific needs and identify opportunities for improvement Translate user needs and scientific challenges into specifications for new software features Test new functionalities using realistic scientific examples before release Contribute to the development of AI-enabled workflows Teaching and Scientific Communication Explain modeling concepts and software workflows to scientists with different levels of experience through demonstrations, webinars, workshops, and training sessions Develop clear training, demonstration, and documentation materials Present and discuss MonolixSuite applications at pharmacometrics conferences Required Qualifications: Strong quantitative and scientific reasoning skills Experience with mechanistic or ODE-based modeling in the life sciences Ability to understand and analyze complex scientific problems Comfortable explaining and presenting scientific material to different audiences. Interest in scientific software development Collaborative mindset and interest in working with scientists, software developers, and users Excellent written and oral communication skills in English French speaking or willingness to learn Preferred Qualifications: MonolixSuite, NONMEM, Phoenix WinNonlin, or other modeling and simulation software Scientific programming or data analysis using R, Python, MATLAB, or similar tools Develop AI agents, including tool integration, MCP, or scientific knowledge bases Write scientific publications, case studies, or tutorial Experience teaching, training, or presenting scientific work Education: Masters or PhD in pharmacometrics, PK/PD modeling, biostatistics, computational biology, or a related field preferred Relevant experience in systems biology, computational biology with mechanistic ODE-based modeling, pharmacometrics, PK/PD modeling, biostatistics, or a closely related quantitative field Come join the happiest employees in the industry by visiting www.simulations-plus.com/career-center and apply today!

Vos missions Au sein d'équipes spécialisées en cybersécurité, vous serez notamment amené(e) à : Gouvernance et sécurité de l'IA Accompagner les clients dans la définition de stratégies de gouvernance et de sécurisation des systèmes d'intelligence artificielle. Vous maîtrisez notamment : La gouvernance de la sécurité des systèmes d'information (GRC). L'analyse et la gestion des risques cyber. Les audits de sécurité et les démarches de conformité. Les référentiels de sécurité, notamment ISO 27001. La communication et le conseil auprès d'interlocuteurs techniques et décisionnaires. Les compétences suivantes constituent de véritables atouts : Connaissances en sécurité de l'intelligence artificielle, IA générative ou LLM. Maîtrise des référentiels AI Act, ISO 42001, NIS2 et RGPD. Expérience des environnements cloud AWS, Azure ou GCP. Connaissance des méthodologies EBIOS RM, ISO 27005 ou du threat modeling. Expérience en cabinet de conseil ou en ESN. Autonome, rigoureux(se) et doté(e) d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de communication, vous appréciez les environnements techniques exigeants et les missions de conseil à forte valeur ajoutée.

items.desc: The group you’ll be a part of The Customer Support Business Group focuses on enabling our customers with premier customer support throughout their lifecycle with Lam. We drive performance, productivity, safety, and quality of customers installed base performance and deliver service and lifecycle solutions for their most critical equipment and processes. The impact you’ll make As a Field Service Engineer (Software & Automation) at Lam, you will step into the limelight of customer support and y ou will work at the intersection of software, automation, data analytics, AI, and field service operations. You will develop digital solutions that enable faster troubleshooting, automate workflows, enhance operational visibility, and transform data into actionable insights. From diagnostics and business intelligence dashboards to predictive support tools, you will help shape the next generation of intelligent service capabilities, driving customer success and operational excellence. In this role, you will directly support our local customer, ESMC Dresden , contributing to the performance and reliability of their advanced semiconductor manufacturing operations. What you’ll do Install, maintain, and upgrade semiconductor manufacturing equipment at customer sites. Troubleshooting and resolving complex software, hardware, networking, and systems issues using structured diagnostic and root-cause analysis techniques. Perform corrective and preventive maintenance to maximize equipment uptime and performance. Diagnose and resolve equipment issues involving mechanical, electrical, software, robotics, vacuum, and process systems. Execute system calibrations, qualification activities, and hardware or software upgrades. Using remote diagnostics, monitoring tools, data analytics, and AI-powered technologies to quickly identify and solve problems. Support equipment startup, acceptance testing, and production ramp activities. Working closely with Engineering, Field Service, Automation, IT, and Customer teams to improve reliability, productivity, and operational performance. Driving continuous improvement through automation, digitalization, predictive diagnostics, and knowledge-sharing initiatives, utilizing Microsoft Power Platform tools, including Power BI, Power Automate, and Power Apps, to create automated workflows and business solutions. Ensure compliance with cleanroom protocols, safety regulations, and customer requirements. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and digital solutions that improve operational visibility and service effectiveness. Serve as a trusted technical advisor, providing professional customer-facing support and effective communication across diverse teams and cultures. Who we’re looking for Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s/ Master degree in Automation, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience in Field Service, Semiconductor Equipment, Industrial Automation, Electronics, or a similar technical environment. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills. Ability to work on complex electromechanical systems in a cleanroom environment. Knowledge of computer systems and equipment software used for diagnostics and troubleshooting. items.desc: Our mission: Are you an information security professional who wants to make a real impact across a decentralized organization? You'll drive the development of our ISMS, ensure compliance with ISO 27001, and work closely with teams to turn security requirements into practical, sustainable solutions. At Open-Xchange (OX), we develop open-source communication and collaboration software used by public sector organizations, telcos, and hosting providers to keep data secure and under their control. Our products cover email, collaboration, DNS security, and related services, and are used by millions of people worldwide. Discover what OX offers you: We work in a non-hierarchical organization that empowers everyone to take responsibility, stay focused, and contribute directly to the company’s success and customer value. We value expertise and continuous professional development. Our professionals work closely with experienced colleagues, take ownership of their work, and continuously expand their skills. Openness and diversity are core to OX. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and ways of thinking strengthen our collaboration and help us see the bigger picture. Your team: Working closely with Engineering, Cloud Operations, and IT Architecture, you'll help embed information security as an integral part of our products and processes. You'll create transparency around technical and organizational security measures, continuously develop our Information Security Management System (ISMS), and advise our Management Board on relevant information security matters. In doing so, you'll help ensure that security is actively considered and effectively implemented across all areas of OX. Your new job: Run the ISMS and ISO 27001 Coordinate the identification and documentation of technical and organizational security measures across the OX Group, working with the responsible cells to keep documentation consistent, up to date, and traceable. Drive the continuous development of our ISMS by establishing sustainable governance structures, clear responsibilities, and aligned security processes and policies across the OX Group, ensuring their consistent application within our decentralized organization. Plan, coordinate, and support internal and external ISO 27001 audits as well as risk-based supplier assessments and audits. Coordinate the resolution of audit findings and track the implementation of agreed measures together with the responsible cells. Make security work in a decentralized organization Harmonize security requirements and processes across different software landscapes, taking varying levels of maturity and risk profiles into account. Support operational cells with clear guidance, practical templates, and targeted advice, while operational ownership remains with the respective cells. Support product cells in identifying and assessing information security risks, document the assessment results within the ISMS, and recommend appropriate measures and risk-based priorities in close coordination with the relevant risk owners. Embed Security by Design across our product portfolio, working closely with DevSecOps and product cells to define security requirements and risk-based priorities early in the development process, including through joint information security sprints. Implementation and operation of security tooling remain with the responsible technical cells. Handle regulation and customers Coordinate the assessment of relevant requirements arising from NIS2 and the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) with the responsible functions and translate them into aligned security, evidence, and reporting processes, including clear responsibilities for operational implementation. Capture and negotiate customer information security requirements and align them with the relevant product cells and business functions. Your background: A degree in Computer Science, Business Information Systems, IT Security, or a comparable qualification, such as several years of relevant professional experience in information security, IT risk management, or IT compliance. Practical experience in establishing, implementing, and certifying an Information Security Management System (ISMS) in accordance with ISO 27001. Knowledge of the German BSI IT-Grundschutz framework is a plus. Experience assessing regulatory security requirements and translating them into practical technical and organizational requirements. Knowledge of NIS2 and the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) is an advantage. Ideally, experience introducing or further developing cross-functional security processes in decentralized organizations with varying levels of technical and organizational maturity, combined with openness to working in an environment without traditional hierarchical structures. A solid understanding of software and cloud architectures, secure software development, and technical security measures, as well as experience working with engineering, architecture, and operations cells. items.desc: Your mission We help SME's get paid with the same certainty as large corporates. Our Business Operations & Collections team plays a key part in keeping that promise, and you’ll be part of it. You make sure invoices are paid on time, and when they aren’t, you find a fair solution. You’re also a first point of contact for our merchants and their customers. Every business you call is our customer’s customer, so how you communicate matters as much as what you collect. We’re looking for someone who wants to become an excellent collector: firm on outcomes, fair with people, and service-minded at heart. You’ll learn the full receivable lifecycle, from approval through payment to dunning, and through dunning when a payment doesn’t come in. What you will do Be the first point of contact for merchants and debtors by phone, email and ticket, and resolve their questions quickly and reliably Call overdue debtors, find out why payments are late, and agree realistic payment dates or instalment plans Follow up on agreements and move cases through our dunning process when they slip Reconcile incoming payments daily and resolve disputes and invoice corrections with merchants Approve receivables within defined guardrails and escalate edge cases to the risk team Use AI tools to work faster: summarising cases, preparing calls, drafting messages Over time, take on complex cases and prepare handovers to our collection partners and lawyers Your profile First professional experience in customer service, collections, accounts receivable or accounting. A commercial apprenticeship or a business degree is a good starting point too. You’re ambitious and enjoy being measured on clear results, such as collected amounts and resolved cases. Your German is excellent (C1 or higher), spoken and written. You build trust quickly on the phone and get complex topics across clearly. You stay friendly and firm in tense conversations, and you know when to be flexible and when to hold the line. You enjoy helping people, and you want every merchant and debtor to end the conversation with a clear next step. You work in a structured, detail-oriented way and are comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets. AI tools are already part of how you work, and you know where they save time and where they need a human check. Your English is at B2 level or higher, for working in our international team and handling international debtors. Bonus Points Experience with dunning (Mahnwesen), Inkasso or the court dunning procedure (gerichtliches Mahnverfahren) A background in factoring, B2B lending or trade credit Why us? We expect nothing less than changing the way mid-sized B2B companies get paid. This is an invitation to an exciting journey, with complex challenges, hard work and the support you need to succeed with us as a team. Real responsibility from day one in a small, fast-moving team 28 days of holiday per year (based on a 5-day working week) Hands-on training from an experienced collections lead A clear path to Senior Collections Specialist Steep growth opportunities in a rising fintech €40 monthly benefits budget via Spendit Regular company offsites Berlin office with our own barista Dedicated personal development budget Referral bonus for bringing in new colleagues Tilta swag About us Tilta was founded in Berlin in 2022 by experienced fintech entrepreneurs. Our growing team of industry experts shares one mission: to modernise how B2B companies get paid. We provide AI-based receivables management for mid-sized companies. Our platform combines risk assessment, customer communication, financing, payment and collections in one service. This gives our clients maximun flexibilty and control over their cash flow. Tilta is an equal-opportunity employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to create a culture in which all individuals can reach their full potential regardless of their differences so that our team can thrive together through collaboration and mutual respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities without discrimination based on race, color, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion age disability marital status, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by the applicable law.

Build automation that eliminates manual work and makes operations safer and faster. Improve observability through meaningful metrics, dashboards, logging, and alerting. Investigate production incidents and complex customer escalations, perform root cause analysis, and turn learnings into long-term reliability improvements. Partner with Software Engineers to design systems that are reliable by default. Continuously improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows. Participate in the on-call rotation while helping make it quieter every week. Optimize performance, scalability, and operational efficiency across our infrastructure. Contribute to operational best practices, documentation, and a healthy engineering culture. ‍ What you’ll need 3+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or similar roles. Strong Linux administration skills and a solid understanding of production environments. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads. Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Pulumi preferred). Good understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, load balancing). Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK/OpenSearch, or similar. Scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar languages. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices. Confidence troubleshooting production systems under pressure. Professional proficiency in English. ‍ Bonus point You'll stand out if you have experience with: Technical Support (L2/L3), Technical Operations, or customer-facing infrastructure support. Managing complex production incidents and technical escalations. Distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or S3-compatible object storage. GitOps practices and tools such as ArgoCD or Flux. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Security best practices, infrastructure hardening, or open-source contribution. ‍ Profile and mindset We're looking for someone who: Thinks in systems, not just servers. Automates first and hates doing the same thing twice. Takes ownership and follows problems through to the root cause: not just the quick fix. Thrives in collaborative environments where engineering and operations work as one team. Enjoys working in a fast-paced scale-up environment, where priorities evolve, ownership is expected, and everyone contributes beyond their role. Stays calm when production gets noisy and enjoys solving problems that matter. Is curious, eager to learn, and continuously looking for ways to improve. Balances pragmatism with engineering excellence: you know when "good enough" is actually the best solution. Believes that reliability is a feature, not an afterthought. ‍ Why you’ll love working with us Join an ambitious and supportive team of builders and innovators Remote-friendly environment with flexible schedules Opportunity to contribute to one of Europe’s most advanced cloud technologies ‍ Location Full remote work is welcome in Cubbit, and you can freely use the lounge area in one of our co-working partner offices worldwide. Brave yourself for progress, samen maken we groei echt menselijk. Van uitdaging naar oplossing Je werkt aan data platform trajecten bij klanten en helpt hen om hun dataomgeving naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je ontwerpt en bouwt moderne data platformen in Azure Je ontwikkelt en optimaliseert data pipelines en datastromen Je vertaalt businesslogica naar schaalbare datamodellen en transformaties Je integreert verschillende databronnen (o.a. via API’s) Je zorgt voor een vlotte en betrouwbare deployment naar productie Je werkt nauw samen met stakeholders zoals data-analisten, data scientists en business teams Je denkt actief mee over performantie, structuur en toekomstbestendigheid Wat jij kan, maakt het verschil Je hebt een bachelor of master· Je beschikt over minstens 2 jaar ervaring in data engineering of data platform projecten Je hebt ervaring met SQL en ETL-processen Je hebt kennis van cloud (bij voorkeur Azure, maar ook AWS, GCP of Snowflake is relevant) Je hebt ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python, Scala, Java of C# Je bent vertrouwd met datamodellering en concepten zoals data lakehouse Je werkt graag in een agile / DevOps omgeving Je communiceert vlot en schakelt goed met verschillende stakeholders Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands Investeren in jou, investeren in groei Bij Alistar draait alles om vooruitgang, ook voor jou. We willen dat je groeit, je goed voelt en trots bent op wat je doet. Daarom zorgen we voor voordelen die echt iets betekenen: Verhaal van Alistar Vooruitgang zit in ons DNA. Wat in 1999 begon als een klein IT-bedrijf, groeide uit tot een dynamische internationale organisatie met één ambitieus doel: bedrijven slimmer laten werken door mensen, data en technologie met elkaar te verbinden. Door de jaren heen zijn we gegroeid, kwamen er nieuwe bedrijven bij en evolueerde de technologie razendsnel. Maar één iets bleef altijd hetzelfde: ons DNA. We zijn nieuwsgierige doeners. Challengers. Dromers die het ook écht waarmaken. Voor ons is technologie geen buzzword, maar een hefboom voor vooruitgang bij onze klanten, binnen onze teams en in onze eigen werking. We denken tech, maar spreken human. Vandaag bouwen we als één Alistar verder aan onze ambitie: uitgroeien tot een toonaangevende, klantgedreven IT-solutions advisor in West-Europa. Dat doen we door talent en expertise te bundelen binnen onze Business Units, volop te investeren in kennis, AI en innovatie, en door onze organisatie zo te structureren dat kleine teams grootse resultaten kunnen realiseren.

items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Oslo Søknadsfrist 8.11.2026 Sektor Privat Bli med som vår nye Senior Quality Assurance Engineer Hos Stingray utvikler vi undervannsroboter som overvåker og forbedrer fiskevelferden i oppdrettsanlegg ved hjelp av sensorer, kameraer, maskinsyn og laser. For å støtte alt fra produksjon og logistikk til service og økonomi utvikler vi også våre egne interne systemer. Nå ser vi etter en Senior Quality Assurance Engineer som vil være med på å sikre kvaliteten i vårt ERP-system. Dette er en sentral rolle for deg som motiveres av kvalitet og forutsigbarhet i systemer som brukes hver eneste dag av kolleger på tvers av Stingray. Arbeidsoppgaver – hva skal du gjøre? Som QA Engineer vil du ha en sentral rolle i arbeidet med å sikre kvaliteten i ERP-systemet og bidra til at det fungerer godt for brukerne som er avhengige av det i sitt daglige arbeid. Rollen kombinerer praktisk testing med ansvar for teststrategi, arbeidsmetoder og kontinuerlig forbedring. Du vil jobbe tett med utviklere, produkteiere og brukere for å sikre at nye funksjoner og forbedringer holder høy kvalitet før de tas i bruk. Du vil blant annet: Utarbeide og videreutvikle teststrategier, testplaner og QA-prosesser Gjennomføre funksjonell og ikke-funksjonell testing av nye funksjoner og endringer Utvikle og vedlikeholde testdokumentasjon, testscenarier og testcases Følge opp feil, avvik og kvalitetsmålinger gjennom utviklingsløpet Bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring av arbeidsmetoder og beste praksis innen kvalitetssikring Hvem ser vi etter? Vi ser etter deg som har høyere utdanning innen informatikk, programvareutvikling, informasjonsteknologi eller tilsvarende, og som har solid erfaring med kvalitetssikring av programvare. Du har gjennom flere år hatt en sentral rolle i testing og kvalitetssikring av komplekse systemer, og er komfortabel med å ta ansvar for både teststrategi, testgjennomføring og videreutvikling av arbeidsmetoder. For å lykkes i rollen er det et krav at du har erfaring med testing av ERP- eller CRM-systemer. Du vil jobbe med kvalitetssikring av et ERP-system som brukes på tvers av Stingray, og erfaring fra tilsvarende systemer er derfor nødvendig. Du trives med å kombinere detaljfokus med et helhetlig ansvar for kvalitet, og motiveres av å jobbe tett med utviklere, produkteiere og brukere for å sikre stabile og pålitelige løsninger. Rollen passer for deg som liker å etablere struktur, forbedre prosesser og bidra til en sterk kvalitetskultur i teamet. For å lykkes i rollen tror vi også at du har: Erfaring med testing av web- og mobilapplikasjoner Erfaring med API-testing, for eksempel ved bruk av Postman Erfaring med testdokumentasjon og testdesign God forståelse for Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) Erfaring med Git eller tilsvarende versjonskontrollsystemer Vi tror også at du er analytisk og kvalitetsbevisst. Du kommuniserer godt med både utviklere og brukere, samarbeider godt med andre og tar eierskap til kvaliteten i løsningene som leveres. Rollen krever gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk. Hva tilbyr vi? Hos Stingray får du en nøkkelrolle i utviklingen av et system som brukes hver eneste dag på tvers av selskapet. Du får muligheten til å påvirke både kvalitet, arbeidsmetoder og hvordan vi jobber med testing fremover. Du blir en del av et kompetent utviklingsmiljø med korte beslutningsveier, høy faglig kvalitet og stor grad av tillit. Her får du jobbe tett på både teknologi og brukere, og se hvordan arbeidet ditt bidrar til stabile løsninger og en mer effektiv hverdag for kollegene dine. Arbeidsmiljøet preges av samarbeid, høy kompetanse og kontinuerlig utvikling. Vi gir våre ansatte tillit, ansvar og mulighet til å påvirke både teknologi, arbeidsmetoder og produkter. Vi legger også stor vekt på det sosiale, med samlinger, arrangementer, turer, kantineordning og treningsmuligheter, inkludert eget treningsrom. Team Stingray har sitt utspring under overflaten, der menneskene, lidenskapen og ulikhetene knytter oss sammen. StingrayPodden er et resultat av de mange historiene som fortjener en arena hvor humor, energi og engasjement kommer opp fra dypet. Følg podkasten vår på Spotify! Er du vår nye Senior Quality Assurance Engineer? Da oppfordrer vi deg til å søke. Kom som du er til Team Stingray - vi ser frem til å høre fra deg! Last opp CV og svar på noen korte spørsmål. Ingen søknadstekst nødvendig. For spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte Mads Rismoen (Recruiter) på tlf. +47 902 33 917. Ready to get started? Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs. About Sanofi: We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Main responsibilities: Engage healthcare professionals and institutions proactively and reactively with accurate, balanced scientific information. Organize and run scientific meetings, webinars, and discussions with key opinion leaders and healthcare professionals. Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships through scientific exchange in a fast-changing healthcare environment. Communicate the clinical value of our therapeutic area products within the regulatory and ethical framework. Respond to unsolicited medical questions and support investigator-initiated research and local advisory boards. Develop and deliver individual stakeholder engagement plans aligned with the medical strategy. Report adverse events and product quality complaints promptly, in line with local procedures. About you Degree in a scientific discipline. Experience in stakeholder strategy, planning, and engagement. Disease and therapeutic area knowledge in rhinology and/or gastroenterology. Strong impactful scientific communication skills, across multiple channels and formats. Fluent in Polish and English, spoken and written. Strategic thinking, business acumen, and strong interpersonal and collaboration skills. Experience using CRM tools is an asset. Why choose us? Be part of a pioneering biopharma company where patient insights shape how we develop and deliver treatments. Work at the forefront of AI-powered science that accelerates discovery and improves patient outcomes. Collaborate beyond your expertise with diverse, multidisciplinary teams across medical, scientific, and commercial functions. Explore bold career paths, with opportunities to grow through scientific, leadership, and cross-functional moves. Make a real difference in the rhinology and gastroenterology community, helping bring meaningful care to patients with high unmet needs. Enjoy a supportive, flexible work environment with comprehensive healthcare, well-being programs, and access to learning and development. Pursue Progress . Discover Extraordinary . Join Sanofi and step into a new era of science - where your growth can be just as transformative as the work we do. We invest in you to reach further, think faster, and do what's never-been-done-before. You'll help push boundaries, challenge convention, and build smarter solutions that reach the communities we serve. Ready to chase the miracles of science and improve people's lives? Let's Pursue Progress and Discover Extraordinary – together. items.desc: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your role Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization. Experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely. In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data. What you will do Maintain Performance •Prevent decay and find efficiencies: Monitor the architecture and identify opportunities to optimize code to maintain and enhance mainframe performance. Debug and Test •Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission-critical applications running. Develop for the Future •Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud-based services. Who You Are Required skills and experience •Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects. •Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills. •Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software. •Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services. •Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues. •Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns. Preferred skills and experience •Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. •Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl. •Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

items.desc: Vi på Riksbanken befinner oss i en omfattande förändringsresa inom IT-utveckling, Data-, AI-, Integration och säkerhet. Nu söker vi en Platform Engineer som vill forma framtidens data- och AI-förmåga. Vår moderna Data- och AI-plattform ger analytiker och ekonomer verktygen att fatta datadrivna beslut, arbeta smartare och utforska vad AI kan göra för verksamheten. Din uppgift är att göra plattformen ännu enklare, stabilare och säkrare att använda. Välkommen till en spännande miljö där du med din kompetens bidrar till samhällsutvecklingen. DET HÄR GÖR DU HOS OSS Som en del av plattformsteamen inom data och AI kommer du vara med och driva utveckling och underhåll av Riksbankens egenutvecklade plattformar. Vår teknik-stack är modern med Kubernetes, S3-baserad objektlagring, Python, och AI-hjälpmedel som viktiga komponenter. Plattformarna är primärt on prem i våra serverhallar men möjlighet erbjuds att även arbeta med Azures moln för valda komponenter. Det pågår många initiativ och satsningar, bland annat en Kubernetesmigrering och en uppskalning av arkitekturen med en query engine för frågor direkt mot datasjön. Här är du med och påverkar riktningen. Rollen handlar dock om mer än teknik. En viktig del av uppdraget är att aktivt driva användning och adoption av plattformen genom nära dialog med verksamheten och de huvudsakliga användarna. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: Underhålla och vidareutveckla plattformens tjänster och komponenter. Automatisera bygg-, test-, leverans- och driftsflöden. Utveckla och förvalta containeriserade applikationer och tjänster. Integrera plattformens olika komponenter med datakällor och stödsystem. Felsökning, problemlösning och förbättring av plattformens stabilitet, prestanda och användbarhet. Samarbeta nära användare och datateam och omsätta deras behov i tekniska lösningar. Påverka tekniska vägval, design och den fortsatta utvecklingen av utvecklingsmiljön. DITT TEAM Både Data- och AI plattformsteamen är agila team som ingår i tvärfunktionella verksamhetsområden som Data & Statistik och AI-Huben. Du samarbetar med flera olika datateam på verksamhetssidan, produktledningar och andra möjliggörande team, till exempel DevSecOps, Integration och IT-infrastruktur. Även med arkitekter, infrastrukturspecialister och säkerhetsexperter i en miljö som värdesätter teknisk excellens och kunskapsdelning. Plattformsteamen tillhör Avdelningen för IT- och Digitalisering samt är en del av enheten IT-utveckling och Dataplattform, som förutom gemensamma applikationsplattformar, även ansvarar för egenutvecklade verksamhetsapplikationer. MER OM DIG Skallkrav : För att vara framgångsrik i rollen behöver du vara förtroendeingivande och bra på att bygga relationer. Du hanterar många kontaktytor och har användarnas behov i fokus. Samarbete och kommunikation är centrala delar av rollen. Du vet att stabil drift och effektiv förvaltning är grunden för allt. Du är strukturerad, tar ansvar och är van vid att driva frågor från idé till implementation. Vidare har du en relevant högskoleutbildning inom exempelvis datavetenskap, systemvetenskap, eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Du har även flerårig arbetslivserfarenhet av: Programmering i modernt språk (Python, Go, JavaScript osv) Utveckling av CI/CD-pipelines (Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions) Containeriserade applikationer (Docker eller Podman) Utveckling i Linux-miljöer Arbete enligt DevOps-modellen, you build it, you run it Goda kunskaper i både engelska och svenska är krav för tjänsten. Meriterande är erfarenhet av: Orkestrering av dataflöden (Dagster, Prefect, Airflow eller liknande) Kubernetes (ArgoCD, Helm, Kustomize) Datamodellering och dataintegrationer, gärna med R och SQL Data lake- och lakehouse-lösningar (S3, Parquet, Iceberg, Delta Lake) Produktionssättning i Linux-servermiljöer och Bash-skriptning Nätverk och nätverksrelaterad felsökning Förståelse och erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt MER OM TJÄNSTEN Tillträde: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelse Anställningstyp: Tillsvidareanställning, provanställning kan komma att tillämpas Placering: Kontor i centrala Stockholm Arbetstid: Förtroendearbetstid Möjlighet att jobba distans: 1 eller 2 dagar i veckan Förmåner: Bland annat generösa semestervillkor, löneväxling till pension, friskvårdsbidrag och tillgång till träningsmöjligheter. Tjänsten kan komma att placeras i säkerhetsklass och en säkerhetsprövning innefattande registerkontroll, säkerhetsprövningssamtal och särskild personutredning görs då för slutkandidaten. För vissa tjänster ställs krav på svenskt medborgarskap. ANSÖK I denna rekrytering samarbetar Riksbanken med rekryteringsföretaget Computer Sweden Recruitment. Deras rekryterare gör ett första urval i samråd med rekryterande chef samt utför intervjuer. De kandidater som går vidare träffar sedan rekryterande chef. Vid frågor är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Alexandra Tihinen, ansvarig rekryteringskonsult, på 070-447 92 24 eller …

items.desc: Vill du vara med och bygga framtidens datadrivna lösningar? Datamängder växer snabbt och kraven på hur organisationer hanterar, strukturerar och nyttjar data ökar i samma takt. Samtidigt förändrar AI hur vi bygger system, men det ställer också högre krav på kvalitet, struktur och förståelse. Därför söker vi nu en Data Engineer som vill arbeta med moderna dataplattformar och skapa lösningar med verkligt affärsvärde. Hos bolaget får du möjlighet att arbeta i en miljö där tekniskt hantverk, datakvalitet och långsiktighet står i fokus. Du blir en del av ett team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig utveckling är centrala delar av kulturen, samtidigt som du arbetar nära kund och bidrar till affärskritiska lösningar. OM FÖRETAGET Vår kund är ett modernt konsultbolag inom tech med fokus på att utveckla hållbara, skalbara och affärskritiska system. Genom att kombinera djup teknisk kompetens med förståelse för kundens verksamhet skapas lösningar som håller över tid. Bolaget arbetar med att designa och utveckla robusta dataplattformar, pipelines och arkitekturer som hjälper organisationer att omvandla data till insikter och affärsvärde. Arbetet sker i moderna datamiljöer med fokus på skalbarhet, säkerhet och långsiktig förvaltning. Teknikstacken omfattar bland annat Python, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Apache Spark och dbt, samt molnbaserade plattformar och AI-stödda arbetsflöden. Organisationen är grundad av erfarna entreprenörer och tekniska ledare, vilket ger en stabil grund samtidigt som det finns stort utrymme att påverka och utveckla verksamheten framåt. Kulturen präglas av samarbete, nyfikenhet och respekt. Här uppmuntras lärande och utveckling, och man tror på att starka team bygger starka system. OM ROLLEN Som Data Engineer arbetar du med att designa, bygga och vidareutveckla dataplattformar och pipelines hos bolagets kunder. Rollen innebär ett helhetsansvar där du arbetar nära både teknik och affär. items.desc: Vill du arbeta med systemutveckling i ett mindre team där ni jobbar nära varandra, lär av varandra och utforskar nya sätt att arbeta? Nu söker vi en systemutvecklare till ett av våra team i Åre, där vi arbetar med utveckling och vidareutveckling av flera av CGIs egna produkter och tjänster. Vi är idag sex personer i teamet och vill nu bli en till. Vi har ett AI-drivet arbetssätt med fokus på att utveckla mjukvara av hög kvalitet. Vi söker dig som är nyfiken på hur AI förändrar systemutvecklingen och vill vara med på den utvecklingen. Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter Hos oss arbetar du med systemutveckling i ett team där samarbete, problemlösning och kunskapsdelning är en naturlig del av vardagen. Vi arbetar långsiktigt med våra leveranser och vidareutvecklar våra lösningar över tid. I rollen jobbar du med: Att utveckla system och lösningar från idé till färdig, kvalitetssäkrad leverans Att lösa problem och vidareutveckla våra lösningar över tid Att bidra med idéer och förbättringar i teamets gemensamma utvecklingsarbete Vi arbetar gärna tillsammans på plats på kontoret i Åre, med möjlighet till flexibilitet när det behövs. Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll Vi söker dig som gärna har några års arbetslivserfarenhet inom systemutveckling. Du har kanske en IT-inriktad utbildning, men kan också ha byggt upp din kompetens på annat sätt. För oss är det viktigt att du är trygg i dig själv, tycker om att samarbeta och är öppen för att lära dig nytt. Du är nyfiken på nya lösningar och hur AI förändrar utvecklarrollen. Vi uppskattar att du tar initiativ, testar idéer och vill bidra till att utveckla våra arbetssätt. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av eller kunskap inom: Ett eller flera programmeringsspråk Backendutveckling Azure DevOps eller liknande verktyg för CI/CD, automatiserade tester och kvalitetssäkring Containerbaserade lösningar, exempelvis Kubernetes Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. Det viktiga är att du vill omsätta idéer i praktiken och bidra till teamets gemensamma utveckling. Vad kan vi på CGI erbjuda dig? På vårt kontor i Åre Sportcenter får du det lilla teamets gemenskap samtidigt som du är en del av CGI Östersund och CGI som helhet. Vi tycker att det ska vara roligt att gå till jobbet och hittar gärna på aktiviteter tillsammans, både lokalt i Åre och med våra kollegor i Östersund. Hos oss får du arbeta med långsiktig utveckling och modern teknik i en miljö där vi hjälper varandra. Vi värdesätter en vardag med utrymme för både gemenskap, lärande och balans. Som en del av CGI får du också konkurrenskraftiga villkor, ägarskapsprogram, goda karriärmöjligheter och flexibilitet i vardagen. Vill du veta mer? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Ansökningarna kommer hanteras löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Om du har några frågor så skicka dom till martina.kanngard@cgi.com Övrigt Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning. #LI-MB14 Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans. Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential. Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning. Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis. Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer. Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

items.desc: Due to internal promotion, we are now looking for a Medical Advisor to join our team! Bring your scientific expertise to a role where your insights, relationships, and ideas can help shape oncology care in Sweden. As a trusted scientific partner to healthcare professionals, you will focus on solid tumours, particularly gynaecological oncology, with the potential to expand into other tumour areas as our pipeline evolves. You will connect emerging evidence with clinical needs, turn insights into medical strategy, and collaborate with internal teams and external experts to advance patient care. If you are curious, collaborative, and motivated to make a meaningful impact, this is an opportunity to grow your expertise while uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together. We create a place where people can grow, be their best, be safe, and feel welcome, valued and included. Discover more about our company wide benefits and life at GSK on our webpage Life at GSK | GSK In this role you will Build and strengthen trusted, peer-to-peer scientific relationships with oncology healthcare professionals and key stakeholders in solid tumours, with a particular focus on gynaecological oncology. Lead balanced, evidence-based scientific exchange, translating complex and emerging data into clear discussions that support informed clinical decisions and patient care. Identify unmet clinical needs, gather and document actionable insights, and translate them into recommendations for medical strategy. Contribute to clinical development by identifying and qualifying potential investigators and clinical sites. Represent GSK at scientific meetings, congresses, and expert forums, fostering scientific dialogue and bringing relevant knowledge back to the organisation. Partner with cross-functional colleagues on approved scientific education, medical projects and initiatives that address clinical needs. Why you? Basic Qualifications & Skills: We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals: Advanced degree in medicine, pharmacy, life sciences or a related field, such as MD, PhD, PharmD or equivalent. Pharmaceutical-industry experience in Medical Affairs, Medical Science Liaison or a related scientific role. Strong knowledge of solid-tumour oncology clinical practice, treatment options and the evolving treatment landscape. Ability to make complex scientific information clear, relevant, and engaging for healthcare professionals. Demonstrated experience in building trusted, peer-to-peer relationships with oncology experts and healthcare teams. Ability to work independently, take initiative, and organise priorities effectively while complying with relevant regulations and standards. Fluent in Swedish and English both written and spoken. Preferred Qualifications & Skills: Please note the following skills are not necessary, just preferred, if you do not have them, please still apply: Clinical experience in oncology or direct patient care environments related to solid tumours, preferably gynecological cancer. Experience supporting clinical trials, investigator-initiated studies, or real-world evidence projects. Familiarity with the Swedish healthcare system, including hospitals and reimbursement processes. Strong presentation and facilitation skills that encourage meaningful scientific discussion and learning. Proven ability to identify and engage key opinion leaders and academic experts in oncology. A collaborative mindset, enthusiasm for continuous learning, and a commitment to contributing within cross-functional teams. Work model and travel This role is based in Sweden with hybrid working flexibility, combining remote work with regular, in-person engagement with healthcare professionals across your assigned territory. Travel within the region is expected, at 50% of your time. Ready to turn scientific expertise into meaningful impact? Bring your curiosity, ideas, and passion for oncology to a role where you can contribute to patient care today and develop your expertise as our pipeline evolves. We value your growth, your contribution, and the power of inclusion. Apply today and help advance care for people living with solid tumours in Sweden. Together, we can unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease. Closing Date for Applications – 30th October (COB) Please take a copy of the Job Description, as this will not be available post closure of the advert. When applying for this role, please use the ‘cover letter’ of the online application or your CV to describe how you meet the competencies for this role, as outlined in the job requirements above. The information that you have provided in your cover letter and CV will be used to assess your application. Skills Digital Fluency, Enterprise Thinking, External Stakeholder Management, High Impact Communication, Key Opinion Leader Management, Medical Affairs, Oncology, Patient Impact, Stakeholder Engagement Swedish Salary …

items.desc: At UBDS, we help organisations transform through cloud, cyber security, AI and digital innovation. As our Managed Services capability continues to grow, we're looking for an experienced Cyber Incident Response Consultant to join our Security and Infrastructure Operations Centre (SIOC), based in either London or Manchester. This is a hands-on, customer-facing consultancy role focused on investigating, responding to and recovering from cyber security incidents across complex customer environments. You will support and lead incident response engagements, conduct digital forensic investigations and advise customers on strengthening their cyber resilience and incident response capabilities. You will work primarily across Microsoft and AWS environments, alongside SIEM, EDR and digital forensic tooling. What You'll Do Lead or support customer-facing cyber incident response engagements, from initial investigation through containment, eradication, recovery and reporting. Investigate security incidents including ransomware, malware, phishing, account compromise and unauthorised access. Conduct digital forensic investigations across endpoints, servers, cloud environments and network infrastructure. Analyse security logs, endpoint telemetry, forensic artefacts and indicators of compromise to establish incident scope and root cause. Use EDR, SIEM and forensic tooling to investigate suspicious activity and reconstruct attack timelines. Advise customers on containment decisions, remediation priorities and recovery approaches. Support eradication and recovery activities, validating remediation and identifying any remaining security risks. Collect, preserve and document digital evidence, following appropriate forensic procedures and chain-of-custody requirements. Produce professional incident investigation reports, including findings, timelines, root cause and remediation recommendations. Present investigation findings and recommendations to technical teams, customers and senior stakeholders. Support threat hunting, detection engineering and improvements to security monitoring capabilities. Develop and improve incident response playbooks, processes and procedures. Design and support cyber incident exercises, including tabletop scenarios, simulated incidents and response workshops. Facilitate or contribute to exercises, evaluating response effectiveness and producing post-exercise recommendations. Work closely with SIOC analysts, security engineers, cloud specialists and wider Managed Services colleagues during incidents. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to less experienced security professionals. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone with strong incident response experience, practical forensic investigation skills and the confidence to engage directly with customers. Experience working within Cyber Incident Response, DFIR, SOC/SIOC or a similar cyber security environment. Hands-on experience investigating and responding to cyber security incidents. Experience supporting or leading customer-facing incident response engagements. Strong experience with EDR tooling, SIEM platforms and security log analysis. Understanding of incident response processes, including containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned. Practical knowledge of digital forensic techniques, including endpoint, memory, network or cloud forensics. Experience collecting and preserving digital evidence, with an understanding of chain-of-custody principles. Ability to analyse attacker activity, indicators of compromise and common attack techniques. Good understanding of Windows, Linux, networking and cloud security. Experience investigating security incidents within Microsoft and/or AWS environments. Experience producing technical investigation reports and presenting findings to customers. Strong analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and consultancy skills. Desirable Experience Experience across some of the following would be beneficial: Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Sentinel. AWS security services, logging and incident investigation. Digital forensic tooling such as Velociraptor, KAPE, Autopsy, Volatility or equivalent. Malware analysis, reverse engineering or network forensics. Threat intelligence, threat hunting and MITRE ATT&CK. Experience supporting ransomware investigations and complex security incidents. Designing and facilitating cyber incident tabletop exercises. Developing realistic incident scenarios, injects and exercise objectives. Evaluating exercise performance and producing post-exercise reports and recommendations. Red Team, penetration testing or adversary simulation experience. Python, PowerShell or scripting for investigation and automation. Experience delivering cyber security consultancy services to external customers. Experience working within Government, Defence or other regulated environments. Desirable Qualifications …
