Monitor and analyse trends in emerging technologies for development to identify high-impact opportunities, innovations, and business models suitable for scaling across LMICs. Collaborate with internal teams, including other M4D Insights, Innovation Fund, and the AI for Impact team, to ensure coherence across research agendas, messaging, and dissemination strategies. Assess the technical and commercial architecture of AI-enabled solutions, spanning infrastructure, data pipelines, models (LLMs/SLMs), local-language capability, compute and inference, and the application and distribution layers, to identify gaps and opportunities for impact-driven innovation in low-resource settings. Translate technical understanding into actionable insight by advising where AI investment, capability-building or partnerships can advance socioeconomic impact, financial inclusion and climate resilience across LMICs. Provide expertise and guidance to innovators in implementing AI and other emerging technologies as they seek to scale up their solutions. Support, as required, the Innovation Fund portfolio of grantees by providing technical assistance, identifying strategic engagements and new growth opportunities. Engage and coordinate with stakeholders across the ecosystem, including donors, mobile operators, startups, government agencies, NGOs, and multilateral institutions—to gather insights, validate findings, and amplify research relevance. Identify and pursue opportunities to promote research through blogs, events (e.g. MWC Barcelona, M360 APAC, AI for Good), webinars, and thought leadership pieces. Contribute to shaping the research agenda, proposing relevant themes, use cases, and strategic focus areas based on trends in digital development. About You The right candidate will be able to draw on a solid foundation of research and industry knowledge to produce thought leadership content. You will be excited to join a diverse team that shares a passion for the ways mobile and emerging technologies can empower people. You will have most or all of the following: A working understanding of the AI for international development ecosystem is essential, supported by a strong foundation in artificial intelligence, machine learning and related technologies, and how they are applied in development contexts. items.card: The role bridges R&D interfaces and operates at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, operations, EHS and quality. As such, the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams will be essential. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver, an effective communicator, and a team player who can influence outcomes through expertise, collaboration, and execution. This role is central to UDC’s vision
items.desc: At Universal Display Corporation (Nasdaq: OLED) (UDC), we’re changing the way people see the world. If you’re reading this on a smartphone, there’s a good chance UDC’s materials are producing the light and color shining from your screen right now. UDC’s OLED ingredients are key parts of stunning, energy-efficient displays used in everything from smartwatches to phones, tablets, laptops, monitors, TVs and automobiles. Virtually every OLED consumer electronics product around the world uses UDC’s phosphorescent OLED materials and technologies. UDC is a publicly traded company and pioneer in the OLED industry. When you join our global team, you are embarking on a journey at the forefront of display technology and organic electronics that impacts the daily lives of people around the world. From engineers to chemists, Ph.D. scientists, technicians, lawyers and more, our UDC team is continuously advancing our field. With a focus on energy efficiency, UDC’s team is contributing to making a better, more sustainable planet. Please visit us at www.oled.com. Job Summary The Process Development Scientist, Flow Chemistry role will lead the development of advanced continuous-flow and intensified chemical processes that enable the production of next-generation OLED materials. This is a hands-on, laboratory-based role. The successful candidate will combine expertise in organic synthesis, flow chemistry, process engineering, and engineering design to develop safe, efficient, and scalable processes for strategically important OLED materials. From early-stage laboratory development through pilot-scale implementation and technology transfer, this role will play a key part in transforming innovative chemistry into robust processes that can be reliably and safely implemented at scale. Success in this position requires strong technical leadership and a highly collaborative mindset. The role bridges R&D interfaces and operates at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, operations, EHS and quality. As such, the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams will be essential. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver, an effective communicator, and a team player who can influence outcomes through expertise, collaboration, and execution. This role is central to UDC’s vision of building a world-class advanced process and product development capability. It offers a unique opportunity to shape future chemical production technologies, establish new process platforms, and contribute directly to the development and commercialization of innovative OLED materials. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and scale-up of continuous-flow and intensified chemical processes, transforming laboratory concepts into safe, robust, and commercially viable processes. Drive process and reaction engineering excellence through the design, optimization, and implementation of scalable synthetic routes, flow reactor systems, and downstream processing strategies. Develop the technical foundation for successful commercialization, including process design packages, operating windows, scale-up strategies, risk assessments, and technology transfer documentation. Collaborate across R&D, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and EHS to advance strategic development programs, ensure process safety, and enable successful deployment of new technologies. Provide technical leadership for equipment qualification, commissioning, technology transfer and process implementation. Build organizational capability through problem solving, knowledge management, and mentorship, driving continuous improvement and fostering a culture of innovation, safety, and scientific rigor. Qualifications: PhD in Chemistry or Chemical Engineering. Industrial experience developing and implementing chemical processes, with a track record of translating laboratory innovation into scalable processes. Expertise in flow chemistry, continuous processes, process intensification, reaction engineering, or related technologies, with experience applying these approaches to solve complex chemical process challenges. Strong understanding of process development fundamentals, including process safety, scale-up, heat and mass transfer, reaction optimization, and unit operations. High level of proficiency in the application of modern analytical techniques (e.g., HPLC/UPLC, GC, MS, IR, NMR, etc.) to reaction/process monitoring, material characterization and structure elucidation. Experience leading cross-functional technical projects, including technology transfer, process documentation, and collaboration across R&D, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and EHS organizations. Effective communicator and problem solver, capable of influencing diverse stakeholders through scientific rigor, data-driven decision making, and clear technical communication.

items.desc: Brief Info About Vinted Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission: Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life. Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces. Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members. Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. Information About The Position As a Decision Scientist in the Search Relevance team within the Buyer domain, you will partner with Data Scientists, Engineers, and a Product Manager to improve how members search our catalog and maximize buyer conversion. The Buyer domain is organized across three layers of product teams: the Experience layer (Discovery & Rediscovery, Search & Refinement), the Content layer (Search Relevance, Recommender Relevance, Content Visibility Management), and the Platform layer (Search Platform, Content Visibility Platform). Together, these teams ensure members find relevant items effortlessly across millions of unique second-hand listings. Within Search Relevance, our scope spans the entire search journey: from semantic and keyword retrieval (including Dense Retrieval vector search) to multi-stage ML ranking (pre-ranking, deep reranking, and personalization). In this role, you will collaborate with your Product Manager, a senior Decision Scientist, and the engineering team to lead analytical discovery, identify search friction and opportunity areas, define success metrics, and design and evaluate A/B experiments measuring the business and member impact of our ranking and retrieval algorithms. You will also be part of the Buyer Decision Science community, collaborating quarterly on technical standards, domain-wide analyses, and experimentation capabilities. Additionally, you will participate in Vinted’s company-wide Data Science & Analytics (DSA) guild, which regularly hosts knowledge-sharing sessions, workshops, and off-sites. In this position, you’ll Collaborate closely with your Product Manager, Data Scientists, and Engineers to uncover search improvement opportunities, size their potential, and provide clear, evidence-based recommendations. Formulate testable hypotheses, establish tracking requirements, and analyze online experiments to measure the causal impact of new retrieval and ranking algorithms on buyer conversion and engagement. Define and monitor metrics and experiment guardrails for Search Relevance, proactively investigating anomalies and diagnosing root causes behind their movements. Build and maintain reliable, intuitive dashboards (e.g. in Looker) that enable your team and cross-functional stakeholders to track search health and feature performance independently. Ensure team initiatives have clear success criteria and decision rules before launch. About You Highly oriented toward business results and actionable recommendations. Good communicator who can present results in an informative and persuasive manner to a wide range of stakeholders. Experience as a Decision Scientist, Data Analyst or Data Scientist. Experience with A/B testing and product development. Knowledge of at least one statistical programming language (Python, R, Scala, etc.) Proficient in SQL and dashboarding tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau, etc.) You are passionate about applying data analytics and excited to use intelligent tools and techniques to uncover insights, improve decision-making and solve real-world business problems. University degree in statistics, econometrics, economics, business, or a related field. Excellent written and spoken English skills. Advantage: Experience with search, ranking or retrieval-based algorithms. Work perks The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme 30 days of paid annual leave Newest MacBook models Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP) Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal …

items.card: Applications are invited for a fully funded 4-year PhD studentship at the University of Cambridge to conduct research into low order models of a rotating detonation engine, in collaboration with Rolls-Royce under the Industrial Doctoral Landscape Award (IDLA) scheme. Rotating Detonation Engines offer a potential improvement towards lower weight/higher power propulsion systems compared to to conventional gas turbine
items.desc: Applications are invited for a fully funded 4-year PhD studentship at the University of Cambridge to conduct research into low order models of a rotating detonation engine, in collaboration with Rolls-Royce under the Industrial Doctoral Landscape Award (IDLA) scheme. Rotating Detonation Engines offer a potential improvement towards lower weight/higher power propulsion systems compared to to conventional gas turbine engines. This project involves the development of a skeleton simplified model for a rotating detonation engine (RDE), using existing models, which will be coded it in a way that makes it simple to access potential performance using realistic thermodynamics. Validation will be conducted using higher fidelity models (RANS and/or LES) and potential experiments. The model will eventually extend to liquid fuels and integrate with a gas turbine simulation platform to simulate the overall system. The project is funded by Rolls-Royce and EPSRC, and belongs to a larger overall initiative on advanced propulsion concepts. The Student Is Expected To Undertake The Following Activities Training in thermodynamic modelling of compressible and supersonic systems Translate existing thermodynamic codes for chemical modelling and detonation toolbox into open source code Implement existing eigenvalue simulation for determination of RDE frequency and cycle properties as a function of operating condition Validate the implemented code against existing higher fidelity simulations and experimental results Extension of the code to include different fuels, geometries and interfaces with compressor and turbine Produce periodic progress reports and present and engage with company specialists Attend International Conferences and submit papers to Journals Attend Annual Doctoral Conference/Symposia organised by Rolls-Royce and other related organisations Qualifications Applicants should have (or expect to be awarded) a good UK Master's degree (or overseas equivalent) in a relevant science subject (Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics), preferably with a focus on fluid mechanics and numerical methods, with some programming experience (Python/C++). The applicant should be self-motivated, but able to work as part of a team, and effectively communicate their research findings. EPSRC IDLA studentships are four-year awards that cover full fees and maintenance, and are available for eligible home students and a limited number of international students. To apply for this studentship, please send your two page CV to Prof Simone Hochgreb (sh372@cam.ac.uk) to arrive no later than 28 February 2027. Applications may close early if the position is filled before this date. Please note that any offer of funding will be conditional on securing a place as a PhD student. Candidates will need to apply separately for admission through the University's Graduate Admissions application portal; this can be done before or after applying for this funding opportunity. The applicant portal can be accessed via: www.graduate.study.cam.ac.uk/courses/directory/egegpdpeg. The final deadline for PhD applications is 14 May 2027, although it is advisable to apply earlier than this. The University actively supports equality, diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from all sections of society.

items.title: Data Scientist - Analytics Business Consulting
items.card: The Role As a Data Scientist in our EU Analytics practice , you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they work with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value. You will play a pivotal role in building advanced analytical models and methodologies, integrating Veeva Data Cloud
items.desc: Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website. Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way. We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back. The Role As a Data Scientist in our EU Analytics practice , you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they work with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value. You will play a pivotal role in building advanced analytical models and methodologies, integrating Veeva Data Cloud products with complex European healthcare data assets. You will drive innovation across our analytical offerings, ensuring Veeva remains at the forefront of data-led, tech-enabled Life Sciences commercial models. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to bridge technical modeling with practical business insights across European markets. You will take ownership of any of our analytics assets (e.g., design solution, manage expectations, status accountancy, impact measurement). What You'll Do Design, prototype, and scale advanced analytics solutions for Life Sciences customers across European markets Process, harmonize, and connect Veeva Data Cloud products with diverse European healthcare data assets Develop and apply statistical methodologies, machine learning, and AI models to solve complex, high-impact commercial and strategic business questions in the Life Sciences space Build and design HCP precision engagement engines that connect disparate healthcare datasets integrated seamlessly with customer CRM information to enable personalized, data-driven targeting and activation Collaborate closely in integrated, cross-functional teams alongside product managers, data engineers, operations, and consultants to deliver end-to-end analytical solutions and ensure continuous feedback and iteration Maintain clear documentation of data methodologies, model architectures, and validation processes to ensure defensibility, scalability, and transparency across client engagements Requirements 2+ years of proven experience in data science, advanced analytics, or machine learning roles, preferably within Life Sciences, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare analytics Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with a track record of collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams. Skilled at translating complex technical challenges to non-technical stakeholders, driving impactful problem-solving sessions, and championing a pragmatic approach to solution design Strong technical expertise across Python, SQL, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI, with a proven ability to design and implement predictive models and intelligent algorithms that solve complex business problems You bring Experience writing process documentation, technical specifications, and data collection guidelines to ensure quality, scalability, and repeatability across projects Nice to Have Knowledge of Veeva products Experience delivering SaaS or Tech-enabled consulting solutions M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field Languages in addition to English Understanding of healthcare, life sciences, or pharmaceutical industry data Experience with data visualization tools to create dashboards and reports Understanding of data engineering concepts (ETL, data pipelines) and automation tools such as Apache Airflow Familiarity with cloud based computing resources such as AWS Interviewing with Veeva We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect. Follow the application process and submit your resume. Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party. Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision. If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows: A conversation with the hiring manager A practical case exercise A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader. Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision. Perks & Benefits Compensation: Highly competitive salary and equity in Veeva Growth: Unrivalled career progression in a fast-growing, global team Flexibility: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth. As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details. What You’ll Do Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making; Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers; Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights. What We’re Looking For Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics; Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems; Fluency in English, both spoken and written. Nice-to-Have Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas; Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python; Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets. €45,000 - €75,000 a year Please note: this is the same position as the one referred as “Data Scientist” on our career site, posted with different job titles to reach STEM students and graduates who might not know a Data Scientist role suits them. Why you'll love it here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 💵 Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from €45k up to €75k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Work closely with infrastructure and risk teams to support smooth implementation and delivery. Support Model Operations as needed. Our Requirements 3+ years of experience in software development, data analytics, or related roles, preferably in financial services, banking, and/or credit risk. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in cross-functional teams. Optional Experience with SAS. Experience with quantitative model development and/or validation. Familiarity with automation and orchestration tools (Airflow, Bash scripting). Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases. Understanding performance optimization for large-scale data processing. This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week. items.desc: Numerisk analys av transienta tryckförlopp i gasgenererande kammare BAE Systems Bofors arbetar med att stärka försvarsförmågan i Sverige och i våra partnerstater världen över. Detta gör vi genom att utveckla, producera och sälja världens mest avancerade försvarsmateriel. BAE Systems Bofors verksamhet finns längs med hela Sveriges försvarspolitiska säkerhetsbälte och företaget har cirka 1000 medarbetare placerade i Karlstad, Karlskoga och Örebro. Företaget ingår i en av världens största försvarsindustrikoncern, BAE Systems, med över 100 000 anställda. Detta ger oss unika möjligheter att kombinera vår långa tradition av lokal expertis med världsledande internationell erfarenhet. Varje år gör flera studenter sina examensarbeten hos BAE Systems Bofors i Karlskoga. Vi som arbetsgivare ser examensarbete som en möjlighet för oss att lära känna potentiella framtida medarbetare, men också som en chans för dig som student att testa dina kunskaper, lära känna vår organisation och ta steget närmare en anställning. Vill du göra ditt examensarbete i en högteknologisk miljö där teori möter praktik? Hos BAE Systems Bofors erbjuder vi spännande examensarbeten där du får möjlighet att arbeta med avancerade simuleringar, experimentella tester och bidra till utvecklingen av framtidens försvarssystem. Som examensarbetare hos BAE Systems Bofors blir du en del av en kultur präglad av samarbete, innovation och kunskapsdelning. Din röst är viktig och nya idéer uppmuntras. Du får en konkret inblick i hur det är att arbeta som analysingenjör och möjlighet att bidra till utvecklingen av verkliga produkter och lösningar. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med erfarna ingenjörer och experter, och du får tillgång till modern analysutrustning i en dynamisk miljö där både praktiskt och teoretiskt arbete är centralt. För dig som är intresserad av en framtid som analysingenjör är detta en utmärkt möjlighet att få inblick i yrkesrollen och utveckla relevanta färdigheter. Vi har ett kontinuerligt rekryteringsbehov inom området och ser examensarbeten som en naturlig och viktig väg till framtida anställning – flera av våra tidigare exjobbare är idag en del av vårt team. Numerisk modellering av snabba tryckförlopp i gasgenererande kammare med OpenFOAM Bakgrund Snabba tryckförlopp i gasgenererande kammare förekommer i många tekniska system, där gas bildas i en begränsad volym och strömmar genom kanaler och komplex geometri. Tryckutvecklingen beror både på hur gasen genereras (t.ex. genom förbränning av ett drivmedel) och hur den strömmar och expanderar. I dag används olika typer av beräkningsmodeller, från enkla 0D/1D- och 2D-modeller till högupplösta 3D-CFD- och FE-modeller. En viktig fråga är när en enklare modell är tillräckligt bra och när högre modellfidelitet motiveras av krav på noggrannhet och detaljnivå. Ökad modellfidelitet ger möjlighet att beskriva fler fysikaliska fenomen och lokala effekter, men innebär samtidigt ökad komplexitet och beräkningskostnad. En central frågeställning är därför vilken modellnivå som krävs för att beskriva olika delar av förloppet med tillräcklig noggrannhet. OpenFOAM är en öppen och väl beprövad CFD-kod för kompressibla, transienta flöden som kan utökas med egna källtermer och partikelmodeller. Det gör verktyget väl lämpat för studier av gasdynamik i gasgenererande kammare. Syfte Att utveckla och använda en 3D-CFD-modell i OpenFOAM för att studera snabba tryckförlopp i en gasgenererande kammare, och genom jämförelse med enklare 0D/1D/2D-modeller analysera när olika modellfideliteter är lämpliga med avseende på noggrannhet, beräkningstid och användbarhet. En ytterligare frågeställning är hur olika representationer av gasgenereringen påverkar simuleringsresultaten och vilka fysikaliska fenomen som behöver modelleras explicit för att uppnå önskad prediktionsförmåga. Innehåll och arbetsuppgifter Litteraturstudie kring snabba tryckförlopp i gasgenererande kammare, modeller för gasproduktion (brinnlagar, källtermer) samt vanliga 0D/1D/2D- och 3D-metoder inom området. Framtagning eller förenkling av en representativ geometri för kammare och kanaler, samt generering av beräkningsnät (t.ex. med snappyHexMesh). Uppställning av en transient, kompressibel OpenFOAM-modell med relevanta rand- och initialvillkor. Implementering/konfiguration av modeller för gasutveckling från drivmedel och jämförelse mellan olika sätt att representera drivmedlet: som en lumpad gasproducerande volym, som en rumsupplöst volym i 3D, som möjlig fördjupning, som diskreta korn (Lagrange-partiklar) där rörelse och omfördelning kan studeras. Genomförande av simuleringar för representativa lastfall och jämförelse av tryck–tid-förlopp, flödesfält, i förekommande fall kornrörelse, samt beräkningstid mellan de olika modellfideliteterna. Jämförelse med resultat från enklare 0D/1D/2D-modeller och analys av avvikelser och överensstämmelse. Analys av sambandet mellan modellernas komplexitet, beräkningskostnad och förmåga att beskriva relevanta fysikaliska …

items.desc:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something. 
Do you have a passion for innovation and technical excellence? Do you thrive on solving complex problems that push the boundaries of what's possible? Join our team to verify innovative, high-throughput cellular baseband modems and transceiver link controllers that power communication for millions of users worldwide.
As a Design Verification Engineer, you'll be at the center of our silicon design group's verification efforts, ensuring the quality and reliability of next-generation cellular systems. Working on innovative baseband modems and RF link controllers for Apple's SOCs, you'll craft highly reusable UVM verification environments that set the standard for quality and efficiency. You'll develop comprehensive coverage-driven and directed test cases that thoroughly validate complex IP and subsystem designs, working closely with multi-functional teams throughout the process. 
In this role, you'll drive methodology innovation by deploying sophisticated tools and techniques that elevate verification practices and ensure tape-out readiness. Collaborating with product development teams across Apple, you'll help deliver cellular systems that redefine industry capabilities and enhance customer experiences globally. This position offers exceptional opportunities to deepen your expertise across cellular protocols, complex IP and subsystem architectures, advanced fabric protocols, and sophisticated debug methodologies. You'll gain experience with best-in-class design verification practices, co-verification techniques with models and firmware, and industry-standard low-power architectures. 
We're looking for experienced engineers with hands-on ASIC design verification experience using reusable verification methodologies such as UVM. The ideal candidate excels at detailed test planning, adapts well to evolving requirements, knows the latest ML-based tools to improve productivity, and is driven to meet the highest quality standards. You thrive in collaborative environments and are eager to tackle the verification challenges of complex, high-performance cellular systems. If you want to contribute to products that impact customers worldwide while advancing your technical expertise, we'd love to hear from you.
Knowledge of SystemVerilog and UVM.
Experience with SystemC, C/C++, Python/perl.
Ability to develop and establish DV Methodologies.
Ability to use LLMs and MCPs.
Ability to develop Python-based automation solutions.
Understanding of constraint random testing, SVA, Coverage driven verification.
Test planning and problem-solving skills.
BSc, MSc, or higher degree in Electrical Engineering/Computer Science, Embedded Engineering or similar 
Experience in C/C++ modeling for design verification.
Knowledge of 4G/5G cellular physical layer operation (3GPP).
Experience with verification of embedded processor cores.
Hands-on verification experience of Bus Fabric, NOC, AHB, AXI, based bus architecture in UVM environment.
Knowledge of using LLMs to improve efficiency and quality of verification.
Understanding of prompt engineering and LLM workflow optimization.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, against the challenging problems our customers face. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the existing workflows are, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.



No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:

 - Meet with strategic customers to deeply understand their AI transformation goals and locate their biggest pain points, particularly around customer-facing and operational workflows powered by AI agents.

 - Own flagship deals end-to-end — from identifying the right use case to structuring commercial terms (including outcome-based pricing, license fees, and implementation arrangements) and driving them to close.

 - Embed yourself deeply inside strategic customers: act as a trusted partner with a provisioned account, spend meaningful time onsite, and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.

 - Identify high-impact use cases through close engagement with customer problems and workflows, and collaborate with Forward Deployed Software Engineers to bring them to life.

 - Guide customers on best practices for deploying our products (e.g. ElevenAgents); including agent design, agent orchestration, production readiness to maximize adoption and impact.

 - Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.

 - Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.

 - Collaborate with our Research teams to feed field insights back into ElevenLabs' platform and models, helping shape the roadmap.

 - Build and deliver compelling demos of ElevenAgents and our broader AI technology to new and existing customers.

 - Collaborate daily with customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure agents reach production and deliver measurable business outcomes.



Requirements

From collecting invoices to accounting, approvals, and payments, we're replacing manual work with intelligent automation. But we're not just using AI in our product. We're also constantly exploring how AI can change the way we build software. We're looking for a curious, ambitious Full-Stack Software Engineer who loves building things, is excited about AI, and has a genuine interest in finance and accounting. We care more about your motivation, curiosity, and what you can build than your years of experience. What you'll do Build and ship features end-to-end. Work across our frontend, backend, and infrastructure, taking ideas all the way to production. Build integrations with financial systems. Connect Cashfeed with accounting platforms and ERPs, tackling complex APIs, data models, and financial workflows. Push the boundaries of AI-assisted development. Go beyond using tools like Cursor and Claude Code. Experiment with AI agents, automate development workflows, and discover better ways to build, test, and ship software. Solve real engineering challenges. Work on architecture, scalability, and reliability in a product where financial accuracy matters. Take ownership. Our tech stack We primarily work with: TypeScript & Node.js NestJS React Turborepo AWS Experience with our exact stack is a plus, but being a fast learner matters more. Who we're looking for We're not looking for someone who ticks every box. We're looking for someone who genuinely loves building software and understanding the problems they're solving. You're passionate about AI and automation. You actively experiment with new tools, agents, and workflows to become a better engineer. You're always looking for ways to automate repetitive work. You're genuinely interested in finance and accounting. You don't need to be an accountant, but you're eager to understand how accounting, payments, and financial systems actually work. You love building things. You enjoy solving complex problems, experimenting with new ideas, and figuring things out independently. You think beyond the code. You care about understanding the bigger picture, building reliable solutions, and taking ownership of what you ship. Whether you're early in your career or have years of experience, what matters most is your curiosity, motivation, and willingness to learn. Why Cashfeed? AI is part of how we work. We actively use and experiment with AI tools and agents to rethink how software gets built. Real ownership and impact. Work on features that directly impact customers and help shape our product and engineering practices. Interesting challenges. From complex financial integrations to intelligent automation, there's no shortage of meaningful problems to solve. Small, ambitious team. Work closely with people who love building, without unnecessary bureaucracy. Room to experiment. Try new tools, automate repetitive work, and challenge how things are done. Work together in Ghent. We're a close-knit team that enjoys collaborating in person, sharing ideas, and building great things. Interested? We'd love to hear from you! Send us a short introduction and tell us about something you've built or experimented with. We're especially curious about how you're using AI in your development workflow, something you've automated yourself, or what excites you about building software in the financial world.

items.desc: At Stackgini we are building the AI operating system for Autonomous Enterprise IT. IT landscapes of large enterprises have never been under more pressure. Thousands of applications to govern. Major transformations to manage. Growing regulatory complexity on one side, business units shipping AI prototypes in days on the other. And in the middle: enterprise IT teams still managing and collecting tech demands manually, managing the complexity of highly integrated processes and systems. Stackgini changes this fundamentally. Stackgini's system understands its customers' enterprise tech landscape from the ground up, from technical configuration to application documentation, from individual IT demands to dependencies across the entire tech portfolio, with the depth of knowledge of a senior IT expert and the speed of a machine. If you had unlimited budget, you would hire a dedicated IT expert for every IT demand. With Stackgini, this is now possible. Some of the largest organizations in this world trust Stackgini including DAX-40 and Fortune-500 customers like Siemens Healthineers or REWE. We're a small, talent-dense team of >10, building what we believe will change how the world's largest companies operate. We are growing fast, and the people joining now are the ones who set the standard - for the product, the culture, and our category. Stackgini will be the place where you will do the most meaningful work of your career. Tasks The role A Product Engineer at Stackgini owns features end to end. You take a customer problem, scope it with Product & CSM, design the solution, build it across the stack, ship it, and stay close to it after release. Recent examples: Product Engineers shipped Decisions and Approvals (a feature for routing IT requests through multi-step approval workflows), built evaluation infrastructure to benchmark agent recommendations against expert baselines, and agentic IT solutions research with our inhouse developed agent tool-use. You are close to users. You join customer calls, run user tests, read support context, and you use that input to decide what should exist and how it should behave. The person building the feature is expected to shape the feature. We have more good ideas than hands. For most reasonable feature ideas the question is not whether we build them, but when. Product Engineers are the people who turn that prioritization into shipped product quickly, without lowering the bar. The AI work AI is core to our product, but we don't run agents for everything. We use them where they create real value. For that we built our own LLM harness from hard-earned production experience: maximum freedom for the model, without compromising on enterprise control, governance or EU data residency. What this means for you: you work hands-on with these new technologies, you run evals instead of trusting demos, and you know how to put this stuff into production reliably. Agent output gets benchmarked against expert-curated baselines, and failure modes get named, measured and fixed. If you are obsessed with how AI systems behave, fail and improve, this is the place for you. How we ship Small teams of 2 to 3 engineers around a topic. We deploy continuously to production. We use AI tools heavily, and you have freedom in which ones (e.g. Cursor, Claude, Codex). Around that we run a strong operating system: clear ticket context, focused branches, AI review before human review, screenshots or videos for product changes, manual product testing before release, production verification after. The engineer who ships a change owns it in production. If something breaks, you lead the fix. Requirements What we need from you Nobody at 11 people knows everything. You can get productive in our stack fast: Kotlin/Spring Boot and Python on the backend, TypeScript/React on the frontend. You don't need to know all of it on day one, but you should get into it quickly. You have shipped agentic systems, side projects absolutely count. You think in tools, context and evals, not just prompts. Fluent English. German is a real plus because many customer calls run in German. We pair you with a German-speaking teammate when needed, but German gets you closer to users faster. You'll stand out if You build with AI natively, not as an afterthought. You can take a vague problem to a shipped feature. You scope, decide, implement, test and iterate. items.card: About the Role Behind the API and the AI agents there is a real, physical lab in Lausanne: millions of francs of instruments, freezers full of reagents, deliveries arriving every day, and customer samples going out. When it runs smoothly, a customer gets their results in days. When it does not — a reagent runs out mid-run, a delivery sits unopened, an instrument goes down and nobody noticed the service contract
items.desc: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role Behind the API and the AI agents there is a real, physical lab in Lausanne: millions of francs of instruments, freezers full of reagents, deliveries arriving every day, and customer samples going out. When it runs smoothly, a customer gets their results in days. When it does not — a reagent runs out mid-run, a delivery sits unopened, an instrument goes down and nobody noticed the service contract lapsed — experiments stop, and customers feel it immediately. You are the person who makes sure that does not happen. What is on the shelves, what is on order, what is shipping, and what is about to break — that is yours, and you will run it. This is a hands-on, in-the-lab role, working closely with our Lab Manager and with the scientists whose experiments depend on you getting it right. This is a good role to be early in your career in. We are going from roughly 25 people to roughly 50 in the next year and multiplying the throughput of the lab, and the person who does this job well will not be doing the same job in two years. We are looking for someone who fixes things rather than reporting them. What You'll Do Keep the lab stocked. Receive deliveries, unpack them, get them into the right freezer at the right temperature, and make sure our inventory system reflects what is actually on the shelf. Flag what is running low before anyone else notices. Run the day-to-day ordering. Place the orders, chase the ones that are late, and sort out the ones that arrive wrong. Handle shipping, in and out. Customer samples, reagents, equipment. Cold chain, dry ice, customs paperwork, and the courier relationships that make it all land on time. Support the science team hands-on. Reconstituting and aliquoting target proteins, buffer prep, plate handling, and tracking materials in our lab software. You will be at the bench for part of your week. Look after the instruments. Coordinate servicing, calibration, and repairs with vendors, keep the maintenance schedule honest, and get an engineer on site fast when something breaks. Keep the lab safe and organized. Chemical inventory, waste disposal, safety compliance, and the general war against entropy in a shared space. Keep the office and the team running. Supplies, workspace, new-starter setups, and the occasional team event. Help build the new lab. We are expanding into new space. You will be involved in setting it up. What We're Looking For Some hands-on lab experience. A degree, an apprenticeship, a technician role, or a couple of years in a research or biotech lab. We care much more about whether you are competent and reliable in a lab than about how many years you have logged. Genuinely organized. You are tracking dozens of small things at once — what is on order, what expires next month, which instrument is due for service — and none of them drop. You notice things before they break. The best people in this role are the ones who spot that we are three weeks from running out of a reagent, and quietly fix it, rather than the ones who report the stockout. You are comfortable getting your hands dirty. This is not an administrative job. You will be unpacking boxes, moving dry ice, and reorganizing a freezer that has become someone's junk drawer. You are tech-savvy, and you want to be more so. Our lab runs on our own software and we use AI tooling across the company, including for operational work. We would love someone who ends up automating the boring parts of their own job rather than doing them forever, and we will teach you how. Curiosity here counts for more than existing skill. items.desc: AI Applications Architect — Agent-First Development Nationwide Utilities Location: Kensington, London W14, 100% office-based Salary: £35,000 per year Employment: Permanent, full-time Reports to: CEO Help build the software factory, not just its next application We are looking for a curious, technically capable builder who wants to develop quickly through real work at the frontier of applied AI. At Nationwide Utilities, our CEO is already directing specialist agent teams across a connected business-software portfolio. The work spans customer operations, email and documents, supplier portals, bill validation, markets, procurement and other business applications. We are also developing the coordination tools that help manage the development itself. These applications are at different stages of build, integration and release. Your opportunity is to help connect the pieces and turn ambitious development into dependable software people actually use. This is not a conventional coding role with an AI assistant added. Agents are central to implementation. Your contribution is the requirements, judgement, coordination and hands-on engineering that make the result work. We value practical ability, learning speed and follow-through over a long CV or a senior title alone. How we work The CEO is hands-on: defining outcomes, directing teams, reviewing screens and making decisions. The development environment uses specialist planner, builder, checker and task-management sessions, with shared coordination across projects. Clear “done means” goals, versioned instructions, evidence of results and controlled releases matter. So does the ability to spot when a busy agent is not moving the actual goal forward. You will help improve this method, not simply add more activity to it. Your contribution Translate business goals into clear requirements, guidelines, reusable agent instructions and testable acceptance criteria. Break work into manageable stages, map dependencies and keep several agent-led workstreams moving without losing the critical path. Use Claude, Codex and appropriate local tools for implementation, testing, review and documentation. Read code, debug problems and integrate changes. Know when to direct an agent, when to intervene and when to ask for experienced review. Distinguish built, tested, integrated and live. Challenge sample-data demos and confident agent summaries until the actual user journey is proven. Help make MVPs production-ready: data integrity, permissions, security, testing, useful interfaces, deployment, monitoring and rollback. Coordinate shared testing and deployment resources; resolve stale instructions, unclear ownership and failed hand-offs. Reduce avoidable supervision by giving the CEO clear progress, concise decisions and early warning of genuine blockers. Our development environment includes four Blackwell GPUs, lightweight local computers and multiple premium Claude/Codex accounts. The goal is more useful, verified software, not simply more sessions, tokens or GPU activity. What matters An insatiable, practical interest in AI: you experiment, learn and can explain what did and did not work. Software foundations: you can work with code, APIs, databases and version control, and diagnose a problem rather than blindly retry prompts. Pace and prioritisation: you can juggle workstreams, preserve context and focus on the next thing that will genuinely unblock delivery. Clear written thinking: an ambiguous idea becomes an executable instruction and an outcome a person can check. Finishing discipline: you care about usability, integration and reliability as much as producing the first working demonstration. Initiative, honest communication and a strong appetite for a demanding development opportunity. Experience with MCP, local models, GPU workloads, containers, CI/CD, Python or TypeScript is useful; you do not need to arrive as an expert in everything. Energy-sector experience is welcome but not essential. Relevant employment, independent projects and substantial learning projects can all demonstrate your ability. This is learning through hands-on contribution alongside the CEO, not a promise of a formal training programme. The scope you own and your production-release authority must match demonstrated capability and agreed review arrangements. One developing hire is not expected to replace every engineering speciality. Working pattern This is a permanent, full-time role, with ordinary working days 100% office-based in Kensington, London W14. It is not a hybrid role. The agentic development environment is intended to operate around the clock. You would be expected to remain available for remote intervention at any time outside office hours, including nights and weekends, using a mobile device or laptop. Active intervention is needed only when required to keep agent work progressing; this is not a statement that you would be working continuously. Specific ordinary working hours, monitoring …

items.desc:
Quel sera votre rôle dans la #TeamDeloitte ? 
 Description de l'emploi
 L'univers de la Data et de l'Intelligence Artificielle (IA) est à l'aube d'une révolution sans précédent, marquée par des avancées technologiques fulgurantes et une intégration toujours plus poussée dans tous les secteurs d'activité. L'ère de l'IA générative, avec son potentiel de transformer radicalement la stratégie de données des entreprises, s'annonce comme un tournant majeur pour les organisations.
 Rejoindre Deloitte France en tant qu' AI Engineer / Scientist confirmé vous offre une opportunité unique de jouer un rôle essentiel dans la conduite et la croissance de nos activités en Intelligence Artificielle au sein d'un cabinet de conseil de renommée mondiale. Vous travaillerez au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, en étroite collaboration avec des experts métiers et des cadres dirigeants, pour transformer les défis de nos clients dans divers secteurs tels que les services financiers, le secteur de l'énergie, la santé ou encore la technologie, les médias et les télécommunications. Vous contribuerez à établir les meilleures pratiques en matière d'ingénierie IA (MLOps), de choix d'architecture technique et de delivery de produits IA en travaillant main dans la main, lorsque le contexte le permet, avec nos partenaires stratégiques (AWS, GCP, Microsoft , Databricks, Snowflake, Nvidia) . Vous aurez également l'opportunité de travailler et apprendre auprès d'une équipe d’experts de l'IA . 
 Contribuer au delivery des projets et produits IA (Machine Learning, GenAI, NLP, Classification, Computer Vision, modélisation) pour des clients de divers secteurs 
 Encadrer de jeunes Data Scientists et Ingénieurs ML en les coachant et assurant leur montée en compétences. 
 Mettre en place et promouvoir les bonnes pratiques MLOps et LLMOps pour optimiser la livraison des modèles IA en production (scalabilité, fiabilité, coûts). 
 Être un prescripteur sur les outils communs Data & IA et assurer l'identification et le déploiement d'assets techniques réutilisables (internes, groupe, marché). 
 Contribuer activement à la veille technologique pour amplifier l'innovation et identifier les synergies entre technologies, méthodes et pratiques. 
 Assurer la qualité des solutions , le respect des bonnes pratiques de développement et de sécurité, et intégrer les principes d'architecture de Deloitte. 
 Capitaliser et diffuser auprès des équipes internes et externes sur les avancées et les résultats des projets IA. 
 Participer à des initiatives d'innovation et effectuer une veille technologique sur les pratiques LLMOps.

Et si c’était vous ?Au moins 3 années d'expérience significative dans le domaine du ML et de l’IA, et plus globalement de la data science, idéalement acquise dans un environnement de conseil ou en lien avec divers secteurs d'activité.Une formation scientifique et/ou informatique de niveau Bac+5 minimum, de préférence avec une spécialisation en mathématiques appliquées, machine learning ou domaines connexes. Une solide compréhension des technologies et outils d'IA, incluant notamment Python, PyTorch, ScikitLearn, services Clouds IA (Azure, GCP, AWS). La maîtrise de frameworks et outils liés aux LLM (ex?: LangChain, LangGraph, FAISS) est également un atout. Une maîtrise des concepts core du Machine Learning (Réseaux neuronaux, apprentissage non/semi/supervisé, Deep Learning, classification, modélisation). Une expérience significative dans les techniques de NLP/GenAI incluant LLM, RAG, VectorStores, Agents LLM. Une expertise avérée en gestion de projets techniques et une excellente capacité de collaboration interfonctionnelle. Une familiarité avec les processus et outils de développement modernes (DataOps, DevOps, CI/CD, Git, Docker, Kubernetes) et le déploiement de micro-services ou API (Flask, Django). Un esprit de synthèse et une capacité à travailler en équipes pluridisciplinaires. D'excellentes capacités de communication et de présentation, vous permettant d'interagir efficacement avec des profils techniques et non techniques. Une curiosité intellectuelle et d'excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes. La maîtrise des outils, méthodologies et concepts de suivi et gestion de projet est un plus.

Leader international de l’expertise après sinistre et de la gestion de sinistres, nous réunissons plus de 4 500 collaborateurs présents dans plus de 120 pays à travers le monde, dont 40 pays dans lesquels nous opérons directement, afin d’offrir une expertise reconnue, des relations humaines de qualité et des solutions innovantes. Ensemble, nous aidons les assureurs, les entreprises et les particuliers à avancer avec confiance, où qu’ils se trouvent dans le monde. Votre environnement La Direction des Solutions d’Expertise recherche Ingénieur IA / AI Software Engineer H/F pour accompagner son développement. Vous intervenez sur des sujets d’IA générative avec un objectif concret : transformer les innovations technologiques en solutions robustes, performantes et créatrices de valeur pour nos métiers. À ce titre, vous serez notamment amené à : Faire évoluer notre moteur interne d’orchestration IA afin de gérer des workflows complexes : routage de modèles, chaînes de traitement, function calling, tool use et protocoles émergents tels que MCP ; Concevoir des fonctionnalités IA facilement exploitables par les développeurs au travers d’APIs, de connecteurs et de SDKs internes simples, robustes et documentés ; Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des architectures RAG avancées, des systèmes d’agents et des solutions d’extraction d’informations permettant notamment d’exploiter des documents et pièces de sinistres complexes ; Évaluer et intégrer les technologies IA les plus pertinentes pour nos usages métiers : nouveaux modèles propriétaires et open source, frameworks d’agents, document intelligence, knowledge graphs ou encore fine-tuning de modèles locaux ; Mettre en place des protocoles d’évaluation et d’observabilité permettant de mesurer la qualité des réponses, réduire les hallucinations ainsi qu’optimiser la latence et les coûts d’inférence ; Partager vos bonnes pratiques avec les équipes de développement et contribuer à l’industrialisation et à l’adoption des solutions IA au sein de nos applications métiers Vous évoluerez dans un environnement orienté développement logiciel et IA générative, avec une attention particulière portée à l’industrialisation, à la performance et à la fiabilité des solutions. Stack technique Python / .NET / C# LLM et APIs de modèles Embeddings et bases de données vectorielles RAG et agents IA REST / gRPC / flux asynchrones MCP, function calling et tool use Azure Profil Vous êtes titulaire d’un Bac+5 ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur en informatique, ingénierie logicielle ou formation équivalente ; Vous disposez d’une solide expérience : en développement backend, notamment avec Python, .NET / C# ou un environnement équivalent ; dans la conception, l’intégration ou l’exposition d’APIs performantes, notamment REST, gRPC ou architectures asynchrones. dans un environnement Cloud, idéalement Azure, et une bonne compréhension des enjeux de déploiement et de maîtrise des coûts ; en pratique des outils d’évaluation et d’observabilité des applications LLM tels que Langfuse, Ragas ou DeepEval ; Une maîtrise des techniques avancées de prompt engineering, notamment la structuration des sorties et l’arbitrage entre qualité, latence et coûts ; en document intelligence et dans le traitement de données non structurées : OCR, extraction, indexation ou exploitation de documents complexes ; Vous maîtrisez les bonnes pratiques d’architecture logicielle, de tests et de robustesse applicative ; des concepts et technologies de l’IA générative : APIs de LLM, embeddings, bases vectorielles, architectures RAG, agents IA, function calling ou tool use ; Ce poste s’adresse avant tout à un profil d’ingénieur logiciel passionné par l’IA générative. Notre objectif n’est pas d’entraîner des modèles de Machine Learning from scratch, mais de concevoir, intégrer et industrialiser des architectures logicielles intelligentes au service de nos métiers. Pourquoi rejoindre ADENES Un groupe en pleine dynamique de croissance, reconnu pour son expertise métier, sa capacité d’innovation et son ancrage national et international solide. Un poste à fort impact stratégique, participer à la transformation digitale des métiers. Une culture managériale fondée sur la confiance, la responsabilisation et la collaboration, où vos idées et votre leadership font la différence. Un poste clé dans un groupe structuré, agile et tourné vers l’avenir. Un engagement fort en matière de RSE, de qualité de vie au travail et d’innovation durable. Rémunération : de 42 000 à 50 000 € annuel selon profil et expérience – Statut Cadre forfait jour (218 jours) Vous bénéficierez d’un accord télétravail, d’une carte tickets restaurants, d’un contrat santé avec prise en charge Employeur et d’un Compte Épargne Temps. items.desc: Software, UI & Agentic Systems Engineer (m/w/d) Graz (hybrid) · Vollzeit Wir sind openmaind - wir bauen eine KI-gestützte, herstellerunabhängige Intelligenzschicht für AGV-/AMR-Flotten – den Fleet Orchestrator. Ein System, bestehend aus drei Modulen: Insight – sehen, was passiert: Bewegungen, Near-Misses, Blockagen Planning – Layouts und Materialfluss simulieren, bevor sie existieren Orchestration – manuelle und autonome Flotten in Echtzeit koordinieren Worauf es uns wirklich ankommt Urteilsvermögen vor Syntax. Du denkst in Systemen und erkennst, wenn der Output eines Agents – oder einer Kollegin, eines Kollegen – falsch, fragil oder over-engineered ist. Das ist uns wichtiger als Tiefenexpertise in einer einzelnen Sprache. Du schreibst selbst Code, leitest Coding-Agents an, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse und stehst für die Qualität dieses Outputs ein. Womit du dich beschäftigst Echte Produkt-Features in Go und Python ausliefern, mit React im Frontend Unsere agentischen Fähigkeiten mit LangGraph vorantreiben – mehrstufige Agent-Workflows entwerfen, testen und robust machen Ran an LLM-Training und -Evaluation: Fine-Tuning, Benchmarks, Regressionstests für Modellverhalten Unseren SDLC aufs nächste Level bringen – CI/CD, Test-Infrastruktur, Release-Prozess, Code-Qualität Dahin, wo die Roboter sind – Orchestrierungslogik gegen echte AGV-/AMR-Hardware im Feld integrieren und validieren Was du mitbringst Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch sicher und souverän, auch mit Kund:innen (mind. C1). Gutes Englisch gehört dazu. Ein solides technisches Fundament, idealerweise durch ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Software Engineering, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder Ähnlichem Starkes architektonisches Urteilsvermögen Echte Hands-on-Erfahrung im Bauen oder Betreiben von LLM-basierten Agents (LangGraph oder ähnlich) Du weißt, wie man LLM-Output bewertet und testet, nicht nur promptet Go, Python und React sind ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung – sich in das einzuarbeiten, was das Problem braucht, zählt mehr Neugier auf Robotik und Lust, dir mit Hardware im Feld die Hände schmutzig zu machen Ein Ship-it-Mindset – verlässlich statt nur clever Nice to have Erfahrung mit Flottenmanagement, Logistik oder industrieller Automatisierung Hintergrund in Simulation oder Planungsalgorithmen Was tatsächlich für dich drin ist Du pflegst nicht die Codebase von irgendwem anders – du baust die Architektur, auf der diese Firma die nächsten Jahre läuft. Deine Entscheidungen zum Design des agentischen Systems zeigen sich im Produkt, nicht in einer Vorschlagsbox Kleines Team heißt: Dein Name steht für das Ergebnis, gut oder schlecht – und genau das ist der Punkt Musst du um 14 Uhr zwischen zwei Meetings laufen gehen? Geh. Das bedeutet Gleitzeit hier – kein Buzzword Kernzeit 9–12 Uhr, den Rest des Tages flexibel, plus 1 Tag Home-Office pro Woche Working Holidays Klimaticket Steiermark, voll übernommen Büro mitten in der Stadt mit Terrasse Richtung Schlossberg, direkt an der Mur – perfekt für einen Kaffee zwischen zwei Debugging-Sessions oder um vor einem Deploy den Kopf freizubekommen Echter Zugang zur Startup-Szene: Events, Community, Leute, die an Ähnlichem bauen wie du Gehalt Faire Bezahlung ist uns wichtig! Das Bruttomonatsgehalt für diese Position beträgt mindestens € 4.061. Je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation sind wir selbstverständlich bereit, ein höheres Gehalt anzubieten. Bewerbung Interessiert? Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf an career@openmaind.ai. Statt eines klassischen Anschreibens interessiert uns etwas anderes: Erzähl uns in 3–5 Sätzen von einem LLM-Agent, den du gebaut oder betrieben hast. Was sollte er lösen, und was hat nicht so funktioniert wie gedacht? Wir lesen jede Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen bei dir.

items.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
items.card: What You'll Do Build and deploy AI agents: Design, develop, and ship AI-powered agents that execute multi-step business workflows, interact with external systems, and complete tasks autonomously. Own customer implementations: Work directly with customers to understand their operational processes, identify automation opportunities, and translate business requirements into working technical solutions. Develop
items.desc: You'll work at the intersection of AI engineering, product development, and customer implementation. Rather than building in isolation or working from detailed specifications, you'll spend time understanding how businesses operate, identify opportunities for automation, and develop AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable results. You'll own implementations from the initial customer conversation through to production, ensuring agents are reliable, observable, and capable of handling real-world complexity. This is a builder's role. You'll be expected to write code, solve problems independently, and get AI systems working in production. What You'll Do Build and deploy AI agents: Design, develop, and ship AI-powered agents that execute multi-step business workflows, interact with external systems, and complete tasks autonomously. Own customer implementations: Work directly with customers to understand their operational processes, identify automation opportunities, and translate business requirements into working technical solutions. Develop integrations: Build and maintain integrations with ERP systems, APIs, email platforms, databases, and other business-critical tools. Handle messy data, edge cases, and inconsistent systems. Engineer reliable AI systems: Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, testing, monitoring, and observability to ensure agents perform consistently in production. Work across the stack: Build backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and supporting interfaces where required to deliver complete solutions. Solve problems in ambiguous environments: Make technical decisions, iterate quickly, and take ownership without waiting for detailed instructions. Improve the core platform: Collaborate with the founding team to turn customer-specific solutions into reusable capabilities that can scale across deployments. What We're Looking For Essential Experience Strong hands-on Python experience , building backend systems, APIs, integrations, and production applications. Real AI agent development experience: You've built and shipped AI agents or LLM-powered systems that do more than generate text. You understand tool calling, multi-step workflows, structured outputs, failure handling, and the challenges of deploying AI reliably. Production ownership: You've taken software from initial development into live environments, dealt with real users and production issues, and improved systems based on actual performance. Early-stage startup experience: You've worked at an early-stage startup, ideally as a founder, founding engineer, or one of the first technical hires. You're comfortable with ambiguity, rapid iteration, and owning problems outside a narrowly defined job description. Customer-facing engineering experience: You're comfortable working directly with customers, understanding their workflows, explaining technical trade-offs, and translating business problems into practical engineering solutions. Integration and data experience: You can connect disparate systems through APIs, work with relational databases, and build solutions that handle real-world business data. Strong engineering judgement: You know when to use an LLM, when deterministic code is better, how to manage failure modes, and how to balance speed with reliability. Technical Environment The existing stack includes: Languages: Python, TypeScript and Go Frontend: Vue AI: LLMs, AI agents, LangChain and agent evaluation Data: PostgreSQL and Neo4j Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Integrations: REST APIs, email systems, ERP platforms and business applications You don't need to be an expert in every technology listed. Strong Python and production AI engineering experience are the priorities; the ability to learn unfamiliar tools quickly matters more than matching every item on the stack. You'll Stand Out If You Have Built AI agents that execute actions across multiple systems rather than simply powering chat interfaces. Developed AI-powered workflow automation for real customers or internal business operations. Worked with agent evaluations, observability, human-in-the-loop controls, and production reliability. Built integrations with ERP, CRM, supply chain, finance, logistics, or other enterprise systems. Worked in B2B SaaS, enterprise AI, or an AI-native startup. Experience in manufacturing, distribution, wholesale, logistics, or B2B commerce. Danish language skills. Who This Role Is For You're likely a strong fit if you're an AI engineer who enjoys building products from scratch, working close to customers, and taking responsibility for whether your software actually solves the problem.
