items.desc: Are you excited about building impactful AI solutions using the latest technologies and tools? Join an Assetization Squad within the AI Center of Excellence at Nationale Nederlanden (NN), where we develop reusable AI assets, collaborate across business units, and drive strategic innovation. As a GenAI Engineer in an assetization squad, you will work in a cross-functional, agile team to deliver high-quality, production-ready AI applications that enhance customer services and operational efficiency. What you are going to do You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining reusable AI components and solutions that address real business challenges across NN. Your work will span from requirement definition to production deployment, ensuring scalability, security, and performance. You will collaborate closely with other GenAI engineers, data scientists, product owners, and business stakeholders to translate needs into robust, reusable AI assets. Key responsibilities include: Develop scalable, reusable AI applications and components using agentic frameworks (e.g., Langchain, Langgraph) Bring AI models to production as APIs and integrate them into the NN landscape Collaborate with Data Scientists, Engineers, and Product Managers to improve the Machine Learning Lifecycle and asset quality Focus on CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and security compliance for all squad deliverables Enhance platform performance through latency optimization and caching strategies Support the squad by promoting best practices, conducting code reviews, and maintaining technical documentation Translate business requirements into reusable AI solutions and present them to stakeholders Continuously contribute to innovation initiatives and explore new technologies for assetization and reuse What we offer you NN invests in an inclusive, inspiring work environment and in skills and competences for the future. We match this with employee benefits that are in line with what is needed today and in the future. This way, we offer our employees the opportunity to get the best out of themselves. We offer you: Salary between €4,527 and €6,036 based on 36 hours per week, depending on your knowledge and experience 13th month and holiday allowance are paid with your monthly salary 27 vacation days for a 5-day working week and 3 Diversity Days A modern pension administered by BeFrank Plenty of training and learning opportunities NS Business Card 2nd class, which gives you unlimited travel, also privately. Do you prefer to travel with your own transport? Then you can declare the kilometers travelled Allowances for setting up your home office and for internet use Who you are You are a pro-active engineer with a strong background in software and machine learning development. You thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment and enjoy sharing knowledge with others. Your curiosity and communication skills help you grow and support your team. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field 2 to 5 years of experience in software or DevOps engineering and developing ML applications Strong experience in Python, FastAPI, and asynchronous development Experience with CI/CD, application security, and performance monitoring Working knowledge of the data science process including data collection, cleaning, and model implementation Experience with agentic frameworks for LLMs (Langchain & Langgraph) Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud, Docker, and Kubernetes Experience in developing automated APIs and cloud solutions using CI/CD tools, Git, and Terraform Proven ability to independently deliver complex, reusable AI solutions with direct business impact Who you will work with You will be part of one of the Assetization Squad within the AI Center of Excellence, collaborating with Product Owners, Data Scientists, and GenAI Engineers. You will also engage with business unit teams and guilds to share knowledge and ensure scalable deployment and reuse of AI assets. You will work closely with operational teams to ensure your solutions are adopted and deliver measurable impact. Any questions? items.desc: Junior Agentic AI Scientist Job Title: Junior Agentic AI Scientist Job Ref: AICOS_Jobs_2026_05 Job Type: Full-time contract Job Salary: €1.807,85 Job Location: Porto, Portugal Job Description: Fraunhofer Portugal AICOS is seeking a Junior Agentic AI Scientist to join our dynamic and multidisciplinary team within the Intelligent Systems Group, namely in machine learning and Agentic AI. It is expected that you will contribute to the business areas of Digital Industry and Digital Futures. Scopul final al aplicațiilor este de a permite echipei de investiții să analizeze mai rapid un volum mai mare de informații și să identifice mai devreme riscurile și oportunitățile relevante .

items.desc:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
 Our Data Platform team provides centralized data platforms and tools for various business functions at Netflix, enabling them to utilize data to make critical, data-driven decisions. We focus on making it easy for our business partners to work with data efficiently, securely, and responsibly. We aspire to set the industry standard in building a world-class data infrastructure, supporting Netflix’s goal to be the most popular and widely accessible destination for global internet entertainment.
 As the Data Platform charter grows, we are expanding our presence to Poland to further increase our impact. We are seeking Distributed Systems Engineers to help evolve and innovate our Product and Infrastructure. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that brings new perspectives as we address the next set of challenges.
 Team Spotlights 
 Analytics Platform and Experience Team 
 This team owns the architecture and foundational systems of Netflix's Analytics Platform, a growing domain with an expanding charter as the platform scales to support critical initiatives like Live and Ads. The team currently owns automated Spark migration tooling and TableDiff, our in-house data validation tool used both as a critical enabler for migrations and as a widely adopted utility across the org. As the charter grows, the team will take on additional high-impact platform initiatives. This offers an excellent opportunity to shape foundational data infrastructure and deliver direct, high-leverage impact across Netflix
 Data Movement Team 
 The Data Movement Connector EcoSystem at Netflix is a growing domain with an expanding charter to own high-leverage business-critical connectors across Netflix. The team currently offers Frameworks, Libraries, and Control Planes and supports a large set of streaming/incremental and batch/snapshot-based connectors. This offering evolves the next step is full ownership of the Mantis ecosystem. We believe having the Poland team build and own a set of connectors to move and integrate data across different business domains would be the fastest way to unlock business values. This offers an excellent opportunity to learn the technology stack and deliver direct, relevant impact across the organization.
 Online Data Stores Team 
 This team takes end-to-end ownership of Netflix's internal Online Data Stores (ODS) platform, spanning two core areas:
 1. Core data platform products 
 Ownership of critical infrastructure such as ZooKeeper and the data abstraction layers that sit on top of our datastores - ensuring their reliability, scalability, and continued evolution as foundational components of the data platform.
 2. Self-service solutions for Online Data Stores 
 Building the self-service capabilities - including agentic interfaces - that let Netflix engineers provision, operate, and reason about their datastores independently, reducing operational friction and toil.
 Over time the team will expand its charter to additional datastores and broader infrastructure initiatives. The mission throughout is to boost Netflix engineers' productivity and innovation through a robust, efficient, and secure data platform, while fostering close collaboration across data platform teams to deliver greater organizational throughput and agility.
 Experimentation Platform Team 
 This team owns the data infrastructure that makes A/B testing work at Netflix. Specifically, they build and maintain the systems that store and govern the record of who was in which experiment, across hundreds of concurrent tests running across streaming, ads, growth, and device platforms. They also own the semantic layer that ties every experiment metric at Netflix back to that allocation data, and the pipelines that keep the whole thing fresh and reliable. As the team matures, the scope grows to include self-service tooling for the teams running experiments and support for AI-driven monitoring and analysis workflows.
 This could be a great opportunity for you if you enjoy: 
 Solving business needs at scale by applying your software engineering and analytical problem-solving skills
 Designing and building robust, scalable, and highly available distributed infrastructure
 Leading cross-functional initiatives and collaborating with engineers, product managers, and technical program managers across teams
 Sharing experiences with open source communities and contributing to Netflix OSS

items.desc:
Every day, hundreds of millions of people trust their documents to iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive and Box on Apple platforms. These services rely on a common foundation built at the core of our operating systems, the File Provider framework, APIs and daemons developed by a Core OS team in Paris. We are responsible for keeping users’ files consistent across their devices and services, and the deep system integration that provides the best local user experience with cloud-backed files.
We are looking for a systems engineer who wants to work where distributed state meets the operating system. You do not need to have sync experience. You do need to care deeply about getting things right, because at our scale, rare bugs have the potential to cause dataloss for many users.
You will join the team that owns the sync engine: the system that detects, tracks and applies changes flowing in both directions between a device and the cloud. The central problem is reconciling two trees that change independently: the local filesystem where users save their files, and remote services we don’t control. The engine plans and executes a graph of dependent operations to apply each change to the other tree, in an order that never breaks the folder structure, even through concurrent edits, crashes and conflicts. The workload is heavily bursty: we track millions of files, and a single event can change a large share of them at once. On iPhone and iPad, absorbing those bursts means competing with apps and daemons for memory, CPU, battery and storage.
You will contribute to a system that walks a constant tightrope: careful enough that it never loses data, fast enough that sync feels instant, and light enough that nobody notices it running. Day to day, you will design, implement, test and debug new features, quality safeguards and performance improvements. Initially, you will be paired with experts who will accompany you on scoped assignments, and you will build autonomy and ownership from there. You will collaborate closely with engineering teams worldwide, from kernel to cloud, across our operating systems and services stack, and external developers adopting our APIs throughout the industry.
Solid programming skills in a systems language such as C, C++, Objective-C or Swift
Working understanding of operating system fundamentals: processes, concurrency, memory, file I/O
Demonstrated ability to debug methodically
Clear written and verbal communication in English, and a collaborative approach to working across teams
Curiosity about how systems actually work underneath the abstractions
Experience reasoning about stateful systems that must stay correct across crashes, restarts, partial failures or concurrent mutation
Exposure to distributed systems concepts: eventual consistency, change tracking, reconciliation, conflict resolution
Familiarity with filesystems, APFS or otherwise, or with filesystem-adjacent system components
Experience with performance, memory or energy profiling
Experience maintaining an API or library that other developers depend on
Experience with agentic coding
Contributions to a large, long-lived codebase

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Music is becoming a first-class part of ElevenLabs Creative. You’ll own the UI that lets creators make it, working closely with Research to turn new music models into products people use the next day.

The open question is what the best interface for AI music creation looks like. Creators come for video, dubbing or ads, and music is part of that flow. Making a song from scratch, scoring a video and localising a track into other languages each need a different flow. You’ll form a view on the right experience, build it end to end, and make it easy to adopt each new model as it lands.

You’ll take an ambiguous problem, decompose it, and carry it through legal, design, engineering and launch with Growth. You’ll work in a small, high-ownership team across product, research and go-to-market.

Requirements

 - Strong Frontend experience: you’ve shipped complex, production UIs (React/TypeScript or equivalent) and are comfortable on the backend when the work needs it

 - You’ve owned ambiguous, zero-to-one product work from problem definition to launch, without a PM or a prescriptive backlog

 - You’ve worked closely with designers (Figma) and have taste and opinions about UX

 - You’ve worked across functions such as legal, safety, growth and design to ship, and keep stakeholders updated without prompting

 - You weigh trade-offs and make pragmatic decisions with no single right answer, and build so that new models can be swapped in as they land

Bonus

 - Music, audio or creative-tools experience, or music as a hobby (singing, an instrument, production)

 - Experience building media-heavy interfaces such as audio, video or timeline editors

 - Experience working with ML models or research teams


LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in Central European timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London, New York and Warsaw.

Intégré(e) au sein d’une unité regroupant les compétences
items.desc: Description du poste Domaine Systèmes d'information Contrat CDI Intitulé de l'offre Architecte logiciel IA H/F Statut du poste Cadre Description de l'offre La Direction des Applications Militaires du CEA, acteur clé de la souveraineté et de la compétitivité numérique pour la France, se mobilise pleinement autour des enjeux liés à l’Intelligence Artificielle. Intégré(e) au sein d’une unité regroupant les compétences nécessaires au développement et au déploiement sur nos réseaux sécurisés de défense de logiciels innovants avec des piles logicielles souveraines, vous contribuerez au développement et au passage à l’échelle de solutions d’IA générative, de RAG sur des bases documentaires scientifiques, de Data Lakehouse, de systèmes multi-agents ou d’adaptation de modèles de fondation. En tant qu’Architecte logiciel vous aurez la mission de définir et développer l’architecture technique des solutions logicielles client-serveur intégrant des services d’IA en garantissant la scalabilité, la performance, la sécurité et la maintenabilité des systèmes conçus. Les domaines d’intervention de votre équipe consisteront à : Proposer des architectures orientées événements robustes, modulaires et évolutives (Python, FastAPI), en maitrisant les patrons de conception et en vous appuyant sur une méthodologie SDD (Specification Driven Design) augmentée d’IA générative. Configurer, déployer et optimiser des moteurs d’inférence (vLLM) sur nos fermes GPU pour maximiser le débit (tokens/seconde) et minimiser la latence, en mesurant les performances et en appliquant des techniques d'optimisation (Quantification (INT8, INT4, FP16), pruning des modèles, PagedAttention, Batch inference, Offloading CPU). Concevoir les schémas de données (relationnels avec PostgreSQL, NoSQL avec MongoDB et stockage objet avec S3), en garantissant la sécurité et l'intégrité des données. Industrialiser les processus de développement (CI/CD, GitLab) et de déploiement (Docker, Kubernetes). Rejoindre le CEA c’est évoluer dans un environnement scientifique d’excellence au service de projets à forts enjeux tout en bénéficiant d’un cadre de travail équilibré. Parcours professionnels variés et accompagnés (formations, mobilité interne), équilibre vie pro/perso (jusqu’à 52 jours de congés/RTT) dispositifs d’épargne salariale et avantages facilitant le quotidien (restauration, transport, conciergerie, CSE, etc.). Avec un Family Score de 98%, le CEA est à la tête du Label Parents on board qui récompense notre engagement en matière de parentalité. Ce poste bénéficie de télétravail, conformément aux accords et modalités en vigueur au sein du CEA. Il est également possible d’occuper le poste à distance sur un autre centre CEA DAM, notamment au CESTA en Nouvelle Aquitaine. Conformément aux engagements pris par le CEA en faveur de l'intégration des personnes handicapées, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l'inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. #LI-RP1 Profil du candidat Titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 en école d'ingénieur ou en université spécialisé en informatique, vous justifiez d'une premiere expérience dans l'IA. Vous êtes à l'écoute et organisé, avec une capacité à fédérer. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos qualités de communication et la tenue des objectifs. Participant à la protection nationale, une enquête administrative est réalisée pour tous les salariés du CEA afin d'assurer l'intégrité et la sécurité de la nation. Localisation du poste Site DAM Île-de-France Localisation du poste France, Ile-de-France, Essonne (91) Ville 26 Rue de la Piquetterie, 91680 Bruyères-le-Châtel Demandeur Disponibilité du poste 01/09/2026 Informations générales Entité de rattachement La Direction des Applications Militaires (DAM) du CEA, au cœur des enjeux de la dissuasion nucléaire Française, cherche ses futurs talents. Organisme inclusif, le CEA est handi-accueillant : nos emplois sont ouverts à toutes et tous. Associer les forces et les compétences de chacun pour atteindre nos objectifs est l'une de nos valeurs partagée par nos 4 600 salariés, répartis sur 5 centres. Les 1 800 salariés du centre de Bruyères-le-Châtel, en Ile de France relèvent les défis scientifiques et technologiques au service de notre Sécurité Nationale. Le centre conçoit les charges nucléaires des armes de la dissuasion, garantit leur sécurité et leur fiabilité en s'appuyant sur le programme simulation. Il met son expertise technique au service des activités dans la lutte contre la prolifération nucléaire, le terrorisme et les alertes en cas de séisme ou de tsunami. Il assure l'ingénierie des infrastructures complexes de la DAM, de leur conception à leur démantèlement. Il co-développe avec Atos les supercalculateurs au meilleur niveau mondial, dont sont issus ceux du Très Grand Centre de Calcul du CEA, qu'il exploite pour ses missions Défense et gère au profit de la recherche. Enfin, il exploite les installations …

Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI. More than 1,000 brands trust Flip AI, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA and Greif. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down with a new $25M round , bringing our total funding to more than $85M . Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Job description We welcome applicants with a range of experience levels, from those a few years into their career to seasoned engineers. If you are just starting your career but already have experience working alongside your studies, we are also happy to talk to you. We’re looking for a Product Engineer with a strong backend specialization, a solid technical foundation, and experience working on SaaS products in Agile environments. You’ll help us build reliable, scalable product experiences, with deep ownership of backend systems while staying close to the full user journey. This role is for someone who is willing to extend their impact across the full stack, from APIs, data models, and infrastructure to the product’s user experience, using AI to bridge the gap where needed. You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering to turn ideas into high-quality shipped features. What you can expect Cross-functional Collaboration: You will join a product squad and work closely with designers, product managers, and experienced engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and AI. Shift in Software Engineering: Driven by AI, the role is moving toward end-to-end ownership—focusing on understanding user problems, shaping product decisions, rapid prototyping, and validating ideas, rather than just coding from strict specs. A Shared Transition: The company is undergoing this transformation itself; you aren't expected to have everything figured out from day one. Key Traits Valued: What matters most is your curiosity, adaptability, strong engineering judgment, and a genuine willingness to learn new ways of working. Growth and Support: You will receive the tools, practices, and team environment needed to evolve into a product-minded, AI-enabled engineer while continuing to deepen your technical expertise. What you bring to the table If you're excited about the role but don't tick every box, we still want to hear from you. Your attitude and willingness to learn matter more to us than matching every bullet. Backend Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Kotlin (or Java) and a web framework like Micronaut or Spring, ideally in a SaaS environment. Cross-stack Mindset: Backend is your home stack, and you're willing to step into web or mobile when a feature calls for it. Comfortable with AI Coding Tools: You use AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) as part of your workflow, or are eager to adopt them, to navigate unfamiliar codebases, bridge the gap to frontend, mobile, or infrastructure, and ship small, well-structured changes outside your home stack. Ownership: You think in terms of user impact, not tickets. You ask "what would actually help the user — or what would bring me closer to understanding that?" and see it through: a prototype, instrumentation on existing features, a conversation with a PM or Customer Success - whatever the question calls for. You carry features through to rollout and observe their impact. Nice to Haves: Experience pairing with designers or working directly from mockups/prototypes. Instrumentation and experimentation experience (A/B testing, Grafana, Mixpanel, etc.). Deployment with Kubernetes and Helm Experience with PostgreSQL. Experience with messaging systems (RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka). What we offer you Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview. Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing. Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere. Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip AI in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed. Happy to be a Flipster: …

Job Description As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet. What you can expect Technical ownership end to end: You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale. Integrations that make Flip AI load-bearing: You design and land identity and authentication (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), user provisioning (SCIM), REST APIs and connections into HR and ops systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG. Advise and enable instead of absorb: You bring the customer's IT, their partners and our external development partners to a solution you would sign off on, and you make sure they can run it without you. Build where building unblocks: Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick. AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them. Technical authority in the account: You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time. What you bring to the table Must-haves Around 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure. Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments. Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them. Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype. German at C1 level or above and fluent English. Nice-to-haves Provisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG. An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking for someone who follows the field closely and has an opinion, not for years of experience that cannot exist yet. Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only. Workflow automation tooling (n8n or similar), comfort with logs, metrics and dashboards, or experience with German co-determination and enterprise data protection. What we offer you Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. items.desc: Empower every employee. AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip AI is changing that. Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI. More than 1,000 brands trust Flip AI, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA and Greif. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down with a new $25M round , bringing our total funding to more than $85M . Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Job Description As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a tenant from nothing from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet. What you can expect Technical ownership end to end: You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale. Integrations that make Flip AI load-bearing: You design and land identity and authentication (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), user provisioning (SCIM), REST APIs and connections into HR and ops systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG. Advise and enable instead of absorb: You bring the customer's IT, their partners and our external development partners to a solution you would sign off on, and you make sure they can run it without you. Build where building unblocks: Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick. AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them. Technical authority in the account: You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time. What you bring to the table Must-haves Around 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure. Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments. Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them. Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype. German at C1 level or above and fluent English. Nice-to-haves Provisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG. An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only. items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day Join us as a Network Automation Engineer, where you will transform repetitive network tasks into efficient, software-driven workflows. Imagine building Infrastructure-as-Code modules, integrating a source of truth with controllers, and creating automated validation processes that enhance network reliability. You will collaborate with network architects, service owners, SRE, operations, and suppliers to streamline network platforms, making them faster, safer, and easier to use. Your focus will be on developing an engineering system that emphasizes controlled version management, reusable APIs, testing, observability, and controlled deployment. How You’ll Make an Impact Build and maintain reusable automation for campus, WAN, Data Center, DDI, and Secure Access platforms using declarative data models, APIs, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices. Establish version-controlled engineering workflows that include peer review, automated testing, policy checks, change validation, rollback, and configuration-compliance controls. Integrate network source-of-truth, IPAM/DDI, ITSM, controllers, telemetry, and supplier workflows to enable end-to-end orchestration and ensure accurate operational context. Convert high-volume manual activities and runbooks into standardized self-service workflows, reducing lead time, configuration drift, and dependency on individual experts. Create the technical foundation for AI-assisted and agentic NetOps by exposing trusted data, safe actions, audit trails, and measurable automation outcomes. Collaborate effectively across traditional network operations, architecture, SRE, and supplier teams to drive innovation and efficiency. What You Bring A university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. A solid understanding of enterprise networking, including routing, switching, IP services, and at least one area of campus, WAN, Data Center, DDI, or Network Security. Hands-on software and automation skills with Python, APIs, data structures, and automation frameworks such as Ansible, Terraform, Nornir, or comparable tools. Experience with enterprise version-control and configuration-management practices, CI/CD, declarative infrastructure workflows, automated testing, secrets management, code review, and traceable infrastructure changes. Knowledge of network data models and interfaces such as YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, OpenConfig, and vendor APIs is highly desirable. An engineering mindset centered on reusable products, documentation, testing, security, maintainability, and measurable reduction of manual toil. Who is Siemens Energy? The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. items.card: The role Mechatronics Engineers at CircuitHub own projects end to end. You'll start with a problem, often on our factory floor, and take it all the way to a working machine: Understand the problem and turn it into a clear specification Generate ideas and choose the right mechanism Design it in CAD and prove it out with the engineering calculations Prototype and build it, machining parts in our in-house CNC shop
items.desc: About CircuitHub CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries. We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies. The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further. The role Mechatronics Engineers at CircuitHub own projects end to end. You'll start with a problem, often on our factory floor, and take it all the way to a working machine: Understand the problem and turn it into a clear specification Generate ideas and choose the right mechanism Design it in CAD and prove it out with the engineering calculations Prototype and build it, machining parts in our in-house CNC shop Bring it to life with software on our in-house robotics operating system We work AI-first. AI tools help you scope the problem, drive your CAD, run the calculations and write the machine software. The software side needs basic software engineering skills, not a software background: you'll write it with AI agents, supported by a dedicated software engineering team who build the operating system. You must have built things before, ideally robots, whether as a hobbyist, student, employee or founder. We don't hire narrow specialists. We want engineers who can: Diagnose system-wide failures from first principles Prototype mechanical and software fixes on the fly Work autonomously and communicate clearly with a team spread across sites Take responsibility for how their machines perform in live production Things you'll do This is a design role with hands-on prototyping. For example: Conceive new mechanisms to handle electronics parts and other robotic handling tasks, using AI to scope and specify the problem Design gantries and end effectors in Fusion 360 Use AI agents to run the engineering calculations, and know when to distrust them Machine prototype parts in our in-house CNC shop Analyse end-effector behaviour from video and revise its geometry and control approach to improve throughput and reliability Program machine behaviour on our in-house robotics operating system, with AI agents doing the heavy lifting Specify sensors that catch errors while a machine is running, or monitor a chemical process Prototype and deploy a new test robot for in-line PCB validation Commission your machines and hand them over to our build team to scale up Work across our US and UK sites to share what you've learned and shape the roadmap Bonus skills Experience programming machines, whether PLCs, robot controllers, embedded systems or Python Programming and running CNC machinery Design of chemical handling machinery Optics Pay and level £45K–£125K depending on experience, plus equity. A candidate at the lower end of the range might have: Built some systems before, with some exposure to robotics or automation Seen parts and subsystems through to manufacture as part of a design team Knowledge of designing for machining A keen interest in moving their career towards practical robotics A candidate at the upper end might also have: Led the build and deployment of large-scale automated systems Written the software that controls their own machines Designed for a wide range of manufacturing methods, from machining to sheet metal to injection moulding Mentored more junior engineers The range isn't a hard limit: if you're an expert in all of the above, we still want to talk to you. Not quite so experienced but passionate and keen to learn? Talk to us too. Location Full-time on-site at one of our UK sites: Cambridge: our central Cambridge site, alongside the team designing, building and expanding the Grid. London: our London site. Compensation Range: £45K - £125K

 un niveau d’autonomie technique

 → une part de la marge générée par ta mission t’est redistribuée.

 Pas de flou.

 un système de points convertibles en euros valorise l’engagement transverse.

 Ce qui est valorisé est concret.

items.desc: Le Centre hospitalier régional universitaire de Nancy est l’établissement public de santé de référence pour la population lorraine. Classé 6ème meilleur hôpital de France (Le Point), le CHRU de Nancy compte plus de 9 600 professionnels et 1 300 étudiants en santé. Les équipes hospitalo-universitaires s’impliquent au quotidien dans le soin, la formation, la recherche et innovation, la santé publique et l’éducation à la santé. Elles ont collectivement identifié 4 valeurs pour définir leur façon de travailler, de collaborer, d’accueillir et de soigner : bienveillance, respect, engagement et faire équipe. Près de 150 métiers contribuent au fonctionnement de l’hôpital. Aux côtés des professions médicales, paramédicales et médico-techniques, on retrouve de nombreux secteurs : administration, finances, achats, qualité, ressources humaines, transformation numérique, biomédical, activités logistiques, techniques et sécurité. Employeur handi-accueillant, le CHRU de Nancy s’engage en faveur de l’intégration et du maintien dans l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. Pour améliorer son fonctionnement, l’accueil des usagers et les conditions de travail des professionnels, le CHRU de Nancy se transforme sur le plan architectural et organisationnel avec la mise en service d’un nouvel ensemble hospitalo-universitaire à horizon 2032. Choisir le Service Public. Choisir le CHRU de Nancy. Le Poste LE PÔLE/DÉPARTEMENT – SERVICE : Service d’Evaluation et d’Information Médicale Le CHRU De Nancy Se Dote En 2026 D’une Stratégie Intelligence Artificielle – Programme Puls’IA - Pour Donner Les Lignes Directrices Du Déploiement De L’intelligence Artificielle Afin De Répondre à Trois Principaux Enjeux Amélioration du parcours de soin par l’innovation et la recherche Optimisation du pilotage opérationnel avec une responsabilité sociale et environnementale Renforcement de la qualité de vie au travail en déchargeant des tâches administratives Cette stratégie s’attache à tirer pleinement partie de cette technologie au service des patients et des agents tout en maitrisant ses risques. Dans ce cadre, le SEIM (Service d’Evaluation et d’information Médicale) participe au développement du projet Patient Voice, qui vise à produire des indicateurs automatisés permettant de mieux capturer la qualité des soins perçue par les patients, à partir de sources de données multiples. Le.la candidat.e retenu.e évoluera dans cette équipe. Le SEIM du CHRU de Nancy regroupe deux unités fonctionnelles : Le Département d’Information Médicale (DIM) : Le DIM a pour mission principale la production et l’optimisation de l’information médicale qui contribue au financement de l’établissement. Il participe également à la production d’indicateurs de suivi de l’activité médicale et à la réutilisation des données pour d’autres usages. Il est également responsable de l’accès aux dossiers médicaux par les patients. L’unité d’évaluation Elle est responsable du recueil, du suivi et de l’analyse des indicateurs de qualité des soins au sein de l’établissement Elle est en charge de la définition, de la mise en œuvre et de l’évaluation de programme d’éducation thérapeutique Ces deux unités regroupent les compétences nécessaires pour définir, suivre et évaluer des indicateurs de qualité et développer les méthodes de traitement de l’information permettant de mesurer ces indicateurs de façon automatisées à partir des données de santé. FONCTIONS ET ACTIVITÉS Missions Répondre aux besoins métiers en menant des projets IA de bout en bout soit en utilisant des solutions sur étagère soit en développant des solutions spécifiques. Eclairer des choix techniques et fonctionnels à la lumière d’études médico-économiques et s’assurer de la pérennité des déploiements. Fiabiliser et professionnaliser les développements internes en participant aux choix des stacks techniques, des infrastructures et des algorithmes d’IA. Assurer le maintien en condition opérationnel des solutions déployées. Accompagner les agents du CHRU dans la démocratisation de l’utilisation de l’IA dans leurs activités. Activités principales Identification et qualification des besoins métiers ; identification, collecte et traitement des données dans le respect des exigences de qualité, de sécurité, de confidentialité et d’éthique ; Participation à l’analyse des données et la production d’indicateurs pour le projet Patient Voice ; assurer le suivi opérationnel, technique et scientifique des travaux ; Rédaction des cahiers des charges et des documents techniques de conception ; Contribution aux choix techniques, aux développements, aux tests et à la mise en production ; Réalisation d’une veille scientifique et technologique continue ; Profil Recherché LE PROFIL RECHERCHÉ/ CAPACITÉS REQUISES Rattachement hiérarchique : Responsable équipe Innovations Numériques Formation supérieure (Bac+5) en traitement de l’information médicale avec une spécialisée en IA. items.desc: Creatio is an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale. We help midsize and large organizations run customer workflows in the AI era. With a global team and a large ecosystem of partners, Creatio serves thousands of customers in over 100 countries and automates tens of millions of workflows daily. Genuine care for our clients and partners is at the heart of our DNA. We’re proud to be recognized by top industry analysts as a Leader and Strong Performer in multiple Gartner and Forrester reports. In 2025, Creatio was named to Inc.’s Best Workplaces list , recognizing our commitment to employee wellbeing and a strong workplace culture. Who We’re Looking For We are looking for an AI Software Engineer to design, build, evaluate, and operate AI-powered capabilities within the Creatio platform. This is an AI-first engineering role: you will spend most of your time designing agents, engineering prompts and context, building retrieval and evaluation pipelines, and directing AI coding agents - with solid .NET engineering as the foundation rather than the whole job. You will join the AI teams building the agent platform that enables AI agents to safely perform real work in the product: call tools and APIs, read and write data, maintain context and memory, follow permissions, and escalate to humans when needed. The team also owns the core infrastructure for evaluation, monitoring, logging, observability, and cost/performance control, ensuring AI agents are reliable, scalable, secure, and production-ready. This role combines strong software engineering expertise with hands-on AI engineering experience. You will work on enterprise-grade AI solutions, including assistants, copilots, knowledge systems, semantic search, RAG-based capabilities, and agentic workflows - and you will use AI coding agents as your primary daily development workflow. Responsibilities Design and implement AI-powered product features within the Creatio platform: assistants, copilots, agentic workflows, knowledge systems, RAG, and semantic search. Design agent architectures - tools, memory and context strategy, orchestration, permissions, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop escalation - and choose the right pattern for each problem (single LLM call vs. tool-using agent vs. multi-agent). Engineer prompts, system instructions, and agent context as first-class artifacts: versioned, reviewed, and covered by evaluations. Integrate LLM providers, MCP servers and tools, enterprise data sources, embedding pipelines, and vector/hybrid search into the platform. Build evaluation datasets, offline and online evals, quality gates, and observability (tracing, logging, drift detection) for AI capabilities. Monitor and improve the quality, latency, cost, reliability, and security of AI capabilities in production, including prompt and model updates. Identify and mitigate AI-specific risks: prompt injection, data exfiltration through tools, hallucinations, over-permissioned agents, and sensitive-data leakage. Develop and maintain backend services using C# and .NET. Use AI coding assistants and engineering agents as the default development workflow; critically review and verify agent output; contribute reusable rules, skills, and prompts to the team. Follow the AI landscape closely and bring new models, tools, and patterns to the team. Requirements Must have: Hands-on experience shipping LLM-based features to production: prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, context-window and cost management. Practical understanding of agent architectures (tool loops, planner/executor, multi-agent, human-in-the-loop), MCP, and at least one agent framework or SDK. Working knowledge of RAG: chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, grounding and citations, and common failure modes. Experience with AI evaluation (datasets, offline evals, LLM-as-judge), LLM observability and tracing, and AI security (prompt injection, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, Responsible AI practices). Daily proficiency with AI coding agents: the ability to direct, review, and verify agent output rather than only write code by hand. Solid experience with C# and .NET, API design, distributed systems, and software architecture. Experience with SQL databases, automated testing, CI/CD, and cloud-native development; Docker and basic Kubernetes. Strong knowledge of engineering best practices and production-grade software development. Nice To Have Python for prototyping, data work, and evaluation scripting. Hands-on experience with a major AI platform (Anthropic API, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI). Experience building agent-facing tools or MCP servers. LLMOps practices: prompt and model versioning, evaluation gates in CI/CD, canary rollouts of prompt changes. Fine-tuning, distillation, or adapter-based model customization. Experience with Creatio or other low-code CRM platforms. What To Expect …

items.desc: This role is hybrid for one of the following cities: Bucharest, Iași, Brașov Salary: 17 000 - 25 000 RON net/month, individual contract of work Please note that it is mandatory to have experience with GCP (Google Cloud Platform) and Python. How you’ll make an impact: You’ll turn research-grade prototypes into a dependable, governed ML service on GCP. Your work will define how quickly we can iterate on synthetic generation approaches without sacrificing reproducibility, security, or methodological rigor. In practice, you will: Enable Reliable AI: Your pipelines will provide the clean, structured data required to train our core generative models. By ensuring data availability and reliability, you directly support the accuracy and fairness of our machine learning outputs. Power LLM Applications: By building robust vector indexing and retrieval (RAG) infrastructure, you will provide our LLM-based synthetic personas with the context and grounding they need to operate effectively and hallucinate less. The Synthetic Data Research team is building next-generation platform for Improve ML Iteration Speed: By optimizing data I/O and standardizing how our models consume datasets, you will eliminate training bottlenecks. This allows our Applied Scientists to run experiments more efficiently and deploy models faster. Ensure Data Integrity: In systems relying on statistical weighting and synthetic generation, data quality is critical. Your work implementing strict data contracts and automated validation will prevent bad data from silently corrupting downstream models and evaluation metrics. Connect Engineering and Research: You will serve as a key link between traditional data engineering and applied machine learning, translating the complex data requirements of ML research into scalable, maintainable infrastructure. Tech stack & ecosystem: You will be the backbone of our ML platform, building everything from user-facing interfaces down to the data layers that feed our models: - Platform & API: Python, FastAPI, React, TypeScript. - Data Warehousing & Storage: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Apache Parquet / Arrow. - Data & ML Orchestration: dbt, Apache Airflow, Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP), Asynchronous Job Queues (Celery/RabbitMQ). - Unstructured Data & GenAI: Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate), modern RAG tooling (LangChain, LlamaIndex). - Data Quality & Contracts: Pydantic, Great Expectations, strict JSON Schema validation. What You’ll Do - Own the API & Platform Layer: Design, build, and maintain the robust backend APIs (FastAPI) that serve as the bridge between our React frontend and our asynchronous, heavy-compute machine learning pipelines. - Build the User Interface: Develop and maintain features in our React frontend, creating intuitive platform dashboards that allow users to design ML experiments, trigger data augmentation jobs, and visualize synthetic data metrics. - Architect ML Data Pipelines: Build and maintain high-throughput ETL/ELT pipelines capable of ingesting massive tabular datasets directly into our Kubeflow training and inference workflows. - Build the RAG Foundation: Develop the data pipelines that power our LLM digital twins. You will handle chunking, embedding generation, and vector indexing of unstructured text to enable highly accurate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). - Optimize ML Data I/O: Optimize how our PyTorch models read and write data, leveraging columnar formats (Parquet) and distributed processing to eliminate I/O bottlenecks during training and generation. - Enforce Strict Data Contracts: Ensure seamless communication between the frontend, backend, and ML workers by implementing strict data contracts (using Pydantic) and automated schema validation.

items.desc: Who We Are A lot of enterprise work still happens by hand. People copy-paste between spreadsheets, live in endless email threads and click through clunky legacy UIs. We started Duvo to end that for good. Customers already trust us with business-critical processes, and our agents are automating them today. We're growing fast, and to win from here we need exceptional people. That's where you come in. We're a team of 60, with 22 engineers, and we just raised a $32 million Series A led by Balderton Capital. What We Are Building Duvo is the AI operations platform for large enterprises. Right now we're focused on retail and consumer packaged goods. Customers build AI agents in Duvo that do the work wherever it lives: SAP, spreadsheets, supplier portals, email, APIs, you name it. We're heavy on browser and computer use. Business users say what outcome they want. The agents plan, act, ask for approval on exceptions and get better with every run. To help customers figure out what to automate, we also map their processes from interviews and internal docs, which gets our foot in the door. We start with the parts of a company we know best (category management, supply chain, finance ops), where we can show value fast, and expand from there to other functions and sectors. Velocity is our moat. We ship fast and iterate even faster. The Role You'll own user-facing features and the systems behind them end to end, live in production and measured by customer impact. You connect technical choices to what customers actually get. Product engineers at Duvo are intense about delivering impact fast. You also get to work directly with our enterprise customers. You'll deliver specific pieces for them and talk to them when it helps. That said, we don't expect you to be a polished presenter on day one. You don't need retail or CPG expertise, but you should be curious about how our customers' businesses actually work. What We're Looking For These are the non-negotiables, and it's what we'll evaluate you on: Shipping and ownership. You've taken ambiguous requirements to production across the whole feature (UI, API, data, deployment), more than once. You don't wait for someone to tell you what to build next. You set your own scope based on customer problems and ship it within a week. Product judgment. You can scope an MVP, pick the metric that matters and kill work that isn't delivering. You think about what the user needs before what's technically interesting. You can explain the tradeoff between shipping fast and going deep, and you can tell us what your work was worth to the customer or the business, beyond how it works. AI-native. You use AI every day to build. Think coding agents, often several running in parallel in Claude Code or Codex. You still own the quality, also when the reviews and tests are AI-written. Product quality. You care how a feature looks and feels. When something is off, you notice and you fix it. Collaboration. You work across functions. You align early with product and design, pull in people from other teams whenever you're missing context, and unblock yourself and others. You Might Also Have designed and run distributed systems that scale, with a good sense for security and reliability in production. Have built LLM products: features on top of LLM outputs or AI agents (parsing agent responses, human-in-the-loop flows), ideally in production with eval design, prompt engineering, safety controls and cost optimization. You won't be training models either way. Have designed interfaces for AI-assisted workflows, like confidence signals. This Is Not For You If You need a lot of hand-holding, or figuring things out yourself doesn't give you energy. You mostly want to work on infrastructure. Check out our SRE and AI Platform Engineer roles instead. You only want to do frontend without owning the full feature path. Location We're looking for people based in Europe, in European time zones, so we overlap for most of the working day. Our Tech Stack TypeScript first: Next.js, React, Tailwind, Fastify, Kysely (PostgreSQL), Zod GCP, Datadog Latest AI primitives (Anthropic) You don't need to know all of it. You should be excited to pick it up fast. How We Work These are real tradeoffs we made: Initiative-driven. We organize around customer problems instead of org charts. Problems come from product feedback, competitive analysis and talking to customers directly. Then we prioritize, build and ship every week. Customer-obsessed. We work on real problems for real customers, not hypothetical ones. Iterative by default. We ship small, learn fast and don't get attached to yesterday's code. Things break sometimes, and we fix forward. AI first. We use AI to go faster and spend human time where it really matters. If a tool can do it, a person shouldn't. Direct feedback. We tell each other right away what to improve. It can feel uncomfortable, and we think it's worth it. Autonomy with accountability. We trust people to make the call, …

Interacts with product and service teams to identify questions and issues for data analysis and experiments. This includes the design, development and deployment of statistical predictive models. - Understands and complies with Risk Management program requirements including Identification of risks, key controls, and control testing as applicable to their responsibilities. - Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics. items.desc: Creatio is an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together — with no limits on users, agents, or scale. We help midsize and large organizations run customer workflows in the AI era. With a global team and a large ecosystem of partners, Creatio serves thousands of customers in over 100 countries and automates tens of millions of workflows daily. Genuine care for our clients and partners is at the heart of our DNA. We’re proud to be recognized by top industry analysts as a Leader and Strong Performer in multiple Gartner and Forrester reports. In 2025, Creatio was named to Inc.’s Best Workplaces list , recognizing our commitment to employee wellbeing and a strong workplace culture. Who We’re Looking For We are looking for an AI Software Engineer to design, build, evaluate, and operate AI-powered capabilities within the Creatio platform. This is an AI-first engineering role: you will spend most of your time designing agents, engineering prompts and context, building retrieval and evaluation pipelines, and directing AI coding agents - with solid .NET engineering as the foundation rather than the whole job. You will join the AI teams building the agent platform that enables AI agents to safely perform real work in the product: call tools and APIs, read and write data, maintain context and memory, follow permissions, and escalate to humans when needed. The team also owns the core infrastructure for evaluation, monitoring, logging, observability, and cost/performance control, ensuring AI agents are reliable, scalable, secure, and production-ready. This role combines strong software engineering expertise with hands-on AI engineering experience. You will work on enterprise-grade AI solutions, including assistants, copilots, knowledge systems, semantic search, RAG-based capabilities, and agentic workflows - and you will use AI coding agents as your primary daily development workflow. Responsibilities Design and implement AI-powered product features within the Creatio platform: assistants, copilots, agentic workflows, knowledge systems, RAG, and semantic search. Design agent architectures - tools, memory and context strategy, orchestration, permissions, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop escalation - and choose the right pattern for each problem (single LLM call vs. tool-using agent vs. multi-agent). Engineer prompts, system instructions, and agent context as first-class artifacts: versioned, reviewed, and covered by evaluations. Integrate LLM providers, MCP servers and tools, enterprise data sources, embedding pipelines, and vector/hybrid search into the platform. Build evaluation datasets, offline and online evals, quality gates, and observability (tracing, logging, drift detection) for AI capabilities. Monitor and improve the quality, latency, cost, reliability, and security of AI capabilities in production, including prompt and model updates. Identify and mitigate AI-specific risks: prompt injection, data exfiltration through tools, hallucinations, over-permissioned agents, and sensitive-data leakage. Develop and maintain backend services using C# and .NET. Use AI coding assistants and engineering agents as the default development workflow; critically review and verify agent output; contribute reusable rules, skills, and prompts to the team. Follow the AI landscape closely and bring new models, tools, and patterns to the team. Requirements Must have: Hands-on experience shipping LLM-based features to production: prompt engineering, function/tool calling, structured outputs, context-window and cost management. Practical understanding of agent architectures (tool loops, planner/executor, multi-agent, human-in-the-loop), MCP, and at least one agent framework or SDK. Working knowledge of RAG: chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, grounding and citations, and common failure modes. Experience with AI evaluation (datasets, offline evals, LLM-as-judge), LLM observability and tracing, and AI security (prompt injection, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, Responsible AI practices). Daily proficiency with AI coding agents: the ability to direct, review, and verify agent output rather than only write code by hand. Solid experience with C# and .NET, API design, distributed systems, and software architecture. Experience with SQL databases, automated testing, CI/CD, and cloud-native development; Docker and basic Kubernetes. Strong knowledge of engineering best practices and production-grade software development. Nice To Have Python for prototyping, data work, and evaluation scripting. Hands-on experience with a major AI platform (Anthropic API, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI). Experience building agent-facing tools or MCP servers. LLMOps practices: prompt and model versioning, evaluation gates in CI/CD, canary rollouts of prompt changes. Fine-tuning, distillation, or adapter-based model customization. Experience with Creatio or other low-code CRM platforms. What To Expect …

Vuono Group is now looking for Full Stack Data Scientists to join our growing team of experts in Helsinki. Vuono Group is a consultancy that drives business value with processes and AI. We empower Nordic organisations in both the private and public sectors to bridge the gap between business needs and AI capabilities, enabling smarter decision-making, increased operational efficiency, and accelerated growth. About The Role As a Full Stack Data Scientist, you are interested in what happens under the hood of modern data solutions and data architectures. You care about data quality, usability and the value it can provide for various business processes. You're experienced with data science and engineering practices, including data observability, implementing MLOps (maybe even LLMOps) workflows and real-time data processing. You understand the intersection of ML/AI systems and data engineering and can build scalable pipelines that support both analytical and operational use cases. Experience with cloud-native data architectures (e.g. Azure, AWS, GCP) is essential. At Vuono Group, you will get to work in a cross-competence team making our clients' businesses more intelligent with data. In practice, this means building data pipelines, integrating systems together, and utilising ML and AI for insights and operational use cases. What We’re Looking For Experience in planning and building production level data solutions that solve real business problems An analytical mindset and problem-solving skills Machine learning modeling and/or natural language processing experience Experience in designing and implementing end-to-end data pipelines that transform raw operational data into business-ready information products Experience in running and monitoring production workloads Programming experience in Python and SQL Willingness and readiness to learn and operate with new technology platforms, tools, whether low code like Celonis or Fabric or pro code like new cloud infrastructure MSc degree in Machine Learning, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or similar Professional-level Finnish and English language proficiency The Following Is Considered a Plus Interest in continuously learning and applying new technologies and platforms; generative AI, RAG, AI Agents, among others Experience with various tech stacks, e.g. AWS Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, DBT, Apache Kafka, Terraform, or similar Experience in utilising data from business technology platforms, such as ERP, CRM or similar (SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.) Experience in transforming data for process and content intelligence purposes Previous consulting experience You don’t need to tick every box! What matters most is your drive to make a real impact! What We Offer We are building the best work environment for data, AI and business process professionals. To get there, we invest in the well-being and work-life balance as well as the professional development of our people. Our recruitment process typically includes at least two interviews, giving you the chance to meet some of our team members and giving us the opportunity to get to know you better: as a professional, a colleague, and a person. Reference checks are also a standard part of our process. We look forward to hearing from you! Vuono Group is a process AI company. We create superior business processes through data and AI. Our growing team of kind and ambitious people is on a mission to turn AI into real, measurable business impact. Take the next step, explore our open positions and connect with us to find your next opportunity!

Trabalhar com equipas multidisciplinares para identificar casos de uso e implementar soluções baseadas em IA. Garantir boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes, versionamento e integração contínua. Explorar novas ferramentas e abordagens para melhorar a eficiência e a qualidade das soluções desenvolvidas. O TEU CONTRIBUTO As nossas pessoas são a nossa maior força. Cada indivíduo contribui com perspetivas únicas que nos tornam mais fortes como equipa e como organização. (obrigatório) IDIOMAS Português (obrigatório) Inglês (preferencial) Espanhol (preferencial) Hard Skills Conhecimentos em linguagens de programação como Python, SQL e Java. (obrigatório) Experiência com bibliotecas e frameworks de IA. (preferencial) Containers (Docker, Kubernetes). (preferencial) Prompt Engineering. (preferencial) OpenAI (preferencial) RAG (preferencial) Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git). (preferencial) Conhecimento em computação cloud (Azure, Aws). (preferencial) Conhecimento com ferramentas de CI/CD como GitHub Actions, GOCD ou similares. (preferencial) Soft Skills Atitude proativa e dinâmica. Oferecemos mais do que um salário. Os nossos benefícios foram concebidos para apoiar a tua vida, os teus objetivos e o teu bem-estar, agora e no futuro. A tua saúde é a nossa prioridade. Por isso, oferecemos licença parental, apoio à infância e programas adaptados a cada fase da vida. items.desc: About Customs Support Group Customs Support Group (CSG) is the European market leader in customs services, operating across 15 countries. CSG is owned by private equity and a fast-growing, dynamic, data-driven company, dedicated to expanding its presence through strong organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Its key priorities include digital transformation, operational excellence and customer experience, all aimed at driving growth and enhancing efficiency. The Role You will take our AI stack and lead its development and customisation for the market. This is a builder and do-er role. You will design, test and implement practical and compliant agentic AI solutions on top of foundation models document understanding, classification support, retrieval over our own procedures and tariff material, and agents that carry multi-step operational work end to end. You are not being asked to train models from scratch. You are being asked to make models that already exist behave reliably enough that operations staff trust them with customs declarations, where being wrong has consequences. Working closely with Operations, Transformation, IT and Group teams, you will turn business needs into scalable solutions. Key Responsibilities Develop and customise AI solutions for the market, from prototype through to production ownership. Be curious and prepared to self-learn to use generative-AI to build agents that make a difference to our business Identify automation and decision-support opportunities across customs and business processes, and size them honestly before building. Design solutions using generative AI and large language models — retrieval, tool calling, structured extraction from customs documentation, and agentic workflows where they genuinely fit. Own the evaluation. Define how we know a solution is working before it ships, and how we know a change has not made it worse. This is treated as core to the role, not an afterthought. Manage pilots and implementation, and set the criteria for killing a pilot as clearly as the criteria for scaling it. Monitor performance, inference cost, latency and business impact. Collaborate with local teams, Group functions and technology partners. Contribute to privacy, security and AI governance compliance, working with Group Legal and IT Security. You should understand how the EU AI Act applies to what you build, and be able to produce the documentation that goes with it. Requirements Essential 1-2 years AI engineering, software engineering or intelligent automation, including LLM or AI features that real users depended on. Strong Python and SQL, with production code ownership. Not familiarity. Demonstrable experience integrating large language models into production systems — prompt and context design, retrieval-augmented generation, structured output, and handling failure gracefully. Practical experience with at least one major cloud AI platform (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex). Solid full stack backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, testing, CI/CD. Most of this job is Strong communication skills — you will spend real time with operations staff who are experts in customs and not in AI. Professional fluency in English. Desirable Evaluation engineering: building eval harnesses and regression suites for non-deterministic systems, LLM-as-judge approaches, and human-in-the-loop review design. This is the single strongest signal we look for and we will weight it heavily. Context engineering: designing and version-controlling what a model sees — retrieval strategy, memory, tool descriptions, and policy layers that constrain what an agent is allowed to do. Agent orchestration frameworks and standards (LangGraph, MCP, Temporal or equivalent), and experience with long-running or multi-step agent workflows. Observability and cost control for inference at volume. What success looks like in your first year By month three: You understand our customs processes well enough to challenge what we ask for, and you have shipped one small, useful thing. By month six: At least one AI solution is live, measured against a baseline, and demonstrably better than what it replaced. By month twelve: There is a working evaluation process others can use, a ranked pipeline of next opportunities, and at least two colleagues outside IT operating what you have built without you in the room. What We Offer A key role in shaping AI capabilities. The opportunity to build solutions with direct business impact, on real operational volume rather than pilots that never leave the lab. An international and fast-evolving environment, with peers in other Customs Support Group markets working on the same problems. Professional growth opportunities, including a budget for conferences, certification and model/compute costs for your own experiments. Permanent role. Hybrid working. How to apply Send us your CV and a short note a few paragraphs is plenty describing one system you have put in front of …

The role turns operational needs into structured requirements, analyses processes, data and workflows, and identifies opportunities to improve service delivery, reporting, AI enablement and transformation execution across internal functions. Build or support dashboards, reports and management views for transformation progress, operating model performance and service improvement. Conduct data quality checks and document assumptions, definitions and limitations to support reliable decision-making. Prepare concise communication, training and decision materials for stakeholders and senior leadership. Contribute to reusable standards, methodologies and artefacts that improve how Synpulse delivers transformation initiatives. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. we operate in 3 markets as one Central European business, so there are many opportunities for growth and development Solid Business Background with more than 100 proud years of company history We are a Great Team , and we are not fond of any formalities here Modern Office with great location (e.g.: free parking) Flexible working policy You will be responsible for -
