items.desc: The SAL MicroFab is looking for a motivated R&D Process Engineer focusing on stepper-based lithography processes to join the team. As an R&D Process Engineer, you will take on challenging and responsible tasks with corresponding decision-making scope. You will work independently across all required activities, continuously expand your skill set, and contribute to the growing success of the team. Your Future Tasks Include Develop, optimize, and maintain stepper-based lithography processes for a diverse multi-project R&D environment. Establish repeatable process baselines and maintain control through SPC and routine performance monitoring. Define and document process parameters, recipes, and SOPs to support repeatable user operation. Own stepper tool and periphery equipment, ensuring high uptime and consistent performance for multiple technologies and flows. Work closely with process engineers and users to ensure lithography compatibility across varied fabrication flows. Work closely with equipment maintenance engineers to ensure tool health. Lead hands-on troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement in a fast-changing R&D setting. Support tool upgrades, new installations, and capability expansion projects. Your Profile Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related field. 5 years of experience as a stepper process engineer in an industrial or applied research semiconductor FAB; more experience is of advantage. Hands-on experience with lithography process & metrology tools. Hands on experience with lithography Tracks - advantage Understanding in mask design – advantage Proven experience with methodologies - process control, SPC, Problem Solving, CIP, Lean, equipment maintenance principles, etc. Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a research-driven environment supporting multiple stakeholders. Excellent teamwork, communication, reporting, and organizational skills. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic R&D setting. items.desc: kausable is moving from a pure research lab toward products used by real customers. As our software engineer for product and enablement, you own two scopes, and serve two types of customers: external ones (product) and internal ones (enablement/tooling). Product : externally shipped functionality. This is the software layer around our AI: the applications through which users interact with our AI and the delivery infrastructure that unlocks them. This entails quality assurance before and after delivery, for the technical/software axis as well as the machine-learning/capability axis. Enablement : internal platforms and tools, developer workflows; in a sense products where the customers are your research-science colleagues. The boundary with our Harness Engineer is deliberate. That role owns building and improving the ML capabilities. You own the adaptable software systems through which users experience those capabilities. Tasks Build customer-facing applications and integrations from scoping through delivery. Assure the quality of our products: before and after delivery, technical (software) and capability (machine-learning performance). Design APIs, workflows and frontend interfaces that keep complex model capabilities usable. Act as a technical bridge between researchers, product stakeholders and the people using what we build. Contain technical debt through thoughtful abstractions, testing and documentation. Design the delivery pipelines, versioning and observability needed across training, evaluation and live inference. Own model releases, monitoring and rollback patterns as the production footprint grows. Build internal platforms and tools that reduce setup time and cognitive load for researchers. Improve researcher experience through reproducible environments, CI/CD, automation and clear repository standards. Requirements Broad software engineering experience across backend and infrastructure. Deep understanding of software design and complexity management: you build systems that remain easy to change. Strong Python skills plus TypeScript, JavaScript or another modern frontend language. Experience with containers, cloud infrastructure and production delivery. Experience with quality measurements and assurance of ML capabilities. A track record of customer-facing or cross-functional project work. Clear communication, strong problem solving and a pragmatic, self-directed operating style. We are primarily hiring at senior level. We are also open to exceptional candidates with fewer years of experience who can demonstrate comparable depth, judgment and ownership. Nice to have: Security, privacy or on-premise deployment requirements. C++ or Rust for performance-sensitive services and tooling. Enough exposure to ML systems to collaborate productively with researchers without being expected to build models. Internal developer platforms, research tooling or ML infrastructure. Experiment tracking, data tooling or reproducible compute environments. Benefits 🚀 Where This Can Go You will shape how kausable builds and ships software as we scale: the architecture, tooling, standards and developer experience. The role can grow into ownership of our platform and internal engineering, or into leadership of customer-facing product delivery. The hard part is balancing both horizons: helping the team move today while keeping the system adaptable tomorrow. 🫂 Our Culture We are "Putting Science at the Core of AI" — with all its curiosity, daringness, and humanity. That means we: are scientists at heart, with a builder's mindset, are open to challenge, grounded in curiosity and respect, welcome diverse perspectives and value thoughtful, open debate, focus on outcomes and real-world impact, foster an environment of support, inspiration, and freedom for everyone to do their best work. 🏆 Perks & Benefits VSOP equity: a real stake in what we build. 30 days of paid holiday per year. Statutory social insurance. Conference travel and role-relevant learning. Flexible hybrid work, with roughly one in-person team meet-up per month. A high-end laptop of your choice. ⚒️ Tools and Infrastructure Python and a modern frontend stack. Docker, AWS, GCP, Hetzner, RunPod or comparable infrastructure. CI/CD, testing and developer-tooling systems. AI agents such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini in daily work. 🫶 Sounds like it's for you? Send us your favorite way to drink coffee along with your CV or LinkedIn, and we'll get back to you soon. If it's a match, we'll get to know each other over a number of online interviews, followed by an onsite day where we go in depth. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

items.desc: The University of Vienna is a community of almost 11,000 individuals, including approximately 7,700 academic staff members, who passionately pursue answers to the profound questions that shape our future. They represent individuals driven by curiosity and a relentless pursuit of excellence. With us, they find the space to try things out and unfold their potential. Are you inspired by their passion and determination? We are currently seeking a/an University assistant predoctoral - Vienna Network for Atmospheric Research (VINAR) 51 Faculty of Physics Startdate: 01.11.2026 | Working hours: 30 | Collective bargaining agreement: 48 VwGr. B1 Grundstufe (praedoc) Limited until: 31.10.2030 Reference no.: 6233 Are you interested in experimental aerosol physics, in-situ measurements, and both laboratory and field work? If so, join the Aerosol Physics and Environmental Physics (AEP) Group to investigate understudied aerosol components across urban and remote environments. As a pre-doc, you will be part of the AEP Group around Professor Bernadett Weinzierl. The AEP Group combines highly sophisticated laboratory, ground-based and aircraft measurements with innovative modelling to study the fundamental physical and chemical properties of aerosol particles and clouds. Current research covers various areas of aerosol science and spans the whole size spectrum from the nano- to the microscale. We are looking for a motivated pre-doctoral scientist to extend our team. The employment duration is 4 years. Your Personal Sphere Of Influence As a pre-doc university assistant in this 4-year position, you will be part of the Aerosol Physics and Environmental Physics Group around Professor Bernadett Weinzierl. The overall aim of this position is the characterization of the atmospheric aerosol collected at the Aerosols Observatory of the University of Vienna, which is in the process of becoming a National Facility within the pan-European Aerosol, Clouds and Trace Gases Research Infrastructure ACTRIS, and comparison to the aerosol data measured at the Sonnblick Observatory, Austria. Specifically, you will focus on the determination of optical and microphysical properties of atmospheric aerosols measured at these two stations, one representing urban background environment, and the other one, remote atmosphere at 3100 m in altitude. The position is offered within the Vienna Network for Atmospheric Research (VINAR) and involves collaboration with colleagues at GeoSphere Austria and the Department of Meteorology and Geophysics at the Faculty of Earth Sciences, Geography and Astronomy, University of Vienna. The employment duration is 4 years. Initially limited to 1.5 years, the employment relationship is automatically extended to 4 years if the employer does not terminate it within the first 12 months by submitting a nonextension declaration. Your Future Tasks Active participation in research, teaching & administration, which means: You will be involved in unique research projects in which we collaborate with top scientific institutions Your work will focus on rarely-studied aerosol components (including microplastics and others) at urban and remote sites in the framework of ACTRIS and beyond You will set up, characterize, maintain and operate ACTRIS instrumentation such as Aethalometer (AE), Nephelometer, Aerodynamic Particle Sizer (APS) in order to measure the aerosol microphysical and optical properties sampling from a PM10 inlet at the Aerosol Observatory You will characterize instruments in the laboratory, perform aerosol measurements at the Aerosol Observatory, process, analyze and interpret the aerosol data with respect to aerosol microphysical and optical properties You will compare data obtained at the Aerosol Observatory (urban background) in Vienna and the Sonnblick Observatory (remote atmosphere) You will collaborate within VINAR, GeoSphere Austria (Sonnblick Observatory) and the Department of Meteorology and Geophysics at the Faculty of Earth Sciences, Geography and Astronomy, University of Vienna (FLEXPART modelling) You will work on your dissertation and towards its completion in time. You will present your research plan to the faculty and complete a dissertation agreement within 12–18 months. This will be reviewed and adapted on an annual basis You will actively and continuously perform literature search to independently locate relevant journal articles You will contribute to teaching (lab courses, exercise classes) within the provisions of the collective bargaining agreement You will fill some administrative tasks, contributing to the success and self-organization of the group for research, teaching and administration You will contribute to outreach by publications, conference presentations and public activities Compulsory This is part of your personality: Master's degree (or equivalent) in physics and/or aerosol-related topics such as atmospheric sciences, aerosol chemistry, meteorology, or similar Affinity for practical …

items.desc: A Different Kind Of Job Description At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make. Why this is a terrible job This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable. You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall. Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four. And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless. Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise. The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening. The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that. We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win. What You'll Build As a Fullstack Developer, you'll build the product surface and the platform underneath it: The workflows tax professionals live in every day, from document intake through review to delivery Deep integrations with the tax software firms already use, so Filed works where they work The pipelines that move documents, data, and returns reliably at scale, through the most intense weeks of tax season You'll ship across the stack, own features end to end, and see your work in front of some of the most demanding professional users in the world within days, not quarters. What You'll Be Responsible For Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told Learning about LLMs and making them work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale Your Hard Skillset Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it Your Soft Skillset Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it A championship team We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together. We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is …

items.desc: The University of Vienna is a community of almost 11,000 individuals, including approximately 7,700 academic staff members, who passionately pursue answers to the profound questions that shape our future. They represent individuals driven by curiosity and a relentless pursuit of excellence. With us, they find the space to try things out and unfold their potential. Are you inspired by their passion and determination? We are currently seeking a/an University assistant predoctoral 51 Faculty of Physics Startdate: 01.12.2026 | Working hours: 30 | Collective bargaining agreement: 48 VwGr. B1 Grundstufe (praedoc) Limited until: 30.11.2030 Reference no.: 6265 Explore and teach at the University of Vienna, where more than 7,500 academics thrive on curiosity in continuous exploration and help us better understand our world. Does this sound like you? Then join our accomplished team! The Group Electronic Properties of Materials at the Faculty of Physics at the University of Vienna searches excellent candidates for the subgroup Low Dimensional Quantum Solids. The Group of Electronic Properties of Materials at the Faculty of Physics is a committed team of scientists with the main research focus on low dimensional quantum solids. We dedicate a great part of our research to the growth and spectroscopic analysis of pristine and doped carbon-based molecular structures to unravel their underlying electron transport and optical properties. We aim at understanding which parameters control their unique properties to subsequently engineer them to access their full application potential. Your Personal Sphere Of Influence Your job will be focused on tailoring the electronic and optical properties of 1D and 2D nanostructures via advanced filling reactions and intercalation. Especially, the control of basic correlation effects, doping of interfaces and the concomitant understanding of their influence on charge transfer and hybridization are crucial. The group offers a vibrant and intellectually stimulating research environment where curiosity and scientific excellence thrive. You'll be part of a dynamic, collaborative community of researchers who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of materials science. Our atmosphere balances ambitious research goals with mutual support and collegiality, fostering both independent thinking and teamwork. We offer an active research culture with regular seminars, group discussions and knowledge exchange that keep you connected to the latest developments. We all value open communication, creative problem-solving, and a healthy work-life balance, creating an environment where you can grow both professionally and personally. International collaboration is at the heart of what we do, providing you with opportunities to build a global network while working alongside diverse, talented colleagues who share your enthusiasm for cutting-edge science. You will be associated to the MORE-TEM project and OVID laboratory as well as to the MATE platform. See more information on more-tem.univie.ac.at and ovid.univie.ac.at. Within these projects our group focuses strongly on the development of new techniques combining high spatial, energy & momentum (q)-resolution for nanospectroscopic analysis at all energy scales. This enables us to investigate dispersion and lifetime of primary excitations in nanomaterials such as 2D heterostructures and 1D nanotubes. This facilitates the control of quantum phases, like charge-density waves and superconductivity, to engineer new materials for energy (e.g. batteries, (opto-)electronic devices). Your Future Tasks You actively participate in research, teaching & administration, which means: You will present your research plan to the faculty and complete a dissertation agreement within 12-18 months. This will be reviewed and adapted on an annual basis. You will work on and advance your dissertation and towards its completion in time toward successful completion with dedicated mentorship. We expect a large degree of independence paired with a high level of social awareness as the goal will only be achieved in a team. You will contribute to teaching activities (lab courses, exercise classes) both in teams and independently within the provisions of the collective bargaining agreement. You will fill some administrative tasks, contributing to the success and self-organization of the group for research, teaching and administration. You will continuously stay informed about the state of the art in your field. You will contribute to outreach by publications, conference presentations and public activities. You will engage with the broader scientific community through conferences and collaborative events. This Is Part Of Your Personality You must have a master's degree or diploma in physics, physical chemistry, materials science or a related field. You must have experience either in inelastic electron scattering (EELS), TEM or optical and Raman spectroscopy. You must have basic …

items.desc:
Location 
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands 
 Description 
 Power Management Engineer in the Power Management and Distribution Section, Power Systems, EMC & Space Environment Division, Electrical Department, Directorate of Technology, Engineering and Quality.
 The Power Management and Distribution Section provides functional support to ESA projects and carries out technological research (R&D) in the fields of power management and distribution for space applications, both primary and secondary, platform or payload. In particular, the Section covers power system design, power and energy budget assessment, power conditioning and distribution design and technology, analogue electronics for power systems, control of power systems, digital control of power systems, sensing techniques and high-voltage technology and design. Within this domain of competence, the Section is responsible for:
 defining, promoting and implementing, in line with anticipated technology trends and project needs, the Section’s contributions to ESA technology programmes and R&D activities;
coordinating, where applicable, the requirements of technology elements in the Section’s domain of competence with the overall requirements of systems being developed under the
 responsibility of other D/TEC areas;
 maintaining state-of-the-art expertise, through the execution of the yearly plan for Technical Assessment and related hands-on activities, by keeping roadmaps up to date and driving the periodic harmonisation exercise in the Section’s domain of expertise as well as by driving selected technology activities of specific importance for the Section or the Division and supporting the definition of European standards related to the Section’s domain of competence;
 ensuring the development, maintenance and evolution of the engineering tools used by the Division in support of its duties;
 coordinating the Section’s laboratory activities with the Energy Storage and Power Laboratory Section in order to optimise the support provided by the laboratory team and to ensure proper prioritisation of tasks;
 participating in the early phase design of power systems for future space missions.
 Duties 
 Reporting to the Head of Section and within the technical fields described above, your main tasks and responsibilities will include:
 providing expert technical support and consultancy to ESA projects, programmes and general studies in the field of power management and power distribution throughout all project phases;
 participating in feasibility studies, project reviews and evaluation of procurement proposals;
 identifying critical development problems and assisting in their resolution;
 contributing to the definition of technology development requirements and work plans for the Agency’s technology programmes;
 defining, initiating and managing R&D activities covering both long- and short-term needs;
 fostering new application areas for multidisciplinary activities, placing emphasis on innovative concepts, cutting-edge technologies and system architectures;
 laboratory activities, as required;
 monitoring applicable scientific and technological trends and maintaining state-of-the-art expertise;
 contributing to the dissemination of the results of the activities performed and the transfer of knowledge across the Agency.
 Your duties may also include supporting other activities within your field of competence.
 Technical competencies 
 General background and specific experience in the technical domains covered by the position
 Hands-on hardware experience
 Project support experience in a relevant domain
 Spacecraft systems knowledge
 Hands-on laboratory experience
 Experience in the preparation of procurement activities for technology development and innovation (statements of work, proposal evaluation, etc)
 Experience in the management and monitoring of industrial activities, including participation in reviews
 Behavioural competencies 
 Result Orientation
Operational Efficiency
Fostering Cooperation
Relationship Management
Continuous Improvement
Forward Thinking
 For more information, please refer to the ESA Core Behavioural Competencies guidebook. 
 Education and professional experience 
 A master's degree in electrical engineering (or similar degree) is required for this post together with, in principle, 5 years of relevant professional experience.
 Additional requirements 
 Experience on the design of power systems at early phase stages of space missions, and the use of relevant tools
Experience of power system analysis, including power and energy budget assessment
Experience of DC/DC converter design and verification 
Experience of power converter control
Experience of digital control and FPGA programming
Experience in the use of GaN and SiC switches for power conversion
Experience in the use of electrical simulation tools and the modelling of power conversion circuits and systems
Knowledge of secondary power system analysis and verification

items.desc: Last date to apply: 05 November 2026 We’re one of the world’s oldest start-ups — and we’re just getting started. At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it. Digital Infrastructure is looking for a Product Owner – Traceability Reporting Platform to take on the role of DPP Business Owner. You will connect people, processes and data across the Group to keep our Digital Product Passport capability working, current and ready for what comes next. This new role sits within the Digital Infrastructure team, part of Digital Data Solutions. The role will work closely with our Traceability manager and report to the Digital Infrastructure Manager. This person will collaborate closely with Group Compliance, Data Management, Operations, Digital Business Solutions, Global Information Systems, and suppliers. About the role: We are now looking for a Product Owner – Traceability Reporting Platform who will take on the role of DPP Business Owner. As DPP Business Owner, you will hold the overall business responsibility for ensuring that Husqvarna Group has a functioning, up-to-date and scalable capability to create, publish, maintain and evolve Digital Product Passports and other regulatory product information. Your ownership covers the complete chain – from regulation, business requirements, processes, data, product identification and labelling, through technical enablement and the published product information, to lifecycle management. You will not operationally perform every activity in the chain. Instead, you will own the overall context, coordinate the involved functions – such as Group Compliance, Product Management, Master Data, GIS, Operations and Digital Solutions – and ensure that the end-to-end capability works. The project delivers the capability; your ownership keeps it alive and evolving. The role also looks ahead. While the platform is initially built to meet the requirements of the Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR), its scope will grow over time into a broader traceability and regulatory platform. It will evolve to fulfil the requirements of the Machinery Regulation, the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) and other regulations that require product data to be made available to customers through a QR code. As Product Owner – Traceability Reporting Platform, you will drive this expansion so that new regulatory requirements are met through one scalable Group platform rather than separate solutions. Key Responsibilities In the role of DPP Business Owner, your key responsibilities are: Secure Platform Capability for Regulatory Readiness: Coordinate regulatory changes affecting the platform together with Group Compliance, assess their business impact, and identify upcoming regulations – such as the Machinery Regulation and PPWR – that the platform can be extended to fulfil. Identify value-creation opportunities arising from these changes and prioritize them towards IT based on business value creation as well as compliance. End-to-End Business Process Lead: Lead and continuously improve the business process, ensuring clear roles, up-to-date documentation and no gaps across divisions and functions. End-to-End Ownership of the Platform Capability: Understand the full flow – from product identification and data through labelling and QR code to publishing – and ensure no part of the chain falls between organizational responsibilities. Governance & Cross-Functional Coordination: Chair the Digital Product Information Governance Forum and mobilize the relevant functions and divisions when alignment or decisions are needed. Single Point of Contact: Be the designated business contact for the platform, answering questions or routing them to the right function. Knowledge & Internal Communication: Ensure platform information – including How We Work – exists, stays relevant and is maintained. Onboarding & Future Regulations: Run an established onboarding process so new product categories and regulations can be brought into scope without new implementation projects. Mandate & Decision Authority Ownership requires mandate. As DPP Business Owner, you hold clearly defined authority to: Initiate platform-related changes. Convene relevant functions and stakeholders. Request impact assessments. Escalate identified gaps and compliance risks. Drive prioritization of platform requirements through the agreed governance structure. Represent the platform in relevant forums. Approve, or drive approval of, business-process changes related to the platform. About you: You enjoy making complex things easier to navigate. items.desc: You turn complex manufacturing data into interfaces factory teams rely on every day, working side by side with our engineers. Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We are a fast-growing team driving massive impact in one of the largest and most under-served industries in the world. We serve the world's top manufacturers across the globe. From Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, our customers trust us to make their factories run better. We are backed by leading investors like Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Google, Meta, Palantir, MBB, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity. WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT? You’ll join our small design team and work directly with our engineers. At first you’ll focus on UI: building screens, components and flows for our platform, and helping our design system grow. Over time you’ll take on larger parts of the product end to end. This is what you’ll do: Turn flows and concepts into detailed production-ready screens. Create and maintain components in Figma, keep them in sync with what’s in code, and notice when patterns start to drift. Pair with developers, review builds, and make quick trade-offs when something doesn’t fit the sprint. Your designs ship; you don’t just hand off Figma files. When a shortcut hurts the experience, you say so, explain why, and propose an alternative. And you know when good enough is good enough. Join customer calls and factory visits, test ideas with our forward deployed engineers, and bring what you learn back into the product. Help where a startup needs it: website updates, sales decks and marketing visuals now and then. WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING? First and foremost, we believe in curious people who are eager to learn and grow. If you're passionate about cutting-edge tech and driving major impact in manufacturing, we want to hear from you. You don’t need to have done it all. We can teach you manufacturing, our product, and a lot about designing complex B2B software. We can’t teach you to care about the details, or to be curious about how things work. Must-haves: You’re fluent in English and comfortable with changing priorities. You know when to be scrappy and when to be thorough. You have 1–3 years of professional experience designing digital products. Internships and working-student roles count if you shipped real work. You have strong UI craft and have hands-on experience with a design system. You’re fluent in Figma (components, variants, auto layout, variables) and comfortable using AI tools for quick iterations and prototypes. You enjoy working closely with developers and understand enough about frontend to design things that can be built. You can explain and stand behind your design decisions, and you change your mind when someone has a better argument. You’re curious about users, technology and how things get made, and you actively look for feedback so you can grow. Bonus: Experience with B2B SaaS, dashboards or data-heavy products WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU? We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. You’ll work alongside two senior designers, get regular design critiques, and sit close to the engineers who build what you design. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. Additionally, we offer: Performance-based career & growth paths On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation Flexible parental leave Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech. HOW TO APPLY Send us your CV and a portfolio with 2–3 case studies, at least one showing detailed UI work. Tell us briefly what you did yourself and what the team did. Our interview process includes a short design challenge during the on-site, so you can show us how you work.

items.desc: sennder is redefining road logistics. As Europe’s leading digital freight forwarder, we are building a smarter, faster, and more sustainable future for freight, powered by a single, unified platform that already runs our entire business. We are moving from a decade of growth through acquisition to a company that is outcome-driven, outward-focused, and AI-native by design. Logistics is one of the best possible use cases for AI, and unlike most of our peers, we own the full loop: the platform, the operations, and the data connecting them. That closed feedback loop is a compounding advantage most competitors can’t replicate. This role exists to turn that advantage into sennder’s sharpest edge in margin, cost, and service, because AI will give us that edge if we lead, or become a risk if we lag. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will join our highly talented ML team. This is an applied machine learning role focused on highly innovative, research-oriented topics. You will work on a diverse portfolio of high-impact projects, ranging from optimizing our established Recommendation engine & Pricing engine to building greenfield solutions. This role can be based out of our Berlin, Barcelona or Amsterdam office. You will not just be implementing technical specifications; you will sit directly with end-users, operators, and Product Managers to deeply understand their workflows, granting you real decision-making power over the product's direction. What You Will Do… Pricing Engine Optimization: Develop and iterate on bid estimation algorithms and margin-optimization models to power our dynamic pricing engine, directly driving company profitability. Recommender Systems: Maintain and improve our existing recommender systems to seamlessly support our operational teams' day-to-day efficiency. Industry Innovation & Applied ML: Explore and validate new areas where machine learning can solve fundamental logistics challenges (such as freight routing and network optimization), turning open-ended industry problems into scalable, data-driven solutions. Product Discovery & Ideation: Partner closely with Product Managers to drive continuous product discovery, translating ambiguous operational pain points into clear, outcome-driven ML hypotheses and rapid prototypes. AI & LLM Integration: Leverage foundational models and AI agents both as daily accelerators for your own engineering workflows and as core components to build new internal products. We expect you to pragmatically evaluate trade-offs and always choose the right solution for the right problem—whether that is an LLM, a traditional ML model, or a simple heuristic. Platform Collaboration: Partner with our Data & AI Platform (MLOps) team to utilize and deploy models via our internal ML infrastructure. You will act as a key customer of this platform, providing continuous feedback and contributions to shape our global engineering standards. End-to-End Execution: Adopt a holistic approach to project deployment, maintaining an end-to-end attitude that covers the entire lifecycle from initial R&D and prototyping all the way through to production release and monitoring. What We Are Looking For… Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science or Machine Learning Engineering. Data Science Fundamentals: Strong foundation in statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and deep data exploration to validate assumptions and commercial viability before building complex models. You must possess a working knowledge of ML approaches to address basic regression and classification problems. Experience working with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake), utilizing Jupyter Notebooks for data exploration, and building interactive data apps/dashboards (e.g., Streamlit, PowerBI) to visualize outcomes for stakeholders. items.desc: Applied AI Engineer – Manchester (Hybrid) We’re recruiting on behalf of a global gaming and entertainment group. AI is a genuine priority here, with a company-wide transformation programme reshaping how teams across product and technology work. What the role involves You’ll join a newly formed AI Transformation team in Manchester, working alongside an established AI R&D group. Teams across the business are experimenting with AI, with dozens of initiatives in flight. Your job is to turn the most promising of those into real, supported tools that people rely on every day. That means working with teams to take their prototypes and make them production-grade, then spotting where shared capability makes more sense than one-off solutions. You’ll run experiments to prove what works, evaluate new tools and techniques, and help engineering teams build faster with AI. What we’re looking for Software/Machine Learning engineering background Experience taking AI prototypes or internal tools into production Hands-on experience building RAG pipelines, agentic workflows or other LLM applications Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and comfortable picking up the other Hands-on AWS experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code and observability Experience building and using evals to measure model and system behaviour Confident running training, workshops or knowledge-sharing sessions A self-starter who owns problems end to end and enjoys working across the business. Experience building internal platforms is a bonus, but not essential. Hybrid working, Manchester based, 2 days a week in the office.

items.desc: Join our innovative team at Curamando as an AI Engineer ! Work with cutting-edge technologies, mentor others, and help shape the future of our growing AI practice in a collaborative, inclusive environment. At Curamando, we're not just creating software; we're crafting the future, one innovative project at a time. We empower our team to not only envision the future but also play a pivotal role in building it. Curamando, part of the Nordic consulting house Eidra, specialises in accelerating top-line growth through digital strategy and innovation. We're a fast-growing consultancy already partnering with industry leaders — from cutting-edge automotive brands to forward-looking tech companies. Together with Eidra's 1,200+ strategists, creatives, and engineers spread across Stockholm, New York, and beyond, we tackle ambitious problems at scale. This role isn't only about delivering on Curamando's value offering — you'll also play an integral part in helping other Eidra verticals deliver on their AI agenda, well beyond commerce. We're looking for people ready to join us on this journey, bringing passion, creativity, and dedication. This role is open across multiple levels — from individual contributors to senior engineers and emerging leaders — and offers an opportunity to develop your craft while working closely with clients on real-world AI challenges. Job Summary: We are seeking AI Engineers with experience in building robust, scalable, AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate combines a product engineering mindset with deep enthusiasm for advancing AI capabilities, a strong interest in knowledge sharing and mentoring, and a genuine curiosity about how to build value offerings on the cutting edge of AI. For more senior candidates, we're particularly interested in people with an intrapreneurial and business development mindset - engineers who want to help grow our AI Core team from a 15–20 person operation to 40+, and who see themselves as builders of the company, not just of the deliverables. As an AI Engineer at Curamando, your role will involve: Helping clients clarify their questions and determining whether AI is a suitable solution Understanding the limitations of models and how to address them within a product's UX Architecting agentic solutions (context, memory, and tool/skill handling) and implementing them using frameworks such as Mastra, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangChain/LangGraph Applying stochastic test casing and trace-based reasoning to evaluate, test, and improve agent behaviour, supported by observability tooling (Langfuse, Promptfoo, etc.) Understanding and applying core AI concepts such as redlining, document chunking for accuracy, efficient use of embeddings, and debugging AI systems Validating, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining models, ensuring they can be used at scale Developing and maintaining end-to-end data pipelines and ML workflows, optimising for performance and reliability Working with diverse, cross-functional teams across Curamando and Eidra on projects that deliver groundbreaking AI solutions For senior candidates and emerging leaders, the role also includes: Mentoring and inspiring: Nurturing a growing team of AI engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and collaborative problem-solving - items.desc: Beskrivning av tjänsten Shape the future with AI at CGI. We are looking for an ML/AI Engineer who wants to turn the possibilities of artificial intelligence and machine learning into solutions that create real value. In this role, you will work at the intersection of software engineering, machine learning, data, and generative AI. You will collaborate with colleagues and clients to design, build, deploy, and improve AI powered solutions, from early prototypes and proofs of concept to robust production systems. The role is intentionally broad. Depending on your experience and interests, you may work with traditional machine learning, generative AI and large language models (LLMs), intelligent applications, MLOps, or a combination of these areas. Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter As an ML/AI Engineer, you will: Design and develop machine learning and AI solutions for real world business challenges Build applications and services using generative AI, LLMs, and modern AI frameworks Develop and evaluate solutions such as RAG, AI agents, search, recommendation, prediction, and automation Build reliable data and ML pipelines and integrate models into applications and business systems Deploy, monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve AI/ML solutions in production Experiment with new models, tools, frameworks, and approaches Apply good software engineering, MLOps, security, and responsible AI practices Work closely with software engineers, data specialists, architects, domain experts, and client teams Translate business needs into practical technical solutions and communicate technical concepts to different audiences. Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll What we're looking for: We believe you could come from several different backgrounds. You might already be an ML/AI Engineer, or you may have developed strong AI/ML capabilities through software engineering, data science, or data engineering. We are particularly interested in experience with some of the following: Python and modern software development practices Machine learning frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit learn Generative AI and LLMs, including prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, evaluation, and/or agentic applications Cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud APIs, microservices, containers, and technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes Data processing, databases, vector databases, and data pipelines MLOps / LLMOps, CI/CD, model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management You don't need to be an expert in everything above. We value strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn and apply new technologies. We believe that: You enjoy solving complex problems and turning ideas into working solutions. You are comfortable experimenting but you also understand what it takes to move from an experiment to something reliable and maintainable. You collaborate well with others and can connect technology with business needs. You are curious about the rapidly evolving AI landscape while maintaining a thoughtful approach to areas such as security, privacy, explainability, quality, and responsible AI. At CGI, you will have the opportunity to work with AI and machine learning across different industries, technologies, and business challenges. You'll be part of a collaborative environment where you can learn from experienced colleagues, contribute your own ideas, and continue developing your expertise. We combine the reach and opportunities of a global organization with strong local teams and close collaboration with our clients. If you're excited about building useful AI solutions, and want to help organizations move from AI possibilities to practical outcomes, we'd like to hear from you. Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans. Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential. Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning. Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis. Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer. Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

items.desc: Job Description: We are seeking an energetic and technically sharp Junior Forward Deployed AI Engineer to support the rapid prototyping, discovery, and proof-of-concept (PoC) delivery of AI-powered solutions across our global Supply Chain and Manufacturing functions. This is a dynamic, fast-paced role where you will work alongside senior engineers to bridge the gap between AI development and real-world shop floor operations. You will spend time embedding directly with frontline teams—visiting manufacturing sites and warehouses—to understand their day-to-day challenges, and then turn those insights into working, AI-enabled software prototypes. The ideal candidate is a proactive builder who is comfortable working with Python, eager to learn cutting-edge GenAI frameworks, and excited about collaborating directly with operational business teams. Key Responsibilities Frontline Engagement & Discovery Frontline Shadowing: Participate in site visits and shadow frontline teams (Logistics, Manufacturing, Procurement) to understand operational bottlenecks first-hand. Requirements Translation: Support senior engineers in translating user feedback and "messy" real-world problems into structured user stories, functional specs, and process flows. Active Scrum Participant: Maintain and update the team's agile backlog, actively participate in daily standups, and assist in coordinating sprint planning. Rapid AI Prototyping & Development Hands-on Coding: Write clean, documented, and functional Python code to build, refine, and test AI-enabled prototypes. Support RAG & Agentic Systems: Work under the guidance of senior engineers to construct and tune Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, semantic search indices, and multi-agent system workflows. Iterate & Refine: Actively modify prototypes based on immediate feedback from factory floor workers and warehouse operators. Adopt Best Practices: Learn and apply enterprise software development standards to ensure prototype code is structured for eventual production handoff. Systems Integration & Data Engineering API Configuration: Assist in building and configuring APIs to connect AI applications to shop floor platforms (e.g., Poka, Weaver) and document repositories. Data Wrangling: Clean, structure, and prepare unstructured documents, telemetry feeds, and SQL database exports for ingestion into AI systems. Typical Use Cases Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Assistants designed to help operators look up technical guidelines hands-free. Manufacturing Knowledge Assistants that index equipment manuals to speed up machine maintenance. Procurement Intelligence Tools that extract and summarize key terms from supplier contracts. Workflow Automation Tools to help administrative logistics teams auto-generate shift handover reports. Career Growth: This role will be an excellent fit for someone who: Enjoys solving varied, real-world problems. Likes interacting with customers and understanding business needs. Wants to work on cutting-edge AI applications rather than purely research. Thrives in fast-paced environments where you own projects from design to deployment. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience: 1–3 years of professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, or digital technology delivery. Coding Foundation: Robust baseline experience writing Python (Pandas, NumPy, requests) and a strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals (OOP, REST APIs). AI Familiarity: Hands-on experience (which can include academic projects, bootcamps, or personal portfolios) using LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini) and basic RAG architectures. Data Skills: Proficient with SQL and comfortable querying relational databases. Soft Skills & Mobility: Excellent communication skills with the confidence to converse with factory operators. Highly curious, eager to learn, and willing to travel occasionally to manufacturing facilities. Preferred Qualifications Basic experience with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph. Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform/Vertex AI, Microsoft Azure). Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub) and containerization (Docker). Academic background or brief exposure to Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or Logistics environments. Success Measures Technical Growth: Rapid ramp-up on advanced enterprise AI architectures and frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Vertex AI). Prototype Delivery Velocity: Successfully completing assigned development tasks within the sprint cycle. User-Centric Execution: Translating frontline operator feedback into functional code modifications. #TBdigital

You'll be a hands-on engineer building and extending this platform — writing the Lambdas that orchestrate agents, integrating Bedrock with GitLab CI, hardening the security and observability layers, and shipping new agent capabilities that any
items.desc: Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We’re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a Flex Work approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work. About The Role We're building Dolby's Centralized Agentic AI Framework — a shared platform that brings safe, governed, cost-aware AI agents into every team's GitLab workflow. You'll be a hands-on engineer building and extending this platform — writing the Lambdas that orchestrate agents, integrating Bedrock with GitLab CI, hardening the security and observability layers, and shipping new agent capabilities that any team can adopt without re-architecting. What You'll Do Build agent orchestration — implement Router Lambdas, SQS-based queueing, and Bedrock Agent invocation Integrate with GitLab CI/CD — design .gitlab-ci.yml patterns where agent invocations run as pipeline stages, consume branch/diff/test context, emit artefacts, and gate downstream stages on agent pass/fail signals. Develop shared Action Groups — build the AWS Lambda-backed tools Design Knowledge Bases — iUtilise AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base / OpenSearch / S3 so agents reason over shared organizational context, not isolated prompts. Implement Bedrock Guardrails — input/output filters, sensitive-data scrubbing, content/word filters, and per-agent permission boundaries enforced by design. Implement TokenOps controls — model tiering and routing via an LLM gateway, semantic caching, context-window management Instrument everything in AWS — CloudWatch dashboards, audit trails, trace logging of every agent invocation (input, output, decision, tokens, cost) for compliance and debugging. Required (3–5 Years Professional Experience) Strong Python, AWS SDK Python for building production Lambda functions and event-driven services. Solid AWS experience: Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch. Amazon Bedrock specifically: Agents, Action Groups, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails. Hands-on experience integrating with LLM APIs — Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar. Familiarity with CI/CD platforms — GitLab CI strongly A security mindset: least-privilege IAM, secrets handling, input validation, awareness of prompt injection and data-leak risks in LLM workflows. Comfortable with observability — structured logging, metrics, tracing — and writing code that's debuggable in production. Nice to have Experience with SAST/DAST/SCA tools Experience building developer platforms or internal tooling — you've shipped something other engineers depend on daily. Familiarity with agent frameworks (Bedrock AgentCore) and their tradeoffs. How You Work You write small, focused services with clear contracts — not monoliths. You treat extensibility as a feature: new triggers/agents/tools shouldn't require touching unrelated layers. You think about the developer experience of the teams who'll use your platform, not just whether the code runs. You're comfortable with ambiguity — agentic systems are non-deterministic, and you debug them empirically. Dolby Hiring Entity: Dolby Poland Sp. z o.o. Business Garden, Building G ul. Legnicka 48 Wrocław, 54-202, Poland

items.card: You will work most closely with the engineers building the platform, the product team defining how operators use it, and the operators who rely on it every day. QA and operations is how the whole team knows the platform can be trusted. The opportunity You will own day-to-day operations and QA for our internal growth platform. You test it, catch problems before our customers do, keep approvals and exception queues
items.desc: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Growth at Kraken is being rebuilt around an AI-native platform. Instead of people manually building audiences, writing copy, adjusting budgets, and scheduling sends, agents find opportunities, make decisions, and execute across paid, organic, and lifecycle channels. They learn from every result and keep going. People still run the system. Operators use a central hub to set the rules the agents follow, review and approve what they produce, and handle exceptions when something doesn’t fit. The platform also has to work across many markets and languages, and it operates in a regulated industry, so there are compliance checks and approval steps built in. The team is a small, cross-functional group of growth, product, and engineering people who build this platform and run it day to day. We ship often, learn fast, and raise the quality bar with every release. You will work most closely with the engineers building the platform, the product team defining how operators use it, and the operators who rely on it every day. QA and operations is how the whole team knows the platform can be trusted. The opportunity You will own day-to-day operations and QA for our internal growth platform. You test it, catch problems before our customers do, keep approvals and exception queues moving, and report on how it’s performing. You will work closely with product, engineering and operators to make sure the platform works and keeps working. This is a hands-on, detail-focused role. You will spend your days in the product, testing what’s new, checking what should already work, and writing up what you find so it gets fixed. Test the platform regularly. Cover new releases, rule changes, and edge cases, and run regression checks to make sure existing features still work. Find bugs and document them clearly, with steps to reproduce, severity, and impact. Follow them through until engineering fixes them and you’ve verified the fix. Monitor platform performance and agent activity, flag anything that looks wrong, and escalate it to the right person. Work the approval queues daily. Keep items moving and make sure nothing is left unreviewed. Check agent output against defined checklists and standards, and escalate anything unclear or risky.Note where flows are confusing or inconsistent, and flag them to the team. Write and maintain documentation: test plans, QA checklists, runbooks, and release notes. What You Bring Experience in QA, testing, operations, support, or analytics, ideally on a software product or complex system Exceptional attention to detail. You notice what others miss and double-check your work. A structured approach to testing. You can create and follow a test plan, and think about what could break. Clear written communication. Your bug reports and documentation should be easy for anyone to follow. Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard and tell when a number looks off. Fast learner. You pick up new tools and systems quickly and ask thoughtful questions. AI-native habits. You use AI tools in your own work every day, and you’re curious about where they get things wrong. Prompt engineering curiosity, you don't need to be an engineer, but you are willing to learn how to communicate with AI systems precisely and improve their outputs Reliability. You keep to a routine, keep your queues clear, and tell people early when something is stuck. Nice to haves Experience testing software products or AI and LLM-based tools Familiarity with Jira, Mixpanel, or similar tools Exposure to marketing, CRM, or lifecycle messaging workflows Interest in fintech or crypto Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. The work is hands-on kernel development, library
items.desc: As a Senior CUDA DSP Engineer , you will port our 5G positioning signal-processing algorithms from CPU reference implementations to high-throughput, low-latency CUDA implementations on NVIDIA GPUs. You will work closely with signal-processing domain experts to meet real-time latency targets, maximise memory-bandwidth utilisation, and maintain strict numerical parity with the algorithm prototypes. The work is hands-on kernel development, library integration, and performance validation. Responsibilities: Port existing signal processing algorithms to high-throughput, low-latency CUDA GPU implementations. Write, test, and tune custom CUDA C/C++ kernels using shared memory, registers, warp shuffles, and asynchronous copy primitives. Replace CPU library calls (Intel MKL and IPP) with NVIDIA math and signal processing libraries including cuFFT, cuBLAS, cuSignal, and NPP. Implement asynchronous processing pipelines using CUDA streams and pinned host memory to overlap PCIe data transfers with compute. Design unit and integration test suites that verify functional equivalence between reference and GPU pipeline outputs. Maintain clear architectural documentation and collaborate with domain engineering teams. Your profile: 4+ years of professional C/C++ development experience, including 3+ years writing low-level CUDA applications for NVIDIA GPUs. High proficiency in C multithreading and low-level memory management. Working knowledge of core DSP concepts, including FFT, MUSIC, and parameter estimation. Hands-on experience identifying hardware bottlenecks using Nsight Systems and Nsight Compute. Based in the US or Europe, with working hours that overlap with our engineering teams in Romania and the US. M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. Experience with Intel vector intrinsics (AVX2, AVX-512), Intel IPP, or Intel MKL. Familiarity with Python wrappers for GPU acceleration such as PyCUDA, CuPy, or RAPIDS cuSignal. Background in parameter estimation, geolocation, software-defined radio, or 5G telecommunications.

Dobre zdolności w zakresie komunikacji i współpracy, umiejętność dzielenia się wiedzą. Język angielski na poziomie komunikatywnym, swobodne posługiwanie się dokumentacją techniczną. Co oferujemy Pracę na odpowiedzialnym stanowisku w największej grupie kapitałowej w kraju. Super atmosferę, przyjazne środowisko pracy, współpracę z osobami otwartymi i chętnie dzielącymi się wiedzą. Stabilne zatrudnienie w ramach umowy o pracę lub umowy B2B. Hybrydowy model pracy. Dostęp do platformy szkoleniowej, gdzie z pewnością znajdziesz coś dla siebie. Pakiet benefitów (karta Multisport, opieka medyczna w LuxMed, ubezpieczenie na życie, liczne oferty pracownicze dedykowane pracownikom Grupy). Dofinansowanie do aktywności organizowanych przez sekcje sportowe i tematyczne, gdzie można rozwijać swoje pasje – bo praca to nie wszystko.

items.title: AI Growth Ops
items.card: You will work most closely with the engineers building the platform, the product team defining how operators use it, and the operators who rely on it every day. QA and operations is how the whole team knows the platform can be trusted. The opportunity You will own day-to-day operations and QA for our internal growth platform. You test it, catch problems before our customers do, keep approvals and exception queues
items.desc: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Growth at Kraken is being rebuilt around an AI-native platform. Instead of people manually building audiences, writing copy, adjusting budgets, and scheduling sends, agents find opportunities, make decisions, and execute across paid, organic, and lifecycle channels. They learn from every result and keep going. People still run the system. Operators use a central hub to set the rules the agents follow, review and approve what they produce, and handle exceptions when something doesn’t fit. The platform also has to work across many markets and languages, and it operates in a regulated industry, so there are compliance checks and approval steps built in. The team is a small, cross-functional group of growth, product, and engineering people who build this platform and run it day to day. We ship often, learn fast, and raise the quality bar with every release. You will work most closely with the engineers building the platform, the product team defining how operators use it, and the operators who rely on it every day. QA and operations is how the whole team knows the platform can be trusted. The opportunity You will own day-to-day operations and QA for our internal growth platform. You test it, catch problems before our customers do, keep approvals and exception queues moving, and report on how it’s performing. You will work closely with product, engineering and operators to make sure the platform works and keeps working. This is a hands-on, detail-focused role. You will spend your days in the product, testing what’s new, checking what should already work, and writing up what you find so it gets fixed. Test the platform regularly. Cover new releases, rule changes, and edge cases, and run regression checks to make sure existing features still work. Find bugs and document them clearly, with steps to reproduce, severity, and impact. Follow them through until engineering fixes them and you’ve verified the fix. Monitor platform performance and agent activity, flag anything that looks wrong, and escalate it to the right person. Work the approval queues daily. Keep items moving and make sure nothing is left unreviewed. Check agent output against defined checklists and standards, and escalate anything unclear or risky.Note where flows are confusing or inconsistent, and flag them to the team. Write and maintain documentation: test plans, QA checklists, runbooks, and release notes. What You Bring Experience in QA, testing, operations, support, or analytics, ideally on a software product or complex system Exceptional attention to detail. You notice what others miss and double-check your work. A structured approach to testing. You can create and follow a test plan, and think about what could break. Clear written communication. Your bug reports and documentation should be easy for anyone to follow. Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard and tell when a number looks off. Fast learner. You pick up new tools and systems quickly and ask thoughtful questions. AI-native habits. You use AI tools in your own work every day, and you’re curious about where they get things wrong. Prompt engineering curiosity, you don't need to be an engineer, but you are willing to learn how to communicate with AI systems precisely and improve their outputs Reliability. You keep to a routine, keep your queues clear, and tell people early when something is stuck. Nice to haves Experience testing software products or AI and LLM-based tools Familiarity with Jira, Mixpanel, or similar tools Exposure to marketing, CRM, or lifecycle messaging workflows Interest in fintech or crypto Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Our commitment Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and …

items.desc: CMCC Position cod. 12839 Impact Modeller – Climate Risks, Energy Systems and Socio-Economic Resilience Deadline: October 31st, 2026 What We Are Looking For We are seeking two outstanding/ambitious mid-level researchers with a strong track record in climate impact modelling, environmental systems modelling, integrated assessment, or related disciplines to join the European Institute on Economics and the Environment (EIEE) at the CMCC Foundation in Milan, Italy. The successful candidates will contribute to the scientific development of next-generation climate impact modelling frameworks supporting climate adaptation, energy transitions, and resilience planning across vulnerable regions worldwide. The position focuses on understanding how climate change propagates through interconnected human and natural systems, affecting energy systems, water resources, ecosystems, food production, infrastructure, and socio-economic development. The successful candidate will lead the development of integrated modelling approaches capable of translating climate hazards into actionable information for decision-makers and supporting evidence-based adaptation strategies. A particular emphasis will be placed on modelling climate impacts across interconnected human and natural systems, including water resources, energy systems, food systems, biodiversity, and ecosystem services, integrating Earth system information with impact models, socio-economic analysis, artificial intelligence, and decision-support tools to support climate adaptation, resilience, and sustainable development. The successful candidates will play a leading role in shaping a new generation of modular, scalable, and policy-relevant impact modelling frameworks, working within interdisciplinary teams spanning climate science, engineering, economics, AI, and environmental systems analysis. Beyond scientific research, the position offers the opportunity to coordinate international research activities, supervise junior researchers and PhD students, contribute to strategic project development, and help shape the future research agenda of EIEE in climate impacts, adaptation, and resilience. About Us CMCC Foundation is a cross-cutting scientific research center on climate change and its interactions with the environment, society, the world of business, and policymakers. Our work aims to stimulate sustainable growth, protect the environment, and develop strategies for the adaptation and mitigation of climate change. CMCC's core objective is to conduct cutting-edge science, to train the next generation of scientists at both national and international levels, and to be a beacon for climate modelling. CMCC pursues fundamental and applied science with utmost scientific integrity, prioritizing data-driven science and providing data, information, and research results that can support informed public debate and decision-making processes. To achieve climate research objectives at the highest international standards, we invest in training all our talents, and strive to create a workplace where everyone can excel. At CMCC you will find a strong, professional environment. Join an inclusive community that values diversity, where every voice is heard and respected. Help foster a culture of innovation and societal change, where individuals from all backgrounds can thrive and succeed. Over the last decade, CMCC has experienced extraordinary growth. We are now embarking on a new chapter of our journey that will further boost CMCC’s global position in climate change research…Together! To learn more about this opportunity and submit your application, please refer to the following: ROLE The successful candidates will work within the European Institute on Economics and the Environment (EIEE), contributing to the scientific leadership of research activities on climate impacts, resilience, and integrated environmental modelling.
