items.desc: À Amiens, Beauvais, Rennes et Rouen, UniLaSalle, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche, propose des formations d’ingénieurs post-bac en 5 ans, une formation vétérinaire post-bac en 6 ans (depuis septembre 2022), des bachelors ainsi que des masters dans les domaines de l’agriculture, de l’agroalimentaire, de l’alimentation-santé, de l’environnement, des géosciences, des énergies et du numérique. Labellisé EESPIG (Établissement d'Enseignement Supérieur Privé d'Intérêt Général), UniLaSalle est membre de la Conférence des Grandes Écoles et ses formations d’ingénieur sont habilitées par la CTI (Commission des Titres d'Ingénieur). UniLaSalle fait partie du réseau d’enseignement mondial La Salle constitué de 72 universités et s’appuie sur 260 universités partenaires à l’étranger. L’Institut compte aujourd’hui 4 000 élèves, accompagnés par 632 salariés dont 180 enseignants chercheurs, 40 doctorants et 27 000 alumni. Inauguré en 1995 sous le nom ESIEE Amiens, le campus est situé en bord de Somme et se distingue par son architecture originale. Depuis le 1er octobre 2020, il a rejoint le groupe UniLaSalle et compte 59 salariés. Il accueille environ 650 étudiants chaque année et les forme sur les thématiques de l’énergie et du numérique. Dans le cadre d’une création de poste et afin de renforcer l'unité de recherche GENUMER, nous recherchons un Doctorant en CDD de 36 mois pour le campus d'Amiens (80), poste à pourvoir dès que possible . 1.1 Contexte général La transformation numérique des industries de bioprocédés constitue un levier stratégique majeur pour améliorer la productivité, la qualité et la durabilité des productions issues du vivant. La conduite de fermentations met en jeu des populations cellulaires vivantes dont l’état physiologique évolue dynamiquement, rendant le comportement des lignes de production intrinsèquement non-linéaire, variable et sensible à de multiples facteurs interdépendants. De nombreuses installations demeurent aujourd’hui pilotées de manière largement empirique, sur la base de recettes figées et de l’expérience des opérateurs, sans exploitation systématique de la richesse informationnelle contenue dans les données de production. Dans ce contexte, le concept de jumeau numérique, réplique virtuelle d’une installation physique continuellement alimentée par les données du réel, s’impose comme une rupture technologique permettant de simuler, prédire et optimiser le comportement d’une ligne de production en temps réel. Deux grandes familles d’approches structurent historiquement la modélisation des bioprocédés. Les modèles déterministes (mécanistes), fondés sur la description des mécanismes biologiques et des bilans de matière, offrent robustesse et interprétabilité, mais reposent sur des hypothèses simplificatrices et des paramètres difficiles à identifier en conditions réelles. À l’inverse, les modèles issus de l’apprentissage automatique captent des relations complexes directement à partir des données, au prix d’une moindre interprétabilité et d’un besoin important en données représentatives. C’est à l’interface de ces paradigmes que se situe l’approche hybride, cœur scientifique du présent projet : la modélisation hybride semi-paramétrique combine un socle mécaniste, garant de la cohérence physique, avec des composantes d’apprentissage chargées de représenter les phénomènes mal connus. 1.2 Contexte industriel BIOCODEX, acteur industriel de la filière des bioprocédés, produit par fermentation des principes actifs d’intérêt pharmaceutique. Les travaux préparatoires de la Chaire VALBIOS ont mis en évidence deux lignes de production, la ligne SB et une seconde ligne, composées chacune de plusieurs opérations unitaires et présentant des niveaux de maturité et de disponibilité de données très contrastés. La première correspond à une ligne établie, stable et répétable, offrant un cadre favorable à la modélisation, mais dont les données de production restent aujourd’hui peu numérisées et historisées. La seconde correspond à une ligne moins répétable, dont l’historique de production est encore limité et qui est appelée à connaître d’importantes évolutions technologiques : elle constitue un contexte exploratoire pour lequel l’enjeu prioritaire est la maîtrise et l’anticipation des dérives à partir d’un faible nombre d’observations. Pour préserver la confidentialité, les caractéristiques détaillées de ces lignes ne sont pas exposées ici et seront précisées dans le cadre des instances de gouvernance de la Chaire. La question des données est ainsi centrale et transversale aux deux lignes : données faiblement numérisées, données non historisées de manière systématique, et données partiellement détenues par des tiers. Ces problématiques convergent vers un même besoin, la construction d’un data lake structuré capable d’agréger des données hétérogènes, de les normaliser et de les rendre exploitables. Ce socle de données, mis en place dans le cadre d’une action dédiée de la Chaire …

Job Description: 
 Airbus Protect vous propose de contribuer à renforcer notre pôle d’expertise support engineering dans le secteur de l’aéronautique. 
 Votre futur job, si vous l’acceptez… 
 En tant que responsable technique de la maintenance, vous intégrerez un plateau interne client en charge d’analyser les impacts de diverses données d’entrées sur la documentation de maintenance. Puis de vérifier la conformité de l’intégration de ces données après la rédaction des procédures techniques. 
 Votre rôle et vos responsabilités consisteront à : 
 Participer au processus de contrôle et de validation de la documentation technique de maintenance, 
 Analyser des données techniques de maintenance et s’assurer de leurs cohérences vis-à-vis : 
 des données sources approuvées, 
 du respect du concept de maintenance, 
 de la faisabilité technique et des aspects de sécurité/navigabilité pour les clients. 
 Être garant de la conformité et de la bonne application des règles et normes en matière de rédaction technique, 
 Analyser les questions clients, 
 Assurer un backoffice technique pour la gestion des points bloquants, et pour la communication transverse auprès des différents acteurs de la Tech Data (partenaires externes, bureau d’études, experts, Training Centers, MRO, Military Support Center, Tech Rep, Customer Center, etc.), 
 Réaliser des projets soumis à l'approbation des Services Officiels, 
 Maîtriser les outils de données d’entrées techniques et de gestion de production, et savoir en exploiter leur contenu, 
 Contribuer à l’atteinte des jalons de productions (Quality Gates) et être garant de la réussite des objectifs Qualité & Techniques associés (évaluation des risques, reporting des activités régulier, etc.), 
 Représenter le Client et le Service dans les réunions. 
 Etes-vous notre futur talent ? 
 Formation grandes écoles ou universités 
 2 à 5 ans ans d’expérience minimum 
 Solides connaissances en :
 Maintenance aéronautique

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Um aktuelle und zukünftige Projekte zu steuern, sucht Airbus Helicopters Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt für das Team in Donauwörth als unsere/n neue/n
 Cyber Security Systems Architekt (d/m/w) 
 Als Teil unserer Abteilung für Avioniksysteme im Entwicklungsbüro widmen Sie sich der Entwicklung von Avionikarchitekturen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber. Da bei Hubschraubern das Sicherheitsrisiko und dessen mögliche Auswirkungen auf die Flugsicherheit und die Mission bewältigt werden müssen, muss die Avionikarchitektur Mittel zum Schutz vor und zur Erkennung von potenziellen Cyberangriffen bereitstellen. Ihre Aufgabe als Cyber Security Architekt wird es daher sein, in Abstimmung mit dem Avionik-Architekten des Hubschraubers die Cyber-Security-Komponente der Avionikarchitektur zu definieren und zu entwickeln.
 Sie werden diese Tätigkeit in einem zivilen Umfeld mit dem Ziel der EASA-Zertifizierung eines neuen Hubschraubers oder der Zulassung einer Modifikation an einem bestehenden Hubschrauber ausüben, oder in einem militärischen Umfeld mit dem Ziel der Cybersicherheitszertifizierung eines Hubschraubers durch die jeweils zuständige Zulassungsbehörde.
 Ihr Standor t 
 Am Standort Donauwörth am Ufer der Donau nahe Augsburg entwickeln wir Hubschrauber von der ersten Idee bis zum flugfähigen Produkt. Erleben Sie mit uns, wie sie auf unserem eigenen Testflugplatz abheben und landen. 
 Unsere Benefits für Sie 
 Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien. 
 Zeit für Sie (und Ihre Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical) 
 Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven 
 Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten 
 Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird 
 Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Formalisierung der Integration der Cyber-Security-Prozesse des Engineerings in die übergreifenden Engineering-Prozesse innerhalb der Airbus Helicopters Prozesslandschaft (Process Landscape Platform) sowie Sicherstellung der Synchronisation mit den Support-Prozessen 
 Bewertung der Sicherheitsrisiken der Hubschrauberkonfiguration und Definition der erforderlichen Sicherheitsanforderungen für das eingebettete System, die sowohl funktionale als auch Assurance-Aspekte abdecken
 Überwachung der Entwicklung von Sicherheitsfunktionen gemäß ihrem Design Assurance Level
 Formalisierung der Nachweisführung (Compliance Demonstration) hinsichtlich der Lufttüchtigkeitsanforderungen sowie Beitrag zur Sicherheitsakkreditierung des Hubschraubers
 Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen 
 Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium (Luft- und Raumfahrt, Maschinenbau oder Informatik) und zusätzlich umfangreiche Erfahrung und Weiterbildung oder durch eine an das Studium anschließende Promotion
Alternativ: Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium (Luft- und Raumfahrt, Maschinenbau oder Informatik) und zusätzlich erweiterte Erfahrung und Weiterbildung oder durch eine an das Studium anschließende Promotion 
 Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich eingebettete Systeme (Embedded Systems) oder Cyber Security, einschließlich fundierter Erfahrung im Systems Engineering
 Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch und Englisch – verhandlungssicher, Französisch – wünschenswert
 Kenntnisse der luftfahrttechnischen Standards (z. B. ARP 4754, ARP 4761, ED-202, ED-203)
 Fähigkeit zur sicheren Beherrschung der funktionalen Spezifikation/Ausprägung von Sicherheitsmechanismen (Authentifizierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Rechteverwaltung, Signatur, Firewall, Verschlüsselung, Segregation, Intrusion Detection)
 Keine 100%ige Übereinstimmung? Kein Grund zur Sorge! Airbus unterstützt Ihre persönliche Entwicklung mit maßgeschneiderten Entwicklungslösungen. 
 Bringen Sie Ihre Karriere auf ein neues Level und bewerben Sie sich jetzt online !

Job Description: 
 SECURITY CLEARANCE : You will be subject to BPSS and Export Control checks (including a criminal record check) 
 TRAVEL REQUIRED : Frequent travel within UK and international 
 LOCATION: Belfast 
 TYPE: Full time 
 GRADE L3 
 What's In It For You 
 Financial Reward : Competitive salary, annual profit share, contributory pension, share options, 
 Work / Life Balance: 36 hour week, flexible working around core hours and Friday afternoons off, flexible working
 Closing date: 2nd November 2026 
 Job Summary 
 Airbus is embarking on one of its most critical industrial and supply chain integrations to date as we adsorb vital Tier 1 structures supplier—into our global Supply Chain and Logistics organization, our primary focus is securing business continuity and mitigating operational risk. Central to this monumental effort is the expansion of our Enterprise Resources Planning (ERP) system, replacing legacy tools with a unified SAP S/4HANA digital ecosystem. We are looking for a Change Specialist based in Belfast who combines battle-tested change management expertise with a forward-thinking mastery of AI technology to steer this high-stakes integration into the future. 
 The Mission 
 As a Change Engineer you will strategically architect and drive the deployment of ERP S/4HANA across the newly acquired Belfast site, which focuses on the A220 wings and A220 mid fuselage components. Your mission is to seamlessly integrate these complex aerostructures operations into the core Airbus organization, transition 100% of the impacted scope to our common system, and secure production ramp-ups while safeguarding the daily continuity of our global supply chain. 
 HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM 
 Strategic Change Leadership: Architect, own, and execute the localized Change Management Plan for the Belfast site integration. Define the "Case for Change" tailored to a transitioning Tier 1 supplier environment and ensure total business readiness across highly complex supply chain and manufacturing operations. 
 Training Strategy & Content Governance: Oversee and own the development of comprehensive documentation and high-quality learning materials using SAP Enable Now, ensuring alignment with the progressive rollout of the new S/4HANA platform across the Airbus Belfast Site 
 Deployment & Hypercare Orchestration: Design the global deployment framework locally and lead "Train the Trainer" initiatives to ensure flawless end-user adoption among hundreds impacted employees. Structure and lead the post-implementation hypercare phase, establishing robust "How Do I" support governance. 
 Project Management: Manage complex modifications within the classical “waterfall” environment and own the capability to shift to an agile governance (manage complex modifications within SAFe/Agile sprint cycles, seamlessly synchronizing content development with ambitious integration timelines). 
 High-Level Stakeholder Synergy: Serve as the primary liaison and strategic bridge between the Belfast integration team, local executive operations, and the core ERP Change Team, leveraging high-level networking to secure organizational buy-in during a sensitive M&A transition. 
 AI-Driven Transformation: Champion the use of AI and data analytics to predict deployment risks, analyze macroeconomic business impacts, and automate predictive reporting within the integration change pipeline. 
 ABOUT YOU 
 Be educated to degree level in Manufacturing Engineering, Production or Supply-chain, together with a minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience in Aerospace or related complex industries (e.g., Automotive, Defence) 
 OR 
 Be educated to HNC level in Manufacturing Engineering, Production or Supply-chain, together with a minimum of 8 years’ relevant experience in Aerospace or related complex industries (e.g., Automotive, Defence). 
 Experience: Extensive, proven track record in leading large-scale Change Management initiatives, specifically within Aerospace M&A, automotive integrations, or a similarly complex, international industrial supply chain. Direct experience with Tier 1 structures suppliers is a major asset. 
 Tech Intelligence & SAP: Strong proficiency in AI applications to enhance process analysis, risk forecasting, and strategic decision-making. Previous experience leading SAP environments or S/4HANA transitions during corporate carve-ins/integrations is highly desirable. 
 Languages: Fluency in English is mandatory. Proficiency in French and/or German is a distinct advantage. 
 Desirable Skills 
 Methodology: Mastery of classical “waterfall” project management and experience with SAFe/Agile frameworks, paired with a demonstrated history of data-driven problem solving in high-pressure, risk-mitigation environments. 
 Mindset: A highly autonomous, transparent leader who excels at senior-level negotiation, conflict resolution, and driving "win-win" solutions across cross-functional and newly integrated organizational borders. 
 This role …

items.desc: Finance | Remote (Republic of Ireland) Reports to: Senior Finance Manager (SFM) Direct reports: None Location: Remote, Republic of Ireland Job type: Full-time, permanent Salary: Competitive, plus bonus About Medihive Medihive is Ireland's longest-standing telehealth provider and a Deloitte Fast 50 company, built on deep clinical and technical expertise. Backed by leading private and institutional investors, we have recently raised capital to accelerate our growth in digital healthcare. We have a big vision, and we're just getting started. The role This is a varied role spanning management reporting, FP&A and commercial business partnering. As part of a small, remote finance team, you will own budgeting, forecasting and analysis, and work with department heads to turn financial insight into clear business decisions. Experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite is essential. Key responsibilities Month end and reporting Support the month-end close, including general ledger and balance sheet reconciliations. Lead departmental variance analysis (actual vs forecast vs prior year), with clear commentary on trends, risks and opportunities. Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual reporting, and support the Senior Finance Manager with senior leadership and board packs. Planning and analysis Prepare the annual budget and rolling forecasts with heads of department, and hold budget holders to account for performance against plan. Prepare the weekly cash flow forecast and monitor working capital. Develop commercial pricing and financial models to support decision-making and long-term strategic planning. Analyse key metrics and share insight with the relevant teams. Business partnering Support SFM in preparation of financial reports and presentations for senior leadership and key stakeholders. Provide regular financial updates to management, ensuring they are informed of financial performance, risks, and opportunities. Partner with Clinical Operations, Commercial, Engineering and other teams to understand their needs and support decision-making. Support ad hoc projects across finance and the wider business. S ystems and process improvement Support the use of automation, AI and analytics tools, including Power BI dashboards, to improve reporting and insight. Continuous improvement of our forecasting and budgeting process. Build a deep understanding of our financial processes, including month end close. Support financial systems and AI projects, working with IT to implement and improve platforms. About you Essential Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with 3–5 years' experience in FP&A, management accounting or financial analysis. Strong working knowledge of FRS 102. Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills, with experience of budgeting, forecasting and scenario analysis. Hands-on experience with Power BI and finance systems. NetSuite experience, including involvement in ERP migration projects. A commercial, analytical mindset and strong attention to detail. A confident communicator who can explain complex financial information to senior and non-finance audiences. Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, remote environment. Desirable Experience in a technology, healthtech or high-growth business. Knowledge of IFRS. Personal Attributes Strong problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail and accuracy. Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently. Ability to think strategically and translate financial data into actionable insights. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships with stakeholders across the organisation. Adapts easily to a changing environment and responsibilities based on the organisational needs. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment, and managing competing priorities Benefits Competitive salary and bonus. 22 days’ annual leave plus statutory public holidays. Pension scheme after probation (3% employer, 3% employee). Laya Healthcare group scheme (10% off health insurance, 50% off dental) and free access to Laya's digital gym. items.desc: Company Description Cinarra is a data-first company at the forefront of building Adtech and ID mapping solutions. We leverage cutting-edge technology and AI to transform data into actionable insights, driving the future of digital advertising and identity management. Cinarra is a wholly owned by SoftBank. Job Description As a QA Tools Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain the tools and infrastructure that enable efficient and reliable testing across Cinarra’s environments. You will focus on automating QA environment management, evolving our AMI-based infrastructure, and creating scalable environments for functional, load, and performance testing. You will work closely with QA, Development, and Operations teams to ensure infrastructure and platform changes can be tested effectively and consistently. Your work will reduce manual operational effort, improve environment stability, and enable teams to identify scalability and performance issues earlier in the development lifecycle. Role & Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain tools and automation for provisioning, configuring, updating, and supporting QA environments. Own and evolve the QA AMI lifecycle, including automated AMI creation, validation, updating, versioning, and maintenance. Develop and support scalable, production-like test environments for functional, load, performance, and infrastructure testing. Build an approach for managing multiple AMI branches and environment configurations across Development, QA, Pre-Production, and Production stages. Design, implement, and maintain automated load and performance testing solutions that provide meaningful insight into system behavior, scalability, and resource utilization. Develop automated test-data generation and environment preparation capabilities to support large-scale and repeatable testing scenarios. Validate infrastructure-related changes and upgrades, including changes to distributed platform components such as Kafka and other system dependencies. Investigate environment instability, deployment issues, performance degradation, and infrastructure-related failures; develop tooling and automation to prevent recurring problems. Integrate QA infrastructure, environment management, and performance testing workflows into CI/CD pipelines to enable repeatable and reliable testing. Collaborate with QA, Development, and Operations engineers to identify opportunities for automation, improve testability, and continuously enhance the reliability and maintainability of Cinarra’s testing infrastructure. Qualifications Basic Qualifications 6+ years of professional experience in QA Engineering, Test Automation, DevOps, SRE, Infrastructure Engineering, or a similar engineering role. Strong programming or scripting skills in at least one language commonly used for automation and tooling, such as Python or similar Hands-on experience with Linux-based environments, including system configuration, troubleshooting, log analysis, and performance investigation. Experience building or maintaining automated test environments, test infrastructure, or environment provisioning solutions. Practical experience with cloud infrastructure and virtual machine image management, preferably AWS and AMIs. Experience with CI/CD systems and integrating automated testing or infrastructure workflows into delivery pipelines. Understanding of load and performance testing concepts, including workload generation, scalability testing, bottleneck identification, and analysis of test results. Experience troubleshooting distributed applications and infrastructure components and working with logs, metrics, and monitoring tools. Good understanding of software development and QA processes, with the ability to collaborate effectively across QA, Development, and Operations teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience designing or maintaining AMI/image pipelines and managing multiple image versions or branches across different environments. Experience with Infrastructure as Code and configuration-management technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, Packer, or equivalent tools. Hands-on experience with performance and load-testing frameworks such as JMeter, Gatling, Locust, k6, or similar. Experience working with distributed systems and technologies such as Kafka. Experience creating automated test-data generation frameworks for large-scale or performance testing. Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Experience developing internal engineering tools or self-service solutions that reduce manual QA and operational work. items.title: Security Engineer, Bridge
items.card: What you'll do We're hiring a Security Engineer to build and scale the Bridge security foundation. This is a rare opportunity to design a security program from the ground up, while also leveraging the infrastructure, best practices, and tooling of one of the most mature security organizations in the industry. items.desc:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.
 We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.
 What you'll do
 We're hiring a Security Engineer to build and scale the Bridge security foundation. This is a rare opportunity to design a security program from the ground up, while also leveraging the infrastructure, best practices, and tooling of one of the most mature security organizations in the industry.
 Responsibilities
 Design and implement the Bridge security roadmap from first principles to production.
 Identify and tackle the most important Bridge security risks quickly and pragmatically.
 Integrate with Stripe infrastructure where it makes sense, and find custom solutions where it doesn't.
 Lead threat modeling and hardening efforts for the Bridge money movement systems in collaboration with crypto and infra teams.
 Build key security capabilities, including monitoring, secrets management, incident response, access controls, and CI/CD hardening.
 Reinforce engineering best practices around secure development and infrastructure.
 Ensure Bridge meets compliance and audit expectations as we scale to more regulated markets.
 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and the Stripe security organization to move fast without compromising safety.
 Who you are
 Minimum requirements
 8+ years of experience in Security engineering.
 Experience building or scaling security programs at a startup or in an embedded role.
 Preferred qualifications
 Experience in fast-paced startup environments, building security practices from the ground up.
 Startup mindset—scrappy, pragmatic, and quick to solve the most critical problems.
 Comfort writing and debugging backend application code, with Ruby experience preferred.
 Comfort with ambiguity and ability to ruthlessly prioritize.
 Ability to balance security rigor with speed, especially in fast-moving environments.
 Clear communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Interest in the potential of crypto and stablecoins to power global financial infrastructure.

Role Purpose:
As a Formulation Specialist working on oral dosage forms, you will plan, perform and document scientific experiments linked to pharmaceutical development for oral dosage forms for small molecules (New Chemical Entities; NCE).
The purpose of this role is to develop our growing pipeline of oral products. We are looking for an expert in the area of Oral Solid Dosage Forms (small molecules, NCE). As a member of the team, you will play a key role in the development of formulations and processes for oral dosage forms with end-to-end scope, from first-in-human trials to marketing phase.
You will plan, perform and document scientific experiments for formulation- and process development for preparation and timely delivery of drug products incl. support at GMP manufacturing, primarily in the area of Oral Solid Dosage forms. You will participate in scientific teams and contribute to the overall Technical Research and Development strategies and goals. 
 Job Description 
 Major accountabilities 
 For the development of oral solid dosage forms we are looking for an experienced associate. Your duties will be to develop formulations of capsules, film coated tablets or sachets, to develop manufacturing processes including scale-up. In addition, you will support the process transfer to GMP Pilot Plant and Novartis Technical Operations (TechOps) sites, and support the manufacture of clinical supplies under a GMP environment. Your responsibilities will be to plan, perform scientific experiments (or pilot plant processes) for formulation- and process development under minimal guidance from team members and to contribute to the interpretation and report results. You have experience in actively applying digital tools e.g. for reporting of experiments, and are experienced and curious to utilize and to further advance data&digital tools.
 Your accountabilities will include:
 Plan, coordinate, perform and document scientific experiments in collaboration with functional and project leads
 Develop phase appropriate formulations for oral drug products
 Develop efficient and robust processes for oral drug products
 Utilize data digital tools (e.g. e-Lab Journal, digital IPC data handling, digital data recording, data visualization tools)
 Provide raw data documentation, evaluation and interpretation of results
 Propose and provide input for the design of next experiments
 Transfer procedures/instructions to GMP production facilities (e.g. Pilot Plant, NTO), including troubleshooting
 Support the manufacture of clinical supplies under a GMP environment
 Contribute to investment projects and maintenance of infrastructure/equipment.
 Adherence to quality, quantity, and timelines for all assigned tasks.
 Adherence to Novartis standards, in particular, quality, ethical, health, safety, and environment (HSE), and information security (ISEC) standards.
 Reproducibility of experiments and results.

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Als Scientist Measurement Engineering Electronics (m/w/d) leistest Du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zu unserer Vision: der nachhaltigen Verbesserung der Lebensqualität von Patient:innen weltweit. In Deiner Rolle bringst Du Deine Expertise in Messtechnik, Elektronik und elektrochemischen Messverfahren ein, um innovative kontinuierliche Monitoringsysteme (Continuous Glucose Monitoring / CGM) weiterzuentwickeln. Damit hilfst Du, neue diabetesrelevante Parameter und Begleiterkrankungen präzise zu erfassen und bahnbrechende medizintechnische Lösungen für die Praxis zu realisieren
 Dein neues Team: 
 Du wirst Teil unserer Abteilung Sterile Unit Design / Interface am Standort Mannheim. Wir sind ein dynamisches, interdisziplinäres Team, das mit Leidenschaft an den Sensor- und Messtechnologien der Zukunft arbeitet. Bei uns erwarten Dich eine offene Feedbackkultur, Vertrauen und der gemeinsame Wille, die Grenzen des technisch Machbaren im Sinne der Patient:innen zu erweitern.
 Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich 
 Deine Mission ist die messtechnische Weiterentwicklung sowie das Design robuster, regulatorisch konformer Mess- und Sensortechnologien. Dabei übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben: 
 Du planst und steuerst Fach- und Teilprojekte (inklusive Ressourcen, Budget und Investitionen/Capex) eigenverantwortlich unter Einhaltung relevanter Qualitätsstandards. 
 Du gestaltest und erprobst neuartige Messtechnologien sowie Breadboards im Labor- und Technikumsmaßstab gemeinsam mit internen und externen Partnern und bewertest deren Funktionalität systematisch. 
 Du entwickelst messtechnische Systeme, Methoden und Prozesse stetig weiter und nutzt moderne Simulationswerkzeuge (z. B. SPICE), um die Entwicklungsleistung zu optimieren. 
 Du wertest Versuchsergebnisse mit mathematischen Methoden aus, dokumentierst diese normgerecht und präsentierst Deine Ergebnisse überzeugend in Gremien. 
 Du bringst Dein Know-how in Analog Frontends, Ultra-Low-Power-Architekturen sowie RF-Design ein und bewertest neue Detektionsansätze für zukünftige Messplattformen. 
 Du arbeitest eng mit internationalen Lieferanten sowie Entwicklungspartnern zusammen und bringst Dich aktiv in agilen Projektteams (z. B. nach SAFe) ein. 
 Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit 
 Wir suchen eine neugierige, zielstrebige Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Teamgeist und Freude an komplexen interdisziplinären Fragestellungen. Du verknüpfst technologische Exzellenz mit einer klaren Lösungsorientierung. Du bringst folgende Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten mit: 
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik (Master of Science oder vergleichbarer Abschluss). 
 3–5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der technischen Entwicklung, vorzugsweise im medizinischen oder sensorischen Umfeld. 
 Fundierte Kenntnisse in Messtechnik, Elektronik und Analog Frontends für Multi-Analyt-Sensoren im In-Vivo-Einsatz. 
 Erfahrung mit Ultra-Low-Power-Embedded-Architekturen (Hardware/Software), elektrochemischen Verfahren (z. B. EIS, SWV, CV) sowie im Requirements Engineering. 
 Vertrauter Umgang mit CAD- und SPICE-Simulationstools sowie Kenntnisse in RF-Design und -Optimierung. 
 Erfahrung mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden (z. B. SAFe) sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams 
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (C1) in Wort und Schrift 
 Die Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet. 
 Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens 02.11.2026 
 (Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist) 
 Deine Bewerbung 
 Ganz pragmatisch: Bitte lade online nur Deinen Lebenslauf hoch. 
 Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir kein Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse oder Ähnliches. 
 Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! 
 Your contact to us! With people. For people.
 Do you need further support?
 Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Job Description: 
 Purpose/ Mission: 
 The jobholder works within Customer Experience and Central Operations team in Customer Support (SC). The department is responsible for leading Customer Experience and Central Operations activities at Company and function level which includes 
 Customer satisfaction monitoring by capturing customer feedback (surveys, Heatmap, escalation process) 
 Drumbeating action plan resulting from analysis of various feedback (CSIP action plan, localized action plan from transactional surveys, case and complains resolution, central Ops action tracking) 
 Identify In service Irritant and in particular drumbeat In Service Top Irritant (Monthly follow-up and S leadership Team Irritant board ) 
 Lead the Customer axis of the Customer Services transformation platform on behalf of Customer Support. 
 Drive Customer Experience process and methodology across Customer Services 
 Manage internal communication though LTTs to ensure ‘One voice’ in front of our customers 
 Manage external communication on actions performed to address Customer feedback captured (CSIP website, support and coordination on dedicated webinars) 
 As the Business Owner for Salesforce Platform , this role involves collaborating with customer-facing teams to ensure CRM platforms and digital tools support efficient information and query management, ultimately driving an exceptional customer service experience. 
 Dimensions: 
 Working in a MFT environment product owners, business owners, solution owners and interfacing with Business Lines and Regions within Customer Services 
 Working across different hierarchical levels within the organization 
 Working across all Regions of Customer Support 
 No direct team management

 Your activities will combine promoting the Voice of the Customer with driving the evolution of the Salesforce CRM platform: 
 1. Analyze, Optimize, and Promote Platform Value Data & Process Improvement: Analyze CRM data to identify trends and process improvement areas for managing customer relationships. 
 Network Animation: Lead and animate the SC Salesforce Ambassadors Network across regions. 
 Reporting & Capabilities: Develop/update dashboards responding to internal requests and collaborate on data quality for performance reporting. 
 Adoption Strategy: Own the end-to-end user adoption strategy, ensuring Salesforce is viewed across teams as a growth tool rather than a data-entry tool. 
 2. Continuous Innovation and Strategic Communication Emerging Technologies: Actively evaluate emerging technologies and AI integrations (e.g., Einstein, Agentforce) to continuously upgrade the platform’s capabilities and automate manual workflows. 
 Strategic Communication: Act as the primary point of contact for the SC community to capture evolving business needs and communicate platform strategy and updates transparently. 
 Training: Design comprehensive onboarding and continuous training programs as the platform evolves. 
 Outputs 
 End-to-end user adoption strategies and training roadmaps. 
 Reports and Dashboards including CRM analytics in Salesforce. 
 Regular platform strategy updates and dedicated communications. 
 Requirements - our ideal candidate will have: 
 Role Requirements & Qualifications Education: Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology (IT), Management Information Systems (MIS), Master in Artificial Intelligence (AI), or a related field. 
 Experience: 4–6 years of experience in project management, leading cross-functional projects and stakeholder groups, and managing CRM implementations is a plus. 
 Technical & Soft Skills Salesforce Ecosystem: Strong understanding of Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Lightning Experience, and reporting/dashboards. Familiarity with AI tools like Einstein and Agentforce is a plus. 
 Agile Framework: Experienced in managing acceptance criteria and working within an Agile/Scrum development environment. 
 Communication & Translation: Ability to translate complex business needs into technical logic, and vice-versa. 
 Core Competencies: Customer mindset, strong data analysis skills, advanced English proficiency, and excellent decision-making capabilities.

 Diverse career opportunities within Airbus European core countries or in other regions around the world. 
 A hybrid working model, allowing you to combine onsite and offsite work. 
 A modern office, well connected to public transportation. 
 A motivated and fun crew to grow and build and shape the GBS together. 
 An intense and exciting onboarding experience.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Ingénieur Méthodes et Performance Maintenance (f/h) pour rejoindre notre département Assemblage, Intégration et Tests (AIT) basé à Toulouse, France. 
 Vos missions : 
 Vous ferez partie d'une équipe passionnée et engagée , en charge du pôle Maintenance et Moyens Industriels . Au sein de la plus grande salle blanche d'Europe dédiée à la fabrication de satellites, vous serez impliqué(e) dans le pilotage et l'optimisation des méthodes de maintenance visant à maximiser la fiabilité, la disponibilité et la compétitivité de notre parc d'équipements industriels de haute technologie. 
 Vos responsabilités : 
 Vos activités s'articulent autour de 4 grands axes : 
 1. Déploiement du projet de maintenance industrielle et digitale : 
 Accompagner le déploiement d'une nouvelle solution de Gestion de la Maintenance Assistée par Ordinateur (GMAO) pour le pilotage et la planification des opérations préventives et correctives. 
 Intégrer les nouvelles technologies et assurer une veille technologique (ex. maintenance prédictive, Intelligence Artificielle / IA). 
 2. Démarche d'amélioration continue et démarche TPM : 
 Piloter le projet de Maintenance Productive Totale (TPM - Total Productive Maintenance ) afin d'ancrer une culture de maintenance autonome et d'en assurer la montée en maturité. 
 Accompagner et former les équipes opérationnelles pour garantir l'adhésion aux nouvelles méthodes de travail et mesurer les gains de compétitivité obtenus. 
 3. Analyse de la fiabilité et plans de maintenance : 
 Mettre à jour les plans de maintenance en lien avec l'ensemble des experts techniques et opérationnels. 
 Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et de fiabilité, tout en réalisant l'analyse des causes racines en cas de dysfonctionnement ou de panne. 
 4. Communication et suivi de la performance : 
 Présenter les résultats et avancements lors des commissions d'amélioration continue et des audits clients externes pour valoriser l'excellence industrielle du site. 
 OBLIGATOIRE : 
 Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Votre profil : 
 Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle en amélioration continue, performance industrielle, ingénierie de maintenance ou gestion de systèmes de production. 
 Solides connaissances des méthodes de maintenance industrielle (TPM, maintenance préventive/corrective) et des outils digitaux de Gestion de la Maintenance Assistée par Ordinateur (GMAO). 
 Maîtrise du pilotage de projet, des démarches de résolution de problèmes et de la gestion des indicateurs de performance. 
 Excellentes qualités relationnelles, sens du service, écoute et capacité à communiquer avec pédagogie auprès d'équipes pluridisciplinaires. 
 Niveau d'anglais avancé et français couramment maîtrisé (niveau négociation) pour échanger dans un environnement international. 
 Disponibilité pour des déplacements professionnels ponctuels. 
 Des déplacements professionnels ponctuels sont à prévoir et, de ce fait, vous devez être disposé(e) à vous déplacer en conséquence.
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! 
 Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : 
 Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d'actions souscrites. 
 Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et d’autres services. 
 Bien-être / santé : Couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage. 
 Développement individuel : Des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale). 
 Vous ne matchez pas à 100% ? Pas d'inquiétude ! Airbus vous accompagnera dans votre plan de développement. 
 Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en candidatant en ligne maintenant ! 
 #LI-GOPOST

items.desc:
Lieu : Massy, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
L’activité Systèmes terrestres et aériens basé sur le site de Massy est leader dans les systèmes de commandement et de contrôle des opérations aériennes et les systèmes radars de défense aérienne. 
 Passionné(e) par les défis posés par les systèmes d’informations complexes, critiques et sécurisés, vous souhaitez percer les enjeux de la protection aérienne ? Dans un environnement international et techniquement riche, vous apportez votre expérience et vos compétences dans la définition des architectures logicielles de nos systèmes.
 Notre site de Massy est leader dans les systèmes de surveillance, commande et contrôle des opérations aériennes. Basé(e) à Massy jusqu’à la fin de l’année 2026, vous serez ensuite localisé(e), début 2027, sur notre futur site à Vélizy , tout autant accessible en transports en commun.
 Nos Solutions sont des systèmes complexes, composés de nombreux composants logiciels. Ces derniers seront sous la responsabilité des développeurs, y compris en terme conception interne. En tant qu’Architect logiciel, vous devez être en capacité d’installer un environnement de développement et de lire/revoir du code, mais vous interviendrez de manière prépondérante sur la Solution globale, à un niveau d’abstraction supérieure, via à une approche à l’échelle.
 Votre mission sera de transformer le QUOI en COMMENT au niveau Solution (et assemblage des logiciels), en adoptant une vision hélicoptère (du besoin client aux composants logiciels).
 A ce titre, vos principales activités seront de :
 Travailler en co-ingénierie pluridisciplinaire avec les : ingénieurs système, ingénieurs infrastructures, développeurs, valideurs, pilotes.
 Identifier, à partir de QUOI, les différentes solutions sur le COMMENT (composants logiciels impactés, messages inter-composant) au regard des contraintes de coût, délais, maintenance, et réutilisation.
 Modéliser et documenter les choix retenus.
 Accompagner les développeurs lors de la déclinaison de la solution.
 Contribuer aux analyses techniques lors de la mise au point du système.
 Contribuer à définir la roadmap de nos produits (obsolescences, nouvelles technos).
 Contribuer aux communautés techniques et métier au sein du groupe Thales.
 Participer à l’élaboration des devis en phase Offre.
 Vous serez intégré(e) sur les projets de nos familles produit à l’export. Vous serez un acteur de la stratégie Produit à court et long terme, où vous apporterez votre vision en termes de stratégie de réutilisation, d’instanciation de la variabilité, d’insertion technologique, et de déclinaison de la Ligne de Produit d’Ingénierie portée par le groupe.
 Une intervention sur des projets Legacy, en maintien en condition opérationnelle et à fort taux de réutilisation est également une possibilité.
 Des déplacements ponctuels en France et à l’étranger sont à prévoir.
 Votre Profil : 
 Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénierie ou formation équivalente BAC+5 dans les domaines informatique, télécom, électronique ou aéronautique avec une culture logicielle forte, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative d’à minima 5 ans en tant qu’architecte sur des systèmes complexes à logiciel prépondérant.
 Vous revendiquez un niveau spécialiste sur les sujets suivants : 
 Cycles d’ingénierie logicielle : agile, incrémental, cycle en V, de la phase d’incubation à la phase de maintenance opérationnelle. 
 Architectures logicielles : client/server, 3-tiers, hexagonale, événementielle, micro-service, patrons de conception (visiteur, factory, Facade, Observer…), client lourds vs clients légers, architecture orientée services vs orientée données.
 Solutions de communication : tcp/ip, webService, API, bus de données type Pub/Sub, Kafka, DDS, etc.
 Les approches MBSE et la modélisation via modelers.

 Langages de programmation …

Update the schedule, risk & opportunities register, the ETC & EAC

The WPM must collect, analyse and synthesise the strengths and weaknesses during the performance of the work package, propose recommendations for improvement and record these as prescribed in the PMP

The WPM must ensure that all the commitments taken in his work package description sheet have been honoured by collating all WP data, costs and estimates, recording them and then organise a closure review

Company: 
Qualcomm France S.A.R.L. 
 Job Area: 
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering 
 General Summary: 
 Qualcomm’s Data Center AI Architecture team defines next-generation cloud AI system-on-chip (SoC) and systems for generative AI inference workloads that demand exceptional compute, memory bandwidth, capacity, and system scalability.
 We are seeking exceptional architects to help shape multiple generations of AI accelerators and complete data center systems, with a strong focus on SoC, memory, and system architecture and technologies.
 If you are passionate about solving complex architecture challenges in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while contributing to building a substantial new business for one of the leading system-on-chip and computer architecture companies in the industry, we want to hear from you.

 Partner across architecture, design, systems, product, software, platform, and customer teams to deliver market-leading data center systems
 Translate product and workload requirements into SoC and system specifications, and drive feature-set requirements into technology, IP, platform, and software teams

 Follow designs through implementation and production, correlate observed system performance with models and targets, identify root causes of gaps, and drive performance to closure

 · Ability to execute quantitative SoC, system, and competitive studies using high-level calculators, spreadsheets, analytical models, profilers, and functional or performance simulators
 · Experience developing architecture methodologies, tools, and analysis frameworks and translating findings into actionable recommendations
 · Experience correlating modeled and measured system performance, isolating hardware and software bottlenecks, and driving cross-functional performance closure through production
 · Excellent technical communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills, including presenting to technical and business stakeholders
 · Self-directed execution, mentorship of others, and rigorous attention to accuracy
 Additional Qualifications: 
 · Understanding of generative AI and machine-learning workloads, especially Large Language Model inference and accelerator bottlenecks
 · Experience in processor, accelerator, or system architecture, including ISA design, microarchitecture, performance modeling, system topology, scale-up or scale-out networks, or hardware/software co-design
 · Knowledge of DRAM and memory-controller architecture, bandwidth, latency, and power tradeoffs, protocols such as LPDDR, HBM, DDR, or GDDR, and emerging technologies such as processing-in-memory, processing-near-memory, or 3D integration
 · Expertise in one or more data center SoC or system technologies such as RAS, ECC, security, encryption, Ethernet or InfiniBand networking, RDMA, network interface controllers, switches, congestion control, chip-to-chip or die-to-die protocols, chiplets, PHYs, power and thermals, advanced packaging, platform management, or system scalability
 · Programming ability for architecture modeling and automation; object-oriented C++ and Python preferred
 · Fluent with using AI to accelerate workflows

 Product Owner – B2B Digital Ecosystem Platform at ETH Space

ETH Zurich | Space encompasses overall five units: Education, Research, Entrepreneurship, the ETH Swiss GeoLab, and the space mission LIFE.

 Project background
 In support of our initiatives within the Entrepreneurship unit of ETH Zurich | Space, we are spearheading the creation of a highly secure, closed B2B digital platform in collaboration with ESA and their ESA Commercialization network. The ultimate objective of this ecosystem platform is to give the European space startup and industry ecosystem a boost, by facilitating more cross-border connections, commercial deals, and collaboration across Europe, to accelerate companies’ development overall.

 In this role, you will serve as the strategic bridge between a diverse network of high-profile international stakeholders (e.g. from ESA, space companies, ESA BIC managers), agile entrepreneurs (e.g. from the ESA BIC network), and software engineers. You will lead the requirements engineering process, translate ecosystem needs into clear technical specifications, select the right development partner, and take ultimate ownership of the project's timely delivery.

 Roadmap ownership: manage the overarching project timeline, ensuring key milestones are met for a timely, high-quality deployment.
 Oversee development & quality: supervise the external implementation partner throughout the development, testing, and deployment cycles, ensuring rigorous adherence to timelines and scope.
 Ensure technical & security excellence: Define and enforce robust platform governance, including strict role-based access management, secure third-party data integrations, high-standard data residency compliance, and system scalability.
 Stakeholder management: beyond the scoping workshops, you are the principal person to interact with diverse stakeholders, to integrate their different perspectives, and to make sure that the project stays on track and delivers the promised results.

 Education: a university degree in computer science or a related field is expected. We are open to other degrees if you have significant, relevant work experience.
 Experience : you have a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience with a proven track record as a Product Owner or Product Manager leading the delivery of complex web-based B2B portals, collaboration networks, or enterprise-grade software applications.
 Technical skills: 
 Strong technical literacy: sound understanding of modern web application frameworks, API / webhook architecture, role-based access control, and modern AI / LLM deployment frameworks.
 Data & AI savviness: experience defining requirements for smart matching engines, data-processing pipelines, or AI-driven user feeds is highly advantageous

items.desc:
Role highlights 
 QMS Specialist 
 Location: Spain
 Department: GMO – Manufacturing Assurance
 Reports to: Global QMS Manager
 Employment type: Permanent
 Workplace model: On-site
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)
 Why this role matters 
 The Quality Management System (QMS) Specialist/engineer is responsible for implementation of the ICEYEs Quality Management System in our Valencia production unit to ensure consistent delivery of products and services that meet customer, regulatory, and industry standards. In this role you will partner closely with production, supply chain, Health and safety teams to ensure that our processes are aligned with business goals and embedded into daily practices.
 This role will report to the Global Quality Management System (QMS) manager and operate as a standalone position within the Spain facility.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.
 As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring including oil-spill detection, and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.
 ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 Ensure ICEYE Quality Management System is fully implemented in our Valencia facility
 Drive ICEYE production framework maturity increase in Valencia - be the subject matter expert for QMS, QA, Support Health and safety and environmental topics.
 Ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, and industry requirements, serve as the main point of contact for auditors and certification bodies.
 Act as an internal auditor in our internal process audits covering quality and supporting EHS topics.
 Ensure controlled documentation rigor in Valencia operations
 Define and track quality KPIs; prepare and present regular performance reports to leadership.
 Provide training and coaching on QMS processes, standards, and quality tools; promote a culture of quality throughout the organization.
 What we’re looking for 
 Must haves: 
 5+ years in quality, engineering, operations, compliance, or process improvement roles.
 Strong experience with digital QMS systems and data-driven improvement methods.
 Strong knowledge of QMS standards (ISO 9001 required; AS9100, AQAP2110, PECAL or similar beneficial)
 Experience with quality tools and risk management (RCA, CAPA, FMEA, PDCA, risk assessments).
 Audit experience, either as an internal auditor or supporting external certification
 Adaptability and a real willingness to learn; comfortable in a fast-paced, agile production environment where processes are still taking shape
 Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills
 Ability to drive cross-functional alignment and work independently with minimal supervision
 Professional fluency in both English and Spanish
 Nice to haves: 
 Degree in Engineering, Quality, Business, or related field.
 Knowledge of AS9100, AQAP 2110, PECAL, or ISO 27001

items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. At Alan, we want people to find the right product to take care of themselves, as early and as easily as possible. Getting a new pair of glasses usually means an appointment, a lost prescription, 47 frames tried on in a store, and a two-week delay. Most people put it off for months. The Shop is how Alan members get glasses, lenses and well-being products in a few clicks, covered by their insurance when possible. Most e-commerce teams are incentivized to sell more. We're incentivized to get members the right product at the right time for their health. We're looking for a fullstack engineer to join the Shop crew. One brief: help our members choose what is right for them, when it is right for them, in a few clicks. Everything else, we figure out together. About the Shop crew The Shop crew is a fully autonomous product team that owns the whole lifecycle of the Shop: not just the code, but the whole business. Product managers, product marketers, ops specialists, designers, data scientists and engineers work side by side on one mission. What we've built so far: An end-to-end optics experience: frames and lenses, virtual try-on, prescription scanning, and checkout priced against each member's coverage. One commerce platform behind the whole Shop and its three verticals. A growing well-being catalog: about 14 brands and 170 products today, thousands soon. The Shop is growing fast: more products, smoother flows, and an experience that's more and more integrated into the rest of Alan for our members. The crew needs to grow too, and that means plenty of new opportunities for engineers. What you'll do The Shop is one of the most varied crews in Alan Engineering. In the same week, you might: Build integrations with our customized e-commerce back office, our in-house virtual try-on, suppliers and partner opticians. Ship member-facing flows: dynamic catalogs, purchase flows tailored to each member's coverage, prescription scanning, returns, and out-of-pocket purchases like lens upgrades and extra pairs. Scale the catalog beyond optics, with discovery and personalized navigation that still work at thousands of products. Navigate legal ground: e-commerce rules, invoicing, France's 100% Santé reform, and supplier compliance. Selling medical devices is not like selling socks. Help products reach members in the Alan app, in campaigns, and through Mo, our AI health assistant. A shop that can't promote its products is just a warehouse. Work with ops on orders, deliveries and customer service, so a two-day delay never surprises a member. You won't just write code. You'll question supplier contracts, debate marketing copy, and debug prescription-scanning logic. Some days it feels less like building software and more like running a small business. That's the point. And the impact is direct: when someone orders their glasses faster, they literally see better, sooner. What we're looking for 8+ years building scalable software, with full-stack experience across backend and frontend. A strong product mindset. You want to understand the why before the how, and you enjoy working with members, ops, legal and marketing. Ownership from start to finish: you frame the problem, ship the solution, and watch the numbers afterwards. Comfort with ambiguity and complex problems. You help shape the scope instead of waiting for a spec. Clear communication with non-engineers, in English (French is a plus, since our first market is France). Humility, curiosity, and a real interest in making healthcare more accessible. Bonus points Experience with e-commerce: catalogs, checkout, payments, order management, or a headless commerce platform like Saleor. Curiosity about where e-commerce meets healthcare. Experience with mobile (React Native) or with LLM-powered product features. How we work Our stack: React and React Native on the frontend, …

items.desc: Architecte Technologies IA – Large Language Models (LLM) Vous êtes En tant qu’AI/LLM Architect opérationnel ( hands-on ), vous serez au cœur de la conception et du développement de systèmes d’IA avancés qui alimentent les entreprises modernes. Il s’agit d’un rôle hautement technique et pratique dans lequel vous consacrerez la majorité de votre temps à l’architecture et à l’ingénierie de solutions d’IA réelles couvrant le machine learning traditionnel, l’IA générative et les systèmes agentiques, dans le cadre de missions clients actives. Vous traduirez les besoins métier en décisions d’architecture concrètes, en sélectionnant les bons patterns de conception, en évaluant et benchmarkant les frameworks techniques, en assemblant des composants réutilisables et en réalisant des choix technologiques réfléchis qui équilibrent innovation et fiabilité de niveau entreprise ( enterprise-grade ). Vous concevrez et développerez des architectures d’agents IA, incluant l’orchestration multi-agents, l’utilisation d’outils ( tool use ), les skills et les systèmes de mémoire, tout en travaillant directement avec des foundation models via le fine-tuning , le Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) et l’intégration de modèles personnalisés. Une part importante de votre travail consistera également à concevoir et mettre en œuvre la couche de contexte IA ( AI Context Layer ) qui rend ces systèmes réellement intelligents en production. Vous connecterez des bases de connaissances d’entreprise, des sources de données structurées et non structurées ainsi que des contenus métiers spécifiques afin de garantir que les réponses générées soient fiables, pertinentes et alignées sur les enjeux du client. Vous concevrez et validerez les systèmes vis-à-vis des exigences non fonctionnelles de l’entreprise, notamment en matière de sécurité, d’observabilité, de gouvernance, de performance et de scalabilité. L’un des principaux livrables de ce rôle est la production d’artefacts d’architecture et d’ingénierie concrets. Cela signifie que vous développerez et prendrez en charge des composants logiciels en tant que praticien, en construisant, intégrant et testant des modules de systèmes d’IA, tout en produisant des documents d’architecture détaillés tels que les Architecture Decision Records (ADR), les diagrammes de composants, les diagrammes de flux de données ( data flow diagrams ) et les spécifications d’intégration qui serviront de référence aux équipes d’ingénierie. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires composées de Data Engineers, ML Engineers et développeurs applicatifs. Ce poste représente une excellente opportunité de développer une expertise approfondie sur l’ensemble de la stack d’architecture IA, d’affiner vos réflexes d’ingénierie sur des problématiques complexes et concrètes, et de construire une trajectoire de carrière vers un rôle de Lead Architect ou Principal Architect. Vos missions Concevoir, développer et livrer de manière autonome des composants logiciels couvrant l’ensemble de l’architecture IA, en prenant la responsabilité de bout en bout du design, du développement, de l’intégration et des tests. Concevoir et développer des architectures d’agents IA, incluant les agents individuels, leurs prompts, outils et skills, l’orchestration multi-agents ainsi que les systèmes de mémoire, tout en réalisant des choix réfléchis de patterns d’architecture et de technologies. Évaluer plusieurs options de conception et approches techniques afin de prendre des décisions d’architecture justifiées, équilibrant fonctionnalités, coût, performance et fiabilité de niveau entreprise. Concevoir, développer et exécuter des stratégies d’évaluation permettant de mesurer la qualité des agents et des systèmes sur des critères tels que l’exactitude ( accuracy ), la pertinence ( relevance ) et la fidélité ( faithfulness ), puis transformer ces résultats en améliorations de conception. Architecturer et implémenter l’intégration de foundation models, en sélectionnant les modèles, méthodes d’invocation et approches de personnalisation ( fine-tuning , RAG, intégrations personnalisées) les plus adaptés selon les compromis entre performance, coût et capacités. Concevoir et développer des pipelines d’adaptation et de fine-tuning des modèles en appliquant une bonne compréhension des architectures basées sur les Transformers afin d’optimiser le choix et les performances des modèles. Concevoir et développer la couche de contexte IA ( AI Context Layer ), incluant la conception de graphes de contexte et de pipelines d’ingestion capables d’analyser, segmenter ( chunk ), enrichir et indexer des contenus structurés ou non structurés issus de l’entreprise, ainsi que les composants de recherche permettant d’ancrer les réponses IA …

items.desc: Your Mission At Accenture, you shape the environment in which you thrive – with ways of working that suit you. You stay flexible and become part of a team full of unique individuals who make a difference together. As a hands-on AI/LLM Architect, you will be at the heart of designing and building advanced AI systems that power the modern enterprise. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role — you will spend the majority of your time in the architecture and engineering of real-world AI solutions across classical machine learning, generative AI, and agentic systems, delivering these within active client engagements. You will translate requirements into concrete architecture decisions: selecting design patterns, evaluating and benchmarking technical frameworks, assembling reusable components, and making deliberate technology choices that balance innovation with enterprise-grade reliability. You will design and build AI agent architectures — including multi-agent orchestration, tool use, skills use, and memory systems — and work hands-on with foundation models through fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and custom model integration. A part of your work will also involve engineering the AI context layer that makes these systems intelligent in practice — connecting enterprise knowledge bases, structured and unstructured data sources, and domain-specific content so that AI outputs are grounded, accurate, and relevant to the client's business. You will design and validate systems against enterprise non-functional requirements across security, observability, governance, performance, and scalability. A core output of this role is the production of tangible engineering and architecture deliverables. This means writing and owning software components — building, integrating, and testing AI system modules as a practitioner — alongside producing detailed architecture artifacts including architecture decision records (ADRs), component diagrams, data flow diagrams, and integration specifications that guide and enable broader engineering teams. You will work with cross-functional delivery teams alongside data engineers, ML engineers, and application developers, and this role is an opportunity to develop deep expertise across the full AI architecture stack, sharpen your engineering instincts on complex, real-world problems, and build a foundation for growing into a lead or principal architect over time. Your Daily Work Independently design, build, and deliver software components across the AI architecture — owning them end to end from design through implementation, integration, and testing as a hands-on practitioner Design and build AI agent architectures — including individual agents, their prompts, tools, and skills, multi-agent orchestration, and memory systems — making deliberate design pattern and technology choices Design and implement agent orchestration patterns that handle task handoffs, communication, state management, and error recovery, validating them through hands-on prototyping Evaluate multiple design options and technical approaches, making deliberate, justified design choices that balance capability, cost efficiency, performance, and enterprise-grade reliability Design, build, and run evaluation strategies and harnesses that measure agent and system quality on metrics such as accuracy, relevance, and faithfulness, translating findings into design improvements Architect and implement foundation model integrations — selecting the right models, invocation patterns, and customization approaches (fine-tuning, RAG, custom integration) based on capability, cost, and performance trade-offs Design and build model adaptation and fine-tuning pipelines, applying working knowledge of transformer-based architectures to inform model selection and optimization Design and build the AI context layer — including context graph design and ingestion pipelines that parse, chunk, enrich, and index structured and unstructured enterprise content, and the retrieval components that ground AI outputs in the client's knowledge Build embedding, vector storage, and retrieval (semantic, hybrid, reranking) into end-to-end RAG pipelines, applying integration patterns that connect to enterprise data sources Design and implement context assembly and memory components that manage prompts, context windows, and conversational state for grounded, accurate
