items.desc: About the client and the challenge Our client is a global leader in passenger information systems — the displays, on-board computers, and real-time data platforms that tell millions of passengers when their bus, tram, or train arrives, in vehicles and terminals across Europe and North America. Having grown through multiple acquisitions across Europe, the client now operates a mixed landscape: transit fleets running hardware and backend systems from different acquired vendors — some brand new, some deeply legacy. Their strategic goal is to consolidate everything onto one unified cloud platform capable of managing both new and legacy systems, without disrupting vehicles in daily service. The first engagement is the migration of a legacy real-time transit system to the unified platform: re-implementing industry data protocols (real-time vehicle feeds, timetable imports, on-board device communication) as cloud services. More migration and modernization initiatives of similar shape will follow — this role is designed to lead them. About the role We are looking for a Tech Lead / Solutions Architect to become the long-term technical owner of this account at N-iX — not a per-project consultant. Requests from the client are often broad or abstract ("we need to migrate this system") and the concrete scope has to be discovered : investigate the legacy landscape, define what actually needs to be done, shape it into a roadmap and technical backlog, then guide delivery. This makes the role as much about bridging the business and technical worlds as about architecture itself: you'll translate business intent into technical direction and technical reality back into business language the client's leadership can act on. You will build and hold a holistic, cross-project view of the client's ecosystem — how their platforms, legacy systems, and initiatives interconnect — becoming the ultimate knowledge holder on the N-iX side and the client's trusted technical counterpart. As the current project completes, you will carry that context into the next initiatives and act as the technical driver of the whole account. Technology landscape: the legacy systems to be migrated are written mostly in C# and C++ (with Java present elsewhere in the client's ecosystem); the target platform is built in Python on Azure , with an MQTT-centric, event-driven architecture. You won't be supporting the legacy code — you'll be reading and dissecting it to migrate it. Responsibilities: Own solution architecture across the account: from ambiguous requests to investigated scope, target architecture, roadmap, and estimated technical backlog Lead technical discovery of legacy systems and define migration strategies to the target platform Act as the client's primary technical counterpart: workshops, architectural decisions, trade-off discussions with their engineering leadership and domain experts Guide the development team day to day: architecture and code reviews, technical standards, unblocking design decisions; hands-on coding when it matters most (PoCs, critical components) Own and maintain system documentation: architecture decisions, protocol specifications, and migration knowledge — kept current as delivery reveals gaps, so account knowledge lives in artifacts, not only in heads Safeguard the integrity of the overall platform architecture (event-driven, MQTT as the single source of truth, adapter-based integrations) across teams and initiatives Identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities across projects; feed them into account planning together with delivery and engagement managers Drive AI adoption & strategic application: Proactively identify high-ROI opportunities across the engagement where AI tools can accelerate discovery, reverse-engineering, and delivery; advise client stakeholders and N-iX teams on where, when, and how to deploy AI safely and effectively Requirements: 8+ years in software engineering, 3+ years in a solution architect / tech lead role on complex backend or integration-heavy systems Proven experience leading legacy modernization / platform migration programs, including working with codebases you didn't write A software engineer's mindset rather than a single-language identity: we're not looking for "a C# engineer" or "a Python engineer," but someone ready to deep-dive into unfamiliar legacy codebases (C#, C++, Java) for migration purposes and design their replacements in the target stack (Python) Proven experience as a bridge between business and engineering: comfortable in front of C-level and product stakeholders as much as in a codebase, able to drive decisions on both sides Hands-on AI-augmented workflow & advocacy: Proven personal track record of integrating AI tools into your daily engineering practice, with the initiative and credibility to champion AI adoption across development teams, set standards and review guardrails, and mentor engineers on getting the most out of AI assistance. You will be involved throughout the product journey, from identifying opportunities and shaping new propositions to driving go-to-market activities, measuring performance, and continuously improving the customer experience. About the Role As our Proposition Management Associate, you will work closely with the Proposition Domain Manager for Digital and the wider Proposition Management Team to identify, develop, and bring innovative digital services to market. Our ambition is to expand our digital services offering, exploring new ways to create value for customers and reach new audiences beyond our traditional product portfolio. We are entering an exciting phase where we are bringing new digital propositions to market, both as part of our existing customer offering and as standalone services available to a wider audience. You will play an important role in defining how these services reach customers, supporting customer acquisition and activation, and helping establish the right commercial strategies and performance indicators to drive future growth. The role combines elements of digital product management, proposition development, and go-to-market execution , offering the opportunity to influence both the development of new features and how our services are positioned and launched. Working across multiple markets and alongside international teams, you will help build and evolve digital propositions that can scale across different geographies, customer segments, and technology platforms. What You'll Be Doing Drive digital product launches: Support the development and launch of new B2C digital products and services, from initial concept through go-to-market execution and ongoing improvement. Shape compelling propositions: Identify customer needs and market opportunities, translating insights into attractive and commercially viable digital services. Develop go-to-market strategies: Work closely with commercial and market teams to define how new services are introduced, promoted, and adopted by customers, including both standalone and existing portfolio offerings. Drive customer acquisition and activation: Identify opportunities to attract new users, improve onboarding and activation, and create the foundation for long-term engagement and revenue growth. Contribute to product development: Collaborate with UX/UI designers, product owners, developers, and architecture teams to shape new features and continuously improve existing solutions. Measure and optimise performance: Define and monitor relevant KPIs related to acquisition, activation, customer engagement, commercial performance, and user experience, using data to guide decisions. Support international expansion: Contribute to the launch and evolution of digital services across European and Latin American markets, adapting propositions to different customer needs and market conditions. items.desc:
Jinto , déploie l’IA Claude d’Anthropic là où elle a le plus d’impact : dans les fonctions de gestion des entreprises. 
 Notre mission : aider les entreprises à tirer le meilleur parti de Claude :
 déployer Claude de manière sécurisée en entreprise;
 mettre en place des pratiques de développement agentique chez les équipes client (cycle de développement agentique outillé et partagé par toute l’équipe, du ticket jusqu’à la livraison, en intégrant la revue de code, les contrôles de sécurité et le déploiement);
 rénover, retro-documenter ou développer des applications;
 sécuriser et fiabiliser les processus de gestion d’entreprise (par exemple Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay et Record-to-Report), et de manière générale tout processus accélérable avec de l’IA (gestion documentaire par exemple);
 réduire les coûts de migration ou de montée de version ERP en automatisant les phases répétitives (migration de données, tests de non régression).
 En tant qu’ AI Engineer , vous construisez avec les équipes clients (sur site ou hybride) des agents IA fiables, de l’idée à la production, en quelques semaines.
 Vous ne serez pas seul.e : vous rejoignez une équipe multidisciplinaire, habituée au travail à distance avec un accès direct au management et vous vous appuyez sur notre partenaire Anthropic .
 Vos missions : 
 Cadrer & diagnostiquer : vous rencontrez les équipes métier et techniques client et vous analysez les contraintes réelles (données, systèmes existants, usages).
 Concevoir & développer : vous concevez et déployez des agents et workflows (orchestration multi-étapes, function calling, RAG, MCP) qui s’intègrent aux ERP, CRM et outils internes.
 Tester & fiabiliser : vous livrez par petites étapes, avec tests automatisés, revue de code et garde-fous adaptés au risque métier.
 Déployer & sécuriser : vous mettez Claude en production à l’échelle (accès, coûts, sécurité, réglementaire), en appui de la DSI et du DPO.
 Outiller les équipes du client : vous installez Claude Code chez les équipes IT (standards, harnessing, connecteurs, CI/CD) et Claude Cowork chez les équipes métier pour qu’elles puissent prendre la main sur la solution.
 Côté interne : 
 Contribuer au développement commercial et la notoriété : vous participez à l’élaboration et à la présentation de propositions, aux événements clients et partenaires, aux publications.
 Faire grandir l’équipe : vous participez aux actions de recrutement (cooptation, entretiens), de formation et d’animation interne.
 Capitaliser : vous documentez les patterns réutilisables (accélérateurs, prompts, architectures de référence).
 Faire remonter les expériences terrain : vous partagez les limites des modèles, les bonnes pratiques, les frictions d’outillage pour faire évoluer les méthodes.
 Diffuser la culture IA : vous faites de la veille et vous partagez avec le reste de l’équipe.
 Environnement technique : 
 IA : Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, MCP, RAG, function calling, prompt engineering, evals, guardrails, observabilité
 IDE IA : Claude Code en priorité, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex
 Cloud & DevOps : AWS, GCP ou Azure, containers, CI/CD
 Données : bases relationnelles et/ou NoSQL, bases vectorielles
 Intégration et sécurité : API, microservices, ERP, CRM, SSO/SCIM, OWASP
 Pratiques : Spec-Driven Development, CLAUDE.md , tests automatisés, revue de code assistée par IA

Ce qui compte pour nous :Ingénierie logicielle : au moins 5 ans d’expérience (frontend, backend ou fullstack), avec une vraie discipline qualité : tests automatisés, revue de code, standards.Cloud & Devops : vous savez conteneuriser, mettre en place une CI/CD et déployer sur au moins un grand cloud AWS, GCP ou Azure.IA en production : une expérience concrète d’agents IA est idéale. Des projets personnels sérieux sur le RAG, le function calling ou MCP comptent aussi.Sécurité : vous savez sécuriser une application (authentification, gestion des secrets) et vous connaissez les risques propres aux agents, comme l’injection de prompt ou l’isolation des outils exécutés.Posture conseil & terrain :Regard critique : vous relisez ce que produisent les agents de code, et vous refusez un code que vous ne sauriez pas expliquer ou maintenir, même s’il fonctionne.Pédagogie : vous savez cadrer un problème avec la DSI comme avec le métier non techniques et défendez vos choix.Français et anglais B2/C1.Nous ne cherchons pas un profil parfait ! items.desc: About MarvelX MarvelX is building highly specialized AI agents for the most complex, heavily regulated industries. Think insurance claims, compliance, support. Automated by AI that actually works in the real world. The opportunity is massive, and we’re moving fast. We’re looking for a AI Engineer to help us push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI in production. Someone who thrives at the intersection of cutting-edge research and shipping real products. Someone who can turn ideas into working systems, fast. You’ll work directly with the founders and tech lead to design, build, and deploy AI agents that solve mission-critical problems for our clients. This isn’t a typical engineering role. It’s an early seat on the rocket ship. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let’s talk. Mission As a founding AI Engineer, you’ll be at the core of MarvelX’s product and tech evolution. You’ll take ownership of designing and building agentic systems that can handle high-stakes, high-complexity workflows. You’ll explore the edge of LLMs, reasoning engines, and orchestration frameworks, and bring them to life in production environments where reliability, compliance, and explainability matter. What you'll be doing Build and deploy AI agents that handle real-world workflows in insurance, banking and other financial services domains . Experiment with LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool-use, and multi-agent orchestration to push performance . Design pipelines that ensure explainability, traceability, and auditability for every decision the AI makes . Collaborate directly with product, design, and GTM to rapidly iterate on customer feedback . Optimize models and systems for production: latency, accuracy, scalability, and security . Stay ahead of the curve: explore new architectures, open-source tools, and research to keep MarvelX at the frontier . What you'll need 4–6 years of hands-on experience building AI/ML systems (startups, scale-ups, or research labs). Strong background in Python , ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), and modern AI stacks (OpenAI APIs, vector DBs,etc.). Experience with LLMs and agentic architectures - you’ve built with them, broken them, and made them better. Solid understanding of data engineering: pipelines, preprocessing, and deploying models in production. Proactive, scrappy, and able to ship fast without compromising on quality. Excited by solving hard problems where there’s no clear playbook, and you create the playbook. Bonus: exposure to compliance, fintech, or other regulated domains where explainability is critical.

items.desc: Cosa farai Il tuo obiettivo è portare AI nel core del prodotto Jet HR e nell'infrastruttura interna - costruendo agenti affidabili, pipeline robuste e sistemi di conoscenza che scalano. Nel concreto: Sviluppi agenti AI multi-step basati su LLM per casi d'uso complessi: orchestrazione, ragionamento, gestione degli errori. Implementi e integri MCP per la gestione di contesti, tool e fonti di conoscenza strutturate. Integri chatbot e agenti direttamente nei prodotti Jet HR e nei tool interni - non come demo o per esplorare, ma come funzionalità in produzione. Prepari e pulisci i dati per l'ingestion in sistemi RAG e knowledge base AI: qualità, struttura, aggiornamento continuo. Mantieni le knowledge base attive e aggiornate, con pipeline automatizzate di update e versioning. Contribuisci all'infrastruttura della data platform a supporto dei workload AI - sei parte integrante del team che la costruisce. Come Lavoriamo ‍ Il team Data di Jet HR non è un team di supporto. È una funzione strategica che costruisce la piattaforma dati su cui gira il prodotto e i prodotti AI che lo estendono. Data platform prima di tutto. Lavoriamo su una piattaforma scalabile e robusta: architettura, automazione, data products. Niente one-off, niente workaround. Full stack mindset. Non aspetti che qualcun altro sblocchi qualcosa. Hai la piena ownership del tuo pezzo, dalla logica all'infrastruttura. Tech-first. Il team è composto da data engineers, AI engineers e analytics engineers. Collaboriamo strettamente con prodotto, payroll e operations per trasformare i dati in asset strategici. Niente task banali. Non esistono report manuali da tenere in vita. Automatizziamo, ottimizziamo, costruiamo soluzioni che durano. Tech stack DBT · Snowflake · Python · Metabase · DltHub · Apache Airflow · Docker · AWS · LangChain Chi stiamo cercando 3+ anni di esperienza nella costruzione di soluzioni di data science o machine learning, di cui almeno 1 su AI (RAG, agent frameworks, LLM in produzione). Python solido. Non un "lo conosco", ma lo usi ogni giorno e conosci bene le librerie AI - LangChain e dintorni. ML/AI hands-on. Hai sviluppato, fatto tuning e deployato modelli reali. Sai cosa funziona fuori da un notebook. Cosa offriamo €45.000 – €65.000 di RAL. Full remote. Per davvero. Puoi lavorare da dove vuoi, basta che sia in una timezone compatibile con l’Italia. Se vuoi, il nostro ufficio a Milano è pronto ad accoglierti. Due volte l’anno abbiamo un meetup di 3 giorni, tutto pagato da Jet. Ownership di quello che fai. Il ruolo del product manager è ripartito tra software engineer e designer. Non hai spec iper-dettagliate, non sei un mero esecutore. Sei tu responsabile dell’output finale. Impatto concreto. Siamo una start-up, ognuno dà un contributo essenziale allo sviluppo dei prodotti e alla crescita di Jet. Il tuo lavoro fa la differenza per migliaia di clienti. Start-up environment . Non è una startup qualsiasi, ma una ben finanziata e zeppa di talenti. In 6 mesi vedrai ed imparerai cose che altrove forse vedresti in anni, con un altissimo livello di responsabilità e coinvolgimento. Processo di selezione Screening call — 30 minuti con Head of Data Task asincrono — ~3/4 ore Tech interview — 60 minuti con Head of Data Final interview — 60 minuti con il team, per il fitting

Laufveranstaltungen, …) Unsere Löhne und Gehälter liegen über dem Kollektivvertrag (KV) der Elektro- und Elektronikindustrie. Develop, train, and maintain machine learning models and software applications in the fields of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), including the application of Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI for specific
items.desc: Act Digital is looking for an AI/ML Engineer for a leading European institution . TASKS : Develop agentic AI systems using Google ADK and / or LangGraph/Langchain. Develop, train, and maintain machine learning models and software applications in the fields of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), including the application of Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI for specific use cases. Work on AI ready data improvements, e.g., semantic layer, agent skills. Define data controls and implement strategies to ensure data quality (consistency, completeness, accuracy, reasonableness), integrity, and the detection and mitigation of bias in datasets and AI models. Perform processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis. Draft technical guidelines, documentation, and presentations to effectively communicate complex AI concepts, project status, and results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Manage services deployments through CI/CD pipelines and OpenShift cluster. SENIORITY REQUIREMENTS : To qualify for this position, the consultant must have: University degree corresponding to Level 7 of the European Qualifications Framework (which typically corresponds to a master’s level or 5 years of higher education), and 5 years of IT professional experience . REQUIREMENTS : Required Certifications : Having successfully completed relevant training on how to deploy LLMs and Agents at Scale and build MCP servers. One of the following or an equivalent certification: Certified Usability Analyst (CUA). Certified User Experience Analyst (CXA). Nielsen Norman Group (NN/g) UXCertification. Certified Professional in User Experience (CPUX). Google UX Design Professional Certificate. Akendi UX Certification. Knowledge & Skills : Excellent knowledge of programming languages essential for AI/ML, primarily Python , and their key libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, SpaCy, NLTK). Excellent knowledge of data management principles, including data governance, data quality, data cleaning, and data lifecycle management for AI projects. Good knowledge of machine learning techniques and algorithms, such as k-NN, Naive Bayes, SVM, Decision Forests, Neural Network, deep learning, and/or artificial intelligence frameworks. Good knowledge of generative AI, small and large language models. Good knowledge of data scraping and data integration pipelines. Expertise in AI ready data improvements through a semantic layer. Good knowledge of cloud platforms for building LLM solutions (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Studio) and frameworks for orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and safety/guardrails. Good knowledge of AI Agent Orchestration frameworks, like Langchain or Semantic Kernel. Experience with data analytics over big datasets, non-structured databases as well as data lakes. Experience with MLOps practices and tools for model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and governance (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow). Ability to understand, speak and write English. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work in a team as well as autonomously. Results-oriented mindset, focused on delivering. Good, applied statistics skills, such as distributions, statistical testing, regression, etc. Proficiency with programming skills in languages essential for AI development and key libraries. Data-driven mindset. (!) IMPORTANT : Open to EU candidates, as well as non-EU candidates already located in Belgium. Minimum level B2 in English, both spoken and written. Far-site/Remote. Long-term, Full-time. -- If you're interested, feel free to submit your application through this job posting, or alternatively send your resume to: oaraoua@actdigital.eu

items.desc: ESPRIMO Srl, società di consulenza informatica che opera dal 2002 su tutto il territorio nazionale ed internazionale, a supporto delle imprese, si colloca nel settore dell’Information Technology proponendosi come obiettivo quello di fornire una vasta gamma di prodotti, servizi e soluzioni nelle aree più strategiche per l’impresa, come: Infrastrutture IT, Content Management, ERP, Business Intelligence, CRM, Web Applications, è alla ricerca di un: AI Engineer con almeno 2 anni di esperienza Competenze Solide competenze nello sviluppo in Python, inclusa la creazione di API e servizi pronti per la produzione (production-grade) Solida conoscenza dei fondamenti del Machine Learning , dei flussi di lavoro per lo sviluppo di modelli, del feature engineering, della validazione e della valutazione Esperienza pratica con PyTorch e scikit-learn Approfondita comprensione dei Large Language Models (LLM) , delle architetture Transformer, della tokenizzazione, degli embedding e dei flussi di lavoro di inferenza Esperienza con LangChain e LangGraph per la creazione di applicazioni basate su LLM e sistemi basati su agenti (agentic applications) Progettazione e implementazione di sistemi di intelligenza artificiale multi-agente , inclusi orchestrazione, utilizzo di strumenti (tool usage), gestione dello stato e meccanismi di controllo (guardrails) Esperienza nella progettazione di soluzioni di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) , che includono chunking, strategie di embedding, recupero delle informazioni (retrieval), reranking e gestione del contesto Esperienza con database vettoriali (preferibilmente Qdrant) e tecnologie di caching/gestione dello stato come Redis Conoscenza delle tecniche di fine-tuning per LLM e modelli di deep learning, inclusi approcci efficienti in termini di parametri come LoRA/PEFT Conoscenza degli stack hardware per l'IA (sviluppo e inferenza), incluse GPU, vincoli di VRAM, fondamenti di CUDA e deployment di modelli ottimizzato per le prestazioni Capacità di progettare soluzioni di IA scalabili, efficienti, affidabili e ad alte prestazioni, con attenzione a latenza, throughput, costi, utilizzo della memoria e osservabilità Architetture a microservizi Algoritmi, strutture dati e capacità di selezionare la soluzione più adatta allo specifico contesto Docker (Dockerfiles, Docker Compose) e carichi di lavoro IA containerizzati Pratiche CI/CD per software e sistemi di ML/IA Progettazione di sistemi distribuiti e integrazione di servizi di IA in architetture di produzione Esperienza in ambienti Agile Ottima padronanza della lingua inglese Sede operativa: Remoto Retribuzione indicativa: RAL € 30.000 Si offre un inserimento in un contesto stimolante e innovativo, con grandi prospettive di crescita professionale e una retribuzione commisurata all'esperienza. Si richiede l’invio di Curricula rispondenti al profilo della posizione aperta, verranno presi in considerazione solo quelli effettivamente in possesso dei requisiti sopraindicati. La ricerca è rivolta ad entrambi i sessi (L.903/77). Inviare dettagliato curriculum vitae, con l’autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali secondo la Legge 196/2003.

Co vás čeká Do vývoje ML a LLM služeb přinesete disciplínu produktového inženýrství: testy, code reviews, CI/CD a čistou architekturu. Budete navrhovat RAG pipeline a multi-tool agentní workflow (LangChain, LlamaIndex). Modely zpřístupníte přes REST nebo GraphQL API ve FastAPI a nasadíte je jako mikroservisy v Kubernetes, včetně monitoringu, canary a A/B rolloutů. Budete spravovat vektorové databáze (Qdrant, LanceDB), embedding pipeline, knihovny promptů a evaluační nástroje. Background úlohy budete orchestrovat v Airflow nebo Ray. Budete spolupracovat s kolegy z C# a Angular týmů, psát design dokumenty a účastnit se sprintů. Co od vás očekáváme Máte 5+ let praxe v softwarovém inženýrství, z toho alespoň 3 roky produkčního Pythonu (FastAPI, async IO, packaging). Máte zkušenost s celým LLM lifecycle: přípravou dat, prompt engineeringem, fine-tuningem, evaluací a monitoringem (PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM apod.). Už jste stavěli AI agenty nebo RAG systémy s nástroji, pamětí a správou kontextu, včetně guardrailů a evaluačních sad. Prakticky jste pracovali s vektorovými databázemi a embeddingy. Ovládáte Docker a Kubernetes. Máte silné SQL a znáte NoSQL nebo grafové databáze. Kvalitu kódu berete vážně: unit a integrační testy, statickou analýzu, CI/CD. Mluvíte i píšete plynule anglicky. Výhodou je: MLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow, ArgoCD), cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), C#/.NET, lakehouse technologie (Iceberg, DuckDB, ClickHouse), Kafka a vizualizace dat v Angularu s D3 nebo ECharts. Co nabízíme Práci na prvních personalizovaných AI asistentech pro finanční instituce na světě. Spolupráci přímo se seniorními lídry s praxí u CEO firem z Fortune 100. Projekty pro přední banky a pojišťovny, které se reálně nasazují do jejich každodenních procesů. Moderní technologie a prostor neustále se učit, s formálním školením i sdílením znalostí v týmu. Kancelář v historickém paláci v centru Prahy se střešní terasou. Týmové akce, kávu, čaj a pivo po práci.

About the Role We're hiring an Applied AI Engineer to build AI agents and intelligent product capabilities that transform how finance teams work. This is a product engineering role, not an isolated prototyping or research role. You'll own agent-based features end to end: from architecture and evaluation through backend integration, deployment, and operation in production. What You'll Do Build and ship AI agents Design and build agents that automate complex finance workflows. Own features from initial concept and prototype through production deployment. Integrate agents deeply with backend services, APIs, the data model, permissions, and product workflows. Design how agents securely access and use data across the platform. Turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable, customer-facing product features. Evaluate and improve agent performance Build systematic evaluations for agent quality, reliability, and business impact. Create representative test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression tests, and human-review processes. Measure and improve accuracy, latency, cost, and user experience. Establish observability and feedback loops that make agent behavior understandable and continuously improvable. Develop the AI application architecture Apply context-engineering techniques such as RAG, MCP, and knowledge graphs. Design prompts, tools, memory, workflows, and orchestration strategies for production agents. Select and use appropriate orchestration frameworks and comparable technologies. Build appropriate guardrails, approval steps, and human-in-the-loop controls for sensitive financial workflows. Integrate machine-learning capabilities Collaborate with data scientists to integrate ML models into production systems. Build the services, data flows, APIs, and operational tooling required to make models usable within the product. Take responsibility for production integration rather than handing prototypes to another team. About You A seasoned software engineer with experience building and operating production applications. Highly proficient in Python and/or Java, and comfortable across backend services, APIs, data, and application architecture. You've built and shipped at least one agent or LLM-powered product capability end to end. You've personally integrated agents into a broader product and backend architecture, not just developed standalone prototypes. You have practical experience evaluating agents or other non-deterministic AI systems. You understand how to provide agents with the right data and context while respecting security, permissions, and privacy. You have hands-on experience with prompt engineering, context engineering, and agent orchestration. You balance rapid experimentation with reliable, maintainable production engineering. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science. Relevant Technologies You don't need experience with every technology below. Strong engineering judgment and demonstrated end-to-end ownership matter most. Agent orchestration: modern agent and LLM orchestration frameworks Context engineering: RAG, MCP, knowledge graphs, tool use, memory, and retrieval systems AI evaluation: offline and online evaluations, test datasets, regression testing, observability, and human review Language models: Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Mistral, or similar Backend engineering: Python or Java, REST APIs, Kafka, microservices, and distributed systems Data systems: SQL, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, vector search, and data pipelines Cloud AI platforms: GCP and Vertex AI, or comparable platforms What's on Offer Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Vibrant offices at the heart of a collaborative culture, with in-person time across weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. 20 days "work from abroad", a Learning & Development budget, and other local benefits.

Responsibilities On behalf of our client, an international industrial group, we are looking for an AI Engineer to join its central Data Science & AI Engineering team. The team is part of corporate R&D and delivers projects for business units worldwide. It combines specialists in agentic AI, time series and computer vision, and works directly with scientists, process engineers and business owners. The team runs its own agentic platform on Azure with a custom agent harness. It already supports several use cases in production, from finance processes to research assistants that query scientific and operational databases. The next phase is underway: more use cases in parallel, more data sources connected, and a larger library of shared skills and tools. You will build those agents and strengthen the platform underneath them. What You Will Do Agent development Design and build agents that carry complex, domain-specific logic, translating expert knowledge from scientists and engineers into reasoning steps, tools and guardrails Build multi-step and multi-agent workflows with LangGraph, combining retrieval, tool calls and business rules Connect agents to structured enterprise data in Databricks, often combining several sources in one solution Context and knowledge management Define what context an agent needs to reason correctly: instructions, retrieved documents, table and column descriptions, domain rules Improve metadata on the data platform so tables and fields are described well enough for agents to use them reliably Design retrieval and grounding strategies that keep answers traceable to their source Skills And Tooling Build reusable skills and tools that agents across use cases can share Decide which agent gets which tools and permissions, and keep the tool library maintainable Evaluation and quality Set up structured evaluation of agent behaviour: test sets, metrics, regression checks and human review Use evaluation results to improve prompts, tools and architecture, and report engineering standards Follow developments in LLMs and agent frameworks and assess what is worth adopting Requirements Master's degree in Computer Science, or a PhD in Mathematics or a related quantitative field 3+ years of hands-on software or AI engineering, including b uilding agentic or LLM-based systems At least one agentic application delivered to production that goes well beyond a About the Role: This is a fantastic opportunity for a recent graduate who wants to build a career at the intersection of software development, solutions architecture, and client consulting. You'll be trained up to work directly with partners at leading accounting firms, helping deploy and customise our partner's AI-native platform, to integrate fragmented tooling and automate complex audit methodologies. You'll receive close mentorship from experienced engineers while getting real, early exposure to client-facing work — with the chance to directly influence product development by feeding client insights back to the core team and helping shape the future of AI in audit. Responsibilities: Support the deployment and customisation of the AI-native platform, working alongside senior engineers with accounting firm partners. Help integrate diverse client systems, such as CCH, Suralink, and QuickBooks, via API solutions. Assist in designing and building data ingestion, parsing, and normalisation pipelines for complex financial files. Develop solutions to transform unstructured data (e.g., PDFs, spreadsheets) into structured, actionable formats. Learn and apply LLM techniques including prompting, structured output, and agent orchestration for audit applications. Support retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) work over extensive document corpora for enhanced accuracy. Gather and relay client feedback and insights to help inform the core product roadmap. Requirements: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Some experience with relevant AI coding tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar) is desirable. Solid software engineering fundamentals, ideally with exposure to Python, and a genuine interest in practical application. Some exposure to API integration, whether through coursework, personal projects, internships, or placements. An interest in data engineering and a willingness to get stuck into messy, inconsistent real-world datasets. Curiosity about unstructured-to-structured data problems, particularly with documents. Enthusiasm for LLM application development, prompting, and agentic systems — prior hands-on experience is a bonus, not a requirement. Willingness to build client-facing confidence over time, engaging with and presenting to accounting firm partners. A strong appetite for learning and quickly adapting to regulated domains and fast-paced, early-stage environments. Compensation and Benefits: Competitive graduate salary ranging from £45,000 to £60,000. Structured mentorship and hands-on training from experienced engineers. Opportunity to contribute meaningfully to an innovative AI-native platform from day one. Direct exposure to shaping the future of the accounting and audit industries. International travel opportunities to engage with clients and global teams. Work within a supportive and dynamic team across London, San Francisco, and New York. Rapid professional growth in a fast-paced, early-stage technology environment. Close collaboration with experienced professionals in software engineering and audit.

items.desc: As a K Trainee, your experience goes beyond your role as an AI Trainee. You will get to explore K Group’s business across different areas and broaden your perspective beyond your own field. You will take on a hands-on professional role while developing your skills and building a network for the start of your career. A personal mentor, development sessions, job shadowing across our different business divisions and opportunities to meet K Group leaders will bring perspectives beyond your day-to-day role. You will work as part of the AI Solutions team and contribute to the team’s ongoing development work. Your assignments will be determined through the team’s shared prioritization and will vary according to current business and technology needs. Your skills and experience will also be considered when determining suitable assignments for you. This gives you the opportunity to work on different AI-related challenges and gain broad, practical experience. Depending on your assignments, you may work on AI agents and generative AI applications, shared AI platforms and components, system integrations, data processing and RAG solutions. Your work may also involve testing and improving large language model based solutions or supporting their operationalisation, monitoring and continuous development through LLMOps practices. You will collaborate with business and technology specialists and learn to look at AI solutions from both a technical perspective and in terms of the business value they create. What We Expect From You You have completed a relevant degree within the past six months or you’ll be graduated in six-months-time. Your studies may focus on artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer science, software engineering or a related field. You can program in Python and are familiar with common software development tools and practices. You understand the fundamentals of system integrations, APIs and data processing. You have basic knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, generative AI frameworks and RAG architectures. You are already familiar with LLMOps practices and understand the fundamentals of the operational lifecycle of AI solutions. You are fluent in both Finnish and English. While English is the working language of the AI Solutions team, the K Trainee programme and its joint activities are conducted in Finnish. You take an active approach to your assignments, take responsibility for agreed tasks and want to continue developing your skills throughout the traineeship. Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services or Snowflake is considered an advantage. We also consider an interest in developing your communication skills and a willingness to share your K Trainee experience on social media an advantage. What You Will Gain As a K Trainee A real role with real responsibilityYou will join us for a paid traineeship. The final salary will be based on the selected candidate’s experience and skills. You will contribute to meaningful development work, and your responsibilities will grow as your skills develop. Personal support for your development You will learn above all by doing, but you’ll be surrounded by experienced specialists who can support you with everyday questions and help you develop your technical expertise. Your personal mentor and the K Trainee development programme will also support your professional growth. A broad view of the retail sector You will gain insight into K Group beyond your own role and learn about our three business divisions through the K Trainee programme. A network for the start of your career You will get to know other K Trainee participants and K Group specialists from different parts of the business. You will build a network that can support you well beyond the programme. You will also have access to a wide range of employee benefits, including the ePassi culture and sports benefit, employee discounts at K Group stores, occupational healthcare services and leisure-time accident insurance. You will work in the modern facilities of K Kampus in Helsinki, where employees have access to a gym, saunas, occupational healthcare services, a staff restaurant and a café. items.desc:
Kitchener (ON), Canada 
 Product Cybersecurity Expert
 Research & Development | Hybrid 
 Help secure the future of connected hearing care. As our Product Cybersecurity Expert in R&D, you will help protect the products and digital experiences that improve hearing health and human connection worldwide. 
 In this role, you will combine product cybersecurity expertise with technical leadership responsibilities, supporting secure design, threat modeling, vulnerability management, DevSecOps integration, and regulatory evidence for connected medical devices while collaborating across global R&D, quality, regulatory, and product teams. 
 WHAT YOU’LL DO 
 Embed cybersecurity across the secure product lifecycle for connected medical devices, embedded platforms, firmware, mobile apps, and cloud-based services 
 Lead threat modeling, product cybersecurity risk assessments, and mitigation planning with global R&D teams 
 Integrate security checks and tooling into development workflows and CI/CD pipelines to find and address issues early 
 Drive product vulnerability management for Sonova products, including intake, triage, remediation tracking, and post-market monitoring. 
 Prepare audit-ready cybersecurity evidence for regulatory submissions and quality processes, including FDA, MDR, and IEC 81001-5-1 expectations 
 Plan and coordinate security testing with internal teams and external partners; analyze findings and drive remediation 
 Advise product, engineering, quality, and regulatory stakeholders on practical, risk-based security decisions 
 Strengthen cybersecurity capability through coaching, security champions, and cross-functional collaboration 
 WHAT YOU BRING 
 5+ years of experience in software engineering, system/software architecture, product development, project management, or DevSecOps, including 3+ years in cybersecurity 
 Strong practical knowledge of secure SDLC, threat modeling, security assessments, security testing, and vulnerability management 
 Experience translating security risks and technical findings into clear decisions for engineering, product, quality, and leadership audiences 
 Understanding of modern development workflows, CI/CD, and how to integrate security without slowing innovation 
 Knowledge of cryptography, authentication protocols, cloud and software supply chain security 
 Basic understanding of AI technology and associated threats; hands-on experience using AI technology 
 Higher-level engineering degree or equivalent experience, with further education or specialization in cybersecurity 
 Excellent English communication skills and the ability to influence across distributed, cross-functional teams 
 NICE TO HAVE 
 Experience in medical devices, healthcare, or another regulated product environment 
 Security certifications such as ISC2/CISSP, GIAC, or equivalent accredited programs 
 Working knowledge of Privacy by Design principles 
 A minimum of 200Mb/sec download and 10Mb/sec upload speed internet connectivity is required to support any remote/hybrid employee functionality at Sonova 
 Don't meet all the criteria? If you’re willing to go all in and learn we'd love to hear from you! 
 We are looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform. For this position only direct applications will be considered. Sonova does not recruit via app, telegram, carrier pigeon or any other format that does not include speaking with an actual human. If you are offered a job without speaking with someone please contact mailto:wholesale.HR@sonova.com 
 This role's pay range is between: $112,000 - $140,000. This role is also bonus eligible. 
 How we work: 
 At Sonova, we prioritize the well-being of our employees and foster an inclusive environment that promotes engagement and collaboration. Our team-customized hybrid work model empowers teams to balance individual needs with business goals, offering flexibility and individualized time management. We recognize the importance of life outside of work and strive to create a supportive and motivating workplace where innovation thrives.

 Overview 
 Entrerai nella Rete Imprese della Divisione Banca dei Territori, dove supporterai le aziende del territorio nella crescita del loro business. Offrirai consulenza ad alto valore aggiunto grazie a soluzioni innovative e a un percorso di formazione continua, pensato per sviluppare competenze distintive e costruire relazioni solide con la clientela imprese. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Gestione del portafoglio e sviluppo del patrimonio aziendale e personale 
 Incontri periodici di sviluppo della clientela 
 Analisi del merito creditizio e lettura bilancio 
 Cross selling di prodotti e servizi 
 Pianificazione assicurativa e protezione 
 Gestione del ciclo incassi e pagamenti 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 esperienza di almeno 5 anni nel settore del credito con una buona conoscenza del tessuto imprenditoriale e commerciale del territorio di riferimento 
 laurea Triennale o Magistrale in ambito economico aziendale o economico finanziario 
 conoscenza dell'analisi di bilancio e della contabilità generale e analitica 
 buona conoscenza della lingua inglese 
 apprezzata esperienza in ambito agribusiness o terzo settore (no profit) 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 45.000€ 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale del Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli 
 Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile 
 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) 
 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 La Divisione Banca dei Territori è focalizzata sul mercato e sulla centralità del territorio per il rafforzamento delle relazioni con le persone, le piccole e medie imprese e gli enti non profit. Dedicata ai segmenti di clientela retail, exclusive e imprese offre un’ampia gamma di prodotti e servizi, distribuiti sia attraverso la rete fisica sia attraverso i canali digitali. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03.

items.desc: ️About Volter AI and renewables are the 21st Centuries two largest megatrends and they're colliding in the world's largest industry: energy. AI has made intelligence abundant, so human brains are no longer the bottle neck, cheap and secure power is. The people, businesses and countries that have access to cheap, clean and secure power will lead this century. Renewables can deliver it, but they’ve turned a previously static predictable commodity into a huge complex changing forecasting and optimisation problem that the industry’s decades-old systems were never built to solve. Volter exists to solve it. We’re building the first AI native operating system for business energy, so that every business can run on power that’s cheaper, cleaner and more secure. Octopus and Kraken did this for homes; we’re doing it for business. And it’s working. We launched our platform in early 2026 and have already 20x revenue with customers from all across the UK now using the Volter platform. We’re still a small team, so you’ll shape the product, the tech and the culture from the ground up. Where you plug in Our platform runs on data: half-hourly meter reads, market prices, forecasts, trades and tariffs all feed the products that price, match, and bill our customers' energy. We’re hiring a Senior Engineer with a data-oriented bent to own and scale our data foundations, while building the product on top of them. In your first year, success looks like data pipelines the business trusts, faster and more reliable pricing and billing, and a product that you've shipped end-to-end that customers and our ops team use every day. ️ What you'll power Build and own the pipelines that bring data into Volter: half-hourly meter feeds, market and price data, network tariffs, weather data, and other third-party sources. Own our data foundations: schema design, data modelling (lots of time-series), query performance and data quality, so our customers and partners can rely on it. Ship product features end to end, from data/backend services and APIs through to the customer-facing flows on top of them. Shape what we build with commercial, ops and data science: understand the real problem, scope a v1, then measure it and decide what comes next. Challenge how we do things: bring your experience to architecture decisions, name the trade-offs and push back when there's a better way. Partner with our data scientists to improve forecasting and pricing models. Run what you build in production, with logging, monitoring, and alerting that keep it reliable. Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, testing, and helping other engineers grow. What you'll bring Several years as a broad-based software engineer, with a track record of owning complex features and systems end-to-end in production. Hands-on data engineering: you've built and run ETL pipelines and worked deeply with databases in data-intensive systems, ideally including time-series data. Strong data fundamentals: knowledge about database technology choices (OLTP, OLAP), schema design, data modelling, query optimisation and data quality. Product instincts as well as pipelines: you enjoy shipping user-facing features and solving user problems as much as building data pipelines. Proficiency across the stack: backend in Go and/or Python, frontend in TypeScript and React, plus cloud deployment (we use AWS), and infrastructure-as-code (we use Terraform). Fluency in AI-driven engineering: you see its value and use it day-to-day, with established processes for high and consistent standards Confidence to challenge the status quo, make sound calls in ambiguity and advise the team as a peer. Nice-to-haves Experience in energy, utilities or another data-heavy, regulated market such as fintech. Building at an early-stage startup, balancing speed with technical debt. Previous experience working with data scientists on forecasting or modelling. Event-driven architectures and security-aware development (least privilege, auditability, PII handling). Your kind of energy How we bring the Volter values to life in this role: Integrity, trust and transparency: When the data looks wrong, or a project is slipping, you say so early, with options and a recommendation. When you disagree, you push back with evidence, then commit. Growth, ambition and excellence: You hold a high bar for quality, learn new domains fast by building, and leave our systems better than you found them. Getting sht done: You ship in days, not weeks. You pick the pragmatic option that gets useful things to customers, then measure whether it worked. Electric enthusiasm: You're always learning, whether that's a new corner of the energy market or a better way to build, and you bring the team with you. items.desc: We are looking for a Risk AI Data Scientist to drive the integration of advanced AI capabilities into the bank’s overall risk management (out of which Credit risk model maintenance is one of them). In this role, you operate in the intersection of risk management practices (amongst which credit risk modelling), model lifecycle governance, and advanced AI (LLMs, NLP, Agentic workflows). You will not only build and steer these solutions; you will help design the cognitive layer of the bank’s risk management environment, turning cutting-edge AI into production-ready, compliant solutions. The team The mission of Integrated Risk is focused on providing risk identification, aggregation and insight capabilities at Group level across the various Risk domains. The team department is using those capabilities across the various risk functions, to assume a general oversight of risk governance, policies and frameworks, and to steer group-wide model and implementation activities across locations. The Bank-wide Credit Risk Models department is responsible for the management of Wholesale Banking (WB) IRB and IFRS9 and the Bank-wide Credit Risk Economic Capital models — including their development, monitoring, and advisory support to the business — in cooperation with relevant stakeholders. All the models in scope are groupwide, managed and developed centrally and consistently applied across all ING’s locations. Roles And Responsibilities What will you do? Develop custom models by fine-tuning open-weights models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) on GCP GPUs to understand the specific nuances of risk management in wholesale/retail banking, credit policies, and financial risk (exploration, production and scaling). Evaluate and monitor GenAI systems in this context (e.g. hallucinations, quality, drifting). Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems to enable interaction with internal policy documents, regulations and other documentation in different formats with high precision. Work with large-scale unstructured data (documents, PDFs, OCR) as a core part of the role. Design and implement agentic AI workflows (e.g. LangChain/LangGraph) where AI components plan, reason, and execute multi-step tasks to support risk managers. Build NLP pipelines to extract complex signals (e.g. transaction patterns, legal clauses) from unstructured text and convert them into usable features. Write clean, modular Python code in Azure DevOps ensuring models are testable, reproducible, and ready for deployment. Align with model suites across different risk domains to understand and create added value in AI-powered lifecycle management. How To Succeed We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself. Du arbeitest in crossfunktionalen, agilen Teams an Kundenprojekten und kommst dabei mit dem gesamten modernen GenAI-Stack in Berührung: pydantic-ai, LangChain/LangGraph, MCP (Model Context Protocol), OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock. Zusammen mit deinem Team berätst du unsere Kunden bei Use-Case-Identifikation, Architektur-Entscheidungen (RAG vs. Fine-Tuning, Agent-Design, Tool-Use, Memory), Aufwandsschätzungen und der Auswahl geeigneter Vorgehensmodelle — du bist am gesamten AI-Lebenszyklus beteiligt. Du analysierst Kundenanforderungen, entwirfst und implementierst agentenbasierte Lösungen, RAG-Pipelines über Unternehmensdaten, strukturierte LLM-Outputs (pydantic-Schemas, Tool-Use) und sorgst auch für gute Dokumentation. Du behältst stets die Qualität auf dem Schirm — und das heißt bei AI: systematische Evals, Regression-Tests gegen Goldsets, Hallucination-Monitoring, Cost-per-Inference-Tracking, Prompt-Versionierung, Observability für Agent-Traces (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Phoenix). Du nutzt moderne, automatisierte Ansätze und AI-native Entwickler-Workflows (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) zur Optimierung von Code, Fehlererkennung und für innovative Lösungen — wir leben "AI-native", nicht nur AI-für-Kunden. Du integrierst deine LLM-/Agent-Komponenten sauber in bestehende Backend- und Frontend-Architekturen (Python/FastAPI, Node.js/TypeScript, Java, React/Angular) und sorgst für saubere Übergaben an die Plattform-Seite (Kubernetes, ArgoCD, MongoDB/pgvector, AWS/Azure). Qualifikation Qualifikation Das solltest du mitbringen Dank deiner entsprechenden Berufserfahrung verfolgst du den AI-Engineering-Ansatz hands-on — du redest nicht nur über LLMs, du baust mit ihnen. Gute bis muttersprachliche Deutschkenntnisse sind ZWINGEND erforderlich, da wir eng mit Kunden im DACH-Raum zusammenarbeiten. Du arbeitest gerne agil, verstehst aber auch, dass nicht alle Kunden Agilität (und schon gar nicht GenAI-Engineering) bereits kennen und schätzen wie wir. Du hast einen M.Sc. (oder vergleichbaren Abschluss) in Artificial Intelligence, Informatik, Data Science, Statistik, Mathematik, Physik oder einer verwandten Natur- oder Ingenieurwissenschaft. Ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit fundierten Grundlagen in Statistik, Machine Learning und Software Engineering ist für diese Stelle zwingend erforderlich. Wichtig — bitte vor der Bewerbung lesen: Das ist keine „Vibe-Coding"-Stelle. Wer seit ein paar Monaten mit AI-Assistenten Code generiert, aber die Grundlagen dahinter (Statistik, ML-Theorie, Datenstrukturen, Software-Architektur) nicht beherrscht, ist hier falsch. Wir nutzen AI-native Tooling täglich — aber als Verstärker für fundiertes Können, nicht als Ersatz dafür. Bewerbungen ohne einschlägigen Abschluss und ohne nachweisbare, mehrjährige Data-Science-/ML-Praxis können wir nicht berücksichtigen. Du bist Team-Player, schätzt offene Kommunikation, lernst gerne von anderen und teilst dein Wissen — gerade im LLM-Bereich, wo sich die Tooling-Landschaft alle drei Monate neu ordnet. Du willst an spannenden Kundenprojekten arbeiten und hast gute Kenntnisse in einigen dieser Technologien: AI / GenAI: Python, pydantic, pydantic-ai, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI APIs, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, Embeddings & Vector DBs (pgvector, MongoDB Atlas, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant), RAG-Patterns, Prompt Engineering, Agent-Evals (Langfuse, Phoenix, ragas) Backend / FullStack: Python (FastAPI), Java/Spring oder Quarkus, Node.js/TypeScript (Express, NestJS), React, Angular, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, REST/GraphQL Platform / DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitLab CI / GitHub Actions, AWS, …

items.desc: 🚀 Únete a RocaSalvatella como Full Stack Developer RocaSalvatella somos una consultora de referencia en transformación digital, innovación y negocio . Creemos en la cocreación con el cliente, la agilidad y la orientación a resultados. Diseñamos e implementamos soluciones que transforman la manera en que las organizaciones trabajan, innovan y crecen. Buscamos a un/a Full Stack Developer para integrarse en nuestro equipo de AI Solutions. Tu misión será diseñar, desarrollar y poner en producción aplicaciones web con IA generativa, del front end a la integración con modelos de lenguaje. El objetivo es que estas soluciones lleguen a uso real en la operación de nuestros clientes y no se queden en prueba de concepto. ¿Cuál será tu rol en el día a día? Trabajarás mano a mano con el equipo de AI Solutions en las siguientes funciones: Construir el back end: diseñar las APIs y servicios que orquestan las llamadas a LLMs y conectan con los datos y sistemas del cliente. Desarrollar el front end: crear asistentes conversacionales, paneles y flujos de validación para los equipos de negocio del cliente. Integrar la IA: implementar RAG, function calling y prompts, con evaluación de respuestas y control de coste y latencia. Llevar prototipos a producción: escribir tests, hacer code reviews y desplegar con Docker y CI/CD en cloud, cumpliendo los requisitos de seguridad y protección de datos. Trabajar con el cliente: aclarar requisitos con sus usuarios y explicar decisiones técnicas sin tecnicismos. ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Al menos 3 años desarrollando aplicaciones web full stack que hayan llegado a producción. Back end en Python (FastAPI, Django o similar) y/o Node.js con TypeScript, y front end en React u otro framework moderno con TypeScript. PostgreSQL o similar, SQL y diseño de APIs REST con autenticación OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect. Git, Docker, CI/CD y experiencia desplegando en Azure, AWS o GCP. Experiencia práctica integrando APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic o similares) en una aplicación. Criterio para distinguir una demo que funciona de software mantenible, y capacidad de avanzar con requisitos incompletos validando rápido con el usuario. Dominio fluido de español e inglés. ✨ Valoraremos positivamente si tienes experiencia previa con RAG en producción y bases de datos vectoriales, con frameworks de orquestación de LLMs o agentes (LangChain, LangGraph o similares), o en proyectos de consultoría con cliente final. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Flexibilidad horaria y trabajo híbrido. Plan de retribución flexible con Cobee. Formar parte de un equipo dinámico, multidisciplinar y con un clima basado en la confianza, la autonomía responsable y la colaboración. Participar en proyectos estratégicos para clientes referentes a nivel nacional e internacional. En RocaSalvatella apostamos firmemente por la diversidad, la inclusión y la igualdad de oportunidades, creando un entorno donde todas las personas puedan desarrollarse y aportar su mejor versión.

items.desc: We are seeking a forward-thinking Full-Stack Developer to bridge the gap between robust SAP S/4HANA stability and the next generation of AI-driven enterprise applications. You will be responsible for building high-performance, Clean Core compliant extensions using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and crafting intuitive front-end experiences with UI5, Angular. In this role, you won't just write code; you will actively integrate SAP AI Core and generative AI tools to accelerate delivery, automate complex business processes, and bring intelligent insights to the heart of the enterprise. What You’ll Do Develop scalable, AI-driven applications on SAP BTP, leveraging SAP AI Core and AI Foundation services. You won't just build apps; you’ll architect systems that integrate Generative AI into core business processes (like Lead-to-Cash or Source-to-Pay). Maximize productivity by using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and SAP-specific LLMs to write, refactor, and document CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) or RAP code. You are expected to stay at the forefront of prompt engineering for automated code generation. Design and manage data pipelines that bridge the gap between structured SAP data and unstructured insights. This includes integrating RESTful APIs and managing high-performance databases, specifically utilizing SAP HANA Cloud’s vector engine for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures. Maintain a rigorous Git workflow to ensure stability in complex SAP landscapes. You will follow Gitflow strategies to manage clean commits and painless merges, ensuring that AI model configurations and application logic are versioned with enterprise-level precision. Develop modular, reusable components in Angular (or SAP UI5) that integrate seamlessly with AI features. Your goal is to create "Agentic" user interfaces—UIs that don't just display data but provide AI-powered recommendations and natural language interactions. Use Docker to containerize AI models and microservices, ensuring consistent execution environments. You will deploy and manage these workloads via SAP AI Core, ensuring your models are production-ready, resource-efficient, and compliant with SAP’s "Clean Core" strategy Collaborate: Participate in code reviews (giving and receiving) and agile ceremonies. Continuous Learning: Stay ahead of the curve by testing and adopting new AI dev-tools that improve the team’s workflow. The Core Stack What You Bring to the Table CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model): Strong foundation in Node.js or Java. Experience with the CAP framework is a must for building enterprise-grade services that integrate seamlessly with SAP HANA. SAPUI5 / Fiori: Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern SAPUI5. You understand the Fiori Design Guidelines and can build responsive, enterprise-ready frontends that users actually enjoy. Git & CI/CD: You know the difference between a rebase and a merge, and you’re comfortable managing code versioning within SAP Continuous Integration and Delivery or Azure DevOps. BTP & Containers: You can navigate the SAP BTP Cockpit, deploy MTAs (Multi-Target Applications), and understand why "Cloud Foundry" and "Kyma" (Kubernetes) are the backbone of modern SAP extensibility. The AI & Tooling Edge AI Orchestration: Experience using AI tools for boilerplate generation, unit test creation, and complex debugging. Prompt Engineering: The ability to craft precise instructions for LLMs to get high-quality, secure code outputs. Critical Evaluation: You don't just "Copy-Paste" AI suggestions; you have the technical depth to audit AI code for security vulnerabilities and performance bottlenecks. HITL (Human in the Loop) The "Nice-to-Haves": Experience integrating OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini APIs into web applications. Familiarity with vector databases (like pgvector or Pinecone) or LangChain. Familiarity with Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). A "testing" mindset—experience with JUnit, or Jasmine/Karma or equivalent Who You Are Pragmatic: You know when to write code from scratch and when to let an AI assistant do the heavy lifting. Curious: You don't wait for a training manual; you're already experimenting with the latest LLM models and plugins. Quality-Focused: You understand that as AI generates more code, the human's role as a "Code Reviewer" becomes even more vital. items.desc: I am recruiting for a SerDes Architecture and Modelling Engineer to join my client’s team in Lausanne, Switzerland. This is a research and architecture-focused position for an engineer who enjoys investigating new ideas, developing algorithms and creating models to explore the performance of next-generation high-speed communication systems. The role has a strong emphasis on research, innovation and developing new architectural concepts rather than simply implementing established designs. As a SerDes Architecture And Modelling Engineer, You Will Research and develop new concepts for high-speed serial communication systems Build system level models to investigate, compare and optimise new architectures Develop signal processing algorithms and evaluate their impact on link performance Use MATLAB, Python or C++ to model communication systems and test new ideas Work with architects and IC designers to translate research concepts into practical transceiver architectures Analyse system limitations including signal integrity, noise, power and clock recovery Define link budgets and block-level specifications based on system requirements Support analog, digital and verification teams throughout the development process My client is looking for an engineer with a strong research background in signal processing, communications, control theory or mathematical modelling. Relevant Experience Could Include Research and development of new communication or signal processing techniques Strong understanding of digital algorithms and control theory Experience developing and implementing signal processing algorithms System-level modelling of digital communication systems Strong programming skills in MATLAB, Python or C++ Understanding of SerDes, clock recovery or other high-speed communication systems Knowledge of signal integrity and analog circuit behaviour Experience with SPICE or Spectre would be useful The role is aimed at someone with 5+ years of experience in semiconductor, telecommunications, communications research or scientific software development. A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Communications, Computer Science or a related field is expected. The SerDes Architecture and Modelling Engineer position would suit someone who enjoys working in an R&D environment, challenging existing approaches and turning research ideas into new system architectures. The role requires a minimum of 3 days on site in Lausanne. Get in touch with Parm Shergill for more information.

items.desc: At IQM, we build world-leading quantum computers for the well-being of humankind. We design systems to tackle computational challenges beyond the practical limits of classical machines. Our work sits at the edge of science and engineering. It's complex, demanding, and deeply collaborative. We turn deep research into reliable, full-stack systems that drive discoveries in fields like medicine, energy, and technology, reshaping how the world computes. Join the team that gives quantum a heartbeat. The work We are looking for a Quantum Engineer (Junior to Senior level) with an experimental background to join our Calibration and Benchmarking team, focusing on improving the performance of superconducting Quantum Processing Units (QPUs). In this role, you will work hands-on with quantum hardware to develop, optimize, and execute calibration and benchmarking protocols. You will play a key role in validating new QPU architectures and supporting IQM's roadmap toward high-performance and scalable quantum computing systems. Analyze experimental data to identify performance bottlenecks and improvement opportunities. Contribute to system-level optimization, balancing performance and efficiency. Provide input to the development of calibration software and automated QPU tune-up frameworks. Support QPU calibration, validation, and preparation for deployment. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across hardware, software, and system engineering. (Senior level) Mentor junior team members and contribute to cross-team technical development initiatives. Quantum Engineer Ph.D. degree in Physics or a related discipline, or equivalent experience in quantum technologies. Senior Quantum Engineer Postdoctoral research experience or equivalent industrial experience in quantum technologies. items.desc: QUELLE SERA VOTRE CONTRIBUTION ? Pilotage De Projets D'innovation En tant que membre de notre équipe R&I Electronic Systems & Solutions (E2S), vous serez le chef d'orchestre de projets complexes et impactants : Mener le cadrage, la planification et le suivi de projets R&I stratégiques, depuis la phase d'étude exploratoire jusqu'au transfert de technologie. Définir et gérer les objectifs, les livrables, les plannings et les risques, en vous appuyant sur des méthodologies Agile et Prince2. Coordonner et animer les équipes techniques, les partenaires internes (Manufactures, Maisons) et externes, garantissant une collaboration fluide et efficace. Assurer la rédaction et la formalisation de la documentation projet à chaque étape clé. Expertise Technique Firmware & Ultra Low Power Concevoir et déployer des architectures logicielles embarquées robustes et évolutives, capables de supporter le développement de nos produits. Développer des preuves de concept (POC) et prototypes, avec une approche système intégrée (hardware, software, mécanique). Implémenter et valider des firmwares performants en C, C++ et Python, avec une expertise reconnue sur les microcontrôleurs STM32 et une connaissance des EFR32. Maîtriser l'optimisation de puissance à un niveau micro-ampère et nano-ampère, en gérant finement les modes de veille, l'utilisation du MCU et les périphériques pour atteindre des consommations ultra-faibles. Intégrer et piloter des capteurs complexes via des interfaces comme SPI, I2C, BLE, NFC et des techniques de bitbang. Mettre en œuvre des pratiques de développement rigoureuses, incluant l'utilisation de GIT pour le contrôle de versions, le débogage embarqué et le JTAG. Veille Technologique & Innovation Être force de proposition sur les technologies, concepts et axes de développement innovants qui soutiennent la stratégie R&I du Groupe. Assurer une veille technologique active sur les dernières avancées en systèmes embarqués, microélectronique et gestion de l'énergie. Support à L'industrialisation Apporter un support technique expert aux Manufactures et Maisons lors du passage en production et garantir la qualité et la robustesse des solutions déployées. QUELLES SONT LES CLÉS DE VOTRE RÉUSSITE ? Ingénieur.e en électronique, systèmes embarqués, microtechnique ou équivalent. Vous justifiez d'une première expérience significative (3 à 5 ans) en développement firmware et en gestion de projets techniques complexes, avec une expertise reconnue en ultra-basse consommation. Compétences techniques : Maîtrise approfondie des langages C et Python. Expertise en architecture logicielle embarquée et capacité à concevoir des solutions évolutives. Connaissance avérée des microcontrôleurs STM32 et une familiarité avec les EFR32. Compétence primordiale en optimisation énergétique pour des applications ultra-low power (cibles nA/µA). Connaissance des interfaces de communication (SPI, I2C, BLE, NFC, bitbang). Pratique de l'intégration de capteurs. Maîtrise des outils de gestion de version comme GIT. Expérience en débogage embarqué et utilisation de JTAG. Expérience en gestion de projet ; connaissance des méthodologies Agile (Scrum, Kanban) et Prince2, un plus. Doté.e d'une forte autonomie, d'un sens aigu de l'organisation et d'excellentes capacités de communication, vous savez fédérer des équipes, prendre des initiatives et résoudre des problèmes complexes avec rigueur et esprit d'analyse. Vous êtes proactif.ve dans l'exploration et l'adoption d'outils innovants, y compris ceux basés sur l'Intelligence Artificielle, pour améliorer l'efficacité du développement. Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral et à l'écrit. Le poste est basé principalement à Buttes, au cœur de notre laboratoire d’innovation, avec une présence régulière dans notre hub R&I de Neuchâtel pour favoriser les échanges d’équipe et les synergies. Nous offrons un cadre de travail souple et équilibré grâce à des horaires de travail flexibles et la possibilité d’une journée de télétravail par semaine. Il s'agit d'un poste d’une durée de 12 mois, avec possibilité de renouvellement. VOTRE EXPÉRIENCE CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature est retenue, nous vous inviterons pour une entrevue dans nos locaux avec le Responsable du Pôle et le HR Business Partner. Dans un deuxième temps, nous vous soumettrons un cas pratique à réaliser et venir présenter devant un parterre d’experts.

items.desc: Chanel est une entreprise indépendante qui croit en la liberté de la création, cultive le potentiel humain et s’engage activement pour avoir un impact positif dans le monde. L'activité Parfums Beauté affirme sa singularité à travers une promesse : celle de révéler la beauté de chaque femme dans ce qu'elle a de plus singulier à travers son Parfum, son Maquillage et ses produits de Soin. La Recherche, l’Innovation et la recherche de Chanel Parfums Beauté est au service de la Création et du développement. Au sein de 5 centres de recherche regroupant plus de 300 scientifiques, chaque métier dédie son temps à la connaissance des femmes et de leur peau et à la recherche de performance pour créer les produits Chanel de demain. VOTRE IMPACT CHEZ CHANEL Rattaché au responsable du Laboratoire Développement Lèvres au sein de notre centre de Recherche et Développement, vous concevez, développez et participer à l’industrialisation des formules et concepts innovants de Rouges à Lèvres en réponse aux briefs Marketing et Studio. Vous êtes garant·e de la performance produit, de la robustesse formule et du respect des exigences de qualité, coûts, délais et écoresponsabilité. A ce titre, vos missions consisteront à : Développer et optimiser des formules rouges à lèvres (textures, performances, robustesse, teintes) et réaliser les contrôles, analyses et demandes de tests associés ; Suivre l'industrialisation des formules en identifiant les risques process. Réaliser les essais complémentaires et valider le mode opératoire en collaboration avec les équipes pilote ; Réaliser des études sur des problématiques identifiées en développement, plans d'essais, reporting et présentation des résultats ; Assurer la veille technologique et matières premières spécifiques lèvres Être référent·e formulation dans les projets transverses Lèvres et accompagner les équipes techniquement Participer à la vie du laboratoire (qualité/sécurité/hygiène/logistique/matériel). Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec les experts des différents départements pour assurer ces missions. Chez CHANEL, nous nous attachons à promouvoir une culture inclusive qui favorise l’épanouissement personnel et contribue au progrès collectif. Nous sommes convaincus que le caractère unique de chaque individu contribue à la diversité, la complémentarité et l’efficacité de nos équipes. items.desc: Shape the future of software with Witted At Witted, we match top-tier software and tech talent with the most ambitious projects in the market. We are now looking for experienced experts in AI Platform Engineering to join us. You can apply for an employment position at Witted Mavericks, or join our freelance network through Witted Partners — either way, you’ll get access to high-impact client projects, competitive terms, and a community of top-level peers. (Employment vs. Freelance): As an employee through Witted Mavericks: competitive compensation, comprehensive employee benefits, a supportive community, and the flexibility to switch projects internally. As a freelancer through Witted Partners: access to top AI projects in both Finland and Norway, full independence, and the backing of Witted’s extensive sales network without administrative hassle. Welcome aboard: once we land a project for you, we will either sign an employment contract (Witted Mavericks) or a freelance agreement (Witted Partners) together. This is where our journey begins - join us!

items.desc: Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off-highway and agricultural vehicle markets.
