You will define subsystem behavior and interfaces, and ensure seamless integration with software, hardware, and the operating environment. Develop and maintain system architecture, system elements, and interface definitions while conducting design reviews. Perform system modeling, simulations, and trade-off analyses to support technical decision-making. Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, including software, functional safety, cybersecurity, electrical and mechanical engineering, verification, and project management. Ensure compliance with applicable standards, regulatory requirements, and internal processes, including maintaining camera FMEA. Education, Experience And Knowledge 5+ years of Systems Engineering experience, preferably within automotive, agricultural, or heavy equipment industries. Knowledge of requirements engineering, gained through formal training or hands-on industry experience. Experience in system architecture development and translating requirements into technical solutions, with expertise in camera systems, image processing, image recognition, and image stitching technologies. Proficiency with requirements management and system modeling tools such as DOORS NG, Polarion, Capella, or similar platforms. Strong analytical skills with the ability to manage complex system interactions and interfaces. Nice to have: Knowledge of ASPICE, UNECE R46, MBSE. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About The Role As an Embedded Software Engineer (Multimedia) at Harmattan AI, you will join the R&D team to expand our Linux Board Support Package (BSP) capabilities. You will be the technical lead for CMOS and IR sensor integration, managing the entire video pipeline bring-up. This is a high-impact role that blends sophisticated "desk work" in Linux environments with hands-on "lab work" to validate next-generation hardware prototypes. Responsibilities Board Support Package (BSP): Expand and maintain Linux BSP capabilities with a specific focus on video pipeline architecture. Sensor Integration: Integrate and configure CMOS and IR camera sensors via MIPI/CSI interfaces. Driver Development: Configure and debug existing drivers within the Linux kernel and chip manufacturer ecosystems (NXP, NVIDIA, Qualcomm). Hardware Validation: Participate in hardware design reviews and validate new designs through schematic review and physical debugging. Reverse Engineering: Perform deep-system reverse engineering when documentation is incomplete to ensure robust system integration. Framework Management: Utilize V4L2 and GStreamer frameworks to achieve glitch-free, continuous video streams for downstream processing. Cross-Functional Support: Collaborate with Optical engineers for ISP tuning, Hardware teams for design reviews, and Computer Vision engineers to ensure acquisition meets algorithmic needs. Candidate Requirements Experience: 5–10 years of senior-level experience in embedded systems, specifically focused on camera video acquisition for Linux. Hardware Proficiency: Proven ability to work with chipsets from manufacturers such as NVIDIA, NXP, or Qualcomm. Debugging Expertise: Advanced skills using laboratory tools, including oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, to investigate memory corruption or performance latency. Framework Knowledge: Practical experience with Video4Linux2 (V4L2) and GStreamer for video pipeline management. Technical Rigor: A methodical investigator who is comfortable performing deep-system debugging and reverse engineering. System Design: Experience connecting and synchronizing multiple camera modules on a single chip. Mindset: Highly collaborative and adaptable, with the ability to translate complex hardware constraints into software requirements for multidisciplinary teams. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission and readiness to solve the most difficult integration challenges in the drone industry. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc: Job Description: Intitulé du poste : Ingénieur système FCS (F/H) Qui sommes-nous ? Au sein du Airbus Helicopters Drone Center, né de la fusion entre Survey Copter et Airbus Helicopters, nous concevons, fabriquons et assurons le maintien en conditions opérationnelles de systèmes de drones tactiques légers, destinés à des missions militaires et civiles. Nous couvrons l’ensemble du cycle de vie de ces systèmes, offrant à chacun la possibilité de contribuer pleinement à des projets technologiques et concrets. Filiale à 100% du groupe Airbus depuis 2011, elle est le centre d’expertise drones d’Airbus Helicopters, implantée à Pierrelatte (sa maison mère) et à Aix les Milles. Nous rejoindre, c’est intégrer des sites à taille humaine et des équipes passionnées, tout en profitant d’un cadre de vie privilégié dans la Drome ou les Bouches du Rhône, territoires dynamiques et ensoleillés. Pour en savoir plus sur nos produits UAS (Uncrewed Aerial Systems) : https://www.airbus.com/en/products-services/defence/uas Ce que nous pouvons accomplir ensemble : Sur notre site d’Aix en Provence, au sein du département du Bureau d’études, vous aurez pour missions principales de : Développer des briques logicielles software critique (code manuel ou model-based) Analyser des exigences fonctionnelles et de mission Concevoir de nouveaux systèmes et outils (conception de nouveaux concepts et mise à jour et suivi des conceptions existantes) Faire des simulations (simulations prédictives pour le prototypage, simulation hors ligne, simulation pilotée, simulateurs de vol complets) Vérifier par simulation et sur équipement réel Faire des mises au point des lois de commande de vol sur simulateurs et en vol Valider et vérifier et certifier Participer aux projets d'innovation relatifs aux projets de drones Vous serez également être amené à : Être en interface avec la gestion de projet, les achats, le service commercial et les autres acteurs du projet au sein de l'organisation Être l’interface pour le management des fournisseurs et des clients Supporter les essais sur banc d'intégration, au sol et en vol du système Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d’être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. Qui êtes-vous ? De formation ingénieur avec une spécialité en automatique, électro-technique et ingénierie aéronautique, vous avez au moins 3 à 5 années d’expérience dans l’industrie. Ce que l’on reconnait chez vous : Vos connaissances approfondies dans la conception, le développement, l'ingénierie et/ou l'intégration de systèmes de conduite du vol et/ou de radio-navigation pour aéronefs (incl. drones) Vos connaissances des normes de développement logiciels embarqués (type DO-178) et d'analyse de sûreté de fonctionnement (type ARP4754) Votre aisance sur des outils de conception (Scade / Matlab) et outils de simulation Votre expérience des systèmes de contrôle de vol (2 à 5 ans) Votre anglais professionnel Vos capacités de communication, d’ouverture d’esprit et d’adaptabilité à travailler dans un environnement agile et complexe Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : Bien-être / santé : complémentaire santé et prévoyance santé / décès financées à hauteur de 100 % par Survey Copter, Team Building. ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

This is a builder role for someone extremely analytical, comfortable running live enablement at scale, and already advanced with AI tools to automate the systems behind it.

Since this is a new role, we expect the scope to evolve over time - being adaptable and excited to build is a core part of being successful here. Focus areas include, but aren't limited to:

items.desc: We're an independent European digital product studio with a strong track record of delivering market-defining strategies and products for enterprises and governments. With about 200 talented people across three countries, premium AI capabilities and a diverse portfolio of international clients, we define, design and ship high-quality digital products, strategies and software. From global cloud-based platforms and large-scale apps to medical devices, banking software and augmented reality experiences. In a nutshell: if it lives and breathes digital, it’s what we do best. Become a part of our team At In The Pocket, you join a multidisciplinary team of designers, engineers, strategists and data specialists who care about the work as much as the people they work with. We work in small, autonomous teams that stay close to our clients and their users, and we give everyone the space to take ownership, speak up and grow. You’ll learn from colleagues across our studios, ship products that reach thousands or even millions of people and help shape what digital can do for leading organisations in Europe. What you’ll do You design the whole solution: the product, its integrations with the client's landscape, the data, the infrastructure, and the AI that makes it smarter. You make sure the architecture is sound, fits the business case and can evolve along with the product. And you're not an architect who draws boxes and leaves the building to others. You prove your choices with your own hands and stay close to the team while they build. Own the solution architecture Make sure the architecture of your products is sound, well understood and evolves in line with the business case. Lead architectural debates and decisions. You make trade-offs explicit, document them in ADRs, and keep internal teams, clients and suppliers aligned. Design solutions that fit the client's reality: their existing systems, data, integrations, security requirements and the way their people work. Bring AI in where it adds value Design AI-powered solutions such as agents, multimodal retrieval, assistants, document analysis and advanced search, and integrate them into the wider architecture. Make the AI calls explicit: whether AI is the right answer at all, foundation models or custom ones, RAG or fine-tuning, managed cloud services or self-hosted, agents or a plain workflow, and when a human stays in the loop. You weigh speed, accuracy and cost. Design for life after launch: scaling, cost control, evaluation, observability and LLMOps/MLOps for model upgrades and redeployment. Build security and governance in from the start, including access control, explainability, GDPR and the EU AI Act, especially in regulated environments. Shape the deal Work with sales in pre-sales. You gather the prospect's needs, shape the solution and the offer, and turn vague requirements and AI ambitions into a realistic, buildable plan. Be the bridge between engineering, data, product and business leadership. Prove it works Build proofs of concept yourself, including with GenAI, to de-risk the big decisions before a team commits to them. Stay close to the delivery teams, unblock them, and adjust the architecture when reality pushes back. Grow the people around you Make engineers better through design reviews, pairing and honest feedback on their work. Mentor engineers and tech leads who are growing towards architecture. Share what you learn in ADRs, Confluence pages, demos and internal sessions, and help define our reference architectures and standards. You have broad technical knowledge and you work well with subject-matter experts to go deep where needed. You have proven experience with SDLC, CI/CD and DevOps, and you model architecture with C4, UML and ADRs. You understand secure delivery (OWASP, threat modelling, SAST/DAST) and extend it to AI risks: data exposure, prompt injection and misuse. You've designed and shipped LLM-based solutions in production. You know what they can do, where they break, what the risks are and what they cost at scale. Support study start-up activities, enrolment initiatives, and issue resolution at investigator sites. Review, document, track, and follow up on site-related issues and escalate where appropriate. Act as the sponsor's regional operational support representative and point of escalation for investigator sites. Support investigator site readiness and study performance throughout the trial lifecycle. Participate in regulatory inspections and audits as a sponsor representative when required. Scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python, Go, Ansible, Helm, Terraform); Experience with monitoring and benchmarking tools (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, MinIO WARP) Past experience in a startup/scale-up and in remote working with agile methodology ‍ Profile and mindset Solid spoken and written communication skills: you can make complex architectures understandable without losing technical accuracy. As a key player in the high-tech machineries production, we specialize in cutting-edge technologies, shaping the future of industrial automation. Our business portfolio encompasses a wide range of innovative making and packing solutions, in particular for Modern Oral and Next Generation products. We strive to continuously expand our offerings and enhance our capabilities to meet the evolving needs of our customers. For more detailed information about G.D and its comprehensive business landscape, please visit www.gidi.it. G.D is part of Coesia, a group of innovation-based industrial and packaging solutions companies operating globally, headquartered in Bologna, Italy. Coesia operates in 34 countries with 21 different companies and employs over 8,000 people as of 2026. About the Role The resource will coordinate the collection, validation, and consolidation of the Group’s environmental and sustainability data, managing the main Sustainability Ratings and Assessments ( EcoVadis, CDP, and customer sustainability assessments ) and act as the key liaison between HSE, HR, Procurement, Legal, Finance, and other business functions involved in sustainability disclosure, reporting, and assessment activities. Main responsibilities will be: Manage and coordinate the Group-wide EcoVadis assessment process. Coordinate climate-related disclosures and the completion of CDP questionnaires. Manage Sustainability Assessment requests from customers. Support the Procurement function in addressing ESG-related requests concerning the supply chain. Coordinate the collection of sustainability data from the various business functions. Ensure the quality, reliability, and traceability of data used for reporting purposes. Support the preparation of CSRD/ESRS disclosures. Consolidate Group environmental data, including energy, emissions, water, waste, and circular economy metrics. Coordinate the calculation of the Group's Carbon Footprint (Scope 1, Scope 2, and support for Scope 3 emissions). Monitor environmental and climate-related KPIs and develop management dashboards. Support the Sustainability Committee through KPI reporting, analyses, and action plan monitoring. Collaborate with auditors, assurance providers, customers, and external stakeholders on verification and sustainability reporting activities. Conduct internal and external benchmarking analyses on sustainability ratings and performance. What You Need to Be Successful Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Industrial Engineering, Sustainability Economics , or a related field. Minimum 8–10 years of experience in Sustainability Reporting, Environmental Management, ESG Ratings, or similar roles. Proven hands-on experience managing EcoVadis, CDP , or comparable sustainability assessment frameworks. Strong knowledge of CSRD, ESRS, Carbon Footprint methodologies, and Climate Reporting . Experience managing cross-functional processes involving multiple business functions and stakeholders. Excellent analytical and data management skills. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting/dashboarding tools ( Power BI preferred). Fluent English, both written and spoken. items.desc: Notre mission L'IA transforme déjà le fonctionnement des entreprises. Chez Modjo, nous voulons révolutionner la manière dont les équipes commerciales vendent. Fondée à Paris en 2019, Modjo est en train de devenir le leader européen de l'IA appliquée à la vente. Les équipes commerciales ont accès à plus de données que jamais, mais celles-ci sont dispersées entre les CRM, les e-mails, les outils de vente et les échanges avec les clients. Lorsque le contexte est fragmenté, des signaux essentiels se perdent, les pipelines ralentissent et les opportunités s'envolent. Chez Modjo, nous développons un système d’agents IA qui comprend le contexte de chaque compte, de chaque opportunité et de chaque équipe. Nos agents aident les commerciaux à préparer leurs réunions, à gérer les objections, à exploiter pleinement les opportunités, à hiérarchiser les actions pertinentes et à faire avancer les dossiers. Le défi n’est pas de créer un énième outil. Il s’agit de développer une IA suffisamment fiable et utile pour devenir un véritable coéquipier des équipes commerciales. Avec une solution développée en France et des données hébergées en Europe, Modjo construit une alternative européenne souveraine en matière d’IA appliquée à la vente. Rejoindre Modjo, c’est contribuer à redéfinir la manière dont des millions de commerciaux travailleront demain. Pourquoi on recrute ? On recrute un(e) Machine Learning pour renforcer l'équipe. Tu seras au cœur de la construction, de la maintenance et du passage à l'échelle des features LLM et agentiques qui font tourner le produit Modjo. Ton terrain de jeu principal : notre système agentique avec un focus sur l'orchestration de modèles, l'exécution d'outils, l'évaluation, la fiabilité et la performance en production. Tes missions Concevoir, builder et optimiser le stack agentique qui fait tourner nos agents conversationnels et autonomes — avec un vrai souci de fiabilité, de scalabilité et de faible latence en prod. Architecturer et maintenir nos features LLM de bout en bout : orchestration de modèles, routing, monitoring, logging et évaluation. Développer et améliorer l'infrastructure ML : observabilité, load balancing, patterns de scaling, workflows de déploiement. Construire des datasets et pipelines d'évaluation robustes pour des systèmes déterministes (ASR) et non-déterministes (LLMs et agents), pour améliorer en continu la qualité. Collaborer avec les Software Engineers pour mettre en place une infrastructure scalable, observable et automatisée autour de nos services ML. Travailler main dans la main avec les Product Managers pour évaluer la faisabilité, affiner les specs et livrer nos features ML de manière fiable. Contribuer à la stratégie technique : choix des modèles et outils, décisions d'architecture, roadmap long terme de notre plateforme agentique. Faire de la veille sur les dernières recherches, frameworks et évolutions open-source en LLM, systèmes agentiques et méthodologies d'évaluation. Ton profil 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en ML Engineering ou Data Science Solide maîtrise de Python (bonus si tu as aussi touché à des langages bas niveau comme Java ou C ; un profil purement scripting ne suffira pas) Bonnes bases en ML : types de modèles, bonnes pratiques data science, méthodes d'évaluation Bonne maîtrise des LLMs : prompt design, évaluation, arbitrages coût/performance Expérience avec les systèmes agentiques : exécution d'outils, workflows, architectures mémoire, LangChain / LangGraph ou équivalent Exposition à MCP (Model Context Protocol), DeepEval, FastAPI, Uvicorn Compréhension des concepts NLP : transcription, embeddings, compréhension du langage Une vraie curiosité intellectuelle : tu te renseignes, tu creuses les sujets, tu as ton propre point de vue De l'ownership et une bonne communication : tu ne restes pas bloqué(e), tu poses les bonnes questions et tu avances Process de recrutement Etape 1 screening call avec Julien, VP Engineering Etape 2: Case study onsite avec Luca, Engineering Manager et Julien Etape 3: Team fit avec des membres de l'équipe Etape 4 : Final interview avec Paul (CEO) Etape 5: prise de références Notre culture Chez Modjo, nous recherchons des personnes qui souhaitent construire, et pas seulement exécuter. Des personnes qui prennent leurs responsabilités, transforment l’ambiguïté en action et restent concentrées sur la création d’un véritable impact. Des personnes curieuses, résilientes et prêtes à remettre en question le statu quo, tout en sachant que les meilleures idées naissent de la collaboration. Nous avançons rapidement, testons, apprenons et nous améliorons. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’excellence, mais nous n’attendons pas la perfection pour passer à l’action. Nous restons proches de nos utilisateurs et accordons la priorité aux ventes, car comprendre la réalité des équipes commerciales est essentiel pour créer un produit qui fait véritablement la différence. Nous apprécions les collaborateurs qui partagent ouvertement leurs retours, …

Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success. Your Responsibilities Will Include Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning. Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive
items.desc: Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning. Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge. Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success. Your Responsibilities Will Include Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning. Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system. Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization. Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking. Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda. Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture. We Expect You To Have A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead. At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI. A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches. Hands-on experience with: Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation. Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent. Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns. Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open-source models. Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Proficiency in English, both written and verbal. Our Ideal Candidate Would Have Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph-based reasoning. Experience in early-stage startups – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase. The ability to think strategically about product-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation. A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research. Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows. Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications. What we offer A competitive salary and JetBrains benefits. A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy. We are an equal opportunity employer We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation. We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the Recruitment Privacy Policy.

We zijn op zoek naar een genAI engineer voor een nieuw te vormen team dat generatieve AI producten naar productie brengt. Dit team ontwikkelt generatieve AI oplossingen voor de hele Belastingdienst: slimme zoekfuncties, documentverwerking, hulp bij het opstellen van teksten. Geen experimenten of proof-of-concepts, maar producten die collega’s daadwerkelijk gebruiken in hun werk. Dit doe je bij de Belastingdienst Als GenAI engineer ontwerp, bouw, evalueer en verbeter je generatieve AI oplossingen (prompting, RAG, agentic workflows) die aantoonbare waarde leveren voor de klant. Deze oplossingen toets je zodat ze voldoen aan de eisen die aan de Belastingdienst worden gesteld op het gebied van betrouwbaarheid, transparantie en verantwoord gebruik. Je werkt op de componenten die het AI platformteam levert. Je bouwt daarop de eindproducten en beheert de configuraties ervan. De kwaliteit van wat je bouwt is een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk. Je hebt affiniteit met generatieve AI en je bent een ambassadeur van de mogelijkheden van AI en analytics. DF&A is volop in ontwikkeling en actief op zoek naar vernieuwing – innovatie - binnen de Belastingdienst. Dat betekent vernieuwen in bijvoorbeeld technologie, toepassing, opleiding, wijze van organiseren, wijze van samenwerken en het werven van nieuwe medewerkers. Met jouw werkzaamheden speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol en help je onze afdeling en de Belastingdienst vooruit. Uiteraard krijg je ook zelf de kans om je te ontwikkelen. Een bijzondere baan, omdat... je de ruimte krijgt om out-of-the-box te denken. je vakgenoten enthousiasmeert om nieuwe ontwikkelingen uit te proberen. je trends en ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied vertaalt naar de Belastingdienst. “Als GenAI engineer bij de Belastingdienst ontwikkel ik GenAI-producten die toegevoegde waarde leveren voor de Belastingdienst” – Matthijs, genAI engineer Wanneer past deze baan bij je? Je hebt een wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in econometrie, statistiek, wiskunde, natuurkunde, data science of software engineering Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bouwen van GenAI-/LLM-toepassingen, zoals het schrijven van prompts of RAG oplossingen Je hebt ervaring met programmeren, bij voorkeur in Python en SQL Je hebt basisvaardigheid in deployment, zoals het bouwen van CI/CD-principes, logging en monitoring Je houdt van pionieren en gedijt goed in een organisatie waar nog niet alles is vastgelegd. Jouw competenties plannen en organiseren overtuigingskracht analyseren resultaatgerichtheid samenwerken De afdeling - Corporate Dienst Datafundamenten en Analytics De Corporate Dienst Datafundamenten en Analytics (DF&A) werkt voor directies van de Belastingdienst die belast zijn met de fiscale behandeling van burgers en bedrijven én voor bedrijfsvoering. DF&A levert signaalmodellen en informatiedashboards die zijn gebaseerd op de analyse van ‘big data’ en die de organisatie inzicht geven in de mogelijkheden om werkzaamheden slimmer en beter uit te voeren. Zo kunnen op informatie-gestuurde wijze keuzes worden gemaakt in bijvoorbeeld handhavingsstrategieën, behandeladviezen en procesinrichtingen. De signaalmodellen en dashboards worden gebouwd door gebruik te maken van innovatieve IT-ontwikkelingen en het koppelen van zeer divers aangeleverde data. DF&A maakt hiervoor gebruik van een zelfontwikkelde methodiek om data op te bouwen tot datafundamenten, die de basis zijn voor de producten. De organisatie Belastingdienst Bij de Belastingdienst werken ongeveer 28.000 mensen verspreid over het hele land aan een financieel gezond Nederland. Dit doen we door eerlijk en zorgvuldig belastingen en premies volksverzekeringen te heffen, te innen en te controleren en fraude op te sporen. De Belastingdienst maakt het burgers en bedrijven zo gemakkelijk mogelijk om verplichtingen na te kunnen komen en gebruik te kunnen maken van rechten. Dat gebeurt met passende dienstverlening, door massale processen juist en tijdig uit te voeren én door adequaat toezicht uit te oefenen. De Belastingdienst is sterk in ontwikkeling en heeft de ambitie om de beste Belastingdienst voor Nederland te zijn met focus op fiscale taken en vakmanschap. Lees meer over de Belastingdienst op: https://over-ons.belastingdienst.nl Bijzonderheden We ontvangen je brief en cv graag in een Word- of PDF-bestand. Neem in de bestandsnaam jouw voor- en achternaam op. Als je een beroep doet op een voorrangspositie, stuur dan ook een kopie van die kennisgeving mee. Selectieprocedure Allereerst wordt beoordeeld of een voorrangskandidaat binnen de Rijksoverheid in aanmerking komt voor de functie. items.desc: Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning. Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge. Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success. Your Responsibilities Will Include Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning. Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system. Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization. Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking. Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda. Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture. We Expect You To Have A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead. At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI. A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches. Hands-on experience with: Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation. Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent. Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns. Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open-source models. Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Proficiency in English, both written and verbal. Our Ideal Candidate Would Have Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph-based reasoning. Experience in early-stage startups – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase. The ability to think strategically about product-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation. A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research. Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows. Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications. What we offer A competitive salary and JetBrains benefits. A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy. We are an equal opportunity employer We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation. We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the Recruitment Privacy Policy.

Our leadership is also named to the Time AI 100. Learn more about the newest product launches from our Liftoff event. About The Team We are building a planet‑scale biometric recognition system that will serve more than a billion users and enable them to become part of the World protocol. We use cutting-edge Machine Learning models deployed on custom hardware to enable high-quality image acquisition, identification, and fraud prevention, all while requiring minimal user interaction. We are building a biometric recognition and fraud detection engine that works on the 1bn people scale. Therefore, its performance needs to outperform all the current recognition technologies. We leverage our powerful custom-made iris recognition and presentation attack detection device, the Orb, combined with the latest research from the field of AI and Deep Learning. To reach our next milestone—continuous, trustworthy ML innovation across millions of edge devices—we’re hiring a Senior ML Platform & Ops Engineer to own the ML lifecycle from data to device. You’ll design and operate production-grade pipelines that transform state-of-the-art ML research into deployed models with clear telemetry, rollback, and reproducibility. If you thrive on building self‑service platforms that turn research ideas into reliable, observable production systems, we’d love to meet you. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and operate reliable, observable infrastructure for training, evaluation, telemetry ingestion, and deployment. Maintain CI/CD workflows and automated pipelines. Edge‑aware rollout services with staged deployment, A/B experimentation and instant rollback across Orbs, Orb Mini and Mobile Apps. Develop secure APIs and backend services that expose governed datasets and model artefacts at scale. Implement automated checks, drift detection, and alerting for real-time model monitoring. Champion best practices in data lineage, reproducibility, privacy‑by‑design, security and secure edge delivery. Collaborate across ML research, product, and firmware teams to streamline delivery and feedback loops. About You 5+ years building ML infrastructure, data platforms, or production ML systems at scale. Track record of delivering platforms and CI/CD pipelines used daily by ML or data teams. Hands-on experience running large-scale training on multi-tenant GPU clusters to maximize throughput and reliability. You’ve built versioned dataset & lineage systems with slice-level provenance and governed access, making every model reproducible to the exact data, features, code, and config used. Deep understanding of containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes/EKS) plus Infrastructure‑as‑Code (Terraform/CDK/Cloudformation). Strong backend engineering skills in Python and/or Go; you value clean, maintainable code. Deep understanding of modern CI/CD, model packaging, and observability practices. Comfortable operating production systems, defining SLAs, and handling rollout or incident workflows. Comfortable using modern Agentic AI development

items.desc: Position description Business unit Investment Management - Equity Management Job title Quantitative Equity Researcher F/M Contract type Permanent Candriam Group Presentation Candriam is a global multi-specialist asset manager and a recognized pioneer and leader in sustainable investment. For more than 25 years, Candriam has offered innovative and diversified investment solutions across many asset classes including fixed income, equities, alternatives, absolute return, asset allocation and illiquid assets. As a Responsible Employer, Equal Employment Opportunity is crucial to Candriam. We are committed to building the best global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We provide an inclusive work environment and support wellbeing and work-life balance. Mission The Quantitative Equity Management team manages assets across active global, US, European and Japanese long-only equity funds and institutional mandates, as well as a long/short market-neutral strategy. We are looking for a Quantitative Equity Researcher to strengthen the team’s research capabilities and contribute to the continued development of its investment strategies. The successful candidate will conduct applied quantitative research aimed at enhancing the existing investment framework and identifying new, differentiated sources of alpha. This includes improving current stock-selection models and developing complementary strategies that broaden and diversify the team’s investment approach. Responsabilities Responsabilities Conduct quantitative research into new equity signals, datasets and investment strategies. Enhance and extend the team’s existing stock-selection models and research framework. Identify complementary sources of alpha across investment styles, regions and market environments. Assess the robustness, economic rationale and scalability of new signals and strategies. Design and perform rigorous backtests, including transaction costs, liquidity constraints and implementation considerations. Analyse signal interactions, factor exposures, portfolio risks and performance across different market regimes. Explore alternative and unstructured datasets, as well as advanced statistical, machine-learning and AI techniques where relevant. Translate successful research into robust, production-ready investment solutions. Collaborate closely with Quantitative Fund Managers on portfolio construction, strategy implementation and ongoing model monitoring. Clearly present research findings and investment recommendations to colleagues and internal decision-making committees. Contribute to the team’s research agenda and challenge existing approaches constructively. Profile A master's degree or PhD in finance, econometrics, statistics, mathematics, engineering, data science or another quantitative discipline. At least five years of relevant professional experience in quantitative equity research, systematic investing or a closely related field. At least five years of relevant professional experience in quantitative equity research, systematic investing or a closely related field. A master's degree or PhD in finance, econometrics, statistics, mathematics, engineering, data science or another quantitative discipline. Strong knowledge of equity markets, quantitative stock selection, factor investing and portfolio construction. Demonstrated experience in developing and testing systematic equity signals or investment strategies. Advanced programming skills, preferably in Python, combined with strong data-handling capabilities. Sound understanding of statistical methods, research design, model validation and the risks of overfitting. Ability to connect rigorous quantitative analysis with a clear economic and investment rationale. Experience with alternative data, machine learning or generative AI applications in investment research would be an advantage. A collaborative, intellectually curious and pragmatic mindset. Job location Candidate criteria Education Master's Degree I / Bac+4 Minimum Level Of Experience Required 6-10 years Languages English (C1 - Fluent)

items.desc: DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk. Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets. We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus. We are seeking a Quantitative Researcher to work on alpha generation, model development, and the full research pipeline for mid-frequency equity statistical arbitrage strategies. The position will collaborate closely with the Portfolio Manager and other team members, contributing across all stages — from data processing and feature engineering to backtesting and live deployment. Key Responsibilities Research, design, and implement predictive signals and features across global equities. Work with large, diverse datasets; develop robust feature engineering and point in time (PIT) data cleaning pipelines. Collaborate with team members to implement research infrastructure, backtesting frameworks, and analytical tools. Build frameworks and tools for performance attribution and ongoing live strategy monitoring. Requirements 2–8 years of experience in quant equities, with a primary focus on alpha research. Familiarity with both standard and alternative datasets used in equity stat arb strategies, including data cleansing, ticker mapping, point-in-time (PIT) handling, and other dataset idiosyncrasies. Strong programming skills in Python; experience with SQL and distributed data environments. Advanced degree (PhD/MSc) in Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related quantitative discipline. items.desc: Job Description Grade UE07: £41,064 - £48,822 per annum, with an additional market pay supplement bringing the total salary to up to £55,000 per annum CSE / School of Engineering / Cosysense Full-time: 35 hours per week Fixed-term: 24 months Location: Primarily based at Cosysense The Opportunity Where curiosity becomes impact. This is a KTP Associate to contribute to the Knowledge Transfer Partnership (KTP) project that aims to develop next-generation thermal comfort and energy optimisation models for scalable deployment. Funded by InnovateUK, the KTP project is co-led by the Institute for Infrastructure and Environment and Institute for Energy Systems at the University of Edinburgh (UoE), and Cosysense . Cosysense reduces electricity costs and carbon emissions in commercial buildings by delivering optimised comfort through AI-native climate control powered by sensors, digital twins, and autonomous control systems. The KTP Associate will lead the development and deployment of advanced thermal comfort and grid demand response physics models into Cosysense’s AI control system. You will act as the bridge between academic research and real-world application, translating cutting-edge building physics and human comfort modelling into production-ready algorithms controlling HVAC systems in live buildings. In line with the KTP model, the Associate is embedded at Cosysense day to day, engaging regularly with the University of Edinburgh for knowledge transfer and academic supervision. This role will be primarily based at Cosysense. The Role Combines Research (building physics and energy systems) Applied AI / modelling Real-world deployment and validation in commercial buildings A unique employer in a vibrant city. The University isn’t just any employer. We are part of a local community and a contributor to global thinking, progress and research. In Edinburgh, you are in one of the world’s most attractive cities with active arts and social sectors, while working in a University that has made significant contributions to society, medicine, physics and teaching for over four centuries. Our people have helped create the modern world and are working on more ground-breaking technologies and practices. Make a meaningful impact. Here, you can continue to make a difference in everything around you. Take on new challenges, grow your career, be recognised for your contributions, and benefit from our commitment to your wellbeing. Be part of something bigger — where your work has real impact and your development matters. There are so many reasons to take your next step with us. This post is full-time (35 hours per week); however, we are open to considering part-time or flexible working patterns. We are also open to considering requests for hybrid working (on a non-contractual basis) that combines a mix of remote and regular on-campus working. We are members of the Race Equality Charter, and we are also Stonewall Scotland Diversity Champions, actively promoting LGBT equality. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and particularly encourage those from groups underrepresented in academia and STEM. Our team has significant experience in creating and delivering respectful, inclusive and supportive environments where all members can thrive and it is supported by the vision for our research, behaviours and norms. items.card: Votre mission : Concevoir, modéliser et industrialiser la génération de code embarqué Vous interviendrez sur un projet stratégique visant à moderniser les outils de conception et de développement logiciel pour l’ensemble des entités du groupe. items.desc: Contexte : Dans le cadre d’un projet de transformation de la chaîne outillée RxD (PLM, ALM, MBSSE), nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur ou Architecte Logiciel Embarqué pour évaluer, sélectionner et déployer une solution de génération de code à partir de modèles (Matlab/Simulink, UML, SysML). Votre mission : Concevoir, modéliser et industrialiser la génération de code embarqué Vous interviendrez sur un projet stratégique visant à moderniser les outils de conception et de développement logiciel pour l’ensemble des entités du groupe. Vos tâches : Évaluer les différentes solutions de génération de code disponibles sur le marché (outils, générateurs, chaînes de production). Sélectionner la solution la plus adaptée aux besoins en termes de qualité, performance et intégration dans la chaîne outillée existante. Accompagner le fournisseur pour optimiser la solution retenue (paramétrage, adaptation, montée en version, corrections). Déployer la solution au sein de la chaîne outillée, en garantissant la production d’un code de niveau production (qualité, efficacité, maintenabilité). Produire les livrables associés : spécifications, modèles (UML, SysML), rapports d’évaluation, résultats de tests, documentation technique. Collaborer avec les équipes R&D, PLM, ALM et MBSSE pour assurer l’intégration cohérente du générateur de code dans l’écosystème existant. Profil candidat: Formation : Bac+5 ingénieur (ou équivalent) en informatique, systèmes embarqués, automatique ou domaine connexe Expérience : 5 à 10 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel embarqué automobile, avec une forte dimension architecture et modélisation Environnement technique : Langages : maîtrise experte du C, bonne maîtrise du C++ Systèmes embarqués : expérience sur Embarqué OS, FreeRTOS, Linux embarqué (notions), AUTOSAR (design & outils type Vector DaVinci) Modélisation : expertise confirmée en UML et SysML (idéalement SysML v2), avec une pratique avancée d’outils tels que IBM Rhapsody, Catia Magic Cyber System (MagicDraw, Cameo), Enterprise Architect Génération de code : expérience sur Matlab/Simulink, Embedded Coder, TargetLink ou équivalents Méthodes & outils modernes : maîtrise de Git, bonnes pratiques de développement, et appétence pour l’usage d’outils d’IA dans le développement logiciel Anglais courant pour les échanges avec les fournisseurs

OUR VALUES AND BELIEFS Being a responsible business, we work with integrity and honesty. We share success with our people and our communities. We embrace diversity in outlook and work as a team with colleagues, customers, and suppliers to provide the best technical solution and professional service experience. We empower each other, we’re adaptable, show initiative, and deliver on our commitments together. THE ROLE If you’re a recognised radar expert who still enjoys hands-on engineering, and want to help shape the future direction of a rapidly expanding capability, we’d like to talk to you. As a Lead Radar Systems Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across our radar activities, supporting customer delivery, capability development and business growth. You will lead the technical definition of advanced radar systems and RF architectures from concept through to demonstration and deployment, working closely with multidisciplinary teams spanning RF, electronics, signal processing, software and systems engineering. You will also play a key role in developing our radar capability, helping to identify new opportunities, mentor engineers and maintain Plextek’s reputation for solving technically challenging problems. This role requires UK SC / UKEO clearance. Key Responsibilities:Technical Leadership Lead the development of advanced radar and RF systems. Define and assess Radio Frequency architectures against (sometimes unclear) customer requirements. Make critical system-level trade-offs involving performance, cost, risk and implementation complexity. Guide multidisciplinary engineering teams through the delivery of complex projects to help drive effective execution. Support technical strategy and the growth of RF and radar-related capabilities. Radar Systems Engineering Develop radar system requirements and performance models. Conduct system-level analysis and architecture selection. Evaluate radar performance trade-offs including detection range, resolution, sensitivity and clutter performance. Act as a trusted technical authority for customers. Support project scoping, proposal generation and technical planning. Present complex technical concepts clearly to customers and stakeholders. Identify new opportunities arising from customer challenges and emerging technologies. Capability Development Mentor and coach engineers across radar, RF and systems disciplines. Contribute to technology roadmaps and research activities. Support recruitment and technical development within the radar team. Help maintain and expand Plextek’s position as a leader in advanced RF and radar solutions. Essential Experience: We are looking for a highly capable engineer with significant (minimum 10 years+) industrial experience in customised radar systems development. You should have deep expertise across a substantial proportion of the following: Radar Systems Pulsed radar systems FMCW radar systems SAR and radar imaging systems Radar performance modelling and analysis Radar architecture development Antenna concepts and system integration RF Systems Design Radio propagation RF link and level planning Synthesiser systems design RF transceiver architecture selection RF Hardware Understanding RF and microwave circuit design Distributed microwave techniques Millimetre-wave systems High-performance frequency synthesisers Analogue electronics relevant to RF electronics Systems Engineering Requirements capture and analysis Verification and validation planning Technical leadership of multidisciplinary teams Project definition and technical scoping Technology and capability development The ideal candidate will be: Technically exceptional and recognised by peers as an authority in radar systems. Curious, proactive and motivated by difficult engineering challenges. Comfortable operating with significant autonomy. Commercially aware and able to engage directly with customers. A natural mentor who enjoys developing less experienced engineers. Excited by building capability and shaping the future direction of a growing business. THE REWARDS We offer an excellent package, a stimulating environment, and a real interest in your development to encourage you to achieve your full potential. We are a versatile business, able to support career progression as appropriate. We are based just south of Cambridge with easy road and rail routes to the city centre. We provide a friendly and supportive working environment, including regular on-site and off-site social events.

items.desc: Azienda: Wide Group srl Digitalizziamo il settore assicurativo, storicamente burocratico e legato al cartaceo, sviluppando internamente il nostro gestionale. L'automazione basata su AI è la leva con cui scaliamo il business. Nasciamo nel 2016 dall'unione di tre realtà storiche del settore e oggi contiamo quasi 300 persone in 20 sedi in Italia. Il ruolo Svilupperai applicazioni basate su LLM che automatizzano i processi di business, seguendo ogni progetto con piena ownership dalla raccolta dei requisiti alla produzione e al monitoraggio, per sostenere la crescita dell'azienda. Cosa farai Raccoglierai i requisiti direttamente dalle persone di business e li tradurrai in soluzioni di automazione basate su LLM, proponendo alternative motivate quando l'approccio richiesto non convince. Svilupperai in Python applicazioni e flussi agentici basati su LLM con approccio code-first, oggi con LangChain e LangGraph. Definirai e applicherai processi di evaluation degli output dei modelli con LangFuse e tecniche come LLM as a judge. Rilascerai le applicazioni in produzione su un'architettura AWS a eventi e microservizi e ne monitorerai il comportamento nel tempo. Sperimenterai nuovi modelli e strumenti AI e proporrai quali adottare nello stack del team. Contesto tecnico Linguaggio e framework: Python, LangChain, LangGraph e LangFuse, in uno stack in rapida evoluzione. Cloud: esclusivamente AWS, con architettura a eventi e microservizi e container Docker su EKS. Approccio: code-first, senza strumenti no-code in produzione. Team: riporto diretto al lead del team AI e collaborazione con un'altra AI specialist basata a Bolzano, senza project manager di filtro verso il business. Lingua: italiano nel lavoro quotidiano; documentazione e codice in inglese. Chi cerchiamo Requisiti essenziali esperienza professionale nello sviluppo in Python di applicazioni basate su LLM tramite codice, con almeno un rilascio in produzione; esperienza nella valutazione sistematica della qualità degli output di applicazioni LLM; esperienza nella raccolta di requisiti da stakeholder di business non tecnici, nella loro traduzione in soluzioni tecniche e nella proposta di alternative motivate quando una richiesta non convince; abitudine a sperimentare di propria iniziativa nuovi modelli e strumenti AI, con la capacità di motivare cosa adottare e cosa scartare; conoscenza professionale della lingua italiana e della lingua inglese. Requisiti preferenziali esperienza con LangFuse o con tecniche di LLM as a judge; esperienza nel rilascio e nel monitoraggio di più applicazioni LLM in produzione su un cloud provider, preferibilmente AWS, con Docker; esperienza nello sviluppo di sistemi RAG. Cosa offriamo Sede: Milano, zona Conciliazione. Modalità di lavoro: ibrida, fino a 12 giorni al mese da remoto, con presenza in sede più frequente nei primi mesi. Trasferte: rare, in giornata o al massimo di 2 giorni. Contratto: tempo indeterminato. Pacchetto retributivo: RAL 35–45k€ + bonus welfare legato a obiettivi individuali + buoni pasto 6,50€/giorno.

items.desc:
Introduction to the job 
 As a Service Center Coordinator , you help manufacturing teams build the advanced systems that power modern technology. You coordinate daily production activities, resolve technical issues, and keep work progressing safely across shifts.
 Your expertise helps ASML deliver reliable lithography systems to customers around the world. You challenge existing processes, collaborate across departments, and care for quality, safety, and your colleagues.
 Role and responsibilities 
 As a Service Center Coordinator , you provide technical and operational direction within a precision manufacturing environment. You coordinate priorities, support colleagues, and solve exceptions using established procedures and practical experience.
 You will:
 Coordinate daily manufacturing activities and maintain production progress across teams and shifts.
 Lead your work area and represent the team when discussing technical or operational matters.
 Resolve technical issues and escalate complex risks to the appropriate supporting departments.
 Check materials, tools, equipment, and products for availability, accuracy, and quality.
 Support new product and process introductions by following approved testing and production requirements.
 Identify recurring shop-floor issues and lead structured improvements that strengthen safety, quality, and efficiency.
 Record production information and provide accurate shift handovers, reports, and status updates.
 Education and experience 
 You bring practical manufacturing knowledge and experience working with mechanical or electrical components. You are comfortable coordinating others while remaining actively involved in daily production.
 Secondary vocational education with at least three years of relevant manufacturing experience; or
 Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, manufacturing engineering, or a related field.
 Hands-on experience using precision tools, technical instructions, and controlled manufacturing procedures.
 Experience supporting colleagues and coordinating work within a production or technical service environment.
 Experience using SAP or another enterprise resource planning system is preferred.
 Experience collecting production data and preparing reports with Microsoft Excel or similar tools.
 Skills 
 Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.
To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:
 Collaborate effectively with production teams, planners, engineers, and supporting departments.
 Communicate technical information clearly and respectfully to colleagues with different experience levels.
 Analyze production issues and develop practical solutions within established safety and quality requirements.
 Take ownership of priorities, progress, documentation, and clear handovers between shifts.
 Challenge existing processes constructively and turn improvement opportunities into measurable actions.
 Coach less-experienced colleagues and encourage the exchange of technical knowledge.
 Act with integrity and protect the safety and well-being of everyone in the workplace.
 Other information 
 The Service Center Coordinator works in a shift-based manufacturing environment and supports progress across consecutive shifts. The position includes hands-on work with precision tools and mechanical or electrical components.
 The reporting line and geographic location will be confirmed in the vacancy details. The role requires close cooperation with manufacturing, planning, engineering, logistics, and technical support teams.

items.desc:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 Senior Software Engineer - Java Application Core Components (JACC) 
 Adyen provides a global, unified platform built by Java application teams across the company. The Java Application Core Components (JACC) team plays a key role in this: we build and maintain the shared frameworks and components that define how other Adyen teams design, structure, and deploy their Java applications.
 As part of JACC, you will build and maintain the core Java tools and components used across all of Adyen, shaping how other engineering teams build their services. You'll work on some of the largest ongoing efforts in the company, including 3 large-scale migrations that will shape the future of Adyen's application architecture. You'll join a lean team of 6 Java experts, working in a Kanban-like way with minimal process overhead, and gain real influence over the architecture of one of the leading players in the payments space.
 What you will do 
 Design, build, and evolve the internal and open source Java frameworks and components used by every Java application team at Adyen.
 Play an active role in one or more of the team's 3 large-scale migrations that are reshaping Adyen's application architecture.
 Provide hands-on technical guidance to other engineering teams, by guiding them on how the frameworks and libraries we provide can be used to solve Adyen's business problems.
 Design and evolve workflows used by other engineering teams across Adyen, working closely with them to identify pain points and improvement opportunities.
 Collaborate with partner platform teams (Kubernetes infrastructure, deployment, security) to make sure our components integrate well across Adyen's tech stack.
 Advocate for best practices across Adyen and define boundaries/guidance on how the frameworks/libraries we maintain can be used. This should be achieved by creating code validation rules, running workshops and giving presentations to other development teams.
 What you bring 
 5+ years of experience with Java backend development
 Strong skills in core Java and code/API design
 Track record of building high-quality software, with testing at all levels
 A communicative, proactive team player who takes ownership, is decisive under ambiguity, and can act as a technical influencer with a multiplier mindset
 Comfortable being a driver: able to build alignment with stakeholders and partners while pushing initiatives for our customers
 Nice to have 
 Experience with Kubernetes/cloud migrations, legacy application modernization, security-related work or platform development experience
 Experience developing and maintaining libraries/frameworks used by many other developers (either open source or internal)
 Experience with build tools, ideally for Java (Gradle/Maven)
 Broader architecture sense across distributed systems
 Familiarity with Spring, Jersey, Feign, OpenAPI
 Understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 Exposure to AI agent workflows and a DevOps mindset
 Developer advocacy experience: public speaking or training/facilitation skills
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

items.desc: Chi siamo Fides S.p.A. , realtà operante nel settore della gestione del credito, è alla ricerca di un AI Engineer da coinvolgere in progetti di innovazione tecnologica e sviluppo di soluzioni basate sull'Intelligenza Artificiale. La risorsa contribuirà alla realizzazione di sistemi intelligenti capaci di supportare e automatizzare i processi aziendali, attraverso l'utilizzo di modelli linguistici (LLM), tecnologie RAG ( Retrieval-Augmented Generation ) e sistemi agentici. La ricerca è rivolta a profili Junior e Middle , con differenti livelli di esperienza, accomunati dalla passione per la tecnologia e dall'interesse per le applicazioni concrete dell'Intelligenza Artificiale. Di cosa ti occuperai In collaborazione con il team tecnico, avrai l'opportunità di: Sviluppare soluzioni basate su AI generativa e sistemi RAG , contribuendo all'elaborazione, indicizzazione e ricerca intelligente delle informazioni aziendali. Collaborare alla progettazione di agenti AI in grado di supportare e automatizzare workflow e processi operativi. Lavorare con modelli linguistici locali (LLM) , partecipando alle attività di configurazione, sperimentazione e ottimizzazione. Contribuire alla valutazione delle prestazioni dei modelli AI , attraverso test, metriche e analisi dei risultati. Supportare l'integrazione delle soluzioni AI con i sistemi e le applicazioni aziendali. Collaborare alle attività di sviluppo, testing e miglioramento continuo delle soluzioni tecnologiche. Il livello di autonomia e responsabilità sarà commisurato alle competenze e all'esperienza maturata. Il profilo che cerchiamo Laurea triennale o magistrale in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Matematica, Fisica o discipline affini, oppure percorso formativo equivalente. Conoscenza dei principi fondamentali del Machine Learning, delle reti neurali e dell'architettura Transformer. Familiarità con i modelli linguistici (LLM), anche attraverso progetti universitari, di tesi, personali o professionali. Conoscenza delle architetture RAG, degli embedding e della ricerca semantica. Conoscenza delle tecniche di prompt engineering. Competenze di programmazione, preferibilmente in C#/.NET, TypeScript o linguaggi equivalenti. Conoscenza dei database relazionali e del linguaggio SQL. Familiarità con Git e capacità di consultare documentazione tecnica in inglese. Costituiscono requisiti preferenziali Conoscenza di Python, PyTorch e Hugging Face. Esperienza con strumenti per l'esecuzione di modelli locali come Ollama, llama.cpp o vLLM. Familiarità con PostgreSQL, pgvector e database vettoriali. Conoscenza di framework come LangChain, LlamaIndex o Semantic Kernel. Nozioni di Docker, Linux e ambienti di sviluppo AI. Esperienza nella valutazione delle prestazioni dei modelli e nell'ottimizzazione dei sistemi AI. Interesse per la sicurezza dei sistemi di Intelligenza Artificiale e la protezione dei dati. Valutiamo anche candidature di neolaureati e professionisti nelle prime fasi della carriera , con buone competenze di base e una forte motivazione all'apprendimento. Per i profili Middle sarà valorizzata una maggiore esperienza pratica nello sviluppo e nell'integrazione di soluzioni basate sull'Intelligenza Artificiale. Cosa offriamo Inserimento in un contesto aziendale orientato all'innovazione e all'evoluzione tecnologica. Opportunità di partecipare a progetti concreti di Intelligenza Artificiale applicata ai processi aziendali. Affiancamento tecnico e possibilità di sviluppare competenze specialistiche. Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e opportunità di crescita professionale. Sede di lavoro: Catania Modalità di lavoro ibrida , con possibilità di alternare attività in presenza e da remoto. Retribuzione Annua Lorda (RAL) commisurata all'esperienza e alle competenze: Profilo Junior: € 25.000 – € 30.000 Profilo Middle: € 30.000 – € 35.000 Candidati! Se l'Intelligenza Artificiale è la tua passione e vuoi contribuire allo sviluppo di soluzioni tecnologiche innovative, inviaci la tua candidatura! Se hai realizzato progetti personali, universitari o professionali legati all'AI, puoi condividere anche un link al tuo repository GitHub o a un progetto che racconti le tue competenze. Fides S.p.A. promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e valorizza le candidature nel rispetto delle pari opportunità.

items.desc: Strategic Business Partner Lloyd’s Register Location: Copenhagen, Denmark What we’re looking for We are looking for a Strategic Business Partner to lead Lloyd's Register's relationship with assigned Strategic Key Accounts, protecting existing business while creating sustainable and profitable growth. You will develop tailored account strategies grounded in a deep understanding of each client's business, priorities, market and competitive environment. Acting as the Voice of the Customer within LR, you will align colleagues across our functions around the outcomes that matter most to the client. You will bring together cross-functional account teams, turn client needs into compelling solutions and value propositions, and help deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience. This is a senior, externally focused role for someone who can operate credibly at C-suite and operational levels, connect long-term strategic ambition with disciplined execution, and build trusted-adviser relationships that create lasting value for both the client and LR. What we offer you The opportunity to work for an organization that has a strong sense of purpose, is values driven and helps colleagues to develop professionally and personally through our range of people development programmes Full-time permanent position The role Develop and lead a One-LR strategy for assigned Strategic Key Accounts, based on a deep understanding of the client's business, strategy, market and competitive landscape. Build, maintain and communicate a Strategic Key Account plan, including a three-to-five-year vision, short- and medium-term objectives, clear accountabilities, KPIs and measures of success. Lead a dynamic, cross-functional Strategic Account Team, bringing together the capabilities required to deliver the account strategy and respond to changing client needs. Act as the Voice of the Customer within LR, translating explicit and emerging client needs into coordinated priorities, solutions and an exceptional customer experience. Identify, shape and lead cross-stream growth opportunities, creating bundled solutions and compelling business and financial value propositions that position LR to win. Develop commercial strategies that balance client value, retention, increased penetration, profitability and cost to serve, delivering sustainable win-win outcomes. Partner closely with the Executive Sponsor and senior commercial leaders to align objectives, remove barriers, manage risk and maintain momentum against agreed priorities. Establish a deliberate relationship strategy across executive and operational levels, strengthening decision-maker and influencer engagement while reducing single points of dependency. Use effective negotiation and solution-selling approaches to resolve conflict, secure internal alignment and achieve positive outcomes for the client and LR. Monitor account performance, client engagement, market developments and competitor activity; maintain accurate records in SFL and use insight to adapt the account strategy and actions. What you bring Demonstrable success leading major or strategic accounts, including developing account strategies and converting them into measurable client and commercial outcomes. Strong strategic and commercial judgement, with the ability to balance customer value, growth, profitability, risk and cost to serve. Credibility and confidence to engage, influence and build trusted relationships at C-suite, senior leadership and operational levels. A customer-focused mindset, with clear evidence of representing the Voice of the Customer and translating client needs into coordinated action. Experience creating business and financial value propositions and shaping solutions across multiple products, services or business areas. The ability to lead, motivate and coordinate cross-functional virtual teams without relying on direct authority. Strong analytical capability, including interpreting market, client and competitor insight and turning it into clear strategic priorities and actions. Excellent communication, influencing, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills, internally and externally. The ability to assess complex or unfamiliar situations, make timely decisions and drive issues through to resolution. Personal accountability, initiative and adaptability, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work successfully in a multicultural environment. You are someone who Is keen to take accountability and ownership for delivering customer needs Is able to self-manage and prioritize tasks towards achieving goals Is effective at solving problems, trouble-shooting and making timely decisions Is flexible and eager to take initiatives Communicates in a structured way and has ability to present technical ideas in user-friendly language Displays a team spirit, particularly in a multicultural environment Responds positively to learning opportunities and is comfortable stepping out of own comfort zone #LI-KC1 …
