items.card: Your Impact Is Measured In your first months, we'll look at: Speed to lead: how fast an inbound lead reaches the right rep and gets a first touch Call to meeting ratio: how many more meetings the team books when calls are prioritized by signals CRM data health: completeness and accuracy of the fields that matter on accounts, contacts and deals Lead to SQL conversion: how much of what enters the funnel turns into
items.desc: Position Overview Our sales & growth team is growing fast, and so is the amount of information it creates every day: accounts, calls, meetings, conversations. We want every rep to pull exactly what they need from our CRM in seconds, complete and ready to act on, and every number leadership needs to be one click away. At the same time, we sell to thousands of manufacturing and industrial companies, and the ones getting ready to rethink their procurement leave signals behind. Catching those signals early and putting them in front of the right rep at the right moment is one of the biggest growth levers we have. We're looking for a GTM Engineer to own both and far beyond. You build and run the systems behind our commercial engine: a CRM that makes information dramatically faster to find and more complete, signals that tell sales who to call today and why, and automations that give our team more time to sell. You'll work mostly with Sales, and with Marketing wherever their systems touch the pipeline. This is an engineering role with a commercial brain. You don't need to have closed deals yourself, but you need to understand why a BDR cares about a signal and what an AE wants to see before a call. Then you build the thing, ship it, and check if it moved the numbers. What You'll Own CRM Foundation and Data Model Everything else runs on this. If the data is wrong, every play built on top of it is wrong too. Commercial audit: sit down with every Account Executive and BDR to map how they actually use the CRM today, what they need from it, and where it could do much more for them A shared setup: turn those conversations into one common data model and pipeline structure, then build it into HubSpot Data quality and guardrails: raise the completeness and consistency of our data, streamline properties and objects, and add the validations and conditional logic that keep quality high as the team scales Data on demand: make sure pipeline, conversion and account data can be pulled in minutes, whether it's for a Monday pipeline review or a board deck Signals and Prioritization Most of our market isn't buying right now. Your job is to find the companies that are, before anyone else does. Signal layer: build the system that collects buying signals (website visits, LinkedIn engagement, hiring, company news, public procurement strategies - you name it) and plugs them to the right accounts and contacts in HubSpot Prioritization: turn those signals into a clear daily answer for the sales team: who to call, and why now Feedback loop: track which signals actually turn into meetings, and kill the ones that are just noise Lead Routing, Enrichment and Outreach Systems Building the proper infrastructure is critical for the actual work of growth & sales team. It’s the plumbing nobody notices until it breaks. Inbound routing: own and improve the flow that enriches inbound leads, filters them against our ICP and routes them to the right rep in minutes Enrichment: keep accounts and contacts enriched with firmographic and contact data, using Clay or whatever does the job best Outreach tooling: own the stack the sales team uses to reach prospects (dialer, sequencing, LinkedIn tools) and be the first call when something stops working Automation: spot the repetitive tasks eating into selling time and automate them with n8n, agents, or whatever gets it done Pipeline Systems for Demand Gen Not ads, not content. The systems that connect what Marketing does to what ends up in the pipeline. Account based plays: build audiences and hyper personalized campaigns based on our best accounts and the patterns in the CRM Marketing to Sales handoff: make sure every lead Marketing generates lands in Sales with the context needed to act on it Lifecycle sequences: support Marketing in building and running HubSpot lifecycle workflows that follow up with prospects through rules, delays and touchpoints across email, WhatsApp and other channels Attribution basics: help us understand which sources and campaigns actually create or influence pipeline Experimentation and AI Building Nothing here is sacred. If it doesn't move the numbers, it changes. Ship fast: prototype with Claude Code, Lovable, n8n and Clay, test with the team, and scale what works Agents in the workflow: build AI agents that take over GTM work once done by hand, from account research to qualification to follow up drafting Never stop exploring: you're compulsively checking Product Hunt, listening to GTM Engineering podcasts and getting your hands on new tools before they go mainstream, then bringing in what's worth trying and skipping what's hype How Your Impact Is Measured In your first months, we'll look at: Speed to lead: how fast an inbound lead reaches the right rep and gets a first touch Call to meeting ratio: how many more meetings the team books when calls are prioritized by signals CRM data health: completeness and accuracy of the fields that matter on accounts, contacts and deals Lead to SQL …

items.desc: Junior Fullstack Developer (Python & Angular) ABOUT THE JOB Join our high-impact AI team within BNP Paribas’s Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) division, where we develop and scale a cutting-edge software platform powering the entire corporate credit chain - from origination to monitoring. Used by thousands of employees across 50+ countries since 2019, our platform is a critical backbone for global credit operations. Depending on your interests and learning path, you will be matched with one of our key projects: AI & Automation Engine: Gain hands-on experience with the frontier of technology, including NLP and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to power our MyCreditApp, and assist in building our internal AI agent. (Branch in Poland), a part of BNP Paribas Group with 200 years of experience in banking. Since 2008, we are at the heart of Warsaw, and now we are also in Krakow. As Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB), we offer financial solutions for corporate and institutional clients in a number of locations globally. Our Securities Services business line is a multi-asset servicing specialist. We are an exciting, dynamic, and growing operations centre; therefore, we are looking for candidates who are willing to be a vital part of the expansion of BNP Paribas’ operational scope in Poland. It’s our values that drive us forward and are a cornerstone of our business. We rely on our strengths, which include stability, responsibility, expertise, and being a good place to work. items.desc: Intuition Machines uses AI/ML to build enterprise security products. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration. As a Senior Cybersecurity Fraud Analyst, you will use your expertise in data analysis, financial transactions, and web traffic analysis to identify and investigate potential fraudulent activities within our hCaptcha SaaS security platform. Your primary responsibilities will include conducting advanced investigations into complex fraud patterns, developing actionable insights to enhance our fraud detection capabilities, and collaborating with machine learning teams to continuously improve our AI/ML detection and response systems. Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines. What will you do: Monitor, identify, and analyze events from diverse data sources, including financial transactions and web traffic, to detect and respond to fraudulent activities. Conduct advanced investigations of suspected fraud, analyzing behavior patterns and anomalies to assess risk and determine appropriate actions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Product, Customer Support, to enhance fraud detection and prevention strategies. Help build and align fraud detection automation, dashboards, and reports. Continuously audit and refine fraud detection measures to ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices. Stay informed of emerging fraud trends, technologies, and regulatory changes to keep our fraud prevention strategies up-to-date. What we are looking for: Minimum of 3 years of experience in fraud detection, financial data analysis, risk management, or trust & safety. Proficiency in SQL and ideally Python for data analysis and visualization. In-depth understanding of fraud detection methodologies and the fraud landscape. Ability to work with large datasets and derive actionable insights. Excellent problem-solving skills, with a detail-oriented and analytical mindset. Strong communication and collaboration skills in English, able to work effectively across teams. Familiarity with the analysis of web-based and API abuse. Nice to Have: Hands-on experience with web security and secure configuration practices. Interest in staying current with industry trends and fraud prevention technologies. Familiarity with modern fraud machine learning practices. Holding a valid CFE, CFS, CFF, or CISA certification is a plus. What do we offer: Fully remote position with flexible working hours. An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world. Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often. High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting-edge R&D. Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams. We celebrate equality of opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. Join us as we transform cybersecurity, user privacy, and machine learning online! Please note that all positions require pre-employment screening, including third-party verification of work history, education, and identity, as well as a final in-person interview and identity verification step, which will be conducted in your country of residence.

items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As an RF Engineer (GNSS) in the Hardware (Electronics) team, you will own the radionavigation architecture of our products. Our systems need high-precision navigation and robust connectivity in contested, complex environments, and you will be the expert responsible for the RF subsystems, from antenna design to integration and compliance. You will design custom GNSS antennas and receiver modules, extend them towards CRPAs for GNSS-denied operations, and see each design through simulation, lab validation and flight tests. Based in Lausanne, Switzerland. Responsibilities Antenna Design: Design custom GNSS antennas and receiver modules for our products, and extend the work towards CRPAs (Controlled Reception Pattern Antennas) for GNSS-denied environments. Antenna Integration: Integrate all antennas (GNSS, radio link) into the drones, validating through simulation (gain diagrams) and real-life lab and flight testing. GNSS Test Bench: Develop, maintain and configure the GNSS test bench to simulate satellite constellations and interference scenarios. RF Measurement: Run hands-on characterization with network and spectrum analyzers, and simulate new antenna iterations with EM software. Electromagnetic Compatibility: Lead EMC troubleshooting and pre-compliance testing, identifying and removing blockers early. PCB Collaboration: Work with PCB designers to review routing, shielding and RF layout. Architecture Ownership: Review and own the RF architecture across product lines, including link budgets and system-level RF performance. Mentoring: Act as the team's RF subject matter expert, coaching junior engineers on RF layout principles and EMC mitigation. Candidate Requirements Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field. Experience: Proven track record taking complex wireless devices from concept to mass production, including clearing strict EMC compliance hurdles. Background in aerospace, commercial drones or GNSS products is a strong advantage. GNSS: Solid grounding in GNSS, including hands-on use of a GNSS test bench to simulate edge-case environments, and an understanding of effects such as multipath. Antenna Design: Experience designing custom antennas under tight mechanical and space constraints, with EM simulation tools. RF & EMC: Strong command of RF fundamentals and measurement equipment (network and spectrum analyzers); comfortable working in an anechoic chamber. Mindset: Analytical, meticulous, structured and resilient; a hands-on problem-solver who works autonomously and collaborates well. Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of leading diverse principals, from junior members to senior executives. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc: You'll be joining an e-commerce company as a Founding AI Engineer , building and scaling AI-powered solutions that transform online retail. Working closely with the founders, you'll develop LLM-powered applications, AI agents, and intelligent automation tools to optimise product data management and streamline commercial operations. Responsibilities Build AI solutions end to end: Design, develop, deploy, and maintain production-ready AI applications for e-commerce. Develop generative AI applications: Build LLM-powered tools, RAG systems, NLP solutions, and intelligent agents. Automate commerce workflows: Apply AI to product information management, customer support, product discovery, and operational processes. Shape technical direction: Define the AI architecture, technology stack, and engineering best practices. Drive innovation: Identify opportunities to improve customer journeys, personalise shopping experiences, and optimise business performance. Your Profile 2–5 years of experience in AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field. Strong Python programming skills and software engineering fundamentals. End-to-end responsibility: Build AI solutions from initial concept through production deployment. High-impact projects: Develop innovative AI applications that transform e-commerce operations and customer experiences. Hybrid working: Flexible working model with an office base in Mechelen. Competitive compensation: Salary and benefits aligned with experience and responsibilities. Career growth: Opportunity to build and lead the AI engineering function as the company scales. Interested? Apply with your CV and a short introduction to ryan.martin@vividresourcing.com

Per questo scegliamo un settore, studiamo il mercato e capiamo i problemi reali, e solo dopo costruiamo il software che li risolve. We operate in 41 countries, with 54 R&D centers and multiple production sites worldwide. We are driven by a strong commitment to innovation, sustainability and the development of creative and technological solutions that deliver real value to our customers. 👉 To learn more, visit our website: MANE Flavor & Fragrance Manufacturer | MANE Role Mission: As a Senior AI/ML Engineer , you will be a key technical contributor responsible for developing and deploying complex AI initiatives. You will focus on the end-to-end lifecycle of ML solutions—from technical design and coding to production deployment and continuous optimization. This is a high-impact technical role where you will apply deep engineering rigor to build scalable, reliable systems that solve real-world R&D challenges. You don’t just build models; you ensure they are integrated into robust software architectures that meet the highest standards of performance and reliability. Key Responsabilities: Technical Implementation: Contribute to the design and development of scalable, maintainable AI solutions aligned with modern best practices. Hands-on Development: Deliver high-quality code for data, modeling, and deployment pipelines, leading the team through engineering rigor. MLOps Mastery: Implement and maintain robust MLOps workflows, focusing on automated CI/CD, containerization, and model observability. Agile Delivery: Work within an Agile framework to ensure research translates into predictable production value, meeting project milestones and deadlines. Business Advisory: Partner with technical and business stakeholders to translate business challenges into technical requirements and provide clear project updates.Ensure compliance with data privacy, security and ethical AI guidelines, in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. Profile Required: Experience: More than 5 years of experience in IT or Engineering, including significant hands-on experience in AI/ML and technical leadership. Education: Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related field. Technical Excellence: Advanced proficiency in Python and strong knowledge of AI/ML algorithms, architectures, and data engineering best practices. MLOps & Cloud: Hands-on experience with Azure ML or Databricks, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and monitoring of AI systems in production. Collaboration & Communication: Experience working in Agile teams and the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Languages: Full professional proficiency in English; French is a strong plus. Industry Experience (Preferred): Exposure to formulation, chemistry, or the fragrance & flavor industry. Our Values and Ethical Commitment: At MANE , we act with a strong ethical and responsible approach, guided by the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. We are firmly committed to the well-being of people, promoting inclusive work environments, equal opportunities and collaboration across generations . We actively work to drive sustainability and contribute to the development of the communities in which we operate. This commitment is an essential part of our culture and guides our decisions as a company at a global level.

items.desc: Rejoindre Davidson, ce n’est pas seulement intégrer un groupe de 3000 consultants dans 6 pays et 2 continents, c’est intégrer LA société qui a été élue par ses salariés Great Place To Work France et Europe pendant 4 ans mais aussi une des plus grandes B Corp de France, nommée Best of the World dans la catégorie “collaborateurs” en 2022 ! (Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde). Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts : Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté. Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme. Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone… Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous… Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques. Profil / Mission L’IA Engineer / Développeur est responsable de la conception, du développement et de l’industrialisation de solutions d’intelligence artificielle, avec un accent sur l’IA générative (GenAI) et les cas d’usage enterprise (assistants, RAG, automatisation, analyse de documents, etc.). Ses Principales Missions Incluent Le choix, la mise en œuvre et l’optimisation de modèles d’IA (LLM, modèles de vision, embeddings, etc.) en fonction des cas d’usage et des contraintes (coût, latence, confidentialité, conformité) La conception et l’optimisation d’architectures RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) : ingestion, chunking, embeddings, bases vectorielles, stratégies de retrieval, évaluation de la qualité des réponses La gestion des pipelines de données : collecte, nettoyage, transformation, enrichment, versioning et gouvernance des données utilisées pour l’IA L’ingénierie de prompts et l’orchestration de flux d’IA (multi-agents, tool calling, function calling, guardrails, filtrage, modération) L’intégration de l’IA dans les applications et SI existants (APIs, microservices, événements, interfaces utilisateurs) La contribution au déploiement de solutions IA dans des environnements cloud sécurisés (AWS, Azure, GCP), avec une attention particulière à la sécurité, la confidentialité et la conformité (RGPD, politiques internes) La mise en place de pratiques MLOps / LLMOps : monitoring des modèles et des prompts, gestion des versions, tests, re-training / fine-tuning, gestion des coûts et de la performance La collaboration avec les équipes métier, data, produit et sécurité pour transformer des besoins business en solutions IA robustes et mesurables Compétences requises ou à acquérir Maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit et oral) Maîtrise du français ou du néerlandais Expérience confirmée en développement : Python (obligatoire), et/ou SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, .NET Expérience confirmée en data engineering : préparation de données, pipelines (batch/streaming), nettoyage, ingestion, qualité des données Expérience confirmée dans la mise en œuvre, la configuration et le test de modèles d’IA : LLM (open source et/ou providers cloud), NLP, embeddings, RAG, fine-tuning / instruction tuning Expérience confirmée en MLOps / LLMOps : monitoring, évaluation, versioning de modèles et de prompts, gestion des coûts, CI/CD pour l’IA Expérience confirmée en architectures RAG : bases vectorielles (Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone, pgvector, etc.), frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, Semantic Kernel, etc.) Expérience en CI/CD et automatisation (Dev / Data / IA) : GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc. About The Company Company Холдинг Т1 Т1 — это стабильный и надёжный работодатель. Мы помогаем профессионально расти и решать действительно интересные задачи, создаём атмосферу открытости и комфортные условия для работы в гибридном формате. В Т1 можно выбрать любое ИТ-направление и построить свою траекторию развития. В состав Т1 входят: Т1 Иннотех, Т1 ИИ, Т1 Интеграция, Т1 Облако, Т1 Сервионика, Т1 Цифровая Академия, НОТА от Т1. Мы стремительно растём, масштабируемся и ищем новых специалистов в команду! Responsibilities Мы занимаемся развитием и сопровождением продуктов на основе больших данныхи ИИ, разработкой платформ хранения информации, а также построением аналитических и рекомендательных систем для крупного бизнеса. Наши продуктыи услуги решают задачи цифровой трансформации в компаниях и организациях: Чем предстоит заниматься: Разработкой и поддержкой backend-сервисов на Python для интеграции AI-агентов и RAG-систем. Реализацией агентных пайплайнов на базе LangChain / LangGraph: проектирование многошаговых сценариев, управление состоянием, вызов инструментов. Интеграцией LLM в бизнес-процессы: prompt engineering, structured output, function calling, обработка ошибок. Работа с корпоративными данными: построение RAG-систем (документы, метрики, BI-контекст); генерация и валидация SQL-запросов на основе метаданных; взаимодействие с аналитическими СУБД (ClickHouse, PostgreSQL). Подготовкой решений к внедрению: участие в адаптации архитектуры под клиентскую инфраструктуру, настройка CI/CD, документирование контрактов и требований к окружению. Участие в создании технических демо: подготовка рабочих примеров, запись кратких видеопрезентаций, визуализация логики работы системы. Requirements Какой опыт для нас важен: Опыт коммерческой разработки на Python от 3 лет, уверенные навыки работы с FastAPI или аналогами. Практический опыт с LangChain / LangGraph / LlamaIndex и LLM API (prompt engineering, function calling, structured output). Уверенное знание SQL: написание сложных запросов, понимание планов выполнения, работа с аналитическими БД (ClickHouse, PostgreSQL и пр.). Базовое понимание принципов проектирования микросервисов, опыт работы с Docker, участие в настройке CI/CD. Аналитическое мышление: умение переводить бизнес-требования в технические решения, понимание логики BI-систем. Будет плюсом: Опыт быстрого прототипирования UI для демо (Streamlit, Gradio, простой React/Next.js) Навыки визуализации данных и процессов (например, отображение chain-of-thought, SQL-логики, графиков). Знание Airflow, Spark или других инструментов data engineering. Опыт в предметных областях: retail, CIB, risk, compliance. Понимание XAI, feature importance, интерпретируемости моделей. Over the last 23 years, RedCompass Labs has delivered 500+ projects across the world’s major payments schemes and platforms, including ISO 20022, SEPA, Swift, the Real-time Payments Network, and FedNow, ISO 20022 migrations, and FIS OPF, Finastra GPP, and ACI Worldwide. Trained on decades of deep payments expertise and more than 30,000 curated documents, the agent is certified to SOC 2 Type II. RedCompass Labs supports clients from offices in London, Warsaw, Brussels, Miami, Boston, Toronto, and Pune. For more information, visit www.redcompasslabs.com. Mission: Imagine reducing a 14-day financial analysis task to just 2 hours. At RedCompass Labs, we don't just imagine-we've built it. We're transforming the trillion-dollar payments industry through intelligent automation. At the heart of our mission is AnalystAccelerator.ai, our proprietary multi-agent AI platform built to accelerate complex analysis in global banking and compliance. We’re seeking exceptional AI Engineers to join our foundational AI Engineering team. Your role: transform cutting-edge research and prototypes into robust, production-ready AI solutions. You'll tackle sophisticated challenges within a regulated, high-stakes environment, developing scalable AI that augments human expertise. As an AI Engineer, you would: You will take proven concepts from research and turn them into production-grade, client-facing AI solutions: Design, build, and scale sophisticated multi-agent workflows that automate complex financial analysis. Engineer robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines leveraging financial rulebooks, regulatory documentation, and client knowledge bases. Develop secure, scalable backend services and APIs (primarily Python/FastAPI) deployed in Azure cloud environments. Implement and enhance MLOps and DevOps practices , using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps pipelines, Docker containers, and Kubernetes orchestration. Collaborate closely with product managers, domain experts, and UX designers, converting complex business requirements into clear, impactful features. Candidate Profile : We’re seeking product-centric engineers who thrive on complex challenges, rapidly acquiring new technical skills, and delivering impactful AI solutions . 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with proven expertise developing and deploying production-grade systems. Experience in modern AI , agentic software development, and use of LLMs . Strong proficiency in either Python/Typescript . Understanding in embedding models, retrieval-based AI architectures (RAG) , and vector databases. Familiarity with cloud-native software development, containerization and orchestration technologies. Commitment to learning and leveraging new technologies and AI tools rapidly and effectively. A ‘t-shaped’ engineering mindset, and a willingness to stretch into tasks such as automation testing, devops, data engineering when the work needs it. Bonus Qualifications: Previous experience with multi-agent systems or complex workflow automation. Background in fintech, banking, payments, or compliance industries. Experience with high-performance API frameworks (FastAPI). Our Technology Ecosystem: Core AI & LLMs: Python, LLM frameworks such as Autogen , LangChain , Pydantic-AI , etc. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and MCP servers. items.desc: Experienced Data & AI Ethics Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Consultant/Senior Consultant – Esperto/a di Intelligenza Artificiale da inserire nel team Data & AI Ethics di Deloitte, all’interno della divisione Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, con sede a Milano o Roma, che lavorerà in modalità hybrid. Il ruolo è ideale per professionisti con una solida preparazione tecnica in ambito Data Science, Machine Learning o ingegneria dell’Intelligenza Artificiale, unita a una buona conoscenza degli aspetti etici, sociali e di governance legati all’utilizzo dell’IA e dei dati. Il nostro team collabora con organizzazioni nazionali e internazionali per promuovere un’adozione responsabile dell’intelligenza artificiale e dei dati, supportare la progettazione e l’implementazione di modelli di governance per garantire pratiche etiche nell’utilizzo dell’IA e dei dati, nonché condurre valutazioni d’impatto e affiancare i clienti nell’allineamento delle proprie strategie di IA alle normative internazionali, come l’EU AI Act, e agli standard etici di riferimento. Your Role Consulenza in materia di IA responsabile e governance dei dati: supportare i clienti nella traduzione dei requisiti normativi ed etici in processi, strategie e procedure operative di natura tecnica e organizzativa. Valutazione dei rischi e analisi d’impatto: individuare e mitigare i rischi etici e sociali associati all’utilizzo dell’IA e dei dati, adottando prospettive tecniche, sociali e incentrate sulla persona Gestione di progetti di etica dell’IA e dei dati: realizzare progetti per importanti clienti nazionali e internazionali, operanti in diversi settori industriali e nella pubblica amministrazione. Progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni tecniche per la verifica dell’affidabilità dell’IA: sviluppare e migliorare strumenti per la valutazione dell’equità e l’individuazione dei bias, procedure di valutazione della sicurezza dei modelli linguistici di grandi dimensioni (LLM) e framework per i test di sicurezza. Sviluppo di metodologie di red teaming: definire metodologie per testare modelli di IA generativa e predittiva, nonché sviluppare strumenti per valutarne la robustezza, l’affidabilità e le prestazioni. Sviluppo di strumenti di monitoraggio e governance: realizzare strumenti automatizzati di monitoraggio e dashboard per la governance dei modelli, a supporto del controllo e della supervisione continuativi dei sistemi di IA. As an Advanced Packaging Materials Engineer based in the EU, you'll serve as the critical link between our European and North American materials science operations—driving paper-based materials development tailored to the EU supplier base while harmonizing global materials strategies across regions. Embedded alongside our automation hardware development teams, you'll ensure that packaging materials and automation systems are co-developed for seamless integration. This is a hands-on, technically broad role spanning pulp and paper manufacturing, packaging converting operations, paper-based materials for manual and automatic packaging, and packaging automation equipment. You'll conduct laboratory research, characterize materials properties, establish specifications, and work directly with EU-based suppliers to bring novel materials from concept to production—while serving as the conduit to align materials globally, simplify where possible, and solve for region-specific requirements driven by regulation, material supply availability, and operational differences. Key job responsibilities Materials Development & Innovation Lead laboratory research and development of paper-based packaging materials for manual and automatic packaging, with deep understanding of pulp and paper manufacturing processes and converting operations. Design and execute experiments to optimize material formulations and processing parameters, applying the materials science triangle framework (processing-structure-properties) across the full range of paper-based packaging materials and converting processes. Develop next-generation materials solutions that unlock step-change improvements in performance, cost, sustainability, and automation compatibility—with specific focus on EU supplier capabilities and regional material availability. Advance materials innovations from concept, pilot, and deployment phases, ensuring solutions are compatible with EU packaging automation hardware and converting equipment. Evaluate and develop paper-based material systems that meet the unique performance demands of automated packaging lines, considering substrate interactions, machine speed requirements, and environmental conditions. Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the EU supplier base—including paper mills, converters, and coating suppliers—and how it differs from the North American supply landscape. Identify region-specific materials requirements dictated by EU regulations (e.g., REACH, EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation, CEFLEX), regional material supply constraints, and operational differences in EU fulfillment networks. Balance global standardization with regional customization—driving simplification where materials can be harmonized and developing tailored solutions where regional requirements demand differentiation. Build and maintain a materials roadmap for EU that aligns with global GSP strategy and EU automation hardware development timelines. Automation Hardware Integration Work closely with EU-based automation hardware development teams to ensure paper-based packaging materials are co-developed with automation equipment, optimizing for machine runnability, reliability, and throughput. Provide materials expertise during automation system design, commissioning, and optimization—translating materials properties into actionable equipment parameters. Develop deep understanding of packaging converting equipment (folders, gluers, sealers, labelers) and how paper-based materials properties influence machine performance at production speeds. Support troubleshooting of materials-related automation failures, conducting root cause analysis that spans materials properties, converting conditions, and equipment settings. Design and execute test plans that validate materials performance against specifications and requirements for both manual and automated packaging operations. Analyze test data using statistical methods to drive data-driven materials selection decisions across the EU supplier base. items.desc: Czym będziesz się zajmować? Role summary: Own quality on the two hardest surfaces of a production AI coaching platform: the LLM agents that answer differently every run, and the API layer everything else depends on. As AI & Backend QA Engineer you own the quality of what the model says and what the APIs return. On the AI side that means building the evaluation practice: golden sets, quality metrics, and regression detection that catch a degraded answer before a user does. On the backend side it means API test suites and consumer-driven contract testing with Pact — agreed with the client's US engineering team as a standing requirement for this role, not an optional technique. The defining skill is localization: when an answer is wrong, you can tell whether the problem sits in the model, in the service code, or in the input data — and you bring the evidence, not a guess. What you'll be testing: AI core — a Python service with LangGraph agents producing streaming, non-deterministic coaching responses; this role's primary surface Backend APIs — a NestJS REST gateway behind Auth0, plus the services behind it Mobile app — React Native, shipping to iOS and Android app stores; AI features surface directly in the app that members use Kogo poszukujemy? Must-have skills: 3+ years in technical QA/test automation, incl. API testing on production Python — writing/maintaining tests, pytest, fixtures HTTP/API fundamentals — REST, JSON, status codes, headers, auth tokens Contract testing with Pact — consumer-driven contracts (hard requirement) Security-aware API testing — auth boundaries, token handling, malformed/hostile input Comfort with non-determinism — assert on properties/contracts, not exact output LLM evaluation — datasets/golden sets, response metrics, detect regressions across prompts/models Prompt engineering — modify prompts and measure effects; aware of hallucinations and prompt injection Backend savvy — HTTP/REST, JSON, tokens, logs, DB queries; isolate model vs service vs input issues Postman and Swagger/OpenAPI daily Git in team workflow — branches, PRs, reviews TestRail for test-case management and runs Mobile product context (Android/iOS) — testing app features, release timing, store builds Nice-to-haves: Langfuse or equivalent (LangSmith, Phoenix) — traces and attached evaluations LangGraph — test agents as state graphs (single node and full flow) CI/CD — run evaluations in pipelines and quality gates on PRs Python with Appium — mobile automation exposure alongside API work Czego wymagamy? 5 lat doświadczenia na podobnym stanowisku Znajomości: Python REST Zendesk Security testing LLM Inżynieria promptów Mile widziane: Postman OpenAPI Git TestRail Mobile applications testing Logs and tracing Języki: Polski Angielski Langfuse (mile widziane) Jakie warunki i benefity otrzymasz? 25.2k–28.6k PLN netto/m (B2B) B2B - Overlap with US Mountain Time afternoons (~14:00–18:00 PL time) (100%) Praca zdalna: W całości Pakiet medyczny, Pakiet sportowy Kim jesteśmy? apreel został założony w kwietniu 2010 roku przez przyjaciół, których marzeniem było stworzenie własnego software house'u. Wraz z rozwojem firmy i jednocześnie wzrostem zaufania klientów, rozszerzyła swoją działalność o usługi takie jak leasing ekspertów IT. Dziś ten obszar stanowi główny filar działalności apreel. Nie oznacza to jednak, że założyciele apreela porzucili swoje marzenia. Naszą pasją zawsze będzie tworzenie autorskich rozwiązań informatycznych, a celem, do którego dążymy, jest ciągłe ich doskonalenie. W połączeniu z wyjątkową atmosferą i profesjonalizmem stworzyliśmy w apreelu wyjątkowy klimat. Zapraszamy do aplikowania, jeżeli zależy Ci na pracy wśród dobrych specjalistów, w stabilnych organizacjach oraz z jasnymi warunkami finansowania.

You work directly with the people whose problems you're solving. Own the full development cycle: experiment fast, build properly, deploy, monitor, improve and scale. Work with Agents, plain LLMs, code, Databricks and whatever the right tools is for the job. items.desc: 🚀 ¡Únete a RocaSalvatella como AI Developer! RocaSalvatella somos una consultora de referencia en transformación digital, innovación y negocio . Acompañamos a grandes organizaciones en su adaptación al entorno digital, combinando estrategia, tecnología y talento para generar impacto real y sostenible. Creemos en la cocreación con el cliente, la agilidad y la orientación a resultados. Diseñamos e implementamos soluciones que transforman la manera en que las organizaciones trabajan, innovan y crecen. Buscamos a un/a AI Developer para integrarse en nuestro equipo de AI Solutions. Tu misión será diseñar y llevar a producción soluciones de IA para clientes corporativos, con autonomía sobre todo el delivery técnico: desde la arquitectura hasta el despliegue. ¿Cuál será tu rol en el día a día? Trabajarás mano a mano con el equipo de AI Solutions en las siguientes funciones: Construir soluciones de IA end-to-end: agentes conversacionales, sistemas RAG, clasificadores y extractores de información integrados con los sistemas del cliente (ERP, CRM, SAP). Decidir la arquitectura: elegir el stack, diseñar pipelines y definir patrones de integración en los proyectos que lideres. Llevar las soluciones a producción: contenedores, entornos cloud, monitorización y mantenimiento. Automatizar con agentes y workflows: n8n, LangGraph, Copilot Studio o Power Automate sobre M365, según el contexto de cada cliente. Elevar el nivel técnico del equipo: revisar y orientar el trabajo de developers junior y definir estándares, patrones reutilizables y buenas prácticas. ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Al menos 3 años desarrollando soluciones de IA o datos, con responsabilidad directa sobre entregables en producción. Python sólido: desarrollo de aplicaciones, gestión de dependencias, testing y buenas prácticas. Experiencia demostrable construyendo sistemas RAG y agentes con LangChain, LangGraph u otros frameworks. Dominio de APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic u otras): prompting avanzado, gestión de contexto y optimización de costes. Experiencia desplegando en producción (Docker, AWS o Azure, CI/CD) e integrando con sistemas corporativos vía APIs REST y bases de datos relacionales. Castellano fluido, y nivel alto de inglés. ✨ Valoraremos positivamente si has trabajado en consultoría con exposición directa a cliente. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Flexibilidad horaria y trabajo híbrido. Plan de retribución flexible con Payflow. Formar parte de un equipo dinámico, multidisciplinar y con un clima basado en la confianza, la autonomía responsable y la colaboración. Participar en proyectos estratégicos para clientes referentes a nivel nacional e internacional. En RocaSalvatella apostamos firmemente por la diversidad, la inclusión y la igualdad de oportunidades, creando un entorno donde todas las personas puedan desarrollarse y aportar su mejor versión.

items.desc: Software development verschuift steeds meer naar systemen die zelfstandig beslissingen kunnen nemen en workflows autonoom kunnen uitvoeren. In plaats van alleen vaste logica te bouwen, ontwerpen engineers steeds vaker software die AI gebruikt om taken te plannen, tools aan te sturen en processen van begin tot eind te automatiseren. Het doel van deze junior functie is om je in korte tijd goed voor te bereiden op het bouwen van dit soort agentische AI-systemen en direct impact te maken bij klanten. Als Junior Agentic AI Engineer bij Itility begin je met een intern programma van ongeveer drie maanden waarin je de technische en consultancyvaardigheden leert die je nodig hebt om als AI-engineer het verschil te maken. Tijdens dit programma leer je door te doen via interne consultancyprojecten, waarbij je bijvoorbeeld werkt aan multi-agentsystemen en AI-oplossingen die processen kunnen ondersteunen en automatiseren. Dit doe je samen met Junior Data Engineers, zodat je vanaf het begin leert hoe betrouwbare data, generatieve AI en agentische applicaties samenkomen in moderne softwareoplossingen. Daarbij doe je ervaring op met verschillende technologieën, teams en klantscenario's. Na ongeveer drie maanden ga je aan de slag in een projectteam bij een klant, waar je jouw vaardigheden direct in de praktijk brengt en door blijft leren. Je draagt bij aan het ontwikkelen van softwareoplossingen voor grote klanten, waarbij AI wordt geïntegreerd in operationele workflows. Samen met je team bouw je agentische applicaties die aansluiten op bestaande systemen, data verwerken en bedrijfsprocessen van onze klanten automatiseren. Wat ga je leren? Tijdens het programma ontwikkel je zowel hands-on engineeringvaardigheden als consultancyvaardigheden die nodig zijn voor moderne softwareontwikkeling met (agentic) AI in een consultancyomgeving. Je leert onder andere: Het opzetten van een professionele ontwikkelomgeving (Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD-pipelines); Het ontwerpen, bouwen en testen van softwareapplicaties; Het ontwikkelen van API’s en toolintegraties; Het ontwerpen en implementeren van agentische AI-workflows; Werken met agentische AI-frameworks zoals LangChain en Deep Agents; Werken met RAG-systemen en vectordatabases; Het implementeren van korte- en langetermijngeheugenconcepten in AI-agents; Het uitrollen van applicaties naar Azure Cloud/AWS Cloud; Het toepassen van security best practices in software- en AI-systemen. Dit is wat we je bieden Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om je op de beste manier te ontwikkelen, onder persoonlijke begeleiding van de rest van het team. Daar hoort het volgende bij: €3.100 bruto maandsalaris; €115 onkostenvergoeding; Keuze uit een mobiliteitsvergoeding van €450 + kilometervergoeding of een leaseauto + tankpas; Bonus gebaseerd op jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en gezamenlijke successen; Twee keer per jaar doorgroeimogelijkheden in salaris; 50% bijdrage aan de zorgverzekering; 60% bijdrage aan het pensioen; 26 vakantiedagen; Hybride werken na het intern programma; Toegang tot de Itility Academy (technische trainingen en soft skills-trainingen); Laptop en mobiele telefoon; Gebruik van de Itility gym op kantoor. Wie ben jij? Je bent een recent afgestudeerde of junior professional met een achtergrond in software engineering en een sterke interesse in AI-gedreven systemen. Je vindt het leuk om software te bouwen en wil leren hoe AI kan worden ingezet als onderdeel van modern systeemontwerp. Daarnaast breng je mee: Een bachelor- of masterdiploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, ICT, Artificial Intelligence of een vergelijkbare richting; Ervaring met softwareontwikkeling in talen zoals Python, JavaScript of C#; Een sterke interesse in het bouwen van schaalbare softwaresystemen; De bereidheid en enthousiasme om te leren en te werken in een snel veranderende technische omgeving; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels en Nederlands; Een mindset die gericht is op continu leren en verbeteren. Pré: ervaring met Generative AI en het werken aan AI-projecten, bijvoorbeeld met LLM’s, AI-agents, RAG-systemen of AI-automatisering. Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen? Solliciteer gerust! We kijken naar impact en groeipotentieel. Wanneer start je? 1 februari 2027 Screening maakt deel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure. items.desc: The Impact You'll Make AI agents are moving from demos into everyday work, and we want every team at Danfoss to be able to use them. You'll build the tools, integrations and templates that let engineers, product teams and domain experts create useful AI agents. Those people should be able to do this without being AI specialists themselves. We're looking for a strong engineer who loves connecting systems and building tools other people rely on, and who is already curious about LLMs and AI agentic development with some experience even if not production ready. Alongside experienced engineers you'll integrate AI into our tools and services bring them to production level components. What You’ll Be Doing Build integrations that let AI agents work with our platform services, using APIs, MCP servers and whatever patterns turn out to work best. items.desc: About Oper Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency. The fastest growing part of our business is Herman , our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment. A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. Oper currently has offices in Zürich, Switzerland, and Antwerp, Belgium. Now, we're looking for an AI Solutions Engineer to join our AI Squad and help shape the future of automated mortgages in Europe and beyond. Your Mission You'll join the AI Squad , the team building Herman. This is a hands-on, hybrid role spanning AI engineering, product management, and solutions architecture . You'll scope and build working AI prototypes, take them in front of real banks to pressure-test against live mortgage workflows, and work alongside the team to turn these into working Herman features. You own delivery end-to-end: from a rough use case to a shipped capability, communicating progress clearly the whole way. This is an applied role, not a research one. We want a builder who can both code and collaborate, who is comfortable in front of a client in the morning and deep in a codebase in the afternoon. Tasks What you'll do Scope and build working AI prototypes - LLMs, RAG, agentic automation, and integrations - that solve concrete origination problems. Engage directly with clients : run workshops, gather requirements, demo, and iteratively refine solutions against the real workflows of regulated banks. Define and manage AI use cases , structuring them functionally so they can scale beyond a single client. Work closely within your team to turn validated prototypes into production features. Own delivery timelines and communicate progress clearly to both clients and internal stakeholders. Work AI-native Building agentic software is the job, and we expect you to build the way you ship: AI-first. Write code AI-first: agents produce the bulk of your code under your direction, while you own the architecture, integrations, review, and quality. We measure your output in shipped value, not hand-typed lines. Build agentic workflows that do real work: scaffolding prototypes and integrations from a spec, generating and running tests, drafting evaluation harnesses, and reviewing diffs. Use modern AI tooling as the default way you build, configure, and debug, not as an occasional helper. Aim for a delivery cadence a non-AI-native engineer simply cannot match, and help us raise the bar on what an AI-native delivery function looks like at Oper. Requirements What you'll bring 4 to 6 years of experience in software development, with hands-on AI/LLM work. Strong with Python and modern AI tooling: LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, orchestration, and evaluation . Able to structure projects functionally and own delivery end-to-end , from scoping to shipped feature. Comfortable being client-facing : running workshops, gathering requirements, and translating ambiguity into working software. Comfortable working with flexible and loosely defined requirements, bringing your own structure where needed. Genuinely AI-native : agents already write most of your code and you build agentic workflows to multiply your output. You can name the tools, the workflows, and the concrete recent projects where AI gave you real leverage. Excellent communication skills. Creative and analytical mindset. Ambition to learn, experiment, and grow while staying humble and open-minded. Fluency in English; additional languages (e.g. Dutch, German) are a plus. Experience in a relevant industry (financial services) and thriving in a scale-up environment are a plus. This is an applied, client-facing, cross-functional role. We are not looking for researchers, "idea people," or internal-only engineers. Location & Setup Belgium-based candidates: hybrid setup with 2 to 3 days per week in our Antwerp office Working in CET hours Reporting to the CTO Close collaboration with the AI Squad, Product, and client-facing teams Benefits As a fast-growing fintech, we're building a team where you can truly make an impact. You’ll partner with the Head of Business Transformation and VP of Operations, to turn complex internal processes into intelligent, user‑friendly experiences that help teams
items.desc: Elliptic is building AI-powered tools that enable the business to scale faster and with greater confidence. Our operations team is at the centre of that work — designing the backend systems and AI integrations behind Elliptic's agentic transformation. This transformation is all about rethinking existing business processes – from workflows to ticket queues to decisions – and enabling our workforce to take the next great leap forward in productivity. We're looking for a full-stack Agent Engineer to help us design and build agent fleets, AI integrations, APIs, workflows, UIs and services that make this possible. The Impact You Will Have As Agent Engineer on the Operations team, you will help design and deliver scalable, reliable services that power Elliptic’s internal business systems, focusing on building our agent fleets to automate core business processes. You’ll partner with the Head of Business Transformation and VP of Operations, to turn complex internal processes into intelligent, user‑friendly experiences that help teams around the business perform their jobs with greater speed and confidence. Your work will make a tangible and immediate impact on team productivity, and you will work iteratively directly with your users to forge solutions that meet their needs. Working collaboratively across disciplines, you’ll contribute to impactful features and continuously improve quality, reliability, and usability across our internal platforms. Through this work, you’ll play an essential role in advancing Elliptic’s mission to make crypto markets safer, more transparent, and more efficient. What You Will Do Lead the development of agent fleets to model complex business processes in Langchain. Develop APIs and workflows that integrate AI and LLM frameworks with business systems. Design, optimise, and query data models across relational and NoSQL databases. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver an agentic platform from concept through to production. Take part in technical design reviews, planning sessions, and code reviews to continuously improve system quality. Contribute to infrastructure and observability practices alongside the Engineering team — you won't own this alone, but you'll be expected to care about how your services run in production. What You'll Bring Strong, demonstrable engineering experience, ideally including Python. We weigh the depth and relevance of your experience rather than years served, so there's no hard minimum. Production AI/agent experience: you've personally built and run an LLM or agent system with real users in production, not demos or prototypes. Hands-on experience with LangSmith or an equivalent LLM/agent platform. This one's essential. We're looking for genuine, practical use rather than awareness, so you should be able to talk us through what you built and ran on it. Evaluations: you've written evals to measure and improve the quality of an LLM or agent system. Solid API design skills: you've built and maintained production APIs and know how to integrate with external systems. Cloud and deployment experience: you've worked with AWS services (e.g. Lambda, ECS, S3) in production, and you're comfortable with CI/CD deployment pipelines like CircleCI. Database proficiency: you're comfortable with SQL (Postgres or similar) and have some exposure to NoSQL stores. A structured approach to problem-solving: you think clearly about system design and trade-offs. Strong collaboration skills: you communicate well across engineering, product and design. Nice to Have Experience with Node.js frameworks like NestJS or Express. Hands-on experience with Terraform, or infrastructure-as-code tooling. Experience with Helm and Kubernetes. Experience with observability platforms like Datadog (metrics, tracing, alerting). Exposure to DynamoDB or other NoSQL databases at scale. Experience with distributed or event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS, etc.). Interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, or compliance — though we're happy to bring you up to speed. Don't Meet Every Requirement? If this role excites you but your experience doesn't perfectly match every bullet point, we'd still love to hear from you. We value curiosity, willingness to learn, and diverse perspectives just as much as specific tool experience. Ensuring that people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences feel welcome at Elliptic is an ongoing priority for us. We believe diverse thinking enables us to solve problems in new ways — benefiting both our team and our customers.

 Ready to shape strategy where it matters? As a (Senior) Strategy Consultant (f/m/d) , you'll take on real responsibility from your first project - from concept to implementation across industries like Automotive & Batteries, Consumer Packaged Goods, Electronics & Semiconductor, Life Sciences and Power Utilities. Backed by Siemens technologies, you'll solve complex problems where strategy meets the real-world and make your mark both for our clients and within Siemens itself.
 What we offer you   
 Attractive remuneration package  
 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family  
 Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG  
 Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date  
 Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement  
 Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here . 
 The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions. 
 You'll make an impact by     
 Owning complex workstreams end-to-end. You grasp unfamiliar problems quickly, structure them efficiently, and develop recommendations tailored to what the client actually needs.    
 Building AI into the answer, not next to it. Agentic systems, industrial copilots, and applied analytics are core to what clients ask us for. You judge where they create measurable value and where they don't, and you make that case to a skeptical board.    
 Keeping projects firmly on course. You build relationships with mid- to senior-level stakeholders, understand what drives them, and hold the line on priorities when the ground shifts mid-project .  
 Seeing your work go live. Because implementation sits under the same roof, your recommendations move from slide to pilot to rollout, across our industry units.    
 Acting as a team role model. You mentor junior colleagues on analytical techniques, give feedback that helps them grow, and shape how we work rather than only what we deliver.   
 Shaping Siemens from within. Alongside client projects, you take on transformation topics inside Siemens, a perspective on industrial transformation you won't get from client work alone.   
 This is how you'll win us over 
 Consulting experience:  3 -5 years in strategy consulting, with a proven track record of leading workstreams and managing client relationships independently.  
 Academic Excellence:  Strong Master's, Ph.D., or MBA with a quantitative or technical core, or from a top business school.   
 AI in practice: AI is embedded in your daily work and problem-solving approach. You instinctively judge where technology creates real business value and where it doesn’t. Hands-on experience with agents, LLM applications, or data products is a big plus.  
 Global Mindset: International exposure gained through studies, internships, or work experience abroad.   
 Analytical skills: Ability to build defensible recommendations on incomplete data and explicitly state underlying assumptions.   
 Empathetic Leadership: Demonstrated experience guiding junior colleagues and actively fostering their professional growth.   
 Languages Proficiency:  Fluent German (min. C1) and English (min. C1), both required. Many of our client discussions happen in German, so English alone is not sufficient for this role.   
 You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you! 
 At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant. 
 As an equal opportunity employer , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.

Dans le cadre de la forte croissance de l'un de nos clients dans le secteur des transports, nous recherchons un(e) IA Engineer. 🎯 Votre Mission : Passer les modèles d'IA de l'expérimentation à la production Rattaché(e) au CTO, votre rôle sera de concevoir, développer et industrialiser des solutions basées sur l'Intelligence Artificielle (Machine Learning, Deep Learning, LLM/IA Générative) et d'assurer leur intégration fluide et performante dans les produits de l'entreprise. Vos responsabilités s'articulent autour de 4 piliers : Développement & Optimisation IA : Sélectionner, fine-tuner et concevoir les algorithmes et architectures IA adaptés aux besoins métier. Industrialisation & MLOps : Déployer les modèles en production, automatiser leur réentraînement et monitorer leurs performances. Intégration Applicative : Exposer les fonctionnalités IA via des APIs scalables pour les équipes Software. Veille & Innovation : Expérimenter en continu les dernières avancées (LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, vision/audio) pour créer de la valeur. 1. Conception, Fine-Tuning & Algorithmes Concevoir et développer des architectures IA / ML applicatives (NLP, LLMs, Vision par ordinateur, systèmes de recommandation). Sélectionner, adapter et fine-tuner des modèles open-source ou propriétaires (ex: Hugging Face, OpenAI, Mistral). Développer des architectures RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) et intégrer des bases de données vectorielles (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus). 2. MLOps, Industrialisation & Mise en Production Mettre en place des pipelines MLOps pour automatiser l'entraînement, la validation et le versioning des modèles et des données (MLflow, DVC). Conteneuriser (Docker) et déployer les modèles sur des infrastructures Cloud scalables (GPUs/CPUs). Mettre en place le monitoring continu en production (dérive des données/data drift, dérive des performances, temps de réponse, coûts). 3. Développement Backend & Intégration Développer des APIs ultra-performantes et sécurisées (FastAPI, Python) pour exposer les modèles aux applications. Optimiser l'inférence des modèles pour réduire la latence et les coûts de calcul (ONNX, TensorRT, vLLM). Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les Data Engineers (accès aux données) et les Développeurs Backend. Environnement de travail stimulant et collaboratif Opportunités de développement professionnel Culture d'entreprise axée sur l'innovation Participation à des projets variés et enrichissants Possibilité d'évolution au sein de l'entreprise 🎓 Formation & Expérience Formation : Bac+5 (École d'ingénieurs, Master IA / Data Science / Informatique). items.desc: AI Engineer Location: Co Westmeath, mostly on-site Type: Permanent Reports to: Engineering Lead About the Role My client, based in Co Westmeath, is a growing international business. They’re hiring a permanent AI Engineer to design, build and run AI-powered applications, intelligent agents and data-driven solutions that automate work and support better decision-making. This is a hands-on role blending software engineering, data engineering and applied AI. You’ll build scalable, secure, production-ready solutions using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and modern AI frameworks, and you’ll turn the company’s proprietary data into reliable, automated insight and action. Key Responsibilities Design, build and maintain AI agents and agentic workflows that automate data processing, analysis, reporting and wider business processes. Build LLM-powered applications, integrating external models and services while optimising prompts, context management, performance and cost. Develop RAG solutions, vector databases and AI-driven data pipelines that combine structured and unstructured data. Build integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) and APIs to securely connect AI systems to internal databases, applications and third-party services. Own AI features from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, observability, safe rollback and evaluation of accuracy, latency, reliability and cost. Apply MLOps/LLMOps best practice, including version control, CI/CD, containerisation and automated deployment. Put guardrails, access controls and audit trails around agents working with sensitive data, in line with security, privacy and responsible AI standards. Work with data engineers, data scientists and business stakeholders to turn business problems into practical AI solutions, and keep clear technical documentation. Skills & Experience Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline. 3+ years in software engineering, data engineering or AI/ML development, with a track record of delivering production solutions. Strong Python, with hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude or similar) and AI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex or equivalent. Working knowledge of MCP, RAG, vector databases, embeddings and system-level prompt engineering. Experience with Azure AI or other cloud AI platforms, plus MLOps/LLMOps practices, Docker and CI/CD. Solid grasp of AI security, governance, privacy and responsible AI. Experience in a regulated industry is desirable. Ability to translate business requirements into practical AI solutions. The Person A self-directed technical expert who can work on their own initiative and deliver best-practice AI that supports the team’s goals. Curious and pragmatic, keeping pace with a fast-moving AI landscape and recommending new tools only where they add real business value. A strong relationship builder who communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Our technology powers public transport systems in more than 200 cities worldwide, helping operators deliver smarter, more connected journeys. But we're just as passionate about transforming how we work. Artificial Intelligence is changing every part of modern business. We're not interested in experimenting for experimentation's sake—we're focused on using AI to solve real business problems, improve productivity and create better experiences for our employees and customers. That's where you come in. We're looking for an AI Engineer to help shape the future of AI at Vix. This is an opportunity to build the internal AI capability of a global technology company from the ground up, working across every business function to identify opportunities, develop intelligent applications and embed AI into the way we work every day. It's about taking great ideas and turning them into production-ready tools that people genuinely enjoy using. You'll become the organisation's technical expert on AI, helping define best practice, evaluate emerging technologies and ensure AI is deployed responsibly, securely and effectively. items.desc: Contribuez aux grandes transformations des entreprises et des acteurs publics en alliant innovation technologique et expertise métier, au service de nos clients et de la société pour les faire avancer durablement. Au-delà de la RSE, nous avons développé notre propre approche, RESET, qui englobe l’ensemble de nos engagements en matière de responsabilité économique, sociale, environnementale et technologique, tant au sein de notre collectif que chez nos clients. Onepoint, est une entreprise inclusive, handi accueillante, avec une politique de diversité affirmée. Votre futur collectif : La Communauté Atlantique regroupe 350 talents Expertises: Data/IA, Architecture, Développement, Product/ Projet Management, Test, Devops/Cloud, Cybersécurité. 3000m² d’espaces de travail exceptionnels et flambant neufs en plein centre-ville (Salle de sport, Fablab, Medialab, Livepoint…). Solidement ancrée auprès de comptes locaux, elle dispose d’un centre d’excellence reconnu également nationalement. Dotée d’une forte dynamique collective, elle offre un cadre stimulant le développement des expertises en connexion avec nos communautés nationales et met en œuvre des modèles à forte valeur ajoutée pour ses clients. Vous intervenez entre autres sur les missions suivantes : Implémenter des solutions RAG, agents IA et assistants métiers. Intégrer des LLM dans les systèmes existants et orchestrer leurs interactions. Optimiser les prompts, embeddings et chaînes d’orchestration pour améliorer la pertinence et la performance. Gérer les problématiques de coûts, latence et sécurité des solutions GenAI. Mettre en place les bonnes pratiques de gouvernance et de conformité pour l’IA générative. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Data, IT et métiers pour assurer la cohérence des solutions. Vos challenges au quotidien : Vous intervenez sur tout le cycle de vie du projet, du conseil au code : Cadrer et architecturer : analyser le besoin métier pour définir la meilleure stratégie (RAG, agents, fine-tuning) et la stack adaptée à l'environnement client. Industrialiser : développer du code robuste et modulaire (Python) pour intégrer les LLM aux SI existants (API, Data Lakes) et sortir de la logique de POC. Optimiser et sécuriser : garantir la viabilité des solutions en maîtrisant les coûts/latences (LLMOps) et en implémentant les barrières de sécurité (guardrails). Accompagner : vulgariser les concepts techniques et guider les équipes métiers et IT du client dans l'adoption de ces nouvelles technologies. Votre palette technique : Nous ne cherchons pas un expert d'un seul outil, mais un ingénieur capable de naviguer dans des écosystèmes variés. Voici les technologies sur lesquelles vous serez amené(e) à intervenir et conseiller : Le socle : maîtrise indispensable de Python et des bonnes pratiques de Software Engineering (Clean Code, Git, CI/CD) pour garantir la robustesse des livrables chez nos clients. LLM et orchestration : capacité à orchestrer des chaînes complexes (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel) et à choisir le bon modèle pour le bon usage (OpenAI, Azure AI, Bedrock, Vertex AI, ou solutions open source type Mistral/Llama). Data et bases vectorielles : savoir intégrer la solution dans l'écosystème data du client, que ce soit sur Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate ou directement via pgvector/Elasticsearch. Architecture et cloud : aisance à déployer aussi bien sur AWS, Azure que GCP, ou dans des environnements on-premise contraints. LLMOps : mettre en place les outils de monitoring et d'évaluation adaptés au client (LangSmith, MLflow, Ragas, etc.). Votre profil : ingénieur et pédagogue Expérience : vous avez un background solide en Data Science, Data Engineering ou Software Engineering (min. 2 ans) et avez pivoté vers l'IA générative avec des premières réalisations concrètes (projets pros ou personnels avancés). Polyvalence : vous ne bloquez pas si le client utilise Azure au lieu d'AWS. Vous apprenez vite et savez vous adapter aux contraintes (legacy, sécurité bancaire, etc.). Posture conseil : vous savez vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes. Vous êtes capable d'expliquer pourquoi un RAG est nécessaire (ou non) à un directeur métier. Mindset « Prod-Ready » : vous codez proprement. Vous savez que la valeur d'un consultant se mesure à la pérennité de ce qu'il laisse derrière lui.  Build and integrate REST APIs, backend services and data processing components following established software engineering practices.
 Explore and prototype automation opportunities, including AI-assisted and agent-based solutions supporting data curation, operational workflows, testing and documentation.
 Contribute to user-facing capabilities with a focus on usability, including API-first services, notebook-based workflows and interactive geospatial applications.
 Participate in the design and implementation of data ingestion, transformation and integration workflows across multiple systems and providers.
 Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing processes and software delivery workflows.
 Troubleshoot performance, configuration and integration issues across platform components with support from senior team members.
 Collaborate with internal teams and technical suppliers on integration activities, technical reviews and delivery milestones.
 Produce and maintain technical documentation, software design specifications, requirements analyses and operational procedures.
 Stay informed about emerging technologies and best practices in cloud-native geospatial platforms, workflow orchestration and AI-enabled automation.

items.desc: Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise qui place l’humain au cœur de ses préoccupations ? On vous attend chez Extia ! Société de conseil spécialisée dans les métiers de l’IT et du digital, Extia privilégie depuis sa création en 2007 une approche qui allie performance et bien-être au travail . Une vision de l’entreprise partagée aujourd’hui par plus de 2 500 Extiens en France et à l'international et récompensée par le label Great Place to Work® depuis 15 ans dont 10 ans sur le podium et 3 années consécutives à la première place du palmarès ! Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et nous offrons à chaque candidat la possibilité de révéler son potentiel, sans distinction et de quelque nature qu'elle soit. Chez Extia, c’est « D’abord qui, ensuite quoi » alors, allons-y ! D'abord qui D'abord qui ️ Compétences Requises ️ Architecture Cloud & SI Environnement Cloud : Expertise sur Google Cloud (GCP) / Vertex AI en priorité. La maîtrise d'Azure ou AWS est un plus apprécié. Intégration SI : Solide maîtrise des architectures distribuées, des API, de la gestion des identités et des flux de données. Socle Data : Connaissances avancées en Data Engineering et structuration des socles de données. Expertise IA & LLMOps IA Agentique & RAG : Maîtrise des architectures RAG avancées, des agents IA et du protocole MCP. Outillage IA : Pratique de Vertex AI, Dataiku ou environnements équivalents. LLMOps & Sécurité : Maîtrise des enjeux d'évaluation, de supervision de modèles en prod, et sécurité OWASP LLM. Profil Recherché Expérience : 6 ans minimum d'expérience, dont 2 à 3 ans sur des projets Data ou IA déployés en production. Parcours : Idéalement issu d'un parcours de Développeur ayant évolué vers le rôle d'Architecte Cloud ou Data (avec une première expérience en cabinet de conseil). Certifications (un vrai plus) : Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect ou Machine Learning Engineer. Posture : Capacité à dialoguer d'égal à égal avec une DSI, arbitrages argumentés à l'écrit comme à l'oral, et forte capacité de vulgarisation auprès des métiers. Langues : Français & Anglais courants (lu, parlé, écrit). Ensuite quoi Ensuite quoi Contexte & Ambition Passer du prototype à la production impose des choix structurants : choix des modèles, hébergement, sécurité et maîtrise des coûts. En tant qu’Architecte IA / IA Agentique, vous arbitrez ces choix complexes avec le client, garantissez la faisabilité technique dès la phase d'avant-vente et concevez des architectures pérennes intégrées au SI client. Missions Principales Architecture Cible : Concevoir les architectures des solutions d’IA Générative (RAG, agents autonomes, protocole MCP) et orchestrer leur intégration au SI existant. Arbitrages Techniques : Sélectionner les modèles, les modes d'hébergement et les approches (Build vs Buy, RAG vs Fine-tuning) en fonction des contraintes budgétaires et métiers. Sécurité & Conformité : Définir le cadre de protection des données, gérer les accès et parer aux failles de sécurité spécifiques aux LLM (OWASP LLM Top 10). Industrialisation & Supervision : Cadrer la mise en production : mise en place de frameworks d'évaluation, supervision continue (LLMOps) et maîtrise des coûts d’usage des modèles. Avant-vente & Chiffrage : Rédiger la partie technique des propositions commerciales, chiffrer les solutions et défendre les architectures en soutenance aux côtés des équipes business.
